israel.title: Account Executive, Mid Market
israel.description:
At Similarweb, we are revolutionizing the way businesses interact with the digital world by revealing to them everything that happens online.

Our unique data and solutions empower over 6,000 customers globally, including industry giants like Google, eBay, and Adidas, to make game-changing decisions that drive their digital strategies. In 2021, we went public on the New York Stock Exchange and continue reaching new heights! Come work alongside Similarwebbers who are bright, curious, practical, and good people.

We’re looking for an Account Executive to drive growth in our Mid-Market book of business. This role will report to the VP of Commercial Sales.

Why is this role so important at Similarweb?

Similarweb’s digital intelligence solutions serve thousands of customers across many different industries and use cases around the world, and we’ve just scratched the surface of our addressable market.

With recognizable customers who love our product, strong brand recognition, and an incredible team, you’ll have the power of a well-established company behind you with the flexibility to help us develop a blueprint for success in the Mid-Market. You’ll control the entire sales cycle, develop critical relationships with mid-sized enterprise accounts, and partner closely with leadership to help us refine our approach and scale up the team.

So, what will you be doing all day?

In this role you will be responsible for:

- Market Research: Stay informed about industry trends, competitive landscape, and client needs to effectively position our solutions

- Sales Strategy: Collaborate with the Marketing and Sales Development teams to create and execute effective sales programs

- Opportunity Generation: Identify and qualify new sales opportunities through various channels; including inbound leads and outbound prospecting

- Sales Presentations: Conduct product walkthroughs and presentations tailored to the unique needs of your customers and our value proposition

- Proposal Development: Prepare and present customized proposals and contracts to potential clients.

- Relationship Building: Develop and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers and stakeholders within target accounts

- Sales Reporting: Maintain accurate records of sales activities, pipeline, and forecasts in Salesforce

This Is The Perfect Job For Someone Who:

- Has a minimum of three years of experience in managing consultative sales processes with mid-sized enterprise accounts

- Has a demonstrated history of exceeding sales targets for high-end Saas sales

- Can confidently present in front of important clients and stakeholders

- Is highly collaborative, and uses a direct and honest approach to deliver customer success

- Brings a high level of energy and activity every day to keep their pipeline full

- Nice to Have: Showcases knowledge and experience selling into the Retail and CPG sectors

A PLUS: Has a clear understanding of current digital marketing trends, including SEO, content marketing, PPC, social and display advertising.

**At Similarweb, collaborating with our colleagues in-office creates a more connected, unified culture. Our best work is a product of our face-to-face collaboration, with the ability to work partially from home.**

The base salary range for this position in the New York City area is $85,000 to $110,000, plus benefits, including: medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401K plan, potential equity, employee stock purchase plan, and paid sick and parental leave.

In addition, this position is eligible to participate in the company’s sales incentive plan, with a maximum target OTE of up to $220,000, depending upon the final terms of employment and achievement of established targets.Individual compensation is based upon a number of factors, including qualifications and relevant experience.

The base salary range above is for the New York City area, and could vary for candidates in other locations.

Why you’ll love being a Similarwebber:

You’ll get to sell a product you actually believe in: Our customers aren’t our only raving fans. When we asked our employees why they chose to come work at Similarweb, 99% of them said “the product.” Imagine how exciting your job is when you get to work with the most powerful digital intelligence platform in the world.

You’ll find a home for your big ideas:  We encourage an open dialogue and empower employees to bring their ideas to the table. You’ll find the resources you need to take initiative and create meaningful change within the organization.

We offer competitive perks & benefits: We take your well-being seriously, and offer competitive compensation packages to all employees. We also put a strong emphasis on community, with regular team outings and happy hours.

You can grow your career in any direction you choose: Interested in becoming a VP or want to transition into a different department? Whether it’s Career Week, personalized coaching, or our ongoing learning solutions, you’ll find all the tools and opportunities you need to develop your career right here.

Diversity isn’t just a buzzword: People want to work in a place where they can be themselves. We strive to create a workplace that is reflective of the communities we serve, where everyone is empowered to bring their full, authentic selves to work. We are committed to inclusivity across race, gender, ethnicity, culture, sexual orientation, age, religion, spirituality, identity and experience. We believe our culture of equality and mutual respect also helps us better understand and serve our customers in a world that is becoming more global, more diverse, and more digital every day.

Please note: We’re unable to sponsor employment visas at this time.

israel.title: Analytics Engineer in Data Collection
israel.description:
At Similarweb, we’re not just another data company—we’re the leading digital intelligence platform used by global giants like Google, eBay, and Adidas. 🌍 Our insights power the digital strategies of over 4,300 companies worldwide, and we’re growing fast. After going public on the New York Stock Exchange in 2021, we continue to break new ground, and now we’re expanding our dynamic team in Prague! 🇨🇿

We’re looking for a Analytics Engineer to join the Data Collection Operations team and contribute to the configuration writing, monitoring and big data analysis of Similarweb’s data collection services. This role involves working as part of a team responsible for ensuring the accuracy and reliability of our data collection processes across mobile and desktop devices.



What is this role crucial?

As the most trusted platform for measuring online behavior, millions of people rely on Similarweb’s insights daily as the ground truth for their knowledge of the digital world. Producing these insights requires large scale raw data to be collected in high quality and with minimal outages.



As a Analytics Engineer, you will have the opportunity to perform hands-on work and take ownership of Similarweb’s raw data collection, monitoring and quality assurance processes. Your work will have a direct impact on the insights our products deliver to our customers.



What You'll Be Doing Day-to-Day

As a Data Analyst, you’ll be involved in a range of tasks that include:

- Configuration Writing: Create and maintain configuration files that define what data needs to be collected from web pages or APIs

- Data Monitoring & Validation: Monitor data flow and quality using Grafana and other tools, ensuring the collected data meets business requirements

- Use the AI tools to automate configuration autohealing and reduce alert fatigue

- Continuously learn and evaluate new technologies to improve the processes

- Collaborate with product managers and other data team leaders to enhance, monitor and maintain high-quality data collection

- Perform code reviews, collaborate on monitoring system improvement, answer data-related questions

- Having lots of fun!



This is the perfect job for someone who:

- Has 3+ years of experience in data analysis

- Is proficient in technologies such as Databricks, Spark, Airflow, Grafana, or similar tools

- Has proven experience performing complex data analysis using SQL, Pyspark or Python

- Knowledge of HTML, JavaScript, AI tools is a bonus

- Acts as a trusted data partner by providing fast, reliable responses to data-related questions, while quickly identifying and resolving data issues

- Is comfortable taking challenges and learning new technologies



Why you’ll love being a Similarwebber:

- Impact😎: Work on a platform used by Google, eBay or Adidas.

- Innovation🚀: Bring your ideas to life with full support.

- Hybrid work model: 3 days in our office and  2 days working from home🏡.

- Our office: Join us in our new office at DOCK IN (Palmovka) -  stocked with snacks, drinks, and space to unwind.

- Great perks: 5 weeks of vacation, an extra day off during your birthday month, 3 sick days and a multisport card 😎

- Top hardware👩🏻‍💻: You'll work with a MacBook Pro M5, dual monitors, and electric standing desk.

- Team spirit: We host team-building events, parties, weekly lunches, and happy hours throughout the year 🎉.

- Access to equity programs💸: Join in the success of Similarweb by becoming a shareholder!

israel.description:
Similarweb is the leading digital intelligence platform used by over 3500 global customers. Our wide range of solutions power the digital strategies of companies like Google, eBay, and Adidas.

Your mission is to turn that data into a single, trusted view: classifying products into a unified taxonomy, normalizing brands and attributes, and matching the same entities across sources. This is an applied ML role within data engineering. You’ll build with LLMs, agentic frameworks such as LangGraph, embeddings and classical ML, and ship them as production pipelines. - Designing and building LLM-powered and ML-based pipelines that classify, normalize, structure and match product, brand and category data

- Choosing the right approach for each problem (LLMs, embeddings, fine-tuned models, classical classifiers or rules), balancing accuracy, cost and latency

- Working closely with Product to define requirements and shape the roadmap

israel.description:
Location: London (hybrid, 3 days per week in office)
Team: Enterprise Sales, EMEA
Reports to: Head of Enterprise Sales, EMEA
Position type: Individual contributor, quota carrying

Similarweb makes the digital world measurable: Which markets are growing? Where is demand moving? How do consumers find, engage with and ultimately choose brands?

Global brands including Google, eBay and Adidas use our data to make decisions they would otherwise make on instinct. We are listed on the New York Stock Exchange and recently surpassed $300 million in annual recurring revenue, with more than 470 customers now investing over $100,000 a year with us.

Enterprise is where the next phase of that growth in EMEA comes from, and we are adding an Enterprise Account Executive in London to help deliver it.

Why this role exists

Enterprise new business is our strategic priority in EMEA, and this team is how we win it. We sell directly into the market rather than managing existing accounts. That approach has been built and proven across the region, and the next phase is growing the team behind it.

The timing helps. How people discover and choose brands is changing faster than at any point since search became the default, and most enterprises still have no reliable way to measure it. That is the conversation you open with executives.

The role

You will own a named list of enterprise accounts end to end, in our focus industries of Retail, CPG, Financial Services, Utilities, Telco and Travel. Your market is Tier 1 EMEA: the UK, France, Germany, Italy, Spain and the Nordics.

Beyond your named list, inbound demand and Sales Development activity generate qualified conversations across the wider market, and those come to you.

You will typically sell across marketing, strategy, insights and e-commerce. Our strongest engagements are the ones that reach Director or C-level, where the use case is tied to a decision the business is already trying to make. You will carry an annual quota with quarterly milestones.

What you will be doing

- Meeting quarterly and annual quota by generating revenue from your named accounts and from inbound and Sales Development demand

- Opening accounts from cold by prospecting with our own data, and qualifying inbound demand properly

- Running the full cycle: prospecting, discovery, value case, commercial negotiation and close

- Winning against the incumbent, a competitive bid, or the option to do nothing, by making the clearer commercial case

- Finding the right champion inside the account, and equipping them to carry the business case when you are not in the room

- Credibility at executive level, making a commercial argument rather than delivering a product demo

- A history of building accounts from cold and turning them into revenue

- Strong discovery. You open with questions that surface what is genuinely at stake

- Experience selling data or insight against a broad set of use cases rather than a single point solution

Five years is a guide rather than a threshold. We are more interested in how you sell and what you have closed than in time served.

The team you are joining

We value drive, ambition and results. The team is led by a former individual contributor who has carried this number and hit it. We use a blend of sales methodologies rather than one, and we measure outcomes, not activity.

israel.title: Lead Data Analyst
israel.description:
Lead Data Analyst

About the team

This team is the bridge between our data and our customer-facing organization. Two things sit with us, and they feed each other.

- Answering the data questions nobody else can. A customer’s numbers do not line up with what they see in their own analytics. A metric moved and the account team needs to explain why. These arrive as tickets from across the customer-facing organization, rarely well specified, and closing one means working through the data and the pipelines behind it.

- Making the next question unnecessary. We turn what we learn into automated tooling, agents and AI-assisted products, so those teams get to the explanation and the insight themselves.

Every investigation is knowledge, and the tooling is how it reaches the rest of the company. The team has three people: this role, a data analyst, and an analytics engineer.



About the role

- Roughly 80% hands-on analysis, 20% management. You will be in the data most days. Two direct reports come with the role, but management is not the majority of the job and is not meant to become it.

- Knowing which data to use. We are a data company with a very large number of datasets, and most questions can be approached from several of them. Choosing the right one, and understanding how it was produced and where its limits are, is the central analytical skill here.

- Owning the answer, not the ticket. These answers usually turn on how a metric is defined and measured, so precision matters: what goes back has to hold up when the customer asks the next question.

- Deciding when to stop answering and start building. You see the whole flow of incoming questions, so you are the one who judges which recurring one is worth automating away, and who shapes it with the analytics engineer.

- Suited to someone who wants to lead a small team without stepping away from the work, and who digs into why a number looks off before moving on.



What the job involves

- Running escalated data investigations end to end: reproducing the issue, tracing the number back to its source, and answering it.

- Occasionally joining customer calls on urgent data issues.

- Deciding what the team works on: what gets answered now, and what gets an owner and a deadline.

- Reporting what we find to the teams that produce our data, bringing them in with the evidence and the context they need.

- Setting how the team runs: intake, routing, ownership and response expectations, with enough shared knowledge that any of the three of you can pick up any investigation.

- Turning recurring questions into permanent answers: documentation, dashboards, and internal tools and agents built with the analytics engineer.

- Managing two people, including technical direction for the analytics engineer.

- Using AI assistants such as Claude or Cursor as a normal part of the daily workflow.



What the role needs

- Python is a must. On top of that, strong SQL or PySpark, and if PySpark is not there yet, the ability and willingness to pick it up quickly.

- Excellence at working out where a number came from: choosing the right dataset among many, understanding how it was built, and getting to the bottom of problems in systems you did not build.

- Working experience with a notebook environment, a cloud platform and Git is a must. Our stack is Databricks, AWS and GitLab and  the stack will keep expanding as we automate more, so picking up new tools matters.

- Enough software engineering to lead an engineer: version control, code review, pipelines and deployment. You will not write production code every day, but you do have to review plans, weigh trade-offs and set direction.

- Leadership experience, and the wish to keep growing in it. The formal side comes with the role: objectives, feedback and development for two people.

- Judgement about how far to take an investigation: some deserve a day, some two weeks. Analytical correctness is non-negotiable.

- The ability to explain data to people who are not technical, including customers, precisely and without hiding behind the detail.

- Ownership in ambiguity. Problems arrive without a specification, often without an obvious owner, and with someone already waiting on the answer.

Nice to have

- Experience with modelled or estimated data, such as panel data, web analytics or forecasting, where the method has to be explained as well as the number.

- Experience building or specifying AI-powered internal tools.



Why you’ll love being a Similarwebber:

- Impact😎: Work with the most powerful digital intelligence platform in the world, loved by both customers and employees.

- Innovation🚀: We value open dialogue and empower everyone to bring their ideas forward. You'll have the support and resources to take initiative and drive real change

israel.title: Product Designer - Maternity Leave
israel.description:
At Similarweb, we are a leading AI-powered digital intelligence company. By providing AI with massive scale data on actual online behaviors - including searches, site visits, and transactions - we deliver actionable market insights. Today, over half of the Fortune 500 trust our platform to drive their strategic next steps.

In 2021, we went public on the New York Stock Exchange and continued reaching new heights! Work alongside Similarwebbers who are bright, curious, practical, and good people.

We are looking for a curious and hands-on Product Designer to join our design team as a maternity leave replacement. You'll take your product areas from A to Z, working closely with product managers and engineers to turn complex problems into intuitive designs that serve both user needs and business goals.

You will join a centralized design team reporting to a practicing product designer, ensuring collaborative feedback and support.

This is not the same job it was two years ago. AI is changing what we build - our product is moving toward AI agents and AI-driven insights on top of the most comprehensive digital dataset in the world. It's changing how we build it - research, prototyping, design systems, and handoff to engineering all work differently now. And it's changing the tools we use, including the ones we're building for ourselves. The field is reshaping as we go and we adjust with it. We're looking for someone who finds that exciting rather than exhausting.

So, what will you be doing all day?

Your role as a Product Designer at Similarweb means your daily responsibilities may include:

- Owning meaningful areas of our product - from research and ideation through user flows, prototyping, testing, microcopy, and all the way to launch.

- Turning dense, complex data into experiences people can actually read, trust, and act on.

- Designing AI-powered experiences: agentic flows, prompt- and conversation-driven interfaces, and AI-generated insights. That means designing for the hard parts too - non-deterministic outputs, trust and explainability, keeping a human in the loop, and what the experience looks like when the model gets it wrong.

- Using AI throughout your own process to get from idea to something real, fast - prototyping working flows instead of static screens, exploring more directions before committing, and putting real interactions in front of stakeholders and users early.

- Building, not only specifying. Some of what you design you'll take considerably further yourself, using AI tools to produce working features that engineering reviews before release. Knowing where that line sits - what's ready to ship and what needs a second pair of eyes - is part of the craft now.

- Maintaining and evolving our design system - components, variables, tokens, patterns, and guidelines - so quality and consistency hold as the product scales, and so anyone building against it (designer, engineer, or AI tool) ends up with something that looks and behaves like Similarweb.

- Using quantitative and qualitative data tools to research, track, and measure design flows.

- Communicating with stakeholders, including executives, on design decisions, progress, and outcomes.

- Bringing back what you learn. New tools, new workflows, better ways of working - we test them, and we adopt what works.

This is the perfect job for someone with:

- 3+ years of experience in product design, with a proven track record of delivering digital SaaS products.

- Strong data visualization instincts - you're at home in dense analytical interfaces: time series, benchmarks, funnels, and tables people actually use.

- A strong portfolio that demonstrates your design skills, process, and impact on business objectives.

- Hands-on experience working with AI as part of your day-to-day design practice - prototyping, exploration, research, or production work. We care much more about how you actually use it than about which tools you name.

- Enough technical literacy to build, not just hand off. You don't need to be an engineer, but you should be able to take a design further than a Figma file with AI tools, read what comes back, and tell good output from output that only looks good.

- Design systems experience - you're fluent in Figma libraries (components, variants, variables, tokens) and know how to keep design and code in sync with engineers. Having built one is a plus, not a requirement.

- Excellent communication skills - ability to present your designs and sell your solutions to various stakeholders.

- Comfort with ambiguity, and enough independence to be the only designer on a problem - setting your own bar, making the call, and knowing when to pull other people in. Ways of working here change often, and we want someone who helps shape that rather than waits for it to settle.

Advantages:

- Experience designing AI-native features - agents, copilots, chat, or generative interfaces - a significant advantage.

- Experience on complex SaaS or analytics platforms.

- Experience writing structured context files for AI tools (such as design.md, AGENTS.md, or custom prompt rules) so both people and AI models can follow them.

- Experience designing products for digital marketers, or in competitive intelligence, e-commerce, web analytics, or the mobile app ecosystem.



**At Similarweb, collaborating with our colleagues in the office creates a more connected, unified culture. Our best work is a product of our face-to-face collaboration, with the ability to work partially from home.**

Why you’ll love being a Similarwebber:

Manage data at scale. You'll design for data sets most designers never get near, and the best companies in the world will use what you ship to make real decisions.

Lead the AI era. You'll build with AI technology at a company engineered for the future - and in a design team actively working out what this craft becomes next, rather than waiting to be told.

Own your projects. The trust, autonomy and freedom to do your best work - and a small enough team that your decisions are visibly yours.

Grow from within. 1-1 mentorship, hands-on learning, skillful design guild, and a managerial team of designers.

israel.title: Product Manager
israel.description:
Product Manager – AI Transformation

We’re looking for an exceptional Product Manager to join our AI Transformation team and help reshape how Similarweb operates in the AI era.

This is not a traditional product role focused on managing a feature backlog.

You’ll work across the organization to identify high-impact business problems and processes, understand how they work today, and determine how AI, agents, automation, data, and software can fundamentally improve them.

You’ll take opportunities from problem discovery → prototype → pilot → production → adoption → measurable business impact.

What you'll do

- Identify high-impact opportunities for AI transformation across business functions such as Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Operations, Finance, and Product.

- Deeply understand existing workflows, user pain points, bottlenecks, and manual processes.

- Redesign workflows around AI rather than simply adding AI features to existing processes.

- Rapidly prototype solutions using LLMs, agents, APIs, automation platforms, and AI-assisted development tools.

- Work closely with Engineering, Data, business stakeholders, and leadership to turn successful prototypes into scalable products and systems.

- Define clear success metrics and measure business impact, including productivity, automation, conversion, quality, cost savings, and revenue impact.

- Run pilots with real users, learn quickly, and iterate based on data and feedback.

- Evaluate when we should build, buy, integrate, or automate rather than defaulting to building software internally.

- Drive adoption and organizational change - not just product delivery.

- Stay close to developments in AI and continuously identify new capabilities that can create meaningful business value.

What we're looking for

Product

- 4+ years of Product Management experience, with a strong preference for hands-on experience building 0→1 products in AI, automation, B2B SaaS, or other technically complex environments.

- Strong Product Management experience with a proven ability to take ambiguous problems and turn them into working solutions.

- Excellent product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

- Strong discovery skills and curiosity about how businesses actually operate.

- Comfortable owning problems rather than receiving predefined requirements.

AI & Technical

- AI-native: you actively use modern AI tools as part of how you work.

- Strong understanding of LLM-based products, agents, APIs, automation, data, and modern AI capabilities and limitations.

- Able to prototype independently using AI-assisted development tools.

- Comfortable discussing architecture and technical tradeoffs with engineers without necessarily being an ML engineer.

- Experience building AI-powered products, agents, automations, or internal tools is a significant advantage.

Business

- Strong business orientation, you naturally think about ROI and measurable outcomes.

- Ability to understand complex business processes quickly.

- Comfortable working across multiple departments and stakeholder groups.

- Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills.

- Able to operate effectively in environments where the problem and solution are initially unclear.

The mindset we're looking for

You hear: “This process takes our team 30 minutes per customer.”

And your instinct is not: “Let's write a PRD.”

It's:

“Why does this process exist? Which decisions are being made? What data do we have? What could an agent do? What still requires a human? Can I prototype this this week? And how would we measure whether it's better?”

We're looking for a builder, problem solver, and product thinker who wants to help define how an AI-native company should operate.

israel.description:

We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to build the distributed services, data access layers, and agent orchestration behind our AI-powered products - systems that serve analytics over billions of rows and run long-lived, LLM-driven workflows in production.



What You'll Do:

This role combines deep backend and distributed systems expertise with product thinking and the ability to leverage AI tools effectively across the development lifecycle. You will work closely with product, design, frontend, and data/AI teams to build reliable, performant services, while driving engineering excellence and modern development practices. Your contributions will shape the technical foundation of an AI-first product and directly influence what end users can ask of it.



What does the day to day of a Senior Backend Engineer at Similarweb look like:

Your daily work will span service architecture, data access at scale, workflow orchestration, and AI-augmented development, engaging directly with the systems that power our product.

Your role will include:

- Design and build scalable, maintainable backend services in Python (FastAPI, Pydantic, asyncio) and TypeScript (NestJS / Node.js)

- Own API design, contracts, and versioning across services - including the tool surfaces (MCP) our AI agents call directly

- Design and optimize data models, schemas, migrations, and query performance across transactional (PostgreSQL) and large-scale analytical stores (Firebolt, Athena, DuckDB)

- Build and operate asynchronous, long-running execution: durable workflow orchestration (Temporal), queues, scheduled jobs, and event-driven processing

- Integrate LLM and agent runtimes (LangGraph, MCP, model APIs) into production services behind deterministic, testable boundaries

- Implement authentication, authorization, and secure service-to-service integration patterns across an internal service mesh

- Build resilient upstream data-fetching layers: timeouts, retries with backoff, caching strategies, and graceful degradation when a source is slow or down

- Lead backend technical decisions, code quality standards, and system architecture

- Ensure system scalability, fault tolerance, and observability - structured logging, metrics, distributed tracing, and alerting that makes production debuggable

- Own services end to end in production: CI/CD pipelines, containerized deployments to Kubernetes, and the debugging that follows

- Partner with frontend engineers on API contracts, data shapes, performance budgets, and UX constraints - designing for the consumer without owning the UI

- Translate product requirements into robust, scalable technical solutions, working closely with product and design

- Conduct high-quality code reviews and drive architectural discussions and best practices

- Improve testing across the pyramid - unit, integration, and end-to-end against real service stacks - alongside observability and reliability

- Use AI coding tools effectively in daily development work (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, etc.), critically evaluating and refining AI-generated code, especially for backend logic and data integrity

- Design efficient personal/team workflows for AI-assisted development and contribute to engineering productivity through AI tooling and automation

What does the ideal candidate look like:

- 5+ years of backend engineering experience, building and operating production services at scale

- Strong proficiency in Python (FastAPI or an equivalent async framework) or in Node.js/TypeScript (NestJS) - with genuine willingness to work in both; our services run on each

- Experience designing scalable backend architectures, clear service boundaries, and data models that survive their second use case

- Deep understanding of API design, authentication and authorization flows, and distributed system tradeoffs

- Strong command of async and concurrent programming, and of long-running or distributed execution (workflow engines, queues, schedulers)

- Experience with relational and/or analytical databases, including schema design, migrations, and query optimization

- A track record of making queries fast and cost-efficient over large datasets - PostgreSQL at scale, or an OLAP/columnar engine such as Athena, Firebolt, BigQuery, Snowflake, or ClickHouse. The engine is learnable; the instinct for scan cost and data volume is what we are hiring for

- Strong understanding of system performance, reliability, and security best practices

- Experience with testing methodologies (unit, integration, E2E) and observability tooling - metrics, structured logs, distributed tracing

- Comfort owning the runtime: Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines

- Production experience putting LLM or model APIs inside a backend service, treating latency, failure modes, cost, and non-deterministic output as engineering problems rather than demo caveats

- Hands-on experience using AI development tools in daily workflows, with the ability to validate, debug, and improve AI-generated code

- Understanding of prompt engineering for engineering workflows and the ability to work effectively in fast iteration environments

- Strong product and technical intuition, with excellent communication and collaboration skills

- Enough frontend fluency (React, TypeScript) to reason about how your APIs are consumed - you will not own the UI, but you will design for it

- Nice to have: agent orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain) or the Model Context Protocol; a durable workflow engine (Temporal, Airflow, Step Functions); data platforms, analytics products, or BI tools

israel.title: Senior BI Engineer
israel.description:
Senior BI Engineer

Location: Givatayim, Israel Experience: 5+ Years Work model: Hybrid

We Are

At Similarweb, we’re revolutionizing how businesses understand the digital world by showing them everything that happens online. Our unique data and solutions empower over 13,000 customers worldwide -including Google, eBay, and Adidas - to make game-changing decisions that drive their digital strategies. We went public on the New York Stock Exchange in 2021, and we’re still reaching new heights! Come join Similarwebbers across the globe who are bright, curious, practical, and genuinely good people.

We Are Looking For

We are looking for an experienced talented BI Engineer to join our Data team in Givatayim. You will take end-to-end ownership of our data modeling, serving as the architect of the "Source of Truth" that powers our company's most critical strategic decisions. This is a hands-on engineering role: you will ship production code (SQL, dbt, Python) through a Git-based CI/CD workflow, use AI coding tools to move faster, build and implement AI based solutionsto turn the data into a critical part of decision making.

What You’ll Do

- Define the Source of Truth: Take raw, complex data and transform it into clean, well-structured tables that Product Analysts and Business Leads can use for high-stakes decision-making. You know how to build a table that is intuitive and easy for other analysts to query.

- Translate Strategy into Logic: Work with Product, Marketing, GTM analysts  to turn abstract concepts into precise SQL definitions and automated datasets.

- Maintain Data Integrity: Act as the guardian of our metrics. You will ensure that the numbers used across our product and business reports are consistent, reliable, and logical.

- Enable High-Tech Initiatives: Partner with our AI and Data Service specialists to ensure they have the structured data foundations they need to build models and external data products.

- Build Scalable Models: Design, build, and maintain production-grade data models using dbt, ensuring code is modular, tested, and documented.

Engineer with CI/CD Discipline: Treat analytics code like software. Work through pull requests, automated tests and deployments (GitHub/GitLab), code reviews, and version-controlled environments, so every change to the Source of Truth is tested before it ships.Build with AI: Use AI coding assistants (Cursor, Claude Code) in your daily workflow to speed up modeling, testing, documentation, and code review, and help the team define how we use them responsibly.Make Data AI-Ready: Build well-documented models with clear definitions and a consistent metrics layer, so analysts, AI agents, and data products can rely on the same trusted data.

- Take part in building Agentic solutions to support 24X7 solutions

This is a perfect job for someone who has:

- Experience of 5+ years of prior experience in a relevant analytics/technical role (Analytics Engineer, BI Engineer, BI Developer or Data Engineer).

- SQL Mastery: Expert-level SQL skills. You can write complex queries, optimize performance, and debug legacy code with ease.

- dbt Expertise: Proven hands-on experience with dbt. You are comfortable with Jinja templating, incremental models, and package management.

- Data Modeling: Experience with ETL processes and strong understanding of data warehousing concepts (Amazon Redshift/ Snowflake) and modeling methodologies .

- Product & Business Acumen: You understand SaaS metrics (ARR, funnels, activation, etc.) and how data logic impacts product growth and strategy.

CI/CD & Git Workflows: Hands-on experience with Git and CI processes for data projects: pull-request reviews, automated tests on every change, and automated deployments of dbt projects.AI-Assisted Development: Practical, day-to-day experience using AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code) to build faster, and the judgment to review and validate AI-generated code before it ships.

- Python : Experience with Python for data orchestration or custom transformationsAdvantages:

Orchestration: Experience with an orchestration tool (such as Airflow / Dagster / Prefect) for scheduling and monitoring data workflows.Data Quality & Observability: Experience with automated data tests, data contracts, monitoring, and alerting that keep stakeholders’ trust in the numbers.Data for AI: Experience building data foundations for LLMs or AI agents, such as semantic/metrics layers, text-to-SQL, or MCP-based data access.Performance & Cost: Experience tuning queries, models, and warehouse usage to keep the analytical data warehouse fast and cost-efficient.

Our Stack:

Redshift, dbt, Databricks ,Airflow, GitLab,Cursor -  any experience with similar tools is relevant.

Why Join Us?

- Impact: You are the architect of the data that drives our engines. Your work literally powers the team's ability to innovate.

- Growth: You will work on the cutting edge of the data stack, gaining exposure to AI implementation and high-scale data logic.

- Collaboration: Our best work comes from face-to-face teamwork in the office, with flexibility to work part-time from home.

- Culture: We’re inclusive, innovative, and supportive. We foster open dialogue and encourage big ideas.

- Perks: Competitive compensation, strong emphasis on well-being, comprehensive equity packages, and plenty of opportunities for team bonding.

About the Role

Riskified is building a new product-led growth motion designed to bring our technology to a much larger universe of ecommerce merchants. We are looking for a highly versatile, entrepreneurial marketer to work closely with the GM responsible for this business. This person will sit in Tel Aviv alongside the GM and act as an embedded marketing partner, with a strong connection to the broader Marketing organization.

This is not a traditional channel marketing or product marketing role. It is a hands-on growth role for someone who enjoys moving between strategy and execution. You will help define how merchants discover Riskified, understand our value, evaluate the product, convert, onboard, and engage. You might develop the positioning for a new merchant segment in the morning, write and build the corresponding landing page in the afternoon, and analyze its performance the following week.

The right person will be comfortable operating like a startup marketer inside a larger company. You should be able to identify an opportunity, develop a point of view, build something, launch it, learn from the results, and improve it without requiring a large team around you.

What You'll Be Doing

- Partner closely with the GM of Product-Led Growth to develop and execute the go-to-market strategy for Riskified's down-market business.

- Help design a scalable merchant journey across acquisition, education, evaluation, conversion, onboarding, activation, and expansion.

- Develop positioning and messaging that translates Riskified's sophisticated technology into clear and compelling value propositions for smaller and mid-sized ecommerce merchants.

- Design campaigns, landing pages, email and linkedin nurture programs, product education, sales enablement, and other merchant-facing experiences.

- Work directly in CMS and marketing technology platforms, including WordPress, to launch and iterate on experiences without relying on specialist resources for every change.

- Replicate and adapt existing website templates to quickly stand up new landing pages, campaign experiences, and tests.

- Use AI tools such as Claude extensively across research, writing, ideation, analysis, prototyping, content creation, and lightweight graphic design.

- Leverage brand design guidelines to create lightweight visual and creative assets when a full design process is not necessary, while knowing when to bring in specialist creative support.

- Develop experiments across the funnel to improve acquisition, conversion, activation, and engagement.

- Use analytics and customer behavior to identify friction, develop hypotheses, prioritize experiments, and determine what to improve next.

- Build repeatable workflows, templates, automation, and processes that allow the team to support a significantly larger volume of merchants efficiently.

- Partner across Product, Sales, Customer Success, Operations, Analytics, Design, and the broader Marketing organization to execute the growth strategy.

- Develop platform-specific marketing strategies (e.g. Shopify, Shopify Plus, WooCommerce, Adobe Commerce / Magento, etc.)

- Continuously gather merchant, competitive, and market insights and translate them into better messaging, experiences, and growth opportunities.

Qualifications

- 4+ years of experience across growth marketing, product marketing, digital marketing, lifecycle marketing, product-led growth, or related disciplines.

- Experience working in a startup, scale-up, or other environment where you were expected to operate with significant autonomy and limited specialist resources.

- Proven ability to take projects from strategy through hands-on execution.

- Excellent (ideally native) English-language writing, messaging, and communication skills.

- Strong instincts for positioning, customer psychology, and simplifying complex technology.

- Comfortable working directly with web CMS platforms (e.g. Wordpress), marketing automation tools, analytics platforms (e.g. Looker, HockeyStack, Mixpanel, GA4), and other digital marketing technology.

- Highly proficient with AI tools and able to use them to materially increase the speed and quality of your work.

- Strong visual judgment and the ability to create effective lightweight marketing assets without depending on a designer for every deliverable.

- Analytical and experimental mindset, with comfort working with funnel metrics, conversion rates, behavioral data, and experimentation.

- Strong process orientation and an interest in creating scalable systems rather than relying on manual execution.

- Ability to thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments with a high degree of autonomy and self-direction.

- Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with senior leaders.

- Experience in B2B SaaS, ecommerce, fintech, payments, fraud, or Shopify is a plus.

- Experience building a PLG, self-service, SMB, or mid-market growth motion is highly valuable.

- BA/BS degree or equivalent experience.

This is a high-impact role at the intersection of risk, payments, machine learning, and merchant experience. You'll help our merchants improve their conversion rates and reduce fraud across different types of payments, including credit cards and alternative payment methods. You'll work directly with Riskified's largest merchants to understand their payment and checkout processes, and with Engineering, Data Science, Analytics and GTM to turn those insights into new capabilities. - Build case studies and performance benchmarks that Sales uses to show the product's value in each market.

- Track competitors and market trends so that long-term decisions reflect the wider landscape.

- Experience with international markets and global payment ecosystems.

- Proven experience optimizing payment flows, such as authentication (3DS), approval rates or alternative payment methods (strong advantage).

- Understanding of payment fraud concepts such as fraud patterns, chargebacks and risk scoring (advantage).

- Passion for the payments ecosystem and enjoyment of time spent with customers learning their complex payment flows.

- A track record of leading cross-functional teams to validate and ship new capabilities.

- Proven experience working hands-on with data and analytics (e.g., SQL, BI tools) to drive product decisions.

At Riskified, we succeed when our merchants succeed. You'll sell across our newer solutions, spot use cases and verticals where Riskified can add value, and turn early merchant conversations into repeatable plays for the wider team. - A track record of selling new or early-stage products, or of opening a new market, segment or use case.

- Ability to build a business case and sell value to multiple stakeholders, including senior leaders.

- Enough technical fluency to discuss APIs, data flows and ecommerce architecture credibly, and willingness to go deeper quickly.

- Strong communication skills, with the ability to make complex concepts clear and persuasive for non-technical audiences.

- An entrepreneurial, curious mindset, comfortable with ambiguity, asking good questions and managing several merchant engagements at once.

- Based in the US, with willingness to travel occasionally for merchant and internal meetings.

This is an incentive-based role and a significant portion of compensation is based on performance against objectives. The base salary range for this position is $150,000_$170,000. This range is applicable to candidates who will perform the job either wholly, or in part, within New York City. Actual salary will be based on qualifications, competencies, and location. Base salary is just one part of the pay package at Riskified. All full-time regular employees receive a bonus target and are eligible to receive stock-based awards. Riskified is seeking a Senior AI Engineer to join a talented and fast-moving AI Engineering team. We're the central hub for AI across Riskified, driving innovation and putting AI to work for every team and product in the company.

AI already plays a foundational role in how Riskified operates. It lets us ship features quickly and at scale, equips non-technical team members with tools that boost their productivity, and underpins much of the innovation happening across the company today.

If this kind of environment excites you — and if you believe great engineering means crafting the most effective and elegant solution within real-world constraints — we'd love to hear from you.



About the Team

Our team takes on strategic, company-wide initiatives that shape Riskified's direction. We're a group of senior individual contributors who work hand in hand with a broad range of partners — product, business development, account management, and beyond — led by the organization's Chief Architect in close partnership with the CTO. Here, you can drive change not only in the technologies we adopt but in how the organization works. The role calls for more than engineering skill: you'll navigate the organization with ease and build effective relationships at every level, from engineers and managers to VP and C-suite leadership. If you thrive at the intersection of technical depth and broad organizational influence, this team is a rare canvas to make your mark.



Why Join Us?

This is a compelling opportunity to work at the forefront of the AI revolution, helping define and build the AI platform that will power Riskified's future. Together, we'll develop infrastructure for autonomous and interactive agents, establish guardrails and evaluation frameworks that ensure both performance and safety, and implement cutting-edge AI and agentic design patterns.

The role is also a distinctive entry point into the AI space. For those who already have some background in AI infrastructure, it offers meaningful growth within a team that is guiding Riskified's transition from AI experimentation to fully productized, AI-driven solutions.



What You'll Be Doing



- Design, build, and maintain reusable AI capabilities — spanning models, tools, APIs, and platforms that support both internal operations and customer-facing products.

- Develop and maintain our internal MCP server, giving AI agents easy and secure access to Riskified's extensive data stores.

- Create and implement rigorous evaluation frameworks and AI guardrails to protect Riskified's value and ensure model reliability.

- Cultivate deep expertise and establish sustainable AI engineering practices across the organization.

- Champion AI readiness and track adoption company-wide to build lasting impact.

- Build and optimize RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems.

- Own projects end to end — from gathering requirements from non-technical stakeholders through development, deployment, and ongoing operation.

- Serve as a consultant and advocate for AI engineering, guiding other teams in leveraging the platforms and tools you create.

- Collaborate with teams throughout Riskified to accelerate AI adoption and productization.



Qualifications



- 5+ years of solid backend and server-side development experience, building complex and highly scalable systems.

- Proven proficiency in at least one general-purpose language (Python preferred, though not required).

- A natural collaborator who builds trust across functions — comfortable working with product, business development, account management, and other non-technical partners, and able to translate between their needs and technical solutions.

- Strong product-oriented thinking, with the ability to elicit, refine, and prioritize requirements from non-technical stakeholders.

- A deep sense of ownership, some DevOps experience, and the drive to develop, deploy, and operate projects from start to finish.

- Able to navigate an organization and influence without authority — communicating effectively with engineers and managers as well as VP and C-suite leadership.

- A bias toward driving change: you spot opportunities to improve processes and accelerate technology adoption, and you act on them.

- High proficiency with AI-assisted coding tools such as Copilot, Cursor, or equivalents.

- Hands-on experience with public cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).

- Fluency in written and spoken English.



Bonus Points If You

- Are experienced with agentic coding tools like Claude Code or Copilot CLI.

- Have familiarity with Strands Agents (or comparable agentic frameworks), RAG architectures, and Bedrock.

- Have worked with MCP (Model Context Protocol).

- Are comfortable operating in containerized environments.

Senior Deal Strategy Manager (APAC)

Location: Singapore

Fast-Frogward Your Career to Years From Now

Be part of a team where your work directly shapes the way the world’s top companies build and secure their software. At JFrog, as a Senior Deal Strategy Manager, APAC you’ll play a key role in bringing our industry-leading solutions to market, helping customers like Amazon, Google, and Netflix solve their most pressing DevSecOps and AI/ML challenges. Every day offers new opportunities to collaborate, strategize, and innovate in a fast-paced, growth-driven culture. If you thrive in a dynamic environment and want to make an impact in the world of software, JFrog is the place for you.

What you’ll be doing as a Senior Deal Strategy Manager, APAC

JFrog is looking for a high-impact Senior Manager of Deal Strategy to serve as a strategic commercial architect and trusted advisor to our APAC Sales organization. In this critical role, you will partner with Sales Management to navigate large-scale, complex, and non-standard commercial structures, ensuring seamless execution while driving revenue growth. You will act as the central nexus between Sales, Finance, Legal, and Operations, building scalable frameworks that empower our leadership to make rapid, data-driven decisions in a fast-paced global environment.

In this role, you will...

- Serve as a strategic advisor to APAC Sales leadership, providing expert guidance on complex pricing, commercial terms, and deal architecture.

- Collaborate with Account Executives to engineer commercial models and financial strategies for key strategic accounts.

- Act as the subject matter expert on revenue compliance and sales policies, advising teams on creative yet compliant contract solutions.

- Partner cross-functionally with Revenue, Finance, Legal, and Sales Operations to resolve complex billing, legal, or revenue recognition hurdles.

- Analyze deal trends and discounting patterns to optimize commercial performance across the APAC territory.

- Vet and refine escalation requests to ensure senior management focus remains on the most critical strategic priorities.

If you don’t meet 100% of the requirements below – that’s okay, nobody’s perfect! We believe in hiring people, not just a list of skills. We encourage you to apply if you think this is a role that would make you excited about coming to work every day.

What you bring to the table...

- 8+ years of leadership experience within a Sales, Deal Strategy or Strategic Finance function.

- MBA or Master’s Degree in Finance, Economics, or a related quantitative field.

- Deep expertise in SaaS metrics (ARR), revenue recognition principles (ASC 606), and the lead-to-cash lifecycle.

- Proven track record supporting high-growth enterprise software sales organizations.

- Exceptional interpersonal skills with the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and executive leadership.

- Strong business acumen paired with superior analytical, problem-solving, and project management capabilities.

- Customer-facing experience with the ability to articulate complex financial structures and principles clearly.

- Highly organized, customer-focused, innovative, and strong attention to detail

- Ability to thrive under pressure and prioritize effectively during high-volume cycles.

About JFrog:

JFrog is the only end-to-end software supply chain platform that provides complete visibility, security, and control for automating the delivery of trusted releases from code to production. Our platform enables organizations to manage, secure, and automate their software delivery process, fueling innovation without worry. We empower companies to build and release software faster and more securely than ever before.

With over 7,500 customers worldwide, including many Fortune 100 companies, JFrog is at the forefront of global innovation. Join us in shaping the future of software delivery and contributing to solutions that empower some of the world's most influential industries.

Here’s what our employees have to say about working at JFrog:

- "I wanted to work in a company that takes technology forward."

- "Our business is so interesting because it is constantly moving, and we have to adapt new solutions to the challenges that arise from the customers."

- "It’s nice to work for a company with a must-have product, not a nice-to-have."

#LI-REMOTE

JFrog is seeking a Senior Financial Analyst to be the primary financial partner to our People (HR) and Operations organizations. Reporting to our Director of FP&A in Israel, you will be a business partner first and a modeler second. You’ll help HR and Ops leaders understand what their people's investments cost, what they return, and where the next shekel does the most good. Curiosity is the core of this role: you’ll understand how and where HR brings value to JFrog, why a number moved, go talk to the people behind it, and turn what you learn into a clear recommendation. You’ll work AI-first, using tools like Claude as part of your everyday analysis.

As a Senior FP&A at JFrog you will...

- HR Partnership: Act as the day-to-day finance partner to HR leadership and HR business partners, translating people priorities into budget, headcount, and cost scenarios.

- KPIs & People Analytics: Partner closely with our HR Analysis organization to build and maintain the people and operations scorecard (headcount vs. plan, attrition and regretted attrition, time-to-fill, cost per hire, revenue per employee), and explain movements in plain language.

- Recruiting Planning: Partner with our VP of Recruiting to create the recruiting plan and budget: requisition planning, recruiter capacity, agency spend, cost per hire, and offer modeling. Act as a single point of contact around company headcount planning representing FP&A.

- Workforce, Compensation & Benefits Planning: Partner on annual headcount planning and in-year re-forecasts, building driver-based models in Pigment that link hiring plans to cost. Model merit and bonus cycles, equity refresh costs, benefits cost, and total rewards scenarios, and support comp reviews and pay-equity analysis with HR.

- Operations, Workplace & Executive Reporting: Partner with Operations on workplace and facilities costs across Netanya and Tel Aviv (real estate analysis is secondary), and prepare monthly and quarterly people and operations reviews plus board-level materials for the Director of FP&A, the CFO, and HR leadership.

To be a Senior FP&A at JFrog you need...

- 5–8 years of progressive finance experience, including at least 3 years in a business partnering role supporting HR, People, or Operations.

- Demonstrated experience as an HR partner: you have sat in HR leadership meetings, owned people metrics, and influenced HR decisions with financial analysis.

- Prior direct partnership with HR and/or Operations teams, ideally in a SaaS, tech, or other high-growth company.

- Genuine business curiosity and a people-oriented mindset: you keep asking “why,” you enjoy learning how teams work, and you build trust with people who don’t speak finance.

- Strong executive function: highly organized, managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced, global environment.

- Hands-on comp and benefits cost modeling: merit, bonus, equity, and benefits costing.

- Expert Excel and financial modeling, with hands-on Pigment experience required. Working experience with Oracle HCM strongly preferred.

- Excellent communication in both Hebrew and English, able to distill complex financial concepts for non-finance audiences.

- AI-first working style: daily hands-on use of Claude or similar AI tools to build models, analyze data, draft materials, and automate recurring reporting - Advantage

- Experience with real estate, workplace, or facilities cost planning - Advantage

- Knowledge of Israeli employment cost components (pension, study fund, severance, statutory benefits) - Advantage

israel.title: Senior Legal Counsel, Commercial
israel.description:
At JFrog, we’re reinventing DevOps to help the world’s greatest companies innovate -- and we want you along for the ride. Thousands of customers, including the majority of the Fortune 100, trust JFrog to manage, accelerate, and secure their software delivery from code to production -- a concept we call “liquid software.” Wouldn't it be amazing if you could join us in our journey?

The position is based out of our Atlanta office.

Our customers set a high bar. JFrog serves about 83% of the Fortune 100. That includes all of the Fortune 500’s top 10 technology and top 10 financial services companies, 8 of the top 10 retail companies, 8 of the top 10 healthcare companies, and all of the top 7 telecommunications companies. These customers bring heavily negotiated paper, demanding security and privacy requirements, and regulators of their own. You will work on a friendly, collaborative team that moves very fast, where each deal needs both speed and precision.

As a Senior Legal Counsel, Commercial at JFrog you will...

- Be the sales team’s trusted deal partner. Join deals early, give account teams clear and practical guidance, and escalate non-standard asks quickly with a clear recommendation. Bring in compliance, finance, export control, and product experts when a customer request requires it, so deals close on time.

- Negotiate directly with enterprise and public sector customers. Draft, review and negotiate SaaS, self-hosted and subscription agreements, order forms, reseller and partner agreements, and NDAs (many of these are on customer paper with sophisticated legal and procurement teams across the table.) Advise sales leadership on limitations of liability, indemnities, IP and AI-related terms.

- Respond to customer privacy demands. Negotiate DPAs and privacy terms requested by customers. Advise sales on obligations under the CCPA/CPRA, and other US state privacy laws.

- Respond to customer security, resilience and incident requirements. Work closely with the security team to Negotiate information security addenda, DORA addenda, NIS2 flow-down terms, audit rights, and breach notification, cooperation and liability terms. Strong preference for candidate that managed cyber security incidents, participate in such programs, and advise management.

- Make the sales process faster. Turn recurring customer requests into better templates, playbooks, approved fallback positions and self-service resources, so routine deals close without legal review.

- Support government and state customer deals. Handle the contract terms public sector customers require, including FedRAMP, CMMC and secure software development attestation obligations. Work with our government channel partners and internal experts.

To be a Senior Legal Counsel, Commercial at JFrog you need...

- Law degree from an accredited US law school and admitted to practice in California or Georgia.

- At least 8 years of relevant experience with a law firm and/or in-house legal department.

- Substantive experience in commercial business transactions, including sales agreements; intellectual property related considerations including SaaS agreements, and risk allocation; independently managing and directing cross-border projects.

- Strong communication and negotiation skills and ability to connect with, and gain the respect of, cross-functional stakeholders.

- Excellent business sense and legal judgment with the ability to identify and escalate matters in a timely and concise manner..

- Strong negotiation skill, ability to command the room and to influence others without authority.

- Capacity to interact and communicate with senior leadership and other stakeholders and remain adaptable in a changing business environment.

- A collaborative approach and the interest in working in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.

- Superior organizational skills and attention to detail with a mindset that processes can always be improved.

- High integrity and professionalism, strong sense of ownership, and eagerness to learn.

WHAT JFROG CAN OFFER…

- This position also includes an equity package of restricted stock units (RSU).  In addition, JFrog employees are eligible to participate in our Employee Stock Purchase Plan.

israel.description:
At JFrog, we’re reinventing DevSecOps to help the world’s greatest companies innovate. Our team of industry-leading software security experts is a true pioneer, constantly pushing the boundaries with original research and technological innovation. JFrog is a special place with a unique combination of brilliance, spirit, and just all-around great people. Thousands of customers, including the majority of the Fortune 100, trust JFrog to manage, accelerate, and secure their software delivery from code to production – a concept we call “liquid software”. Wouldn't it be amazing if you could join us on our journey?

As an Offensive Security Engineer, you will spearhead JFrog’s offensive security operations and lead advanced threat research initiatives, playing a pivotal role in safeguarding our organization and customers from evolving cyber threats. You will develop and execute Red Team exercises, simulate real-world attacks, and identify security weaknesses in JFrog’s systems and applications. We seek a highly skilled, proactive tech leader who thrives in challenging environments and is passionate about advancing security research and offensive strategies.

As an Offensive Security Engineer, you will…

- Lead, plan, design, and execute Red Team operations, threat modeling, and adversarial simulations against JFrog’s infrastructure and cloud environments.

- Drive threat research and intelligence initiatives to stay ahead of emerging cyber threats, attack techniques, and vulnerabilities.

- Develop and execute advanced attack scenarios to assess security defenses and provide actionable recommendations for improving JFrog’s security posture.

- Collaborate closely with security engineering, DevOps, and software development teams to implement findings and enhance our defenses.

- Lead the development of tooling, frameworks, and methodologies to automate and optimize Red Team exercises.

- Mentor and guide a team of security professionals, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning.

- Participate in incident responses when Red Team exercises reveal vulnerabilities, providing expertise on attack techniques, forensics, and post-attack mitigation.

- Continuously assess and improve security processes, playbooks, and threat detection mechanisms.

To be an Offensive Security Engineer at JFrog, you need…

- 7+ years of experience in offensive security operations, Red Teaming, threat hunting, or threat research

- Deep knowledge of attack techniques, TTPs (Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures), adversary simulations, and threat-hunting methodologies

- Hands-on experience with Red Team tools, frameworks (e.g., Metasploit, Cobalt Strike, Burp Suite), and custom exploit development

- Strong experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and containerized environments (Kubernetes, Docker)

- Familiarity with the MITRE ATT&CK Framework and its application in Red Team and threat-hunting scenarios

- Proficiency with scripting and automation languages for tool development, threat detection, and attack simulation

- Solid understanding of offensive security best practices, vulnerability management, threat detection, and advanced threat analysis

- Ability to effectively communicate and collaborate with cross-functional teams, translating complex security concepts into actionable insights

- A passion for continuous learning, research, and innovation in the fields of offensive security, threat hunting, and cyber threats

israel.title: Senior Product Manager - JFS

Be part of a team where your work takes center stage, shaping the future of software development. At JFrog, we solve critical challenges for leaders like Amazon, Google, and Netflix. Here’s what our employees have to say about working at JFrog:

- "I get to solve complex platform challenges that impact thousands of developers and enterprises worldwide."

- "Product decisions here are driven by customer problems, not just roadmaps. We have the autonomy to shape the future of the platform."

- "Working alongside world-class engineering teams allows us to build secure, scalable capabilities—from identity and access management to AI-powered developer experiences."

We are looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to drive product strategy, discovery, and execution across our security and enterprise software portfolio. In this role, you will own products and features throughout their lifecycle, translate customer and market needs into impactful solutions, and collaborate closely with engineering and cross-functional teams to deliver secure, scalable, customer-focused products.

What you’ll be doing as a Senior Product Manager :

- Own the end-to-end product lifecycle, from ideation, discovery, and market research to product strategy, roadmap definition, development, launch, and ongoing optimization.

- Define product vision and strategy by understanding customer needs, market trends, competitive landscapes, and business objectives, particularly in enterprise software and security.

- Drive product discovery and execution by translating customer problems and business requirements into clear product specifications, user stories, and prioritized roadmaps.

- Collaborate closely with Engineering and R&D to evaluate technical feasibility, make informed trade-offs, and deliver scalable, reliable, and secure solutions.

- Champion security-focused innovation by identifying opportunities to strengthen application security, software supply chain security, vulnerability management, and developer-focused security capabilities.

- Act as the voice of the customer, engaging with enterprise customers, sales, support, and other stakeholders to gather feedback, validate solutions, and drive product adoption.

- Lead cross-functional alignment with Product Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Support, and other business teams to ensure successful product launches and feature adoption.

- Use data and product metrics to measure product performance, evaluate business impact, and continuously improve customer experience and product outcomes.

- Influence stakeholders across the organization and communicate product strategy, priorities, progress, and results effectively to leadership and global teams.

What you bring on to the table:

- 12+ years of overall professional experience, with at least 6 years of hands-on Product Management experience in the software industry.

- Proven experience owning and delivering complex B2B enterprise software products, preferably SaaS platforms or developer-focused products.

- Strong understanding of application security, software security, or cybersecurity concepts, with experience translating security challenges into product capabilities.

- Experience defining product strategy, managing roadmaps, conducting product discovery, prioritizing features, and driving end-to-end product execution.

- Ability to translate complex customer and business requirements into clear product requirements, specifications, and user stories for Engineering and QA teams.

- Experience working closely with Engineering and R&D teams on technically complex products, balancing customer needs, technical feasibility, scalability, and business priorities.

- Strong understanding of enterprise customers, their business challenges, and the requirements of large-scale software environments.

- Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and analytical skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams without formal authority.

- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, drive alignment across teams, and deliver measurable product and business outcomes.

- A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent hands-on experience in software development or technical product management.

Good to have

- Experience with JFrog Artifactory or other artifact management and binary repository solutions.

- Experience in the DevOps ecosystem, including CI/CD pipelines, software delivery, developer tools, or platform engineering.

- Knowledge of software supply chain security, vulnerability scanning, open-source security, SBOMs, or related security practices.

About JFrog:

JFrog is the only end-to-end software supply chain platform that provides complete visibility, security, and control for automating the delivery of trusted releases from code to production. Our platform enables organizations to manage, secure, and automate their software delivery process, fueling innovation without worry. We empower companies to build and release software faster and more securely than ever before.
With over 7,500 customers worldwide, including many Fortune 100 companies, JFrog is at the forefront of global innovation. Join us in shaping the future of software delivery and contributing to solutions that empower some of the world's most influential industries.

NOTE: The job location is Bangalore (Bellandur) and we follow a hybrid model, mandatory 3 days/week work from office.

- Represent JFrog at customer events, conferences, webinars, partner engagements, and executive briefings

- Bring customer and market feedback back to JFrog Product and Engineering teams and help influence product direction

- Stay current with developments in DevOps, DevSecOps, Kubernetes, cloud platforms, software supply chain security, and AI-assisted software development

If you don’t meet 100% of the requirements below – that’s okay, nobody’s perfect! We believe in hiring people, not just a list of skills. We encourage you to apply if you think this is a role that would make you excited about coming to work every day.

What you bring to the table:

- 8+ years of relevant industry experience, with significant experience across areas such as Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Presales, DevOps, software engineering, platform engineering, cloud, or application security

- 4+ years in a customer-facing technical role, ideally supporting enterprise technology sales

- Proven ability to independently manage the technical aspects of complex enterprise sales opportunities

- Strong hands-on understanding of modern DevOps and software delivery practices

- Experience with technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD platforms, Git-based workflows, build tools, and artifact/package management

- Experience designing, explaining, or implementing software delivery pipelines and integrating multiple tools within the software development lifecycle

- Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud

- Good understanding of application security and software supply chain security concepts, including areas such as Software Composition Analysis (SCA), SBOM, container security, vulnerability management, or application security testing

- Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both deeply technical audiences and senior stakeholders

- Strong discovery, presentation, demonstration, and problem-solving skills

- Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with regional and global teams

- Native or fluent Mandarin Taiwanese and strong business English communication skills

- Experience working with enterprise customers in Taiwan and an understanding of the local technology ecosystem

- Based in Taipei, Taiwan

Good to have:

- Previous experience as a software developer, DevOps engineer, platform engineer, cloud architect, or security engineer

- Experience with enterprise DevOps platforms, artifact management, application security, or software supply chain technologies

- Experience working with large-scale enterprise development environments and complex technical architectures

- Familiarity with AI-assisted development and emerging concepts such as LLMs, AI coding assistants, agents, MCP, and agentic development workflows

- Experience working with channel partners, system integrators, or technology alliances

- Experience presenting at technical events, customer forums, or industry conferences

About JFrog:

JFrog is the only end-to-end software supply chain platform that provides complete visibility, security, and control for automating the delivery of trusted releases from code to production. Our platform enables organizations to manage, secure, and automate their software delivery process, fueling innovation without worry. With over 7,500 customers worldwide, including many Fortune 100 companies, JFrog is at the forefront of global innovation. Join us in shaping the future of software delivery and contributing to solutions that empower some of the world's most influential industries.

- 5-7+ years of experience in program or technical project management, with a strong focus on managing complex web projects in a fast-paced environment.

- Expert-level knowledge and proven success implementing and managing Scrum, Kanban, and Waterfall project management processes.
