If you want to grow, stretch, and do work that truly matters, Gong is the place to do the best work of your career.

Gong empowers everyone in revenue teams to improve productivity, increase predictability, and drive revenue growth by deeply understanding customers and business trends; driving impactful decisions and actions. The Gong Revenue AI Platform captures and contextualizes customer interactions, surfaces insights and predictions, and powers actions and workflows that are essential for business success. More than 4,500 companies around the world rely on Gong to unlock their revenue potential. For more information, visit www.gong.io.

As we continue our expansion in APAC, we're hiring an Account Executive to drive new business across India. This role is based in Singapore, with travel to India required. This role sits within our Upper Mid Market segment, and we're looking to have someone in seat within the next quarter.

This is an Expression of Interest, not a live job posting yet. We're moving quickly to identify the right person, so if this sounds like you, we'd rather hear from you now than after the role goes public.

Who we're looking for

We need a true hunter — someone energized by unproven territory, not someone waiting for warm leads or an established book of business. This means you'll be prospecting into a market where we have little to no brand recognition yet, and turning cold conversations into signed Mid Market logos — often while managing the added complexity of building a business remotely and closing the gap through frequent travel.

You should be someone who gets a charge out of being first — first rep, first customer, first win in a new market — and who's comfortable defining the approach rather than inheriting one. Given our timeline, we're looking for someone who can hit the ground running with minimal ramp time.

What you'll do

- Own the entire sales cycle end-to-end — from first cold outreach to signed contract — with no existing account base to fall back on

- Build the India go-to-market playbook from scratch: territory strategy, prospecting cadence, messaging, positioning

- Generate your own pipeline aggressively — this is a self-sourced, self-hunted number, not a hand-off from marketing or SDRs

- Travel regularly into India to run in-person meetings, build local relationships, and represent the company on the ground

- Run sharp discovery to uncover real business pain in a market that may not yet know our category

- Articulate our value proposition to buyers with no prior context on who we are

- Act as the face of the company for India — building initial brand credibility deal by deal

- Forecast accurately in a market with limited historical data, and hit quota despite the added ambiguity

What we look for

- Proven closing experience in B2B SaaS, specifically within Upper Mid Market, ideally including new-market, new-logo, or greenfield territory building

- A demonstrated track record of winning business without inbound support — true hunter DNA

- Comfort operating with zero playbook, minimal brand awareness, and high ambiguity

- Comfort with a travel-heavy role — willing and able to travel to India on a regular, recurring basis

- Strong discovery, qualification, and objection-handling skills against sophisticated, sometimes skeptical buyers

- Experience selling platform or transformation solutions is a plus

- Fluency in English required

- Entrepreneurial mindset — you think like a founder of your own territory, not an employee inheriting one

- Curiosity, grit, resilience, and genuine hunger for the chase — this role will have real headwinds early on, and we need someone who wants that challenge

- Based in or willing to relocate to Singapore

- Available to start within the next quarter

What happens next

- You submit your expression of interest (about 5 minutes)

- Our Talent team reviews submissions on a rolling basis, given our timeline

- Strong-fit candidates are contacted directly for an initial conversation, ahead of any public posting

- If there's mutual fit, we move quickly into a full interview process, including conversations about your approach to opening new markets

Given the timeline, we'll be moving fast — but we'll always respect your time and won't string you along without real intent to hire.

Field Operations is the connective tissue between GTM strategy and what actually happens in the field. We translate annual plans into revenue-unit-level execution, own the forecast and pipeline cadence, and are the first to see — and act on — performance gaps before they become planning problems.

We're hiring a Senior Manager, GTM Field Operations to serve as the embedded operational partner and single point of contact for one of our North America Revenue Units (Sales and Revenue Architect teams with an annual revenue target upwards of $300M). You'll own the operating rhythm for your segment, turn data into decisions, and represent a unified Ops voice alongside Strategy & Planning, RevOps, and Enablement — not a siloed, segment-only function.

The ideal candidate pairs operational rigor with a genuine bias for action: solving today's fire without losing sight of the scalable, repeatable process underneath it. You'll need to build trust with senior stakeholders based on credibility and reliability — not just being agreeable — and be comfortable delivering hard operational calls (policy changes, resource reallocation, ROE enforcement) with clarity and empathy.

Responsibilities

Segment Leadership & Trusted Advisory

- Serve as the primary operational point of contact for your assigned segment's reps, managers, and senior leaders — owning end-to-end ops needs.

- Maintain constant, fluent command of your segment's numbers: targets and quotas, real-time actuals and forecast trajectory, leading KPIs (pipeline generation, close rates, cycle length), and the top 15-20 deals and risks in-quarter.

Operating Rhythm & Performance Management

- Own and enforce the business operating rhythm without exception: weekly/monthly forecast and pipeline reviews, deal reviews, account reviews, KPI and headcount tracking, and QBR/MRR prep.

- Coach and hold segment leaders and reps accountable to their deliverables inside that rhythm — this includes rules of engagement (ROE) enforcement and flagging violations back to central RevOps.

- Bring proactive analysis to the table, not just reactive reporting: surface pipeline coverage gaps, ramp-time stalls, and emerging risks before they show up in a QBR.

Cross-Functional Partnership

- Partner with Strategy & Planning on territory methodologies, capacity models, and headcount plans that translate the annual plan into RU-level execution priorities.

- Partner with RevOps to enforce ROE, escalate systems/process gaps for triage, and stay aligned on shared tech stack strategy (Salesforce, Gong, planning/analytics tools).

- Partner with Enablement on new-hire integration, role excellence, and surfacing field skill gaps that should shape program design.

- Build cross-functional relationships with Marketing, Finance, and Product so operational strategy stays aligned to broader GTM goals — not just your segment's.

- Serve as a subject matter expert and voice of your segment in planning and strategy sessions and annual planning cycles.

- Collaborate with Analytics/BI to design reporting and dashboards giving visibility into performance, productivity, and pipeline health.

- Champion adoption and hygiene of sales tools (Gong, Salesforce, planning/analytics platforms), and identify new use cases as the tech stack evolves.

- Act as "Customer Zero" for the processes and data you enable in Gong — using the product as a segment leader would, and feeding use cases and feedback back to the product team.

- Evaluate the cost/benefit of any proposed solution — people, tools, or process — before recommending it; favor scalable fixes over one-off, high-touch solutions.

- You're the first call, not the last resort, for your segment's leadership on anything operational.

Documentation & Communication

Continuous Improvement

As an Architect in Gong's AI Applications group, you will lead the architecture and technical direction of the Revenue Harness, the agentic framework that powers an AI teammate for every revenue professional. The assistant understands a user's deals, customers, and pipeline. It can reason, plan, and act on the user's behalf, grounded in the richest revenue data in the world.

What You'll Build

- Agentic Core: Agent orchestration, planning and reasoning loops, multi-step execution, and multi-agent coordination for long-running revenue workflows.

- Tools & Integrations: A secure, extensible tool ecosystem, including MCP-based tools and connectors, that lets agents read from and act on Gong data, CRMs, email, and calendars.

- Context & Memory: Retrieval pipelines over calls, emails, deals, and accounts, using RAG, hybrid search, and knowledge graphs, plus short- and long-term memory.

- Quality & Trust: Offline and online evaluation of accuracy, groundedness, and task success, along with guardrails, permissions, and human-in-the-loop controls.

- Model Platform: Multi-provider model routing, streaming, LLM observability, and cost and latency management.

- Runtime & Execution: High-concurrency infrastructure for stateful and stateless agents, including lifecycle management, isolated workers, task queues, and distributed state persistence.

- Deployment & CI/CD: Cloud-native Kubernetes deployments with multi-region rollout, zero-downtime updates, canary releases for non-deterministic workflows, and strict tenant sandboxing.

You'll Own

- Revenue Harness Architecture: Serve as the group's central technical leader. Define the reference architecture and the contracts between agents, tools, context, and models, so that teams build on a shared, scalable foundation.

- Hands-On Engineering: Embed in teams across domains and contribute directly to design and code.

- Quality & Reliability Standards: Set the group's eval methodology, regression gates, and production monitoring for non-deterministic systems.

- Mentorship & Engineering Standards: Raise the bar on design quality and best practices across the group.

- AI-Assisted Development: Drive adoption of coding agents, AI code review, and agentic workflows to improve velocity and quality.

You'll Solve

- Reliability on Non-Deterministic Foundations: Make LLM behavior trustworthy through structured outputs, tool-call validation, fallbacks, and well-defined failure modes.

- Context at Enterprise Scale: Get the right information into the context window efficiently when the data spans millions of conversations, deals, and accounts.

- Secure, Permission-Aware Agents: Enforce data boundaries, user permissions, and tenant isolation, and defend against prompt injection and unintended actions.

- Quality, Cost & Latency Trade-offs: Balance them through model selection, caching, and routing.

- Ambiguity & Divergence Across Teams: Bring clarity to loosely defined cross-team problems, surface blind spots, and steer teams toward aligned, reusable patterns.

- Speed vs. Long-Term Evolution: Catch architectural gaps early and make pragmatic trade-offs, so that systems keep pace with rapidly changing models and tooling.

You'll Impact

- The Future of Revenue Work: Help sales professionals shift their time from busywork to selling.

- A Higher Engineering Bar: Build stronger, more autonomous teams through better design practices and mentorship.

- Consistent, Fast Delivery: Reduce duplication and accelerate execution without compromising long-term platform health.

How You'll Succeed

Requirements

- 10+ years of backend development, with strong expertise in Java and modern frameworks such as Spring Boot.

- Proven Staff or Principal-level impact across multiple teams, with the ability to lead through influence rather than authority.

- Hands-on experience shipping production LLM applications, such as agents, tool calling, RAG, or structured generation, and an understanding of their failure modes.

- Deep expertise in designing large-scale distributed systems, including asynchronous, event-driven, and streaming architectures.

- Versatility in diving into unfamiliar codebases, switching context across teams, and spotting high-impact opportunities.

- A passion for mentoring, and the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly to diverse stakeholders.

- Genuine curiosity about the AI landscape, and a track record of driving adoption of AI-assisted development.

Nice to Have

- Experience with agent frameworks and protocols (e.g., MCP, Spring AI, LangChain/LangGraph) or with building an in-house equivalent.

- Experience with LLM evaluation (LLM-as-judge, golden datasets, online monitoring), observability, and multi-provider routing.

- Experience with vector databases, search infrastructure (e.g., Elasticsearch/OpenSearch), or knowledge graphs.

- Familiarity with AI security concerns, including prompt injection, data leakage, and agent permission models.

- Working knowledge of Python alongside a JVM stack.

- Background in B2B SaaS, CRM, or revenue technology.

We operate in a flexible hybrid work model.

What makes Engineering at Gong unique?

Here at Gong, we trust and empower our employees with ownership to solve complex problems, make the right decisions, and build the best products that create radical impact. We call this "Own. Solve. Impact." For our engineers, it means it's not just about writing code. You are involved and able to influence the entire process to create the best product.

If you are curious to discover Gong's wonderful and challenging world, what are you waiting for? Don't delay—fill in your application details. Who knows, maybe there's a Gongster in you!

We encourage our employees to express their personality and identity (whether gender, ethnic, religious, or sexual), and we ensure fairness and equal opportunities. ABOUT THE ROLE

Today, Gong’s Talent Acquisition team runs on manual processes and disconnected systems — candidate data in one tool, interview data in another, employee data in a third, and no way to see across any of it without someone stitching it together by hand. This role exists to fix that permanently, with a system, not a person doing it manually.

You will not recruit. You won't source candidates, screen resumes, or run interviews. Your job is to build the engine underneath all of that: the automations, integrations, and AI-powered workflows that let recruiters and hiring managers actually see what's happening and move faster, without you in the loop for every question.

This is a 0-to-1 build. There's no existing  talent engineering function here today — you're standing it up wiring all of our disparate systems into a single governed layer that AI tools can actually reason over. Success looks like shipped systems, not proposals: a dashboard that updates itself, a stuck-req alert that never needed a human to notice it, an agent that a recruiter or manager can interact with instead of having to manually find the solution.

You'll be evaluated the same way an engineer is evaluated — by what you ship and the measurable difference it makes. Prior recruiting operations experience is useful context, not a requirement.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Unify our systems and make them useful. Connect and integrate Workday (HRIS), Greenhouse (ATS), Gem (sourcing), and BrightHire (interview intelligence).

- Build the talent intelligence repository. A governed data and context layer that lets AI tools answer questions using our real definitions and data, with proper permissions — not generic or hallucinated logic.

- Build agentic solutions across the hiring lifecycle for things like:

- Automated reporting on time in stage metrics

- Real-time visibility into bottlenecks in our workflow

- A conversational tool that lets talent leadership and managers self-serve pipeline status

- Surfacing previously-qualified candidates already in our ATS against new roles

- Interview quality and consistency signals from recorded interviews

- Predictive flags for at-risk offers

- Recruiter workload and capacity modeling

- Real input on build-vs-buy evaluation for our talent tech stack. Work directly with your manager to assess where in-house tooling can replace or reduce reliance on outside vendors.

- Own outbound sourcing and offer effectiveness. Apply structured experimentation to how we reach and hire candidates — testing messaging, timing, and sequencing to systematically improve response, interest and acceptance rates instead of guessing. Build agents that continuously monitor these conversion rates, flags when performance starts trending in the wrong direction before it becomes a bigger problem, and refines its own benchmarks and test design as more data comes in.

- Partner, not duplicate. Work alongside our central People Analytics, HRIS, and IT teams — this role owns the talent-specific slice of data, automation, and tooling, operating inside the same governance model IT is building for technical/builder tool access company-wide.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Real experience building solutions that integrate with external systems — APIs, OAuth, webhooks, rate limits, error handling in production, not just in a tutorial.

- Strong scripting/backend skills (Python or TypeScript/Node).

- SQL proficiency — you're comfortable joining and querying data across systems.

- Hands-on experience with LLM APIs and tool/function-calling patterns; direct experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) is a strong plus, though not required.

- Sound instincts around permissions and access-control design — you think about who should see what before you're asked to.

- Experience designing and analyzing structured experiments — A/B or multivariate testing, in any domain — and the judgment to know when a result is real signal versus noise from too small a sample.

- Comfort with ambiguity. This role is being defined as it's built; you'll help shape the roadmap, not just execute one.

- Recruiting or Talent Acquisition background is a plus, not a requirement. We'd rather hire a strong builder who can learn the domain than the reverse.

- Familiarity with recruiting or HR systems (Greenhouse, Workday, Gem, BrightHire, or similar).

- Interest or prior exposure to the emerging discipline of applying software engineering directly to talent acquisition and recruiting operations.

Less resume, more proof. Come ready to walk through 2–3 systems you've actually built — what problem they solved, how you designed them, and what changed because they existed. Diagrams, repos, or before/after metrics are worth more here than a title on a LinkedIn page.

israel.location: Austin | Chicago | New York City | Salt Lake City | San Francisco
israel.description:
Gong harnesses the power of AI to transform how revenue teams win. The Gong Revenue AI Operating System unifies data, insights, and workflows into a single, trusted system that observes, guides, and acts alongside the world’s most successful revenue teams. Powered by the Gong Revenue Graph, AI-powered intelligence, specialized agents, and trusted applications, Gong helps more than 5,000 companies around the world deeply understand their teams and customers, automate critical sales workflows, and close more deals with less effort. For more information, visit www.gong.io.

At Gong, you will join a company built on innovative products, ambitious goals, and passionate people. We are shaping the future of revenue intelligence and we want people who are excited to build what comes next. You will work with a team that dreams big, moves fast, and cares deeply about the craft and about each other. Here, transparency and trust are core to how we operate, and every person has the opportunity to make a visible impact. If you want to grow, stretch, and do work that truly matters, Gong is the place to do the best work of your career.

Gong's Revenue Architects are the strategic post-sale partners who turn Gong's AI Operating System into measurable revenue outcomes for customers. Organized today across Enterprise, Enterprise Growth, Mid-Market, Commercial, Digital, and the new Industry Expansion (IX) segment (currently focused on Financial Services and Healthcare), RA teams own adoption, value realization, and renewal and expansion across the full customer lifecycle. The function spans NAMER, EMEA, and APAC.

This is a newly elevated global leadership role, created to unify strategy, execution, and accountability across all Revenue Architecture segments and regions. Reporting to the Chief Customer Officer, the VP of Global Revenue Architecture will lead a multi-layered organization of roughly 100 people including a VP, a team of regional and segment leaders, and the individual-contributor Revenue Architects who sit closest to customers. You will set the global strategy for how Gong drives retention and expansion across Enterprise, Enterprise Growth, Mid-Market, Commercial. Digital, and Industry Expansion, while building the leadership bench, operating rhythm, and cross-functional muscle needed to scale the function as a global, industry-aware growth engine.

The preferred location for this role is in one of Gong's current hubs: San Francisco, Austin, Lehi, Chicago, or NYC.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Lead across three regions: Own the performance, hiring, and development of a global organization of ~100 across NAMER, EMEA, and APAC, ensuring consistent standards while adapting for regional and market nuance.

- Set the global RA strategy: Define a single revenue transformation methodology; workflow architecture, adoption and change management, value realization, and renewal and expansion that scales consistently across Enterprise, Enterprise Growth, Mid-Market, Commercial, Digital, and IX segments.

- Own the numbers: Hold end-to-end accountability for gross and net revenue retention, expansion, and customer value realization across the entire Revenue Architecture book, and build the forecasting and pipeline rigor to defend those numbers to the executive team.

- Scale Industry Expansion (IX): Guide the build-out of the IX segment currently Financial Services and Healthcare as a 'startup within a startup,' developing industry-specific playbooks, automation, and self-service strategies that improve customer health and reduce churn in these verticals.

- Build the leadership bench: Coach and develop all layers of regional and segment leaders beneath them; own succession planning and career pathing so the org can keep scaling without you in every room.

- Represent RA at the executive level: Act as an escalation point and strategic partner on the largest, highest-risk, and highest-opportunity accounts, engaging directly with customer C-suite and VP stakeholders alongside your leaders.

- Partner cross-functionally: Work closely with Sales, Product, Support, Marketing, and other CCO-org peers to ensure Revenue Architecture strategy is embedded in the broader customer journey, and that RA insights shape product and GTM priorities

- Drive operating cadence: Establish the global rhythm of business in QBRs, forecasting, performance reviews, and org health check-ins that keeps a distributed, multi-region team aligned and accountable.

- 15+ years of experience in customer success, account management, or revenue-facing leadership within B2B SaaS, including significant experience leading through multiple layers of management (leaders of leaders), not just individual contributors.

- A track record owning enterprise-scale retention and expansion targets (GRR/NRR) for a large, distributed post-sale organization

- Experience operating across multiple regions and time zones, with the judgment to balance global consistency against local market needs.

- Direct experience building or scaling a new segment, vertical, or 'startup within a startup' motion, ideally involving automation, self-service, or AI-driven customer workflows.

- Comfort owning relationships with customer C-suite and VP stakeholders on the highest-stakes accounts, with strong executive presence and negotiation skill.

- A data-driven, change-management mindset comfortable translating customer workflows into measurable business outcomes and using data to drive adoption.

- A collaborative leadership style that thrives in ambiguity and fast-paced, high-growth environments, and genuinely enjoys developing other leaders.

israel.title: Front Line Support Engineer - East Coast
israel.description:
Fireblocks is the company bringing global finance onchain. Backed by over $1 billion in capital, we are the premier digital asset infrastructure provider trusted by thousands of industry-defining financial institutions, including banks, payment providers, fintechs, and global corporates such as BNY Mellon, BNP Paribas, ANZ Bank, Western Union, Stripe, and Revolut. Built for institutional scale and security, our enterprise-grade platform and network have powered over $14 trillion in digital asset transfers worldwide.

What You’ll Do

Join our mission to deliver unparalleled customer support in the dynamic world of cryptocurrency and DeFi. As a Customer Frontline Support Engineer, you will act as the first point of contact for our customers, resolving complex issues with empathy, precision, and urgency. You'll be instrumental in ensuring our customers succeed, collaborating with internal teams to deliver proactive, world-class support.

This role is intended to work US-Eastern hours and operates on a 24/7 schedule including weekends and holidays to meet customer needs, with shifts determined based on seniority and business requirements.

*Please note that these hours are subject to change based on business needs, with or without advance notice.

Training Period:
All new hires will initially undergo training Monday through Friday during standard US-Eastern business hours. During the training period, which may last approximately 90 to 180 days depending on individual progress and proficiency with the platform, candidates may occasionally be scheduled for rotating weekend shifts (Saturday or Sunday, 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM US-Eastern) as part of their onboarding and readiness preparation.

Responsibilities

- Serve as a trusted advisor and advocate for customers, managing inquiries with empathy and efficiency.

- Provide real-time support via Slack and other communication tools, ensuring timely and accurate resolutions.

- Deliver outstanding technical support for Fireblocks' SaaS platform, going above and beyond to address customer needs.

- Escalate and collaborate on complex issues with the Senior Support Team, ensuring seamless resolution and customer satisfaction.

- Proactively identify and resolve recurring issues, contributing to process improvements and enhancing the customer experience.

- Manage cases meticulously, maintaining clear and detailed documentation throughout the support process.

- Communicate effectively during critical incidents, participating in "war room" calls and keeping customers informed with timely updates.

- Embrace and adhere to business processes and policies while suggesting improvements to enhance the customer journey.

Required Skills

- 1 - 2 years of experience in a customer support or similar role, with a passion for delivering exceptional service.

- Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to work under pressure and prioritize customer needs effectively.

- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, demonstrating professionalism and empathy in all interactions.

- Proven ability to build strong relationships with customers, acting as a trusted advisor and advocate for their needs.

- A customer-first mindset, ensuring that resolutions align with customer success and satisfaction.

- Demonstrated experience in managing and resolving complex issues with a proactive and collaborative approach.

- Ability to adapt quickly to changing customer needs and prioritize tasks to meet expectations.

- Commitment to continuous learning and staying updated on the latest industry trends and technologies.

Nice-to-Have

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

- Previous experience supporting SaaS-based solutions or working in the financial services or technology sectors.

- Familiarity with databases, scripting languages (Python, JavaScript, etc.), and tools like Coralogix, Kibana, Grafana, and LogStash.

- Understanding of blockchain technologies and cryptographic principles used in public blockchain networks.

- Proven ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment to solve customer challenges.

It is not typical for a candidate to be hired at or near the top of the pay range and each compensation decision is dependent on each individual case. A reasonable base salary range estimate for this position is $90,000 to $95,000. The base salary is one component of the total compensation package, which for some roles may include a target bonus, a very competitive equity grant, and very generous benefits.

While we believe competitive compensation is a critical aspect of you deciding to join us, we do hope you also spend time considering why our mission and culture are right for you. We are creating something transformational here, and we hope you are as excited about the future as we are.

Fireblocks is on a mission to enable every business to easily and securely access digital assets and cryptocurrencies. As a leading provider in the digital asset space, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workforce that mirrors the global clientele we serve.

About the Team

The FinApps Access team at Fireblocks builds the backbone of on-chain access for some of the world's largest financial institutions and crypto-native organizations. We operate at the intersection of blockchain protocol engineering and enterprise-grade reliability — designing systems that route, protect, and optimize transactions across dozens of chains at scale.

You'll work on mission-critical infrastructure powering DeFi connectivity, multi-chain integrations, transaction execution pipelines, and on-chain data access — with direct impact on how billions of dollars flow through decentralized networks every day.

What You'll Do

- Design and build robust, scalable backend services supporting high-volume on-chain transaction flows across multiple blockchain networks — both EVM and non-EVM.

- Own end-to-end development of backend components and APIs — from architecture decisions to production deployment.

- Lead integrations with DeFi protocols, on-chain data sources, and blockchain nodes across a wide range of chains and ecosystems.

- Research and evaluate emerging blockchain technologies, protocols, and standards to keep Fireblocks at the cutting edge.

- Optimize existing production systems for performance, reliability, and security — reducing latency and increasing throughput.

- Collaborate closely with product, protocol research, and platform engineering teams to deliver high-quality solutions on time.

- Drive features from inception through to delivery at scale, taking full ownership of the product lifecycle.

What You'll Bring

- 7+ years of experience as a Backend or Full Stack Engineer.

- Bachelor of Science (B.Sc.) or equivalent degree/experience.

- Blockchain and Web3 experience are a must — including deep understanding of transaction lifecycles, consensus mechanisms, smart contract interactions, and on-chain data.

- Proven experience working across multiple blockchain ecosystems — EVM-compatible chains (Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum, Base, etc.) as well as non-EVM chains such as Solana, TON, Tron, or similar.

- Proficiency in Node.js and TypeScript.

- Experience designing and operating microservices in production CI/CD environments.

- Strong understanding of security principles, cryptography, and best practices in a blockchain context.

- Familiarity with DeFi protocols — AMMs, lending markets, bridging infrastructure, or on-chain routing — is a strong advantage.

- Experience with Web3 tooling and libraries (ethers.js, viem, web3.js, Solana web3.js, etc.).

- Demonstrated experience taking products from inception to delivery at scale.

- Full stack experience (React, frontend development) — a nice to have.

About You

- You think in systems and care deeply about correctness, reliability, and scale.

- You're comfortable navigating ambiguity and can drive technical decisions with limited oversight.

- You have a natural curiosity for how blockchain protocols work under the hood — and you actually read the specs.

- You thrive in fast-moving environments and can balance shipping velocity with long-term code quality.

- You communicate clearly and collaborate effectively across engineering, product, and research.

Why Fireblocks

- Work at the frontier of blockchain infrastructure, with real impact on how DeFi scales for institutional and retail users.

- Tackle genuinely hard engineering problems — multi-chain routing, on-chain data indexing, protocol integrations, and more.

- Collaborate with world-class engineers, protocol researchers, and product minds in a fast-growing global company.

- Competitive compensation, meaningful equity, and a culture that rewards ownership and initiative.

- Respectful and transparent culture: Our executives pride themselves on being accessible to everyone and believe in sharing knowledge with the employees. Each employee has a place in shaping the future of our industry.

About the Role:

The DevOps Lead (FedRAMP) will own Orca's FedRAMP environment. All of it. The infrastructure, the authorization, and the relationships with the agencies and assessors who depend on it.

This is a builder's role with real authority. You will be the most senior Orca engineer in our federal environment and the person everyone comes to for anything that touches it, from a Terraform change to an agency security review. You will set the technical direction, and you will implement it yourself. Over time you will grow a small US based team around you while keeping your own hands on the system.

The timing is good. FedRAMP is moving to 20x, with machine readable OSCAL packages, Key Security Indicators, and continuous validation replacing point in time assessment. Most companies are treating that as a compliance problem. We want to treat it as an automation problem, and you will be the one who designs how Orca does it.

If you like being the definitive expert on a system that matters, and you want the ownership without giving up the engineering, this is a rare shape of role.

What You'll Do:

Build and operate the federal environment

- Own and evolve Orca's FedRAMP environment in AWS GovCloud, AWS East/West, Azure Government, Azure Commercial, and GCP, including EKS, Terraform, Helm, CI/CD, FIPS validated endpoints, hardened images, secrets management, and centralized logging.

- Write the infrastructure code yourself and set the standards for how it is written.

- Design the automation that makes compliance a byproduct of how the system runs, covering continuous configuration validation, drift detection, evidence collection, and inventory accuracy.

- Decide how new platform capabilities land in the federal environment, and bring them in cleanly.

- Own production health, monitoring, and incident response for the environment.

Own the FedRAMP program

- Run continuous monitoring end to end, including scanning, POA&M, inventory, and reporting.

- Own the authorization artifacts, from the SSP and boundary diagrams through control implementation, and lead their move to OSCAL.

- Assess and categorize changes to the boundary, and own the notification process that goes with them.

- Lead annual assessment and 3PAO engagements, from scoping through evidence to closing findings.

- Be Orca's interface to the FedRAMP PMO, our agency sponsor, and our assessors.

- Track where the program is heading and tell us what it means for us early.

Represent Orca to federal customers

- Be the technical voice of our federal environment in front of agency security teams, prime contractors, and prospects, across security reviews, architecture deep dives, and audit responses.

- Work directly with our federal sales, sales engineering, and customer success teams. You will be in the rooms where a credible technical answer wins the account.

- Translate between an agency ISSO and an R&D team in Tel Aviv, in both directions, so requirements arrive as something buildable.

Who You Are:

- You are hands on today and you want to stay that way. You are writing infrastructure code and operating production systems now, and you would be doing roughly two thirds of that in this role alongside the ownership and customer work.

- Real experience inside a FedRAMP authorized system. You can talk about an authorization boundary, a significant change, or what a 3PAO will ask for, from having done it.

- 3 or more years in DevOps, SRE, or cloud infrastructure, with genuine production ownership.

- Deep AWS experience, including hands on AWS GovCloud and a clear understanding of how it differs from commercial.

- Kubernetes in production. Operating it, debugging it, and upgrading it.

- Terraform and infrastructure as code at scale, 3 or more years.

- Automation in Python or an equivalent language, with an instinct to script what others do by hand.

- Fluency in NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5. You can move between a control and its real technical implementation in either direction.

- Vulnerability management experience in a regulated environment.

- The presence to hold a technical conversation with a federal customer's security team and be the reason they trust the answer. Excellent written and spoken English.

- Based in the United States, with access to the authorized environment subject to our federal personnel screening requirements.

- Comfortable working with an Israel based R&D organization, with meaningful overlap with Israel hours.

Bonus Points:

- Experience with the FedRAMP 20x pathway, OSCAL tooling, or KSI based validation.

- Exposure to DoD IL4 or IL5, StateRAMP, CMMC, or IRAP.

- Experience growing a small infrastructure team.

- Compliance automation tooling such as Xacta, Paramify, RegScale, or Vanta.

- Background at a security product company or with a cloud native security platform.

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Computer Engineering, or equivalent hands on experience.

What We Offer:

- Competitive salary and equity package

- Discounted medical, dental, and vision benefits with significant employer contribution

- Benefits coverage starting on your first day of employment

- Generous PTO with U.S. holidays observed and flexible hybrid & remote work environments

- Work-from-home stipend to be used in your first month of employment

- Monthly reimbursement for cell phone and for home internet

- The chance to collaborate with a team of talented global colleagues all around the world

Annual Salary range: $210,000 - $230,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience, skills, and other factors.

This position is open until filled. Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis.

- Experience debugging on live publisher pages with browser DevTools: inspecting the DOM, tracing bid requests and responses in the Network tab, checking console errors and timing

- Experience building dashboards or internal tools for non-technical users, or running training programs

- Experience with AI-assisted workflows or building agents

- Experience with ad-tech (particularly advertiser side).

- Innovative thinking.

- Be an escalation point for burning issues within and outside your primary SME area/s.

How you'll make an impact:

Realize your potential by joining the leading performance-driven advertising company!

As a Staff Engineer - Data Platform on the infrastructure department in ourTel Aviv Office, you’ll play a vital role in as a Staff Engineer – Data Platform in the Infrastructure Department in our Tel Aviv office, you’ll play a vital role in building the core data platform that powers Taboola’s reporting, billing, ML training, experimentation, revenue optimization, and business decision-making — ensuring data is reliable, fresh, scalable, and easy to use.

You’ll be a senior technical leader across the Data Platform group, owning the hardest technical challenges across Spark, Iceberg, Kafka, and StarRocks. As a hands-on individual contributor, you’ll drive technical excellence and make every engineer around you better through mentoring and technical leadership.

1.4 billion users. 950,000 requests per second. 150TB of fresh data every day. 800M metrics every minute. That's the scale Taboola's Data Platform group operates at.



To thrive in this role, you'll need:

- 10+ years of hands-on software engineering, with deep expertise in Java or an equivalent JVM/object-oriented language

- Deep, hands-on expertise in Apache Spark — internals, Spark SQL and the Catalyst optimizer, and performance and cost tuning at scale

- Production experience with Apache Iceberg (or another open table format such as Delta Lake or Hudi) — table design, partitioning, compaction, and metadata/catalog management

- Deep expertise in Apache Kafka — internals, partitioning and delivery semantics, and operating high-throughput pipelines in production

- Hands-on experience with StarRocks or a similar MPP/real-time analytics engine (Druid, ClickHouse, Trino)

- Lead by example with AI: introduce agent-based engineering workflows, measure their impact, and help the group adopt them

- A track record of designing, building, and owning large-scale distributed data systems end to end — from architecture to production reliability

- Proven experience mentoring engineers and growing technical leaders — through design reviews, code reviews, pairing, and knowledge sharing

- Ability to influence without authority and drive alignment across teams, managers, and stakeholders

- Highly proficient with Linux and Kubernetes in production

- B.Sc. in Computer Science or equivalent experience

Bonus points if you have:

- Contributions to open-source data projects (Spark, Iceberg, Kafka, StarRocks, or similar)

- Conference talks, blog posts, or other public technical writing

- Experience running Spark on GPU (RAPIDS) or other query acceleration techniques

- Experience with stream processing (Spark Structured Streaming, Kafka Streams, Flink)

- Experience with dbt and/or Airflow

- Knowledge of Ansible, Puppet, or similar configuration systems

- A track record of leveraging AI agents to accelerate engineering work

- Familiarity with how ML training pipelines consume data, to partner effectively with algo teams

How you’ll make an impact:

- Shape the technical direction of the Data Platform group — the architecture, the long-term roadmap, and the bets we make on emerging tech (Iceberg, StarRocks, GPU Spark, dbt, AI tooling)

- Mentor and grow engineers across the group: lead design reviews, pair on hard problems, review code with care, and help strong engineers grow into technical leaders

- Raise the engineering bar group-wide — set standards for design, code quality, testing, observability, and operational excellence

- Own the hardest problems on our stack: Spark performance and cost across 60,000+ jobs/day, Iceberg table management at Taboola scale, high-throughput Kafka ingestion, and low-latency analytics on StarRocks

- Evolve our Spark SQL platform and the core framework code used across R&D — making the call on what gets built, refactored, or retired

- Drive the evolution of our lakehouse, with Iceberg as the backbone — from ingestion through storage, compaction, and serving

- Be the go-to expert for the production health of the main Taboola data pipeline — the system behind reports, ML model training, billing, and other business-critical processes — and lead deep-dives and postmortems on the toughest incidents

- Partner with team leaders, group managers, and fellow principal engineers to shape how the platform evolves across R&D, balancing the needs of algo, product, finance, and infrastructure stakeholders

- Stay deeply hands-on — write production code, build prototypes, and prove out new technology before the group commits to it

- Represent the group internally and externally — in architecture forums, hiring, open-source communities, and conference talks

- Directly shape how billions of people discover the internet

- Pioneered deployment of Spark SQL workloads on GPU with RAPIDS

- Delivered a real-time pipeline reports product serving all our customers on top of Druid

- Actively migrating a proprietary ETL system to dbt-core

- Compliance & Standards: Ensure automation coverage aligns with financial regulatory and payment-industry quality requirements.

- 3+ years working experience in a high-tech or fintech company, or hands-on experience in core modules of cross-border payments or third-party payments — preferred, not required.

israel.description:
About Payoneer

Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.

By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.

Role Summary

Location: Mexico City, Mexico

Hybrid

Full-Time

Payoneer is seeking an experienced local Compliance Officer to lead and manage the compliance program for Payoneer Mexico as a regulated Institucion de Fondos de Pago Electronico (IFPE) regulated by the Comisión Nacional Bancaria y de Valores (“CNBV”). This role will serve as the designated Compliance Officer for Payoneer Mexico. The Compliance Officer also serves as Payoneer Mexico’s local Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO) and point of contact with Mexico’s regulatory authorities, responsible for developing, implementing, administering, and maintaining all aspects of the AML/CFT Compliance Program in alignment with Mexico’s laws and regulations, internal policies and procedures, and supervisory expectations. The Compliance Officer must be fully knowledgeable of Mexico’s AML/CFT regime and best practices applicable to electronic payment institutions and payment service providers. The Compliance Officer must hold a valid CNBV certification in PLD/FT (Prevención de Lavado de Dinero y Financiamiento al Terrorismo) and will be expected to meet CBNV approval requirements as the designated Compliance Officer of Payoneer Mexico. The role combines hands-on regulatory knowledge with the ability to partner closely with global Compliance, Legal, Risk, Banking, and Product teams to embed compliance requirements into the local business.

This role will be based in our Polanco, Mexico City office and will functionally report to the Regional Head of Compliance for Americas.

What you’ll do:

- Design, implement, and continuously enhance Payoneer Mexico's compliance program in line with CNBV general provisions for IFPEs and local regulations applicable to electronic payment funds institutions.

- Serve as the designated Mexico Compliance Officer of record and Money Laundering Reporting Officer for Payoneer Mexico, fulfilling all statutory obligations attached to that role, including any formal registration or notification requirements.

- Act as primary compliance liaison to Mexican authorities, law enforcement, and regulators including CNBV; coordinate relevant regulatory exams, information requests, and remediation.

- Oversee end-to-end suspicious and unusual activity reporting processes, escalating and filing reports to Mexico’s national financial intelligence unit, Unidad de Inteligencia Financiera (UIF) as required (e.g., avisos, reportes de operaciones relevantes, reportes de operaciones inusuales, internas preocupantes, and 24-hour reports as applicable).

- Maintain and refresh compliance policies, procedures, standards, and controls to fulfill compliance requirements for an IFPE, ensuring they reflect current regulatory expectations and Payoneer's global standards, as well as related identification, reporting and record retention regulations.

- Support transaction monitoring and investigations workstreams, ensuring adherence to defined policies, procedures, and industry standard best practices.

- Facilitate and collaborate with applicable stakeholders on the annual AML and Sanctions Risk Assessments, with respect to regulated activity in Mexico.

- Prepare and present periodic compliance reports and information for the Payoneer Mexico Board of Directors.

- Oversee local Sanctions, Politically Exposed Persons (PEP) and Negative News screening decisions against Mexico lists, and coordinate with Payoneer’s Global Head of Sanctions and Screening as appropriate on relevant list management and system tuning.

- Assist with local Mexico regulatory examinations and internal/external independent reviews or audits of the AML program.

- Oversee responses to subpoenas or other document requests from Mexico law enforcement or regulatory bodies as applicable.

- Assist and advise Regional Head of Compliance and other members of Senior Compliance Management of emerging risks, new or amended laws, regulations, or agency guidance and recommend local Mexico compliance program improvements or enhancements.

- Prepare and review management information (KPIs/KRIs, training, issues and incidents, reporting statistics) for senior compliance leadership, local management, and periodic governance reporting, with respect to regulated activities in Mexico.

- Provide ongoing education and oversight on emerging AML/CFT risks arising from Payoneer’s customers, products, services, and partners in Mexico.

- Act as the bridge between Payoneer Mexico's local operations and Payoneer's global compliance, legal, and risk functions, ensuring local regulatory requirements are reflected in global systems, policies, and controls.

- Partner cross-functionally with Product, Data, Operations, and Global Compliance to embed local controls into new features and markets and to maintain alignment with Payoneer’s global standards.

- Future opportunity to build and lead local AML team and/or manage external resources as needed; promote a culture of compliance and continuous improvement.

What we are looking for:

- 7–10 years of progressive compliance and AML/CFT experience within a bank, fintech, IFPE, casa de cambio, or another entity regulated by the CNBV, Banco de México, and/or subject to AML regulation in Mexico. Cross‑border payments experience is strongly preferred.

- Prior experience serving as a designated Compliance Officer, Oficial de Cumplimiento, or similar registered/statutory compliance role before the CNBV is strongly preferred.

Payoneer Workforce Management (WFM) is Payoneer's global workforce solutions business, helping companies hire, onboard, pay, and manage talent anywhere in the world. The business enables organizations to build international teams quickly and compliantly without the need to establish legal entities in every country where they hire.

As remote and distributed workforces become increasingly common, companies face challenges related to employment compliance, payroll, benefits administration, contractor management, and local labor regulations. Payoneer WFM simplifies these complexities through technology-enabled workforce solutions and in-country expertise.

What We Do: Payoneer WFM provides end-to-end solutions that help businesses:

- Engage and manage contractors compliantly

- Process global payroll across multiple countries and currencies

- Manage onboarding and offboarding processes

- Ensure compliance with local employment and labor laws

- Handle benefits administration and workforce operations

- Support international expansion without requiring entity setup

Today, Payoneer WFM supports businesses across more than 160 countries, enabling them to access talent globally while maintaining compliance and operational efficiency.

The platform enables businesses to:

- Hire employees and contractors in 160+ countries

- Run global payroll in 70+ currencies

- Manage onboarding, contracts, benefits, compliance, expenses, and offboarding from a single platform

- Navigate local labor laws, tax requirements, and employment regulations across jurisdictions.

Employer of Record (EOR): A key offering within WFM is Employer of Record (EOR). Under the EOR model, Payoneer WFM becomes the legal employer of an individual in their local country while the client company manages the employee's day-to-day responsibilities, goals, and performance.

This allows organizations to hire talent internationally without establishing a local subsidiary or legal entity. Payoneer WFM manages employment contracts, payroll, taxes, statutory benefits, and compliance requirements, enabling clients to focus on growing their business.

Why This Market Matters: The global workforce landscape has changed significantly over the last few years. Companies are increasingly adopting remote and distributed hiring models, allowing them to access talent regardless of geography. As a result, the demand for global employment solutions, international payroll, and compliance management has grown rapidly.

How WFM Fits Within Payoneer: Payoneer is widely recognized as a global financial technology company that enables businesses to send, receive, and manage cross-border payments worldwide. Workforce Management extends this mission by helping businesses not only move money globally but also hire and manage talent globally. Together, these solutions enable companies to build, operate, and scale international businesses more efficiently.

Payoneer WFM is helping redefine how companies build global teams, making international hiring simpler, faster, and more accessible for businesses around the world.

israel.description:
About Payoneer

Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.

By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.

About the Role:

The Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) function supports Payoneer’s enterprise-wide risk governance, risk reporting, risk event management, issue management, risk assessments, controls and oversight processes.

This role will drive data, analytics, automation and AI-enabled transformation initiatives across the Risk & Resilience department. The role will lead enterprise risk data projects, strengthen risk analytics and reporting capabilities, and design and build practical AI-enabled solutions that improve Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) processes.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can combine GRC process knowledge, system administration, data analysis, AI-enabled solution building and stakeholder engagement.

The successful candidate will help improve how risk and governance teams operate by simplifying workflows, improving data quality, automating manual processes, enhancing reporting, and identifying where AI or in-house tools can complement existing GRC platforms.

The role is well suited to someone who is analytical, technically curious, comfortable working in a fast-paced fintech environment, and motivated to build practical tools that improve governance, risk management, compliance, audit and decision-making.

What you’ll do:

- Lead enterprise risk data and analytics projects from problem definition and requirements gathering through data sourcing, analysis, solution design, implementation and adoption.

- Support the development and execution of ERM’s data, analytics, automation and AI transformation roadmap, including identifying and prioritising high-value initiatives.

- Design and develop risk analytics, dashboards and management reporting across areas such as enterprise risk assessments, risk events, issues, controls, Key Risk Indicators (KRIs), audit findings, remediation activities, root causes and emerging risks.

- Analyse risk and GRC data to identify trends, risk concentrations, recurring themes, control weaknesses, emerging risks and opportunities for management action.

- Design and implement automated processes for data collection, transformation, validation, analysis, reporting and stakeholder follow-up.

- Lead the design, prototyping and delivery of AI-enabled GRC solutions across risk assessments, issue management, risk event analysis, control monitoring, KRI management, reporting, knowledge management, classification, summarisation and thematic analysis.

- Translate business and risk requirements into clear solution designs, workflows, user journeys, data requirements, functional specifications, prototypes and acceptance criteria.

- Build and test practical solutions using data analytics, business intelligence, automation, generative AI and low-code or no-code development capabilities.

- Partner with Technology, Data, AI, Security and Privacy teams to determine appropriate technical approaches, data sources, integrations, architecture and implementation models.

- Establish appropriate controls for AI and automated solutions, including data sensitivity, privacy, security, access management, validation, reliability, explainability, documentation, auditability, monitoring and human oversight.

- Lead data quality reviews and improvement initiatives, including identifying data gaps, inconsistencies, duplicate information, outdated records and reporting limitations.

- Manage AI pilots and proof-of-concept initiatives, evaluate outcomes, incorporate user feedback, and develop plans for controlled implementation and broader adoption.

- Measure the effectiveness of departmental data, automation and AI initiatives through defined success measures, including efficiency gains, data quality improvements, user adoption, reporting accuracy and decision-making value.

- Prepare risk insights, dashboards and analytical outputs for senior management, governance forums and other key stakeholders.

- Support stakeholder engagement, training, change management and adoption activities for new analytics, automation and AI-enabled capabilities.

- Support broader ERM activities and enterprise-wide risk initiatives as needed, including risk assessments, risk monitoring, governance materials, management reporting, capital modelling and strategic projects.

What we are looking for:

- Strong experience leading data, analytics, automation or technology-enabled transformation projects, preferably within enterprise risk management, operational risk, compliance, internal audit or another governance function.

- Strong understanding of risk and GRC processes, including risk assessments, risk events, issue management, control management, KRIs, audit findings, remediation tracking and governance reporting.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work with complex and fragmented datasets and translate them into clear, actionable risk insights.

- Hands-on experience developing dashboards, analytical tools, automated reporting or data-driven solutions using business intelligence, data visualisation, query, automation or similar technologies.

- Practical experience designing, prototyping or building AI-enabled solutions, including generative AI, workflow automation, intelligent classification, summarisation, thematic analysis or knowledge management capabilities.

- Ability to translate business and risk problems into structured requirements, data needs, solution designs and practical implementation plans.

- Understanding of data management principles, including data quality, governance, lineage, access controls, validation, documentation and reporting accuracy.

- Strong project ownership skills, with the ability to manage initiatives from concept and design through development, testing, implementation and adoption.

- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to explain data, technical, AI and risk concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

- Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities and deliver effectively in a fast-paced, global environment.

- A hands-on mindset with a willingness to analyse data, build prototypes, test solutions, resolve problems, document outcomes and support implementation.

- Experience with business intelligence, data analytics, automation, low-code or no-code development, or AI-enabled development tools is strongly preferred.

- Experience with tools such as Power BI, Tableau, SQL, Python, Microsoft Power Platform, Lovable or similar technologies would be advantageous.

Who you are

- Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Finance, Risk Management, Business or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

- Five or more years of relevant experience in data analytics, automation, AI solution delivery, risk management, GRC transformation, operational risk, compliance, internal audit, technology risk or a related field.

- Demonstrated experience delivering data, analytics, automation or AI-enabled solutions from initial concept through implementation is required.

- Experience within fintech, financial services, payments, banking, technology or another regulated environment is preferred.

- Experience supporting Second Line or Third Line functions would be advantageous.

israel.title: Legal Counsel - Employment (APAC & MEA)
israel.description:
About Payoneer

Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.

By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.

Our Growing WFM Ecosystem

This role sits at the heart of a rapidly expanding global workforce management (WFM) business, shaped by three significant transactions:

- Skuad (acquired August 2024, now rebranded as Payoneer Workforce Management): Skuad's expertise helps businesses in over 160 countries navigate complex challenges, including international payroll, remote onboarding, and regulatory compliance. This acquisition reinforced Payoneer's mission and solidified its role as a trusted partner for global WFM.

- Boundless (acquired January 2026): An Ireland-based Employer of Record (EOR) platform that helps companies seamlessly and compliantly employ people around the world. The acquisition deepens Payoneer's European presence and strengthens its end-to-end EOR capabilities globally — bringing complementary infrastructure and deep local expertise to the WFM business.

Together, these transactions position Payoneer WFM as one of the most comprehensive global employment and financial infrastructure platforms in the market — and this role will contribute directly to that scale.

Role Summary:

To achieve our mission of enabling remote employment globally, we need world-class legal capability embedded in the heart of our WFM business. We are seeking a Legal Counsel – Employment (APAC) to provide comprehensive, practical legal guidance across employment and labour matters for Payoneer WFM entities in India and across the APAC region.

The Legal Counsel – Employment (APAC) will report to the Senior Legal Counsel – Employment (APAC & MEA) and will be a critical contributor to the labour and employment charter for our EoR and AoR employee populations across the APAC portfolio. This is a high-impact role in a fast-moving environment - you will be advising on complex employment matters, supporting business expansion, and helping build scalable legal infrastructure for a growing platform.

What You'll Do

- Provide high-quality, practical employment law advice across the full employee lifecycle in multiple APAC and MEA Jurisdictions, including hiring, employment terms, statutory benefits, disciplinary processes, performance actions, separations, and workforce restructuring.

- Advise on and manage employee relations matters - including complex terminations, mutual separations, and dispute resolution - ensuring risk-aligned outcomes for EoR clients..

- Draft, review, and refine employment documentation including employment agreements, separation and mutual termination letters, transfer and relocation documents, full and final settlement letters, and statutory HR policies.

- Ensure compliance with labour laws across all relevant jurisdictions.

- Serve as POSH Internal Committee (IC) member or advisor - ensuring all compliance obligations under the India Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace Act are met, and personally managing or supporting inquiry proceedings as required in line with the law.

- Assist in developing and implementing employment, HR, compensation, and workforce-structuring policies aligned to local laws and business needs - including drafting and updating employee handbooks and statutory policies across multiple jurisdictions.

- Stay ahead of legislative and regulatory developments across central and state employment laws and translate updates into actionable, business-friendly guidance for internal stakeholders and clients.

- Collaborate closely with the wider Legal, HR Ops, Payroll, Finance, Sales, and GTM teams to deliver commercially aligned legal solutions across all relevant jurisdictions.

- Support individual and large-scale workforce transitions, reorganisations, and restructuring projects, ensuring legal compliance and robust documentation throughout.

- Conduct legal research and prepare clear analysis on employment and labour law issues as required.

- Deliver training and guidance to internal teams and clients on employment law compliance, risk mitigation, and best practices.

Who You Are

- You hold a Bachelor's degree in Law (LLB); a Master's degree or LLM is an added advantage.

- You bring 2–5 years of hands-on experience in Indian employment and labour law, either from a reputable law firm or an in-house legal function. Exposure to other APAC jurisdictions' employment laws is a significant advantage.

- You understand the legal nuances of hiring, employee lifecycle management, workforce transitions, and separations in India and other APAC and MEA jurisdictions.

- Prior experience working in or advising an Employer of Record (EoR) or global workforce management platform is a significant benefit.

- You have deep, practical knowledge of Indian labour laws and regulations — including the four Labour Codes (Code on Wages, Industrial Relations Code, Code on Social Security, and the Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code), POSH, and applicable state-level rules.

- You have strong drafting skills and are experienced in preparing and reviewing employment agreements, HR policies, separation documentation, and related employment artefacts.

- You possess excellent analytical, research, and problem-solving abilities, with the ability to translate legal requirements into practical, business-aligned guidance.

- You communicate legal concepts clearly and confidently, partnering effectively with HR, business teams, and leadership.

- You can work independently and as part of a wider team manage multiple matters simultaneously and operate with sound judgment in fast-moving environments.

- You have strong attention to detail, reliability, and a commitment to accuracy and compliance.

- Experience in working with US based companies is a benefit.

- You are proactive, adaptable, and comfortable navigating evolving laws, regulations, and business needs.

israel.title: Manager, Sales Development
israel.description:
About Payoneer

Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.

By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.

Role Summary

We're building a high-velocity outbound engine at Payoneer. As SDR Team Leader, you'll lead a team of 8 SDRs operating in cross-functional pods with Business Development Managers (BDMs) across EMEA countries. Your mission: generate pipeline velocity, drive qualification discipline, and scale revenue-generating prospecting activities.

This is not a pipeline factory role. This is about building a commercial operation where prospecting is strategic, selective, and outcome-focused. You report to the Head of Sales EMEA.



What You'll do

- Team Leadership & Execution: Lead and develop a team of SDRs working in country-based pods (SDR + BDM pairings). Set weekly and monthly prospecting targets. Remove blockers and coach your team on messaging, positioning, and objection handling.

- Pipeline Generation & Qualification: Own target account selection and campaign planning with BDM partners. Execute multi-touch prospecting campaigns (email, LinkedIn, phone) that convert to qualified meetings. Drive a qualification standard that supports BDM productivity and win rates.

- Performance & Analytics: Measure and report on SDR KPIs (activities, response rates, meeting-set rates, pipeline contribution to InYear revenue). Identify underperformers and top performers. Test, iterate, and optimize campaign plays.

- Process & Enablement: Define prospecting workflows, tools, and scripts. Work closely with Sales Leadership to refine targeting, while your team owns messaging strategy and execution. Own SDR onboarding, training, and ongoing knowledge updates. Ensure consistent use of CRM and forecasting.



Who You Are

- 5+ years in sales development (SDR, BDR, or similar outbound role)

- 2+ years managing / leading an SDR or sales team (minimum 3 direct reports)

- Proven success in EMEA markets (UK, EU, UAE, or MEA preferred)

- Experience in fintech, B2B SaaS, or payments is preferred

- Fluency in CRM (Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar) and sales engagement platforms

- High proficiency with AI-powered tools and automation, with a proven ability to leverage modern technology to improve efficiency, personalization, and overall performance



We're Looking For Someone Who:

Is obsessed with metrics. You can recite your team's activity rates, conversion rates, and pipeline contribution in your sleep.

Coaches through data, not intuition. You invest in SDR development and measure the impact.

Thinks commercially. You understand the BDM's economics and design prospecting to improve their productivity and close rates.

Runs lean and scrappy. You're not waiting for perfect tech or perfect market data. You iterate fast with what you have.

Has shipped results in emerging markets or in high-velocity growth environments.

israel.description:
About Payoneer

Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.

By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.

About Payoneer Workforce Management (WFM)

Payoneer Workforce Management (WFM) is Payoneer's global workforce solutions business, helping companies hire, onboard, pay, and manage talent anywhere in the world. The business enables organizations to build international teams quickly and compliantly without the need to establish legal entities in every country where they hire.

As remote and distributed workforces become increasingly common, companies face challenges related to employment compliance, payroll, benefits administration, contractor management, and local labor regulations. Payoneer WFM simplifies these complexities through technology-enabled workforce solutions and in-country expertise.

What We Do: Payoneer WFM provides end-to-end solutions that help businesses:

- Engage and manage contractors compliantly

- Process global payroll across multiple countries and currencies

- Manage onboarding and offboarding processes

- Ensure compliance with local employment and labor laws

- Handle benefits administration and workforce operations

- Support international expansion without requiring entity setup

Today, Payoneer WFM supports businesses across more than 160 countries, enabling them to access talent globally while maintaining compliance and operational efficiency.

The platform enables businesses to:

- Hire employees and contractors in 160+ countries

- Run global payroll in 70+ currencies

- Manage onboarding, contracts, benefits, compliance, expenses, and offboarding from a single platform

- Navigate local labor laws, tax requirements, and employment regulations across jurisdictions.

Employer of Record (EOR): A key offering within WFM is Employer of Record (EOR). Under the EOR model, Payoneer WFM becomes the legal employer of an individual in their local country while the client company manages the employee's day-to-day responsibilities, goals, and performance.

This allows organizations to hire talent internationally without establishing a local subsidiary or legal entity. Payoneer WFM manages employment contracts, payroll, taxes, statutory benefits, and compliance requirements, enabling clients to focus on growing their business.

Why This Market Matters: The global workforce landscape has changed significantly over the last few years. Companies are increasingly adopting remote and distributed hiring models, allowing them to access talent regardless of geography. As a result, the demand for global employment solutions, international payroll, and compliance management has grown rapidly.

How WFM Fits Within Payoneer: Payoneer is widely recognized as a global financial technology company that enables businesses to send, receive, and manage cross-border payments worldwide. Workforce Management extends this mission by helping businesses not only move money globally but also hire and manage talent globally. Together, these solutions enable companies to build, operate, and scale international businesses more efficiently.

Payoneer WFM is helping redefine how companies build global teams, making international hiring simpler, faster, and more accessible for businesses around the world.

About the Role:

We are looking for a detail-oriented Payroll Analyst to support accurate and timely payroll delivery across assigned countries. You will validate payroll inputs, reconcile outputs, resolve discrepancies and coordinate with internal teams and payroll partners. You will also support entity and platform transitions and contribute to automation and AI initiatives that simplify global payroll.

What you’ll do:

- Support payroll transitions between employing entities, payroll providers or platforms by validating employee data, opening balances and payroll results, and coordinating readiness for the first payroll cycle.

- Coordinate with payroll partners and internal teams to close pending inputs, approvals and discrepancies within agreed timelines, escalating risks that could affect payroll delivery.

- Investigate recurring payroll errors and exceptions, identify root causes and improve validation checks and processes to prevent recurrence.

- Maintain country-specific payroll procedures and support statutory reporting, reconciliations and audits in coordination with local payroll partners.

- Contribute to automation and AI initiatives by identifying manual tasks, documenting payroll requirements, testing workflows and validating outputs, helping us shape the future of Global Payroll

Who you are:

- 2-5 years of experience in payroll processing, input validation and reconciliation; exposure to multi-country payroll or payroll partner coordination is an advantage.

- Sound understanding of payroll calculations, tax and statutory requirements for the countries you have supported.

- Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets for validating data, reconciling payroll and investigating discrepancies.

- Comfortable working with payroll systems and learning new tools and workflows.

- Strong attention to detail, analytical skills and the ability to identify risks and resolve problems.

- Clear communication skills and the ability to coordinate across teams, manage competing deadlines and work independently.

- Eager to embrace automation and AI, continuously improve payroll delivery and help shape the future of global payroll.

How you’ll grow

- Build expertise in multi-country payroll, entity transitions and process improvement while gaining hands-on experience with AI agent-powered workflows.

- Work alongside Product, Engineering and Operations to improve payroll accuracy, reduce manual effort and measure the impact of your contributions.

Note: This role will be part of Payoneer WFM business unit.
