About Payoneer

Payoneer empowers businesses, professionals, and enterprises to participate in the global economy by enabling seamless cross-border payments and financial services. Our technology powers critical financial workflows at global scale, with a strong focus on reliability, security, scalability, and innovation.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Principal Engineer – Backend to provide technical leadership across Payoneer's backend engineering organization and help shape the next generation of our distributed financial systems.

This is a high-impact individual contributor role for an engineer who combines deep expertise in distributed systems and backend architecture with strong product thinking and organizational influence.

As a Principal Engineer, you will work on some of Payoneer's most complex technical challenges, define architectural direction, drive engineering excellence, and enable multiple teams to build reliable, scalable, and resilient systems.

The role also requires an AI-first mindset in identifying opportunities to use AI and agentic technologies to improve how we build, operate, and evolve our products and engineering systems. You will also help explore and build systems using emerging protocols and technologies such as MCP (Model Context Protocol).

What You'll Do

• Define and drive the technical and architectural vision for large-scale backend systems and distributed platforms.

• Design and build highly scalable, resilient, secure, and fault-tolerant distributed systems supporting Payoneer's global financial infrastructure.

• Solve complex technical problems spanning multiple systems, services, teams, and domains.

• Drive architectural decisions and establish engineering patterns, standards, and best practices across teams.

• Lead the evolution of backend platforms toward greater scalability, reliability, observability, performance, and developer productivity.

• Act as a technical leader and trusted advisor to engineering leadership, product leaders, and other stakeholders.

• Work closely with engineering teams to identify and address systemic technical challenges and technical debt.

• Champion an AI-first approach to software engineering, identifying opportunities to leverage LLMs, AI agents, automation, and intelligent developer tooling across the software development lifecycle.

• Explore, prototype, and drive adoption of emerging AI technologies, including MCP (Model Context Protocol) and agent-based architectures, where they can create meaningful business or engineering value.

• Partner with teams across engineering, product, security, infrastructure, data, and other functions to solve complex cross-domain problems.

• Influence technical strategy across multiple engineering teams and organizational boundaries, without relying solely on direct authority.

• Mentor and coach engineering leads, senior engineers, and architects, helping raise the technical bar across the organization.

• Help develop the next generation of technical leaders through architecture reviews, design discussions, technical mentorship, and knowledge sharing.

• Establish and promote practices around engineering excellence, system design, reliability, security, testing, observability, and operational readiness.

• Lead technical initiatives that require coordination across geographically distributed and cross-functional teams.

• Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Stay current with emerging technologies and continuously evaluate how they can improve Payoneer's engineering capabilities.

What We're Looking For

• Extensive experience designing and building large-scale distributed systems and backend platforms.

• Strong expertise in backend engineering, system architecture, APIs, microservices, data-intensive systems, and cloud-native architectures.

• Deep understanding of distributed systems concepts including consistency, availability, fault tolerance, concurrency, distributed transactions, messaging, event-driven architectures, and scalability.

• Proven experience leading architecture and technical strategy across multiple engineering teams or complex technology domains.

• Strong track record of taking ambiguous, complex problems and translating them into scalable technical solutions.

israel.description:
About Payoneer

Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.

Principal Mobile Engineer
AI-Native Cloud Platform

Team: Mobile Platform Team

Reports to: Sr. Director of R&D, Cloud Platform

Location: [Gurgaon / Hybrid]

About the role

Payoneer is investing in the next generation of its mobile application: lightweight, high-performance, and designed as a platform that lets product teams contribute features independently while the app remains coherent, fast, and stable as a whole. The host application will provide the common foundations — observability, logging, navigation, identity, networking, feature flags, release tooling, automation — and product teams will plug into it through a clear contribution model.

We are hiring two Principal Mobile Engineers to define and build this foundation alongside the existing mobile team. Together you will own the tech stack decision — native iOS and Android, Flutter, React Native or a hybrid — and you will shape the platform every product team at Payoneer ships mobile features on top of. The two-Principal structure gives us the capacity to build the platform properly, and the optionality to specialize one Principal per native platform if we go that route.

What you’ll own

You will own the tech stack decision and the rationale behind it. You will run the evaluation — native (Swift / Kotlin) vs Flutter vs React Native vs hybrid — against real constraints: performance, binary size, hiring market, team contribution model, build and release velocity, long-term maintenance cost. You will make the call jointly with your peer Principal and you will be expected to defend it under scrutiny from engineering, product, and executive leadership.

You will build the host application foundation. The architecture, the module boundaries, the navigation and lifecycle model, the dependency injection approach, the state management patterns, the threading and concurrency model, the network stack, the persistence layer, the observability and logging backbone, the release and rollout machinery, the testing strategy at every level of the pyramid. Every product team’s first impression of mobile at Payoneer will be the abstractions you ship.

You will define the contribution model that product teams use to deliver features into the host app. Module boundaries, public API surface, lifecycle hooks, dependency policy, build and integration patterns, version compatibility, and the developer experience that makes contributing a feature fast and contributing a bad one hard. You will own the standards every contributing team writes against.

You will own performance, binary size, startup time, frame rate, memory, and battery as first-class engineering disciplines with measured budgets and gates. You will own crash-free rate and stability as platform commitments. You will own the CI/CD, signing, release, and rollout pipeline for the app, and the observability that makes a production issue debuggable in minutes rather than days.

You will partner with the Application Foundations Crew and the Cloud Platform Base, DevEx, and Network and Security teams to make sure mobile integrates cleanly with the platform — APIs, events, identity, secrets, automation and the shift-left controls that apply on the mobile side as much as the server side. You will partner with product engineering across the company to bring contributing teams into the platform and keep them productive in it.

What we’re looking for

You have ten or more years of mobile engineering experience and you have built mobile applications from the ground up — not joined them, not iterated on them, but defined the foundation and shipped it to production at scale. You have an honest, scarred view of what mobile platform decisions cost three years after you make them.

You are deeply expert in at least one of iOS or Android, and seriously fluent in the other. On iOS that means Swift, the Swift concurrency model, UIKit and SwiftUI, the Apple toolchain and release process, and the parts of the ecosystem most engineers learn the hard way. On Android that means Kotlin, coroutines and Flow, the Android lifecycle, Jetpack and Compose, Gradle in earnest, RxJava where it still lives, and the same hard-won understanding of the ecosystem.

You understand the cross-platform landscape with the same honesty. You have an opinion on Flutter, KMP, and React Native that goes beyond preference — performance characteristics, ceiling, where each shines, where each fails — and you can defend the recommendation you would make for a fintech app at Payoneer’s scale.

You have built and operated a modular mobile platform before, or something close enough that you understand the trade-offs: how to define module boundaries that survive ten product teams contributing in parallel, how to keep the host app coherent when contributors disagree, how to version a contribution model without breaking everyone, and how to keep the binary lean as the surface grows.

You think in budgets and measurements. You have driven startup time, frame rate, binary size, and crash-free rate as numbers on a dashboard. You understand mobile observability at a level beyond crash reporting, and you have shipped the instrumentation needed to debug productio.

You communicate clearly with engineers, product partners, and executives. You can write a one-page architecture proposal, run an RFC that actually converges, demo what you built so other engineers want to use it, and explain a stack decision to a CPO in language they care about. You handle disagreement well — including with your peer Principal — and you know how to land a joint decision.

Nice to have

Experience integrating AI capabilities into mobile applications — on-device models, conversational and agent UI patterns, latency-sensitive AI features, and the privacy and offline considerations that come with them — is a strong plus, given Payoneer’s AI-native platform direction.

Why this role matters

The mobile app is the surface Payoneer customers touch after Web. The foundation you build will compound for years. You will have unusual scope to define what good looks like for Payoneer, and credibly for the industry, at the point where regulated payments, mobile engineering at scale, and AI-native development converge.

Payoneer is building the AI platform that will enable teams across the company to create, deploy, and operate AI agents safely, consistently, and at scale.

We are looking for a Principal Product Manager to lead our AI Control Plane, the platform layer that allows developers, and over time broader teams across Payoneer, to build agents without having to solve the underlying infrastructure challenges themselves.

The vision is simple: teams should be able to focus on what an agent needs to accomplish, the business outcome it should drive, and how it should behave, while the platform takes care of the infrastructure, controls, governance, and reusable capabilities required to make it work reliably.

This is not a role for someone who has only shipped individual AI features or customer-facing products. We are looking for a product leader who has built internal platforms that other teams build on, understands Agentic AI deeply, and is excited by the challenge of creating foundational capabilities that can unlock AI across an entire organization.

You will operate at the intersection of Product, Engineering, Architecture, Security, and AI, helping shape how Payoneer builds and scales agentic products for the future.



What you'll do:

- Own the AI Control Plane. Define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the platform that enables teams across Payoneer to build and operate AI agents.

- Build for builders. Create a platform experience that allows developers and other teams to focus on business logic and agent behavior while the platform handles the underlying complexity.

- Create reusable platform capabilities. Define common services, patterns, and infrastructure that can support multiple agents, teams, and use cases rather than one-off implementations.

- Shape the agent infrastructure. Partner deeply with Engineering and Architecture on the capabilities required to build, manage, and scale agentic systems.

- Establish control and governance. Define how users, permissions, policies, monitoring, risk, and governance should work across the agent ecosystem.

- Make agents observable and manageable. Build the capabilities needed to understand how agents behave, where they fail, how they are being used, and how teams can operate them safely.

- Drive platform adoption. Make the platform simple enough and valuable enough that teams choose to build on it rather than creating their own infrastructure.

- Set the product standards. Define what good looks like for agent infrastructure, platform quality, scalability, developer experience, and operational readiness.

- Lead through ambiguity. This is a rapidly evolving space. You will make decisions with incomplete information, evaluate new technologies quickly, and turn emerging capabilities into a coherent platform strategy.

Experience

- An experienced product leader. You have 9+ years of Product Management experience, with a track record of owning complex, technical products.

israel.description:
About Payoneer

Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.

By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.

About Payoneer Workforce Management (WFM)

Payoneer Workforce Management (WFM) is Payoneer's global workforce solutions business, helping companies hire, onboard, pay, and manage talent anywhere in the world. The business enables organizations to build international teams quickly and compliantly without the need to establish legal entities in every country where they hire.

As remote and distributed workforces become increasingly common, companies face challenges related to employment compliance, payroll, benefits administration, contractor management, and local labor regulations. Payoneer WFM simplifies these complexities through technology-enabled workforce solutions and in-country expertise.

What We Do: Payoneer WFM provides end-to-end solutions that help businesses:

- Engage and manage contractors compliantly

- Process global payroll across multiple countries and currencies

- Manage onboarding and offboarding processes

- Ensure compliance with local employment and labor laws

- Handle benefits administration and workforce operations

- Support international expansion without requiring entity setup

Today, Payoneer WFM supports businesses across more than 160 countries, enabling them to access talent globally while maintaining compliance and operational efficiency.

The platform enables businesses to:

- Hire employees and contractors in 160+ countries

- Run global payroll in 70+ currencies

- Manage onboarding, contracts, benefits, compliance, expenses, and offboarding from a single platform

- Navigate local labor laws, tax requirements, and employment regulations across jurisdictions.

Employer of Record (EOR): A key offering within WFM is Employer of Record (EOR). Under the EOR model, Payoneer WFM becomes the legal employer of an individual in their local country while the client company manages the employee's day-to-day responsibilities, goals, and performance.

This allows organizations to hire talent internationally without establishing a local subsidiary or legal entity. Payoneer WFM manages employment contracts, payroll, taxes, statutory benefits, and compliance requirements, enabling clients to focus on growing their business.

Why This Market Matters: The global workforce landscape has changed significantly over the last few years. Companies are increasingly adopting remote and distributed hiring models, allowing them to access talent regardless of geography. As a result, the demand for global employment solutions, international payroll, and compliance management has grown rapidly.

How WFM Fits Within Payoneer: Payoneer is widely recognized as a global financial technology company that enables businesses to send, receive, and manage cross-border payments worldwide. Workforce Management extends this mission by helping businesses not only move money globally but also hire and manage talent globally. Together, these solutions enable companies to build, operate, and scale international businesses more efficiently.

Payoneer WFM is helping redefine how companies build global teams, making international hiring simpler, faster, and more accessible for businesses around the world.

About Payoneer

Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. Role Summary

We are looking for a Senior Director, Customer Success for Latin America to own the retention and growth strategy for our LATAM customer base — from SMB at scale to larger, strategic accounts.

This is a hands-on regional leadership role within a global Customer Success organization. You will own regional outcomes, define and launch LATAM-specific retention and growth initiatives, and adapt the global Customer Success model to what works best for the market. You will be expected to bring fresh, data-informed ideas, turn them into measurable programs, and drive execution with speed and rigor.

You will also act as the voice of LATAM within the global organization, influencing global teams and senior stakeholders to secure the priorities, resources, and decisions the region needs to succeed.

This role is ideal for a results-driven, entrepreneurial CS leader who combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution — someone who can identify opportunities, build the strategy, remove blockers, and deliver measurable business outcomes.

What you'll do

-
Own the LATAM retention and growth strategy — define the regional agenda and identify new opportunities to improve retention, adoption, and expansion across the customer base.

-
Design, launch, and iterate region-specific programs — develop lifecycle motions, retention plays, and growth initiatives tailored to LATAM segments; test, measure, and continuously improve based on results.

-
Adapt and elevate the global Customer Success model for LATAM — leverage global frameworks, playbooks, and KPIs where they work, while reshaping them where local market dynamics require a different approach.

-
Drive the full customer lifecycle — own onboarding, adoption, engagement, expansion, and renewals, balancing scalable SMB motions with a more sophisticated approach for larger and strategic accounts.

-
Execute with pace and quality — translate strategy into action, maintain high execution standards, and ensure regional priorities consistently move forward.

-
Unblock issues, escalations, and cross-functional initiatives — act as a regional problem-solver, rapidly removing obstacles and driving complex issues and projects to resolution.

-
Influence global teams on behalf of LATAM — partner with global Customer Success, Product, Risk, Operations, Sales, and Support teams to advocate for regional priorities and secure the resources and decisions needed to deliver results.

-
Own regional performance and KPIs — maintain accountability for retention, NRR/GRR, product adoption, churn, segmentation health, and other key Customer Success metrics.

-
Establish a disciplined operating cadence — lead dashboards, QBRs, success scorecards, forecasting, and executive reporting for the LATAM business.

-
Build, coach, and scale the regional CS organization — hire, develop, and retain high-performing talent while establishing a culture of ownership, accountability, speed, and customer obsession.

-
Strengthen regional cross-functional alignment — work closely with Sales, Product, Risk, Operations, and Support to improve customer outcomes and operational efficiency.

-
Be the voice of the LATAM customer — consolidate regional insights and translate them into clear, actionable recommendations for global teams.

-
Build executive customer relationships — engage directly with key and strategic accounts, particularly in high-value, complex, or escalated situations.

Who you are

Professional background

-
10–15+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Post-Sales, or a related customer-facing function, including senior leadership experience.

-
5+ years leading regional or country-level Customer Success teams, with direct accountability for execution, customer outcomes, and business results.

-
A proven track record of hands-on execution and delivering results in fast-paced, complex environments.

-
Demonstrated experience originating and launching retention and growth strategies, not simply executing existing programs.

-
Strong experience operating Customer Success models at scale, including segmentation, lifecycle design, playbooks, KPI frameworks, and operating cadences.

-
Proven ability to influence across a matrix organization, including senior and global stakeholders, without relying on direct authority.

-
Experience in fintech or payments is a significant advantage.

-
Experience managing SMB customers at scale is a strong advantage.

-
Experience evolving Customer Success toward more strategic and upmarket customer engagement is a strong advantage.

-
Deep knowledge of the LATAM market and professional fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese, plus business-level English.

Hybrid
Full-time

The PM on an AI-native team is a business owner in the fullest sense. They own the problem space, the customer, the data, the roadmap, the communication, and the outcome.
AI tools remove the operational overhead that previously prevented PMs from operating at this level.
This is a demanding profile. The PM needs to be experienced enough to exercise judgment under ambiguity, commercially minded enough to connect product decisions directly to business outcomes, and technically literate enough to work alongside engineers without becoming a bottleneck.
The three things that matter most: judgment, bias for action, and creativity. AI fluency is table stakes.

What you’ll do

- Own the full product lifecycle for your area - discovery, definition, delivery, and post-launch learning - end-to-end, without waiting for handoffs.

- Develop deep customer understanding. Spend real time with users. Bring customer insight into every prioritization decision.

- Run and interpret your own data - Define goals and KPIs, monitor and measures impact, and make decisions based on evidence you’ve constructed yourself.

- Define and manage experiments with statistical rigor. Own the hypothesis, the design, and the interpretation of results.

- Orchestrate AI agents and tools to accelerate research, synthesis, and execution. Use them to eliminate low-value work, not to replace thinking.

- Communicate decisions clearly and proactively. Stakeholders should always know what the team is doing and why - without needing to ask.

- Be a part of a learning organization. Share what you and your team learn across the organization. Treat cross-pollination as a core part of the job.

- Operate in a high autonomy environment. Work with a high sense of ownership. Know when to move independently and when to bring others in.



Who you are

- 6+ years of product management experience with a track record of owning business outcomes, not just shipping features.

- Commercially minded, users focused. You think in terms of business impact through solving real users' problems. Product decisions connect directly to metrics that matter.

- Strong analytical instincts. You work directly with data - building queries, interpreting results, making the call.

- High agency. You move without being pushed. You identify what needs to happen and make it happen.

- Technically fluent. You understand how systems work well enough to have substantive conversations with engineers and make trade-offs.

- AI-native. You use AI tools as a core part of how you work - research, synthesis, prototyping, analysis. This is not optional for this role.

- Incredible communicator. You write and speak with precision. You know how to tailor context for different audiences.

- Curious and honest. You ask hard questions, including of your own assumptions. You share what you learn, including what did not work.

- Great to work with – You're a team player, eager to learn as you’re eager to teach. You’re creative, passionate, flexible, and humble

israel.description:
About Payoneer

Role summary

PAYO Digital Bank, N.A. (PDB), Payoneer's national trust bank subsidiary, is seeking a deeply experienced Senior Staff Engineer to serve as the technical anchor of the bank's engineering organization and the architect of record for its core transactional systems. You will own the design of the integration between the core banking ledger and the stablecoin issuance engine: the system of record that reconciles fiat reserves, on-chain token supply, and customer balances with bank-grade accuracy and auditability.

This is a high-impact, hands-on architecture and leadership role reporting directly to the Chief Technology Officer of PDB, providing technical direction to the core team of engineers.

The ideal candidate is a distributed systems expert with high-integrity transactional experience (banking core, payments ledger, exchange, or settlement infrastructure). You must be able to defend architectural decisions to independent auditors and OCC examiners, and build engineering culture as deliberately as you build systems.



Candidates must be based in New York, NY OR Miami, FL | Full-time



What you'll do

- Core Architecture Ownership: Architect and build the bank's core backend, including microservices, transactional persistence schemas, event messaging endpoints, and internal APIs, documented to a standard suitable for OCC examination.

- Ledger & Stablecoin Integration: Design the reconciliation architecture guaranteeing absolute consistency between the fiat subledger, reserve accounts, and on-chain token supply. Build the event messaging layer securely synchronizing core ledger transactions with custody platform mint/burn actions.

- Technical Leadership: Serve as the technical lead and mentor for the Core Backend team. Establish uncompromising standards for code reviews, testing, observability, and deployment appropriate for a regulated bank.

- Compliance in the Transaction Path: Integrate automated sanctions screening connectors with auditable screening and case escalation hooks.

- Resilience & Observability: Partner with the SRE Lead on multi-region availability, failover targets, and real-time ledger alerting. Work with the Security division on IAM, key management interfaces, and threat modeling for mint/burn pipelines.

- Audit Readiness: Support UAT, feature freezes, and external control validation ahead of the pre-opening exam.



Who you are

- Engineering Depth: 12+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years hands-on architecting high-integrity transactional systems (banking core, payments ledger, exchange, or settlement infrastructure).

- Distributed Systems Expertise: Deep understanding of event-driven architecture, exactly-once processing semantics, idempotency, and reconciliation at scale.

- Cloud-Native Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Infrastructure-as-Code, and multi-region deployment in a regulated or audited environment.

- Audit-Grade Engineering: Track record designing immutable transaction logs, reconciliation controls, and automated evidence generation for examiners and external auditors.

- Technical Mentorship: Proven success elevating the technical output of senior engineers, setting architectural standards, and owning delivery end-to-end.

- Regulator-Ready Documentation: Ability to produce system architecture documentation that withstands intense regulatory and audit scrutiny.



Not a must but a great advantage:

- Digital Asset Systems: Direct experience with stablecoin, digital asset custody, or blockchain settlement systems, including on-chain/off-chain reconciliation.

- Examination Environments: Familiarity with FFIEC IT examination expectations or SOC 2 audit environments.



Why This Role Matters Every dollar of PAYO-USD in circulation depends on the systems this role designs. The Senior Staff Engineer builds the transactional backbone that regulators examine, auditors verify, and merchants trust.

israel.description:
About Payoneer

Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.

By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.

Role Summary



Location: London

Hybrid

Full-Time



The Strategic Account Director is a new-business, quota-carrying hunter responsible for landing the largest, most complex enterprise logos in the market. You own the full pursuit — from target identification and outbound generation through multi-threaded, committee-driven sales cycles to signed, revenue-producing contracts. Your prospects run cross-border volume at scale, they are today served by incumbent banks or specialist fintechs, and displacing that incumbent is the job.

This is a role for someone who is energized by the chase: building conviction where none exists, getting into the CFO's and Treasurer's office cold, orchestrating a pursuit team through a long and technical evaluation, and closing seven-figure relationships. You set the bar for how strategic new business gets won at Payoneer.

This is a strategic role. It is deliberately seated centrally under Global Sales so the strategic-accounts motion can be built, proven, and standardized before ownership is distributed to the regions. You will work hand in hand with regional heads of sales for in-market coordination and, over time, help shape how this function scales across the field.



What You'll Do



- Hunt and land net-new strategic accounts. Own a new-business quota. Identify, prioritize, and pursue the highest-value target accounts in your territory (typically $500K+/month cross-border volume, up to $10M+/month strategic targets) and convert them into signed, funded customers.

- Generate your own pipeline. Build top-of-funnel through disciplined, research-led outbound — direct executive outreach, referrals, partner and ecosystem channels, and events. Do not wait for leads; create them.

- Break into the buying committee cold. Get in front of and build conviction with CFOs, Treasurers, Finance Operations, and Compliance/Risk leaders at target accounts. Multi-thread deliberately so a deal never rests on a single contact.

- Displace the incumbent. Position Payoneer's speed, global coverage, economics, and platform breadth to unseat incumbent banks and specialist competitors. Run competitive displacement plays and build the business case that moves an entrenched buyer.

- Own complex, long-cycle deals end to end. Drive multi-stakeholder, technical, compliance-sensitive evaluations from first meeting to close. Own the mutual close plan, procurement, legal, and commercial negotiation.

- Sell the platform. Lead with value, not features. Land the entry wedge and architect the deal to open cross-border payments plus high-value services (Capital, Treasury/FX, Embedded/Platform Payments, Workforce/EOR, and emerging rails) — maximizing initial contract value and expansion potential.

- Qualify with discipline. Apply Payoneer's Sandler-based methodology — Up-Front Contracts, Pain Funnel, budget and decision qualification — to every pursuit so you invest team resources only in winnable, real deals.

- Orchestrate the pursuit team. Direct Solutions/Pre-Sales, Product Specialists, Compliance, and RevOps as a coordinated deal team through the sales cycle, and quarterback executive sponsorship where needed.

- Forecast honestly and close on time. Own a credible, hygienic pipeline and forecast in CRM. Drive deals to close dates and call your number straight.

- Set up the win for the long term. Land with a clean handoff to Customer Success and a clear expansion thesis, so every logo you close becomes a growth account.





Who You Are

- 8+ years in enterprise B2B sales with a strong bias toward new business / new logo acquisition — not primarily account management or renewals.

- Consistent, demonstrable record of hitting or exceeding a new-business quota on complex, high-value deals.

- Proven ability to self-generate pipeline through outbound and to break into cold enterprise accounts at the executive level.

- Experience closing long-cycle, multi-stakeholder deals with meaningful (six- to seven-figure) contract value.

- Demonstrated success selling into and navigating executive buying committees — CFO, Treasury, Finance, Compliance/Risk.

- Strong commercial and negotiation skills, including running procurement, legal, and margin-protective deal structuring to close.

- Fluency operating in a matrix environment and orchestrating a cross-functional pursuit team.

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.



Preferred

- Background in payments, fintech, banking, treasury, FX, or cross-border commerce.

- Track record of competitive displacement against incumbent banks or specialist fintechs.

- Experience selling a multi-product platform and structuring land-and-expand entry deals.

- Familiarity with a structured sales methodology (Payoneer uses Sandler).

- Exposure to compliance-sensitive, regulated sales environments (KYC/AML-aware selling).

- Strong CRM discipline and data-driven pipeline management (e.g., Salesforce).

PAYO Digital Bank, N.A. (“PDB”) is Payoneer’s proposed U.S. national trust bank, designed to support stablecoin-enabled infrastructure for global businesses. As a wholly owned subsidiary of Payoneer Global Inc., PDB will sit at the center of Payoneer’s strategy to integrate stablecoin capabilities into its global payments ecosystem, connecting stablecoin efficiency to the local economies where nearly two million Payoneer customers operate.

We are looking for a hands-on Treasury Operations Director to build and own the operational treasury flows of the bank end-to-end. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role reporting directly to the Chief Financial Officer. The ideal candidate will have operational experience, exceptional analytical skills, sound judgment, and a strong controls mindset. The Treasury Operations Director will be responsible for the day-to-day management of PDB’s liquidity and the reserve assets backing the bank’s stablecoin, so the bank can reliably meet its obligations and stay compliant with PDB policy and the GENIUS Act framework. This is a build role: you will help stand up PDB’s treasury function from the ground up rather than inherit an existing one. Subject to designation by the PDB Board, this role may also serve as one of PDB’s designated fiduciary officers, exercising control over PDB’s fiduciary custody accounts.



What you'll do

- Build and develop PDB's treasury operating model, systems, controls and processes.

- Manage day-to-day liquidity, funding activities and settlement operations.

- Oversee stablecoin reserve assets and ensure compliance with applicable regulatory and governance requirements.

- Develop cash flow forecasting and liquidity stress testing capabilities.

- Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Risk, Compliance and Finance teams to support new initiatives and operational readiness.

- Manage relationships with banking partners, custodians and treasury service providers.

- Prepare treasury reporting and materials for executive management, committees and board discussions.

- Assess treasury and liquidity implications of new products and business initiatives.

Who you are

- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting or a related field.

- 10+ years of experience in Treasury, Liquidity Management, Reserve Management or Investment Operations.

- Experience within a regulated financial institution, payments company, fintech, or digital asset organization.

- Strong understanding of liquidity management, cash forecasting, treasury operations and controls.

- Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.

- Comfortable operating in a fast-paced and evolving environment.

- Self-starter with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

Nice to have

- Experience with stablecoins, digital assets, blockchain infrastructure or custody solutions.

- Familiarity with trust banking or fiduciary custody frameworks.

- Knowledge of the GENIUS Act, OCC regulatory environment, or related banking regulations.

- CTP, CFA or CPA certification.

Risk Adjustment accounts for differences in members’ health needs and expected cost of care. Accurate and complete clinical documentation helps ensure that a member’s health status is appropriately represented. Prospective Risk Adjustment focuses on proactively supporting opportunities for healthcare providers to review members’ health information and accurately document conditions addressed during clinical care, in accordance with applicable clinical coding and documentation requirements. These efforts may include sharing relevant clinical information with providers at the point of care, conducting virtual or in-home health assessments, and providing reports that identify historical or suspected conditions for provider review and clinical validation.

The Analyst, Risk Adjustment supports the day-to-day execution and performance of Prospective Risk Adjustment programs. This role partners with internal teams and external vendors to ensure operational workflows are functioning as intended, program data and reporting are accurate, claims are processed appropriately, and operational issues are identified and resolved in a timely manner. The analyst will support a portfolio of initiatives including Point-of-Care tools, Virtual Health Assessments (VHA), In-Home Assessments (IHA), and provider reporting to support the review of member conditions. This role is well suited for an analytical, detail-oriented professional interested in developing expertise in Risk Adjustment and healthcare operations.

You will ensure claims are paid accurately and timely with the highest quality. You will report into the Manager, Payment Integrity (Pre-Pay).

- Proactively identify and document potential billing errors, including duplicate billing of items, services, or procedures as improper unbundling of services (e.g., separating components that should be billed together) and charges for non-covered or non-rendered services

- Compare billed charges against both payor-specific contracts and industry guidelines to confirm appropriate billing practices.

- Apply working knowledge of national coding systems (e.g., CPT, HCPCS, ICD-10, MS-DRGs) to validate the accuracy of codes used for services billed.

- Provide subject matter expertise and in-depth understanding of Payment Integrity internal claims processing edits, external vendor edits and Oscar reimbursement policies

- Identify claims payment issues from data mining, process monitoring, etc., provide scoping and action steps needed to remediate the issue

- Respond to internal and external inquiries and disputes regarding policies and edits.

- Document industry standard coding rules and provide recommendations on reimbursement policy language and scope

- Ideate payment integrity opportunities based on a deep knowledge of industry standard coding rules. Translate into business requirements; submit to and collaborate with internal partners to effectuate change

- Compliance with all applicable laws and regulations

- Other duties as assigned

- 2+ years of bill / coding audit experience with a focus on hospital or facility billing (UB-04)

- Medical coding certification through AAPC (CPC, COC) or AHIMA (CCS, RHIT, RHIA)

- Experience with reimbursement methodologies, provider contract concepts and common claims processing/resolution practices

Ancillary Product Strategy & Portfolio Management

-
In partnership with leader, drives the ancillary product strategy and roadmap across dental, vision and other ancillary offerings (e.g. hearing, fitness, over the counter benefits, wellness and other insurance add-on products)

Owns the full end-to-end lifecycle of ancillary products, including dental and vision insurance offerings, from ideation and benefit design through launch, performance management, and ongoing optimization

Build and manage business cases for new and existing products, including financial modeling, membership projections, and ongoing performance tracking against goals.

Analyze product performance using financial and membership metrics to forecast results, identify risks and opportunities, and inform decision-making.

Lead benefit design for ancillary products, including augmenting existing offerings, remediating underperforming designs, and introducing new benefit structures for specific consumer populations, based on performance, member needs, and market dynamics

-
Contribute to annual planning, roadmap development, and prioritization for ancillary products

Business lead for end to end implementation of ancillary vendors, serving as the primary product DRI and escalation point for dental and vision vendors and provide oversight for ancillary vendors

Define and manage vendor requirements, SLAs, KPIs and performance scorecards

-
Partner with procurement, legal and compliance on vendor selection, contracting, renewals and performance governance

-
Drive timely issue resolution and root cause remediation with vendors to prevent repeat issues

Serves as a member of the Joint Operating Committee (JOC) for ancillary products, in partnership with Network, and leadership, including agenda setting, performance reviews, issue tracking, and follow-through on commitments

-
Identify risks, gaps, and opportunities across benefit design, product performance, and execution, including recommendation of corrective actions



Execution, Filings & Regulatory Alignment

-
Partner with Actuarial and Finance teams to evaluate pricing, unit economics, and profitability tradeoffs, to inform benefit and portfolio decisions

-
Collaborate with Regulatory and Legal teams to ensure ancillary products comply with federal and state requirements and are filed, updated, and approved as needed

-
Oversee ancillary product QA, attestations and final sign off prior to filing submissions

-
Ensure compliance with all applicable laws, regulations, and internal governance standards



Cross Functional Leadership & Governance

Act as the single accountable product owner for ancillary benefits- coordinating across teams

-
Translate vendor capabilities and regulatory constraints into clear product requirements

-
Influence senior leaders with clear data-driven recommendations and risk assessments



Post Launch Performance & Optimization

Develop and maintain regular performance reporting and product look-backs, assessing financial, operational, clinical, and member experience outcomes

Use analytics and business intelligence tools (e.g., Looker) to pull, analyze, and interpret data related to utilization, cost, engagement, retention, and vendor performance

Carry forward learnings to future cycles to improve scalability, reduce risk and enhance member outcomes



Data Driven Decision Making

-
Leverage enrollment, utilization, cost, quality and vendor performance data to inform ancillary product strategy

-
Identify trends and risks early and proactively adjust product or vendor strategies

-
Compliance with all applicable laws and regulations

-
Other duties as assigned

6+ years of experience developing, managing, or supporting commercial insurance products, with direct ownership of ancillary (dental, vision, supplemental health) offerings, with Strong understanding of regulatory requirements impacting ancillary benefits

-
5+ years of expertise in Dental and Vision product design and vendor implementation

-
4+ years of Proven experience managing delegated vendors and complex operational partnerships

-
4 + years experience with ACA, including individual market place and small group products

-

israel.title: Senior Product Designer
israel.location: New York, New York, United States
israel.description:
Hi, we're Oscar. We're hiring a Senior Product Designer to join our Product Design team.

Oscar is the first health insurance company built around a full stack technology platform and a relentless focus on serving our members. We started Oscar in 2012 to create the kind of health insurance company we would want for ourselves—one that behaves like a doctor in the family.



About the role:

Oscar’s Internal Tools design team creates the mission-critical products that power our insurance and care operations. These tools support teams across Clinical, Core Insurance, and Network as they manage complex workflows involving claims, risk adjustment, provider networks, clinical care, and other essential business functions.  As a Senior Product Designer, you will help define and deliver clear, effective experiences across this ecosystem. You will work closely with product managers, engineers, researchers, data partners, clinicians, operational teams, and other designers to understand complex problems, identify opportunities, and take solutions from discovery through delivery.  The work is operational, workflow-heavy, data-rich, and technically complex. It requires strong systems thinking, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to connect decisions across users, workflows, and products. Your initial product area will be determined based on your experience, interests, and Oscar’s current needs.

Oscar is building an AI-enabled design practice. You will use approved tools such as Claude and Codex to clarify problems, explore workflows, identify risks and edge cases, and create realistic prototypes earlier in the design process. You will bring validated directions into Figma for complete state coverage, design-system alignment, and production readiness. You will also help the broader team develop effective and responsible ways of working with AI.

This role reports to a Product Design Director.

Work Location:

This position is based in our New York City office, requiring a hybrid work schedule with 3 days of in-office work per week. Thursdays are a required in-office day for team meetings and events, while your other two office days are flexible to suit your schedule. #LI-Hybrid

Pay Transparency:

The base pay for this role is: $149,040.00 - $195,615.00 per year. You are also eligible for employee benefits, participation in Oscar's unlimited vacation program, company equity grants and annual performance bonuses.



Responsibilities:

- Independently lead the design process for complex problems, balancing immediate delivery and polish with a coherent long-term direction.

- Develop a deep understanding of internal users, their goals, and the operational environments in which they work.

- Partner with Product and Engineering to define product direction, identify opportunities, establish measurable goals, and contribute to roadmaps.

- Map complex workflows and systems to identify pain points, dependencies, duplication, and opportunities for simplification.

- Lead design work from early discovery and concept development through detailed interaction design, implementation, and iteration.

- Use research, data, hypotheses, and experimentation to evaluate ideas and improve product direction.

- Create prototypes that help teams explore ideas, test assumptions, and build confidence in a proposed solution.

- Lead workshops, product-vision activities, and presentations when they help teams reach clarity.

- Use Claude and Codex to clarify user and business needs, explore possible approaches, and identify requirements, risks, and edge cases.

- Use Claude and Codex to build and test realistic interactions, workflows, and front-end prototypes.

- Apply strong design judgment to AI-generated output, refining its structure, behavior, accessibility, and visual quality.

- Partner with engineers to determine which prototypes, patterns, or components can be carried into production.

- Use Figma to ensure validated concepts have complete states, follow shared patterns, and are ready for implementation.

- Document and share useful prompts, workflows, prototypes, and lessons that improve how the broader design team uses AI.

- Use AI responsibly and in accordance with Oscar’s privacy, security, and member-data requirements.

- Collaborate closely with engineers throughout implementation to ensure the shipped experience meets the intended quality bar.

- Navigate technical constraints without losing sight of user needs, product quality, or long-term scalability.

- Contribute to a consistent and scalable experience across Oscar’s internal products.

- Use and improve shared design-system components, patterns, and standards.

- Apply Oscar’s brand, accessibility standards, and design principles across product experiences.

- Present work clearly, explain the reasoning behind decisions, and invite feedback at the appropriate stages.

- Contribute to team critique, design practices, and the growth of the broader Product Design organization.

- Compliance with all applicable laws and regulations.

- Other duties as assigned.

Requirements:

- 4+ years of experience in Product Design, UX Design, or a related field.

- At least two examples of designing and shipping complex web, mobile, SaaS, or internal-tool experiences.

- 2+ years owning relationships with cross-functional stakeholders.

- A strong portfolio demonstrating product thinking, systems thinking, interaction design, and visual craft.

- Experience owning product design work from problem definition through launch and iteration.

- Experience working autonomously across complex or ambiguous product areas.

- Experience partnering closely with Product and Engineering to define problems, evaluate solutions, and deliver measurable outcomes.

- The ability to translate requirements, business goals, research, and technical constraints into clear and useful product experiences.

- Active use of tools such as Claude, Codex, or comparable AI-assisted tools within a product design workflow.

- Comfort using AI-assisted development tools to create realistic prototypes, even if you do not write production code by hand.

- Examples of using AI to improve the speed, fidelity, or quality of product exploration and delivery.

- The ability to explain where AI was useful, where it was insufficient, and how your own judgment shaped the result.

- Strong written, visual, and verbal communication skills.

Bonus points:

- Experience designing SaaS products, enterprise software, CRM platforms, operational tools, or similarly complex applications.

- Experience in healthcare, insurance, financial services, or another regulated industry.

- Experience designing data-dense interfaces, configurable workflows, permissions, or multi-role systems.

- Experience simplifying fragmented products, workflows, or product ecosystems.

- Experience contributing to or working closely with a design system or front-end component library.

- Experience creating realistic or coded prototypes.

- Familiarity with front-end concepts such as components, states, responsive behavior, and accessibility.

- Experience planning and conducting customer interviews, usability testing, or other lightweight research.

- Experience using animated prototypes, working software, or user-flow diagrams to communicate a product direction.

- Experience contributing reusable prompts, patterns, components, or workflows to a broader team.

- Experience designing AI-powered products, including considerations around transparency, uncertainty, user control, and trust.

- Interest in accessibility, design ethics, and the responsibilities involved in designing healthcare products.

- A genuine and inquisitive working style, with humility, determination, and openness to feedback.

Hi, we're Oscar. We're hiring a Senior Product Manager to join our Lucie Health Marketplace team.

Oscar is the first health insurance company built around a full stack technology platform and a relentless focus on serving our members. We started Oscar in 2012 to create the kind of health insurance company we would want for ourselves—one that behaves like a doctor in the family.



About the role:

Lucie Health Marketplace is a new all-in-one storefront that will change how Americans shop for healthcare. Consumers buy cars, homes, and everyday products with transparency and choice. Healthcare is next. Lucie’s platform can serve millions of entrepreneurs, full- and part-time employees, gig workers, and early retirees.

This marketplace will serve D2C and ICHRA employee shoppers - guiding them with AI and broker support as they shop health plans, supplemental products, telehealth benefits, and other healthcare goods and services.

As a Senior Product Manager on the Lucie Health Marketplace team, You will lead marketplace product strategy, partnering closely with Engineering, Data, and Design teams. You will prioritize the marketplace roadmap, balancing initiatives across growth, user experience, AI investments, and strategic partnerships. You’ll work closely with Product Managers responsible for the enrollment platform and ICHRA tooling to create an end-to-end shopping experience.

You will report into a Director, Product Management.

Work Location:

Work Location: This is a remote position, open to candidates who reside in: Boston, MA. You will be fully remote; however, our approach to work may adapt over time. Future models could potentially involve a hybrid presence at the hub office associated with your metro area. #LI-Remote

Pay Transparency:

The base pay for this role is: $163,944.00 - $215,176.50 per year. You are also eligible for employee benefits, participation in Oscar's unlimited vacation program, company equity grants and annual performance bonuses.



Responsibilities:

- Define, defend, and execute on the vision, strategy, and roadmap for product investments that power the Lucie Health Marketplace platform; implement solutions well-tailored to that strategy.

- Define OKRs and KPIs to measure business and operational impacts, and relentlessly identify improvements.

- Independently identify and bring together the right counterparts to solve a strategic or executional challenge, even when not clearly defined.

- Independently problem-solve issues across teams and domains to quickly diagnose root cause and move to resolution factoring in trade-offs on speed, scalability and quality.

- Spearhead complex initiatives with ability to influence without authority. Manage timelines, cross-functional team accountability, and risk identification.

- Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and operations partners to gather insights on user needs and ship innovative functionality that improves operational and financial efficiency goals.

- Articulate crisp and thorough requirements and clearly communicate them across stakeholders, incorporating data and user research insights. Produce artifacts that junior team members can learn from.

- Invest in strengthening the talent on Oscar's product team, by developing more junior team members through mentorship.

- Compliance with all applicable laws and regulations.

- Other duties as assigned.

Requirements:

- 6+ years of experience collaborating cross-functionally among engineers, designers, operations experts, and others in a Product Management or Product Management-adjacent role.

- 4+ years of experience in driving rigorous prioritization processes.

- 4+ years of experience with tech systems and understanding basic technology infrastructure such as backend services, database relationships, and leveraging database tools such as SQL2+ years of experience leading complex, cross-domain initiatives.

- 2+ years of experience root-causing ambiguous problems, building roadmaps towards a solution, and successfully executing against that roadmap.

Bonus points:

- Ecommerce or two-sided marketplace experience preferred.

- Deep knowledge of A/B testing practices.


This is an authentic Oscar Health job opportunity.

At Oscar, being an Equal Opportunity Employer means more than upholding discrimination-free hiring practices. It means that we cultivate an environment where people can be their most authentic selves and find both belonging and support. We're on a mission to change health care -- an experience made whole by our unique backgrounds and perspectives.

Pay Transparency:  Final offer amounts, within the base pay set forth above, are determined by factors including your relevant skills, education, and experience. Full-time employees are eligible for benefits including: medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, paid sick time, paid parental leave, 401(k) plan participation, life and disability insurance, and paid wellness time and reimbursements.

Artificial Intelligence (AI): Our AI Guidelines outline the acceptable use of artificial intelligence for candidates and detail how we use AI to support our recruiting efforts.

Reasonable Accommodation: Oscar applicants are considered solely based on their qualifications, without regard to applicant’s disability or need for accommodation. Any Oscar applicant who requires reasonable accommodations during the application process should contact the Oscar Benefits Team (accommodations@hioscar.com) to make the need for an accommodation known.

California Residents: For information about our collection, use, and disclosure of applicants’ personal information as well as applicants’ rights over their personal information, please see our Privacy Policy.

israel.title: Senior Product Manager, Virtual Care
israel.description:
Hi, we're Oscar. We're hiring a Senior Product Manager, Virtual Care to join our Product team.

Oscar is the first health insurance company built around a full stack technology platform and a relentless focus on serving our members. We started Oscar in 2012 to create the kind of health insurance company we would want for ourselves—one that behaves like a doctor in the family.



About the role:

As a Senior Product Manager, you’ll lead product development for Oscar Virtual Care (OVC), improving how members access care and how clinicians deliver it. Your work will span the experience before, during, and after a visit, from intake and scheduling to clinical documentation, treatment, and follow-up.

Oscar brings together a health plan and its own care delivery organization, creating an opportunity to connect product decisions directly to the cost and quality of care. You’ll work with clinical and business partners to identify where technology can help members get the care they need. This includes improving access to virtual care and health assessments, supporting effective clinical workflows, and reducing administrative work for care teams.

You’ll turn ambiguous problems into a clear product direction, align partners around priorities, and work with engineering, design, and data science to deliver and measure results.

You will report into a Director, Product Management.

Work Location: This is a remote position, open to candidates who reside in: Boston, MA. You will be fully remote; however, our approach to work may adapt over time. Future models could potentially involve a hybrid presence at the hub office associated with your metro area. #LI-Remote

Pay Transparency: The base pay for this role is: $163,944.00 - $215,176.50 per year. You are also eligible for employee benefits, participation in Oscar's unlimited vacation program, company equity grants and annual performance bonuses.



Responsibilities:

- Define and execute the product strategy and roadmap for Virtual Care. Prioritize investments based on their expected impact on affordability, clinical outcomes, member experience, and operating efficiency.

- Lead discovery with members, clinicians, and operations teams. Combine user research with data analysis to identify problems, challenge assumptions, and build a business case for product investments.

- Improve the member journey from finding and accessing care through the visit and follow-up. Reduce friction in intake and scheduling, improve visit completion, and help care teams share context and coordinate next steps.

- Build tools that help clinicians deliver high-quality care efficiently, including reviewing medical history, documenting encounters, addressing care gaps, and ordering appropriate tests and treatments. Evaluate opportunities for AI and automation to reduce administrative work while maintaining clinical quality.

- Define success metrics and measure the clinical, financial, and operational impact of product changes. Use findings to refine priorities and improve the experience after launch.

- Lead alignment across clinical, operations, engineering, design, and data science partners. Bring clear recommendations, work through competing needs and tradeoffs, and establish decisions that move the work forward.

- Own complex initiatives from problem definition through delivery. Write clear requirements, manage dependencies and risks, and resolve issues across teams with the autonomy expected of a Senior Product Manager.

- Invest in strengthening the talent on Oscar's product team, by developing more junior team members through mentorship.

- Compliance with all applicable laws and regulations.

- Other duties as assigned.

Requirements:

- 6+ years of experience collaborating cross-functionally among engineers, designers, operations experts, and others in a Product Management or Product Management-adjacent role.

- 4+ years of experience in driving rigorous prioritization processes.

- 4+ years of experience with tech systems and understanding basic technology infrastructure such as backend services, database relationships, and leveraging database tools such as SQL.

- 2+ years of experience leading complex, cross-domain initiatives.

- 2+ years of experience root-causing ambiguous problems, building roadmaps towards a solution, and successfully executing against that roadmap.

Bonus points

- 1+ years of experience building clinician-facing experiences.

Oscar is the first health insurance company built around a full stack technology platform and a relentless focus on serving our members. We started Oscar in 2012 to create the kind of health insurance company we would want for ourselves—one that behaves like a doctor in the family.

About the role:

As a Senior Product Security Engineer, you will be a key technical resource for the team, leading  the security of the software development life cycle (SDLC) from design to completion. You will work at the intersection of traditional application security and modern AI-driven engineering, ensuring that our "paved roads" for development remain fast and secure.

You will work to Secure Architecture.  You will help architect, build, test, and deploy Oscar’s application security systems and processes.

You will work on AI Integration & Security.  You will design security measures for AI-driven workflows, specifically integrating security reviews into AI agent processes that bypass traditional ticketing.

You will report into the Manager of Product Security.

Work Location: This position is based in our New York City office, requiring a hybrid work schedule with 3 days of in-office work per week. Thursdays are a required in-office day for team meetings and events, while your other two office days are flexible to suit your schedule. #LI-Hybrid

Pay Transparency: The base pay for this role is: $163,944K - $215,176 per year.  You are also eligible for employee benefits, participation in Oscar's unlimited vacation program company equity grants and annual performance bonuses.

Responsibilities:

- Vulnerability Management: Drive the vulnerability management lifecycle, from automated identification (SAST/DAST) to complex manual analysis and remediation tracking.

- Technical Mentorship: Act as a technical resource and mentor to junior engineers, providing guidance to remove obstacles and develop smooth, highly functional workflows.

- Code Review & Development: Conduct source code reviews of internal and third-party software while writing production-quality code and libraries for engineering teams to utilize.

- Risk Assessment: Build risk assessment frameworks and deliver action plans to manage assessed risks, simplifying intricate security concerns into actionable steps.

- Partner with Engineering:  Provide guidance to Engineering teams for remediating or migrating vulnerabilities.  Give in-depth software security presentations to the engineering team.

- Compliance with all laws and regulations.

- Other Duties as Assigned

Requirements:

- 4+ years of combined career experience in software development and information security

- Proven experience across all areas of the Secure Software Development Life Cycle

- Strong background in building moderate to complex standalone systems or major new features.

- Hands-on experience using AI models and integrating them with internal systems via protocols like the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

- Bachelors degree or four years of equivalent experience

- Prior work experience in or understanding of security challenges specific to the healthcare or health insurance industries

Oscar is the first health insurance company built around a full stack technology platform and a relentless focus on serving our members. We started Oscar in 2012 to create the kind of health insurance company we would want for ourselves—one that behaves like a doctor in the family.

About the role:

We are hiring Staff Product Managers to join our Core Insurance Platform and Network pillars. By applying to this job post, you will be considered for all Staff Product Manager openings across our tech org.

Core Insurance (Payment Integrity):

Every dollar Oscar pays on a claim that contains a billing error, a coding mistake, or fraud is a dollar that doesn't go toward affordability for our members. Oscar's Payment Integrity team makes sure we pay claims accurately. Historically, this work has been heavy on friction - retrospective audits, denials, and provider disputes that create burden for everyone, including members. Oscar is shifting toward a prospective model that puts members first: catching issues upstream instead of resolving them after the fact.

As a Staff Product Manager on this team, you will own the strategy and roadmap for a domain being reshaped by AI. You'll lead work that combines Oscar’s core insurance technology platforms - rules, audits, recovery workflows - with LLM-powered medical record review, anomaly detection, and agentic workflows that compress weeks of human review into hours. You'll partner with engineers, data scientists, clinical coders, finance, and vendor partners to ship products that meaningfully reduce avoidable spend without adding friction for providers or members.

Network:

As a Staff Product Manager on our Network team, you will own the product strategy for our provider data reconciliation and quality platform. You'll transform our existing reconciliation engine into a transparent, operator-controlled system that empowers Network Operations teams to maintain high-quality provider data with confidence. You will define product strategy for provider data reconciliation, quality tooling, and operational configurability across credentialing, contracting, and provider data operations workflows. You will drive explainability of complex ETL pipelines and reconciliation logic, making the "why" behind data decisions transparent to operational partners. You will enable self-service operations by building configuration interfaces that shift control from engineering to business operators and partner deeply with data engineering to validate data models, relationship logic, and completeness while translating technical concepts for business stakeholders. About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Our Account Management teams create and build our relationships with restaurant-partners. Together, we help restaurant brands and neighborhood restaurants grow through our platform. We’re constantly launching new cities and products, so there are always new opportunities to expand your skills and progress your career. We are looking for an Account Development Manager based in Astana, Kazakhstan, to manage a portfolio of restaurant partners in the 2 largest cities across Northern Kazakhstan. As our new Account Development Manager, you’ll help a mix of enterprise and SMB restaurant-partners grow with Wolt. You’ll build strong relationships, identify commercial opportunities, and turn performance insights into practical actions that help your restaurant-partners succeed.

What you’ll be doing

-  You’ll be the primary point of contact for your portfolio, working with restaurant owners, central teams, and local venue managers. You’ll adapt your approach to each restaurant-partner’s needs, balancing growth opportunities with day-to-day operational performance.

- You’ll develop growth plans for restaurant-partners, run promotional campaigns, and lead commercial discussions. Working closely with internal teams, you’ll make sure plans are delivered and restaurant-partners receive the support they need.

Day-to-day in this role you’ll:

- Own and develop a portfolio of restaurant-partners across Northern Kazakhstan.

- Build strong relationships with restaurant-partners through regular check-ins and business reviews, aligning on priorities and following up on agreed actions.

- Create and execute growth plans that help restaurant-partners increase sales, attract customers, and improve performance on Wolt.

- Identify opportunities to grow adoption of Wolt’s advertising and promotional solutions based on each restaurant-partner’s goals.

- Lead commercial negotiations and renewal discussions to support sustainable growth for both Wolt and our restaurant-partners.

- Use performance data to identify trends, understand challenges, and recommend practical improvements.

- Collaborate with Marketing, Operations, and other internal teams to deliver campaigns, resolve issues, and improve the restaurant-partner experience.

- Prioritize your time across restaurant-partners of different sizes, balancing commercial impact with the needs of your wider portfolio.

Our humble expectations*

- We’re looking for someone who combines commercial curiosity with strong relationship-building skills and enjoys taking ownership of restaurant-partner growth.

- Experience: You have 3+ years of experience in account management, customer success, business development, or a similar commercial role. Experience working with SMB or enterprise restaurant-partners is a plus.

- Commercial understanding, upselling, and negotiation skills: You understand how to grow a restaurant-partner’s business, identify and convert upselling opportunities through advertising and promotional solutions, and confidently lead commercial negotiations to reach mutually beneficial agreements.

- Analytical skills: You’re comfortable working with data in Excel or Google Sheets and translating performance insights into clear recommendations.

- Communication and relationship-building: You communicate clearly and confidently, adapting your approach to restaurant owners, operational teams, and enterprise stakeholders.

- Adaptability: You thrive in a fast-paced environment, adapt quickly to changing priorities, and stay focused on delivering results.

- Ownership and autonomy: You roll up your sleeves and get things done, proactively identifying what needs attention without waiting to be told. You’re comfortable working independently, taking initiative, and following through on your commitments.

- Ownership and organization: You manage competing priorities, follow through on commitments, and take a proactive approach to solving problems.

- Tools and curiosity: You’re comfortable learning new tools and open to using AI to improve your daily work and analysis.

- Languages: You’re fluent in Kazakh and Russian and have a working proficiency in English.

Nice to have:

- Experience working with restaurant-partners, restaurant chains, or within the food delivery industry.

- An understanding of marketplace or platform businesses.

- Experience growing a portfolio of restaurant-partners across enterprise and SMB segments.

- Advanced skills in data analysis or business intelligence tools.

Why you’ll love it

- 🚀Global and growing fast: Be part of a fast-moving scaleup

- 🤩Ride of a lifetime: Accelerate your career and build your sales skills

- 💪Instant impact: Take ownership and make a difference

- 💙Big hearts and small egos: Surround yourself with smart, friendly people

- 🩺 Medical Insurance and strengthened sick leaves

- 🚀 Career growth and development opportunities

- 💙 Employee Assistance Program—therapy and wellbeing support

- 🍽️ Discount on your Wolt orders

- 🧑‍🎓 Wolt-wide training programs

- 🎉 Team budgets for celebrations and bonding

- 🍊 Fruits and drinks at the office

If you’re excited about working in a high-growth environment, taking ownership, and joining an ambitious team, we’d love to hear from you! Click below to apply and attach your CV. 💙

Please submit your application by November 4th. We’ll be accepting applications until then, and you can expect to hear from us after this date.

Nachdem einer unserer Talent Acquisition Partner deine Bewerbung geprüft hat und feststellt, dass Du die erforderlichen Kriterien erfüllen, wirst du zu den folgenden Schritten eingeladen:

The Associate Operations Manager for Supply Activation & Acquisition plays a pivotal role at Wolt. As Central scales at an unprecedented pace, your mission is to keep courier supply ahead of demand - both in the moment and over the medium term. You will be responsible for leading and mentoring a team of 3, ensuring that intraday activation (weather-driven boosts, DxGy and ARC / radius adjustments) and courier acquisition (job boards, application attainment, reactivations and sign-ups) are tightly coordinated across all Central markets.

In this role, you will own two of Central’s most closely tracked supply KPIs - undersupplied hours and GOV loss - reported weekly to senior leadership, alongside a multi-million euro activation and acquisition budget. Your leadership extends beyond day-to-day activation calls; you will be the primary bridge to higher management on supply health, escalating risks early and proposing structural fixes such as mobilizer strategies and special events planning ahead of demand spikes (holidays, weather events, local events). Your ability to translate data into fast, defensible calls will be key to keeping Central’s ADT, UH% and GOV loss on plan.

What you’ll be doing

- Own Central’s intraday activation strategy - activation surges, special events management and day-to-day operations (radius / busyness adjustments, communication flows, etc.) - to keep courier supply matched to demand hour by hour.

- Lead and mentor a team of 3 and own a multi-million euro activation and acquisition budget across Central markets.

- Own Central’s courier acquisition function: job boards, application attainment, reactivation campaigns and sign-ups.

- Own and report on Central’s UH% and GOV loss KPIs weekly, surfacing risks and driving corrective action with senior leadership.

- Plan and execute mobilizer strategies and special events coverage (holidays, weather events, local events) ahead of demand spikes.

- Partner with Support, Product and Global Delivery Ops to build tools and processes that scale activation and acquisition across markets.

- Serve as the primary point of contact for top management on Central’s supply health.

Our humble expectations

- Proven track record managing complex, data-driven operations across multiple markets, ideally in courier / gig supply, logistics or marketplace operations.

- Comfortable owning hard KPIs (UH%, GOV loss) and being accountable for the numbers, not just reporting them.

- Experience leading and developing a small team (3 direct reports).

- Strong budget ownership experience - able to allocate and defend a multi-million euro spend across activation and acquisition levers.

- Excellent ability to distill complex operational trade-offs into clear, actionable recommendations for senior leadership.

- Comfortable working under time pressure during weather events, special events and demand spikes.

- Fluent English skills in both spoken and writing.
