You will be responsible for leading and mentoring a team of 3, ensuring that intraday activation (weather-driven boosts, DxGy and ARC / radius adjustments) and courier acquisition (job boards, application attainment, reactivations and sign-ups) are tightly coordinated across all Central markets.

In this role, you will own two of Central’s most closely tracked supply KPIs - undersupplied hours and GOV loss - reported weekly to senior leadership, alongside a multi-million euro activation and acquisition budget. Your leadership extends beyond day-to-day activation calls; you will be the primary bridge to higher management on supply health, escalating risks early and proposing structural fixes such as mobilizer strategies and special events planning ahead of demand spikes (holidays, weather events, local events). Your ability to translate data into fast, defensible calls will be key to keeping Central’s ADT, UH% and GOV loss on plan.

What you’ll be doing

- Own Central’s intraday activation strategy - activation surges, special events management and day-to-day operations (radius / busyness adjustments, communication flows, etc.) - to keep courier supply matched to demand hour by hour.

- Lead and mentor a team of 3 and own a multi-million euro activation and acquisition budget across Central markets.

- Own Central’s courier acquisition function: job boards, application attainment, reactivation campaigns and sign-ups.

- Own and report on Central’s UH% and GOV loss KPIs weekly, surfacing risks and driving corrective action with senior leadership.

- Plan and execute mobilizer strategies and special events coverage (holidays, weather events, local events) ahead of demand spikes.

- Partner with Support, Product and Global Delivery Ops to build tools and processes that scale activation and acquisition across markets.

- Serve as the primary point of contact for top management on Central’s supply health.

Our humble expectations

- Proven track record managing complex, data-driven operations across multiple markets, ideally in courier / gig supply, logistics or marketplace operations.

- Comfortable owning hard KPIs (UH%, GOV loss) and being accountable for the numbers, not just reporting them.

- Experience leading and developing a small team (3 direct reports).

- Strong budget ownership experience - able to allocate and defend a multi-million euro spend across activation and acquisition levers.

- Excellent ability to distill complex operational trade-offs into clear, actionable recommendations for senior leadership.

- Comfortable working under time pressure during weather events, special events and demand spikes.

- Fluent English skills in both spoken and writing.

israel.description:
About Wolt

Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. Wolt is a technology company that makes it easy to discover and get the best of your city delivered to your door. Founded in Helsinki in 2014 and now part of DoorDash, we operate in 30+ countries, connecting customers with local restaurants, grocery stores and retailers through our app and delivering it all through courier partners.

Three groups make that marketplace work: the customers who order, the courier partners who deliver, and the merchants who sell. This role sits on the merchant side. Merchant Operations owns the support experience for our restaurant, grocery and retail partners, covering everything from onboarding and menu management to the day-to-day operational issues that come up while they're trading. That support is delivered through a combination of internal Wolt Operations teams and external BPO partners.

What you’ll be doing

As part of our Merchant Operations team, the Content, Training & Quality (CTQ) Manager plays a key role in making sure that the people who support our merchant partners know exactly how to do the work, and do it consistently. This is a global role: your audience is both our external BPO agents and our internal Operations team across 30+ Wolt countries.

Day-to-day in this role you’ll:

- Content Ownership: Build and maintain the process documentation, SOPs, and knowledge-base articles behind Merchant Operations workflows. Consolidate what exists today into one coherent, findable, and trustworthy source, and keep it current as processes change.

- Training Design & Delivery: Organise, facilitate, design and/or deliver onboarding and upskilling programmes for internal operations teams and external BPO agents — live sessions, workshops, and self-serve modules in Cornerstone. You'll apply sound instructional design: define what someone needs to be able to do, build the shortest path to getting them there, and measure whether it worked.

- Stakeholder Management: Work across operations team leaders and process owners to understand how each process actually runs, align on what "correct" looks like, and drive adoption of new or updated ways of working. You will influence without direct authority, which makes this a core part of the role rather than an add-on.

- Build the Quality Framework: Establish our quality assurance approach from the ground up, together with the Operations team — defining what gets checked, how it's scored, and how often. Then close the loop by translating what the checks surface into the next round of content and training improvements.

- Continuous Improvement & Scale: Proactively identify where unclear process, content, or training is driving errors, rework, or long handling times, and close those gaps before they become escalations – staying close enough to the work, through quality reviews, agent feedback and performance data. You’ll design CTQ for reuse and consitency across 30+ countries and multiple delivery partners rather than rebuilding market by market, while leaving room for genuine local differences.

Our humble expectations:

- Experience: 3–5 years in operations, learning & development, process enablement, or customer support — preferably in a marketplace, e-commerce, delivery, or other fast-paced operational environment. We're open on background: what matters is that you've built content and training for people doing repeatable operational work.

- Content & Training: Demonstrated experience creating operational content (SOPs, process documentation, knowledge-base articles) and designing and delivering training to distributed, multicultural teams. Formal instructional design or adult learning knowledge is a strong plus.

- Analytical Mindset: Comfort working with quality and performance data to spot where processes are breaking down and prioritise what to fix first.

- Ownership: Ability to work independently in an ambiguous environment, set your own starting point, and drive changes through to adoption without close direction. Mess doesn't paralyse you — you sequence a clean-up, make concrete decisions on the best available data, and get on with it.

- Teaching Instinct: You're a natural simplifier who'd rather write three clear pages than fifteen thorough ones, and you adapt how you teach to the audience in front of you — including stakeholders more senior than you. You build trust quickly with operational teams and can get busy people to give you what you need.Bonus points  Experience with BPO or outsourced operations teams, or setting up a quality assurance framework from scratch.

What we offer

- A blank page, not a maintenance job. A global quality assurance framework doesn't exist yet — you'll build it from the ground up with the Operations team, and consolidate scattered documentation into something people actually trust and use.

- Genuine global scope at IC level. Your work reaches internal Operations teams and external delivery partners across 30+ countries, with exposure to the wider DoorDash network.

- Measurable impact. This isn't content that disappears into a wiki — you'll see handling times, error rates, and agent confidence move as a direct result of what you build.

- Real autonomy. You set the roadmap and decide where to start. No one looking over your shoulder.

- Career growth in a fast-moving sector. A dynamic environment at the centre of delivery and e-commerce, with room to grow as the function you're building matures.

- Salary package and benefits, plus discounts on Wolt orders.

Within this organisation, the Velocity team owns the paved road for consumer app development across mobile and web: shared SDKs and client foundations, integration patterns and multi-brand customisation, migration playbooks and reference implementations, and developer tooling that makes building on shared foundations fast and safe. Our mission is to reduce the cost, time, and risk of building consumer experiences across platforms and brands. Product teams own customer-facing experiences; our job is to make sure they can spend their time on delivering delightful experiences. The team is AI-native: AI is a default part of how we design, build, and ship software.

As the Engineering Manager, you will lead a team of experienced engineers across mobile and web, collaborating closely with product teams, design, and adjacent platform organisations across three brands. Your primary responsibility will be owning the team's roadmap and delivery of shared client foundations, and driving their adoption across the organisation, so that product teams ship delightful customer experiences without rebuilding the foundations under them. israel.description:

About the Team

The Unified Privacy Platform team’s mission is to earn the trust of every DoorDash user by upholding their right to privacy, consent, and transparency. We are building a common privacy foundation across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo so Consumers, Dashers, and Merchants can understand how their data is used, control their choices, and exercise their privacy rights through simple, consistent experiences.

Our work is organized around three connected pillars: the Privacy Center, a unified user-facing destination for privacy controls and rights; the Unified Privacy Platform, which captures and enforces consent, policy, jurisdictional requirements, and privacy actions; and Privacy Operations and Intelligence, which gives Legal, Support, Privacy, and engineering operators the workflows, diagnostics, audit history, and automation needed to resolve privacy work safely and efficiently.

Together, these capabilities turn fragmented, one-off compliance work into reusable platform primitives that can support new products, brands, and emerging regulations.

About the Role

DoorDash is looking for an Engineering Manager to lead the Unified Privacy Platform team. You will lead a team of backend and platform engineers responsible for the next generation of privacy and consent infrastructure, including the Privacy Center, the User Consent Platform, privacy-policy decisioning, self-service data-rights experiences, and the operational tooling required to manage privacy cases at global scale.

As the Engineering Manager, you will own and execute a multi-year vision for privacy at DoorDash. You will balance legal and regulatory correctness, user trust, security, reliability, and developer velocity while building systems that work consistently across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo. You will be a strategic partner to Product, Legal, Security, Data Governance, Marketing and Communications, and engineering leadership, establishing clear ownership boundaries and turning complex privacy requirements into scalable, self-service capabilities.



You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

- Lead and mentor a high-performing team of backend and platform engineers, fostering a culture of ownership, privacy by design, operational excellence, and thoughtful cross-functional partnership

- Drive the technical strategy across the Privacy Center, the Unified Privacy Platform, and Privacy Operations and Intelligence

- Build the cross-brand User Consent Platform, including canonical consent state, policy and configuration management, consent SDKs, audit history, and consistent enforcement across products and jurisdictions

- Deliver simple, self-service experiences for consent and communication preferences, Right to be Forgotten (RTF), Right to Information (RTI), and Data Subject Access Requests (DSARs)

- Turn emerging privacy and regulatory requirements into standardized platform capabilities instead of one-off product implementations

- Lead the migration from fragmented legacy consent systems to a single source of truth across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo, while managing compatibility and safe deprecation

- Define clear contracts with data-governance fulfillment systems and downstream product and storage teams so privacy actions are traceable, retryable, auditable, and correctly reflected back to users and operators

- Provide architectural guidance for distributed systems that manage sensitive user choices, policy evaluation, orchestration, secure data delivery, reporting, and immutable audit trails

- Partner with recruiting to build a diverse and inclusive team, attracting and retaining exceptional engineering talent



We’re excited about you because you have…

- A bachelor’s, master’s, or doctoral degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

- 3+ years of experience in people management leading backend or platform teams

- 8+ years of industry experience

- Extensive experience as an engineer or engineering leader in a fast-paced, platform-focused development environment

- Proven experience designing large-scale distributed systems, service application programming interfaces (APIs), policy or rules engines, workflow orchestration, state machines, data-lifecycle systems, or audit architectures

- Preferred experience with privacy, consent, data governance, or regulatory systems, including concepts such as the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), California Privacy Rights Act (CPRA), data-subject rights, retention, deletion, and legal holds

- The ability to translate ambiguous legal, policy, and product requirements into clear platform boundaries, reusable abstractions, and executable roadmaps

- Strong product sense and the ability to partner effectively with Legal, Product, Design, Security, Data, Marketing, Support, and engineering teams across multiple brands and geographies

- A growth mindset—you are eager to expand your skills, raise the quality bar, and build enduring systems in a rapidly changing environment

- Partner with country and area leaders to manage food safety compliance and find pragmatic solutions to emerging risks.

- Support our external audit programme, coordinating schedules with third-party auditors and local food authorities.

- Help develop and maintain our global food safety policies, procedures, and HACCP plans, translating them into concrete steps at country level.

- Handle food safety issues, enquiries, and product recalls, guiding country and site teams through execution and customer communication.

- Work with Legal and Policy to keep us ahead of food safety regulations across our European markets.

- Track compliance metrics and use the data to spot trends and drive improvements

Our humble expectations*

Formal food safety qualification (e.g. Food Science, Microbiology, Public Health), or equivalent hands-on experience.

- 5+ years of progressive food safety or regulatory compliance experience in hospitality, retail, quick commerce, or manufacturing.

- Strong working knowledge of HACCP and food safety standards such as FSSC 22000, ISO 22000, IFS, or BRC.

- Proven experience managing food safety programmes across multi-country, multi-unit operations, with a pragmatic, solutions-focused approach.

- Proven track record conducting internal/external audits, risk assessments, and gap analyses, with the ability to drive follow-up actions that deliver real compliance improvement.

- Experience implementing policies and procedures in response to new business initiatives or evolving risk environments.

- Fluent in English, given the multi-country scope of this role.

- Willingness and ability to travel regularly across our European markets.

What we offer

- The chance to build and shape food safety practices across a fast-growing set of European markets, with real ownership over how you get there.

- A seat on a collaborative, supportive global team genuinely invested in your growth as a leader.

- Cross-functional exposure — you’ll work directly with legal, policy, ops, and country teams, not from behind a desk.

Next steps*

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. If shortlisted, you’ll start with a screening call with our Talent Acquisition Partner, followed by an interview with the hiring team, a short take-home assignment, and a final debrief. We aim to move quickly and will keep you posted throughout.

Мы активно набираем сотрудников в магазины Wolt Market в городах Алматы и Астана!

На данный момент открыты вакансии в следующих локациях:

Алматы: Горный Гигант, Mega Towers, Шевченко

У нас одна анкета на все точки магазинов — пожалуйста, при отклике обязательно выберите нужную точку, в которую вы хотите попасть. Это поможет нам быстрее связаться с вами и пригласить на следующий этап.

Описание должности

Wolt – тамақ жеткізу платформасымен танымал финдік технологиялық компания. Wolt 2017 жылы 4 елде және солтүстік елдердің 10 қаласында жұмыс істеді. Бүгінгі күнге біз 25 елде және 500-ден астам қалада 8000-нан астам адамнан тұратын командамыз, 29 миллионнан астам тіркелген пайдаланушыларға қызмет көрсетіп нарықта 50-ден астам Wolt Market дүкенін қамтимыз. Платформа экономикасы тұтынушылардың мейрамханалармен және саудагерлермен байланысу тәсілдерін өзгертіп жатқандықтан, біз жаһандық деңгейде құрған таңғажайып командалармен бұл саланың көшбасшысы болу мүмкіндігін мақсат етіп отырмыз.

Wolt Market - бұл әлемдегі жетекші ыңғайлылық пен ең жоғары тұтынушы тәжірибесін ұсынатын біздің жеке супермаркет - сіз есігіңізге жарық жылдамдығынанда тез азық-түлікке қол жеткізе аласыз! 🤩

Мы ищем сотрудников на полный и частичный рабочий день. Став частью нашей великолепной команды ты станешь сердцем нашей ежедневной работы онлайн магазина - твоей ответственностью будет чтобы все заказы собраны и упакованы правильно, чтобы затем передать нашим курьерам-партнерам (a.k.a героям доставки) или покупателям.

График работы зависит от магазина и заранее составляется на месяц:



Алматы

-
Шевченко / Mega Towers:Смешанные смены, в том числе:07:00–16:00, 09:00–14:00, 12:00–20:00, 17:00–23:00, 19:00–01:00, 22:00–07:00- Особенно важна готовность к утренним сменам с 07:00 и вечерним/ночным.

-
Горный Гигант:Вечерняя смена: 18:00–01:00 и 22:00–07:00, 4/3, 5/2 график. Утренняя смена: 07:00–16:00, 4/3, 5/2 график.

Астана

-
Правый берег:Возможные смены: 08:00–13:00 (частичная занятость с графиком 5/2), 08:00–17:00 и 02:00–08:00 (частичная занятость с графиком и фиксированными днями 2/2).

-
Левый берег:Основная смена: 17:00–02:00, 4–5 смен в неделю.



Вы будете частью веселой команды, которая переопределяет как должен выглядеть магазин и пока ваши коллеги делятся с вами шуткой, они так же гордятся местом в котором работают, потому что - как компания мы делаем обычные вещи необычайно хорошо!

Чем вы будете заниматься

- Принимать заказы через наше приложение.

- Собирать и упаковывать товары для передачи курьерам и покупателям.

- Обновлять нашу внутреннюю систему учета, отображающую актуальную информацию по составу и аллергенам.

- Поддерживать порядок и чистоту в магазине.

- Участвовать в ежедневном развитии магазина.

Наши ожидания

- Ты уверен в себе и тебе нравится работать в быстро изменяющейся обстановке.

- Ты проактивный и клиентоориентированный, у тебя хорошее внимание к деталям.

- Ты  быстро обучаешься - особенно когда дело касается технологий, а также мультизадачности.

- Командный игрок с хорошими коммуникационными навыками.

- Ты готов работать как днем, так и по вечерам в будние и выходные дни.

- Опыт работы в розничном магазине будет преимуществом.

- У тебя есть разрешение на работу в Республике Казахстан.

Что дальше

Если тебе понравилось все вышесказанное, ты не боишься ответственности, готов с головой погрузиться в работу с динамично растущей среде и ты хочешь стать частью невероятно амбициозной команды - то жми на кнопку!

Описание должности

Wolt – тамақ жеткізу платформасымен танымал финдік технологиялық компания. Wolt 2017 жылы 4 елде және солтүстік елдердің 10 қаласында жұмыс істеді. Бүгінгі күнге біз 25 елде және 500-ден астам қалада 8000-нан астам адамнан тұратын командамыз, 29 миллионнан астам тіркелген пайдаланушыларға қызмет көрсетіп нарықта 50-ден астам Wolt Market дүкенін қамтимыз. Платформа экономикасы тұтынушылардың мейрамханалармен және саудагерлермен байланысу тәсілдерін өзгертіп жатқандықтан, біз жаһандық деңгейде құрған таңғажайып командалармен бұл саланың көшбасшысы болу мүмкіндігін мақсат етіп отырмыз.

Wolt Market - бұл әлемдегі жетекші ыңғайлылық пен ең жоғары тұтынушы тәжірибесін ұсынатын біздің жеке супермаркет - сіз есігіңізге жарық жылдамдығынанда тез азық-түлікке қол жеткізе аласыз! 🤩

Мы ищем сотрудников на полный рабочий день и частичную занятость. Став частью нашей великолепной команды ты станешь сердцем нашей ежедневной работы онлайн магазина - твоей ответственностью будет чтобы все заказы были  собраны и упакованы правильно, чтобы затем передать нашим курьерам-партнерам (a.k.a героям доставки) или покупателям.

Вы будете частью веселой команды, которая переопределяет как должен выглядеть магазин и пока ваши коллеги делятся с вами шуткой, они так же гордятся местом в котором работают, потому что - как компания мы делаем обычные вещи необычайно хорошо!

Чем вы будете заниматься

- Принимать заказы через наше приложение.

- Собирать и упаковывать товары для передачи курьерам и покупателям.

- Обновлять нашу внутреннюю систему учета, отображающую актуальную информацию по составу и аллергенам.

- Поддерживать порядок и чистоту в магазине.

- Участвовать в ежедневном развитии магазина и в других активностях стора.

Our humble expectations

- Ты уверен в себе и тебе нравится работать в быстро изменяющейся обстановке.

- Ты проактивный и клиентоориентированный, у тебя хорошее внимание к деталям.

- Ты  быстро обучаешься - особенно когда дело касается технологий, а также мультизадачности.

- Командный игрок с хорошими коммуникационными навыками.

- Ты готов работать как днем, по вечерам так и по ночам в будние и выходные дни.

- Опыт работы в розничном магазине будет преимуществом.

- У тебя есть разрешение на работу в Республике Казахстан.

Next steps

Если тебе понравилось все вышесказанное, ты не боишься ответственности, готов с головой погрузиться в работу с динамично растущей среде и ты хочешь стать частью невероятно амбициозной команды - то жми на кнопку!

israel.title: Group Customer Service Manager
israel.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Wolt is a technology company that makes it incredibly easy to discover and get the best restaurants, grocery stores and other local shops delivered to your home or office. Wolt works together with over 30,000 restaurant and retail partners as well as with over 60,000 courier partners across 23 countries and 129 cities. Our apps (iOS and Android) have the industry’s highest reviews, largely because of our customer-centric approach to how we build our products and operations. For example, our customer service team responds in a matter of seconds, in the customer’s own language.

We’ve raised more than €707M in financing from renowned U.S. and European-based investors, such as ICONIQ Capital, Tiger Global, DST, Prosus, KKR, Coatue, 83North, Goldman Sachs, Highland Europe and EQT Ventures & EQT Growth, among others. We've also been fortunate enough to receive some appreciation and recognition for our hard work along the way: Apple selected Wolt’s app as their Editors' Choice, Wired named the company one of the "Hottest Startups in Europe," Forbes included our CEO Miki Kuusi on its 30-under-30 in Consumer Tech list, and the Nordic Startup Awards named Wolt Company of the Year.

In 2020, the Financial Times named us Europe’s second fastest-growing company. We’re still expanding rapidly and are looking for more talented individuals to join us. If you are passionate about cutting-edge technology, great food, and making an impact in your city, then Wolt just might be for you.

Wolt is more than just a food and retail delivery operation – we are built upon a solid foundation of state-of-the-art technology. Our internal tooling enables us to ramp up new cities efficiently and provide excellent customer service, our own logistics platform allows us to optimize our couriers' work to get you the food you want as fast as possible, and our restaurant platform allows restaurants to offer exciting food experiences for our customers in an optimal way.

We work in small teams with high ownership, with each team focusing on a key area of the Wolt product stack. Every one of our product team members has a say in where we are going and what solutions we implement. We work with passion, but we haven't forgotten how to have fun along the way!

What you’ll be doing

We are looking for a Group Support Service Manager to lead the Courier Support function at our Haifa site. This role will manage Team Leads and be responsible for service quality, operational performance, and the professional development of the teams within the domain.

This is a meaningful leadership role that includes leading multiple teams and managers, working closely with local and global stakeholders, and directly influencing both courier experience and site performance.

Day-to-day in this role you’ll:

-  Manage, coach, and develop Team Leads within Courier Support.

- Own team performance across quality, efficiency, and service metrics, including CSAT, HT, SLA, and productivity.

- Build work plans, identify performance gaps, and lead data-driven improvement initiatives.

- Implement management routines, performance controls, and feedback practices across managers and teams.

- Lead performance improvement processes and employee development, while addressing professional and behavioral gaps when needed.

- Oversee day-to-day operations, task prioritization, and resource allocation based on operational needs.

- Partner closely with internal stakeholders, including Operations, Quality, Training, Workforce Management, and Global leadership.

- Lead projects and change initiatives within Courier Support while maintaining high-quality service and performance.

- Foster a professional, engaged, and growth-oriented work environment for managers and agents.

Our humble expectations*

- Previous experience managing teams or managers in a service, operations, or fast-paced environment.

- Proven ability to lead performance, analyze data, and build effective work plans.

- Strong people-management skills, including coaching, giving feedback, developing managers, and leading challenging conversations.

- High level of ownership, independence, and ability to lead initiatives end to end.

- Strong prioritization and decision-making skills in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

- Excellent interpersonal and stakeholder-management skills.

- Fluent Hebrew and English.

- Familiarity with Courier Support or Wolt systems is an advantage.

If you are a people-focused leader who can drive change, turn data into action, and deliver results on the ground, we would love to hear from you.

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

israel.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Wolt is on a growth journey as part of the DoorDash family, together with Deliveroo. Retail is one of our biggest growth opportunities: supermarkets, convenience chains, pharmacies, and specialty and department stores that want to reach customers through our Marketplace. These partners have different needs from restaurants, with larger catalogues, more complex integrations and longer, more structured sales cycles. This brings us to you, our next Head of Enterprise Retail Sales for Scandinavia.

You’ll lead retail acquisition across Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Iceland and own the new partner targets for your cluster. You’ll manage a team sales professionals and turn regional commercial direction into disciplined country-level execution. You’ll work closely with Account Management, Operations, Marketing and the Regional Commercial teams, and you’ll be part of the regional Retail sales leadership.

What you’ll be doing

- Own new Enterprise retail partner acquisition targets across your countries, and drive consistent delivery against monthly and quarterly goals.

- Translate regional commercial strategy into clear country-level execution plans.

- Lead, coach and develop a team of sales professionals: set clear targets, run regular pipeline reviews and check-ins, and support hiring and onboarding.

- Oversee the sales process end to end, from prospecting to signed agreement. Help the team build structured, data-driven value propositions, and join negotiations on larger or more complex deals.

- Make sure commercial terms follow our profitability and pricing guardrails, and build a high-quality partner portfolio aligned with long-term growth.

- Monitor pipeline health, conversion rates and forecast accuracy, and keep CRM usage and reporting standards high.

- Partner with Account Management for smooth handovers, with Operations for strong onboarding and launch readiness, and with Marketing on local acquisition campaigns and partner launches. Align on basic retail standards with local SMB sales teams where needed.

- Share best practices across markets, spot performance gaps and fix them, and keep improving win rates, sales cycle efficiency and acquisition quality.

- Give Regional Sales and Commercial teams structured feedback on market dynamics and the competitive landscape.

Our humble expectations

- At least 7 years of experience in B2B sales or business development, ideally in retail, marketplace, FMCG or technology environments.

- At least 3 years of direct people management experience.

- A proven track record of delivering acquisition targets and closing commercial deals.

- Strong commercial acumen and structured negotiation skills.

- Strong analytical skills, and experience using CRM systems and BI tools to steer performance.

- The ability to balance hands-on selling with team leadership.

- Fluency in English. Proficiency in Nordic languages is strongly beneficial.

Seen as a strong advantage:

- Manage Wolt's external public policy / government relations agency and other third-party advisors.

- Maintain relationships with other key stakeholders relevant to the business, including the U.S. Embassy.

Our Expectations

- 12+ years of public policy experience, in the public sector, private sector, or (ideally) both.

- A degree in law, public policy, political science, or a related field; a master's degree is preferred but not required.

- A demonstrated network and credibility with senior Israeli government officials, regulators, and Knesset members.

- Direct experience with, or strong understanding of, labor and platform-economy policy issues.

As DoorDash continues to grow its international footprint, we are looking for a candidate with deep, hands-on experience in VAT regimes who can lead a team, collaborate cross-functionally, and own the delivery of tax features and new-platform feature / new-market / new-partnership launches across Wolt and Deliveroo.

You will report to the Senior Manager of the Tax Calculation Platform & Mx Operations and lead tax platform and business projects for Wolt and Deliveroo. You will manage a team to deliver day-to-day VAT configuration and testing, and partner closely with Tax Engineering, the Wolt and Deliveroo Tax teams, Tax Product, and other stakeholders — gathering business and VAT requirements, translating them into tax-system functional requirements for configuration and testing, and reviewing Technical Design Documents (TDDs) to provide functional tax expertise back to Tax Engineering.

The primary focus of this position is end-to-end delivery of VAT tax solutions across the Wolt and Deliveroo platforms — new product, market, partnership launches and legislative changes, roadmap alignment with Wolt and Deliveroo's international expansion, and day-to-day leadership of the team executing that delivery — with an understanding of how data flows from upstream systems through the tax engine to downstream reporting.  Rather than handing off requirements to the Vertex Center of Excellence team, you will apply your own Vertex knowledge to help influence the functional design and determine the specific Vertex configuration a solution requires. Familiarity with US sales and use tax, food and beverage, and retail tax context is valuable for alignment with the broader platform.

- Lead tax platform and business projects across the Wolt and Deliveroo platforms, including new product, market, partnership launches, and legislative changes.

- Gather business and VAT requirements and translate them into tax-system functional requirements for configuration, testing and delivery.

- Review BRDs, PRDs, and TDDs for VAT tax-system implications and provide functional tax expertise back to Tax Engineering.

- Define testing requirements and oversee validations across unit, integration, E2E, shadow, and post-launch phases.

- Align tax engine priorities and the integrated delivery plan with the Wolt and Deliveroo international market roadmaps, and represent tax platform status updates to Tax and Engineering leadership.

- Trace VAT-relevant data from upstream systems through Vertex to downstream reporting and compliance.

- Serve as the senior functional tax leader for Wolt and Deliveroo, escalating risk and driving cross-functional alignment across Tax, Product, Engineering, and Data.

- Manage and develop a team supporting this area, allocating workload, establishing QA checkpoints, and providing structured knowledge transfer on complex processes.

We’re excited about you because…

- You have 8+ years of indirect tax or indirect tax technology experience, with several years working directly in VAT regimes.

- You are familiar with VAT tax requirements and can translate them into system requirements.

- Hands-on experience implementing or configuring Vertex O Series, and ability to review Vertex configurations and testing documentation and provide feedback.

- Hand-on experience implementing or configuring ERP tax integration (e.g. Netsuite) with Vertex tax engine.

- Experience with multi-country VAT implementations and EU VAT compliance; familiarity with non-US indirect tax regimes more broadly is a plus.

- Demonstrated people-leadership experience, including managing, coaching, workload delegation, and quality oversight.

- You can review technical design documents and provide functional tax expertise to engineering and product.

- You have familiarity with US sales and use tax, food and beverage, and retail tax context.

- You understand how tax data flows from upstream transaction systems through a tax engine to downstream reporting, including both in-house systems or ERP system integration flows.

- Program or project management experience across dependent teams, including building plans, milestones, and dependency maps, and driving them to completion.

- Comfort operating cross-functionally and building trust with partner teams without always holding formal authority over their roadmaps.

- Experience in use of SQL or Snowflake for data self-serve, issue investigation or testing validation.

What you'll be doing

We are seeking a Menu Growth Senior Specialist to support Restaurant growth by improving restaurant Menu Performance and driving adoption of menu-related growth initiatives across EMEA.

Menus are a critical part of the customer and merchant experience. Their quality, completeness and use of growth features can influence customer choice, basket size and overall merchant performance.

You will work closely with the Menu Growth Manager to analyze menu performance, identify opportunities and translate insights into concrete initiatives. You will take end-to-end ownership of defined workstreams, such as Menu Completeness,  and work with local Account Management and Merchant Operations teams to execute them across markets and measure their impact.

This is a hands-on Strategy & Operations role combining analytics, project management and stakeholder collaboration. You will independently drive your initiatives from analysis through execution and performance tracking, while partnering with the Menu Growth Manager and Consumer Teams on broader strategy and prioritization.

Day-to-day in this role you'll:

Menu Growth Analysis (~30%)

- Analyze consumer needs around menu, merchant and business performance to identify gaps and growth opportunities.

- Use SQL, Snowflake, spreadsheets and dashboards to investigate performance and support data-driven decision-making.

- Work with the Menu Growth Manager to turn insights and hypotheses into concrete initiatives.

- Track key metrics including and identify markets or merchant segments requiring additional focus.

- Support impact measurement and experimentation to understand which interventions improve merchant and business outcomes.

- Prepare clear analyses and recommendations that help EMEA and local teams make informed decisions.

Initiative Execution (~45%)

- Own defined Menu Growth initiatives end-to-end, from planning through market rollout and performance tracking.

- Support the rollout and adoption of EMEA initiatives

- Translate initiatives into clear execution plans, timelines, materials and actions for participating markets.

- Track progress against agreed targets and proactively identify execution gaps or blockers.

- Coordinate follow-ups with local teams and support them in implementing agreed actions.

- Measure results, document learnings and recommend improvements together with the Menu Growth Manager.

- Help scale successful approaches and best practices across EMEA markets.

Market & Stakeholder Collaboration (~25%)

- Work closely with local Account Management and Merchant Operations teams and their leaders across EMEA.

- Support markets in understanding menu performance gaps and translating insights into concrete actions.

- Build strong relationships with local stakeholders to drive adoption and execution of Menu Growth initiatives.

- Gather structured market feedback and use it to improve future initiatives.

- Coordinate with Analytics and Product when initiatives require additional data, insights or tooling support.

- Share successful approaches and learnings across markets to accelerate adoption and reduce duplicated effort.

Our humble expectations

- 2–4 years of experience in Strategy & Operations, Business Operations, Marketplace/Commercial Operations or a comparable analytical role.

- Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn data into actionable recommendations.

- Comfortable working with large datasets, SQL/Snowflake, Excel/Google Sheets and BI/dashboarding tools.

- Familiarity with hypothesis-driven problem solving, experimentation and A/B testing principles.

- First project management experience, with the ability to independently drive defined initiatives from analysis through execution.

- A commercial mindset and curiosity about how merchant and customer behavior translates into business growth.

- Strong stakeholder-management skills and a proactive, action-oriented approach to driving execution across teams and markets.

- Fluent business English; experience in marketplaces, food delivery, e-commerce or high-growth tech is a plus.

What we offer

- A fast-growing tech company with lots of career opportunities, both locally and internationally;

- Employee Assistance Programme - therapy and wellbeing;

- Employee discount on all Wolt orders;

We are seeking a Merchant Account Development Manager to lead our partnerships efforts for our Restaurant and Merchants ads and promos business. In this role, you will be reporting to our local Head of Commercial and our Global Advertising Lead. This person will be a key member in both the Global Ads team and local merchant team.

- Develop and implement a comprehensive local strategy to drive revenue growth for our restaurant and merchant ads business.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product development, marketing, and operations, to ensure sales objectives are met.

- Develop and implement sales processes and procedures to improve sales efficiency and effectiveness.

- Analyze sales performance metrics and provide regular updates to leadership on sales ROI and key trends.

- Negotiate and close advertising investment deals with a focus on revenue growth, product adoption, and customer engagement.

- with a proven ability to lead and motivate a high-performing sales team.

- Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to present to senior executives and clients.

- Strong analytical skills with the ability to use data to inform decisions.

- Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.

Our Retail Onboarding Team (ReOB) is the heart and soul of Wolt. We ensure that all our retail partners are set up for long-term success through a seamless, scalable onboarding, menu, and catalog experience. ReOB combines hands-on onboarding & communication with data-driven menu management and elements of category management.
As Wolt continues to grow, so does the complexity of our operations. As a Senior member of the Retail Onboarding team, you will play a key role in driving, optimizing, and scaling our onboarding engine in the German market. You will work closely with internal teams as well as major retail partners (e.g. key accounts like Edeka), ensuring we maximize both speed and quality.

What we offer:

The opportunity to play a key role in shaping something exceptional in an international environment
A steep learning and growth curve in a global technology company
An attractive salary and flexible working hours
High ownership and autonomy within a dynamic team
A flat hierarchy in a scaling start-up environment
Discount on Wolt orders
Public transport allowance
Wellness allowance (Urban Sports Club)
Weekly (virtual) all-hands meetings and regular team events
Flexible working hours + 30 days paid holiday

-  Own the end-to-end onboarding of retail partners – from first contact to successful go-live
Actively onboard, train, and support merchants, including conducting on-site training when needed
Coordinate photoshoots and manage external workforce for data entry and catalog creation
Edit, structure, and optimize menus and assortments, with a strong focus on data quality (Excel is a core part of your daily work)
Ensure high-quality product data and continuously improve catalog standards
Collaborate closely with Sales, Account Management, and other stakeholders to remove bottlenecks across the onboarding funnel
Act as a central driver of onboarding velocity by proactively identifying and resolving roadblocks
Analyze and improve workflows, leveraging new technologies to scale operations

You demonstrate strong ownership and an entrepreneurial mindset, working independently with limited guidance

You thrive in cross-functional environments and actively drive collaboration

Om rollen

Vi udvider vores forretning i Danmark og leder efter en Sales Manager til at joine vores erfarne salgsteam i København.
Som Sales Manager får du en central rolle i at vækste Wolt i Danmark – ved at onboarde nye restaurant- og retailpartnere til vores platform. Du ejer hele salgsprocessen fra første kontakt til underskrevet aftale og bliver en vigtig del af vores fortsatte ekspansion.

Du kontakter potentielle partnere via telefon og mail for at booke møder – og besøger dem derefter personligt for at præsentere Wolt og skabe stærke relationer.

Dine ansvarsområder

- Eje og drive din egen portefølje af potentielle samarbejdspartnere, som du systematisk kontakter og følger op på

- Booke og afholde møder med restauranter og retailpartnere (fx kiosker, bagerier, convenience og blomsterbutikker)

- Arbejde ud fra København og på tværs af hele Sjælland for at udbygge Wolts tilstedeværelse i alle vores byer

- Planlægge dit arbejde effektivt – og være villig til at tage 1–2 overnatninger om måneden, når det giver mening for at dække dit område bedst muligt

- Forhandle kommercielle vilkår og sikre en grundig overlevering til vores Partner Onboarding Team

- Samarbejde med resten af salgsteamet om at forbedre salgsmetoder og dele best practices

- Træffe solide forretningsbeslutninger baseret på både data og din kommercielle intuition

Hvem er du?

- Du er en ægte hunter med minimum 3 års dokumenteret erfaring indenfor B2B-salg

- Du trives i et performanceorienteret miljø, hvor du sætter ambitiøse mål og fejrer succeser sammen med teamet

- Du har en can-do attitude og trives i et tempofyldt miljø

- Du er en stærk kommunikator og har solid kommerciel forståelse

- Du taler og skriver flydende dansk og engelsk (bemærk; dine første interviews vil være på engelsk)

- Erfaring med CRM-systemer (fx Salesforce eller Pipedrive) er en fordel

- Kendskab til hotel-, restaurant- eller detailbranchen er et plus

Hvem er vi?

Du bliver en del af et dynamisk og erfarent salgsteam bestående af 8 Sales Managers, hvoraf 5 er baseret i København og 3 i Aalborg, som alle arbejder tæt sammen på tværs af Danmark. Teamet består af engagerede Sales Managers, der alle brænder for at skabe vækst for vores partnere – og for at gøre Wolt til det foretrukne valg for både restauranter og retailbutikker.

Hvad Wolt tilbyder

Hos Wolt får du:

- En rolle med stort ansvar og indflydelse, hvor dine resultater kan ses direkte på væksten

- Et stærkt fællesskab med ambitiøse og hjælpsomme kolleger

- Muligheden for at blive en del af en hurtigt voksende international virksomhed, der kombinerer lokalt kendskab med global rækkevidde

- Et kulturmiljø præget af tillid, frihed og ejerskab, hvor du kan udvikle dig fagligt og personligt

Næste skridt

Vi gennemgår ansøgninger løbende, så ansøg allerede i dag.
Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte [indsæt navn / titel].

Bemærk: Vi accepterer ikke ansøgninger via e-mail af hensyn til GDPR. Ansøg venligst via vores karriereside.

(En) Sales Manager – Denmark

About the role

We’re expanding our business in Denmark and are looking for a Sales Manager to join our experienced sales team in Copenhagen.

As a Sales Manager, you’ll play a key role in growing Wolt in Denmark by acquiring new restaurant and retail partners to our platform. You’ll own the entire sales process - from the first contact to a signed agreement - and be an essential part of our continued expansion.

You’ll reach out to potential partners via phone and email to book meetings - and then visit them in person to present Wolt and build strong, lasting relationships.

What you’ll be doing

- Manage your own portfolio of potential partners, driving outreach and systematic follow-ups

- Book and conduct meetings with restaurants

- Work primarily out of Copenhagen while covering all of Zealand to expand Wolt’s presence across our cities

- Plan your time efficiently and be flexible to travel - with 1-2 overnight stays per month when needed to cover your area effectively

- Negotiate commercial terms and ensure a smooth handover to our Partner Onboarding Team

- Collaborate closely with the rest of the sales team to share best practices and continuously improve our sales approach

- Make sound business decisions based on both data and your commercial intuition

What we’re looking for

- A true hunter with a proven track record in B2B sales (minimum 3 years)

- Someone who thrives in a performance-driven environment, setting ambitious goals and celebrating success together

- A can-do attitude and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced setting

- Strong communication skills and solid commercial understanding

- Fluent in Danish and English (note: your initial interviews will be conducted in English)

- Experience working with CRM systems (e.g. Salesforce or Pipedrive) is a plus

- Experience within the hospitality, restaurant, or retail industry is an advantage

Who we are

You’ll be part of a dynamic and experienced sales team of 8 Sales Managers - 5 based in Copenhagen and 3 in Aalborg and 5 Inside Sales Associates - working closely together across Denmark. Our team is driven, collaborative, and passionate about helping our partners grow and making Wolt the preferred choice for both restaurants and retail stores.

What Wolt offers

At Wolt, you’ll get:

- A role with significant ownership and impact, where your results directly contribute to our growth

- A supportive and ambitious team culture, built on trust and collaboration

- The opportunity to be part of a rapidly growing international company, combining local expertise with global reach

- A culture of freedom, ownership, and development, where you can grow both personally and professionally

Next steps

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so apply today!

Please note: Due to GDPR, we do not accept applications via email. Apply directly through our careers page.

About the Role

Israel is one of Wolt's most established markets. Arab-Israeli communities, roughly a fifth of the population, are also one of its largest growth opportunities. We have launched in a growing number of Arab towns and cities and seen strong early traction. Our ambition is much bigger: a leading, scaled business in this market, winning consumers, merchants, and couriers in every region where Arab communities live.

The Senior Manager, Arab Market Business Lead, takes full ownership of Wolt Israel's business in the Arab market, with end-to-end accountability for strategy, growth, and results across consumers, merchants, and couriers. You will lead the existing Arab market team and serve as the link between Wolt Israel's management and this market, translating what works at Wolt in Israel into what works for Arab-Israeli customers, merchants, and couriers.

You will report to the Director of Market Growth, Wolt Israel.

What you’ll be doing

Business Ownership and Strategy

- Own the Arab market business plan and its results: users, orders, frequency, merchants, and the economics behind them.

- Define the strategy: which regions, segments, and categories to prioritize, in what order, and what it takes to win in each. Translate it into clear priorities for each function.

- Evaluate performance continuously and adjust based on data, the competitive landscape, and growth potential.

- Run a regular operating cadence (weekly performance review, forecasts, OKRs) and hold teams accountable for delivery.

- Bring results, risks, and opportunities to Israel leadership, in a form that works for people who don't know the local market.

Team Leadership

- Lead the Arab market team: set expectations, build accountability, develop talent, and add capacity as the business scales.

- You will lead the sales and account manager teams serving the Arab market, setting commercial priorities, driving performance, and developing the team.

Consumers

- Raise penetration, frequency, and retention, and compete directly for share against strong local players.

Merchants

- Lead acquisition and growth of local restaurants, retailers, and small and medium businesses. Build the commercial offer, onboarding, and ongoing account management that make a small business choose Wolt and grow with us.

- Open the door to larger chain and enterprise partnerships.

Cross-Functional Leadership

- Work as a peer with Merchant, Marketing, Operations, Supply, Product, Analytics, Finance, and Legal, and align them behind one plan for the market.

- Work closely with Marketing. You are not the marketing manager, but you set the priorities and direction so that campaigns, messaging, and local community presence turn into measurable growth.

- Adapt Wolt's Israel playbook to the needs, habits, and expectations of Arab-Israeli customers. Where the playbook doesn't exist, create it.

Market and Network

- Know the market in depth: the differences between communities and regions in the North, the Triangle, Jerusalem, the Negev, and mixed cities.

- Build and maintain a strong network of community, municipal, business, and civic leaders.



Our Humble Expectations

- 15+ years of professional experience, including 5+ years of people leadership.

- Fluent Hebrew, Arabic, and strong professional English, with the ability to translate local context for a global audience.

- A proven record of building or scaling a business line, market, or product from an early stage, ideally in a consumer platform, marketplace, delivery, retail, or e-commerce environment.

- Hands-on experience with merchants, SMBs, and/or enterprise clients in B2B, and a solid understanding of the platform-to-small-business relationship.

- Strategic thinking: the ability to see where we need to go, set a plan, prioritize, and drive it to results against clear metrics.

- Financial and analytical acumen: comfortable managing a business through data, funnels, and unit economics.

- A strong, credible network in the Arab-Israeli community across several regions, and a deep understanding of how they differ.

The Platform Hiring Team (PHT) is building a centralized, technology-enabled hiring engine for repeatable, high-volume roles across supported DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt businesses.

You'll join Platform Hiring Operations, PHT's business-facing team. This team owns demand, market context, and pipeline health: translating business needs into hiring plans, keeping stakeholders ahead of risk, and clearing blockers before they reach the execution team.

About the Role

You'll own business readiness, attraction, and pipeline health for Courier hiring across the business, a new area for Platform Hiring. You'll translate business needs into hiring plans, validate demand against strategy and cost, coordinate Marketing and sourcing partners, activate roles when requirements are complete, and monitor progress against hiring dates.

As the senior business-facing partner for Courier, you'll advise business leaders on hiring strategy, market conditions, timing, location, quality, and delivery trade-offs using funnel and talent-market evidence. When pipeline volume declines, you'll coordinate targeted sourcing interventions and ensure the execution team has sufficient pipeline. You'll proactively coordinate blockers across onboarding, background checks, training capacity, HR, and local operations.

You'll also identify recurring friction and work with the Platform Hiring Manager and PM Team on scalable improvements, automation, and AI adoption.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will

- Own the end-to-end business partnership for Courier hiring, from demand validation through pipeline health and hiring delivery.

- Establish and continuously improve the Platform Hiring operating model for a new hiring area.

- Collect, validate, and translate hiring demand against workforce strategy, timing, market conditions, and cost expectations.

- Set up approved headcount and role requirements in the active hiring platform.

- Own relationships with Marketing, Employer Brand, sourcing, and relevant operational partners to build an effective top-of-funnel strategy.

- Use historical funnel performance and talent-market data to establish the sourcing and application volume required for delivery.

- Activate roles with the Platform Hiring team and maintain clear handoffs, service expectations, and priorities.

- Monitor pipeline health, conversion, drop-off, and hiring dates, providing proactive business updates and surfacing risks early.

- Maintain accurate portfolio documentation, decisions, risks, and source-of-truth reporting.

- Create clear, structured business documentation, including process documentation, recommendations, and stakeholder updates that enable effective alignment.

- Courier demand is validated, prioritized, and activated with complete and accurate information.

- Hiring plans and pipeline requirements are aligned with business needs, market conditions, and agreed hiring dates.

- Pipeline volume and conversion remain sufficient to support delivery commitments.

- Business leaders have clear, timely visibility of hiring progress, risks, blockers, and required decisions.

- Sourcing interventions are targeted, evidence-based, and effective.

- Recurring operational friction is identified and converted into scalable improvements.

- Manual work declines through documented improvements, automation, AI adoption, and effective platform usage.

We are bringing our recruitment teams together into one EMEA organisation aligned to the business departments we support. We are looking for a Senior Recruitment Manager to lead recruitment for Marketplace for Wolt and Deliveroo, the B2B space and SevenRooms, building a team that combines strong business partnerships with consistent hiring delivery across both brands.



Based in Helsinki, you will lead a geographically distributed team of recruitment managers and recruiters across EMEA. You will set the strategy for your portfolio, develop the leaders and specialists in your team, and work with senior business, Finance and People leaders to translate hiring demand into a clear delivery plan.

This role combines leadership through managers with direct leadership of selected individual contributors. You will bring together different markets and business needs, make informed choices about capacity and priorities, and help the team establish effective ways of working in the combined organisation.



What you will be doing:

Lead through managers. Coach and develop recruitment managers and individual contributors, set clear expectations and build a team with strong judgement, accountability and room to grow. Develop leadership capability and succession within your portfolio.

Own the recruitment strategy for your portfolio. Translate business plans for Marketplace, B2B and SevenRooms into short- and longer-term recruitment priorities across Deliveroo and Wolt. Balance department requirements with country, language and role-level needs.

Advise senior business leaders. Build trusted partnerships with the leaders of the areas you support. Bring an informed perspective on talent availability, hiring priorities and trade-offs, and challenge plans constructively when demand, resources or market conditions do not align.

Plan capacity against demand. Partner with Finance and People colleagues to forecast hiring, maintain the position and capacity plan, and allocate recruitment resources using productivity, hiring complexity and business priorities. Surface delivery risks early and recommend practical responses.

Deliver measurable hiring outcomes. Hold your teams accountable for agreed hiring goals, conversion, time to fill, offer acceptance and candidate experience. Use data and talent-market insights to diagnose issues, improve delivery and explain progress to senior stakeholders.

Build consistent hiring practices. Work with Talent Acquisition colleagues and recruiting operations to improve sourcing, assessment and interview practices. Support effective adoption of shared tools and standards while retaining the local expertise needed to hire well across EMEA.

Lead the team through change. Bring recruiters from both brands together around clear responsibilities and effective working routines. Protect valuable business relationships, coordinate handovers and help people build the knowledge and connections they need.

Champion fair and inclusive hiring. Embed inclusive sourcing, structured assessment and consistent decision-making throughout your portfolio. Partner with business leaders to maintain a high hiring bar and a respectful candidate experience.

What you will need to thrive

Essential :

Leadership at scale. Experience leading recruitment managers and geographically distributed recruiting teams, with evidence of developing leaders and improving team performance.

Business and commercial recruitment expertise. A strong track record delivering recruitment across commercial or business functions in a complex, fast-moving organisation, with the judgement to support distinct business models and hiring needs.

Senior stakeholder influence. Experience advising senior business leaders, challenging assumptions with evidence and aligning stakeholders around realistic priorities and delivery commitments.

Strategic workforce and capacity planning. The ability to translate a hiring forecast into a recruitment plan, assess resource requirements and make clear trade-offs across competing needs.

A practical command of recruitment data. Confidence using funnel, productivity and delivery metrics to identify causes, guide action and communicate business impact.

Experience across markets. An understanding of the complexities of hiring across EMEA, including how language, local market conditions and role requirements affect sourcing and delivery.



Nice to have:

Change leadership. Experience helping teams adopt new structures, processes or systems while maintaining trust, continuity and hiring delivery.

Integration experience. Experience combining recruitment teams or operating models across brands, countries or acquired businesses.

Why join us

You will shape recruitment for several distinct business areas at an important point in the integration of Deliveroo and Wolt. The role offers the opportunity to influence senior leaders, develop managers and recruiters across EMEA, and build a sustainable delivery model grounded in business demand.

You will work with colleagues across the broader DoorDash organisation, sharing expertise and improving how we identify, assess and hire talent. We value the different perspectives people bring and want everyone to have the opportunity to do their best work.

About the Team

Merchant EMEA Engineering builds the technology that helps merchants join, grow, and operate successfully across our markets.

Our organization brings together the strengths of Wolt and Deliveroo and supports merchants across 37 countries. We work across the merchant journey, including onboarding, business growth and support, analytics and recommendations, menu and order management, integrations, and merchant applications.

Our teams sit close to the business. Rather than primarily building foundational platforms, we build products and features on top of our existing platforms to solve real merchant and market needs, including local business requirements, growth opportunities, and operational challenges.

📍This open role is based in our tech hubs in Helsinki or Berlin.

Please note: This role requires being based in Berlin/Helsinki on a hybrid basis. We are currently unable to offer fully remote work, visa sponsorship, or relocation support for this opportunity.



What You'll Do

As a Fullstack Engineer, you'll contribute to products and services used across the merchant experience. You'll:

- Build and maintain production software across backend services and user-facing applications.

- Work on areas such as merchant onboarding, analytics, recommendations, menu and order management, integrations, or merchant-facing tools.

- Develop reliable APIs, data models, services, and user-facing features.

- Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, operations, and other engineers to turn business needs into practical technical solutions.

- Own features from implementation through production and ongoing maintenance.

- Contribute to technical design discussions and improve the quality, scalability, observability, and maintainability of our systems.

- Use AI-assisted development tools effectively as part of your engineering workflow, while critically evaluating their output and taking ownership of the final solution.

- Be willing to work outside your primary area of expertise when needed to solve the problem end-to-end.



How We Work

- Ownership: Engineers take responsibility for the features and services they work on, from development to production.

- Collaboration: We work closely across engineering, product, design, data, and operations.

- Pragmatism: We value simple and maintainable solutions that create business impact without unnecessary complexity.

- Flexibility: We care more about solving the problem than strict frontend or backend boundaries.



Our Tech Stack

Our backend services primarily use Go and Kotlin, while our frontend applications use technologies such as TypeScript and React.

We also work with technologies including Kafka, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, gRPC, and modern cloud infrastructure.



Our Humble Expectations

We're looking for engineers who have:

- An AI-first mindset, with a deep experience in leveraging modern AI tools and solid engineering principles to solve problems end-to-end, independently of any specific technology stack.

- Proven experience building production software in backend, frontend, or fullstack environments end-to-end and at scale.

- Strong expertise in at least one area of the stack, with a willingness to contribute outside that area when needed.

- Experience with a modern backend language such as Go, Kotlin, Java, or similar, and/or modern frontend technologies such as TypeScript and React.

- Good understanding of APIs, databases, testing, and software design fundamentals.

- The ability to work independently on well-scoped problems and collaborate effectively with others.

- Good communication skills and a pragmatic, collaborative mindset.

- Merchant-facing or internal operational tools.

- Grocery, retail, restaurants, logistics, or marketplace technology.

- Integrations with external business systems.

- Kafka or other streaming technologies.

- Cloud infrastructure such as AWS, Kubernetes, or Docker.

You'll work on products that directly affect how merchants interact with Wolt Deliveroo and DoorDash across Europe. The scope is broad and close to the business, giving you the opportunity to work on meaningful problems across different parts of the merchant journey while developing your skills across the stack.

israel.title: Senior Specialist, Market Planning
israel.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

At Wolt, keeping courier supply healthy across every city we operate in is core to a great experience for both customers and couriers. As we've scaled to dozens of countries and hundreds of cities, planning & managing supply has grown from a market-by-market exercise into a global challenge: we need a system that plans well everywhere at once, from our largest metros to our smallest cities.

That's where this role comes in. As Senior Specialist, Global Market Planning, you'll help refine the models and tools at the heart of how we plan courier supply globally. You'll make sure the right supply levers are pulled in the right markets, and you'll help us learn which levers actually work. It's a role at the crossroads of data, tooling, and operations. It's for someone who is as comfortable designing a test or building a model as they are working out why a specific market is off plan and what to do about it.

You'll be part of the Global Market Planning team and will partner closely with local operations and courier marketing so that our planning always reflects the reality on the ground.

What you'll be doing

- Develop the global planning model: Help develop and refine our global supply planning model so it delivers robust coverage across both large and small cities, accounting for local context like holidays, special events, etc.

- Allocate investments across markets: Help optimize supply lever allocation, translating region and country budgets into the right mix of levers for each market.

- Test and learn in markets: Propose tests and actions within markets, in line with lever allocation, especially where we don't yet know the right answer or don't have enough data to rely on history. You'll work with local teams and analytics to shape the approach and turn what we learn into the next plan.

- Build the tooling: Develop tools that ensure the correct supply levers are being used effectively across markets to hit our targets.

- Deep dive & solve: Investigate problem areas, identify root causes, and turn your findings into corrective actions and better planning approaches.

- Collaborate: Partner with regional supply leads, local operations teams, and central teams (finance, procurement, product, analytics) on plans, performance, and improvements.

- Improve how we work: Test and prove new concepts in planning, acquisition, onboarding, and activation, and support the roll-out of global improvements across regions.

Our humble expectations

- 3+ years of experience in consulting, operations, analytics, or strategic business development in a fast-paced environment.

- Strong analytical and modelling skills, with a structured, pragmatic approach to solving complex problems.

- Experience designing and interpreting tests or causal analyses, and good judgment about what you can and can't conclude from them in a marketplace setting.

- A systems view of supply: you consider trade-offs between levers and their knock-on effects on cost, courier experience, and customer experience.

- Comfort making and defending recommendations with incomplete data, and adapting your thinking when the facts change.

- Proficiency in SQL, Looker, and Excel/Google Sheets modelling. Python, Cursor, and Claude Code are a plus.

- An attitude for action and ownership beyond the obvious, always looking for opportunities to improve, with the determination to drive change.

- The ability to work across cross-functional teams and manage relationships with stakeholders, both local and global.

- A true culture champion who leads by example with collaboration, teamwork, and data-driven decision making, and who brings humility and respect to every interaction.

- Excellent written and oral communication skills in English.

- Based in Berlin or Helsinki, with the ability to work in a hybrid model from our Wolt office.

Next steps

What to expect from our hiring process:

- Talent Acquisition screen — an introductory conversation with our recruiter to learn more about your background and answer any initial questions about the role.

- Hiring Manager interview — a deeper conversation with the team manager about your experience, the team, and what this role involves day to day.

- Assignment — a practical task related to the role, giving you a chance to show how you approach real problems in this space.

- Final interview — a conversation with a senior stakeholder to round out the process.

Please submit your up-to-date resume in English.

Τι θα κάνεις

Ως Shift Lead/Assistant Store Manager, θα συνεργάζεσαι στενά με τον/την Store Manager για τη διασφάλιση της ομαλής και αποδοτικής λειτουργίας του καταστήματος. Συγκεκριμένα, θα:

- Υποστηρίζεις την επίτευξη των καθημερινών KPIs του καταστήματος

- Αναλαμβάνεις ενεργό ρόλο στη διαχείριση της καθημερινής λειτουργίας και λειτουργείς ως υπεύθυνος/η καταστήματος κατά την απουσία του/της Store Manager

- Υποστηρίζεις την ομάδα στην επίλυση λειτουργικών ζητημάτων και στην αντιμετώπιση προκλήσεων της καθημερινότητας

- Παρακολουθείς τον φόρτο εργασίας, διασφαλίζοντας την αποτελεσματική κατανομή καθηκόντων και πόρων

- Παρέχεις και συλλέγεις feedback, συμβάλλοντας στην ανάπτυξη και δέσμευση της ομάδας

- Συμμετέχεις ενεργά στη βελτίωση διαδικασιών και στην υλοποίηση νέων πρωτοβουλιών

- Ηγείσαι και υποστηρίζεις μια ομάδα περίπου 20 ατόμων, ενισχύοντας μια κουλτούρα συνεργασίας, απόδοσης και συνεχούς εξέλιξης

Τι αναζητούμε

- Προϋπηρεσία σε περιβάλλον παντοπωλείου/λιανικής ή/και εμπειρία σε λειτουργίες Wolt Market

- Προηγούμενη εμπειρία σε ρόλο Shift Lead, Team Lead ή άλλη θέση με ευθύνες συντονισμού ομάδας θα θεωρηθεί ισχυρό πλεονέκτημα

- Ικανότητα διαχείρισης πολλαπλών προτεραιοτήτων σε ένα δυναμικό περιβάλλον

- Ισχυρό προσανατολισμό στην εξυπηρέτηση και στη δημιουργία θετικής εμπειρίας για πελάτες και συναδέλφους

- Πολύ καλές επικοινωνιακές και οργανωτικές δεξιότητες

- Καλή γνώση της αγγλικής γλώσσας

- Διαθεσιμότητα για εργασία σε κυλιόμενες βάρδιες, συμπεριλαμβανομένων πρωινών, απογευματινών, Σαββατοκύριακων και αργιών

Χρήσιμες πληροφορίες

📍 Η εργασία πραγματοποιείται αποκλειστικά δια ζώσης στα καταστήματα Wolt Market.

📅 Τα καταστήματά μας λειτουργούν 365 ημέρες τον χρόνο, με κυλιόμενες βάρδιες μεταξύ 07:00 και 00:00 (ή έως 03:00 σε συγκεκριμένες τοποθεσίες).

Για τον λόγο αυτό, είναι σημαντικό να υπάρχει ευελιξία στη διαθεσιμότητα για πρωινές, απογευματινές και βραδινές βάρδιες, καθώς και για εργασία τα Σαββατοκύριακα και τις αργίες.

Γιατί να κάνεις αίτηση

Αυτή είναι μια εξαιρετική ευκαιρία να αναπτύξεις περαιτέρω τις ηγετικές σου δεξιότητες, να αναλάβεις αυξημένες ευθύνες και να συμβάλλεις ενεργά στην επιτυχία των Wolt Markets.

Εάν πιστεύεις ότι είσαι έτοιμος/η για το επόμενο βήμα στην επαγγελματική σου πορεία στη Wolt, θα χαρούμε να λάβουμε την αίτησή σου.

Παρακαλούμε επισύναψε το ενημερωμένο CV σου και οποιαδήποτε σχετική πληροφορία που αναδεικνύει την εμπειρία και τα επιτεύγματά σου.

Οι αιτήσεις θα αξιολογούνται σε συνεχή βάση.
