israel.title: Software Engineer
israel.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

At Wolt, world-class customer service isn’t an afterthought, it’s at the heart of everything we do. We’ve built our reputation on delivering fast, thoughtful, and high-quality support, and we’ve done that by investing deeply in our own technology. Rather than just reacting to problems, we aim to solve them before our customers and partners even notice. Behind the scenes, that means building systems that scale globally, handle real-world complexity, and empower support teams to do their very best work.
This is where the Multilingual Intelligence & Resolution Automation (MIRA) team comes in. The team is on a mission to make customer support truly borderless. We’re building intelligent, AI-powered systems used across Wolt, DoorDash, and Deliveroo, including a real-time translation engine that supports seamless conversations across 20+ languages. Processing hundreds of requests per minute and powered by modern cloud infrastructure and state-of-the-art LLMs, this system enables borderless support and helps create experiences that feel natural, human, and native, no matter where you are in the world. And we’re only just getting started.
What you’ll be doing

- Design, build, and operate scalable backend services powering real-time, customer-facing systems

- Develop and evolve AI-powered translation capabilities using LLMs in production

- Help build the tooling and infrastructure needed to evaluate models across quality, latency, and cost

- Collaborate closely with product, applied science, frontend, and platform teams to turn complex support problems into robust user-facing systems

- Take ownership of technical decisions and help shape the architecture and future direction of the system

- Improve the performance, reliability, and operational readiness of services handling real production traffic

- Continuously explore better ways of working, including leveraging AI tools to improve development workflows

Our humble expectations

-  You have strong backend development skills in Python or Go (interest in other tech is highly appreciated)

-  You actively leverage modern AI tools (such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT or similar) to enhance your productivity, code quality, and day-to-day development workflow.

-  You have experience with cloud platforms (AWS or similar), container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker), observability tools (such as DataDog), and database technologies (SQL and NoSQL).

-  You're a pragmatic problem-solver with a growth mindset, eager to step outside your comfort zone and continuously learn.

-  You're comfortable working with real-world data and its nuances.

-  You have solid experience designing, building, and integrating quality software (microservices) at scale within a complex domain.

What we offer

- A chance to build something that truly matters, technology that enables people to connect and solve problems across languages and borders

- The opportunity to work with AI and LLMs in real, high-impact production use cases

- Being part of a global engineering organization of 2000+ people, we aim to build none other than the best-in-the-world engineering team here.

- You’ll get to work in a company culture where we take ownership beyond the obvious, do common things uncommonly well, we think big but stay humble, do right by people, we treat others kindly and justly, recognise that if we don’t learn, we won’t stay still but fall behind, and keep in mind that Luke was Yoda’s greatest achievement.

Join us for an exciting journey of creating technology that brings joy, simplicity, and earnings to the neighbourhoods of the world!

Compensation

The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range listed below and is determined based on factors such as the candidate’s skills, experience and qualifications. Please note, that the starting pay may vary if the candidate does not fully meet the expectations as outlined in this job posting.

The salary below is the monthly salary range for this position.
€5,400 - €8,000 Per month

To learn more about our benefits, please do not hesitate to bring this up with our Talent Acquisition Partner!

israel.title: Staff Engineer
israel.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Wolt’s AdTech & Promotions team is building the systems that power how restaurants and brands grow on our platform. From campaign creation to optimization and forecasting, we develop tools that help advertisers make smarter decisions and drive measurable results. As we expand our offering, we are investing in new capabilities that combine real-time data, scalable systems, and intuitive user experiences to unlock the next phase of growth.

We’re looking for a Staff Engineer to join the Wolt AdTech & Promotions organization, who can drive technical direction across this space and help us build reliable, scalable systems that directly impact revenue and advertiser success.

What you’ll be doing

- Drive the technical vision and architecture for Wolt’s AdTech and Promotions platforms, ensuring they are scalable, reliable, and high-performing.

- Provide technical leadership across multiple teams and projects, bringing architectural consistency to complex, large-scale systems.

- Work across the end-to-end domain, contributing to backend services, data pipelines, and advertiser-facing tools.

- Design and evolve systems that support campaign execution, targeting, ranking, allocation, and reporting in real-time or near real-time environments.

- Partner with engineering, product, and data stakeholders to align priorities, improve campaign performance, and manage trade-offs in a revenue-driven environment.

- Lead large cross-team projects, guiding them from concept to rollout across multiple regions and time zones.

- Ensure strong operational excellence, including observability, reliability, and incident readiness for revenue-critical systems.

- Promote best engineering practices, mentor engineers across teams, and support their growth in scalability and system design.

- Act as a bridge between technical and non-technical colleagues, ensuring clarity and alignment across functions.

- Contribute to the technical roadmaps of AdTech and Promotions platforms by collaborating with other senior engineers.

This position is based in London

Our humble expectations

Technical Expertise

- Proven track record designing and scaling large distributed systems in production environments.

- Strong understanding of system architecture, scalability, reliability, and performance optimization.

- Experience working with data-intensive and real-time or near real-time systems.

- Familiarity with AdTech concepts such as targeting, ranking, attribution, or experimentation is a strong plus.

- Ability to adapt quickly to new technologies and languages; while many of our services are written in Kotlin and Go, we are looking for someone language-agnostic.

- Ability to dive quickly into new domains and navigate complex system interactions.

- Familiarity with modern cloud-native tools and data systems (e.g., Kubernetes, Kafka, MongoDB).

Communication & Influence

- Strong communicator with the ability to influence, align, and build consensus across diverse teams and stakeholders.

- Comfortable working in a global environment across US and international teams.

- Skilled at translating complex technical decisions into clear direction for technical and non-technical audiences.

- Experience mentoring and coaching engineers, helping raise the technical bar across teams.

- Strong sense of ownership combined with a collaborative mindset, able to work effectively across team boundaries to deliver shared outcomes.

- Proactive in identifying opportunities and gaps across teams, and driving alignment to solve problems holistically rather than locally.

What we offer

At Wolt, this role provides a rare opportunity to work on challenging AdTech problems at scale, where technical decisions directly impact revenue and user experience.

Our compensation follows a total compensation model, combining a competitive base salary with DoorDash RSUs.

You will play a key role in building and evolving the next generation of advertisement tools and platforms, shaping how advertisers create, manage, and optimize campaigns across Wolt. This is not just about maintaining systems, but about defining and scaling new capabilities in a fast-growing domain.

As a Staff Engineer, you will have end-to-end ownership and high autonomy, with the ability to influence architecture, product direction, and engineering practices across teams. Your work will have clear, measurable business impact, directly contributing to revenue growth and advertiser success.

You’ll be part of a global company operating at scale, collaborating with teams across Europe and the US, and solving problems that span multiple markets, use cases, and customer segments.

This role also offers strong opportunities for career growth and scope expansion, whether through deep technical leadership, cross-domain influence, or progression toward more senior individual contributor roles.

Alongside the technical challenge, you’ll work with talented engineers and leaders in a diverse and international environment, shaping both our systems and engineering culture while mentoring and learning from others.

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. The EU Compute team has a specific focus on provisioning, scaling, and the efficient operation of GPU infrastructure for AI and ML workloads. You'll set direction for the platform, turn complex problems into deliverable plans, write and review production code, and help other engineers make sound decisions. It's an exciting time to join: we're building a global platform and the choices made now will shape how engineers across the company ship for years.

What you’ll be doing

You'll own some of the hardest infrastructure problems in the company and make the platform easier to operate and safer to build on. We’re determined to build great platform products and user experiences, and you’ll be pivotal in making this reality.

Day-to-day in this role you’ll:

- Set technical direction for shared AWS and Kubernetes infrastructure, balancing reliability, security, developer experience, and cost.

- Lead substantial initiatives from design through rollout and operation, coordinating dependencies and decisions across Wolt, Deliveroo and DoorDash, focusing on workloads targeting GPUs.

- Evolve Kubernetes clusters, cloud networking, identity, and infrastructure provisioning to support growing and varied workloads.

- Build reusable Terraform patterns and self-service tooling that help teams provision infrastructure safely and consistently.

- Improve deployment and operational practices, including GitOps, observability, capacity planning, incident response and recovery.

- Use production signals and developer feedback to find platform friction, choose where to invest and measure whether changes actually help.

- Assist with supporting the platform, with deep focus on GPU infrastructure, as well as broad focus on compute in general.

- Gracefully sunset legacy infrastructure and tooling, and create strategies to reduce toil.

- Mentor engineers through design reviews, implementation and incidents, raising the quality of infrastructure work across teams.

Our humble expectations

- Deep experience building and operating Kubernetes and AWS infrastructure in production. Familiarity with GPU workloads and orchestration is a plus.

- Strong software engineering skills: you use Go, Python or a similar language to build maintainable tools and automation.

- Experience with infrastructure as code (we use Terraform) and with designing systems that other engineering teams depend on.

- A track record of leading complex technical work across teams, including architectural decisions, delivery, and operational follow-through. You have the breadth to collaborate and design across team and domain boundaries, and the depth to have hands-on impact.

- Strong judgment on trade-offs in distributed systems, networking, security, reliability, and cloud cost.

- Clear communication, and the ability to bring people together around a practical technical direction.

What we offer

- Scope and influence. Shape infrastructure used globally, while staying close to the engineering. Your work will help product teams ship services with greater ease and confidence.

- Real problems at global scale. Multi-cluster Kubernetes, AI / ML workloads, cloud networking, GitOps, and progressive delivery across a global company.

- Autonomy and ownership. Set direction and see it through from design to operation, with the backing of a global engineering organisation spanning Europe and the US.

israel.title: Strategy & Business Operations Manager, Wolt Drive
israel.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

About the role

Wolt is on a growth journey as part of the DoorDash family, together with Deliveroo. Drive is our delivery-as-a-service business: we let merchants offer fast, reliable delivery in their own channels (their webshop, app or ordering system), powered by the Wolt and Deliveroo courier networks. We're now bringing Drive across Wolt and Deliveroo countries together into one EMEA business, with one team and a clear ambition: grow fast and build a business that stands on its own feet.

A growing share of that scaling comes from outside restaurants: grocers, retailers, pharmacies and other eComm players who want on-demand and same-day delivery for their own customers. Their needs can be very different from restaurants: bigger baskets, scheduled and batched deliveries, larger and heavier items, longer distances and more complex integrations. This brings us to you, our next Manager, Strategy & Operations for Grocery & Retail Drive.

You'll own this segment across EMEA, from strategy and planning to pricing, product requirements and performance. You'll work hand in hand with our regional commercial teams, who own the partner relationships, and with Product, Logistics, Finance and our Marketplace grocery & retail teams. You'll join the Drive EMEA Strategy & Operations team and report to the Director of Strategy & Operations, Drive EMEA.

What you'll be doing

- Own the Grocery & Retail strategy and annual plan for Drive EMEA: where we play, which partners we go after, and the growth and profitability we commit to.

- Set the commercial framework for the segment, including pricing guidelines, deal economics and investment cases for our largest partnerships, together with the regional commercial leads.

- Act as the voice of grocery and retail partners towards Product and Logistics, turning commercial needs such as scheduled delivery or large and heavy items into sized, prioritized requirements.

- Run performance management for the segment: track growth, unit economics and service levels for our biggest partners, spot what's off and drive the fix with the teams involved.

- Shape how Drive works with our Marketplace grocery & retail teams, so partners get one joined-up offer from us.

- Turn wins into playbooks that country teams can reuse, from the first pitch to launch and scale-up.

Our humble expectations

- 5+ years of experience in strategy & operations, business development, commercial roles or management consulting, with a track record of owning outcomes, not just recommendations.

- Strong commercial and analytical skills: you can build a deal P&L or a segment plan from scratch, and defend it in front of a partner's leadership or our own.

- Proven ability to get things done across a matrix organization without direct authority, working with regional teams, Product, Logistics and Finance.

- You use AI tools (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) in your daily work, for example in analysis, planning and ways of working, and look for new ways to apply them to elevate you - whilst maintaining strong judgement that comes from personal understanding complex systems

- Structured thinking and clear, concise communication in English, both written and spoken.

- Willingness to travel occasionally across our EMEA markets.

Seen as a strong advantage:

- Background in retail, grocery, e-commerce, logistics or on-demand delivery, either in-house or advising companies in these sectors.

- Experience with B2B platform or delivery-as-a-service businesses.

Why you'll love it

- 🚀 Global and growing fast: Be part of a fast-moving business at the moment it's being built, across two of Europe's best-known delivery brands

- 🛒 A segment to own: Work with some of the biggest grocery and retail brands in Europe, and see what you write end up on the product roadmap

- 🤩 Ride of a lifetime: Accelerate your career with direct access to DoorDash's global Drive experience and room to grow as the segment scales

- 💪 Instant impact: Take ownership and make a difference

- 💙 Big hearts and small egos: Surround yourself with smart, friendly people

Next steps

If you are excited about working in a high-growth environment, taking ownership, and being part of an extremely ambitious team, then click below to apply, make sure to add your CV in English and get the conversation going! We will be reviewing applications on a rolling basis.

[Location preference Helsinki/Berlin/London externally; internally flexible. Expect moderate travel to meet partners, country teams and HQ stakeholders]

israel.description:
About Wolt

About the Team

DashOS is DoorDash’s restaurant growth platform, connecting Marketplace demand with the tools restaurants use to serve, understand and retain guests. Digital Ordering - white-label ordering, websites, apps and loyalty on a merchant’s own channels - is a core part of it. Our Global Strategy & Operations (S&O) team sets the commercial strategy and operating model for DashOS worldwide, working across Product, Sales, Finance, Legal and regional teams to take what works in one market and make it work in the next.

About the Role

You will help build Digital Ordering in EMEA, creating the playbook to succeed across the very different markets of the region. You will have real ownership of key parts of this build, from commercial strategy to market expansion to the processes that let it scale. You will be based in London.

What You’ll Be Doing

- Shape the commercial strategy: Help define the global Digital Ordering strategy and adapt it to EMEA, including segments, pricing and positioning.

- Influence the product: Be the voice of EMEA merchants and markets, build business cases, and partner with Product and Engineering to prioritise what the region needs.

- Expand to new markets: Assess and prioritise new markets, build launch plans, and drive go-live and early traction with local teams.

- Scale how we work: Build the processes, forecasting, reporting and enablement that let Digital Ordering grow efficiently across regions.

- Support key deals: Work with regional Sales and Account Management on strategic merchant partnerships and commercial terms.

- Stay ahead of the market: Track first-party ordering trends and competitors, and turn insights into recommendations for leadership.

- Bridge product & Ops: Help launch new features in the merchant partner base to help our partners grow.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

- Experience: 4+ years in strategy & operations, business development, commercial strategy, consulting or a similar role, ideally in SaaS, marketplaces, e-commerce or hospitality tech.

- Building and scaling: Experience launching or scaling a product, business line or programme, ideally in a new market.

- Analytical and strategic thinking: You use data to build business cases and drive decisions, and turn analysis into clear, executive-ready recommendations.

- Commercial and product fluency: You can translate merchant needs into product requirements and are comfortable with commercial negotiations.

- Influence: You build strong relationships and drive results across many teams without direct authority.

- Operator mindset: You are an owner by nature, who enjoys building processes and moving fast in ambiguity.

Why Join Us?

You’ll do work that matters and be a part of our next big bet that’s constantly evolving. Working here you can expect to:

- Make a visible impact every day, directly improving experiences for merchants, customers and couriers.

- Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment, with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.

- Build a career, not just a role, as the business evolves.

- Deliver together in an inclusive, values-driven culture.

You’ll manage a layer of Team Leads (managers of frontline Account Managers) or directly manage Account Managers in several countries and be accountable for the overall retention, revenue growth, and operational excellence across the segment. This is a leader role — you’ll set strategy, build the playbook, run operations & forecasting, recruit and coach leaders, and partner cross-functionally to drive lifetime value for thousands of  merchants.

What you’ll own:

- Strategy & Vision: Define and execute the account management strategy — segmentation, coverage model, lifecycle motions (onboarding, adoption, retention, growth), and long-term roadmap.

- People Leadership: Line manage Team Leads and frontline Account Managers. Hire, coach, develop and scale high-performing leaders; run regular 1:1s, calibration, and career planning.

- Operational Excellence: Build standard operating procedures, playbooks, KPIs, forecasting cadence, quota & incentive design, and capacity planning for the  channel.

- Revenue & Retention: Own  revenue retention, expansion (upsell/cross-sell), and churn reduction strategies — working to maximize Take Home Pay

israel.title: Supply Chain Manager (WM)
israel.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

About the Role..

As a Wolt Market Supply Chain Manager, you will play a key role in managing and continuously improving the supply chain for Wolt Market in Finland.

You will take ownership of a broad portfolio of Supply Chain responsibilities, including inventory and availability management, demand forecasting, supplier performance and operational supplier management. You will use data and strong commercial judgement to balance availability, inventory, shrinkage, and profitability, ensuring that Supply Chain decisions support both our customers and the overall performance of the business.

The role requires a high degree of independence and ownership. You will identify opportunities and challenges, translate analysis into actions, and drive complex Supply Chain initiatives from problem definition through implementation and follow-up with limited guidance.

You will work particularly closely with the Finland Supply Chain Analyst and act as an experienced sparring partner to the Finland Category and Store Operations teams. You will also collaborate closely with colleagues across the regional Supply Chain team and the wider Wolt Market Supply Chain community, sharing knowledge, contributing to common initiatives and supporting the continuous development of our Supply Chain capabilities.

Key tasks and responsibilities of the role

- Own and drive core Supply Chain responsibilities for Wolt Market Finland together with the local Supply Chain team.

- Manage and continuously improve inventory availability, stock levels and inventory health while balancing availability, shrinkage, capacity and profitability.

- Analyse demand, inventory, availability, shrinkage and supplier performance and translate insights into clear recommendations and actions.

- Own and continuously improve demand forecasting and replenishment processes, including forecasting around promotions, seasonal events and other changes in demand.

- Monitor Supply Chain KPIs, identify performance gaps and root causes, and independently develop and execute actions to improve performance.

- Work closely with Category to evaluate the Supply Chain implications of supplier, assortment, promotion and commercial decisions and provide constructive challenge where required.

- Partner closely with Store Operations to identify and solve Supply Chain-related operational challenges and ensure processes work effectively from supplier through to store.

- Manage operational relationships with suppliers and collaborate on topics including ordering, delivery performance, lead times, order conditions, availability and Supply Chain improvements.

- Identify structural supplier or assortment-related Supply Chain challenges and develop commercially sound solutions together with relevant stakeholders.

- Own complex projects and larger workstreams from analysis and problem definition through implementation, stakeholder alignment and measurement of results.

- Contribute to the implementation and continuous improvement of Supply Chain tools, systems, automation and processes.

- Use data, analytical tools and AI to diagnose complex problems where multiple factors need to be considered and exercise sound judgement in determining the appropriate solution.

- Proactively identify new business needs and improvement opportunities and develop proposals for how Supply Chain can address them.

- Work closely with the Finland Supply Chain Analyst, sharing expertise, providing guidance and supporting development through informal mentoring and collaboration.

- Collaborate with the regional Supply Chain team and wider Supply Chain community, contributing to cross-country projects, exchanging best practices and helping develop scalable ways of working.

- Communicate clearly and proactively with stakeholders across Supply Chain, Category, Store Operations, Finance, Product and other relevant functions.

- Manage several priorities and initiatives simultaneously in a fast-moving environment while maintaining a high level of quality and follow-through.

- Take a hands-on approach and be willing to move between strategic analysis, problem solving and operational execution as required.

- Demonstrate excellent business judgement and a practical, solution-oriented approach to getting things done.

- Contribute positively to Wolt's culture and ways of working and be an active member of both the local and regional team.

Qualifications for the role

- Strong experience in Supply Chain, inventory management, replenishment, demand planning or a closely related field, ideally within grocery, retail, e-commerce or another fast-moving environment.

- Strong understanding of inventory and replenishment principles and the trade-offs between availability, stock levels, shrinkage and profitability.

- Demonstrated ability to independently solve complex Supply Chain and business problems using data, structured analysis and commercial judgement.

- Experience working with demand forecasting and translating forecasts into inventory and replenishment decisions.

- Strong commercial understanding and the ability to assess Supply Chain decisions in the context of broader business performance and profitability.

- Experience collaborating with commercial or Category teams and confidence in constructively challenging decisions based on data and Supply Chain expertise.

- Experience working with suppliers and analysing and improving supplier performance.

- Ability to take ownership of complex projects and workstreams and drive them from problem identification to implementation with limited guidance.

- High level of autonomy and the ability to determine the appropriate methods and approach when faced with new or ambiguous assignments.

- Strong stakeholder-management skills and the ability to build credible working relationships across different functions and levels of the organisation.

- Ability and willingness to share expertise, provide guidance and informally mentor less experienced colleagues without formal people-management responsibility.

- Highly analytical, structured and detail-oriented while maintaining a strong understanding of the bigger commercial picture.

- Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.

- Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with several competing priorities.

- Advanced skills in analytical and productivity tools such as Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel; experience with BI and Supply Chain systems is an advantage.

- Passion for analytical excellence, continuous improvement and using data to make better decisions.

- Fluency in English. Finnish language skills are an advantage.

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Trenutno iščemo nove sodelavce za polni delovni čas za podporo uporabnikom, ki se bodo pridružili naši ekipi v pisarni v Ljubljani! Delo je izmensko in poteka vsak dan med 06:45 in 01:00 (tudi med vikendi in prazniki). Tako lahko ti in tvoji sodelavci v tem časovnem okviru našim uporabnikom kadarkoli zagotavljate vrhunske storitve!

Kaj bo obsegalo tvoje delo

- Najboljša podpora uporabnikom in partnerjem na svetu: Naše poslanstvo v podjetju Wolt je, da strankam vsakič znova zagotovimo nepozabno izkušnjo. Kar delamo, je več kot le odpravljanje težav.

- Usmerjenost v ekipno delo: Delo z raznoliko ekipo sodelavcev za podporo uporabnikom in sodelovanje z drugimi člani naše ekipe, z namenom komuniciranja in odpravljanja morebitnih težav, tudi tehničnih, ali v povezavi z drugimi možnimi vprašanji, ki se lahko pojavijo tekom tvoje izmene.

- Komunikacija: Tekoče in nemoteno komuniciranje z našimi uporabniki in partnerji ter ustrezno prilagajanje tona komunikacije potrebam vsakega posameznika.

- Osebna nota: V naših interakcijah se ne bojimo biti igrivi, zato je ustvarjalnost obvezna!

- Osredotočenost k doseganju ciljev: Osredotočenost na izpolnjevanje nalog in skrb, da so le-te odlično opravljene.

Kvalifikacije

- Tekoče govoriš in pišeš slovensko in angleško.

- Imaš že nekaj izkušenj na primerljivem delovnem mestu in se veseliš dela v naši nagrajeni ekipi za podporo uporabnikom.

- Hitro se učiš in si pozoren/-na tako na majhne podrobnosti kot tudi na širšo sliko.

- Večopravilnost je tvoja močna točka in lahko brez problema obvladaš več interakcij hkrati, pri čemer zlahka določiš, katere so prednostne.

- Pripravljen/-a si zavihati rokave in se lotiti dela v hitro rastočem zagonskem okolju.

Kaj nudimo

- Najmanj 25 dni dopusta - letno (only full-time)

- Dodatni dnevi plačanega dopusta za pomembne privatne zadeve (only full-time)

- Wolt krediti - uživaj v Woltovih dostavah na dom in ob vsakem dostavljenem naročilu na tvoj Wolt uporabniški račun v obliki Wolt kreditov prejmi povrnjen delež celotnega naročila

- Hibridni način dela - ko začneš delati samostojno, je delo na daljavo mogoče (ob vikendih, praznikih, popoldanskih in izbranih jutranjih izmenah)

- Program pomoči zaposlenim - naša interna Wolt izobraževanja, personalizirani trening programi in učni viri

- Wolt-wide programi izobraževanja - koristne informacije in svetovanje na različnih področjih in o številnih tematikah namenjeno ne le tebi, temveč tudi tvojim najbližjim in najdražjim

- Letni budget - namenjen večerjam in aktivnostim v krogu tvojih sodelavcev

- Sadje in pijača v pisarni

Če si navdušen/-a nad delom v hitro rastočem zagonskem okolju in v izjemno ambiciozni ekipi ter ti prevzemanje odgovornosti ne predstavlja problema, klikni spodaj in se prijavi, pri čemer ne pozabi na svoj življenjepis.  Intervju bo potekal v živo na lokaciji pisarne. Se slišimo! :)

- Contribute to strategic initiatives and their execution in order to constantly improve the service proposition

- Guide and coach the team in order to improve the associate’s performance, personal development and happiness

- Drive operational KPIs, including quality, productivity, customer satisfaction, and service levels.

- Analyze performance data and identify opportunities for improvement.

- Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to solve operational challenges and improve the customer experience.

- Lead process improvement, automation, and AI adoption initiatives within Support.

- Support workforce planning, performance management, and team growth.

- Foster a culture of accountability, continuous learning, and operational excellence.

- You can formulate yourself very well, both verbally as well as in written form in English and Kazakh or Russian

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

With outstanding customer care, our Support teams are the glue that keeps the Wolt marketplace running smoothly. We ensure seamless interactions between customers, merchant partners, and courier partners every single day.

As a Support Team Lead, you’ll take ownership of our local support operations, lead by example, and empower your team to deliver consistently high-quality service. You’ll play a key role in driving performance, developing people, and continuously improving how we support our partners across the country.

What you’ll be doing

- Lead, motivate, and develop a high-performing support team through coaching, encouragement, and empowerment

- Create a customer-obsessed culture by leading by example

- Own your team’s performance, including KPIs, productivity, and service quality

- Set clear performance goals and provide regular, constructive feedback

- Manage daily operational needs such as shift planning and scheduling

- Lead shifts when needed, supporting representatives and shift leaders to ensure smooth and effective operations

- Collaborate closely with other teams to continuously improve the overall support experience

- Communicate effectively with all customer groups (customers, courier partners, and merchants), adapting tone and approach as needed

- Actively contribute as a member of the group leadership team, supporting decision-making and team success

- Take ownership of support-related projects and approach them with creativity and a continuous improvement mindset

Our humble expectations

- Strong background in customer service, with a solid understanding of metrics such as SAT/CSAT, SLA, and ticket handling time

- Proven experience leading and managing a customer service or support team

- Experience setting performance goals and delivering regular performance feedback

- Ability to work full-time from the office, Monday–Friday, 09:00–18:00

- Good working proficiency in Kazakh, Russian, and English

- At least 1 year of experience at Wolt or experience as a Shift Lead

Next steps

If you’re excited about working in a fast-growing environment, taking ownership, and being part of an ambitious and supportive team, we’d love to hear from you.

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so don’t wait — apply today and remember to attach your CV.


Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

Role Background

As we continue to scale, we’re now looking for an experienced Direct Tax Manager to join the team. In this role, you’ll be involved in global corporate tax projects on planning, implementation and tax reporting, ensuring compliance and supporting the organization with these topics.

What makes the Finance team so special is our ‘service first’ approach to the job - we enjoy creating strong communication loops with the wider business, so that bottlenecks are minimised and that things get done quickly and efficiently.

Role Overview

We are seeking a versatile Tax Technology Manager to support our growing EMEA and beyond scope. This role connects tax, technology, and data — ensuring our systems and processes enable compliant, efficient, and scalable  across the region.

The ideal candidate combines a strong understanding of indirect tax (particularly VAT and invoicing) with an ability to partner cross-functionally and translate tax requirements into smart, tech-enabled solutions. You don’t need to be a developer or automation engineer — but you must be able to see opportunities, shape solutions, and drive them to execution by partnering with tax, engineering, accounting, data ops, and automation teams etc.

Key Responsibilities

- Lead and coordinate the implementation of tax-related technology solutions, ensuring compliance with new or changing legislation (e.g., invoicing, digital reporting, VAT mandates).

- Represent Tax in engineering, product, and finance initiatives — ensuring that new business rollouts and systems capture all relevant tax requirements.

- Partner with vendors and internal system owners to integrate and maintain compliance tools

- Support data governance and system control frameworks, ensuring audit (SOC) readiness, traceability, and documentation across tax technology systems.

- Drive standardization of tax processes and tools across entities and regions (Wolt, DoorDash, Deliveroo).

- Build strong partnerships with engineering, data, automation, and finance teams to ensure tax technology needs are prioritized and delivered effectively.

- Act as a bridge between tax and technology — translating regulatory and compliance requirements into actionable system and process specifications.

- Collaborate with local tax teams to ensure regional regulatory nuances are accurately reflected in the design and functionality of tax technology solutions.

- Identify automation and efficiency opportunities across tax processes and drive them from concept through delivery while collaborating with the automation and data ops to teams to develop scalable solutions..

- Promote adoption and consistent use of tax technology solutions across regional and global tax teams.

- Provide training, documentation, and user support for new tools and processes.

- Champion a culture of continuous improvement — gathering feedback, measuring outcomes, and iterating on solutions post-implementation.

- Develop and maintain a joint roadmap with cross-functional teams, balancing strategic priorities and operational capacity.

- Ensure strong governance around tax technology initiatives, including change management, security, and compliance oversight.

Qualifications & Experience

- Understanding of indirect tax (especially VAT), e-invoicing, and digital tax compliance frameworks in the EMEA region.  Understanding of other areas in tax such as Direct Tax, DAC7 etc. is a plus

- Understanding of commercial tax engines (ie Vertex)

- Proven track record of supporting or optimizing tax technology solutions in a multinational environment.

- Familiarity with data flows and ability to partner effectively with data and automation teams.

- Strong analytical mindset

- Project management experience

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills — able to explain complex tax technology topics to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Accounting/tax qualification or relevant technology certification preferred.

- Understanding and display of using AI tools

This role will require traveling dependent on where the employee is based. We anticipate a 25% travel rate if the candidate is based in either Helsinki or London.

Szeretnél kiszámítható, hétköznapi munkarendben dolgozni, és hosszú távon akár targoncavezetői jogosítványt is szerezni? Ha a válaszod igen, olvass tovább! 🤩

Budaörsi raktárunkban (Shark Park) a Wolt Market boltok kiszolgálását végezzük: a készleten lévő élelmiszer szárazárut szortírozzuk, raklapokra pakoljuk az egyes telephelyeink megrendelései szerint, majd útnak indítjuk. A raktárban kizárólag szárazáruval dolgozunk – hűtött zóna és frissáru nincs.

Fontos, hogy ez fizikai munka: a termékek a kis csokitól és chipstől a 10–18 kg-os zsugor üdítőkig terjednek, és van olyan nap, amikor a teljes műszak pakolással telik. Cserébe kiszámítható munkarendet, tanulási lehetőséget (targoncavezetői jogosítvány) és hosszú távú, stabil munkát kínálunk.

A budaörsi raktárunk hétfőtől péntekig reggel 8 órától 16:30-ig tartó munkavégzéssel dolgozik.

💙 Mi lesz a feladatod?

- Kimenő áruk komissiózása: szárazáru raklapra pakolása és szortírozása a Wolt Market telephelyek megrendelései szerint

- Beérkező áruk bevételezése saját rendszerünkben, PDA segítségével, a belső folyamatnak megfelelően

- Napi és heti leltárok elvégzése, a készletpontosság támogatása

- A raktári rend és tisztaság fenntartása

- Aktív részvétel a napi raktári folyamatokban

- Később: napi szintű kommunikáció a boltokkal

🌟 Mit várunk Tőled?

- Fizikai munkára való alkalmasság és terhelhetőség (maximális emelési súly: 20 kg)

- Pontosság és precizitás – a komissiózásnál a részletek számítanak

- Megbízhatóság, jó munkabírás, csapatszellem

- Alapszintű digitális készségek (PDA / kézi vonalkódolvasó használatának elsajátítása)

- Raktári tapasztalat előnyt jelent, de nem feltétel – a betanítást biztosítjuk

- Érvényes targoncavezetői jogosítvány előny

- Élelmiszerraktárban szerzett tapasztalat előny

🎁 Mit kínálunk mi?

- Kiszámítható munkarend: hétfőtől péntekig, 8:00–16:30 között.

- Teljes munkaidőben bruttó 600 000 Ft elérhető juttatás havonta.

- Nettó 32 000 Ft OTP SZÉP-kártya-juttatás a három hónapos próbaidő letelte után.

- Wolt dolgozói kedvezmény kreditek formájában vásárlásokat követően.

- Bejárási támogatás a jogszabályi feltételek fennállása esetén.

- Cégünk támogatásával hosszabb távon akár targoncavezetői jogosítványt is szerezhetsz.

- Cég által támogatott egészségbiztosítás 🍎

- All You Can Move Kártya lehetőség 🚴

- Ünnepnapi munkavégzés lehetősége a jogszabályban meghatározott pótlékkal.

- Teljes körű betanítás, hosszú távú és stabil munkahely 📚

- Előrelépési lehetőség 📈

A következő lépés

Ha szeretnél egy fizikailag aktív, ugyanakkor kiszámítható munkakörben dolgozni, ahol hosszú távon is számítunk rád, kattints és beszélgessünk!

Folyamatosan dolgozzuk fel a beérkező jelentkezéseket, szóval küldd el, amilyen gyorsan csak lehet! 💙

israel.description:
About Wolt

About the Team

Our Wolt Workplace team runs our offices, to ensure our workplaces’ functionality, comfort, safety, sustainability and efficiency. Our Workplace Coordinator in-country ensure that our offices are properly set up for collaboration and focus as well as ensuring that workplace programs cater to a diverse population of onsite and remote employees. Workplace is a part of the wider Real Estate & Facilities teams and in partnership with the wider team we aim to remove any and all friction in the physical space that prevents our employees from being their most successful.

You’ll be responsible for the Workplace Experience and Operations for a specific country, running things on the ground and creating functional and efficient workplaces for our offices, employees and guests.

Role background

Wolt is looking for an experienced Workplace Coordinator who will report to the Regional Workplace Lead, North and work out of our Tallinn Office. You will help shape our workplace experience and run operations. The person in this position must be a creative problem solver; adept at handling multiple tasks concurrently. Combining People, Technology, and Space across to create an exceptional workplace experience for our Employees, Visitors and Contractors whilst ensuring an optimal use of resources. You will need to possess the ability to take thoughtful initiative and the desire to go above and beyond. Offering an exciting and fast-paced work environment, we are looking for a committed, hands-on, customer-focused individual with the ability to keep pace with our dynamic growth.

What you’ll be doing

- You are the primary point of contact / Directly Responsible Individual to landlords, vendors and local stakeholders for all workplaces within your country.

- You will manage vendors

- Day-to-day implementation of policies, procedures, and programs that assure well-managed, well-maintained building/s with a focus on functionality, comfort, safety, sustainability and efficiency.

- Lead all workplace programs, including but not limited to food & beverages, lockers, mail services, space planning, reception experience, and workplace technology.

- Manage all site-specific workplace projects and initiatives to improve the workplace by writing playbooks, operationalizing guidelines, and physically improving the office.

- Streamline accessibility of our offices and services ensuring spaces and services are easy to navigate and use, automating and innovating to enable self service where it makes sense.

- Promote a high level of employee satisfaction by ensuring prompt responses to the concerns and needs of the occupants, environmental, health and safety, and quality programs. Ensure the same level of service from team members and Workplace vendors.

- Working alongside local and global stakeholders, develop and maintain a detailed understanding of Wolt’s business and key factors influencing their service requirements.

- Build strong relationships with business leaders and local teams to understand their business functions and how to deliver workplace experience strategies that support them.

- Coordinating the activities, financials, vendors, and staffing required for current and future needs of the building, infrastructure and operations including owning the country facilities operating budget.

- Establish, maintain and manage vendor relationships and implement clear KPIs and contract management processes to ensure efficient service agreements are met.

- On-site stakeholder liaison during planning and construction of office expansions.

- Responsible for space planning, tracking, move coordination, and new hire space accommodations.

- Manage the planning, execution, and post-event reporting of team onsite events and support ad-hoc company-wide event needs in the local office. Creating and communicating processes for employees to self-manage large internal events, and coordinating workplace specific event related tasks such as workplace activation initiatives, cleaning, room setup and building specific protocols.

- Collaborate with Global Real Estate, Facilities, IT, Safety, Security and Sustainability teams to roll out global policies and initiatives Woltwide.

Our humble expectations

- Experience in Office, Workplace or Facilities Management in a global organization within a fast-paced and high growth environment

- Strong and passionate Customer focus

- Proven Vendor Management experience

- Event Management experience a bonus

- Enjoy taking ownership and solving problems independently and proactively.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

- Ability to work autonomously in a fast-moving environment, strong relationship building and stakeholder management skills, and a true growth mindset to consistently learn and develop skills.

- Willing to participate in First Aider and Fire Warden Training and ready and willing  to provide assistance in an emergency

- Comfortable collaborating remotely and dynamically using digital tools such as GSuite, Slack and Zoom.

Compensation

The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range listed below and is determined based on factors such as the candidate’s skills, experience and qualifications. Please note, that the starting pay may vary if the candidate does not fully meet the expectations as outlined in this job posting.

The salary below is the monthly salary range for this position.

To learn more about our benefits, please do not hesitate to bring this up with our Talent Acquisition Partner!
The successful candidate's starting pay will fall within the pay range listed below and is determined based on a number of job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions.

This position is not eligible for consideration for an equity/RSU grant.

Pay Range:
€2.000—€2.250 EUR

We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

israel.description:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.

So, what’s the role all about?

The Account Executive is a driven, hunter-minded sales professional responsible for proactively identifying, developing, and closing new enterprise business for NiCE Actimize. This role is focused on generating new opportunities, building strategic relationships from the ground up, and owning the sales cycle from initial prospecting through negotiation and close. The ideal candidate is a self-starter who creates pipeline, engages senior decision-makers, and consistently drives deals forward with urgency and accountability.

In addition to hunting for new business, this role will manage a portfolio of enterprise accounts, building strategic relationships and proactively identifying opportunities to cross-sell and upsell NiCE Actimize solutions. Success requires a proven ability to win new business, expand existing relationships, uncover customer challenges, and position NiCE Actimize’s solutions to solve critical business problems and deliver measurable value.



How will you make an impact?

- Responsible for achieving annual sales quota and personally negotiating Enterprise-wide agreements.

- Coordinate and lead all sales activities to achieve business goals.

- Ensure the proposed sales and solutions capitalize on NiCE Actimize strengths and can be implemented successfully.

- Establishing new strategic relationships while maintaining existing relationships and analyzing customer’s business situations to identify constraints and new opportunities due to technological advances.

- Develop and maintain high-level relations with ‘C ’levels

- Create and maintain a high-level presence and a network of relationships to facilitate sales. Initiate, support, develop, and monitor purchasing agreements between NiCE Actimize and the customer.



Have you got what it takes?

- 4 + years' experience selling SaaS as an Account Executive. (not Account Management)

- High-profile salesperson with excellent communication and presentation skills

- Proven successful ability to sell $1M Enterprise software/business solutions.

- Ability to develop relationships with the ‘C’ level business users to sell based on business value.

- Ability to interface with Sales Engineers and IT users to understand high-level technical requirements.

- Global vision, creativity, and long-term planning ability required.

- 4 + years’ experience selling Software solutions to the financial services industry is a bonus

- Experience selling or general knowledge of Anti-Money Laundering is a bonus



What’s in it for you?

Join an ever-growing, market-disrupting, global company where the teams – comprised of the best of the best – work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NiCE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate, innovative, and excited to constantly raise the bar, you may just be our next NiCEr!



About NiCE Actimize:

NiCE Actimize is the largest and broadest provider of financial crime, risk, and compliance solutions for regional and global financial institutions, as well as government regulators. Consistently ranked as number one in the space, NiCE Actimize experts apply innovative technology to protect institutions and safeguard consumers and investors’ assets by identifying financial crime, preventing fraud, and providing regulatory compliance.

At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.

Account Executive – Public Safety / 911

Territory: Ohio, Pennsylvania, Update NY, Kentucky, West Virginia

Travel: ~50%



So, what’s the role all about?

This role is responsible for driving net-new business, pipeline growth, and revenue within 911 Emergency Communications Centers and broader Public Safety agencies across a seven-state territory. The Account Executive will own the full sales cycle while acting as a trusted, consultative partner—positioning NiCE’s Public Safety solution portfolio through direct selling, partner collaboration, and solution expertise.

Success in this role requires balancing high-activity territory execution with deep understanding of Public Safety workflows, including 911 and Criminal Justice digital evidence processes, to win complex public-sector opportunities.



Key Responsibilities

Sales & Territory Execution

- Build and execute a strategic territory plan to drive meeting creation, pipeline growth, and revenue.

- Conduct consistent outbound prospecting and account-based outreach to generate first meetings and new opportunities.

- Manage the full sales cycle, including discovery, solution positioning, procurement navigation, and deal close.

- Deliver accurate weekly reporting on activity, pipeline creation, and forecasting.

- Achieve quarterly and annual pipeline and revenue targets.

Public Safety & Customer Engagement

- Develop strong relationships with 911 directors, supervisors, procurement teams, IT leadership, and executive stakeholders.

- Interview and engage multiple user groups within Public Safety agencies to understand operational workflows and challenges.

- Maintain and grow existing customer relationships to maximize long-term revenue and generate referral opportunities.

- Operate with a mission-driven mindset focused on improving staff well-being and operational performance within 911 centers.

Solution & Technical Collaboration

- Act as a solution expert, demonstrating NiCE capabilities and articulating differentiated value versus competitors.

- Conduct needs assessments and solution alignment in collaboration with Presales/Solutions Engineering.

- Support technical responses to RFPs, RFIs, and bids, including development of Scopes of Work (SOWs).

- Collect customer feedback on solution requirements and interface with Product Management on market needs and trends.

- Develop and deliver compelling presentations to end users, partners, consultants, and executive decision-makers.

Partner & Internal Collaboration

- Manage and co-sell with reseller and channel partners to expand territory coverage and accelerate opportunities.

- Collaborate cross-functionally with Marketing, Product Management, Business Development, Project Management, Legal, Professional Services, and Customer Support.

- Participate in marketing campaigns, demos, and demand-generation initiatives.



Required Experience & Skills

- 3–5+ years of technology sales and/or sales engineering experience within Public Safety, 911/PSAP, or Government sectors.

- Strong understanding of Public Safety and Criminal Justice workflows, including digital evidence processes.

- Proven success generating pipeline and closing deals in complex public-sector procurement environments.

- Experience working with government purchasing personnel, RFPs, bids, and state/federal contracts.

- Consultative selling approach with strong discovery, demonstration, and presentation skills.

- High-activity, disciplined sales execution with exceptional work ethic.

- Strong communication, technical aptitude, and creative problem-solving skills.

- Ability to influence senior decision-makers and build trust across multiple stakeholder groups.

Education

- BA/BS in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent experience).



Success Measures

- Weekly meeting creation and pipeline growth targets consistently achieved.

- Healthy, forecastable pipeline aligned to quarterly revenue goals.

- Successful execution of co-selling motions with partners.

- Positive feedback from customers, partners, and internal cross-functional teams.


About NiCE

NICE Ltd. (NASDAQ: NICE) software products are used by 25,000+ global businesses, including 85 of the Fortune 100 corporations, to deliver extraordinary customer experiences, fight financial crime and ensure public safety. Every day, NiCE software manages more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors 3+ billion financial transactions.

Known as an innovation powerhouse that excels in AI, cloud and digital, NiCE is consistently recognized as the market leader in its domains, with over 8,500 employees across 30+ countries.

NiCE is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, neurotype, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other category protected by law.

israel.title: Accounting Manager
israel.description:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.

Accounting Manager – Revenue Accounting

Location: Sandy, UT (Hybrid; 2 days in office / week)

So, what's the role all about?

As an Accounting Manager – Revenue Accounting at NiCE, you'll play a key leadership role in managing revenue accounting operations for a global, publicly traded SaaS company.

You'll lead and develop a team of Senior Accountants supporting the CXone line of business, oversee monthly and quarterly revenue close activities, and ensure accurate revenue recognition and financial reporting in accordance with US GAAP and ASC 606.

This is an opportunity for an experienced revenue accounting professional who enjoys combining technical accounting expertise with team leadership, operational ownership, and continuous improvement. You'll work closely with Finance, accounting leadership, external auditors, and cross-functional business partners to navigate complex revenue arrangements, strengthen accounting processes, and support key financial reporting requirements.

You'll also play an important role in the implementation of a new revenue recognition system, helping modernize processes, improve controls, and introduce greater automation into a growing and evolving accounting function.

Whether you're an experienced Accounting Manager or a Senior Revenue Accountant ready to take the next step in your leadership career, this role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact in a complex, global SaaS environment.

How will you make an impact?

- Lead and develop your team. Manage, mentor, and support a team of Senior Accountants, providing technical guidance, coaching, and oversight of day-to-day revenue accounting activities.

- Own the revenue close process. Lead monthly and quarterly revenue close activities, including reviewing journal entries, account reconciliations, revenue recognition schedules, and financial reporting deliverables to ensure accuracy, completeness, and timeliness.

- Oversee CXone revenue accounting. Take ownership of revenue accounting activities for the CXone line of business, working closely with accounting leadership to maintain consistent processes, strong financial controls, and reliable reporting.

- Apply technical accounting expertise. Provide guidance on complex revenue arrangements, contract reviews, and revenue recognition matters in accordance with ASC 606 and US GAAP.

- Research and document accounting conclusions. Evaluate technical accounting questions, prepare and review accounting memoranda, and support well-reasoned, clearly documented accounting conclusions.

- Support external audits and compliance. Coordinate audit requests, prepare supporting documentation, participate in walkthroughs, and work with external auditors to resolve revenue accounting questions and ensure compliance with public-company reporting requirements.

- Partner across the business. Collaborate with Finance, Accounting, and other cross-functional stakeholders to resolve revenue-related questions, address accounting challenges, and support accurate financial reporting.

- Help modernize revenue accounting systems. Support the implementation of a new revenue recognition system, working with key stakeholders to improve processes, strengthen controls, reduce manual activities, and introduce automation where appropriate.

- Drive operational improvements. Identify opportunities to improve accounting processes, documentation, reporting accuracy, and overall team effectiveness while supporting scalable and sustainable practices.

- Deliver against critical deadlines. Monitor close timelines, anticipate potential challenges, communicate risks proactively, and ensure accounting deliverables meet established deadlines in a fast-paced, publicly traded company environment.

Have you got what it takes?

- 5+ years of progressive accounting experience, including hands-on responsibility for revenue recognition within a SaaS, subscription software, or similarly complex recurring-revenue environment.

- Strong working knowledge of ASC 606, US GAAP, and the accounting principles governing subscription-based and complex software revenue arrangements.

- Experience working within a publicly traded company or similarly complex accounting and financial reporting environment.

- Previous people management experience or demonstrated leadership of accounting teams, processes, or significant accounting workstreams. We welcome candidates who have successfully led others and are ready to take the next step into formal people management.

- Demonstrated experience leading or managing monthly and quarterly accounting close processes, including reviewing journal entries, reconciliations, and revenue accounting schedules.

- Experience researching technical accounting matters, preparing accounting memoranda, documenting conclusions, and supporting accounting positions during external audits.

- Experience collaborating with Finance, Accounting, external auditors, and business stakeholders to resolve accounting questions and meet financial reporting objectives.

- Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

Additional experience that will help you stand out:

- CPA certification.

- Public accounting experience, particularly with a Big 4 accounting firm.

- Previous experience as a Revenue Accounting Manager, Accounting Supervisor, or Senior Revenue Accountant with demonstrated leadership responsibilities.

- Experience supporting ERP implementations, revenue recognition systems, accounting automation, or financial systems transformation initiatives.

- Experience navigating complex revenue arrangements, contract modifications, or multiple-element software and subscription agreements.

Skills and Tools

- Leadership and team development: Ability to coach, mentor, and develop accounting professionals while creating accountability, encouraging collaboration, and maintaining high standards of performance.

- SaaS revenue accounting: Strong technical understanding of ASC 606, subscription and software revenue arrangements, accounting close processes, and financial reporting requirements.

- Technical accounting and judgment: Ability to research complex accounting questions, evaluate alternatives, document conclusions, and communicate accounting guidance clearly.

- Financial systems and analytical skills: Advanced Excel proficiency and experience working with ERP and revenue recognition systems, including reviewing complex accounting schedules and reconciling financial data.

- Process improvement and automation: Comfortable operating in an evolving systems environment, with the ability to improve manual processes through automation, stronger controls, and scalable accounting practices.

- Communication and collaboration: Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to explain accounting matters clearly and work effectively with Finance, external auditors, accounting leadership, and cross-functional business partners.

- Organization and execution: Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to balance competing priorities, anticipate challenges, and consistently meet demanding reporting deadlines.

- Problem-solving and ownership: A proactive approach to identifying accounting issues, investigating discrepancies, recommending solutions, and taking responsibility for accurate, timely results.

israel.title: AI Pre-Sales Engineer
israel.description:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.

So, what’s the role all about?
As part of the Presales team, the AI Presales Engineer will work closely with Sales on discovery calls, technical deep dives, demos, and POCs, acting as a trusted advisor who bridges technology and business value

The Agentic Solution Sales Team combines an overlay and a hunter sales capacity to support advanced, AI solution sales cycles to accompany our CXone platform or be standalone.

The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of advanced digital and AI technologies such as conversational AI, IVA, knowledge management, agent assistance and more.

How will you make an impact?

- Value Selling & Discovery: Partner with account executives to lead technical discovery sessions, identify high-value enterprise AI use cases, and articulate the ROI of automated agents.

- Rapid PoC Building: Design and build functional prototypes and workflow blueprints using n8n and LangChain to visually demonstrate value during the sales cycle.

- Solution Architecture: Translate client requirements into production-ready blueprints featuring RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), semantic search, and secure enterprise app integrations.

- Technical Advisory: Serve as the trusted AI expert for client CTOs, IT directors, and business leaders, confidently handling security, data privacy, and architecture questions.

- Cross-Functional Feedback: Feed field insights and client requirements back into the Product and Engineering teams to influence the core product roadmap.

Have you got what it takes?

- Experience: 4–7 years of experience in a Pre-Sales Engineering, Solutions Architecture, or Technical Consulting role, with a strong focus on automation or generative AI solutions.

- Technical Comprehension: Deep conceptual and practical understanding of the AI ecosystem: workflow orchestration (n8n), LLM application frameworks (LangChain/LangGraph), and RAG pipelines.

- Value-Driven Mindset: Proven track record of value selling—translating technical features (like chunking, vector databases, or agents) into business outcomes (cost reduction, speed, risk mitigation).

- Communication & Presentation: Exceptional ability to deliver highly engaging product demonstrations and present complex architectures simply to C-level executives.

- Light Coding Capabilities: Proficient enough in Python or JavaScript to build quick connectors, parse JSON schemas, and ensure reliable api tool-calling in demos.

What’s in it for you?
Join an ever-growing, market disrupting, global company where the teams – comprised of the best of the best – work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NiCE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate, innovative, and excited to constantly raise the bar, you may just be our next NiCEr!

Enjoy NICE-FLEX!
At NiCE, we work according to the NiCE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. Naturally, office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere.

israel.description:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.

This position reports to our clients office in NYC and you'd be required to report to their office 4x a week. You will not be reporting to the NiCE Hoboken, NJ office.

The Dedicated Support Engineer (DSE) is a technical expert within NICE’s Technical Support organization, responsible for delivering proactive, and reactive support to large enterprise customers. Acting as a trusted advisor and technical liaison, the DSE ensures seamless incident resolution, system stability, and continuous improvement across customer environments.

This role combines deep technical troubleshooting with strategic customer engagement, cross-functional collaboration, and operational excellence. The DSE supports managed services customers with a focus on incident management, change control, compliance, and governance.



Key Responsibilities

1. Incident & Problem Management

- Serve as the primary contact for customer-raised incidents and service disruptions.

- Perform advanced troubleshooting across platforms including NICE, Avaya, Microsoft Teams, and more.

- Escalate complex issues to higher tier/vendors and drive resolution to closure.

- Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for recurring issues and share insights with stakeholders.

- Ensure all incidents are resolved within agreed SLAs and maintain high CSAT.

2. Change & Release Management

- Plan, test, and implement approved changes such as patches, upgrades, and configuration updates.

- Participate in CAB meetings, presenting impact and risk assessments.

- Ensure rollback strategies are documented and ready for critical changes.

- Maintain detailed documentation and implementation guides.

3. Monitoring & Preventive Maintenance

- Monitor system health and NICE monitoring.

- Conduct regular health checks and share proactive reports with customers.

- Identify performance bottlenecks and initiate preventive actions.

- Validate backup integrity, disaster recovery readiness, and patch compliance.



4. General Provisioning & Access Requests

- Provisioning of new user/agent IDs in recording platforms.

- Assigning/adjusting recording profiles (voice, chat, screen).

- Provisioning access roles (e.g., Compliance Officer, Supervisor, Playback user).

- Profile setup for compliance/legal teams.



5. Compliance & Audit Support

- Ensure recording systems (voice/chat/video) meet regulatory and business compliance standards.

- Provide audit artifacts such as ticket logs, configuration snapshots, uptime reports, and RCA documentation.
