israel.title: Analyst, Transportation & Supply Chain Strategy
israel.location: Atlanta, Georgia, United States; Bellevue, Washington, United States; Chicago, Illinois, United States; Dallas, Texas, United States; Los Angeles, California, United States; New York City, New York, United States
israel.description:
About Flexport:

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

The Opportunity

We're looking for an Analyst who thrives at the intersection of transportation economics, supply chain strategy, and quantitative modeling. This is a high-visibility individual contributor role—you won't be managing people, you'll be doing the work that directly shapes our network design, carrier strategy, and cost structure.  In this role, you will not just build models, but proactively identify high-impact cost-saving and optimization opportunities, transforming raw analysis into business-critical strategy.Your analysis will inform senior leadership decisions on carrier RFPs, zone skip expansion, FC location strategy, and how we price and position our fulfillment product against competitors. You'll partner closely with carrier ops managers, supply chain leadership, data science, and commercial teams to turn complex data into clear, actionable recommendations.

You Will

- Own lane analysis and zone skip strategy including lane-level margin modeling, utilization thresholds, go/no-go decision frameworks for trailer dispatch, and identification of new lane opportunities across our middle mile and deep injection network.

- Drive Cross-Functional Execution: Translate complex operational and network simulations into structured project plans; partner closely with Product and Engineering teams to scale standalone analytical tools into platform-native features.

- Build cost models and simulations that forecast the financial and service impact of network changes before they go live—new zone skip lanes, carrier mix shifts, rate card scenarios, schedule changes, and FC expansion. Your models will be the analytical foundation for major capital and operational decisions.

- Conduct shipment and transportation cost analysis including label cost trends, carrier overpayment identification, rate shopping effectiveness, and per-shipment margin by merchant, lane, and carrier—surfacing where cost is leaking and quantifying the opportunity to recover it.

- Support carrier RFP and network strategy by modeling rate card scenarios, benchmarking carrier economics across lanes and geographies, and building the analytical case for carrier mix decisions and contract negotiations.

- Conduct supply chain analysis including inbound flow modeling, FC throughput and capacity analysis, and demand-driven network planning inputs to support inventory positioning and FC capacity planning.

- Support network and location analysis to evaluate fulfillment center and sort center placement, injection point optimization, and the cost impact of serving different geographies from different nodes—helping us understand where to route volume to minimize transportation cost while maintaining service commitments.

- Build reporting and business intelligence for carrier ops managers and transportation leadership—translating complex operational data into clear dashboards covering OTD, TNT performance, trailer utilization, and lane-level economics.

- Drive cross-functional transportation initiatives as a project lead: defining scope, aligning stakeholders across carrier ops, engineering, finance, and commercial teams, and managing workstreams from analysis through implementation.

- Produce competitive and strategic analysis on how Flexport's transportation network and product compare to the market—including how peers productize services like zone skipping—and build the analytical case for strategic shifts in our commercial offering.

- Team Mentorship: Act as a technical and domain mentor, helping scale team capabilities in SQL best practices, data modeling frameworks, AI usage and effective stakeholder communication.

You Should Have

- 3–6 years of experience in supply chain analytics, transportation strategy, network design, or a closely related analytical role.

- Strong quantitative skills—you're comfortable building financial models, running scenario analysis, and designing simulations that inform network or operational decisions.

- Proficiency in SQL; experience querying large operational datasets in tools like Snowflake, Redshift, or BigQuery.

- Advanced Data Visualization: Strong proficiency with BI and data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, PowerBI) to build automated, executive-ready dashboards. Experience with Python or R for predictive modeling is a plus.

- Experience with transportation or supply chain economics: shipping cost structures, carrier rate cards, zone-based pricing, network cost modeling, or equivalent.

- Supply chain or network economics—you have a solid understanding of freight procurement frameworks, carrier bid structures, or data-driven RFP evaluation models.

- A track record of translating complex, multi-source data into clear recommendations that leadership actually acts on.

- Strong project management instincts—you can own an analytical initiative end-to-end, drive cross-functional alignment, and deliver without needing close direction.

- Excellent communication skills; you can present nuanced quantitative analysis simply and confidently to senior operational and commercial audiences.

- Experience working in highly ambiguous operational environments—you're comfortable navigating fragmented or incomplete datasets and confidently making data-driven recommendations.

Bonus Points

- Experience with zone skip, middle mile, parcel carrier networks, or last mile logistics.

- Familiarity with rate shopping logic, fulfillment network simulation, or carrier rate card structures.

- Python or R skills for advanced modeling, automation, or data pipeline work.

- Background at a 3PL, e-commerce fulfillment company, carrier, or supply chain consulting firm.

- Experience with BI tools such as Metabase, Looker, or Tableau for operational reporting.

- Exposure to location optimization or facility network modeling.

israel.description:
About Flexport:

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

The opportunity

Join the Office of the CEO and work directly on Flexport's highest-priority problems alongside the CEO, the President, and the leaders who run our regions and modes of freight. You will pick up a mode or a region, ocean, air, trucking, omnichannel, or customs, and learn it from the inside by solving real problems in it. Pricing in a mode that is losing money. Why a region misses its plan. Whether we buy, build, or partner.

Then you go run part of it. Some people in this role move into a business unit as the number two to the leader who runs it. Some stay at the center and take on more scope. The operating job at the end is the point of the role, not a side benefit.

You will:

- Own our biggest open questions end to end and come back with recommendations the CEO can act on.

- Build the analysis yourself. Pull the data, build the model, find the error before someone else does.

- Go to where the work happens, from warehouses and ports to a customer's supply chain team. Opinions about freight formed in a conference room are usually wrong.

- Run the operating cadence for a freight mode or region. Weekly metrics, quarterly plan, and the follow-ups nobody wants to chase.

- Get things unstuck, which often means finding the four people who need to agree and getting them in a room.

- Use AI on everything and automate your own job as you learn it.

You should have:

- 4 to 6 years in investment banking, private equity, management consulting, a high-growth operating role, or running your own company. Founders who shut it down are welcome. Tell us what broke.

- The ability to build a financial model from a blank sheet and defend every cell.

- A track record of taking an ambiguous problem, doing the research, and turning it into a recommendation a senior leader can act on.

- Relentless curiosity about how physical goods move. Freight is messy, old, and full of edge cases. That should sound interesting to you, not tedious.

- Clear, short writing and the judgment to influence people more senior than you.

- A compliance first attitude. We operate in a heavily regulated industry and our regulators matter to us.

This is not for you if:

- You want to stay in strategy. Every one of these seats is a path into an operating job.

- You need a fixed scope. The scope changes when the business changes.

- You want to work remotely. You need to be in the room.

You will get:

- Direct exposure to the CEO and the executive team from week one.

- A real operating job at the end of it, not a vague promise.

- The fastest way we know to learn how global trade actually works.

Flexport is experiencing massive growth with 2000+ Flexporters across 40+ global offices and warehouses. And we’re just getting started. With revenue growing at breakneck speed, Flexport is looking for a Global Customs Associate to join our Customs Team in Amsterdam. This is a great position for hard-working, detail-oriented professionals looking to develop their career in the international trade industry.  You'll be working alongside and learning from some of the smartest people in the logistics industry as we challenge the status quo and reduce the friction in global trade.

You Will:

- Digitally prepare and file all documentation required to customs clear goods (import & export)

- Review and organize incoming documents to ensure compliance with EU Customs Regulations

- Classify products as necessary using GRIs

- Identify the potential for the use of a Preferential Trade Agreement on a per shipment basis

- Maintain excellent working relationship with clients by providing customer service that exceeds client expectations

You Should Have:

- 2-5 years current experience in customs

- Dutch is a plus

- Ability to handle a large volume of entries

- Familiarity with Customs product classification and rulings

- Excellent communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills

- Next-level logistical problem-solving skills

- An obsession with client happiness. You succeed when they succeed

- Courage to challenge the status quo when logic and reason require it. See something broken? Fix it

- High level of computer literacy. No paper. All digital

- An opportunity to contribute to one of the fastest-growing companies, where you’ll have the chance to create a global impact while being a part of a  thriving multinational environment

- Daily catered lunches incl. vegetarian options, breakfast, snacks and soft drinks available in our office on daily basis

- Commute expenses: Flexport will cover  home-office commuting costs for employees living outside of Amsterdam

- 25 working days as vacation days based on full time employment.

Lead complex client partnerships and set the standard for strategic account management.



The opportunity:

The Sales team at Flexport is critical to our mission, fostering deep, lasting relationships that drive client success and accelerate global trade. As an Account Executive III (Farmer), you own some of Flexport's most complex and highest-opportunity client relationships in North America. Your accounts span multiple shipping modes and trade lanes — ocean, air, trucking, customs — and require genuine supply chain expertise to navigate well. You don't just manage these relationships; you shape them. You bring a strategic point of view to every client engagement, lead business reviews that drive meaningful decisions, and connect the dots across Flexport's full product suite to unlock growth. You operate with full autonomy, deliver against a high bar on revenue and retention, and are increasingly the person junior teammates turn to when they need guidance.



You will:

- Own end-to-end success for a portfolio of complex, multi-modal Flexport accounts in North America — including accounts with significant revenue potential and high operational intensity.

- Lead RFP bids and renewals end-to-end

- Serve as a true strategic partner to clients, going deep on their supply chain operations to identify where Flexport can unlock efficiency, reduce cost, or introduce new capabilities.

- Lead high-impact business reviews (QBRs/MBRs) that go beyond reporting — you bring market context, multi-modal insights, and tailored recommendations that shift how clients think about their supply chain.

- Drive cross-sell and upsell across Flexport's full product suite, consistently meeting or exceeding revenue and retention targets.

- Collaborate with Operations, Pricing, Procurement, Product, and Sales on solutions that require internal alignment and creative problem-solving.

- Help mentor and coach Account Executive I and Account Executive II teammates — sharing playbooks, joining key client calls, and helping the team raise its game.



You should have:

- 5+ years of experience in account management, client success, or a similar client-facing role; logistics, supply chain, or SaaS background strongly preferred.

- A proven track record of independently managing and growing a complex, multi-product book of business — your accounts are more demanding and your results reflect it.

- Deep understanding of global trade and supply chain operations across multiple modes; you can speak fluently about ocean, air, trucking, and customs.

- Demonstrated ability to operate without a playbook in ambiguous or novel situations — and the judgment to write the playbook for others after you've solved it.

- Strong commercial instincts: you see growth opportunities before clients ask for them and you close them.

- A natural tendency to develop others — peers and junior teammates get better from working alongside you.

- A 'compliance first' attitude to keep our regulators happy and enthusiastic about Flexport since we operate in a heavily regulated industry.



You will get:

- Ownership of Flexport's most complex and exciting client relationships — the accounts where the biggest impact gets made.

- A visible role in shaping how the Sales team operates: your judgment and approach set the standard.

- Opportunities to contribute to team playbooks, onboarding content, and process improvements.

- Competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and a vibrant company culture.

The Opportunity:

Flexport's Global Operations team is the front line team responsible for successfully managing our Customer’s supply chains end to end. To achieve this, the Global Operations team is at the heart of delighting our customers, managing our partners and working closely with our technology partners to drive innovation through process automation. With our focus on developing a global network, our operational teams are strategically located across the world to manage and execute our services and products offered to our customers and partners. Flexport Global Operations raises the bar by using data to manage our customer’s supply chains and identifies opportunities to improve fidelity in planning, responsiveness and overall execution.

The Global Operations Associate is responsible for the ownership and execution of the end-to-end movement of global shipments within a regional network including Ocean less than and full container load (LCL and FCL), Ocean imports and Air imports and exports. This role will focus on driving a first in class customer experience by obsessing over quality and on time performance.

As a new team member in our North American Operations group, you'll begin by immersing yourself in our company culture and mastering world-class operations. As Flexport continues to grow, there could be opportunities for future Flexporters to become founding team members in new markets, relocate internationally, and help us expand our presence around the world. - Be the “front line” to ensure the highest standard of Flexport quality: shipments move on-time and exceptions are handled appropriately.

- Be responsible for ensuring your work satisfies internal KPIs and SLAs that demonstrate quality delivery.

- Follow standard operating procedures (SOP)

- Own the client experience; solving client issues quickly and ensuring smooth operations at origin and destination, escalating issues as needed.

- Seamlessly coordinate day-to-day logistics operations with internal and external partners such as steamship lines, air carriers, intermodal and drayage vendors, customs, trade lane management, warehousing, transloading, trucking, and the air operations team.

- Quote and invoice client shipments with responsibility to their P&L

- Participate in QBR and MBR presentation prep as well as hold client operational calls when deemed necessary

You should have:

- 2+ years of experience in logistics, freight forwarding, supply chain, ocean carrier operations, or consulting (ocean freight knowledge is a plus)

- Bachelor’s Degree preferred

- Able to adapt to new technology and can thrive in a fast-paced environment

- Effective time management - be able to properly prioritize and manage a large volume of tasks

- Attention to detail

- Ability to effectively seek and receive feedback

- Effective communication both verbally and in writing in client facing interactions

- Teamwork and relationship-building

- Orientation towards working smarter and adopting best practices and standardization

- Problem-solving capabilities

- Fluent in English

- A "compliance first" attitude to keep our regulators happy and enthusiastic about Flexport since we operate in a heavily regulated industry.

israel.description:
About Flexport:

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

Help Win New Business

The Opportunity:

We are scaling our dedicated Data Center practice, and we are looking for the person who will lead it. This is a founding commercial role. You will start as a team of one, owning the full sales motion end-to-end, and you will build the team around you as the practice grows. You will define how Flexport goes to market with hyperscalers, hardware OEMs, and the broader ecosystem. You will set the playbook, win the first marquee accounts, and hire the people who scale what you build. Reporting directly to the Regional General Manager, you will operate with a high degree of autonomy and direct access to executive leadership.

This role features a 50/50 compensation model (Base + Uncapped bonus, with accelerators), with OTEs of $500k+, designed for strong leaders who take bets on themselves.

Why This Role Is Different:

The data center logistics market is not a standard freight problem. A single AI compute rack can cost more than $1 million and weigh up to 4,000 pounds. Racks contain Class 9 dangerous goods (lithium-ion batteries) and liquid cooling systems requiring specialized handling. Construction sequencing failures delayed 57% of data center projects in 2025, meaning late freight isn’t just expensive, it can stop an entire build.

Flexport has built the capabilities this market demands:

- 98%+ air on-time performance for Fortune 500 data center customers, achieved through dedicated ground setups that pick up directly from the tarmac at major hubs.

- White glove project management for complex deliveries—including Next Flight Out (NFO), 747-400F charter solutions for oversized equipment, and highly orchestrated last-mile delivery to active construction sites.

- TAPA Level A, CTPAT, and Dangerous Goods certifications, with full CCTV warehouse coverage and shock, tilt, and temperature monitoring across all major hubs.

- $900M+ saved in tariff exposure for customers over five years, with an AI-powered customs auditor that error-checks 100% of filings prior to submission—achieving a 0.2% error rate, roughly ten times better than the industry average.

- A 24/7 digital control tower giving customers and their supply chain partners real-time visibility, milestone tracking, and proactive exception management.

You Will:

- Own the full commercial motion for Flexport’s Data Center practice: from pipeline generation through close and expansion.

- Build, inspire, and ultimately lead a high-performing sales team as the practice scales, including hiring, onboarding, coaching, and developing Account Executives.

- Define and execute a go-to-market strategy targeting hyperscalers, co-location providers, OEM hardware manufacturers, and EPC contractors across North America.

- Establish and drive specific, targeted revenue goals and quotas; monitor and manage key performance metrics to ensure consistent performance.

- Partner closely with Flexport’s operations teams and product teams to design and deliver mission-critical solutions.

- Represent Flexport externally as a subject-matter authority in data center logistics: at industry events, in RFP processes, and in senior customer conversations.

- Take an entrepreneurial approach: you are building something new inside a company with global scale, and you will bring both the vision and the execution.

You Should Have:

- 10+ years of overall professional experience, including direct experience selling complex, high-value logistics or supply chain solutions to Fortune 500 customers.

- Deep familiarity with the data center, hyperscaler, co-location, or critical infrastructure ecosystem, either through direct sales, account management, or operational roles.

- A demonstrated track record as a top-performing individual contributor and, ideally, early-stage team builder: you know what it takes to close, and you know how to build a team that closes.

- The instincts and resilience to operate as a team of one while building toward scale.

- Strong consultative selling skills, with the ability to navigate complex, multi-stakeholder deals involving procurement, operations, logistics, and executive leadership.

- Excellent analytical and commercial judgment: you can build and manage a pipeline, forecast accurately, and make strategic tradeoffs.

- Exceptional communication skills and the ability to earn trust at every level, from AE to C-suite.

- A “compliance first” attitude to keep our regulators happy and enthusiastic about Flexport since we operate in a heavily regulated industry.

You Will Get:

- A 50/50 compensation model (base + uncapped bonus and accelerators) built for closers who bet on themselves.

- Equity grants and comprehensive benefits.

- Founding-level autonomy and direct access to executive leadership.

- The mandate to build and lead the team as the practice scales.

israel.description:
About Flexport:

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

Build the solutions to help Flexport grow

The Ecosystem team’s mission is to make information exchange in global trade easy for everyone by efficiently, securely and reliably connecting the Flexport Platform with the external Global Trade Ecosystem.

The opportunity

We are looking for a talented Integration Support Engineer to join our team! In this role you will be supporting the integrations built to help exchange data between Flexport and our customers and partners.. You will serve as an SME for customers utilizing our self-service API’s, providing technical team members with business knowledge to help us solve our customers API issues..

Integrating our best in class platform seamlessly with our logistics partners is a critical component of our strategy. Our integrated solutions bring end to end automation in the information exchange that is required between us and our partners, eliminating slow and error prone manual workflows. This requires the Flexport platform to be fully integrated with customers and any third party systems our customer uses. The success of our team is measured by the extent to which information exchange between Flexport and our customers is reliably and effectively automated, reducing cost to serve for our operations teams.

We’re looking for an organized and motivated person to ensure inbound requests are triaged quickly and efficiently, owning all communications with major stakeholders including customers, engineers and platform teams. In addition, you’ll work closely with Solutions Engineers and Solutions Consultants to identify process improvements that will maximize the efficiency of the integration support team.



You will serve as a technical anchor for our production environment. You will go beyond basic triage to lead deep-dive technical investigations, implement code or configuration enhancements, and collaborate cross-functionally to improve the scalability of our ecosystem. You are expected to manage complex stakeholder relationships and act as a subject matter expert (SME) for our integration suite.

You will

- Proactively support the integrations running in our production environment. This would include monitoring and triaging the inbound requests, providing support for integration issues, owning investigations end to end and contributing to the integration support knowledge base. Drive end-to-end resolution for high-priority production incidents, perform root cause analysis (RCA) and implement permanent fixes or workarounds.

- Partner with internal operations, business and technical teams to drive the success rate of these integrations to help bring maximum value to our customers. Lead meetings with customers/third parties by involving required internal team members to help resolve any issues.

- Identify and execute improvement enhancements within the integrations or surface platform level improvements.

- Work as a technical expert in the logistics space, EDI standards being used by our larger partners for logistics data, Boomi (our iPaaS), and Flexport public (and private) APIs and develop a deep understanding of new and existing integrations.

- Partner closely with Product and Engineering teams to transition new integrations from "build" to "support." Act as the voice of the customer to influence the product roadmap based on recurring support trends.

- Work efficiently to contribute to a high success rate across all support SLAs by identifying opportunities to optimize existing processes as well as product inefficiencies and also help educate our users on best practice guidelines and overall integration success guidelines

- Lead technical calls with high-value customers and third-party vendors. You will translate complex technical EDI/API issues into actionable business insights for non-technical stakeholders.

- Create and maintain required charts, dashboards to monitor the health of integrations

- Ensure the team meets or exceeds SLAs, taking ownership of the most challenging tickets while identifying systemic bottlenecks in the support workflow.

- Share insights and lessons learned about the integration issues you come across with your Flexport Ecosystem peers to continuously improve our processes and efficiency

You should have

- Bachelor's degree in a technical field and relevant work experience of minimum 3-5 years of relevant experience in systems integration, technical support, or implementation engineering.

- Good knowledge of APIs (REST/SOAP) and EDI standards.

- You should be comfortable reading logs, querying databases, and understanding the flow of data through complex distributed systems.

- Experience with data analytics, data manipulation and systems integration involving various data formats using different connectivity methods.

- Experience with SQL and at least one scripting or programming language (e.g., JavaScript, Typescript, Python, or Groovy) or Integration platforms like Boomi, Mulesoft, Webmethods etc to assist in data manipulation or small code changes.

- Experience using various tools to debug/monitor the transactions like postman, SQL clients, reporting tools like looker and experience working with AWS infrastructure including EC2, S3, SQS and others.

- Experience working with AI/LLMs to debug/triage issues, generate reports etc.

- Ability to effectively support integrations between Flexport and our customers to achieve a high success rate of these integrations. Work with various internal teams and external partners. Should have passion for helping our users excel with our integrations, offering best practice guidance when opportunities arise

- Ability to prioritize, focus, and adhere to support SLAs and should be able to manage multiple priorities and tickets with organizational and time-management skills

- Strong analytical and problem solving skills paired with a persistent, proactive, results-oriented mindset, excellent verbal and written communication

- Initiative and positive attitude with a desire to learn and seek answers independently and curiosity to explore the technical side of supply chain / logistics industry

Bonus points if you have

- Deep understanding of logistics business logic (Shipments, Orders, Invoices) and specific EDI sets (e.g., 850, 856, 214, 315).

- iPaaS Expertise: Certified or highly experienced in Boomi (highly preferred), MuleSoft, or Workato.

You will own credit and collections for Flexport across Asia Pacific and be the partner to APAC leadership and every country leader on customer risk. You will take Flexport’s global credit framework and adapt it to APAC, tailoring policy, terms and limits to each market’s practices and making sure the business applies them consistently. You will also run collections for the region, keeping receivables current and cash coming in. As Flexport expands across APAC, you will extend this framework to new countries, supported by the automation and risk tools developed by our US Corporate Credit team.

If you want to protect Flexport’s capital while helping the business win more trade in Asia, you belong here.

Scope:

- Regional Ownership: Manage Flexport’s credit and collections function across Asia Pacific, covering every market where we operate.

- Expansion Support: Support Flexport’s growth across the region, rolling out credit for new countries, entities and products as they launch.

- Policy Localization: Adapt Flexport’s global credit policy and processes to APAC markets, adding country-specific rules where local practice requires it.

- Function Building: Scale a robust credit function in the region, from decisioning and monitoring to collections and reporting.

You Will:

- Localize Credit Policy: Apply Flexport’s global credit framework to each APAC country and adapt it to local legal, regulatory, tax, currency and payment practices

- Partner with APAC Leadership: Serve as the credit partner to APAC leadership and each country leader. Align credit strategy with commercial goals, present portfolio risk, and make clear, timely calls on high-impact requests.

- Own the APAC Portfolio: Monitor exposure, aging and concentration, and spot emerging risk early so issues are handled before accounts go past due.

- Lead Regional Collections: Own collections across APAC, from dunning strategy and past-due follow-up to payment plans, dispute resolution and escalation to external agencies or legal partners. Work with country teams to keep DSO and past-due balances within target.

- Adopt US-Built Automation: Work with the US Corporate Credit and Credit Science teams to deploy credit scoring, monitoring and workflow tools in APAC. Define local requirements and drive adoption with country teams.

- Apply Freight Forwarding Practice: Bring proven methods for managing credit with shippers, consignees, overseas agents and carriers, including duties, outlays, freight collect and cargo-release controls.

- Manage External Partners: Own relationships with local credit bureaus, credit insurers, banks and collection or legal partners across the region.

- Report and Govern: Deliver regular APAC portfolio reviews to regional and global Finance leadership, and keep the region compliant with policy and ready for audit.

You Should Have:

Hard Skills

- 10+ years of experience in commercial credit and collections, with at least 5 years leading credit and collections across multiple APAC countries.

- Industry: Freight forwarding, logistics or shipping credit experience strongly preferred.

- Policy Implementation: Proven record of rolling out and adapting credit policy across several jurisdictions.

- Collections: Track record of running collections and reducing past-due balances and DSO.

- Regional Knowledge: Working knowledge of credit, collections and enforcement practices across APAC markets.

- Financial Judgment: Sound financial statement analysis and judgment on complex or high-exposure accounts. Comfortable making decisions from data and automated tools; coding not required.

- Languages: Fluent English. Mandarin or Cantonese preferred; other APAC languages a plus.

- Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting or Business (required). MBA, CPA or credit certification are a plus.

Soft Skills

- Executive Presence: Able to influence senior commercial leaders and country managers, and to say no when the risk isn’t right.

- Cross-Cultural Leadership: Builds trust with teams across very different markets and business cultures.

- Ownership: Takes full accountability for the region with little direction.

- Communication: A clear, persuasive communicator, both written and verbal, at every level of the organization.

- Flexibility: Willing to travel across APAC and work across US and EU time zones.

- Collaboration: A team player who makes cross-functional partners better.

Why Flexport:

You’ll join a credit team that operates with the agility of a startup and the data advantage of a global logistics leader. You’ll lead credit and collections for one of Flexport’s most important regions, building on an established global framework and automation already built for you to deploy, with direct access to APAC and global Finance leadership. If that’s the kind of impact you’re after, let’s talk.

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

The Opportunity:

To support our continued global expansion and enhance our ocean freight operations, we are seeking a Manager of Regional Ocean Management to oversee a multi-million dollar Ocean P&L for their district. This role is crucial for scaling volume, increasing yield, and driving profitability through expert market knowledge and strategic interfacing with customers. The position requires designing tailored products, managing tenders and RFQs, and collaborating with procurement and pricing teams to identify growth opportunities. By improving operational and financial processes and leveraging data for decision-making, the Manager will ensure financial health and drive the growth of the book of business.

You will:

- Manage a sizeable Ocean P&L for your district through scaling volume and increasing yield

- Be the market expert and support the commercial organization with market-specific intelligence, trade idiosyncrasies, and directly interfacing with customer

- Help design products and generate customized go-to-market strategies for customers

- Own tenders and RFQs for your district to secure regional and global customers

- Interface with procurement and pricing teams to drive profitable business, identify growth opportunities, and capture market-specific knowledge

- Identify and drive improvement in go-to-market, operational, and financial processes

- Build and own P&L review and actively participate in book of business growth rhythms

- Use data to drive decisions

- Help drive near and long term district forecasting

- Join on a regular basis client calls

- Drive all financial health levers for your district including quoting, invoicing, and dispute escalation

- Develop your team to create the future of Flexport district management

- Work across Procurement, Pricing, Planning, and District Management teams to deliver globally optimized results to the Ocean P&L

You should have:

- 5+ years of prior Ocean Freight experience at a top freight forwarder or carrier or 5+ years of supply chain experience and a BA/BS Degree;

- Strategic vision and ground floor execution;

- Bias to Action, Process, Structure and Data;

- Excellent communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills;

- An obsession with client happiness. You succeed when they succeed;

- Ability to travel regionally;

- Courage to challenge the status quo when logic and reason require it. See something broken? Fix it;

- The desire to lead, train, and develop up-and-coming talent in the future

#LI-Onsite

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

The Opportunity

The Ocean team at Flexport works globally to make sure all business moves smoothly and our ocean product is the best it can be for our clients.  Our Ocean Procurement Team is essential to winning new business, supporting all current business, and building out the future of Flexport’s ocean services.

As a Procurement Manager, you’ll be an integral part of helping achieve Flexport’s growth goals. It’s a face-paced and integral position for both winning new business, and supporting our current book of business. This role is focused on the Transpacific-Eastbound (TPEB) trade. A successful procurement manager will need to communicate market developments and strategy to a broad range of colleagues, negotiate freight rates, be willing and able to dig into the weeds of pricing / contract nuances, manage carrier relationships, and represent Flexport commercially.

You Will

- Drive all things ocean carrier procurement for TPEB and take direct responsibility for carrier development and partnership on the respective trade, demonstrating Flexport’s competitive advantages

- Coordinate and negotiate annual, quarterly, monthly, and weekly procurement activities

- Build scalable procurement operating rhythms and tools, including working directly with internal contract tools for cost and pricing management

- Lead rate setting and strategy for RFP season on the trade

- Work closely with commercial Ocean and demand teams to win new business and execute for current book of business

- Educate and enable the broader Flexport organization with carrier and tradelane intelligence to foster better decision making, client engagement and growing the trade

- Lead regular cross team meetings

- Work collaboratively with colleagues in Asia to execute trade strategy and fulfillment

- Dive into escalations both in Asia and in the U.S. to keep our business moving

You Should Have

- 7+ years of prior Ocean procurement experience at a top freight forwarder or trade experience at a carrier or 7+ years of supply chain experience and a BA/BS Degree;

- Strategic vision and continuous desire to improve–get into the weeds and build process from ground-up when needed

- Strong negotiation skills

- Excellent communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills;

- Desire to build / scale ocean business

- Ability to travel regionally and internationally

- People management experience desired (but not required)

- A "compliance first" attitude to keep our regulators happy and enthusiastic about Flexport since we operate in a heavily regulated industry.

Your responsibilities as a Marketing Manager APAC include, but are not limited to the following:

About the role

As the first dedicated owner for brand awareness, thought leadership, and media/PR in APAC, you will have the unique opportunity to establish new ground and build our regional presence from the bottom up. We're hiring a Marketing Manager to close that gap: a generalist across content, events, and media who can stand up APAC's top-of-funnel engine and build a credible local media presence, working closely with global marketing and regional business teams.

What You’ll do:

- Develop and execute an integrated, multi-channel APAC marketing strategy spanning events, media/PR, and content, aligned with global brand goals and regional growth priorities.

- Plan and execute APAC event presence across industry conferences, field/partner events, and high-touch client gatherings, managing end-to-end logistics, messaging, and follow-up.

- Lead the end-to-end lifecycle of our regional webinar and event programming, collaborating with global and regional stakeholders to drive targeted attendee engagement.

- Define and own APAC's media and PR strategy: establish press relationships, evaluate paid media channels, and build country-by-country distribution plans across target markets.

- Produce targeted regional content—including articles, social campaigns, and sales enablement assets—tailored to key sub-regions (South East Asia, Greater China, Indian Sub Continent, and Oceania).

- Evaluate and manage external partners, including regional PR agencies, event vendors, and media outlets, to expand our brand footprint.

- Identify and test market-specific advertising and sponsorship opportunities to build local brand awareness and support lead generation.

- Utilize marketing automation tools and CRM systems to build campaign landing pages, manage lead flows, and measure event and channel performance.

- Monitor market trends and campaign analytics to continually refine regional marketing tactics across events, media, and digital channels.

- Identify market-specific advertising opportunities to increase brand awareness.

What You'll bring

- Experience running B2B content, field, or demand-gen marketing in a fast-moving, multi-market environment.

- Working knowledge of media and PR - comfortable defining press targets and a distribution strategy, not just executing campaigns.

- Marketing Automation & CRM: Hands-on proficiency with Salesforce and Salesforce Account Engagement (Pardot) (or similar platforms like HubSpot/Marketo), including lead scoring, nurturing, and funnel optimization.

- Analytics & Reporting: Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets with a strong ability to build dashboards, track ROI, and analyze campaign performance metrics.

- Exposure to more than one APAC market and an instinct for where content and channels need to flex by country.

- A generalist mindset - happy moving between content, events, and media in a single week, and comfortable with ambiguity.

- Excellent English (spoken & written); additional APAC language skills a plus for localised content and YouTube/video work.

- Stakeholder Management: Strong interpersonal skills to collaborate seamlessly with regional GMs, global US teams, sales leaders, and external vendors.

israel.description:
About Flexport:

We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

Market Performance Associate - Ocean Gateway

Description:

As the Market Performance Associate for Ocean Gateway, you will be responsible for the ground performance strategy and planning within your assigned markets. Your main objective is to achieve over 95% destination On-Time Performance (OTP) by proactively managing all operational elements, including terminals, Shipping Line (SSL) carriers, rail providers, warehouses, and truckers, to consistently meet our Service Level Agreements (SLAs).

A key part of this role involves driving exceptional vendor performance. You will coach vendors, serve as their primary escalation point, and act as a technical support liaison. Additionally, you will collaborate with the Trucking Procurement team to adjust volume allocations and provide insights into trucking market needs, which will help prioritize onboarding efforts. Working within Ocean Gateway, you will maintain close ties with your Gateway Execution peers, gathering crucial feedback directly from the operators who handle the containers.

You will

- Develop and own vendor relationships, ensuring we have drayage partners in place that will support growth and deliver a best-in-class service for our customers.

- Develop dashboards to measure trucking SLAs: Work cross functionally with business leads to help them set and achieve key results.

- Manage performance reporting at a market and vendor level, including inbound forecasting, milestone reporting, timely pickup and delivery.

- Provide Product Support to drayage carriers by onboarding, training and continuously coaching dispatchers on Transmission.

- Trucker Assignment Inputs: Provide detailed feedback and recommendations to ensure drayage market allocations leverage top performing carriers.

- Oversee successful implementation of new FCL/LCL destination business, by way of proper carrier selection, SOP development, and intimate shipment monitoring.

- Navigate service escalations alongside Gateway Operator peers to keep freight moving and deliver a positive client experience.

You should have

- BA/BS degree and/or 2+ years of experience in relevant freight forwarding, transportation or supply chain rolesExcellent communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills

- In depth knowledge of product and technology within the industry, experience building product and partnering with product teams to deliver innovative and unique solutions

- Industry expert for knowledge on ground transportation, experience with regards to imports and/or exports from a sales, operational and procurement perspective.

- Experience building and maintaining strong relationships and partnerships with vendors.

- Analytical skills and metric / data based approach to solving problems, drives organization by numbers/metrics.

- Strong analytical background and knowledge of analytical tools (Excel, etc)

- Strategic vision and ground floor execution

- Experience with SQL, Looker, and Snowflake, including data manipulation and dashboard/report building.

Partner Performance Management

This role is designed to problem solve impactful operational challenges as part of our Global team while developing specialized expertise in supply chain operations. As the person who executes service delivery for our clients, you have the unique opportunity to help your regional account team spot opportunities to improve and grow our customers’ business. Scope of Duties:

- Execute booking and documentation processes with clients /carriers

- Timely shipment troubleshooting and exception escalation / handling

- Work intimately with Flexport AM, Planning team to ensure an effective end to end export process.

- Coach junior specialists on the daily job.

- Plan and execute special freight operations (i.e. DG, reefer, etc).

- Assist Sr. Associate on new business/process implementation, new projects and new tasks.

- Support internal and external clients to make the best decision with your expertise;

- Live and act with integrity guided by the company values including sustaining a high bar for operational quality and service.

- Inform the business process and software capability needs to help scale our growing team while improving quality, service, efficiency and regulatory compliance.

- Contribute to the development and implementation of the procedure and system to differentiate Flexport operations from the industry.



What you will need:

Experience:

- BA/BS degree

- Minimum 3 years of experience in logistics, freight forwarding, supply chain, ocean carrier operations, or consulting (ocean freight knowledge is a plus)



What you will learn:

- You will learn what it takes to lead small teams in the execution of day-to-day tactical tasks.

- You will learn how to thrive in an ambiguous environment, research and test operational hypotheses and inform the strategy of a newly built team.

- You will gain specialist expertise to become an ocean or network operations and intermodal subject matter expert within the company. You are the leading advisor in this area, someone our clients, partners, and internal teams go to for advice and strategy.

- You will gain the ability to continuously improve the client experience through a deep industry understanding. You are singularly positioned to realize how we can both work within and push the logistics industry forward to meet the standards of Flexport’s client-centric service.

The Opportunity

The Manager, Americas Control Tower leads the execution strategy for ocean and air freight operations across North and Latin America, based out of Flexport’s Guadalajara office. This role is responsible for driving operational excellence through consistent process execution, quality management, and standardization across regions, panning Ocean (FCL/LCL) and Air, and Flexport’s growing Control Tower product suite. The Operations Manager oversees the daily performance of their team’s workflows, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and adherence to service standards. A key focus of this role is developing scalable, repeatable processes that enhance efficiency and consistency across pre-departure tasks, while also overseeing select post-arrival functions owned by the Control Tower. This position works closely with regional Gateway, Carrier Performance Management, and Demand teams to identify performance gaps, implement best practices, and align stakeholders around a shared goal: delivering a seamless, best-in-class experience for our clients.

Responsibilities:

Team Leadership & Control Tower Development

- Build, lead, and develop a team of Gateway Operators within the Americas Control Tower, able to execute across both ocean and air modes

- Serve as the primary leadership presence for the Americas Control Tower from day one; act as the bridge between Control Tower operators and regional Gateway leadership teams

- Establish clear escalation protocols, communication rhythms, and performance standards between the Control Tower and its regional counterparts

- Lead weekend and after-hours coverage planning for accounts requiring extended support

Operational Performance

- Oversee exception management workflows: dwelling cargo, document discrepancies, milestone gaps, line holds, and carrier SLA resolution

- Ensure flexibility is maintained across ocean and air modes; gateway operators flex between modes based on volume and account needs

- Act as a client-facing escalation point for high-priority issues, partnering with Account Management and Demand to ensure client expectations are met and communicated clearly

- Partner with Americas ops leaders on outbound forecasting, terminal dwell, milestone accuracy, and timely carrier communication

Process, Standards & Scalability

- Develop and maintain SOPs for all Control Tower-managed functions; ensure consistent, repeatable, and compliant execution across modes and accounts

- Generate SLAs for the Control Tower team aligned with regional and company-wide goals

Stakeholder Partnership & Reporting

- Develop dashboards and reporting to measure team performance; support regional leadership in data-driven decisions on carrier strategy and account management

- Collaborate with Carrier Performance Management and Demand teams to surface insights from Control Tower-managed shipments

- Partner with product leaders to develop product strategy that supports Control Tower execution needs

Hiring & Team Growth

- Plan for headcount, hire, grow, and manage a high-performing team as scope expands

- Identify and develop team leads from within the operator cohort as the Control Tower matures

Experience Needed:

- BA/BS degree and/or 5+ years of experience in relevant freight forwarding, transportation, or supply chain roles

- 3+ years of people management experience in a relevant freight forwarding, transportation, or supply chain role required

- English and Spanish language fluency required, as the role requires professional-level Spanish for team leadership and shipper/carrier coordination

- In-depth knowledge of freight forwarding technology and platforms; experience partnering with product teams to deliver operational improvements

- Analytical, metrics-driven approach to problem solving; strong working knowledge of analytical tools (Looker, BI dashboards, AI, Google Suite/Microsoft Suite, etc.)

- Experience developing and enforcing SOPs in a high-volume operational environment

- Excellent communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills, including the confidence to represent Flexport directly to clients and carriers; ability to manage effectively across time zones and cultural contexts

Preferred Qualifications:

- Portuguese language proficiency

- Ability and willingness to travel to the US as needed

Worried about not having any freight forwarding experience?

- Don’t be! We’re building the first Operating System for Global Trade. That’s why it’s incredibly important for us to bring people from diverse backgrounds and experiences together with our industry veterans to help move the freight forwarding industry forward.

- What’s freight forwarding and why does it matter? Listen to Ryan, our CEO explain what freight forwarding is and why improving global trade can help to connect the world and break down economic barriers in this Fast Company Freethink Original Series video.

- We know this industry is complex. That’s why we invest in education starting day one with Flexport Academy, a one week intensive onboarding program designed specifically to set every new Flexport employee up for success.

As an Operations Solutions Manager, you'll sit at the intersection of commercial growth and operational execution, partnering daily with Sales, Account Management, Ops, Implementation, Solutions Engineering, Product, Tech, and Pricing to scope fulfillment solutions for high-volume, operationally complex enterprise clients. You'll be the one turning a client's ambitious (and often messy) requirements into a warehouse process that actually works — designing pick/pack flows, slotting strategy, and WMS/ERP integrations, then staying in the room through implementation to make sure what was sold gets delivered. The work is inherently ambiguous: no two enterprise clients want the same thing, so you'll build reusable frameworks as you go rather than following an existing playbook. If you can translate a pallet layout into a client-ready proposal, you'll fit right in here.

You will:

- Partner with Sales to scope fulfillment solutions for prospective enterprise clients, serving as the operational SME in client-facing conversations on capabilities and custom flows

- Own solution design from pre-sale through onboarding, including time studies, equipment cost scoping, and total cost-to-serve estimates.

- Design warehouse workflows and process flow diagrams (inbound, putaway, pick/pack, returns) for non-standard requirements — WMS/ERP configurations, storage methodology, slotting — with an explicit cost lens to flag workflows that break at scale.

- Identify gaps in product capabilities and operational processes, and build the business case for tooling, process, or headcount investments.

- Propose implementation timelines based on scope of work and technical/ops readiness.

- Establish reusable frameworks and best practices for onboarding and solutioning enterprise accounts.

You should have:

- 5+ years of hands-on warehouse operations experience with process/industrial engineering fundamentals, including slotting/cube optimization, facility layout design, capacity analysis, and space planning.

- Experience building or validating cost-to-serve/pricing models, ideally from deal desk or pricing conversations.

- Strong working knowledge of WMS and ERP platforms and how they integrate in a fulfillment environment.

- Cross-functional experience with Sales, Account Management, Ops, Implementation, Solutions Engineering, Product, Tech, and Pricing in a solutions or pre-sales capacity, moving fluidly between operational detail and client-facing communication.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, able to translate operational constraints for commercial stakeholders.

- Comfort with ambiguity, a bias toward building structure where none exists, and willingness to travel 50%.

We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

The Opportunity



As Flexport continues to grow its footprint across Asia Pacific, we're looking for a Payroll Manager to be the cornerstone of payroll excellence across the region. You'll own the full payroll cycle for our APAC entities — spanning Australia, Singapore, Malaysia, Greater China, Vietnam, Thailand, Korea, Japan, Indonesia, Cambodia, Philippines, India and other new markets as we expand — and serve as the go-to expert where precision, compliance, and people experience intersect.



Sitting within the APAC People team and reporting to the Senior Director, People APAC, this is a people-manager role leading a team of one, with significant cross-functional visibility. You'll set the regional payroll operating standard, drive payroll strategy, build out your team as scale demands, and work closely with Finance, People Operations, and business partners to ensure every employee across APAC is paid accurately and on time.



What You'll Do

- Own Regional Payroll End to End: Lead monthly payroll processing across 18+ APAC entities, managing vendor relationships and ensuring timely, accurate execution at scale.

- Handle Direct Payroll Execution: Perform hands-on processing and verification for assigned entities, directly coordinating with payroll vendors to calculate and finalize local payroll runs.

- Lead & Develop the Team: Manage and grow a direct report responsible for payroll data preparation — set priorities, review quality, and build a team structure that scales with new-market growth.

- Drive Data Accuracy: Coordinate with Finance on payment funding, GL booking, cost centre allocation, and month-end reconciliations — keeping payroll and finance in lockstep.

- Support the Full Employee Lifecycle: Own off-cycle payments, bonus runs, and statutory pay calculations across all employment events, ensuring compliance with local labour requirements.

- Enable Compliant Growth: Partner with the Expansion team to onboard new APAC entities onto payroll — from vendor setup to first run — as Flexport enters new markets.

- Support on regional bonus scheme: partner with global and regional stakeholders on incentive plan.

- Be the Audit & Compliance Expert: Own external audit requests, maintain payroll documentation standards, and manage compliance notifications as the business evolves.

- Elevate Vendor Performance: Own vendor SLA performance across a large multi-vendor footprint, proactively resolving service issues and driving consistent quality across all markets.

- Own Leave & Statutory Pay Calculations: Calculate maternity, paternity, sick, and other statutory leave pay amounts across all APAC entities, coordinating with People Ops on eligibility determination.

- Manage Overtime Compliance: Ensure accurate, compliant overtime calculations across markets with strict statutory multiplier requirements.

- Administer Post-Employment Payments: Process ongoing non-compete payments and other post-termination obligations, tracking start and stop dates for accuracy.

- Execute Compensation Changes: Process merit increases and promotions once approved, including any required backpay adjustments, accurately and on schedule.

- Lead Annual Compliance Cycles: Own annual individual income tax reconciliation and social insurance/housing fund base adjustments across applicable markets.

- Manage Equity-Related Withholding: Handle tax withholding and reporting obligations triggered by RSU vesting events across jurisdictions.



What We're Looking For

- 8+ years of hands-on APAC payroll experience, including 3+ years managing/leading a team, and demonstrated ownership of 5+ countries' payroll operations at scale (ideally 10+).

- Broad multi-country payroll experience across the region — Australia, Singapore, Malaysia, Greater China, Vietnam, Thailand, Korea, Japan, Indonesia, Cambodia, Philippines, India — with a track record of standing up new-market payroll from scratch.

- Deep knowledge of statutory compliance, local labour laws, and payroll vendor management across a large, diverse APAC footprint.

- Proven people-management experience — able to coach, delegate, and build capability in a small but scaling team.

- Hands-on experience using modern AI assistants to automate data analysis, reporting, and modelling.

- Proven ability to partner with Finance on reconciliations, GL allocations, and audit deliverables.

- A reputation for precision — you hold yourself and your team to a high bar and catch issues before they reach employees.

- Strong communicator who can work fluidly across Finance, People Operations, and People Business Partners.

- Experience with HRIS platforms, specifically Workday.

- Professional proficiency in English is a MUST.

- Energised by a fast-scaling environment and excited to build payroll infrastructure and a team from the ground up in new markets.

- Comfortable challenging ideas and holding space for other perspectives to be heard.

- Strong logical approach to resolving complex issues and adept at fostering resilience.

- Committed to maintaining a high degree of personal integrity and confidentiality.

Guided by our values, we empower our internal clients, build for the long term, act with an entrepreneurial spirit, and simplify complexity to create scalable, high-impact solutions. We're seeking a People Business Partner to provide comprehensive HR support across our growing region. - Day-to-day manager support and Employee Lifecycle: Be the first point of contact for manager requests. Guide leaders through onboarding, internal mobility, absence management and offboarding, following our SOPs. Keep processes swift and transparent, and continuously review and improve them.

israel.title: Rotational Development Program
israel.description:
About Flexport:

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

Build the operational and technical skill set that runs global trade

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. We're shaping the future of a $10T industry with technology and people who understand it end to end. The Rotational Development Program (RDP) exists because that combination — real supply chain fluency plus the ability to build and automate — doesn't exist at scale in the market today. So we're building it ourselves.

This is an 18-month program, not a rotation for rotation's sake. Every assignment is live, revenue-generating work. Every participant leaves with a certification in AI and low-code tooling running alongside their operational and commercial training. And every graduate places into a role with real scope: primarily Account Management, with paths into Automation Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering/Consulting, Sales Engineering, or a traditional Ops/Sales/Customs track.

What you'll do

You'll rotate through three functions, six months each, with AI/low-code curriculum running continuously across all three:

- Gateway Ops (Air or Ocean). Own the shipment lifecycle. Execute bookings, manage exceptions, and hold data integrity to Flexport's standard. Build your first automation and reporting skills through structured coursework running in parallel.

- Customs. Become a global trade expert by navigating the complex world of customs regulations to ensure goods comply with international laws. Simultaneously, move into applied technical work: SQL, workflow automation, Lean process improvement, etc.

- Sales / Account Management. Take on go-to-market work and build client-facing skills, operating with more independence. Your capstone: identify a real business problem in the function you're sitting in and build the tooling or process fix that solves it. You'll present it to leadership at graduation.

Throughout the program, you'll get:

- A day-to-day manager in your current rotation and a Rotation Program Manager tracking your development, with mid-point and end-of-rotation evaluations at every stage.

- Certifications in AI/low-code tooling, from foundational bootcamp through applied builds to a capstone project.

- Bi-weekly cohort touchpoints and a standing alumni mentor community.

- Increased earning potential as you clear program benchmarks

This role is for you if you

- Are on track to graduate, or recently graduated, and want to build a career at the intersection of supply chain operations and technology — not just run one or the other.

- Are genuinely curious about AI and low-code tooling and want to build real fluency, not just check a resume box.

- Can operate with minimal supervision, prioritize a high volume of work, and communicate clearly under pressure.

- Want real ownership fast? This program hands you live client and business work from the very beginning — it is not a shadowing or classroom based program.

- Have a "compliance-first" mindset. We operate in a heavily regulated industry, and that matters in every rotation.

Ready to build the future of global trade — and the skill set to run it?

Apply now.

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

Location: Seoul

Reporting: Country Manager

Position : Individual Contributor



Role Overview

As an Account Executive, you will be responsible for acquiring and developing net-new mid-market customers through a consultative, value-based sales approach.

This role requires a strong hunter mentality and the ability to independently build and manage a pipeline from prospecting through close. You will work with customers to understand their logistics and supply chain challenges, identify opportunities for improvement, and position Flexport's technology and services as a broader business solution—not simply as a freight or transportation provider.

A successful AE is able to move customer conversations beyond price and transactional freight discussions by demonstrating the broader value Flexport can deliver through its platform, visibility, technology, and operational capabilities.



Pipeline & Opportunity Ownership

- Independently identify, prospect, and close net-new mid-market customers, meeting or exceeding individual sales targets.

- Build and manage a healthy pipeline through self-sourced prospecting, outbound outreach, referrals, networking, and other channels.

- Own the full sales cycle from initial prospecting and qualification through negotiation and close.

- Qualify opportunities based on customer needs, business priorities, timing, and strategic fit—not solely on immediate price competitiveness.

- Maintain accurate opportunity management and forecasting in Salesforce (SFDC).

- Maintain clear ownership of next steps and momentum throughout the sales cycle.



Customer Discovery & Value-Based Selling

- Lead discovery conversations with prospective customers to understand their logistics, supply chain, and business challenges.

- Engage relevant stakeholders and uncover the underlying needs, priorities, and decision criteria behind a customer's requirements.

- Understand when a customer is primarily focused on price and effectively reframe the conversation around total value, operational efficiency, visibility, technology, and service quality.

- Demonstrate the ability to challenge a customer's existing approach and introduce new perspectives on how logistics can create business value.

- Translate customer needs into tailored Flexport solutions and articulate a compelling value proposition.

- Conduct effective customer presentations, platform demonstrations, and solution discussions in both remote and in-person settings.



Deal Management & Closing

- Manage opportunities from qualification through negotiation and close with clear ownership and consistent sales momentum.

- Develop compelling commercial proposals that connect Flexport's solution to the customer's business priorities.

- Lead commercial discussions and negotiations within Flexport's pricing and contracting frameworks.

- Avoid competing solely on price and clearly communicate the value and differentiation of Flexport's platform and services.

- Coordinate with internal teams such as Operations, Solutions, Finance, and Legal when required to progress opportunities.



Onboarding & Account Development

- Partner with internal teams to ensure a smooth transition from sales to customer onboarding and execution.

- Establish trusted relationships with key customer stakeholders from the early stages of the customer lifecycle.

- Identify opportunities to expand and deepen customer relationships based on evolving customer needs.



Prerequisites

- 3+ years of B2B sales experience with a proven track record of managing the full sales cycle from prospecting to close.

- Proven ability to independently build pipelines and acquire new customers without relying on a dedicated SDR.

- Strong consultative and value-based selling skills, with the ability to move customer conversations beyond price and transactional requirements.

- Strong discovery, communication, presentation, negotiation, and commercial judgment skills.

israel.description:
About Flexport:

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

All security disciplines work under the umbrella of the combined PSI (Platform, Security & Infrastructure) team: we build the paved path and tooling that hundreds of engineers around the world rely on every day to ship. Corporate Security owns the estate everyone at Flexport actually touches — the laptops, the identity provider, the SaaS sprawl, the browser. Get it right and nobody notices. Get it wrong and it's the fastest way into everything else we're trying to protect.

This is a security engineering role, not an IT support role. You'll spend your time writing code and shipping automation, not administering a helpdesk queue or babysitting a ticket tray.

What you'll do

- Identity & access

- Advance our identity posture: SSO coverage, phishing-resistant MFA rollout, SCIM lifecycle automation, and least-privilege access across the SaaS and cloud estate.

- Build the detections and guardrails that catch account takeover, MFA fatigue attacks, and session token theft before they turn into incidents.

- Endpoint & device lifecycle

- Write and ship device policy as code — configuration profiles, remediation scripts, and enforcement rules across macOS and Windows — with staged rollout and rollback built in from day one.

- Maintain and improve our EDR stack's detection and response coverage across the fleet.

- SaaS posture

- Reduce SaaS risk at scale through SSPM tooling and automation, including detection of risky OAuth grants, shadow IT, and configuration drift across our critical SaaS applications.

- Own security configuration for the SaaS tools hundreds of Flexporters use daily (Google Workspace, Slack, and similar), and keep pace as we add AI agents and MCP integrations to that surface.

- Automation & enablement

- Automate the parts of corporate security that don't need a human — device provisioning, access reviews, vendor security questionnaires — so the team scales with headcount instead of straining against it.
