The PSI (Platform, Security & Infrastructure) team makes this possible: we build the paved path and tooling that hundreds of engineers around the world rely on every day to ship.

This is not a role where you wait for tickets. You'll talk to engineers, dogfood our platform, and find the friction that's slowing us down, and then design and ship the tools to remove that.

What You'll Do

You'll own and evolve the developer platform that powers Flexport engineering. That means:

- Making the best paved paths and self-serve tooling possible that makes the right thing the easy thing, protected by guardrails but not locked gates.

- Creating and supporting developers with CI/CD pipelines (Buildkit, Github Actions), build tooling (Gradle, Bazel, npm/pnpm/bun, Go and Cargo) and artifact repositories (Artifactory, ECR, github).

- Owning and improving the backend and frontend developer experience.

- Acting as the steward of our GraphQL and gRPC ecosystem and make sure our middleware, federation and schema sharing, CLIs, codegen and servers and clients work smooth as butter.

- Evolving and integrating our IAM solutions and primitives so that everything is easy and secure by default.

- Making sure engineers can easily use and understand our container orchestration (Kubernetes, ECS) and observability stack (Openmetrics, Datadog) that engineers rely on to run, understand and debug their services.

- Doing user research with developers: shadowing engineers, running interviews, and tracking DevX metrics so that what you build is grounded on data and not assumptions.

- Crossing organizational boundaries to align with product teams and ship changes that impact the whole engineering org.

You Should Have

- 10+ years of software engineering experience, with significant time spent building developer platforms, internal tooling, or core infrastructure that other engineers depend on.

- Deep full-stack instincts: you're equally comfortable in a backend service, a frontend build pipeline, a Kubernetes manifest, and a CI configuration.

- Strong product instincts applied to internal users: you treat engineers as customers, identify what's actually worth building, and measure whether it worked.

- Expertise and hands on experience with at least one of each: a CI/CD system (Github Actions pref), a container orchestrator (Kubernetes pref.), build tooling preferably for more than one language, backend-for-frontend (Graphql pref.), service-to-service communication (gRPC preferred), Metrics and artifact storage.

- An appetite to take a shovel to that brown field: you thrive on fixing what’s broken and building bridges to what’s next. You don’t just throw migrations over the wall, you either execute them yourself or make sure they feel effortless.

- An independent mindset: you thrive in ambiguity, find the highest-leverage problems yourself, and don't wait to be told what to do.

- Excellent communication: you can run a developer interview, write a clear design doc, and align stakeholders across teams to land platform-wide changes.

- A generally helpful attitude. Everyone should know you within no-time as the person who gets stuff unblocked, points them in the right direction and makes their work easier. The 90’s can keep their BOFH.

- A drive for impact: you are not satisfying until every engineer is productive and confident thanks to your team.

Nice to Have

- Experience in data-driven DevX development using metrics such as DORA.

- Experience with AWS.

- Experience in Identity and Access Management (IAM) at scale such as JWTs, OIDC and fine-grained authorization.

- Experience with Terraform.

How We Work

- We come to the office 3 times a week to hang out, whiteboard, and ship together.

- We have the latest hardware and software, including frontier AI models on day one.

- We're agile, but not dogmatic. Teams decide how they work best.

Why This Role Is Special

- Massive leverage: every improvement you ship is multiplied across hundreds of engineers and thousands of deploys a day.

- Full ownership: from developer research to production rollout to measuring impact, it's yours.

- You shape the paved path: the conventions you set and decisions you make become how Flexport engineering builds for years to come.

What's in it for you:

- An opportunity to contribute to one of the fastest-growing companies, where you’ll have the chance to create a global impact while being a part of a  thriving multinational environment.

- Daily catered lunches incl. vegetarian options, breakfast, snacks and soft drinks available in our office on daily basis.

- Commute expenses: Flexport will cover  home-office commuting costs for employees living outside of Amsterdam.

- 25 working days as vacation days based on full time employment.

- Health insurance: Flexport offers a collective health insurance plan including a basic package and any available additional packages. Your monthly premium is fully paid by Flexport.

- A defined pension contribution scheme.

- Equity program: every team member becomes a shareholder, aligning our success with yours. As a private company in a multi-trillion dollar industry, you have a direct stake in our collective growth and success.

- Employee Assistance Program through Aetna Resources for Living: Flexport provides an employer-sponsored program at no cost to you and your household members.

- Parental leave benefit: Flexport is here to support you and your families in one of the most important times in life – the birth of a child! Our parental leave program allows both mothers and partners to take time off from work for pregnancy, childbirth, and to bond with your new child.

As a CDL Driver at SAM by Via, you will drive buses and provide outstanding customer service to riders in the immediate Sioux Falls area.

israel.title: City Operations Manager (m/w/d)

Du hast die einzigartige Möglichkeit, operatives Tagesgeschäft mit Innovation zu verbinden und die Zukunft der On-Demand-Personenbeförderung in der Region aktiv mitzugestalten.

Diese Rolle ist im Großraum Frankfurt angesiedelt - wir erwarten, dass Du mindestens 3 Tage pro Woche vor Ort bist.

- Du führst das tägliche operative Geschäft und sorgst für sicheren, zuverlässigen und barrierefreien Transport für unsere Fahrgäste.

- Du triffst Echtzeit-Entscheidungen zu Fuhrpark, Fahrerverfügbarkeit, Compliance, Fahrgastbedürfnissen und unerwarteten Problemen – und nutzt Daten, um Probleme schnell zu diagnostizieren und den Service am Laufen zu halten.

- Du denkst taktisch wie strategisch, kannst Probleme in Echtzeit lösen und gleichzeitig vorausschauend Lösungen entwickeln, die ein erneutes Auftreten verhindern.

- Du hast einen gültigen deutschen Führerschein der Klasse B.

- Betriebliche Altersvorsorge (bAV) mit 20 % Arbeitgeberzuschuss

Wir wertschätzen Vielfalt und begrüßen alle Bewerbungen unabhängig von Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion/Weltanschauung, Behinderung, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität.

israel.title: Director of Product
israel.description:
Via is on a mission to create public transportation systems that provide far greater access to jobs, healthcare, and education. Our platform serves as the technology backbone for modern transit networks, transforming antiquated and siloed public transportation systems into smart, data-driven, and efficient digital networks. With hundreds of agency partners around the world, Via is recognized as the leading transportation technology and service provider globally.

About the role:

Remix is Via's premier transit planning and scheduling platform, trusted by transit agencies worldwide to design networks, model scenarios, and optimize service. We're looking for a Director of Product to define and drive the next era of Remix: a multimodal planning and scheduling system that gives transit agencies a single, authoritative place to make smarter decisions across every service type they operate.

This is a high-impact, high-ownership role. You will shape the vision for how agencies move from static schedules to data-driven, dynamically optimized operations — balancing labor union rules and contractual constraints with the operational agility modern transit demands. You will own the end-to-end product experience from strategic planning through live execution, and your work will directly affect how millions of riders experience public transit every day.

What you will do:

- Define and own the product vision and roadmap for Remix as the global standard for multimodal transit planning and scheduling, spanning fixed route, paratransit, microtransit, and emerging modes

- Build the framework for data-driven scheduling — enabling agencies to make optimal use of driver and vehicle time through intelligent analysis of ridership patterns, operational constraints, and service goals

- Deeply understand and incorporate labor union rules, collective bargaining agreements, and workforce regulations into the product in a way that is structured yet flexible enough to adapt as those rules evolve

- Connect planning and scheduling seamlessly to live operations, reducing the gap between what is scheduled and what is executed — improving accuracy, dispatcher confidence, and rider reliability

- Partner closely with engineering, design, data science, and GTM teams to move from vision to shipped product with clear milestones and measurable outcomes

- Engage directly and frequently with transit planners, schedulers, and operations leaders to surface unmet needs and validate product direction

- Stay current on industry trends, emerging regulations, and competitive dynamics to keep Remix ahead of the market

Who You Are:

- You have 10+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex enterprise software products

- Have a track record of shipping high-quality products for sophisticated, workflow-heavy enterprise environments where the cost of getting it wrong is high

- Are a systems thinker who can hold both strategic vision and operational detail — you know when to zoom out and when to get into the weeds

- Have strong instincts for simplifying complexity: translating divergent customer needs and intricate business rules into clean, scalable product decisions

- Bring deep empathy for the professionals who use your product daily — planners, schedulers, dispatchers — and design with their real working context in mind

- Can quickly become technically fluent in the underlying data models and entities that power scheduling and operations systems — blocks, runs, trips, stops, vehicles, duties, pairings — and can engage at that level of specificity with engineers and architects

- Are a strong, credible voice in technical architecture decisions alongside your engineering partners, capable of evaluating tradeoffs and advocating for platform choices that serve both current product needs and long-term scalability

- Experience with resource management, labor scheduling, or workforce optimization software is a strong plus

- Experience in transportation, transit, or logistics is a plus but not required — intellectual curiosity and the ability to learn technical domains quickly matter more

Compensation and Benefits:

- Base salary range: $200,000-$300,000, determined by experience and skills. Total compensation also includes variable pay and equity.

- Comprehensive health coverage, with low-cost dental and vision plans.

- A 401(k) with a generous company match and vesting.

- Fully paid parental leave for new parents, with extended leave options.

- Additional benefits (mental health, pet insurance, and other wellness perks).

- 20 days of paid time off (PTO) annually.

As a Field Manager on Via’s Operations team, you are the force that keeps our services running reliably for the communities that depend on them. This is a high ownership, boots-on-the-ground role where you’ll lead daily operations, tackle real-time challenges, and continuously elevate the rider and driver experience.

**This is a fully in-person position with the expectation that you will be onsite 4-5 days per week.**

What You’ll Do:

- Run the daily onsite operations of our service. You’ll make sure our operations run smoothly to provide our riders with safe, reliable, and accessible transportation.

- Make informed, real-time decisions about fleet, driver supply, compliance, rider needs, and unexpected issues - stepping in quickly to ensure continuously excellent and dependable service.

- Guide and support drivers - building strong relationships, addressing concerns, and ensuring they feel equipped to deliver great service.

- Turn rider and community feedback into tangible improvements, spotting patterns and collaborating with internal teams to make thoughtful and actionable operational improvements.

- Use data and technology to understand service performance, diagnose problems, and implement solutions that enhance efficiency and rider experience.

- Act as the operational bridge between city partners, drivers, and Via central teams to help bring the community's goals to life.

Who You Are:

- Operationally experienced, with a background in people management, logistics, customer service, or process-oriented work.

- Relationship oriented, earning trust from drivers, riders, teammates, and city partners through clear communication and follow-through.

- Hands-on and proactive, preferring to be in the field, learning the service firsthand, and solving problems where they happen.

- Tactical and strategic, able to problem-solve issues as they come up but also think long term about solutions to mitigate these occurrences.

- Mission driven, motivated by expanding access to transportation and improving how communities move.

- Based in Sacramento, ready to be onsite 4–5 days a week.

israel.title: Field Manager – Data, Optimization & AI (m/w/d)
israel.description:
Via hat die Mission, Mobilität auf der ganzen Welt zu verbessern. Von der Optimierung des täglichen Arbeitswegs einer einzelnen Person bis hin zur Verringerung des ökologischen Fußabdrucks der Menschheit – wir haben große Ziele.

Als Field Manager (m/w/d) im Operations-Team von Via bist Du die treibende Kraft, die unsere Services für die Menschen, die auf sie angewiesen sind, zuverlässig am Laufen hält. Dies ist eine Rolle mit hoher Eigenverantwortung und direktem Bezug zum operativen Geschäft, in der Du das Tagesgeschäft unserer On-Demand-RMV-Services im Großraum Frankfurt leitest, Herausforderungen in Echtzeit löst und sicherstellst, dass unsere Fahrgäste sicher und zuverlässig befördert werden.

Ein wichtiger Teil der Rolle ist die Optimierung unseres Field-Teams und Services: Du nutzt Daten, um operative Fragen schnell zu beantworten, Potenziale zu identifizieren, Prozesse zu verbessern und KI- sowie Automatisierungsprojekte zu leiten. Du hast die einzigartige Möglichkeit, operatives Tagesgeschäft mit Innovation zu verbinden und die Zukunft der On-Demand-Personenbeförderung in der Region aktiv mitzugestalten.

Diese Rolle ist im Großraum Frankfurt angesiedelt - wir erwarten, dass Du mindestens 3 Tage pro Woche vor Ort bist.

Deine Aufgaben:

- Du führst das tägliche operative Geschäft und sorgst für sicheren, zuverlässigen und barrierefreien Transport für unsere Fahrgäste.

- Du treibst die kontinuierliche Optimierung von Field-Team und Service voran – durch Daten, Technologie, KI und Automatisierung, inklusive der Leitung von KI-Projekten von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung.

- Du triffst Echtzeit-Entscheidungen zu Fuhrpark, Fahrerverfügbarkeit, Compliance, Fahrgastbedürfnissen und unerwarteten Problemen – und nutzt Daten, um Probleme schnell zu diagnostizieren und den Service am Laufen zu halten.

- Du begleitest und unterstützt unser Fahrpersonal, baust starke Beziehungen auf und identifizierst Möglichkeiten zur Verbesserung der Team-Performance.

- Du wandelst Feedback von Fahrgästen und Community in konkrete Verbesserungen um, indem du mithilfe von Daten Muster erkennst und Ursachen angehst.

- Du bist das Bindeglied zwischen Via's Partnern, Fahrpersonal und zentralen Via-Teams, ziehst schnell Daten heran, um Fragen zu beantworten, Probleme zu lösen und Verbesserungen voranzutreiben.

Das bringst Du mit:

- Du bringst operative Erfahrung im Personalmanagement, in der Logistik, im Kundenservice oder anderen prozessorientierten Tätigkeitsfeldern mit.

- Du bist beziehungsorientiert und ein starker Kommunikator, der Vertrauen zu Fahrpersonal, Fahrgästen, Teamkolleg:innen und städtischen Partnern aufbaut und auf jeder Ebene den richtigen Ton trifft.

- Du bist hands-on und proaktiv, übernimmst gerne Verantwortung für Mitarbeitende, bist gerne im operativen Geschäft unterwegs und löst Probleme dort, wo sie entstehen – auch unter Druck.

- Du arbeitest datengetrieben, strukturiert und digital versiert, nutzt Analyse- und KI-Tools, um Probleme zu lösen, effektiv zu priorisieren und unsere Services zu verbessern.

- Du denkst taktisch wie strategisch, kannst Probleme in Echtzeit lösen und gleichzeitig vorausschauend Lösungen entwickeln, die ein erneutes Auftreten verhindern.

- Du verfügst über Sprachkenntnisse in Deutsch und Englisch auf mindestens C1-Niveau.

- Du hast einen gültigen deutschen Führerschein der Klasse B.

Vergütung & Benefits:

- Gehaltsspanne: zwischen 45.000 und 55.000 € pro Jahr

- Ein internationales Team, das für sozialen Nutzen steht

- Betriebliche Altersvorsorge (bAV) mit 20 % Arbeitgeberzuschuss

- Mitgliedschaft im Urban Sports Club

- 30 Urlaubstage pro Jahr

Es gab noch nie einen spannenderen Zeitpunkt, um an der Spitze der öffentlichen Mobilität zu stehen.

Wir wertschätzen Vielfalt und begrüßen alle Bewerbungen unabhängig von Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion/Weltanschauung, Behinderung, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität.

israel.title: Field Operations Manager

israel.description:
Via is using technology to transform transportation around the world. From changing a single person’s daily commute to reducing humanity’s collective environmental footprint — we’ve got huge goals.

Via has partnered with 100+ cities and public transit agencies around the world to deploy our mobility technology. As a Field Manager on Via’s Transit-as-a-Service (TaaS) Operations team, you’ll be responsible for managing operations using our innovative technology platform. You’ll manage daily operations while driving continuous improvement and growth of our services.

**This is a fully in-person position with the expectation that you will be onsite 4-5 days per week**

What You’ll Do:

- Ensure operational excellence and an unbelievable customer experience

- Oversee operations in person, the business needs may dictate a need for early mornings or evenings at times

- Manage driver supply to ensure the appropriate amount of vehicles are in service at any given time to meet demand expectations

- Prioritize operational issues as the real-time point of contact and implement creative solutions to solve problems as they arise

- Respond to driver feedback and live customer issues

- Diligently work collaboratively with a broad interdisciplinary team to scale operational processes, systems, and tools to drive rapid growth

- Analyze, interpret metrics/KPIs in order to identify possible inefficiencies and apply analysis to optimize operations.

Who You Are:

- A socially perceptive, environmentally conscious individual who is aligned with promoting transportation equity and the reduction of carbon emissions.

- A self-starter who is comfortable taking on a high level of responsibility

- A driven executor with a track record of end to end ownership of a book of business, and a history of hitting KPIs and revenue goals.

- A team-focused individual that takes ownership of their work and pride in their team's success.

- Experienced in project management, creating and refining operational processes, and customer service. Multi-site management experience is a plus.

- An outgoing and sociable leader; skilled at communicating professionally with partners, customers and driver partners from a broad range of backgrounds.

- Willing to wear multiple hats and contribute on projects of all types

- Fluent in English, additional languages a plus

- Experienced in managing (including scheduling) a team is a plus

- Taking initiative and owning new projects

- Comfortable with ambiguity and evolving / adapting as conditions change

- Experienced in managing projects with multiple stakeholders is a plus

- Bachelor’s degree is a plus

Compensation and Benefits:

- Final salary will be determined by the candidate’s experience, knowledge, and skills. Salary reflected does not include equity or variable pay, where applicable

- Salary Range: $65,000 - $75,000

- We are proud to offer a generous and comprehensive benefits package, including free medical plans and 401K matching.

We’re Via, and we build technology that changes the way the world moves. We’re driven by a simple mission: to create modern and efficient public transportation systems that provide far greater access to jobs, healthcare, and education. With our best in class suite of products, we make transit thrive.

Our teams of world-class engineers, data-scientists, product managers, operations specialists, marketers, transit experts and more bring cutting-edge AI-powered software and innovative technology-enabled operations to our partners across the globe. Founded in 2012, Via builds solutions to digitize, automate, and enable data-driven decision making for entire transportation networks; fixed-route buses, microtransit, paratransit, school buses, autonomous vehicles, and more.

If you’re excited to be at the forefront of modernizing the future of transportation, are up for solving tough problems, and willing to become/already are a transit nerd, we are the place for you. Even if your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description for this role, we encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other opportunities.

Ready to join the ride?

Via is an equal opportunity employer.

Via is using technology to transform transportation around the world. From changing a single person’s daily commute to reducing humanity’s collective environmental footprint — we’ve got huge goals.

Via has partnered with 100+ cities and public transit agencies around the world to deploy our mobility technology. As a Field Manager on Via’s Transit-as-a-Service (TaaS) Operations team, you’ll be responsible for managing operations using our innovative technology platform. You’ll manage daily operations while driving continuous improvement and growth of our services.

**This is a fully in-person position with the expectation that you will be onsite 4-5 days per week. This role will also require travel to Birmingham, AL at least 2x/month**

What You’ll Do:

- Ensure operational excellence and an unbelievable customer experience

- Oversee operations in person, the business needs may dictate a need for early mornings or evenings at times

- Manage driver supply to ensure the appropriate amount of vehicles are in service at any given time to meet demand expectations

- Prioritize operational issues as the real-time point of contact and implement creative solutions to solve problems as they arise

- Respond to driver feedback and live customer issues

- Diligently work collaboratively with a broad interdisciplinary team to scale operational processes, systems, and tools to drive rapid growth

- Analyze, interpret metrics/KPIs in order to identify possible inefficiencies and apply analysis to optimize operations.

Who You Are:

- A socially perceptive, environmentally conscious individual who is aligned with promoting transportation equity and the reduction of carbon emissions.

- A self-starter who is comfortable taking on a high level of responsibility

- A driven executor with a track record of end to end ownership of a book of business, and a history of hitting KPIs and revenue goals.

- A team-focused individual that takes ownership of their work and pride in their team's success.

- Experienced in project management, creating and refining operational processes, and customer service. Multi-site management experience is a plus.

- An outgoing and sociable leader; skilled at communicating professionally with partners, customers and driver partners from a broad range of backgrounds.

- Willing to wear multiple hats and contribute on projects of all types

- Fluent in English, additional languages a plus

- Based in the Atlanta area can easily commute between operations at least 3-4 times a week

- Experienced in managing (including scheduling) a team is a plus

- Taking initiative and owning new projects

- Comfortable with ambiguity and evolving / adapting as conditions change

- Experienced in managing projects with multiple stakeholders is a plus

- Bachelor’s degree is a plus

Compensation and Benefits:

- Final salary will be determined by the candidate’s experience, knowledge, and skills. Salary reflected does not include equity or variable pay, where applicable

- Salary Range: $65,000 - $75,000

- We are proud to offer a generous and comprehensive benefits package, including free medical plans and 401K matching.

We’re Via, and we build technology that changes the way the world moves. We’re driven by a simple mission: to create modern and efficient public transportation systems that provide far greater access to jobs, healthcare, and education. With our best in class suite of products, we make transit thrive.

Our teams of world-class engineers, data-scientists, product managers, operations specialists, marketers, transit experts and more bring cutting-edge AI-powered software and innovative technology-enabled operations to our partners across the globe. Founded in 2012, Via builds solutions to digitize, automate, and enable data-driven decision making for entire transportation networks; fixed-route buses, microtransit, paratransit, school buses, autonomous vehicles, and more.

If you’re excited to be at the forefront of modernizing the future of transportation, are up for solving tough problems, and willing to become/already are a transit nerd, we are the place for you. Even if your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description for this role, we encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other opportunities.

Ready to join the ride?

Via is an equal opportunity employer.

israel.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, AI Labs
israel.description:
Via is on a mission to create public transportation systems that provide far greater access to jobs, healthcare, and education. Our platform serves as the technology backbone for modern transit networks, transforming antiquated and siloed public transportation systems into smart, data-driven, and efficient digital networks. With hundreds of agency partners around the world, Via is recognized as the leading transportation technology and service provider globally.

We’re now launching AI Labs - an incubator-style team operating like a startup within the company - to expand our reach and provide cutting-edge technical solutions to cities in areas beyond transit.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Via, you'll be a founding member of Via's new AI Labs - an incubator-style team operating like a startup within the company. This is a rare opportunity to get in at the ground floor of something genuinely new: a dedicated space to move fast, experiment boldly, and build AI-powered products that could fundamentally change how Via and our partner cities operate. You'll have real autonomy, direct access to leadership, and the backing of a company that's already at scale - without the constraints that usually come with it. If you're experienced at building AI products end-to-end and you're energized by the idea of doing that with a blank canvas, this is the role for you.

About the Role:

- Build and ship production-grade AI products end-to-end - owning everything from problem framing and data pipeline design through to deployment and iteration in live environments.

- Work closely with our customers in a forward-deployed manner to deeply understand problems and constraints and iterate quickly on scalable agentic solutions.

- Lead technical scoping workshops, directly interfacing with city leaders to solve challenging local problems with agentic workflows.

- Work across a fast-moving and varied roadmap, contributing to intelligent tooling involving data consolidation, predictive modelling, real-time decision-making, and LLM-powered experiences.

- Collaborate directly with product, data science, and operations teams to identify and prioritize the highest-impact AI opportunities across the business.

- Write clean, scalable backend and frontend code that powers AI-driven features - designing APIs, managing data flows, and ensuring your systems perform reliably at scale.

- Help shape the technical culture of AI Labs from the ground up - contributing to how the team builds, reviews, ships, and iterates.

- Stay close to the frontier of AI development and bring new ideas, tools, and approaches into the team proactively.

About You:

- You have 5+ years of hands-on experience building full stack applications - with a track record of owning features end-to-end rather than working in isolation on models or research.

- You have 3+ years of working with AI tools and/or building AI powered products

- You have deep expertise across the AI stack - including LLMs, predictive modelling, and the data infrastructure required to support them in real-world environments.

- You're a strong backend engineer at your core - comfortable designing scalable APIs, working with distributed systems, and writing code that is clean, maintainable, and built to last.

- You're energized by ambiguity and early-stage environments - you don't need everything to be defined to do great work, and you take ownership without being asked.

- You bring the communication skills to work cross-functionally and the intellectual curiosity to keep pushing the boundaries of what's possible with AI.

- You thrive when working directly with users and customers, and are comfortable with travel to collaborate on-site.

Compensation and Benefits (US only)

- Final salary will be determined by the candidate’s experience, knowledge, and skills. Salary reflected does not include equity or variable pay, where applicable.

- Salary Range: $160,000 - $220,000

- We are proud to offer a generous and comprehensive benefits package, including free medical plans, 401K matching, catered lunch on Wednesdays, and many other perks.

There has never been a more exciting time to be on the cutting edge of public mobility. Ready to join the ride?

Via is an equal opportunity employer.

israel.title: General Manager
israel.description:
Via is using technology to transform transportation around the world. From changing a single person’s daily commute to reducing humanity’s collective environmental footprint — we’ve got huge goals.

As General Manager, you will manage a first-of-its-kind, intermodal transit service while gaining exposure to a fast-paced tech company. This is not a role where you will be following a playbook, you will be building the plane while flying it - making it a challenging people-facing role that spans entrepreneurship, business development and operations management. We hope you are up for it!

What You'll Do:

- Manage the on-site daily operations of Via’s service around Chemung County

- Prioritize operational issues as a real-time point of contact for drivers and dispatchers and provide creative solutions for scheduling of a round the clock team

- Manage and mentor the on-site team of dispatchers and shift managers

- Be the face of the operation; develop relationships with driver partners, customers, community leaders, and local organizations

- Liaise closely with Via senior management and Via’s external partners

- Develop clear metrics for the team and visibility into results against KPIs and priorities to the on a weekly basis

- Prepare reports and analyze data to improve operational processes, ensure resources are properly allocated, and maximize efficiency and customer satisfaction.

- Ensure compliance with all relevant federal, state, local and company policies, procedures and regulations on service operations

- Lead, coach and develop an engaged team of drivers, fostering a collaborative, cohesive, and energetic environment.

Who You Are:

- Experienced operations manager, with a minimum of 6+ years of experience

- You are an independent self-starter, you thrive in fast-paced environments and feel comfortable with a very high level of responsibility

- You are a savvy and tactful communicator: you intuitively find the right tone in every situation

- You desire to foster a culture deeply committed to providing a world class customer service experience

- You are a detail-oriented executor: you’re obsessively action-oriented and thrive while operating autonomously

- You are an experienced and exceptional leader: people love working with you and for you and you have extensive experience leading support teams

- You are flexible and adaptable, you love the challenge of adapting to change rapidly and making things work on the fly

- You have a proven track record of managing teams (at least 3-5 years) and developing people - you know how to motivate and get the best work out of every person who you work with

- You are effective at managing multiple tasks simultaneously; you can delegate, prioritize, and take responsibility

- You are a problem solver; you don’t accept the status quo and are always looking for creative solutions

- Experience working in transit a plus

- Successful completion of a drug test, criminal background check, and motor vehicle records check is mandatory for employment.

Compensation and Benefits:

- Final salary will be determined by the candidate’s experience, knowledge, and skills. Salary reflected does not include equity or variable pay, where applicable.

- Base salary range: $110,000-$160,000 / per year + RSU package

- We are proud to offer a generous and comprehensive benefits package, including free medical plans and 401K matching.

Ready to join the ride?

Via is an equal opportunity employer.

- Own and manage launch of new Via services, from technology implementation to operational setup

- Define and manage against KPIs spanning on-time performance, rider satisfaction, safety, and cost efficiency

- Translate weekly and monthly performance data into decisions

israel.title: Head of AI Research Product
israel.description:
Via is a global leader in smart transportation, using technology to revolutionize mobility worldwide. Our impact ranges from transforming individual daily commutes to reducing the collective environmental cost of transit systems. We're driven by ambitious goals. This is an opportunity to join a core team reshaping how public mobility operates at scale.

We are looking for a Head of AI Research Product to lead the intersection of applied machine learning research and product innovation across Via's rider and transit operations platform. This role sits at the frontier of what AI can do for public transportation, not as a feature layer, but as the engine that makes the system smarter, more equitable, and more efficient for every rider and agency we serve.

This is a three-part role: innovating with lighthouse customers to pilot and pressure-test cutting-edge approaches in real-world transit environments, conducting original applied research, and driving productization of proven methods into Via's core platform.

What you'll do:

- Build and lead Via's AI research product function, defining the roadmap for how machine learning advances rider experience and transit network performance.

- Design and deploy reinforcement learning systems that optimize routing, pooling efficiency, and real-time dispatching, balancing rider satisfaction against vehicle utilization and transit agency cost targets.

- Pioneer AlphaGo-style machine learning for transit: combine deep reinforcement learning, and tree search over high-fidelity simulations of real transit networks, training policy and value networks that discover dispatching, pooling, and network-design strategies beyond what hand-built heuristics or conventional optimization can reach.

- Develop weighted ensemble models and multi-objective optimization frameworks that surface the right tradeoffs between competing system goals: wait times, cost per ride, emissions, and equity of service.

- Invent personalization systems that adapt the rider mobile experience in real time, surfacing relevant trip options, proactive alerts, and dynamic pricing signals, in close partnership with the rider mobile product team.

- Research and productize behavioral incentive models that increase ridership and shift demand to improve aggregation: surge smoothing mechanisms, loyalty structures, and gamified engagement grounded in behavioral economics and causal inference.

- Partner with lighthouse transit agencies to co-develop and validate novel AI approaches, turning field pilots into scalable platform features.

- Establish rigorous experimentation infrastructure (A/B testing, contextual bandits, offline policy evaluation) to measure the real-world impact of model changes on rider behavior and agency outcomes.

What we are looking for:

- MS or PhD in a quantitative field: machine learning, operations research, statistics, applied mathematics, or a related discipline.

- Deep hands-on proficiency in ML: reinforcement learning, supervised and unsupervised methods, probabilistic modeling, and optimization. Experience with AlphaGo-style approaches (self-play, Monte Carlo tree search, policy/value networks) and with large-scale real-time inference systems is a strong plus.

- Genuine user empathy: you think as carefully about what a rider or agency dispatcher experiences as you do about model architecture.

- Very user-minded and clear-eyed about outcomes for users. You work closely with the mobile and SaaS product teams on experimentation, and you know how to find the balance between a delightful user experience and service KPIs such as efficiency and rider experience.

- Business sense and product instincts: you know how to translate a research finding into a shipped product and a shipped product into a business outcome.

- Experience partnering with engineering teams to move models from research into production at scale.

- Track record of working with external customers or partners to iterate on novel solutions in ambiguous, real-world conditions.

- Comfort operating across research, product, and commercial contexts: you can present a model architecture to an ML engineer and a product strategy to a transit authority CEO.

- Passion for building technology that makes public transit work better for everyone, especially riders in underserved communities.

Compensation and Benefits:

- Final salary will be determined by the candidate’s experience, knowledge, and skills. Salary reflected does not include equity or variable pay, where applicable

- Salary Range: $250,000 - $310,000 per year

- Comprehensive health coverage, with low-cost dental and vision plans

- A 401(k) with a generous company match and vesting

- Fully paid parental leave for new parents, with extended leave options

- Additional benefits (mental health, pet insurance, and other wellness perks)

- 20 days of paid time off (PTO) annually

Ready to join the ride?

israel.title: Head of Risk & Insurance
israel.description:
Via is using technology to transform transportation around the world. From changing a single person's daily commute to reducing humanity's collective environmental footprint — we've got huge goals.

As Head of Risk & Insurance, you will lead Via's insurance program, shaping its strategy, structure, and operations, as well as continuing to expand it as we take on new business lines.  Reporting to the COO, you'll be close to the integral parts of the business where risk shows up first.

What You'll Do:

- Own Via's insurance program end-to-end: assess our risk profile, identify the coverage we need, and put risk programs in place across the markets we operate in

- Partner with senior leadership on risk strategy, including coverage decisions, alternative risk transfer (captives, self-insured retentions), and how risk and insurance figure into Via's broader operational and financial planning

- Manage brokerage and carrier relationships: run renewals, evaluate quotes, negotiate terms, and select partners who can grow with us globally

- Build the systems and team to manage claims and litigation efficiently: define how incidents are reported; how reserves are set; and how we run a highly effective claims management process

- Develop a risk management strategy that goes beyond insurance: partner with Legal, Finance, and other internal teams to identify and reduce loss exposure

- Build the internal infrastructure: put policies, processes, dashboards, and reporting in place so the rest of the company has clear visibility into our risks

- Stand up the analytics that tell us whether the program is working: monitor loss ratios, claim frequency and severity, cost per mile, and retention thresholds and use them to inform every renewal

- Lead, grow and develop Via’s risk team as the program scales

Who You Are:

- You have built and run an insurance program before — ideally one with significant operational  exposure, and ideally at a company operating across multiple jurisdictions. You know what excellent looks like because you've built it.

- You have at least 10+ years of experience in risk management, insurance, or a closely adjacent function

- At the same time, you’re excited to build. You thrive in ambiguity and are excited to help scale a function at a rapidly growing company

- You think commercially. Insurance is both a cost to be optimized and a risk management tool to be wielded. You understand both sides and can make trade-offs that hold up to scrutiny

- You are analytical and data-driven. You leverage claims, litigation, and operational insights to identify trends, evaluate risk, and drive decisions that improve outcomes and reduce costs

- You are operationally minded. You know how to translate strategy into process, headcount, and tooling and how to do it in a way that scales

- You are hands-on and low ego — no task is too small if it helps contributes to Via’s success

Compensation and Benefits:

- Final salary will be determined by the candidate's experience, knowledge, and skills. Salary reflected does not include equity or variable pay, where applicable.

- Salary Range: $200,000 - $300,000 / year

- We are proud to offer a generous and comprehensive benefits package, including free medical plans and 401K matching.

israel.title: Hub Manager (German-speaking)
israel.description:
Via has the mission to improve transportation and mobility around the world. From changing a single person’s daily commute to reducing humanity’s collective environmental footprint — we’ve got huge goals.

As a Hub Manager on Via’s Operations team, you are the force that keeps our services running reliably for the communities that depend on them. This is a high-ownership, boots-on-the-ground role where you’ll lead the daily operations of our on-demand RMV services across the greater Frankfurt area, tackle real-time challenges, drive optimization, and ensure our riders are transported safely and reliably.

A big part of the role is optimizing how our field team and service operate: using data to quickly answer operational questions, identify opportunities, improve processes, and lead AI and automation projects. You’ll have a unique opportunity to combine hands-on operations with innovation and help shape the future of on-demand passenger transportation in the region.

This role is based in the greater Frankfurt area, with the expectation that you will be on-site at least 3 days per week

What You’ll Do:

- Run daily onsite operations, ensuring safe, reliable, and accessible transportation for our riders.

- Drive continuous optimization across the field team and service, leveraging data, technology, AI, and automation — including leading AI projects from idea to implementation.

- Make real-time decisions on fleet, driver supply, compliance, rider needs, and unexpected issues — using data to quickly diagnose problems and keep service running smoothly.

- Guide and support drivers, building strong relationships and identifying opportunities to improve field team performance.

- Turn rider and community feedback into actionable improvements, using data to spot patterns and address root causes.

- Act as the bridge between Via's partners, drivers, and Via central teams, quickly pulling data to answer questions, solve problems, and drive improvements.

Who You Are:

- Operationally experienced in people management, logistics, customer service, or other process-oriented work.

- Relationship-oriented and a strong communicator, able to build trust with drivers, riders, teammates, and city partners and find the right tone at every level.

- Hands-on and proactive, comfortable taking responsibility for employees, being in the field, and solving problems where they happen — even under pressure.

- Data-driven, structured, and digitally savvy, using analytics and AI tools to solve problems, prioritize effectively, and improve our services.

- Tactical and strategic, able to tackle issues in real time while thinking ahead and building solutions that prevent them from recurring.

- You have a proficiency level of at least C1 in both German and English.

- You have a valid drivers license in Germany, class B.

What We Offer:

- Base salary range: €45-55k. Final salary will be determined by the candidate’s experience, knowledge, and skills

- An international team, who stands for social impact

- Company pension scheme (bAV) with a 20% employer contribution

- Urban Sports Club membership

- 30 days of vacation per year

israel.title: Hub Manager (m/w/d)
israel.description:
Via hat die Mission, Mobilität auf der ganzen Welt zu verbessern. Von der Optimierung des täglichen Arbeitswegs einer einzelnen Person bis hin zur Verringerung des ökologischen Fußabdrucks der Menschheit – wir haben große Ziele.

Als Hub Manager (m/w/d) im Operations-Team von Via bist Du die treibende Kraft, die unsere Services für die Menschen, die auf sie angewiesen sind, zuverlässig am Laufen hält. Dies ist eine Rolle mit hoher Eigenverantwortung und direktem Bezug zum operativen Geschäft, in der Du das Tagesgeschäft unserer On-Demand-RMV-Services im Großraum Frankfurt leitest, Herausforderungen in Echtzeit löst und sicherstellst, dass unsere Fahrgäste sicher und zuverlässig befördert werden.

Ein wichtiger Teil der Rolle ist die Optimierung unseres Field-Teams und Services: Du nutzt Daten, um operative Fragen schnell zu beantworten, Potenziale zu identifizieren, Prozesse zu verbessern und KI- sowie Automatisierungsprojekte zu leiten. Du hast die einzigartige Möglichkeit, operatives Tagesgeschäft mit Innovation zu verbinden und die Zukunft der On-Demand-Personenbeförderung in der Region aktiv mitzugestalten.

Diese Rolle ist im Großraum Frankfurt angesiedelt - wir erwarten, dass Du mindestens 3 Tage pro Woche vor Ort bist.

Deine Aufgaben:

- Du führst das tägliche operative Geschäft und sorgst für sicheren, zuverlässigen und barrierefreien Transport für unsere Fahrgäste.

- Du treibst die kontinuierliche Optimierung von Field-Team und Service voran – durch Daten, Technologie, KI und Automatisierung, inklusive der Leitung von KI-Projekten von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung.

- Du triffst Echtzeit-Entscheidungen zu Fuhrpark, Fahrerverfügbarkeit, Compliance, Fahrgastbedürfnissen und unerwarteten Problemen – und nutzt Daten, um Probleme schnell zu diagnostizieren und den Service am Laufen zu halten.

- Du begleitest und unterstützt unser Fahrpersonal, baust starke Beziehungen auf und identifizierst Möglichkeiten zur Verbesserung der Team-Performance.

- Du wandelst Feedback von Fahrgästen und Community in konkrete Verbesserungen um, indem du mithilfe von Daten Muster erkennst und Ursachen angehst.

- Du bist das Bindeglied zwischen Via's Partnern, Fahrpersonal und zentralen Via-Teams, ziehst schnell Daten heran, um Fragen zu beantworten, Probleme zu lösen und Verbesserungen voranzutreiben.

Das bringst Du mit:

- Du bringst operative Erfahrung im Personalmanagement, in der Logistik, im Kundenservice oder anderen prozessorientierten Tätigkeitsfeldern mit.

- Du bist beziehungsorientiert und ein starker Kommunikator, der Vertrauen zu Fahrpersonal, Fahrgästen, Teamkolleg:innen und städtischen Partnern aufbaut und auf jeder Ebene den richtigen Ton trifft.

- Du bist hands-on und proaktiv, übernimmst gerne Verantwortung für Mitarbeitende, bist gerne im operativen Geschäft unterwegs und löst Probleme dort, wo sie entstehen – auch unter Druck.

- Du arbeitest datengetrieben, strukturiert und digital versiert, nutzt Analyse- und KI-Tools, um Probleme zu lösen, effektiv zu priorisieren und unsere Services zu verbessern.

- Du denkst taktisch wie strategisch, kannst Probleme in Echtzeit lösen und gleichzeitig vorausschauend Lösungen entwickeln, die ein erneutes Auftreten verhindern.

- Du verfügst über Sprachkenntnisse in Deutsch und Englisch auf mindestens C1-Niveau.

- Du hast einen gültigen deutschen Führerschein der Klasse B.

Vergütung & Benefits:

- Gehaltsspanne: zwischen 45.000 und 55.000 € pro Jahr

- Ein internationales Team, das für sozialen Nutzen steht

- Betriebliche Altersvorsorge (bAV) mit 20 % Arbeitgeberzuschuss

- Mitgliedschaft im Urban Sports Club

- 30 Urlaubstage pro Jahr

Es gab noch nie einen spannenderen Zeitpunkt, um an der Spitze der öffentlichen Mobilität zu stehen.

Bereit für die Fahrt?

Wir wertschätzen Vielfalt und begrüßen alle Bewerbungen unabhängig von Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion/Weltanschauung, Behinderung, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität.

israel.title: Launch Associate Principal
israel.description:
Via is using technology to transform transportation around the world. From changing a single person’s daily commute to reducing humanity’s collective environmental footprint — we’ve got huge goals.

As a Launch Associate Principal, you will sit at the intersection of operational strategy and execution, launching a growing pipeline of new, complex services across markets. For each launch, you will serve as the leader of a transit network transformation; taking full ownership of the technology and operational transition, service performance, partner relationships, and a 30+ frontline team. You will be setting up Via's newest services in high-visibility markets that require building new operational systems from the ground up, not just managing existing ones. The decisions you make here will shape how the market runs for years.

This is a unique leadership and operating opportunity for anyone who is eager to lead and launch  high-stakes, high-visibility, and high-impact new markets at Via. The role is excellent for a generalist looking for exposure in strategy, operations and product/technology.

This role requires a willingness to travel up to 40% of the time.

About the Role:

- Launch & Service Performance

- Own and manage launch of new Via services, from technology implementation to operational setup

- Define and manage against KPIs spanning on-time performance, rider satisfaction, safety, and cost efficiency

- Translate weekly and monthly performance data into decisions

- People Leadership

- Lead a 30+ team of field operators and drivers during the launch transition, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and culture setting

- Build an operation where people feel accountable, supported, and proud of what they're delivering

- Hire, develop and train frontline leaders who will run the long-term operations

- Partner & Stakeholder Management

- Own Via's relationship with the transit agency partner, a public entity with its own board, elected officials, and community accountability

- Represent Via to community stakeholders, local officials, and riders

- Operational Excellence

- Drive continuous improvement across vehicle operations, maintenance protocols, and service delivery

- Identify and execute cost and efficiency improvements that strengthen margin without compromising service

- Product Development

- Influence the product roadmap for Via's newest product lines

About You:

- Minimum of 3+ years of experience in operations, consulting, strategy, tech or a field with meaningful client accountability and a demonstrated ability to lead big projects and develop teams

- Ownership mentality: You get things done. You plan ahead, manage risks and design processes that prevent things from going wrong and, if they still do, you find what’s going wrong, own it, and fix it

- Leadership instinct and experience: You know how to motivate and inspire individuals, from drivers all the way to a transit agency’s CEO

- Effective at managing multiple tasks simultaneously: You can delegate, prioritize, and take responsibility.

- Attention to detail and operational judgment: No detail is too small, and nothing gets passed you. You're equally comfortable in a spreadsheet as in the field

- Partner and stakeholder sophistication: You know how to manage relationships that are complex, high-stakes, and not fully in your control

- Mission alignment that goes beyond the talking points: You embrace that Via's partners are public agencies serving communities that often don't have other options

- Flexible and adaptable: You love the challenge of adapting to change rapidly and making things work on the fly

Compensation and Benefits:

- Final salary will be determined by the candidate’s experience, knowledge, and skills. Salary reflected does not include equity or variable pay, where applicable

- Salary Range: $95,000-$115,000

- We are proud to offer a generous and comprehensive benefits package, including free medical plans, 401K matching, catered lunch on Wednesdays, and many other perks.

There has never been a more exciting time to be on the cutting edge of public mobility. Ready to join the ride?

Via is an equal opportunity employer.

israel.title: Motion & AI Video Designer (Via, Remix, Citymapper)
israel.description:
Via is using technology to transform transportation around the world. From changing a single person’s daily commute to reducing humanity’s collective environmental footprint — we’ve got huge goals.

As a Motion & AI Video Designer (Via, Remix, Citymapper), you’ll bring our brands and products to life through bold videos and motion graphics moving people’s hearts and minds. This role is based in New York City and reports directly to the Creative Director of our in-house studio. The studio is responsible for elevating Via, Citymapper and Remix brands, and delivering communications to our riders, commercial partners and investors across all channels. We care about the quality of your output and your ability to create with AI-native workflows, regardless of your years of formal experience. Candidates of all levels are welcome to apply. Join us to design the future of transportation and take the brand to the next level.

What You'll Do:

- Turn information into stories: Lead high-stakes projects, transforming complex information into clear, impactful motion narratives that drive outcomes for B2G or B2C audiences.

- Create Via’s first Motion Design System: Document and build a comprehensive library of motion patterns and kinetic behaviors that scale across our marketing and product touchpoints.

- Establish AI-native workflows: Use AI to elevate our creativity, scale our output and reduce production cycles.

- Bring interactive products to life: Bridge the gap between marketing and product by designing delightful micro-interactions and UX motion. Implement animations natively using tools like Lottie or Rive.

- Cross-functional collaboration: Work with stakeholders (marketing, business, product) to manage and execute projects internally, or with video production partners.

- Mentorship and development: Support creative peers so they develop their understanding of motion and AI craft to elevate the entire design organization.

Who You Are:

- A world-class motion and video designer with a portfolio demonstrating exceptional talent, regardless of your years of formal experience. You understand foundational animation principles (timing, physics, easing, weight).

- An expert in translating complex technical concepts (i.e., data science visualizations, technical product infrastructure flows, process optimization algorithms) into intuitive and impactful motion graphics.

- A big-picture thinker who can seamlessly move between high-level conceptualization and pixel-perfect execution, under tight deadlines.

- An expert at generative AI motion and keep refining your Claude / Gemini set-up.

- You know which model to pick to get the best out of a project (Nano Banana, Runway, Kling, Seedance).

- You have experimented with node-based generative workflow (ComfyUI, Krea.ai, Weave) and understand the best creative workflow for a given project.

- Proficient with After Effects and the Creative Suite, and interaction design tools like Rive.

- Understanding of 3d softwares like Cinema 4D/Blender is welcome.

What Catches Our Eye:

- A great reel: We care about the quality of the output, not the number of years on your resume.

- Great stories: Move hearts & minds.

- AI workflows: We look for examples or case studies showing how you've integrated AI tools into a professional pipeline to drastically reduce production time while increasing visual impact.

- Systems over standalones: Evidence of having built and documented comprehensive Motion Design Systems.

- Motion into Interaction design: Real-world examples of your motion work living natively inside a digital product or app.

- An obsession with the details: An uncompromising eye for the invisible elements of motion: perfect easing curves, realistic physics, rhythmic timing, and weight.

- Final salary will be determined by the candidate’s experience, knowledge, and skills. Salary reflected does not include equity or variable pay, where applicable

- Salary Range: $85,000 - $160,000 per year

- We are proud to offer a generous and comprehensive benefits package, including free medical plans and 401K matching.

israel.title: On - Demand Driver
israel.description:
Sioux Area Metro is South Dakota’s largest transportation provider. Our mission is to have a positive social and economic impact on the community by providing a safe and reliable transportation option for all who live, work, or play in Sioux Falls.

As an On-Demand Driver at SAM by Via, you will drive buses and provide outstanding customer service to riders in the immediate Sioux Falls area.

What You’ll Do:

- Drive vehicles in heavy or light city and highway traffic, in all conditions, and following all rules and regulations in a productive and timely manner

- Safely and courteously, operate lift-equipped vehicles to transport elderly and/or disabled persons

- Learn the fundamentals of SAM by Via operations and related safety procedures

- Perform the routine operation of agency vehicles

Who You Are:

- Possess good knowledge of the city

- Able to follow written and verbal instruction

- Able to operate a bus within standard safety guidelines to ensure public safety

- Able to deal effectively and courteously with all customers and the public

- Hold a valid SD driver’s license

- Able to pass a pre-employment physical

- Pass a drug screening and background check: no felonies, clean MVR, no DUI/DWI or reckless driving convictions, and no more than 2 speeding tickets

- At least 25 years old

- Able to apply in person at the Sioux Area Metro office

Compensation and Benefits

- Final salary will be determined by the candidate’s experience, knowledge, and skills.

- Salary Range: Starting at $22.50/hour during training/probation with increases up to $25.00

- Benefits include health, dental, and life insurance, 401K with up to 6% company match, holiday pay, vacation, and bonus days

Founded in 2012, Via pioneered the TransitTech category by using new technologies to develop public mobility systems — optimizing networks of buses, shuttles, wheelchair accessible vehicles, school buses, autonomous vehicles, and electric vehicles around the globe.

Building the world's most efficient, equitable, and sustainable transportation network for all passengers — including those with limited mobility, those without smartphones, and unbanked populations — Via works with its partners to lower the costs of public transit while providing transportation options that rival the convenience of a personal car while reducing environmental impact.

At the intersection of transportation and technology, Via is a visionary market leader that combines software innovation with sophisticated service design and operational expertise to fundamentally improve the way the world moves, providing technology in 650 communities and more than 35 countries and counting.

israel.title: Operations Manager
israel.description:
Via is on a mission to create public transportation systems that provide greater access to jobs, healthcare, and education. Our platform serves as the technology backbone for modern transit networks, transforming antiquated and siloed public transportation systems into smart, data-driven, and efficient digital networks. With hundreds of agency partners around the world, Via is recognized as the leading transportation technology and service provider globally.

As an Operations Manager at Via, you are the force that keeps our services running reliably for the communities that depend on them. This is a high ownership, boots-on-the-ground role where you’ll lead daily operations, tackle real-time challenges, and continuously elevate the rider and driver experience.

**This is a fully in-person position with the expectation that you will be onsite 4-5 days per week in Rochester, Minnesota.**

What You’ll Do:

- Run the daily onsite operations of our service. You’ll make sure our operations run smoothly to provide our riders with safe, reliable, and accessible transportation

- Make informed, real-time decisions about fleet, driver supply, compliance, rider needs, and unexpected issues - stepping in quickly to ensure continuously excellent and dependable service

- Guide and support drivers - building strong relationships, addressing concerns, and ensuring they feel equipped to deliver great service

- Turn rider and community feedback into tangible improvements, spotting patterns and collaborating with internal teams to make thoughtful and actionable operational improvements

- Use data and technology to understand service performance, diagnose problems, and implement solutions that enhance efficiency and rider experience

- Act as the operational bridge between city partners, drivers, and Via central teams to help bring the community's goals to life

Who You Are:

- Operationally experienced, with a background in people management, logistics, customer service, or process-oriented work

- Relationship oriented, earning trust from drivers, riders, teammates, and city partners through clear communication and follow-through

- Hands-on and proactive, preferring to be in the field, learning the service firsthand, and solving problems where they happen

- Tactical and strategic, able to problem-solve issues as they come up but also think long term about solutions to mitigate these occurrences

- Mission driven, motivated by expanding access to transportation and improving how communities move

- You possess a deep understanding of the unique challenges of fixed-route transit, including managing time-point adherence, breakdown escalations, and the logistical complexities of run scheduling for large-scale operations

- You are comfortable working around Class B/Class A vehicles and understand the specific safety, maintenance, and maneuvering requirements associated with 35-to-45-foot coach buses

- You have a proven track record of managing and retaining professional CDL drivers, emphasizing a culture of safety and compliance (DOT/FMCSA) while maintaining high morale in a high-pressure, scheduled environment

- Based in Rochester, MN ready to be onsite 4–5 days a week

Compensation and Benefits:

- Final salary will be determined by the candidate’s experience, knowledge, and skills. Salary reflected does not include equity or variable pay, where applicable.

- Salary Range: $75,000-$90,000 / per year.

- We are proud to offer a generous and comprehensive benefits package, including free medical plans and 401K matching.

Via is an equal opportunity employer.

As an Operations Manager, Autonomous Vehicle Projects on Via’s Operations team, you are the force that keeps our services running reliably for the communities that depend on them. This is a high-ownership role where you’ll lead daily operations, optimize accessible transit networks, and support initiatives for Via’s growing portfolio of autonomous and specialized Wheelchair Accessible Vehicle (WAV) fleets.

This is a field position with an expectation that you will be onsite at local services several days per week.  There will also be monthly travel to services located across the United States.

What You’ll Do:

- Run the daily onsite operations of our service, ensuring our fleets operate smoothly to provide riders with safe, reliable, and fully accessible transportation.

- Make informed, real-time decisions regarding fleet availability, WAV compliance, rider accessibility needs, and unexpected issues—stepping in quickly to ensure continuously excellent, dependable service.

- Turn rider, mobility-advocate, and community feedback into tangible operational improvements, addressing accessibility friction points and collaborating with internal teams to enhance the WAV rider experience.

- Use data and technology to analyze ridership trends, service performance, and fleet utilization, spearheading operational solutions that maximize transit efficiency and rider independence.

- Act as the operational bridge between local partners, safety drivers, third-party operators, and Via central teams to elevate accessible mobility standards across all markets.

- Serve as the primary operational point of contact for Via’s AV partners and local operators, maintaining proactive, ongoing communication to deliver on service goals and resolve operational issues as they arise.

- Travel to key markets to lead driver onboarding and specialized WAV safety/securement training, while establishing strong operational relationships with local disability advocate groups and transit partners.

Who You Are:

- Excited to bring about the future of transit and the opportunity to travel

- Operationally experienced, with a background in people management, logistics, customer service, or process-oriented work (experience with paratransit, Non-emergency Medical Transport, or WAV fleets is a strong plus).

- Relationship-oriented, earning trust from riders, accessibility advocates, teammates, and external partners through empathetic, clear communication and follow-through.

- Hands-on and proactive, eager to understand the end-to-end WAV rider journey firsthand and solve mobility challenges right where they happen.

- Tactical and strategic, capable of triaging live operational issues while building long-term processes that safeguard service quality and accessibility compliance.

- Mission-driven, deeply motivated by expanding equitable transit access and transforming how communities move.

- Based in the DFW area, able to be on-site and in-office when needed.

- Final salary will be determined by the candidate’s experience, knowledge, and skills. Salary reflected does not include equity or variable pay, where applicable.

- Salary Range: $65,000–$80,000 / per year.

israel.title: Partnership Proposals Lead

As a Partnership Proposals Lead at Via, you'll craft persuasive, exceptionally-written proposals that forge new partnerships with cities, transit agencies, and other public transit providers. Working with members of Via’s Strategy and executive leadership teams, you will develop a deep understanding of our customers' needs and goals, become an expert in Via’s unique positioning as a technology partner, and own high-quality written proposals for transformative mobility services. Partnership Proposals Leads gain wide-ranging experience in Via's products and services; no specific experience in technology or public transit services is required.

What You'll Do:

- Hone your strategic thinking skills by coordinating with Via’s Partnerships, Expansion, and Finance teams to develop strategies for winning high-stakes, competitive procurements.

- Become an expert in Via’s technology and product offerings, absorbing complex, sometimes technical specifications and distilling information into clear, easily-digestible prose for both internal and external audiences.

- Write, review, and copy-edit comprehensive long-form narrative proposals for potential partners.

- Generate compelling original content by ascertaining an audience’s needs and deploying your familiarity with Via’s technology and operational capabilities, transit norms, and the latest innovations from across the industry.

- Lead competitive procurements from beginning to end -- through evaluation, creation of exceptional proposal content, review, and submission.

- Conduct rigorous research by analyzing news stories, new service announcements, scopes of work, city histories, and other forms of information and synthesizing findings into insightful commentary.

- Skillfully manage communications with potential partners over the phone and email.

Who You Are:

- You’re meticulous and thoughtful. You can pay attention to every detail in a complex project while, at the same time, relating each of them to the big picture in a coherent way. You can see the forest and the trees.

If you've won awards for your writing, that's a plus!

- You’re data-savvy and believe in evidence-based arguments. You excel at crafting compelling narratives using a wide range of quantitative and qualitative metrics.

- Become an expert on our Via software and book rides for our passengers, serving as the first point of contact and helping hand for our riders

- Thrive in a fast-paced environment tackling an array of customer issues.

- Deliver above-and-beyond customer service to our driver-partners, finding new and interesting ways to make customers smile.

- A well-rounded team player who takes ownership of (and pride in) your work

- Dynamic; willing to wear multiple hats and work on projects of all types

- Strong leadership skills with the ability to mentor and guide drivers.

- Strong communication skills for effective feedback delivery and conflict resolution.

- Final salary will be determined by the candidate’s experience, knowledge, and skills. Salary reflected does not include equity or variable pay, where applicable

israel.description:
Via is using technology to transform transportation around the world. From changing a single person’s daily commute to reducing humanity’s collective environmental footprint - we’ve got huge goals.

As a Senior Platform Engineer at Via, you’ll join our R&D center in TLV. You’ll be part of a team of developers and devops engineers, directly contributing to our product by using cutting-edge technologies. You’ll take a critical part in our mission to shape the future of transportation, affecting tens of thousands of riders daily worldwide.

The Platform Group is a cross-functional group dedicated to building and maintaining the robust foundation on which Via operates. This team is responsible for designing, implementing, and managing cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes clusters, CI/CD systems, and tools that empower our development and production environments.

With a focus on enhancing developer experience, operational efficiency, and reliability, the team drives initiatives that:

- Design and implement scalable and secure cloud infrastructure.

- Develop and maintain Kubernetes clusters and related tools, ensuring high availability and performance.

- Manage edge gateways, WAF solutions, and other critical infrastructure components.

- Define and enforce CI/CD standards to streamline development and delivery workflows

- Build tools and automation to enhance productivity across engineering teams.

- Ensure the reliability, security, and scalability of production infrastructure.

What You’ll Do:

- Define infrastructure standards for dev teams

- Design, implement and develop tools for controlling infrastructure of micro services

- Build CI/CD automation and templates with GitLab

- Build, maintain and operate AWS and Kubernetes infrastructure

- Develop and maintain an in-depth understanding of the applications and architecture at Via

- Work in contact with other teams across the company to ensure smooth and documented changes to all environments

- Identify and resolve problems in mission-critical services, automating remediation procedures to prevent recurrences

- Bring ideas to the table, take ownership over their project timelines and deliverables and help us scale

Who You Are:

- BSc. Computer Science or similar.

- 5+ years of professional experience in backend or full-stack development in a product development team. Object oriented programming programming experience is required.

- 3+ years experience as Devops/SRE in a production environment

- 2+ years experience with containers, Kubernetes, Helm, Argo CD

- 2+ years experience with AWS or GCP/Azure

- 1+ years experience with CICD - GitLab/Jenkins/Github actions/etc.

- Experience with networking, distributed systems, SQL and NoSQL databases

- Experience with Unix/Linux operating systems internals and administration

- Fluent in English language

- Advantage - Experienced with declarative IaC tools like Terraform, Cloudformation or Pulumi

- Commitment to a collaborative environment infused with professionalism, integrity, passion, and accountability

Compensation and Benefits

- Our product impacts millions of users around the world  providing alternative transport solutions that are more: efficient and accessible, changing cities to make them greener.

- Competitive compensation package which includes base salary and equity.

- Health insurance with a discount for family members.

- Hybrid work and a lovely office situated in the heart of TLV, in Midtown, close to the light rail and train station.

israel.title: Senior/Principal Product Designer, Public Transit Operations (Multiple Roles)
israel.description:
Redesign the operating system for public transit.

Via is a global leader in smart public transportation, using technology to change how the world moves. Our Transit Operations platform powers on-demand, paratransit, school bus, and fixed-line service for public agencies, reaching hundreds of thousands of riders every week. For many of them, public transit isn't a convenience. It's how they get to a job, a hospital, or a classroom.

Checklists are where public-sector software starts. They shouldn't be where it stops. The real test is whether a dispatcher can fix a missed pickup in seconds, or whether a rider with a disability can book a trip without a phone call. Our users span paratransit eligibility managers, call center agents, dispatchers, and agency leaders, plus the riders, caregivers, and students on the other end. Each one deserves a product that's insights-first, obvious to use, and delightful, especially the communities with the fewest alternatives.

This is your chance to redesign a complex, mission-critical platform with usability and delight as the bar. You'll also drive how design itself can be AI-led, moving from static mockups to rapid prototypes to production-ready code, working side by side with engineers. This isn't AI for AI's sake. It's a way to democratize great design and ship better real-world outcomes for the people who rely on transit most.

The Product org is investing in Design and is looking for multiple candidates with varying degree of experience - this is a fast and growing team!

What You'll Do:

- Lead the redesign of our dispatch and booking platform, unifying the experience across on-demand, paratransit, school bus, and fixed-line service.

- Make every workflow insights-first, so data surfaces the right decision at the right moment instead of sitting in a report.
