israel.title: Senior Product Manager
israel.description:
Via is on a mission to create public transportation systems that provide far greater access to jobs, healthcare, and education. Our platform serves as the technology backbone for modern transit networks, transforming antiquated and siloed public transportation systems into smart, data-driven, and efficient digital networks. With hundreds of agency partners around the world, Via is recognized as the leading transportation technology and service provider globally.

About this role:

Remix is Via's premier transit planning and scheduling platform, trusted by agencies worldwide to design networks, model scenarios, and optimize service. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the Remix platform itself — its usability, scalability, and flexibility — ensuring Remix remains the most powerful and intuitive tool available to transit professionals globally.

This role sits at the center of everything Remix does. You will own the platform foundation that every module is built on, champion AI-led insights that help agencies design better service and measure real performance, and maintain the end-to-end view from planning through operations and back — ensuring data flows in ways that make each step smarter than the last. You are equally comfortable setting long-term platform direction and rolling up your sleeves to sharpen individual features and make each module best in class.

What you'll do:

- Own the Remix platform roadmap — usability, scalability, flexibility, and the cross-cutting capabilities that every module depends on

- Define and drive the vision for AI-led insights within Remix, enabling transit agencies to make data-informed decisions about service design, network performance, and operational efficiency

- Hold the end-to-end product view: from network planning through scheduling and live operations, and back into planning via performance data — ensuring the platform is a continuous feedback loop, not a collection of disconnected tools

- Identify and prioritize vertical feature investments across Remix modules, with the rigor to make each one best in class rather than broadly adequate

-  Partner with engineering and design to raise the bar on platform usability — reducing friction for planners, schedulers, and analysts without sacrificing the depth power users depend on

- Work closely with data science and engineering to define how AI and analytics capabilities are surfaced in the product — what insights matter, when they appear, and how they drive action

- Engage directly with customers to understand workflow pain points, validate priorities, and pressure-test the roadmap against real operational needs

- Stay current on industry trends, competitive products, and emerging technology to ensure Remix leads rather than follows

Who you are:

- You have 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of platform or infrastructure-layer products used in complex enterprise workflows

- You are a big-picture thinker who can articulate a multi-year platform vision while also making sharp, well-reasoned prioritization calls at the feature level

- You have strong instincts for usability and product quality — you notice when something is harder than it needs to be, and you know how to fix it without breaking what works

- You understand how AI and data products actually work in practice, and you have experience defining how analytical insights should be integrated into operational workflows in ways users trust and act on

- You can quickly become technically fluent in the underlying data models and entities that power planning and scheduling systems, and you are a credible voice in technical architecture decisions alongside your engineering partners — capable of evaluating tradeoffs and advocating for platform choices that serve both current needs and long-term scalability

- You have a track record of shipping high-quality features in complex, workflow-heavy enterprise environments where precision and reliability matter

- You are collaborative, direct, and effective at building alignment across engineering, design, data science, and go-to-market partners

- Experience in transportation, transit, logistics, or resource-intensive industries is a plus; the ability to learn a technical domain quickly is essential

Compensation and Benefits:

- Base salary range: $150,000-$220,000, determined by experience and skills. Total compensation also includes variable pay and equity.

- Comprehensive health coverage, with low-cost dental and vision plans.

- A 401(k) with a generous company match and vesting.

- Fully paid parental leave for new parents, with extended leave options.

- Additional benefits (mental health, pet insurance, and other wellness perks).

- 20 days of paid time off (PTO) annually.

There has never been a more exciting time to be on the cutting edge of public mobility.

Ready to join the ride?

Via is an equal opportunity employer.

Via is on a mission to create public transportation systems that provide far greater access to jobs, healthcare, and education. As Via’s Senior Workday Platform Architect, you’ll play a critical role in shaping and scaling the Workday ecosystem that supports our global workforce. You will serve as Via’s senior Workday expert and help us build a reliable, well-governed, and best-in-class People technology foundation.



This role is ideal for someone who has managed Workday in a large, complex organization and has worked across multiple Workday modules, business processes, integrations, and stakeholder groups. You’ll bring proven practices from mature Workday environments and apply them thoughtfully at Via—strengthening our platform architecture, improving governance, and helping our teams get more value from Workday.



You’ll partner closely with Via’s People, Payroll, Finance, and IT teams. In addition to overseeing day-to-day administration and troubleshooting, you’ll help define the long-term direction of our Workday platform and ensure that new solutions are scalable, secure, maintainable, and designed around a great employee experience.



What You’ll Do:

- Serve as Via’s senior Workday platform expert, with ownership across configuration, security, business processes, reporting, integrations, data quality, and system administration.

- Help define and implement a scalable Workday architecture and operating model, including governance, documentation, change management, testing standards, and release processes.

- Evaluate current Workday configurations and processes, identify gaps or technical debt, and recommend improvements based on experience with mature enterprise environments.

- Lead the design, configuration, testing, and deployment of solutions across multiple Workday modules, such as Core HCM, Compensation, Recruiting, Benefits, Absence, Time Tracking, Performance, Talent, and Payroll.

- Ensure that Workday business processes are efficient, consistent, compliant, and able to support Via’s continued growth and organizational complexity.

- Design, build, and maintain Workday reports, dashboards, calculated fields, and analytics that enable reliable, data-driven decision-making.

- Oversee Workday integrations with payroll, benefits, identity management, finance, recruiting, and other enterprise systems, partnering with internal teams and external vendors to ensure accuracy, reliability, and security.

- Establish strong security and access-management practices, including role-based access, segregation of duties, periodic reviews, and audit readiness.

- Lead Workday release planning by evaluating new functionality, assessing business impact, coordinating testing, documenting changes, and communicating recommendations to stakeholders.

- Maintain data integrity through proactive monitoring, recurring audits, reconciliation processes, and root-cause analysis of system or integration issues.

- Provide clear guidance and hands-on support to People team members, managers, employees, and business leaders.

- Create and maintain documentation for configurations, business processes, integrations, reports, controls, and user procedures.

- Build strong relationships with Workday, implementation partners, and other vendors while ensuring that Via retains clear internal ownership of its platform.

- Stay current on Workday capabilities, product releases, and industry practices, and help Via determine which improvements will deliver meaningful business value.

Who You Are:

- You have at least 7 years of hands-on Workday experience, including significant responsibility for administering or designing Workday within a large, complex, or global organization.

- You have deep experience with Core HCM and meaningful hands-on exposure across several additional Workday modules, such as Compensation, Recruiting, Benefits, Absence, Time Tracking, Performance, Talent, or Payroll.

- You understand how decisions in one Workday module can affect business processes, security, reporting, integrations, and downstream systems across the broader platform.

- You have experience improving an established Workday environment—not only maintaining it—and can bring practical examples of governance, architecture, process, or configuration improvements you have led.

- You have strong knowledge of Workday security, business-process configuration, reporting, calculated fields, data management, and integration concepts.

- You understand HR operations, payroll processes, compliance requirements, and the controls needed to support accurate and sensitive employee data.

- You can balance immediate business needs with long-term platform health, avoiding unnecessary customization and designing solutions that remain scalable and maintainable.

- You are comfortable advising senior stakeholders, challenging assumptions constructively, and translating complex technical topics into clear recommendations.

- You are highly detail-oriented, organized, and process-driven, with strong judgment and a clear sense of ownership.

- You thrive in a fast-paced environment, can manage competing priorities, and remain thoughtful and methodical when addressing complex issues.

We're hiring an Account Manager II to make Instacart Ads the place CPG advertisers and agencies trust to grow their business, by improving campaign performance, widening how brands invest across our ad products, and shaping the advertiser experience. This role sits at the intersection of client strategy and campaign performance, and the person who fills it will have a direct line of sight to advertiser growth and retention. You own the vision and content for these reviews, and advertisers leave knowing what to do next. You also resolve campaign and partner issues with limited guidance.

- Product and Team Influence: Advertiser pain points reach the right internal teams as specific feedback that shapes product enhancements and process improvements. You also share best practices across the category and Advertiser Success teams and lead projects that strengthen team-wide capabilities.



The secret ingredients we're looking for

You are customer-focused and analytical, comfortable influencing senior stakeholders, and energized by a fast-paced role where priorities and solutions keep evolving. You use judgment and initiative to balance immediate client needs against longer-term chances to improve products, processes, and advertiser outcomes, and you are at your best explaining complex campaign data in plain terms.

The Billing Operations Lead oversees and optimizes the end-to-end billing lifecycle across all Instacart Marketplace retailers, ensuring accurate invoicing, compliance with financial controls, and timely month-end close. This role serves as the operational and strategic anchor for the billing team, partnering closely with Finance, BD, Financial Systems, Legal, Product, and Engineering to drive accuracy, scalability, and continuous improvement.

What you'll cook up in your first year

- Billing portfolios across strategic retail partners and multiple revenue streams are owned and operating accurately, with day-to-day billing operations executed with a focus on revenue recognition inputs and timely month-end close.

- Billing policies, SOPs, and quality standards are developed and maintained, with discrepancies and escalations resolved in close partnership with Finance Systems, BD, and Revenue.

- Dashboards, reporting, and KPIs that track billing health are built in collaboration with Finance Systems, enabling continuous improvement and proactive identification of issues.

- Billing system enhancements, integrations, and automation opportunities are scoped and delivered in partnership with Product and Engineering, reducing manual workload and improving operational scalability.

- Internal controls, audit requirements, and contractual billing terms are enforced, with junior team members mentored and billing operations scaled to support Instacart's growth.



The secret ingredients we're looking for

Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications)

- Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.

- 5+ years of experience in Billing Operations, Order-to-Cash, or Accounts Receivable within technology, ecommerce, marketplace, or subscription/SaaS environments.

- 2+ years leading cross-functional billing or quote-to-cash projects as an individual contributor, from requirements through UAT and launch.

- Hands-on experience with Salesforce CPQ and at least one billing platform (e.g., Zuora, Chargebee, Stripe Billing) plus one ERP (e.g., NetSuite, SAP, Oracle).

- Proficiency in Excel (pivot tables, lookups) and basic SQL for reconciliations and data analysis.

- Working knowledge of billing controls, SOX requirements, and revenue considerations (e.g., ASC 606) as they apply to invoicing, credits, and adjustments.



Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications)

- Demonstrated success leveraging data modeling tools such as Alteryx to automate billing processes.

- Aptitude and demonstrated success leveraging AI solutions to improve billing processes.

Instacart's mission is to create a world where everyone has access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Online Grocery is the heart of that mission — the products millions of customers rely on every day and the team that builds them. We're looking for a Chief of Staff, Online Grocery to partner with the General Manager who leads this business and its product and R&D organization of ~200 people across product, design, research and technical program management.

People, operations and programs are the core of the work — but what should energize you is what that work makes possible. A Chief of Staff here helps the organization operate at its best: more cohesive, clearer in its purpose, sharper and faster in how it makes decisions and operates, and enabled to do the thing that matters most — building products our customers love. If you're motivated by improving how a team works, and serve as a multiplier on everything the team can ship, this is your role.

This is a highly strategic and operational individual-contributor role (no direct reports) for someone exceptionally organized, has strong business and strategic sense, high in empathy, and who has an understanding of how product, design, and engineering teams work.

About the Job

Run the operating rhythm

- Own and continuously improve the business rhythm for the GM and the organization — leadership team syncs, all-team meetings, monthly and quarterly business reviews, planning reviews, organizational communications, and Online Grocery segments of company-wide all-hands.

- Manage the operating cadence for the GM — prioritizing and delegating workstreams, ensuring the right things get the right attention at the right time.

- Improve how the organization decides: clarify decision rights and the questions that matter, build the frameworks and pre-reads that bring options into focus, and remove the friction that slows good calls.

- Once decisions are made, capture and sharpen them, ensure they're communicated to the right stakeholders, and close the loop on execution — keeping leadership priorities, decisions, and commitments visible and on track (R&D execution itself is owned by TPM).

- Shape and run the substance of the leadership team offsites: objectives, agenda, pre-reads, the hard discussions, decisions, and follow-through (logistics and events are handled separately).

- Be a trusted thought partner to the GM and a credible problem-solving partner to product and R&D leaders, and build strong relationships with chiefs of staff across the organization to partner effectively in getting your responsibilities done.

- Prepare briefings and coordinate research for the GM's meetings with partners and key leaders — identifying goals, talking points, and relevant context.

- Partner with the GM, HR and finance to manage the organization's headcount budget

Plan executive communication

- Drive the calendar, planning, and content for upward communication and alignment with the C-suite and the board on Online Grocery priorities.

- Support the GM in preparing content for speaking engagements (working with our comms team).

Strengthen people, culture, and organizational health

- Help the GM spot, diagnose, and get ahead of issues across the organization — bringing structured, candid read-outs and early signals, not just status.

- Partner with the GM and HR to address relationship and culture dynamics across the team and create a high-trust, high-performance leadership team culture.

- Turn signals like engagement surveys into action — working across the organization to develop the right plans, pressure-test them, and ensure they get executed and the loop gets closed with teams.

Drive priority programs

- Help the GM kick off and drive annual and long-range planning for Online Grocery.

- Take ambiguous new efforts for the GM from unclear to fully underway — creating clarity and a plan, identifying DRIs, setting up the decisions that need to be made, aligning stakeholders, and developing the right operating rhythm to track progress.

- Proactively identify and take ownership of emerging opportunities and risks before they become blockers.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

- 10+ years of work experience

- R&D experience — earned in a direct R&D role (product, design, engineering, or technical program management), an adjacent role embedded with R&D teams, or as a Chief of Staff within an R&D organization

- Consulting, corporate strategy/operations, or finance background and experience working directly with executives

- Working fluency to navigate a product, design, and engineering organization at scale, and to be a true problem-solving partner to R&D leaders rather than a coordinator.

- High EQ and a genuinely people-oriented instinct — builds trusted relationships, reads organizational dynamics, and bridges leadership and teams.

- Outstanding written and verbal communication at an executive level

- Strong analytical skills, and a commitment to consistently high-quality work.

- Exceptional program management: organized, effective, and relentless at driving multiple hard initiatives forward to deadline at once.

- Ability to travel 10%

Preferred Experience

- Experience designing and facilitating leadership offsites and driving organizational, culture, or operating-model change.

- Experience building with AI (e.g., prototypes, automations, or agents) in a professional setting.

- Experience within high-growth, technology-driven companies.

People, operations and programs are the core of the work — but what should energize you is what that work makes possible. A Chief of Staff here helps the organization operate at its best: more cohesive, clearer in its purpose, sharper and faster in how it makes decisions and operates, and enabled to do the thing that matters most — building products our customers love. If you're motivated by improving how a team works, and serve as a multiplier on everything the team can ship, this is your role.

This is a highly strategic and operational individual-contributor role (no direct reports) for someone exceptionally organized, has strong business and strategic sense, high in empathy, and who has an understanding of how product, design, and engineering teams work.

About the Job

Run the operating rhythm

- Own and continuously improve the business rhythm for the GM and the organization — leadership team syncs, all-team meetings, monthly and quarterly business reviews, planning reviews, organizational communications, and Online Grocery segments of company-wide all-hands.

- Manage the operating cadence for the GM — prioritizing and delegating workstreams, ensuring the right things get the right attention at the right time.

- Improve how the organization decides: clarify decision rights and the questions that matter, build the frameworks and pre-reads that bring options into focus, and remove the friction that slows good calls.

Instacart's Sales organization is at an inflection point. New products, pricing models, and acquisitions are making every deal more complex, and the processes behind them need to scale just as fast. - Cross-Functional Partnership: Sales, Finance, Tax, and Legal work from one shared playbook, and teams across Instacart are trained on deal best practices and know exactly when and how to engage Deal Desk.

- Scalable New Programs: New products, pricing models, and acquisitions are operationalized from day one. Each is owned from kickoff to rollout, with processes in place before volume arrives.

You're proactive, tactful, and detail-obsessed: someone who spots problems before they land and arrives with a proposed solution. You're humble, professional, and positive with stakeholders, driven by doing the right thing, finding win-win outcomes, and being both efficient and thorough. You build trust easily in a remote environment, work independently, and stay flexible as priorities shift, thriving in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial setting inside a large company.

- Develop, tune, document, and maintain detection logic across multiple log sources including endpoint, cloud, container, and SaaS products.

- Assist in cyber forensic investigations across a variety of log sources

- Optimize log ingestion pipelines and telemetry collection to ensure high-quality, actionable security data while managing volume and cost

- Design and build SOAR playbooks and automation workflows to streamline detection triage, enrichment, and response actions

- Mentor/knowledge share with other detection engineers on threat hunting methodologies, detection logic development, and investigation techniques

About You

Minimum Qualifications

- 2+ years of experience in a detection engineering, incident response, or offensive security role.

- Experience with 1 or more public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)

- Deep understanding of attacker TTPs across modern zero trust environments, including identity compromise, token theft, and abuse of trust boundaries

- Proficient understanding of macOS internals and telemetry available to identify macOS specific threats

- Experience implementing detection-as-code workflows including version control, peer review processes, automated testing, and CI/CD deployment pipelines

- Basic proficiency with Python, Golang, or other programming/scripting languages

- Relevant certifications: GCFA, GCFE, GNFA, GREM, OSCP, GCIA, or similar

Overview

Instacart's Enterprise Solutions team partners with Global grocery and retail chains to power their digital commerce through StorefrontPro, Enterprise API (Fulfillment and Ads), CarrotAds, and adjacent Enterprise Solutions  products. We're seeking a Director, Customer Success to lead the  Customer Success organization — accountable for post-live value realization  across the enterprise software portfolio.

In this highly visible role, you will lead senior managers and Customer Success Managers who serve as the strategic advisor of Instacart to retailer executives. You'll own retailer value realization, measured through adoption velocity, time-to-value, health score coverage, at-risk portfolio management, CSAT, and QBR quality across the portfolio. You'll partner closely with Business Development, who owns NRR, GRR, and expansion, by providing account health, risk signal, and expansion readiness. You'll also partner with Enterprise Solutions Delivery, Technology leadership, and Product on portfolio strategy, retailer signal, and roadmap adoption.

This is a roll-up-your-sleeves leadership opportunity for someone who has personally led the transformation of CS from reactive enablement toward proactive business advisory, can hire and develop senior consultative talent, and thrives in a fast-paced, BD-led commercial environment with shared standards rather than rigid process. The role reports to the Senior Director, Enterprise Solutions , and is remote across the United States and Canada with a preference for proximity to Toronto for key cross-functional collaboration.

About the Job

- Lead the Customer Success organization for the Enterprise Solutions  portfolio — owning value realization,  outcomes end to end, and partner closely with BD, who owns NRR, GRR, and expansion, by providing account health, risk signal, and expansion readiness.Build and develop a senior consultative CS bench by hiring, sponsoring, and ramping Customer Success Managers  who engage with retailer executives on ecommerce strategy, merchandising, and operations and who can credibly influence retailer P&L outcomes and roadmap adoption.

- Manage senior managers leading segments, setting standards for what good looks like across the CSM’s  — including QBR quality, growth planning, executive engagement, and renewal execution.

- Operate in a BD-led commercial environment as a true commercial peer to BD — preserving BD's ownership of the primary commercial relationship while owning post-sale accountability and surfacing churn, expansion, and escalation signal early and clearly.

- Partner with the Director of Enterprise Architecture & Engineering on shared-account coordination — ensuring the cross-org account team ( CS + Technical Account Managers (TAM’s) ) functions as one team to the retailer despite the functional ownership, with co-authored protocols and clean escalation paths.

- Define and enforce the CSM/TAM boundary based on segmentation — CSM’s lead retailer-executive engagement, value realization, and growth planning, while TAM’s own technical delivery, configuration, and issue resolution, so that CSM capacity stays focused on strategic advisory, not technical execution.

- Own the consultative transformation roadmap — talent strategy, comp structure, operating cadence, and tooling shifts required to evolve CS from a feature-enablement function into a strategic business advisory function.

- Partner with the Director of Retailer Delivery on the implementation-to-success motion as a managed lifecycle (not a document handoff) — ensuring CS is engaged early, named handoff criteria are met, and accounts transition cleanly into early-lifecycle growth ownership.

- Operationalize the retailer segmented  model in CS — applying high-touch coverage and scaled/digital-first models, with clear exception protocols and capacity guardrails.

- Own the multi-year product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Logistics — spanning service coverage, delivery speed, order batching and routing, shopper matching, positioning, and pay — and drive cross-company momentum behind it.

- Partner with the company’s executive leadership to define, prioritize, and deliver the strategy, translating complex, interconnected tradeoffs into crisp narratives that align the organization.

- Lead, hire, develop, and grow a high-performing team of product managers; establish operating rhythms, hiring plans, and development frameworks that build a healthy, high-trust team and develop leaders who set the pace.

- Act as a trusted partner to engineering and ML leadership on complex, high-stakes technical tradeoffs; anticipate where to focus the team ahead of the business impact becoming obvious.

- Define clear success metrics and maintain a rigorous experimentation portfolio with a consistent cadence, using data, first-principles thinking, and user research to make sound, sometimes irreversible, tradeoffs.

- Lead cross-org initiatives that measurably improve org health, and mentor and uplevel PMs across the broader organization.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

- 10+ years of product management or similar experience, including 4+ years managing and developing product managers (including senior PMs).

- Strong marketplace or systems thinking — the ability to reason about multi-sided marketplace interactions and long-term vs. short-term tradeoffs, heavily informed by data as well as user research.

- Proven track record leading multi-quarter initiatives and delivering impactful products measured by hard business outcomes (e.g., cost, speed, quality).

- Strong technical fluency with ML- and algorithms-driven products; comfortable working through complex technical tradeoffs alongside engineering and ML leaders.

Overview

At Arpalus, recently acquired by Instacart, we build AI-powered computer vision and AR technology that turns a phone camera into a precise sensing tool - real-time
object detection, scanning, and spatial understanding shipped as a mobile product. Our tech runs on real devices, in real environments, under messy real-world conditions.

We're a small, fast-moving team and we're looking for a Principal Computer Vision Engineer who already works that way too.

You'll join our core AI team and help craft best-in-class perception systems thatpower our real-time retail analytics. You'll solve genuinely hard problems in computer
vision, bridging the gap between cutting-edge research and highly optimized production pipelines. You'll work hands-on, architecting solutions that seamlessly blend classic computer vision techniques with modern deep learning.

In this role, you'll partner closely with our mobile and backend teams to deliver unique capabilities. As a Principal Computer Vision Engineer, you'll help shape the technical strategy for the AI group, influence direction across our training and inference codebases, and ship high-quality, observable algorithms at scale.

We value clear communication, practical problem solving, and ownership. If you thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment where you can roll up your sleeves, make
thoughtful tradeoffs, and see your work move key metrics in real time, you'll feel right at home here.

About the Job

- Architect and Own: Drive the evolution of our core computer vision pipelines, taking algorithms from initial research and training through to highly optimized production deployment.

- Blend Classic & AI: Design and implement robust classic computer vision algorithms alongside deep learning architectures to solve complex spatial, alignment, and tracking challenges.

- Model Development: Train, evaluate, and fine-tune state-of-the-art deep learning models for object detection, classification, and advanced segmentation.

- Optimize for Production: Build and optimize high-performance inference pipelines in Python and C++, leveraging optimization tools like TensorRT and CUDA to ensure low-latency execution.

- Technical Leadership: Drive technical excellence across the AI stack, evaluating new architectures, standardizing our training methodologies, and making pragmatic tradeoffs between accuracy, speed, and compute constraints.

- Deliver End-to-End: Handle technical design, clean architecture, implementation, observability, and iterative improvements of our perception engine.

Minimum Qualifications

- 6+ years of industry experience in computer vision, machine learning, or a related field.

- Deep expertise in classic computer vision techniques, including strong practical knowledge of optical flow, multi-view geometry, feature matching, and homography
estimation (e.g., using OpenCV).

- Strong foundational understanding of modern deep learning architectures, specifically for object detection, image classification, and semantic/instance segmentation.

- Production-level programming skills in Python.

- Extensive hands-on experience with PyTorch and building scalable model training andevaluation pipelines.

- Proven track record of optimizing complex algorithms for deployment in resource-constrained or real-time environments.

Preferred Qualifications

- Familiarity with state-of-the-art segmentation frameworks and zero-shot/foundation models (e.g., SAM, Mask2Former, Grounding DINO).

- Experience working alongside mobile teams to integrate computer vision models into native SDKs (iOS/Android).

- Experience translating computer vision algorithms into Apple frameworks and iOS.

- Background in retail tech or AR-based scanning applications.

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

We are seeking a Program Manager to orchestrate how Instacart responds to its most critical escalations, including executive-raised issues and issues from our most strategic retail partners. When something is urgent, ambiguous, and spans multiple teams, you bring clarity, drive resolution, and make sure it doesn’t happen again. This role reports to the Senior Manager of Customer Experience.

You’ll be responsible for moving our model from reactive to proactive. That means defining the risk signals that trigger early intervention, building recovery paths for known risk vectors, and turning recurring issues into data-backed product change requests. This is a strategic and analytical role for a resourceful professional with strong judgment under pressure. It is critical for building a scalable escalation process that earns the trust of internal stakeholders and key retail partners.

The Customer Experience team ensures that critical issues affecting our retailers, customers, and shoppers are resolved quickly and permanently. The team operates globally across a network of BPO partners and works closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, and Business Development to provide immediate resolution and address systemic root cause issues.

About the Job

Program Operations & SLA Governance:

- Run the escalation operating rhythm end to end: daily case review, weekly escalation review, monthly business review, and quarterly calibration of severity criteria.

- Keep meeting hygiene tight: agendas, decisions logged, and action items assigned with named owners and due dates.

- Manage a central tracker that captures every escalation signal and root-cause action and routes each to a named owner.

- Publish and drive SLAs, and report adherence, escalation cycle time, and signal-to-action lag to leadership weekly. [Targets to be set]

Proactive Service Recovery:

- Define and maintain risk-detection signals that support early intervention.

- Design recovery paths for known risk vectors, so issues are resolved before users have to escalate.

Root-Cause & Program Delivery:

- Identify and size the frequency and impact of patterns across escalations, and turn them into effective solutions that reduce repeat issues.

- Drive cross-functional execution with Product, Engineering, Operations, and the rest of Customer Experience so every signal has a destination, every action has an owner, and every outcome is measured.

Data, Analytics & Reporting:

- Write SQL queries to investigate spikes, isolate root causes, and answer ad-hoc questions from CX, Product, and Operations leaders.

- Build and maintain dashboards and automated reporting tracking escalation volume, time to resolution, recurring themes, SLA adherence, and partner impact.

- Prepare leaders for key partner meetings, business reviews, and incident readouts with clear, quantified impact.

Process & Playbook:

- Define and improve escalation intake, severity criteria, SLAs, and communication standards.

- Build repeatable processes that scale beyond the team.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

- [5+] years of program or escalation management experience, preferably in customer experience, contact center, or partner operations.

- Proven ability to run cross-functional programs with named owners, published service-level agreements, and measurable outcomes, without direct authority in fast-moving, high-pressure situations.

- Hands-on analytical skills, including strong SQL and experience with visualization tools (e.g., Looker, Mode, Tableau, or similar) to find patterns and prioritize.

- Understanding of contact center metrics (e.g., Consumer Sentiment, first contact resolution, average handle time, Internal Quality Score) and the operational levers that move them.

- Ability to identify the root causes behind changes in key metrics and recommend a mitigation strategy.

- Track record of building reporting that an executive audience actually uses to make decisions.

- Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to synthesize complex topics into a compelling narrative for executives and external partners.

- Sound judgment on what to escalate, to whom, and when, and the ability to navigate ambiguity and shifting priorities, including direct conversations with upset customers, shoppers, and partners.

- Strategic mindset: able to think ahead of where the program is today and help stand up a new operating model rather than maintain an established one.

- High accountability and ownership, with a driven, self-starter approach.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience writing product feedback or change requests that Product teams accepted and shipped.

- Experience building or scaling an escalation or incident-management process.

- Experience with de-escalation strategies, including customer relationship management.

- Experience with retail, grocery, e-commerce, or marketplace partners.

- Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, JIRA, Slack, etc.

- Highly collaborative, with a track record of building trust across teams and a desire to help others learn.

- Subject matter expert on grassroots mobilization strategies, with the ability to provide briefings and recommendations to leadership

- Strong digital organizing skills — comfortable with CRM systems, advocacy platforms, email and SMS programs, and organic social engagement

- Metrics-driven mindset with experience tracking digital campaign performance and applying learnings for continuous improvement

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to craft compelling narratives for diverse audiences

- Proactive self-starter who monitors political developments, identifies organizing opportunities, and leads with results

- Proven ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment

- Willingness to travel regularly across the Midwest, the mid-Atlantic, and the South

Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications)

- Experience with Quorum or similar CRM and advocacy platforms

- Background in gig economy, labor, food access or tech policy issues

- Experience supporting elected official or government affairs team engagement

- Familiarity with Slack, Google Workspace and AI tools

Overview

The Advertiser Optimization team is the decision-making engine of Instacart's $1B+ ads business. We own the systems responsible for Bidding, Pacing, Budgeting, and Targeting: converting stated advertiser goals into real-time auction actions. Our mission is to maximize realized Advertiser Value by deciding when to participate, how much to bid, and how fast to spend, all while balancing User Experience and Platform Revenue.

This is a role for someone who thinks in terms of control theory, constrained optimization, and auction economics, and who can translate those frameworks into production code that makes millions of decisions per day. About the Job

- Design and evolve real-time bid optimization systems that translate advertiser goals (target ROAS, budget constraints) into optimal auction bids under uncertainty. Formulate the bidding problem as constrained optimization and build the feedback mechanisms that keep bids aligned with realized outcomes.

- Build intelligent budget pacing algorithms that distribute spend across time and auction opportunities. The core challenge: allocating a finite daily budget across stochastic demand while maximizing total value, subject to advertiser constraints and time-varying conversion dynamics.

- Develop the analytical frameworks that connect bidding, pacing, and budgeting into a coherent optimization objective.

- Shape auction mechanics including reserve pricing, multi-slot allocation, and bid-to-price mapping. Reason about mechanism design tradeoffs between advertiser outcomes, platform revenue, and marketplace efficiency.

- Own the full research-to-production loop: diagnose system behavior from large-scale data, formulate hypotheses, design experiments, ship production code, and measure impact. Write technical strategy documents that set the algorithmic direction for the team.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

- Graduate degree (Masters or PhD) in operations research, applied mathematics, control systems, computational economics, or a related quantitative field.

- 8+ years of experience building and deploying optimization or control systems in production environments (not just research prototypes).

- Strong foundation in at least two of: feedback control theory (PID, MPC), convex and stochastic optimization, auction theory and mechanism design, dynamic programming.

- Proficiency in one of the following languages: Go, Java, C++ for production systems and Python for data analysis and offline pipelines.

- Demonstrated ability to translate mathematical formulations into production code that runs at scale (millions of decisions per day, sub-100ms latency constraints).

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with real-time bidding systems, ad auction optimization, or computational advertising at scale.

- Background in budget-constrained allocation methods. Experience with adaptive control or model-predictive control in production systems.

- Familiarity with causal inference and experimental design for evaluating algorithmic changes in marketplace settings.

- Track record of shaping technical strategy and driving cross-functional alignment between engineering, product, and data science.

The Senior Financial Insights Analyst sits at the center of Instacart's Finance organization, with a mandate to identify and close areas of P&L leakage through rigorous financial and transactional data analysis and compelling narratives that drive action.



The team works through invoice challenges with retailers and serves as experts in the broader Instacart financial ecosystem. Invoicing retailers correctly is a key operational responsibility that impacts financial success and builds trust with retailer partners.

- P&L leakage is identified and closed through rigorous analysis of Instacart's financial and transactional data.

- Graduate Degree (Masters or PhD) in Economics or a closely related field

- A blend of economic theory, applied econometrics, and business skills that let you jump into a fast-paced environment and contribute from day one.

- Experience applying causal inference methodologies to both observational and experimental datasets.

- An understanding of machine learning algorithms and techniques.

- Strong programming skills (Python) and fluency in data manipulation (SQL, Pandas) and machine learning tools (e.g., scikit-learn, XGBoost).

- Excellent communication skills (both verbal and written).

- Self-motivation and a strong sense of ownership.

- 1-3 years of industry experience in a similar position.

- Experience putting machine learning models into production environments.

- Experience with cloud computing and related ML infrastructure.

Preferred Qualifications

- A PhD in Economics or a closely related field with a focus on data-intense problems.

- Intern experience in related roles.

- Experience with large language models and generative AI, both on the algorithm side as well as a day-to-day tool.

- Experience with uplift modeling, contextual bandits, and/or heterogeneous treatment effect estimation.

About You

You bring a strong foundation in machine learning and software engineering, along with the ability to communicate clearly and work effectively across disciplines. - Five or more years of professional experience developing and deploying machine learning models or systems in production.

- Proficiency in Python and SQL, including experience writing production-quality code with automated testing, profiling, debugging, and code review practices.

- Experience with the complete machine learning lifecycle, including data preparation, feature engineering, model evaluation, experimentation, deployment, and production monitoring.

- Experience building and operating machine learning services or data products in a cloud environment such as Google Cloud Platform or Amazon Web Services.

- Experience with containerized services and production software development practices, including Docker, continuous integration, monitoring, alerting, and incident response.

- Demonstrated ability to work with product, engineering, data science, and business stakeholders to define requirements and deliver measurable outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

- Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field.

- Experience designing machine learning systems for large-scale, high-throughput, or low-latency applications.

- Familiarity with distributed data processing, streaming systems, feature stores, or real-time feature computation.

- Experience with model serving, orchestration, and machine learning platforms such as Kubernetes, Airflow, Spark, or comparable technologies.

- Experience designing simulation, experimentation, or counterfactual evaluation frameworks for machine learning and decision systems.

- Proficiency in a performance-oriented language such as C++, Java, or Go.

- Experience mentoring engineers, leading cross-functional projects, or setting technical direction for machine learning initiatives.

As a senior leader within the Customer Success organization, you will play a pivotal role in building the future of our commercial organization. You will oversee a team of Managers and Customer Success Managers focused on CPG brands of all sizes, coaching them through the full customer lifecycle, from onboarding and micro-testing to data-driven insights and scaled rollout of optimal topline revenue strategies. - Lead, hire, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of Customer Success professionals, driving team performance and customer satisfaction across the portfolio while embodying our "Serve Generously" value. ABOUT THE TEAM

The Growth Design Team focuses on driving business impact through thoughtful strategy, experimentation, and exceptional craft. We design the end-to-end journeys that help customers discover, understand, and engage with the value of Instacart.

Our work sits at the intersection of product thinking, brand expression, behavioral insight, and interaction design. We're constantly exploring new ways to make growth experiences feel more useful, intuitive, expressive, and distinctly Instacart.

We pride ourselves on a culture of experimentation, accountability, and craft, continuously evolving how we design for conversion, engagement, retention, and long-term customer value.

ABOUT THE ROLE

In this role, you'll help our product designers move from intent to launch in more fluid, faster ways, while making sure everything we ship draws on the high-quality, evolving design language of our product. You'll do it by leading and evolving the design system foundations for Growth and the AI workflows that put them to work, making nuanced design judgment explicit and usable by both designers and AI agents. At times, you'll take point on larger cross-functional efforts, from new agent workflows to design-to-code. Our AI practice in design is still taking shape, and you'll be one of the people defining it.

Our design system is the most important context our agents have. If it's unclear, so is everything they make. Get it right, and designers spend less time on production and handoff, and more time on the problems that matter most.

A paramount part of this role is raising our craft bar. Growth ships more variants, states, and flows than any team can hand-build, and a single campaign can mean dozens of modals, emails, landing pages, and in-product flows. Speed can't come at the cost of quality: you'll define what excellent Growth design looks and feels like, establish clear guidance for when and why a designer or an agent should choose a particular pattern, and ensure every new experience strengthens a coherent system.

Working closely with Product, Engineering, Content Design, Legal, and Data Science, you'll create a continuous learning loop between design principles, product experiences, evaluation, and evolving technology, shaping a system that becomes more capable and expressive as our experiences grow.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Find where designers lose time between intent and launch, such as production variants, handoff, and review, and design the system changes, agents, and workflows that remove it

- Set a high standard for craft and taste across Growth, and turn it into a clear, opinionated framework for when and how designers and agents should use each pattern, including the right default

- Own and evolve the foundations Growth is built on, including components, variants, tokens, layout, responsive behavior, and content and legal patterns, in partnership with our Design Systems team

- Establish a shared source of truth: a master Figma file of approved components, screens, and flows, connected to code through machine-readable specs that declare tokens, states, and edge cases

- Take point on building agents and skills that use the system to turn a request like "a renewal modal offering 14 days free" into on-brand, legally approved, production-ready design

- Translate design judgment into evals and review agents that check work before it ships, such as an agent that reviews designs against approved legal and content patterns, and use what they catch to improve the system

- Drive design-to-code efforts with Engineering, so agents can turn approved designs into shippable code that engineers review rather than rebuild

- Stay close to Growth work across incentives and lifecycle, spotting promising patterns and turning them into reusable, documented foundations every designer can adopt

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

- 7+ years of experience designing consumer-facing digital products across web and mobile

- A portfolio demonstrating exceptional visual, interaction, and product craft, including hands-on design system work

- Strong communication and storytelling skills, and comfort operating autonomously and carrying work from early concept through polished execution

YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU

- Get energy from making other designers faster and better, and measure your impact by what the team ships

- Bring a high craft bar and are motivated to raise the quality, clarity, and distinctiveness of Growth design

- Have sophisticated design taste and can make the judgment behind it explicit, teachable, and actionable for designers and agents

- See a design system as a living body of product judgment, not simply a collection of components

- Have a strong command of interaction design, layout, content hierarchy, accessibility, and responsive behavior

- Can move fluently between foundational systems work and concrete, high-craft Growth experiences

- Care as much about choosing the right default as designing the full range of possibilities

- Can explain not only what a pattern should look like, but when a designer or an agent should choose it and why

- Are skilled at turning ambiguous or inconsistent work into a coherent, extensible system

- Are comfortable taking the lead on cross-functional efforts when the work calls for it, and bringing partners along

- Stay close to the latest AI developments, modern tooling, and component-driven design practices, and have built with agents, skills, or MCPs yourself

We're looking for smart, curious designers who are excited to learn. This role spans craft, systems, and AI, and we don't expect anyone to match every line above. If the work excites you, we encourage you to apply.

There's no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it's from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Growth Design Team focuses on driving business impact through thoughtful strategy, experimentation, and exceptional craft. We design the end-to-end journeys that help customers discover, understand, and engage with the value of Instacart.

Our work sits at the intersection of product thinking, brand expression, behavioral insight, and interaction design. We're constantly exploring new ways to make growth experiences feel more useful, intuitive, expressive, and distinctly Instacart.

We pride ourselves on a culture of experimentation, accountability, and craft, continuously evolving how we design for conversion, engagement, retention, and long-term customer value.

ABOUT THE ROLE

In this role, you'll help our product designers move from intent to launch in more fluid, faster ways, while making sure everything we ship draws on the high-quality, evolving design language of our product. You'll do it by leading and evolving the design system foundations for Growth and the AI workflows that put them to work, making nuanced design judgment explicit and usable by both designers and AI agents. At times, you'll take point on larger cross-functional efforts, from new agent workflows to design-to-code. Our AI practice in design is still taking shape, and you'll be one of the people defining it.

Our design system is the most important context our agents have. If it's unclear, so is everything they make. Get it right, and designers spend less time on production and handoff, and more time on the problems that matter most.

A paramount part of this role is raising our craft bar. Growth ships more variants, states, and flows than any team can hand-build, and a single campaign can mean dozens of modals, emails, landing pages, and in-product flows. Speed can't come at the cost of quality: you'll define what excellent Growth design looks and feels like, establish clear guidance for when and why a designer or an agent should choose a particular pattern, and ensure every new experience strengthens a coherent system.

Working closely with Product, Engineering, Content Design, Legal, and Data Science, you'll create a continuous learning loop between design principles, product experiences, evaluation, and evolving technology, shaping a system that becomes more capable and expressive as our experiences grow.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Find where designers lose time between intent and launch, such as production variants, handoff, and review, and design the system changes, agents, and workflows that remove it

- Set a high standard for craft and taste across Growth, and turn it into a clear, opinionated framework for when and how designers and agents should use each pattern, including the right default

- Own and evolve the foundations Growth is built on, including components, variants, tokens, layout, responsive behavior, and content and legal patterns, in partnership with our Design Systems team

- Establish a shared source of truth: a master Figma file of approved components, screens, and flows, connected to code through machine-readable specs that declare tokens, states, and edge cases

- Take point on building agents and skills that use the system to turn a request like "a renewal modal offering 14 days free" into on-brand, legally approved, production-ready design

- Translate design judgment into evals and review agents that check work before it ships, such as an agent that reviews designs against approved legal and content patterns, and use what they catch to improve the system

- Drive design-to-code efforts with Engineering, so agents can turn approved designs into shippable code that engineers review rather than rebuild

- Stay close to Growth work across incentives and lifecycle, spotting promising patterns and turning them into reusable, documented foundations every designer can adopt

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

- 7+ years of experience designing consumer-facing digital products across web and mobile

- A portfolio demonstrating exceptional visual, interaction, and product craft, including hands-on design system work

- Strong communication and storytelling skills, and comfort operating autonomously and carrying work from early concept through polished execution

YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU

- Get energy from making other designers faster and better, and measure your impact by what the team ships

- Bring a high craft bar and are motivated to raise the quality, clarity, and distinctiveness of Growth design

- Have sophisticated design taste and can make the judgment behind it explicit, teachable, and actionable for designers and agents

- See a design system as a living body of product judgment, not simply a collection of components

- Have a strong command of interaction design, layout, content hierarchy, accessibility, and responsive behavior

- Can move fluently between foundational systems work and concrete, high-craft Growth experiences

- Care as much about choosing the right default as designing the full range of possibilities

- Can explain not only what a pattern should look like, but when a designer or an agent should choose it and why

- Are skilled at turning ambiguous or inconsistent work into a coherent, extensible system

- Are comfortable taking the lead on cross-functional efforts when the work calls for it, and bringing partners along

- Stay close to the latest AI developments, modern tooling, and component-driven design practices, and have built with agents, skills, or MCPs yourself

We're looking for smart, curious designers who are excited to learn. This role spans craft, systems, and AI, and we don't expect anyone to match every line above. If the work excites you, we encourage you to apply.

Overview

Instacart Ads is one of the fastest-growing and most strategically important parts of the Instacart business. Our Ads organization brings together product, engineering, data science, design, sales, and strategy to build a world-class advertising ecosystem — one that serves brands, retailers, and agencies looking to reach millions of shoppers at the point of purchase.

The Advertiser & Partner Experience (APEX) team sits at the heart of this ecosystem. We own the flows and tools that advertisers use to create, manage, optimize, and understand the value they derive from campaigns and promotions across Instacart Ads. Our scope spans Ads Manager and its APIs, advertiser-facing reporting and insights, retailer advertising products, and Carrot Ads — a growing suite of tools that enables retailers to monetize their own e-commerce sites using Instacart's ad tech, brand partnerships, and expertise.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own a critical portion of the Advertiser Experience — specifically, the tools and platform capabilities that help advertisers understand the value they're getting from Instacart Ads, trust those results, and act on them. This PM will also own the core platform infrastructure that underpins all aspects of campaign creation, management, and reporting, including API, product library, user management, change history, billing, and notifications.

This role is an opportunity to own a high-impact, highly visible product surface that directly shapes how advertisers engage with and derive value from one of the industry's most exciting retail media platforms. Over time, as you demonstrate mastery of your scope, you'll have the opportunity to take on increasing strategic ownership and step into a senior PM lead role for the Advertiser Experience team as a whole.

About the Job

- Own the problem space of advertiser value measurement — defining how advertisers understand, trust, and act on the results they're seeing from Instacart Ads campaigns, and building the reporting and insights experiences that make that possible.

- Own and evolve core platform capabilities that support all stages of the advertiser journey, including API infrastructure, product library, user management, change history, billing, and notifications — ensuring these foundations are reliable, scalable, and built to support a sophisticated advertiser base.

- Serve as a primary product point of contact in external conversations with advertisers and agency partners — sharing roadmap direction, gathering strategic feedback, and helping to nurture relationships that inform product decisions and drive trust in the platform.

- Work cross-functionally across a 100+-person Ads R&D team — collaborating with engineers, data scientists, designers, and researchers — as well as with sales, strategy, and commercial enablement teams to drive alignment and deliver impact across a complex, fast-moving organization.

- Grow into a senior PM lead for the Advertiser Experience team over time, including providing strategic guidance and serving as a thought partner to a more junior PM on the team, as you demonstrate command of your scope and expand your ownership footprint.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

- 5+ years of product management experience, with a track record of independently owning complex, cross-functional product areas.

- Experience building or owning B2B platform products, including enterprise UX flows and underlying platform infrastructure.

- Strong technical acumen — comfortable engaging deeply with engineering teams on system design, APIs, and platform architecture.

- Experience managing external partner or customer relationships as part of a product role, not just internal stakeholders.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex technical and business context for both engineering teams and executive audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in ad tech, retail media, or marketplace advertising, particularly on the demand or advertiser side — for example, owning advertiser-facing campaign management or reporting flows.

- Familiarity with programmatic advertising concepts, including auction mechanics, ad serving, attribution, billing and revenue share, and reporting infrastructure.

- Prior experience at a company where the platform you owned enabled third-party businesses to operate — such as a white-label ad platform, a marketplace API, or an embedded commerce product.

- Experience driving strategic expansion into new business verticals or partner segments.

- Demonstrated ability to ship in ambiguous, high-stakes environments where product scope, technical constraints, and business requirements are evolving simultaneously.

israel.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Overview

As a Senior Software Engineer II in the Ads Quality team specializing in ML infrastructure, you'll work with a team of software and machine learning engineers to build state-of-the-art systems that optimize Ads performance throughout the ads serving funnel, from retrieval to pricing. You'll own the technical direction of our data, feature processing and model training/serving solutions, enabling next-generation modelling opportunities—from utilizing out of the box LLMs to building bespoke Foundation Models that powers all the Ads use cases. You will eliminate bottlenecks across the training and serving system to optimize stability, latency and cost. Building on Instacart's unique data and market position, these systems create value for advertising partners, improve consumer experience, and directly contribute to Instacart's overall revenue / business success.

You'll have the unique opportunity to collaborate with a cross-functional team, turning diverse insights into powerful solutions that elevate advertising effectiveness and operational stability. Your expertise will steer the development of scalable training and serving infrastructure, driving performance and efficiency gains across our advertising platform. Together, we'll build an ads ecosystem that not only serves millions but also excels in delivering value to users and advertisers alike.

Instacart Ads is transforming the online grocery shopping experience by seamlessly integrating advanced advertising solutions into our platform. The Ads Quality team is dedicated to delivering outstanding advertising outcomes by driving innovation and precision in response prediction, advertiser optimization, and ads auction processes. Our mission is to ensure relevance, fairness, and performance for all participants in the ad ecosystem. By leveraging terabytes of data and sophisticated machine learning algorithms, we build advanced predictive models that enhance user experience, drive advertiser success, and sustain a thriving ad ecosystem. We're also at the forefront of integrating Large Language Models (LLMs), unlocking powerful new capabilities that are redefining how brands connect with consumers in the digital grocery space. Our next major bet is a real-time sequential foundation model for ads—and building the training and serving infrastructure to make it possible is central to this role.

About the Job

- Design, develop, and deploy machine learning infrastructure to tackle practical challenges in our complex marketplace while advancing the training and serving platform. Work with the company wide ML Foundation team to develop solutions to meet Ads unique needs.

- Optimize training and serving funnel bottlenecks—profiling real systems and driving meaningful wins in throughput, cost, and latency, from GPU/accelerator utilization to tail latency at serving time.

- Identify instabilities and shortcomings of our systems and operating procedures to deliver best in class availability.

- Build real-time feature processing infrastructure—low-latency pipelines that compute, join, and serve fresh features to models on the critical path of every ad request.

- Lead the infrastructure foundation for our real-time sequential foundation model, including online sequence feature stores, streaming update paths, efficient long-context serving, and training pipelines that keep pace with rapidly evolving data.

- Collaborate closely with product managers, data scientists, and MLEs to deeply understand business needs and co-design systems where product, model architecture and infrastructure constraints are solved together.

- Actively engage with diverse stakeholders to ensure that solutions are well-integrated and aligned with business goals.

- Mentor engineers, set technical direction, and conduct thorough code reviews to ensure high code quality and maintainability. Lead by example in fostering a culture of continuous improvement and technical excellence.



About You

Minimum Qualifications

- Have a graduate degree (masters or PhD) in computer science, artificial intelligence, machine learning, operations research or equivalent self study and experience.

- Have 3+ years of industry experience building ML infrastructure or using machine learning to solve real-world problems with large datasets.

- Deep expertise building, scaling and managing ML infrastructure for training and/or serving in production, with a strong understanding of modern machine learning systems and MLOps.

- Strong programming skills in software engineering (e.g., Python, Go), along with expertise in data manipulation using tools (SQL, Spark, and Pandas), and ML frameworks (Torch, Tensorflow, XGBoost).

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Excellent communication skills (both verbal and written) and can collaborate with a diverse group of stakeholders across all levels.

- Eager to jump into domains, languages, and problem areas that might be new and unfamiliar.



Preferred Qualifications

- Have 5+ years of industry experience tech leading a team to build ML infrastructure or using machine learning to solve real-world problems with large datasets.

- Demonstrated experience solving complex model training and serving efficiency challenges, including optimizing training pipelines, reducing model training times, and improving serving architectures to enhance operational efficiency and scalability.

- Hands-on experience with real-time / online feature processing and serving—streaming systems (e.g., Kafka, Flink), online feature stores, and low-latency retrieval on the request path.

- Experience with sequential modeling, transformer architecture, and generative retrieval or building large scale online recommendation systems.

- Experience serving large sequential or foundation models in low-latency, high-QPS production settings.

- Experience in digital advertising platforms.

- Familiarity with LLM integrations, prompt engineering, and productivity tooling.

israel.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

Enterprise Foundations is the engineering team responsible for the architectural and integration work that allows Instacart's Retailer Platform to scale across the world's largest grocers. Our work spans omnichannel integrations — bringing products like FoodStorm catering and Caper Carts onto unified Instacart platform rails — enterprise extensibility (sandbox environments, configuration systems, retailer-facing tooling), and the cross-cutting data isolation work that allows Instacart's ML and Data Engineering teams to safely build bespoke models on top of the platform. As Instacart's enterprise retail business expands to hundreds of partner brands and new international markets, this team's work is foundational to how the platform matures.

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer II to own and ship one of the team's most complex multi-quarter work-streams — at the seam of omnichannel identity, international storefront search expansions, and partner-owned integrations that we ultimately operate ourselves. You'll be the technical DRI for your area: framing the problem, designing the systems, driving the rollout, and codifying the patterns so the rest of Enterprise Platform can adopt them without your direct involvement. You'll work closely with Staff engineers on the team who set the team-wide architectural thesis, and partner across Connected Stores, Professional Services, Commerce, Search, Data Engineering, and ML to land integrations that hold up across organizational boundaries.

About the Job

- Own a multi-quarter integration workstream end to end — for example, unified customer identity across FoodStorm and Storefront Pro, international storefront and search expansion for enterprise retailers, or consolidation of bespoke retailer-vertical services onto shared Instacart platform rails — from problem framing through design, implementation, rollout, and deprecation of legacy paths.

- Drive the technical direction for your area: write the ERDs, propose the options, make and defend the trade-off calls, and bring partner teams along through design reviews and written artifacts that read clearly for first-time readers.

- Lead vendor and cross-team integrations where Instacart will eventually own the system — push for the right observability, fallback behavior, and cost/latency guardrails up front, and challenge partner designs early rather than inheriting them at handoff.

- Build reusable patterns, frameworks, and templates that other engineers across Enterprise Foundations and adjacent teams adopt with minimal hand-holding; treat "system at a glance" docs and migration runbooks as first-class deliverables.

- Operate hands-on as a senior individual contributor on the highest-leverage technical work in your area; raise the bar on design quality, code quality, observability, and operational rigor.

- Mentor more junior engineers in your area, delegate well-defined implementation pieces while retaining overall technical ownership, and act as a credible technical peer to senior and staff engineers in adjacent organizations.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

- 7+ years of backend software engineering experience, with a track record of owning complex, multi-quarter projects end to end as a senior individual contributor.
