OVERVIEW

Every year, people across the world spend nearly one trillion dollars on groceries. It’s an industry that’s been around for centuries. Food itself, however, has been a constant in people’s lives since the beginning of time. Yes, sustenance is essential, but it’s also much more than that. Food can be a part of a daily ritual or a special moment that resonates with people on a meaningful and emotional level. It can be a much-needed break in a long day, a taste that brings back memories, a creative experiment, a shared meal with loved ones, or even comfort during a hard time. Whether it’s a special occasion or an everyday occurrence, it should always be easy for people to get the ingredients they need.

The Instacart Design Team is dedicated to making grocery shopping effortless for everyone and finding solutions to large-scale opportunities that will forever change the way people feed themselves and their loved ones. We’re a four sided marketplace and design for the needs of Consumer, Shoppers, Retailers, and Advertisers.

Within the Instacart Design org, we have exciting roles that will drive meaningful business impact through thoughtful strategy, experimentation, and high-quality execution. We design the end-to-end journeys that help customers discover, understand, and feel the undeniable value of Instacart, putting empathy for both prospective and existing members at the center of every decision. Our team blends product thinking, brand-forward storytelling, and behavioral insight to create cohesive, high-performing growth experiences. We pride ourselves on a culture of experimentation, accountability, and craft, continuously evolving how we design for conversion, retention, and long-term customer value.

We’re hiring for a Staff Experience Designer to join the Core Experience team and lead work across multiple touchpoints along our end to end online grocery experience in app. You’ll obsess user, cultural and industry shifts in food and shopping spaces and inspire new features that come with strong value propositions that can be uniquely owned by the Intacart brand experience and online grocery ecosystem. This role will need to work very closely with teams across the end to end shopping experience as well as new modalities that help deliver experiences through AI and agentic based conversational interfaces. This is a high-impact, highly collaborative role partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Brand, Data Science, and Research to drive measurable business outcomes while strengthening customer trust, affinity for the brand and long-term loyalty.

About The Job

Daily Rhythms and Samples of Work

- Drive and lead experiences across consumer-facing products to create highly personalized journeys that meet households where they are — their routines, their needs, their goals — and build new layers of value into the core grocery experience.

- Lead end-to-end experience design briefs across all surfaces and modalities, including agentic interfaces, that deepen how customers discover, shop, and build lasting habits with Instacart.

- Craft narratives, naming, and value propositions for experiences and features, creating artifacts (strategy docs, flows, storyboards, internal decks) that help teams socialize strategies and ideas.

- Define and own experience frameworks that map key journeys (first 3 orders, building repeat patterns, subscription adoption, household management) and clearly articulate the beats, rhythms, and jobs to be done at each step.

- Shape content, hierarchy, and information architecture across surfaces: define how information is structured, named, and prioritized so users have clear comprehension at every step while the business and partners get the right visibility where it matters.

- Codify experiential principles, functional and emotional, to guide what users should understand, decide, and feel across flows, then translate those principles into patterns, content hierarchies, and interaction rules that scale across teams.

- Use AI-assisted prototyping and concept development as a core part of your practice, providing strong art direction, references, and experiential intent to generate flows and concepts that align with Instacart's design system, brand positioning, and evolving interaction patterns.

- Design for visual clarity, pacing, and density, establishing patterns, grids, and rules that govern how modules, carousels, and key placements work (above vs. below the fold) to balance user needs, business objectives, and partner value.

- Work with Research, and sometimes lead or plan it yourself, to uncover insights about how customers shop, build routines, and evolve over their lifecycle with Instacart, then translate those insights into concrete journey maps, flows, and experiential principles.

- Raise the bar for experience-led thinking across the pods, mentoring partners on how to think in journeys and emotions rather than just screens, and advocating for cohesive, principle-driven experiences that feel uniquely Instacart.

OVERVIEW

Every year, people across the world spend nearly one trillion dollars on groceries. It’s an industry that’s been around for centuries. Food itself, however, has been a constant in people’s lives since the beginning of time. Yes, sustenance is essential, but it’s also much more than that. Food can be a part of a daily ritual or a special moment that resonates with people on a meaningful and emotional level. It can be a much-needed break in a long day, a taste that brings back memories, a creative experiment, a shared meal with loved ones, or even comfort during a hard time. Whether it’s a special occasion or an everyday occurrence, it should always be easy for people to get the ingredients they need.

The Instacart Design Team is dedicated to making grocery shopping effortless for everyone and finding solutions to large-scale opportunities that will forever change the way people feed themselves and their loved ones. We’re a four sided marketplace and design for the needs of Consumer, Shoppers, Retailers, and Advertisers.

Within the Instacart Design org, we have exciting roles that will drive meaningful business impact through thoughtful strategy, experimentation, and high-quality execution. We design the end-to-end journeys that help customers discover, understand, and feel the undeniable value of Instacart, putting empathy for both prospective and existing members at the center of every decision. Our team blends product thinking, brand-forward storytelling, and behavioral insight to create cohesive, high-performing growth experiences. We pride ourselves on a culture of experimentation, accountability, and craft, continuously evolving how we design for conversion, retention, and long-term customer value.

We’re hiring for a Staff Experience Designer to join the Core Experience team and lead work across multiple touchpoints along our end to end online grocery experience in app. You’ll obsess user, cultural and industry shifts in food and shopping spaces and inspire new features that come with strong value propositions that can be uniquely owned by the Intacart brand experience and online grocery ecosystem. This role will need to work very closely with teams across the end to end shopping experience as well as new modalities that help deliver experiences through AI and agentic based conversational interfaces. This is a high-impact, highly collaborative role partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Brand, Data Science, and Research to drive measurable business outcomes while strengthening customer trust, affinity for the brand and long-term loyalty.

We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Overview

Instacarts Data Infrastructure organization builds and operates the systems that power our company’s data ecosystem, including a modern open data lakehouse on Apache Iceberg, a multi-engine compute platform for stream and analytical workloads, and self-serve tooling that helps Product, Data Science, ML, Ads, Finance, and engineering teams move fast with data.

We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer, Data Infrastructure to join our Data Governance and Foundations Team. In this role, you’ll serve as a senior technical leader owning the architecture and delivery of our open lakehouse foundation, governance and access patterns, and multi-engine compute strategy—balancing today’s reliability with the next three to five years of scale, maturity, and cost efficiency.

You’ll collaborate closely with engineering leadership and stakeholders across Data Science, ML Platform, Ads Infrastructure, Finance Engineering, Product Engineering, and Security. You’ll operate with a high degree of ownership in a fast-paced environment where architectural decisions have real technical and financial consequences. If you thrive on complex, high-scale challenges and roll-up-your-sleeves execution, this is a chance to shape the backbone of Instacart’s data platform.

Our stack includes technologies such as Apache Iceberg, Apache Flink, Trino, ClickHouse, Apache Kafka, Apache Spark, Snowflake, Databricks, Confluent, Airflow, dbt, Delta Lake, Scala, Python, Postgres, and AWS. You’ll join a focused team of 7 engineers that values pragmatism, clarity, and impact.

About the Job

- Translate Instacart’s data strategy (e.g., monetization, federated access, real-time) into an actionable multi-year architecture roadmap; align with leadership while evolving the platform for scale, maturity, and cost efficiency.

- Own the open lakehouse foundation: define and deliver unified table formats, storage governance, and a multi-engine compute portfolio (interactive, batch, streaming) that enables portability and prevents lock-in.

- Drive real-time and streaming infrastructure for critical use cases (Ads, Fraud, ML): set deployment patterns, SLAs, and operational practices that balance performance, availability, and spend.

- Pioneer AI-native data infrastructure engineering by applying LLM/AI tools to the platform lifecycle—accelerating development, automation, observability, and cost optimization—and partnering to embed AI-powered capabilities into the platform.

- Elevate engineering excellence: lead architecture reviews, mentor senior/staff engineers, influence hiring, and clearly communicate complex trade-offs to both technical and executive audiences to ensure cross-org alignment.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

- 10+ years of software engineering experience building and operating data infrastructure or distributed systems at production scale.

- Hands-on expertise with modern data lakehouse architectures and open table formats (e.g., Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, Hudi) and with distributed query/compute engines (e.g., Trino, Spark, ClickHouse), including performance tuning and production reliability.

- Experience with event-driven and streaming infrastructure (e.g., Kafka, Flink) for real-time pipelines and serving systems.

- Proven ownership of major platform transitions or migrations (build vs. buy, migration design, risk management) delivered to production.

- Ability to build cost/benefit and TCO models for infrastructure investments and to drive alignment via clear architecture docs and strategy memos across multiple teams and leadership levels.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience designing platform-level governance controls and familiarity with compliance frameworks (e.g., SOX, CPRA, GDPR).

- FinOps experience optimizing data platform spend, including managing multi-million dollar infrastructure budgets and negotiating vendor contracts.

- Deep SQL proficiency and strong skills in Python or Scala for systems-level development.

- Experience with orchestration (e.g., Apache Airflow) and data transformation pipelines (e.g., dbt) in large-scale production environments.

- Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

israel.description:
¿Quieres cambiar el mundo?

Eso es lo que hacemos en Cabify. Nuestro objetivo es hacer de las ciudades mejores lugares para vivir, mejorando la movilidad de las personas que viven en ellas, conectando a pasajeros y conductores con tan sólo pulsar un botón. Es posible que algún día las ciudades sean lugares donde nadie necesite un coche privado, pero aún nos queda un largo camino por recorrer… ¿nos acompañas?

Fundada en 2011, nos hemos convertido en el primer ‘unicornio’ español. Nuestra sede central está en Madrid pero actualmente nos encontramos en 38 ciudades de España y Latinoamérica. Y cada mes que pasa más gente se une a nuestro equipo internacional lleno de personas apasionadas, brillantes y con talento con ganas de desafiar el “status quo”.

Pero no importa lo rápido que crezcamos o lo grande que nos volvamos, queremos mantener nuestro espíritu ‘start-up’. Somos un equipo seguro de sí mismo, energético, profesional y carismático, y estamos orgullosos de hacer las cosas bien. Nos gusta pensar en nosotros mismos como una empresa de tecnología ética e innovadora que ha creado un negocio donde todos son tratados de manera justa y respetuosa, desde nuestros ingenieros hasta los conductores que utilizan nuestra plataforma. Además, siempre cumplimos plenamente con las regulaciones gubernamentales y respetamos las leyes locales.

Hemos recorrido un largo camino hasta ahora, pero en realidad nuestro viaje no ha hecho más que comenzar. Si vamos a convertir nuestra misión en una realidad, ¡necesitamos que personas con talento y ambición como tú se unan a nuestro equipo!!

Sobre el puesto

Como agente de contac center te encargaras de brindar una atención integral y oportuna a los usuarios a través de los diferentes canales de servicio (chat, correo, tickets y voz), garantizando una experiencia positiva, el cumplimiento de los SLA establecidos y la gestión eficaz de las solicitudes internas y externas.

Lo que estamos buscando:

- Formación académica: Bachiller, técnico, tecnólogo o estudiante en modalidad virtual.

- Experiencia: Mínimo 8 meses en servicio al cliente en contact center, con manejo de diferentes skills (llamadas, chat, correo y tickets).

¿Qué ofrecemos?

- Salario: SMLV + prestaciones de ley, variable y beneficios adicionales.

- Jornada laboral: Turnos rotativos de domingo a domingo, con un día compensatorio entre semana o fin de semana según la programación operativa.

- Modalidad: Presencial.

Somos una empresa llena de gente feliz y motivada… ¡y no queremos que eso cambie! Aquí te mostramos algunas razones por las que te encantará formar parte de la familia Cabify.

- Eventos divertidos con todo el equipo.

- Descuentos para empleados.

- Programas de desarrollo personal.

- Todo el equipamiento que necesites (tú solo tienes que poner tu talento).

- Y lo último, pero no menos importante... ¡café gratis!

Formarás parte de Cabify Logistics, el área encargada de administrar nuestro servicio de envío de paquetería y mercancías, con un fuerte enfoque en dar soluciones de última milla a empresas líderes del mercado. Quien ocupe la posición tendrá como propósito dar soporte y asegurar la excelencia del servicio en tiempo real, gestionando de forma eficiente la flota de conductores, mitigando incidencias operativas del día a día y garantizando el cumplimiento de los acuerdos de nivel de servicio (SLAs) de cada cuenta comercial en el mercado peruano.

Mantener el nivel de servicio dentro de SLA con cada cliente corporativo.

Gestionar eficientemente la flota de conductores por operaciones y atender las incidencias que se presenten durante la jornada de manera oportuna.

-
Identificar desvíos en los procesos de entrega para poder tomar acciones de forma proactiva.

-
Coordinar la comunicación fluida entre el despacho, la flota y el destinatario final del delivery.

-
Realizar el seguimiento del nivel de cumplimiento de protocolos dentro de la flota asignada.

-
Hacer un monitoreo exhaustivo de las demoras generadas para lograr cumplir con los tiempos de entrega.

-
Detectar oportunidades de mejora que generen un impacto positivo y medible en la calidad del servicio.

-
Registrar correctamente todas las interacciones y gestiones realizadas durante la jornada laboral según los procesos establecidos.

Afinidad e identificación con nuestros principios y cultura corporativa.

-
Experiencia mínima de 6 meses en áreas de operaciones, idealmente en empresas de tecnología, aplicaciones de food delivery o logística de última milla.

-
Experiencia mínima de 1 año en entornos de atención al cliente, call center o back office, gestionando reclamos y fidelización.

-
Perfil proactivo, resolutivo, autónomo y con una alta orientación a resultados bajo entornos dinámicos.

-
Manejo de herramientas analíticas como Microsoft Excel y Tableau (altamente deseable).

Somos un equipo repleto de gente feliz y motivada. Flexibilidad, buen ambiente, crecimiento e impacto ¡asegurados! Cabify viene cargado de beneficios para que los disfrutes en tu viaje junto a nosotros:

israel.description:
Do you want to drive the next urban revolution? At Cabify, that’s what we’re doing. We aim to make cities better places to live by improving mobility for the people living in them, connecting  riders to drivers at the touch of a button. Maybe one day cities will be places where nobody needs a private car. But we’ve still got a long way to go… want to be part of this journey?

About the position

You will join Cabify’s Applied Science team, a group of highly motivated data scientists with access to all data within the organization. The team is involved in all main areas of the company, including vehicle and route management, understanding user experience, pricing, fraud detection, and marketing optimization (see for yourself: exhibit A, exhibit B, exhibit C). You will work with state-of-the-art tools and infrastructure to help improve everyday operations in more than 40 cities worldwide. Cabify's Applied Science team provides a unique opportunity to research, test and implement great ideas that will shape the future of our cities.

As a Data Scientist in our team, you will:

- Develop high-impact data science projects, working closely with other data, engineering, product and business teams.

- Design, train, and validate statistical and machine learning models and help deploying them into production.

- Participate in the results analysis of real-life experiments, following academy-standard scientific methods and procedures, to demonstrate the impact of the new product features we develop.

- Help to convert the team’s technical knowledge into real and tangible business insights that bring value to the company.

- Join product development conversations, discussing new features and bringing the data science perspective to everything we build.

What we’re looking for

- At least 3 years of professional experience working as a data scientist or equivalent research role.

- Strong educational background, e.g Masters in Computer Science, Physics, Engineering, Mathematics, Economics, etc.

- Solid foundations in Probability & Statistics.

- Experience designing, training and validating statistical and machine learning models.

- Experience working with Python for data analysis and data visualization libraries.

- Experience with data extraction and processing. Capable of writing complex SQL code.

- Ability to work autonomously in an unstructured environment.

Bonus Points

- Experience bringing machine learning to production, with all its subtleties: deploying, training, testing, model degradation, model serving, etc.

- Experience with state-of-the-art methods in topics like deep learning models, time series analysis, bayesian statistics, causal inference, etc.

- Experience with geo data modeling, analysis and visualization.

What’s it like to work at Cabify?

We’re a company full of happy, motivated people and we never want that to change. Here are some more reasons why it rocks to be part of our high-performance team:

Chile es uno de los mercados más dinámicos y competitivos, y nuestra ventaja se construye asegurando un nivel de servicio inconfundiblemente superior. Como Head of Operations & Customer Experience, liderarás una de las áreas más estratégicas de Cabify, asegurando que nuestra promesa de valor se cumpla por diseño, mediante procesos robustos, tecnología y un equipo de alto desempeño.

Buscamos una persona con fuerte visión de negocio y capacidad de operación "ambidiestra". Serás responsable de la P&L operativa y actuarás como partner estratégico para el crecimiento de la compañía, pero también disfrutas de estar en el terreno, metiendo las manos en la masa para entender profundamente la raíz de los problemas y así mejorar sistemáticamente la operación.

Tu triple mandato

- Gestión de la Realidad y Customer Support: Liderarás el área de soporte para resolver los incidentes y errores operativos una vez que han ocurrido. Pero más importante aún, serás capaz de sumergirte en el barro, auditando en terreno, yendo a la raíz de los tickets, escuchando a los agentes para transformar esa experiencia correctiva en aprendizaje sistémico.

- Absorción de Contingencias y Ejecución Comercial: Serás la persona encargada de repartir el  juego ante los retos diarios. Evaluarás la factibilidad operativa, los costos y la rentabilidad ante cada requerimiento comercial de Ventas B2B o Growth. Sabrás armar planes operativos rentables y escalables, absorbiendo la presión y el volumen de operaciones críticas de alta visibilidad que funcionan 24/7 (como hubs complejos o concesiones), asegurando un nivel de servicio inquebrantable incluso en situaciones complejas y de alta exigencia.

- Excelencia Operacional y Mejora Continua: Tu prioridad será garantizar el customer journey de todas nuestras audiencias (pasajeros, conductores y empresas) de principio a fin. Para ello, asegurarás que la gobernanza, los procesos y el "Business As Usual" (BAU) funcionen de forma impecable, mientras utilizas la automatización y la Inteligencia Artificial como herramientas clave para evolucionar la operación hacia un modelo predictivo, cuestionando la estructura actual y preparándonos para los desafíos del mañana.

Tus principales responsabilidades

- Gobierno Financiero y Comercial (Deal Governance): Ser partner estratégico de las áreas comerciales estableciendo límites claros (guardrails) para asegurar que el crecimiento no sacrifique la rentabilidad y factibilidad operativa de la compañía.

- Gestión de Activos, Flotas y Terceros: Liderar el ecosistema físico y de partners, gestionando el ciclo de vida de las flotas, negociaciones de abastecimiento y gobernando rigurosamente a los socios operadores y servicios externalizados (BPO), mediante auditorías, SLAs y planes de eficiencia.

- Liderazgo de Alto Desempeño: Atraer, desarrollar y estructurar equipos multidisciplinarios (analíticos y de front-line), asegurando un ritmo de alto rendimiento sostenible y formando a los futuros líderes de la compañía.

¿Qué buscamos?

- Afinidad con nuestros principios.

- Título profesional en Ingeniería, Administración de Empresas o carreras afines.

- Postgrado o MBA será muy valorado.

- 10+ años de experiencia en Operaciones, Logística o Customer Experience, con al menos 5 años liderando líderes (managers).

- Experiencia sólida en entornos de hipercrecimiento, marketplaces, transporte, logística de última milla o hubs de alta complejidad.

- Historial comprobado gestionando presupuestos (P&L), líneas de costo operativo, e implementando gobierno financiero sobre operaciones físicas y digitales.

- Experiencia demostrable en el diseño de procesos y escalamiento de operaciones complejas (ej. soluciones B2B a medida, concesiones o gestión integral de flotas).

Tus fortalezas y perfil

- Gusto por el terreno (Hands-on): Cuentas con una visión de liderazgo estratégico que no tiene miedo de bajar al barro. Entiendes que las verdaderas respuestas no siempre están en los dashboards, y disfrutas la cercanía con el ecosistema físico de conductores, la auditoría en terreno y el front-line.

- Mentalidad financiera: Lees la operación en números (costo unitario, ocupación, margen) y conversas de igual a igual con Finanzas y áreas comerciales.

- Criterio y firmeza: Sabes evaluar factibilidad, negociar condiciones y, cuando es necesario, decir que no, para proteger la rentabilidad y los estándares de servicio de la compañía.

- Articulación transversal y global: Eres capaz de “repartir el juego” de manera excelente,con soltura para influir en una matriz global-local, sabiendo cuándo adoptar estándares globales y cuándo proponer ajustes locales sustentados en el negocio.

- Resiliencia y foco: Serenidad para absorber las contingencias y la operación crítica del día a día, sin perder de vista la agenda de transformación a largo plazo.

Y cada mes que pasa más gente se une a nuestro equipo internacional lleno de personas apasionadas, brillantes y con talento con ganas de desafiar el “status quo”.

Pero no importa lo rápido que crezcamos o lo grande que nos volvamos, queremos mantener nuestro espíritu ‘start-up’. Somos un equipo seguro de sí mismo, energético, profesional y carismático, y estamos orgullosos de hacer las cosas bien. Nos gusta pensar en nosotros mismos como una empresa de tecnología ética e innovadora que ha creado un negocio donde todos son tratados de manera justa y respetuosa, desde nuestros ingenieros hasta los conductores que utilizan nuestra plataforma. Hemos recorrido un largo camino hasta ahora, pero en realidad nuestro viaje no ha hecho más que comenzar. Si vamos a convertir nuestra misión en una realidad, ¡necesitamos que personas con talento y ambición como tú se unan a nuestro equipo!

El puesto se encuentra dentro del equipo de Operational Excellence (OEX), el cual pertenece al área de Customer Operations (COPS). ¿Quieres cambiar el mundo? En Cabify eso es exactamente lo que hacemos. Quizás algún día las ciudades sean lugares donde nadie necesite un coche privado. Pero aún nos queda camino por recorrer.

Fundada en 2011, nos hemos convertido en el primer 'unicornio' tecnológico español. Nuestra sede central está en Madrid, pero actualmente puedes encontrarnos en 93 ciudades de España, Portugal y Latinoamérica.

Sin importar cuánto crezcamos, estamos decididos a mantener nuestro espíritu 'startup'. Somos un equipo seguro, profesional, carismático y enfocado, joven de corazón y orgulloso de hacer las cosas bien. Nos consideramos una empresa tecnológica ética e innovadora, donde todos son tratados con justicia y respeto, desde nuestros ingenieros hasta los conductores que usan nuestra plataforma. Cumplimos con todas las normativas gubernamentales y respetamos las leyes locales.

Cabify se enorgullece de ser un lugar de trabajo con igualdad de oportunidades. Celebramos la diversidad y estamos comprometidos a crear un entorno inclusivo para todos los empleados, independientemente de su origen, género, religión, orientación, edad o capacidad. ¿Te apuntas?

¿Cómo nos ayudarás a cumplir nuestra misión?

Te asegurarás de que los managers cuenten con las herramientas e información necesarias para impulsar el compromiso y alcanzar los objetivos de negocio

- Implementarás programas de desarrollo globales adaptados a las necesidades de cada equipo

israel.description:
Cabify Ads es una división de negocio de publicidad dentro de las soluciones B2B que ofrecemos en Cabify. Nuestro inventario incluye soluciones digitales (in-app), como Journey Ads y otros formatos, en las que aprovechamos al máximo nuestra tecnología e información para crear segmentos altamente alineados con las necesidades de nuestros clientes. Y clave para este rol, ofrecemos soluciones offline (in-car, in-moto), como vinilos, reposacabezas, pantallas y otros soportes, que contribuyen directamente al aumento de la consideración y la visibilidad de marca de nuestros clientes.

Cabify se enfoca en un público que prioriza la calidad, la seguridad y la sostenibilidad, y estos mismos valores son los que ofrecemos en esta nueva vertical.

Acerca de la posición:

En Cabify Ads buscamos una persona organizada, resolutiva y con capacidad de gestión operativa para coordinar todos los procesos vinculados a la publicidad dentro de nuestros vehículos: el vinilado y desvinilado de vehículos, y las pantallas internas y externas de los coches, tanto en nuestra flota propia como en otras flotas, en España e internacionalmente, asegurando el cumplimiento de plazos, la calidad del servicio y la comunicación fluida entre las áreas internas, proveedores y socios externos.

- Planificar y coordinar de forma integral todos los recursos, procesos y timings necesarios para la ejecución de campañas.

- Liderar la gestión operativa de principio a fin: activación, seguimiento, control, cierre, facturación y cobro.

- Asegurar la trazabilidad y eficiencia operativa.

- Ser el punto de conexión entre equipos comerciales, tecnología, data, marketing y finanzas para garantizar la entrega efectiva y a tiempo de todas las campañas.

- Coordinar en la base las operaciones diarias de vinilado y desvinilado de vehículos, tanto de campañas publicitarias como de la propia publicidad de Cabify.

- Gestionar el flujo de entrada y salida de vehículos en coordinación con el área de flota y el proveedor externo.

- Supervisar la calidad del vinilado (revisión visual, reportes fotográficos, incidencias, daños, etc.).

- Controlar la documentación y trazabilidad del proceso (checklists, registros, actualizaciones en sistema).

- Colaborar con plataforma y equipo Media para el seguimiento de campañas y cumplimiento de SLA.

- Comunicar de forma continua el estado de avance, incidencias o desviaciones.

- Asegurar el cumplimiento de normativas internas, PRL y políticas de seguridad dentro de base.

- Con respecto a otras pantallas (tablets, on-top), tu rol será:

- Gestionar operativamente las pantallas (planificación y activación de campañas, coordinación con diferentes equipos, reporting post-campaña)



¿Lo que buscamos?

- Experiencia previa en coordinación operativa, logística o gestión de flotas (valorable experiencia en automoción y/o publicidad exterior).

- Capacidad de planificación y resolución de incidencias en entornos dinámicos de forma autónoma

- Capacidad de aprendizaje para gestionar campañas de otros soportes digitales (pantallas online).

- Comunicación efectiva, capacidad de negociación y orientación al trabajo en equipo.

- Nivel medio en herramientas de gestión (Google Workspace, Excel, Slack, etc.) y capacidad para trabajar con nuevas tecnologías (IA)

israel.description:
Do you want to drive the next urban revolution? At Cabify, that’s what we’re doing. We aim to make cities better places to live by improving mobility for the people living in them, connecting  riders to drivers at the touch of a button. Maybe one day cities will be places where nobody needs a private car. But we’ve still got a long way to go… want to be part of this journey?

About the position

You will join Cabify’s Applied Science team, a group of highly motivated data scientists with access to all data within the organization. The team is involved in all main areas of the company, including vehicle and route management, understanding user experience, pricing, fraud detection, and marketing optimization (see for yourself: exhibit A, exhibit B, exhibit C). You will work with state-of-the-art tools and infrastructure to help improve everyday operations in more than 40 cities worldwide. Cabify's Applied Science team provides a unique opportunity to research, test and implement great ideas that will shape the future of our cities.

As a Senior Data Scientist in our team, you will:

- Propose and develop high-impact data science projects, working closely with other data, engineering, product and business teams.

- Design, train, and validate statistical and machine learning models and help deploying them into production.

- Participate in the definition and results analysis of real-life experiments, following academy-standard scientific methods and procedures, to demonstrate the impact of the new product features we develop.

- Help to convert the team’s work into real and tangible business insights that bring value to the company.

- Participate in research and innovation, bringing new ideas to the team and helping expand our technical and scientific knowledge.

- Participate in the diffusion of complex ideas to all sorts of stakeholders, in alignment with the deeply-rooted data culture of the company.

- Be an active participant in product development conversations, proposing new features and providing the data science perspective in everything we build.

- Be a technical reference within the team, fostering growth and promoting best practices.

What we’re looking for

- At least 5 years of professional experience working as a data scientist or equivalent research role.

- Strong educational background, e.g. Master/PhD in Computer Science, Physics, Engineering, Mathematics, Economics, etc.

- Experience leading the design, training and validation of statistical and machine learning models.

- Strong knowledge of Python for data analysis and data visualization libraries.

- Experience with data extraction and processing. Capable of writing complex SQL code.

- Experience bringing machine learning to production, with all its subtleties: deploying, training, testing, model degradation, model serving, etc.

- Ability to work autonomously in an unstructured environment.

Bonus Points

- Strong background in Probability & Statistics.

- Experience in the various aspects of scientific experimentation (experiment design, population sampling, testing methodology, statistical significance analysis, etc.).

- Experience publishing in peer-reviewed scientific journals.

- Experience with state-of-the-art methods in topics like deep learning models, time series analysis, bayesian statistics, causal inference, etc.

- Experience with geo data modeling, analysis and visualization.

What’s it like to work at Cabify?

We’re a company full of happy, motivated people and we never want that to change. Here are some more reasons why it rocks to be part of our high-performance team:

israel.description:
Do you want to change the world? At Cabify, that’s what we’re doing. We aim to make cities better places to live by improving mobility for the people living in them, connecting riders to drivers, providing mobility alternatives such as scooters and mopeds and many others to come, all at the touch of a button. Maybe one day cities will be places where nobody needs a private car. But we’ve still got a long way to go… Fancy joining us?

Our Product & Engineering teams are both based in Madrid, with a strong remote culture, and include an eclectic bunch of awesome people from different backgrounds like Ruby, Go, Elixir, Javascript, and Python.

Right now we’re working on some pretty greenfield projects with a solid set of product ideas lined up ready for innovative engineers to tackle. And of course we have big plans to take over the taxi app service industry!

Site Reliability Engineers at Cabify work on improving all aspects of our platform and have an impact across the whole organisation. They are a blend of systems engineers and software developers who solve scalability issues with software and implement the best production engineering and security practices.

Check our Public Tech Handbook >HERE< to know a bit more about us!



As a Site Reliability Engineer, you will be:

- Evolving our infrastructure platform building self-service components that will be used by all the engineering team and by millions of users around the world.

- Working closely with our Product and Infrastructure teams to architecture and develop world-class infrastructure components.

- Designing and implementing tooling to improve the availability, scalability, observability and latency of our services, which are used by internal customers to deploy and operate their services.

- Increasing reliability awareness with other teams, helping with the adoption of reliability principles and reviewing observability implementations or software architectures.

- Defining SLIs, SLOs and SLAs as part of the services' lifecycle.

- Sharing an on-call schedule for the platform services you own.

- Solving problems in our highly available platform together with other teams, then build automations to prevent incidents from happening again.

- Participating in our recruiting process to help grow our engineering team.

You may be a fit for this role if you:

- Think Unix, you know the networking stack, the OSI model, containers (and schedulers), and you know your way around monitoring, logging and the CAP theorem (bonus!).

- Have strong programming skills in at least one language, and know your way around a few more or can learn them if the opportunity arises.

- Automate yourself out of everything by nature, making machines do the toil.

- Communicate effectively and asynchronously.

- Care about the things that affect the company, your team, and yourself.

- Embrace diversity and humbleness (and a bit of trolling).

- Prefer taking iterative action over waiting for things to happen or to be perfect.

- Strongly favor simplicity over complexity. Ie, adhering to the KISS principle.

- Have a sense for identifying, exploiting and elevating bottlenecks.

- Are not afraid of expressing yourself in English. We aren't expecting you to have the Queen's accent, but you'll be part of an international team and we communicate in English, so you should be comfortable with that.

- Enjoy herding cats and shaving yaks. Ie, being a great influence to other product teams and teaching them best practices. As well as analyzing and simplifying our setup.



Projects you could work on:

- Helping us iterate on and improve our Kubernetes setup (AWS EKS) and surrounding infrastructure (i.e. secrets, container images and repositories) using Terraform.

- Iterate our networking layer to implement network policies, service mesh, and more…

- Evolving our observability platform (Grafana stack and Cortex), in order to provide a first-class service to all of our engineering teams.

- Operating and improving the persistence layer (SLQ and no-SQL DBs).

- Maintaining our company-wide code repository and continuous integration solution (GitLab)

israel.title: Software Engineer - Backend + AI
israel.description:
Do you want to change the world? At Cabify, that's what we're doing. We aim to make cities better places to live by improving mobility for the people living in them, connecting riders to drivers at the touch of a button. Maybe one day cities will be places where nobody needs a private car. But we've still got a long way to go… fancy joining us?

At Cabify, diversity fuels our Product & Engineering teams. We actively recruit talent beyond traditional channels, embracing individuals from diverse backgrounds and supporting initiatives like Women Tech Dating, Contrata Diferente and our Internal Diversity Committee. Our commitment is reflected in inclusive job descriptions, creating an environment where every contribution is cherished. Join Cabify to be part of innovative teams that truly represent the rich tapestry of talent in the tech industry.

Right now, we have more than 20 million users around the world. We work across 6 countries and 40 cities, adapting our product fast to be leaders in all those markets and taking care about sustainability.

The job

We are looking for Software Engineers (Backend) who are ready to embrace Agentic Development as part of how they build software. At Cabify, we use AI tools throughout the development lifecycle, to explore and understand systems, design solutions, implement and test them, and accelerate delivery, while engineers remain accountable for technical decisions, code quality, reliability, and production outcomes.

We're language agnostic - your team will primarily work with Go, Elixir or Ruby, but that doesn't mean your past experience needs to match. We rely on whatever tool fits the problem best, and you'll have the flexibility to draw on other languages and technologies across the stack when it makes sense. We believe that if you've worked in other languages like Java your whole career, you can still pick up Elixir or Go quickly, what matters most is being adaptable, curious, and quick to learn new tools, including AI-native ones.

Check our Public Tech Handbook >https://cabify.tech/handbook/< to know a bit more about us!

At Technology you will

- Collaborate with principal engineers on development planning and architecture design, including where AI-driven components fit into our systems

- Design, build and maintain distributed, clean, testable, data-oriented applications, increasingly incorporating AI/LLM-powered services and features

- Use AI coding assistants and agentic tools as part of your daily workflow to move faster without compromising code quality

- Improve service reliability, scalability and performance,  including systems that integrate with LLM and AI model APIs.

- Own your code all the way to production with a self-service continuous delivery pipeline and production infrastructure

- Dive deep into host-level problem-solving and help improve detection methods

- Play a vital role in nurturing our engineering culture, emphasizing quality through peer reviews, monitoring, on-call best practices, and responsible use of AI tooling

- Mentor junior developers, including how to effectively pair with AI tools

- Collaborate closely with the Data Science team on data

Our ideal candidate has

- Great alignment with our principles (check out the handbook)

- Solid knowledge of common algorithms & data structures

- Experience developing medium/large-scale web applications and distributed systems in production

Liderar al equipo presencial de venta y atención al cliente del aeropuerto para que cumpla sus

israel.title: Talent Acquisition Analyst
israel.description:
¿Quieres cambiar el mundo?

Eso es lo que hacemos en Cabify. Nuestro objetivo es hacer de las ciudades mejores lugares para vivir, mejorando la movilidad de las personas que viven en ellas, conectando a pasajeros y conductores con tan sólo pulsar un botón. Es posible que algún día las ciudades sean lugares donde nadie necesite un coche privado, pero aún nos queda un largo camino por recorrer… ¿nos acompañas?

Fundada en 2011, nos hemos convertido en el primer ‘unicornio’ español. Nuestra sede central está en Madrid pero actualmente nos encontramos en 38 ciudades de España y Latinoamérica. Y cada mes que pasa más gente se une a nuestro equipo internacional lleno de personas apasionadas, brillantes y con talento con ganas de desafiar el “status quo”.

Pero no importa lo rápido que crezcamos o lo grande que nos volvamos, queremos mantener nuestro espíritu ‘start-up’. Somos un equipo seguro de sí mismo, energético, profesional y carismático, y estamos orgullosos de hacer las cosas bien. Nos gusta pensar en nosotros mismos como una empresa de tecnología ética e innovadora que ha creado un negocio donde todos son tratados de manera justa y respetuosa, desde nuestros ingenieros hasta los conductores que utilizan nuestra plataforma. Además, siempre cumplimos plenamente con las regulaciones gubernamentales y respetamos las leyes locales.

Hemos recorrido un largo camino hasta ahora, pero en realidad nuestro viaje no ha hecho más que comenzar. Si vamos a convertir nuestra misión en una realidad, ¡necesitamos que personas con talento y ambición como tú se unan a nuestro equipo!

Sobre el puesto

Como People Analyst (Talent Acquisition), tendrás un rol clave en la gestión integral de los procesos de selección, asegurando la correcta ejecución, seguimiento y trazabilidad de las vacantes asignadas, desde el levantamiento de la necesidad hasta el cierre del proceso.

Tu misión será garantizar la atracción, evaluación y vinculación oportuna del talento, asegurando la calidad de los candidatos, la eficiencia del proceso y la adecuada articulación con hiring managers, proveedores externos y áreas internas, contribuyendo al cumplimiento de los objetivos del negocio.

¿Cómo nos ayudarás a cumplir con nuestra misión?

- Gestionando integralmente los procesos de selección asignados, organizando kick off, realizando seguimiento a vacantes y coordinando con hiring managers y outsourcing.

- Ejecutando el reclutamiento, selección y evaluación de candidatos, brindando feedback oportuno y asegurando la calidad del proceso.

- Administrando la publicación de vacantes y el uso de herramientas internas, garantizando el correcto flujo del proceso de selección.

- Garantizando la consecución y validación de la documentación requerida para la contratación.

- Manteniendo la actualización en tiempo real de los procesos de selección y su trazabilidad.

- Apoyando la ejecución de iniciativas de Talent Acquisition y Development, contribuyendo al cumplimiento de los objetivos del área.

Lo que estamos buscando

- Formación académica: Profesional en Psicología o carreras afines.

- Experiencia: Mínimo 2 años como generalista en procesos de Gestión Humana, con experiencia en selección de personal, administración de beneficios, desarrollo organizacional y seguimiento de indicadores.

¿Qué ofrecemos?

En Cabify queremos que disfrutes tu trabajo tanto como nosotros. Encontrarás un ambiente positivo, oportunidades de crecimiento y la posibilidad de generar un verdadero impacto.

Además, te ofrecemos:

- Tipo de contrato: Término indefinido.

- Horario: Lunes a viernes.

- Eventos divertidos con todo el equipo.

- Descuentos para empleados.

- Beneficios extralegales.

- Programas de desarrollo personal.

- Todo el equipamiento que necesites (tú solo tienes que poner tu talento).

- Y lo último, pero no menos importante... ¡café gratis!

israel.title: (Senior) Technical Program Manager - M&A Integration (m/f/d) - Berlin
israel.description:
Location: Come and join us in Hamburg or Berlin!

Following Lyft’s acquisition of Freenow, we are looking for a Senior TPM to lead the technical workstreams that get us to Day 1 readiness — the period between signing and closing — and to set up the integration that follows. This is a high-stakes, high-visibility role reporting into the EU Tech Leader, with direct exposure to Freenow and Lyft leadership.

You will be the single point of accountability for technical Day 1 readiness. That means making sure every employee, every office, and every critical system is ready to operate underFreenow by Lyft from the moment the deal closes — and that the integration stream is up and running the day after. You will also be the TPM accountable for the integration of future acquisitions Freenow makes.

This is not a role for someone who wants to administer a project plan. You are expected to be technically credible, opinionated, and comfortable holding senior people to account across IT, Security, Infrastructure, Engineering, Legal, People, and Finance. You make decisions when others stall, escalate cleanly when you can’t, and keep the whole machine moving.

YOUR DAILY ADVENTURES WILL INCLUDE:

- Day 1 readiness. Own the end-to-end technical readiness plan between signing and closing. Define what “ready” means, track every workstream against it, and call the go/no-go on technical readiness for Day 1.

- IT and workplace cutover. Coordinate identity and system access (SSO, IdP, mail, productivity suite, engineering tooling), hardware provisioning and re-imaging, and office setup including network, VPN, Wi-Fi, meeting rooms, and physical access. Make sure nobody shows up on Day 1 unable to work.

- Security and compliance posture. Partner with Security and Legal to make sure the technical environment meets the new shareholder’s requirements on Day 1 — access controls, data handling, audit trails, vendor relationships.

- Integration stream kickoff. Stand up the technical integration workstreams between Freenow and Lyft so they are running, staffed, and producing output from day one of the integration phase. Set the operating cadence, dependencies, and escalation paths.

- Cross-functional orchestration. Hold IT, SRE, Infrastructure, Platform, Product Engineering, Data, Security, People, Legal, and Finance together on a single plan. Push hard on dependencies. Surface risks before they become incidents.

- Executive communication. Produce the technical readiness narrative for Freenow leadership, Lyft leadership, and the integration steering committee. Honest, concise, decision-oriented.

- Future M&A. Codify what you learn into a repeatable M&A integration playbook so we can do this faster and better the next time Freenow acquires a company.

TO BE SUCCESSFUL IN THIS ROLE:

- Significant TPM, engineering management, or M&A integration experience, with a clear track record of delivering on M&A separation, integration, or carve-out programmes — ideally including a Day 1 cutover under a new owner.

- A strong technical foundation — software engineering or infrastructure background. You can sit in an architecture review and push back credibly, and you understand what it takes to operate large-scale, 24x7 production systems.

- Working knowledge of enterprise IT and corporate engineering: identity providers and SSO, MDM, endpoint management, networking and VPN, SaaS provisioning, source control and CI/CD tooling, cloud account structures.

- Comfort operating in extreme ambiguity with only high-level direction, across multiple jurisdictions, time zones, and corporate cultures.

- Excellent written and verbal communication in English. You can brief a C-level audience in three slides and an engineer in a Slack thread, and adjust the register without losing precision.

- Influence without authority. You get senior people to commit, deliver, and stay aligned in a matrixed environment — without needing a reporting line to do it.

- Calm under pressure. M&A timelines move, regulators ask questions, and things break. You stay structured and keep others structured.

Nice to have:

- Previous experience inside a regulated business (mobility, fintech, payments) or working through a change-of-control event.

- Familiarity with the German labour and works council context.

- Exposure to both acquirer-side and target-side integration work.

BENEFITS & PERKS IN A NUTSHELL:

- Flexible working arrangements

- LinkedIn Learning

- Sabbatical & special leave policies

- WeRoad partnership

- Birthday, 24th + 31st December off

- Short term EU work policy

- Mobility Credit

- Health Insurance

- Employee assistance program





DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION:

Freenow is an equal opportunity employer and we consider qualified applicants regardless of race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability or age.
We want you to grow and evolve, bring your true self to work.

About Us:

AppsFlyer helps the world's leading brands understand what their marketing is actually doing.
Our measurement, analytics and audience platform processes billions of events a day for customers who need to separate what works from what only looks like it works.
We were built by people who came out of the industry we serve, and staying close to that problem is still how we operate.

Measurement is being rebuilt right now. Platform privacy changes, the shift from deterministic attribution toward incrementality and modelling, and AI moving from a product feature to the way marketing decisions actually get made.
All of it lands on our roadmap and on our customers' desks at the same time. Greater China is where it plays out fastest.

About the role:

GCR is AppsFlyer's largest market in Asia and one of the most competitive measurement markets in the world. The General Manager owns the full regional P&L: revenue, margin, people, product relevance and market position. You'll set the strategy, build and hold the leadership team, and be the face of AppsFlyer to customers, platforms, partners, media and regulators in China.

This is a defend-and-grow mandate. The business is established and the brand is known. Growth from here comes from deepening our largest accounts, winning the outbound motion as Chinese apps and brands scale overseas, and making sure the platform solves the measurement problems Chinese marketers actually have.

What you'll do:

- Own the full regional P&L: revenue, margin, and budget against plan

- Set multi-year regional strategy: which verticals and segments to prioritise, resource, or walk away from

- Build and lead a regional leadership team spanning revenue, customer engagement, partnerships and marketing, and grow the bench beneath them

- Own the product agenda for GCR: identify where the platform falls short for local customers, build the case, and drive it through global product and engineering

- Ensure full regulatory, data and labour compliance in partnership with Legal, Finance and People

About the Role

We’re looking for an Industry Lead – eCommerce to be our eCommerce expert in EMEA. You’ll work with clients, and with our own teams, on how mobile-first commerce really works: how customers are acquired and retained, which markets and models are growing, and where measurement changes the decisions people make. You’ll sit inside the Sales organization, but the job is advisory. You help clients and colleagues see their business more clearly, and the commercial outcomes follow from that.

EMEA is a varied region. Mature Western European markets sit next to fast-growing ones in CEE, the Middle East, and Africa. Clients range from D2C brands building their first performance programs to marketplaces running retail media businesses. You’ll need to hold a credible conversation with all of them.

What you’ll do

- Be the vertical expert. Build a clear, evidence-based view of EMEA eCommerce: what’s changing, what’s working, and what’s next. Retail media, marketplaces, D2C, cross-border commerce, and quick commerce are all in scope. Share it with the people who need it.

- Run executive business reviews for eCommerce clients. Use category benchmarks to show clients how they perform against their peers. Turn the data into a clear story, with recommendations they can act on.

- Go deep on the data. Work with our data analysts on analyses such as conversion funnels, in-app event performance, and cohort behavior. Define the KPIs that matter for the vertical and track them over time. Use our benchmarking and AI-enabled tooling to make this repeatable.

- Advise on strategy. Join client workshops and strategy conversations. Bring vertical context and best practice to help teams decide where to invest and what to measure.

- Support account teams. Give Sales and Customer Success vertical insight, benchmarks, and positioning for their key accounts. Build account-level views of where a client stands and where the opportunity is.

- Look ahead. Track where the vertical is heading, including new commerce models, platform changes, and the regulatory and privacy landscape (GDPR, DMA and others). Work out what it means for clients and for us.

- Build playbooks and content. Create vertical playbooks, frameworks, and research that teams across the company can reuse. Work with Marketing, Product, and Enablement so it reaches the right audience.

- Bring the market back to Product. Pass on what you hear from clients and from the market, so it shapes what we build.

- Be visible in the industry. Publish, speak, host executive roundtables, and represent AppsFlyer at eCommerce events and forums.

- Work as one global team. Collaborate with Industry Leads in other regions and verticals. Share methods, benchmarks, and learnings, and help us package our expertise in more structured ways.

- Show the impact. Be clear about how your work influences client outcomes, pipeline, and growth. We measure the function’s contribution, and you’ll help us do it well.

What you have

- 6+ years in eCommerce, retail, or growth, strategy, or analytics roles serving them, such as in-house, agency, or consulting

- Deep understanding of customer acquisition and retention: UA, re-marketing, conversion optimization, omnichannel

- A strong analytical mindset. You’re comfortable with data and good at explaining what it means to non-analysts.

- Experience working with sales or customer-facing teams on client strategy

You’re also part of a global team building a new kind of function inside AppsFlyer, and you’ll have real influence on how it develops.

israel.title: IT Service Desk Team Leader
israel.description:
As the IT Service Desk Team Leader at AppsFlyer, you will drive the end-to-end operation of our global Service Desk, managing our people, service quality, technical standards, and AI-driven support capabilities. Reporting directly to the Head of Global IT, you will guide a distributed group of Service Desk engineers spanning HQ/EMEA, the Americas, and APAC.

You will serve as the operational catalyst for our transition from traditional ticket queues to an AI-native ITSM framework. This modern model prioritizes higher self-service resolution, leverages a tightly governed knowledge base as a single source of truth for AI and employees alike, and integrates automated processes directly into daily workflows.

Operating as a true player-coach, you will mentor the team and evaluate service performance using clear metrics, while maintaining the technical expertise needed to handle complex escalations and help architect Tier-0 self-service solutions. Rather than simply managing incoming tickets, your success will be defined by eliminating repetitive tasks and sharpening the team's capabilities for high-value technical support.

What You'll Do

Lead and Develop the Team

-     Manage the global Service Desk team: hiring, onboarding, goal-setting, performance, coaching, and career development

-     Run follow-the-sun coverage across regions, including shift planning, on-call, and handoffs between HQ/EMEA, the Americas, and APAC

-     Build a culture of ownership, service quality, and continuous learning; level up engineers through pairing, technical reviews, and knowledge transfer

-     Define roles, responsibilities, and growth paths within the team so that technical and service ladders are explicit and understood

-     Represent the Service Desk to the wider IT organization, to leadership, and to business stakeholders

Own Service Operations and Outcomes

-     Own the Service Desk KPIs end to end: self-service rate, CSAT, time-to-fulfillment, SLA attainment, knowledge coverage and quality, and automation hours saved

-     Operate and continuously improve the ITSM platform: queues, workflows, request catalog, automation rules, and reporting

-     Own major incidents and VIP escalations end-to-end, including stakeholder communication, coordination with Infrastructure and Security, and post-incident learning

-     Drive onboarding, offboarding, and asset lifecycle quality across the employee lifecycle, in partnership with People, Security, and Facilities

-     Report on service health and transformation progress to IT leadership with data, not anecdotes

Set the Technical Standard

-     Act as the Senior technical escalation lead for macOS, Windows, MDM systems (Kandji, Intune), IAM (Okta), Google Workspace, Slack, AV conference equipment (Zoom Rooms, Neat, Google Meet), networking, and LLM administration console management.

-     Own runbooks, troubleshooting methodology, and technical standards, and ensure the team actually adopts them

-     Partner with Infrastructure, Security, and IT Operations on cross-functional issues, access governance, and endpoint compliance

-     Stay hands-on: take escalations, ship fixes, and keep your own technical credibility current

Build the AI-Native Service Desk (Tier 0)

-     Own the Tier-0 roadmap: identify the highest-volume, lowest-value request categories and design them out of existence through self-service, knowledge, and automation

-     Govern the knowledge base as a product: ownership, quality standards, review cycles, and structure fit for both human readers and AI grounding

-     Build and oversee automations that remove entire ticket classes (Make.com, scripting, ITSM-native automation), with measured impact

-     Develop, evaluate, and improve AI-assisted support workflows; define how the team validates AI output and handles its failure modes

-     Make the team AI-native by default: AI fluency is a baseline for every engineer, and building with AI is a shared responsibility rather than a side project

What You Have

Required:

- 5+ years in IT Service Desk/Support at 500+ employee companies, including 2+ years leading a Service Desk team

- Led a distributed or multi-region team, or supported a global user base across time zones

- Ran a service against defined KPIs (CSAT, SLA, time-to-fulfillment, self-service rate) and improved them measurably

- Hands-on depth across macOS and Windows, with admin-level MDM (Kandji, Intune, Jamf) and IAM (Okta, Entra ID) experience, including lifecycle workflows

- Owned or configured an ITSM platform (JSM, ServiceNow, Freshservice, Zendesk, or an AI-native equivalent)

- Evidence of building, not just using: an automation, AI-assisted workflow, scripted process, or knowledge base engineered for self-service or AI. Daily AI fluency is a baseline.

- Led incidents or rollouts end-to-end, including communication with executives and non-technical stakeholders

- Clear communicator and coach: professional fluency in English

Nice to Have:

- Successfully deployed an AI-driven support solution (e.g., virtual agents, intelligent routing, automated triage)

- Proven track record driving Tier-0/self-service initiatives or navigating complex ITSM platform migrations

- Background operating within cloud-native or SaaS-focused technology environments

- Proficiency with workflow automation platforms (Make.com, Zapier, n8n) and scripting environments (Python, Bash, PowerShell, AppleScript)

- Administrative experience with core enterprise systems, including Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, OpenAI, and Anthropic

- Strong grounding in ITIL or comparable IT service management best practices

- B.Sc. or Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems or related technical field

- Referral from a current AppsFlyer team member

Why AppsFlyer

AppsFlyer is the global leader in marketing measurement and analytics. Our IT team operates at the forefront of technology, building an AI-native support environment where automation and intelligence are embedded into everything we do. israel.title: Sales Development Representative Manager
israel.description:
Position number - 2877



At AppsFlyer, we believe every challenge is an invitation to innovate. We're looking for a Manager of Sales Development to lead our North America SDR team: Six reps in San Francisco running the top of funnel into the accounts that drive our new logo pipeline. You'll own how they prospect, how quickly they ramp to full productivity, and how the role itself evolves as AppsFlyer builds an AI-first go-to-market organization.

About the Role

AppsFlyer is the Modern Marketing Cloud trusted by more than 15,000 brands worldwide. North America sales development sits inside regional marketing org and creates the net-new pipeline behind our growth and enterprise business.



The team runs the full top-of-funnel motion: Greenfield prospecting, competitive displacement against other measurement providers, and inbound qualification. You'll report to the Senior Director of Marketing for North America, and success in this role depends on operating in lockstep with regional sales, field marketing, and the global demand generation team.



North America is also where AI-assisted sales development gets defined at AppsFlyer. Part of this job is deciding which parts of the motion software should run, which parts stay with people, and what an SDR's day looks like as that line moves.

What You'll Do

Lead the team

- Manage six SDRs directly. Own one-to-ones, coaching, ramp, territory and patch decisions, and performance.

- Stay close enough to the work that you notice when activity or results drift that week, and act on it, rather than finding it in a quarterly review.

- Set the standard for how the team operates and hold it, including when that means an uncomfortable conversation early instead of a harder one later.

Own the craft

- Coach outbound calling directly. Listen to live calls and give reps specific, actionable direction on what to change and why.

- Own sequence quality, messaging, call structure, objection handling, and discovery. Take a sequence apart with a rep and rebuild it together.

- Have a point of view on the work: Which accounts are worth 1:1 personalization, which are best served by a strong pre-built cadence, and where the team's time is better spent elsewhere.

Own pipeline quality

- Carry the team's pipeline target across both volume and quality of meetings generated.

- Protect focused time for named strategic accounts while driving coverage across the wider set of high-fit prospects.

- Own the metrics and act on them. Weekly pacing, per-rep diagnostics, and a clear read on where the funnel is leaking and why.

Build the AI-assisted motion

- Own the AI tooling behind the team's output, from evaluation through implementation and day-to-day operation, across lead qualification, signal-based outbound, meeting preparation, and sequence generation.

- Define the plays, set the qualification and disqualification logic, and review what the agents produce before it reaches a prospect.

- Judge output honestly against a real quality bar and a real cost, and decide what earns a place in the motion and what does not.

- Shape what the team does with the capacity this creates, which we expect to shift toward the work that benefits most from a person in the room.

Hire and develop people

- Own recruiting and onboarding as a standing part of the job. This team turns over by design: Strong SDRs graduate into Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing roles, and there is a path from Growth SDR into Enterprise SDR.

- Give every new rep a structured ramp with clear expectations and regular feedback, so they always know where they stand and have what they need to succeed.

- Build the assets that make ramp repeatable: A documented onboarding plan, a library of strong calls and sequences, and defined 30, 60, and 90 day expectations.

What You Bring

- Recent hands-on outbound sales development experience. You have personally made the calls, written and tested the sequences, and learned the craft by doing it rather than by managing people who do.

- The ability to transfer that craft. You can sit with a rep after a difficult call and tell them precisely what to do differently.

- Direct management experience with SDRs or BDRs, covering hiring, ramping, coaching, and performance management.

- Daily fluency with AI tools and informed opinions about where they fail. Engineering skills are not required, but judgment is: The ability to take an agentic tool, point it at a real problem, evaluate the output without wishful thinking, and decide whether it belongs in the motion.

- Comfort with a role that is actively changing shape, and interest in being one of the people who determines that shape.

- Out-of-the-box thinking. The obvious plays are already running, and we want someone who finds the angle nobody else is working.

- Curiosity about the mobile app economy and how marketing performance is measured within it. This is a technical space where privacy rules, platform policies, and measurement methods change constantly, and the people who do well here want to understand how it works rather than only how to sell it.

- Autonomy. You set your own priorities, build your own process, and escalate the things that genuinely need a decision.

- Candor. You give feedback early and plainly, to your team and upward.

- Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to present performance, a shortfall, and a credible plan to leadership.



At AppsFlyer, we're committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. Don't meet 100% of the qualifications? If you're excited about this role and believe you have the skills to succeed, we encourage you to apply.

Bonus Points

- Experience in MarTech, AdTech, mobile technology, attribution, analytics, or measurement platforms.

- Experience working with Mobile Measurement Partners (MMPs).

- Vertical depth in one of our priority industries (gaming, e-commerce, finance, media and entertainment).

- Experience selling or prospecting into marketing, growth, data, or product teams.

- Experience working with global teams across multiple time zones.

- Introduced by an AppsFlyer team member.



This role is based in our San Francisco office and requires in-office presence four days per week. The team is co-located and the coaching happens shoulder to shoulder.
For our SF-based candidates, the expected On Target Earnings (OTE) are between $180000 and $220000 (including bonus or commission). The offer varies on many factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, experience, interview results, references, etc.

israel.title: Senior IT Infrastructure Operations
israel.description:
AppsFlyer is looking for a Senior IT Infrastructure Operations to join our IT Infrastructure team in Herzliya, Israel. IT at AppsFlyer is not only a support function - it is one of the operating layers that enables the company's AI-native transformation. We are building an autonomous, AI-operated IT department: agents run the routine 24/7, humans stay in the loop, and autonomy is earned through gates.

You will join a small InfraOps team that owns the company's identity, SaaS, IT cloud environment and endpoint foundations - and turns them into a governed platform that both people and AI agents can operate. This is a hands-on role for someone who designs at the architecture level, ships production-grade automation and internal products end-to-end, and treats documentation as part of "done" so that agents can run on it.

What you'll do

Identity & core systems

- Own and evolve our identity platform: Okta (SSO, tier groups, Workflows, SCIM, API Gateway), Just-In-Time access, and the full user and non-human identity lifecycle - service accounts, API keys, break-glass and audit.

- Administer, and harden core SaaS - Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, Entitle, Microsoft 365 - and the AI platforms the company runs on (Claude, ChatGPT / OpenAI, Gemini, Cursor, etc.).

- Serve as Tier 3 escalation with real diagnostic depth: certificates, auth chains, cross-platform policy conflicts, MDM edge cases.

Platform engineering

- Build and operate the IT Infra Platform on GCP - Cloud Run, VPC Service Controls, Cloud Armor, Terraform, GitHub Actions, secret management - and deliver internal products on it end-to-end: design → IaC → CI/CD → secured deploy → operate.

- Contribute to the AI Govern layer: usage governance, cost attribution and model access control.

Automation

- Design automation across Make.com, Okta Workflows and deployed code, with APIs, webhooks and MCP as first-class integration surfaces.

- Own the health of what you build - monitoring, alerting, failure runbooks - and drive the backlog toward zero-touch self-service.

AI-native IT & agents

- Build agents that execute real infra tasks with explicit action boundaries and stop/escalation conditions - from Tier-0 self-service to autonomous remediation.

- Apply prompt and context engineering and evaluation to real IT use cases; own skills and plug-ins in the company's AI framework.

- Write resolution notes, ADRs and runbooks so that agents (and teammates) can act on them.

Endpoint, network & security

- Support the endpoint stack (Kandji, Intune, Airlock) and global office network (Meraki, FortiGate, Palo Alto Prisma) alongside the team.

- Partner with Security on vendor and app risk, shadow-AI and SaaS governance, and audit readiness - moving manual approvals to policy-as-code.

What you have

- 5+ years hands-on in IT infrastructure, SysAdmin / InfraDevOps or platform engineering in a SaaS or high-growth tech environment.

- Deep, production-level command of Okta (or equivalent IdP) and enterprise SaaS administration - Google Workspace, Slack, Atlassian, Microsoft 365.

- Real cloud engineering: GCP (preferred) or AWS / Azure, Terraform or other IaC, containers, CI/CD, secrets management.

- Strong scripting and integration skills - Python and/or TypeScript, REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth.

- Proven experience designing and operating automation at scale (Make.com, n8n, Workato, Okta Workflows or similar), including monitoring and ownership of what you build.

- Hands-on experience building with LLMs (Claude and/or OpenAI APIs) and applying prompt and context engineering to real use cases.

- Security-minded by default (least privilege, zero trust, secret hygiene, audit trails), architecture-level thinking, and a habit of documenting so others - and agents - can run what you build.

- Self-directed and fast: you originate improvements rather than execute tickets, and you're comfortable learning a new tool this week and owning it in production the next.

- Strong written and verbal English.

Bonus points

- Building internal tools / full-stack apps (React / Node / Python) with SSO-backed auth.

- Advanced LLM engineering: RAG, agent frameworks, MCP servers, LLM evaluation; AI gateway / LLM cost governance (LiteLLM, Bifrost, Vertex AI, Bedrock).

- MDM at depth (Kandji, Jamf, Intune) and cross-MDM scripting; network fundamentals or global office rollouts.

- Relevant cloud, Terraform or Okta certifications - or the equivalent hands-on experience.

Why this role

You will be one of a handful of engineers turning IT into a platform that agents operate - with a real say in what we build and how, ownership of production systems used by the entire company, and a mandate to build the next generation of autonomous IT. New AI and infrastructure technologies land on our desk constantly; you'll be the one evaluating them, adapting them to how AppsFlyer works, and taking the ones that earn it into production.

israel.title: Senior Legal Counsel
israel.description:
Position Number - 2923

At AppsFlyer, we believe every challenge is an invitation to innovate. We’re looking for a Senior Legal Counsel to be a trusted legal partner as we shape the future of measurement. In this role, you’ll work with talented professionals across the globe, within a culture that values curiosity, collaboration, and personal development. If you're ready to bring your skills to a global stage, this is your chance to make an impact.

About the role: As our sole Senior Legal Counsel based in the United States, you’ll lead commercial contract negotiations and privacy matters for a wide range of deals, partnering closely with Sales, Procurement, R&D, Product, Security and Finance, while operating as an integral part of AppsFlyer’s broader legal team, collaborating daily with colleagues and leadership

What You’ll Do:

- Draft, review, negotiate and close commercial and technology-related contracts, including master services agreements, SaaS subscription agreements, license agreements, data protection agreements, reseller and referral agreements, RFP responses and supporting documentation with customers, partners and vendors.

- Coordinate commercial and contractual issues with other groups and departments across the company (Finance, Sales, Marketing, Business Development, Security, IT, R&D) in furtherance of corporate policy.

- Develop a strong understanding of AppsFlyer’s technology and provide timely, practical, business-oriented legal advice and recommendations on commercial, regulatory and privacy issues.

- Monitor and advise on applicable laws relating to commercial transactions, including data privacy and other regulatory compliance matters.

- Develop and maintain company contract templates, business processes and internal policies and guidelines to help scale the business.

- Contribute to other legal projects as needed from time to time.

What You Bring:

- Qualified Lawyer with at least 5 years of commercial and technology law experience, gained at a major law firm and/or in an in-house legal department.

- Experience handling complex, technology-related commercial legal matters, including independently reviewing, drafting, negotiating and closing agreements with minimal support.

- Knowledge and experience in data privacy laws and related regulations.

- Experience in SaaS or big data businesses.

- Strong negotiation skills, including the ability to independently negotiate agreements and lead calls with other legal teams.

- Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage and support multiple matters simultaneously for different stakeholders.

- Good interpersonal skills and the ability to work effectively within a globally distributed team in a fast-paced business environment.

- Ability to work independently from a US location while reporting to and closely collaborating with HQ and the legal team in Israel.

- Highly independent, with a strong personality, able to multitask across multiple matters and stakeholders and manage stress well in a fast-paced environment.

- Meticulous attention to detail and high motivation to contribute to the success of the company.

- Ability to comfortably deal with a global customer and supplier base in a multicultural environment.

- Excellent written and oral communication skills, including a clear and concise drafting style, with English at mother-tongue level.

Nice To Have:

- CIPP certification.

- Experience in adtech and/or martech.

Bonus Points

- Introduced by an AppsFlyer team member.

For our US-based candidates, the expected ‘On Target Earnings’ (OTE) are between $220,000 and $250,000 (including bonus). The offer varies on many factors including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, experience, interview results, references, etc.
This role operates on a hybrid model, with 3 days a week in either our San Francisco or New York office.

At AppsFlyer, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. Don’t meet 100% of the qualifications? if you’re excited about this role and believe you have the skills to succeed, we encourage you to apply.

Why Join Us?

AppsFlyer is a global company with 20 offices worldwide. Through mental health programs like Be Well, the Global Employee Exchange Program, and fitness programs, we empower our people to thrive physically, mentally, and professionally.

Here, titles don’t define us—ideas do. You’ll thrive in a culture where everyone’s input shapes the future.
