israel.title: Warehouse Associate - Cambridge
israel.description:
WAREHOUSE ASSOCIATE

Location: Cambridge (CB1)

Working pattern: Onsite | Part-time | Shift-based (15 hours per week)

Pay: £13.25 per hour

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Site Operations team powers the physical side of our marketplace through HOP (our rapid grocery delivery service) and Editions (our network of delivery-only kitchens). From launching new sites to ensuring operational excellence across markets, we combine retail and hospitality expertise with operational rigour. If you thrive in hands-on environments and want to help redefine how food and groceries reach customers—come join us on the ground.

We’re looking for a Warehouse Associate to join our Cambridge team. Our Warehouse Associates are the beating heart of our day-to-day site operations. You’ll work closely with your management team to ensure our loyal customers get what they want when they need it, ensuring the smooth running of our Hop sites.

Get to know our Site Operations https://careers.deliveroo.co.uk/operations/ team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

- Execute precise order fulfillment by picking customer essentials quickly and accurately to meet delivery deadlines.

- Maintain product integrity by ensuring all goods received and dispatched meet our high standards for freshness and quality.

- Facilitate seamless logistics through clear communication with riders to ensure prompt order handovers.

- Drive inventory excellence by supporting the intake of daily stock deliveries and assisting with ongoing inventory management.

- Champion site safety and standards by maintaining a clean, organized warehouse environment for the whole team.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO THRIVE

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

- Adaptability in fast-paced environments, with the ability to remain focused under pressure.

- Strong attention to detail to ensure order accuracy and high-quality stock control.

- Effective communication skills to collaborate with teammates, managers, and riders.

- A proactive, hands-on mentality with a drive to solve problems as they arise on-site.

- A customer-first mindset, understanding that your speed and accuracy directly impact the user experience.

- Previous experience in FMCG, Retail, or Warehouse environments is valued but not required.

WHY JOIN US?

At Deliveroo, operations are central to how we build trust across our marketplace. You’ll work in a fast-paced environment where service excellence drives real impact.

- 🔧 See the impact of your work in real time: Solve problems as they happen, turning challenges into positive experiences across our three-sided marketplace.

- 🌱 Grow through doing: Develop problem-solving, communication, and leadership skills with structured progression pathways and real opportunities to move into management.

- 🤝 Be part of a tight-knit culture: Work collaboratively to achieve shared goals in an environment that values support, ownership, and resilience.

- 🕒 Flexibility that works for you: Enjoy the benefits of shift-based work that fits your schedule.

OUR INTERVIEW PROCESS

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine:

- Step 1: Apply – Apply for any role you’d like to be considered for. We’re looking forward to hearing from you.

- Step 2: Online assessment – If your application is successful, you’ll receive an assessment from our AI hiring assistant, Maki People. Please note: this must be completed to continue.

- Step 3: Initial conversation – One of our Recruitment team will get in touch to talk through your experience and what you’re looking for next.

- Step 4: Final Onsite interview – You’ll be invited to an onsite interview with one of our Site Managers.

- Step 5: Outcome – We’ll get back to you quickly after your interview to let you know the result!

OUR GLOBAL STRUCTURE

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

DIVERSITY, EQUITY AND INCLUSION

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

israel.title: Customer Success -Travel Operations Specialist
israel.description:
Travel Operations Specialist

About the Role

Hopper's Travel Operations Specialists sit at the intersection of customer advocacy and operational expertise — the go-to resource for CS teams and travellers navigating complex, high-stakes situations. In this role, you'll own escalation management across air, hotel, fulfillment, and rapid response channels, ensuring every customer interaction upholds the trust and loyalty Hopper is built on. It's a role that demands deep travel knowledge, sharp judgment, and a genuine commitment to getting the right outcome for every user.

What would your day-to-day look like

- Document and manage internal escalations, acting as the primary intake representative for incidents and drafting SOPs to prevent recurring disruptions

- Monitor multiple queues simultaneously — from automation errors to same-day voids and cancellations — adjusting priorities in real time as conditions shift

- Interpret travel advisories and coordinate workflows that process high volumes of schedule changes driven by disruptions or disasters

- Communicate directly with airlines, hotel providers, HTS partners, and Hopper customers via phone, email, and chat to gather the information needed to resolve escalated concerns

- Service complex bookings — including net fares, multi-ticket itineraries, and commission-based arrangements — often within the same PNR

- Support Hopper-specific products like Cancel for Any Reason and Price Freeze, applying sound judgment to unconventional scenarios

- Go beyond the playbook when needed — if a customer needs something you haven't handled before, you find a way

An ideal candidate has

- At least 3 years of experience in a customer-facing or back-of-house airline or travel agency role

- Hands-on proficiency with native Sabre as primary GDS, with working knowledge of Amadeus and Travelport (Apollo)

- Solid understanding of fares, airline contracts, ticketing rules and regulations, and NDC/portal-based products

- Strong written and spoken English communication skills; French bilingualism (CEFR B2+) is a meaningful asset

- Familiarity with ticketing procedures across air, hotel, and ground transportation

- North American geography knowledge, with the ability to apply it to real booking and routing decisions

- The composure and empathy to handle difficult customer conversations professionally under pressure

- A learning mindset — you treat new challenges as opportunities and actively seek to grow your expertise

- Preferred: 3+ years at a leisure or corporate travel agency, with experience in complex exchanges, refunds, and both domestic and international reservations

Perks and benefits of working with us:

- Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary.

- Hopper covers 100% of the cost for employees, and up to two dependents, for employer sponsored health insurances.

- Hopper covers 100% of premiums for supplemental accident and life liability insurances, to provide benefits for you and your loved ones from day one.

- Unlimited PTO.

- Hopper provides a monthly allowance to assist with costs of internet utility.

- Hopper provides the 13th month salary for PHL employees in the month of December.

- Carrot Cash travel stipend.

- Hopper will apply the De Minimis benefit for dependent medical, rice subsidy, uniform/clothing, medical assistance and laundry allowances.

- Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business.

- Open communication with management and company leadership.

- Small, dynamic teams = massive impact.



More about Hopper

At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world-class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips.



The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. he Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.



While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands.



Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.



Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company’s recent growth:



Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS’ channels every year.



Our fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no-questions-asked resolutions.



Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel.



Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business.



Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper’s fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co-develop Capital One Travel, a new travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more.



Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to have millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the #3 largest online travel agencies in North America and 70% of our app customers are Gen-Z and millennials travelers.



Hopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. The Hopper app and website will also continue to be the preferred travel provider for Gen Z and Millennials.



Come take off with us!



#LI-REMOTE

israel.description:
About the Role

We are seeking an exceptional Principal Product Manager to build the HTS API Marketplace — the commercial and developer-facing layer through which enterprise partners access Hopper's lodging and cars capabilities.

This is a true 0-to-1 role. You will be the person who defines what it is: how capabilities are packaged and priced, how partners discover and integrate them, and how the marketplace evolves as a platform business. The underlying technical capabilities — connectivity orchestration, pricing and sort, content mapping, the extranet — are owned by dedicated capability teams. Your job is to work closely with those PMs to understand, package, and commercially expose those capabilities as coherent, enterprise-grade API products.

We expect this PM to move fast and build scrappily. You should be comfortable using AI tools and vibe coding to prototype workflows, mock APIs, and test partner experiences before handing off to engineering. The best candidate will reach for a prototype before a PRD.

You will partner with Engineering, Data Science, Commercial, Finance, and Supply — and coordinate tightly with other PMs across the organization — to bring the marketplace from concept to a revenue-generating platform.

This is a fully remote role.

israel.title: Gestionnaire de produit principal, Place de marché API HTS
israel.description:
À PROPOS DU POSTE

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un Gestionnaire de produit principal (Principal Product Manager) exceptionnel pour bâtir la place de marché API de HTS — la couche commerciale et orientée développeurs par laquelle nos partenaires entreprises accèdent aux capacités d'hébergement et de location de voitures de Hopper.

Il s'agit d'un véritable rôle « 0 à 1 ». Vous serez la personne qui définit le produit : comment les capacités sont regroupées et tarifées, comment les partenaires les découvrent et les intègrent, et comment la place de marché évolue en tant que plateforme d'affaires. Les capacités techniques sous-jacentes — orchestration de la connectivité, tarification et tri, cartographie de contenu, extranet — sont détenues par des équipes de capacités dédiées. Votre rôle est de travailler en étroite collaboration avec ces gestionnaires de produits (PM) pour comprendre, packager et exposer commercialement ces capacités sous forme de produits API cohérents et de calibre entreprise.

Nous attendons de ce PM qu'il agisse rapidement avec agilité (scrappily). Vous devez être à l'aise avec les outils d'IA et la programmation intuitive (vibe coding) pour prototyper des flux de travail, simuler des API et tester l'expérience des partenaires avant de passer le relais à l'ingénierie. Le candidat idéal privilégiera toujours un prototype avant un document d’exigences produit (PRD).

Vous collaborerez avec les équipes d'ingénierie, de science des données, commerciales, financières et d'approvisionnement — et vous coordonnerez étroitement avec d'autres PM à travers l'organisation — pour faire passer la place de marché du concept à une plateforme génératrice de revenus.

Ce poste est entièrement en télétravail.

RESPONSABILITÉS

- Définir la place de marché API de HTS : structurer, packager et tarifer les capacités d'un portefeuille incluant HTS Connect, les polygones de recherche, l'autocomplétion, le classement, la cartographie de contenu et de propriétés, la cartographie de chambres, la déduplication/enchères, la tarification, l'extranet, les taxes et le moteur d'accords personnalisés.

- Coordonner avec les PM de capacités : comprendre la feuille de route, les contraintes et les possibilités de personnalisation des systèmes techniques sous-jacents, et les traduire en produits API consommables à l'externe.

- Gérer le modèle commercial : prendre les décisions entre frais de plateforme et frais variables, définir la structure de commission (take rate) par capacité, le packaging entreprise et le cadre d'accords personnalisés pour les grands partenaires.

- Bâtir l'expérience développeur et partenaire à partir de zéro : spécifications d'API, flux d'intégration des partenaires, normes de documentation, environnements bac à sable (sandbox) et outils d'intégration minimisant le délai de rentabilisation.

- Utiliser l'IA et le prototypage rapide : tester les idées rapidement (simulations de réponses API, prototypes de portails partenaires) avant d'engager des ressources d'ingénierie.

- Établir la stratégie de mise en marché (GTM) : identifier les bons partenaires, séquencer les lancements et définir les critères de succès commerciaux.

- Gérer les revenus et pertes (P&L) de la place de marché : modéliser et suivre le volume d'affaires (GBV), le taux de commission et la rentabilité par unité de capacité en partenariat avec l'équipe des finances.

UN(E) CANDIDAT(E) IDÉAL DÉTIENT:

- Plus de 7 ans d'expérience en gestion de produits, avec au moins un produit bâti de « 0 à 1 » (du concept au lancement commercial).

- Expérience démontrée dans la création de produits B2B ou de places de marché orientées développeurs, incluant la conception de produits API et le packaging commercial pour entreprises.

- Méthode de travail axée sur l'IA : vous utilisez les LLM et la programmation intuitive comme outils de première ligne pour le prototypage. Vous avez déjà conçu des démos ou des preuves de concept (PoC) fonctionnels via l'IA.

- Solide compréhension de l'économie des places de marché : commissions, incitatifs côté offre, optimisation côté demande et modèles commerciaux variables vs plateforme.

- Capacité de coordination inter-équipes : synthétiser des feuilles de route et assurer l'alignement sans gérer directement l'ingénierie sous-jacente.

- Expérience avec des partenaires entreprises externes : traduire les besoins commerciaux en exigences produit et gérer les attentes lors de déploiements multiphasés.

- Maîtrise de SQL et des ensembles de données transactionnels à grande échelle.

- Excellentes capacités de communication écrite et verbale, incluant la rédaction de documentation API et produit claire.

Atouts :

- Expérience dans le commerce du voyage (hébergement, voitures, vols) ou dans les secteurs fintech ou publicitaires.

- Connaissance des systèmes de distribution (GDS, gestionnaires de canaux, API d'agences de voyages en ligne).

- Expérience préalable en ingénierie ou en science des données.


Ce poste requiert une maîtrise du français et de l’anglais. La personne retenue devra communiquer et collaborer régulièrement avec des collègues, gestionnaires, clients, fournisseurs et partenaires d’affaires situés à l’extérieur du Québec, ainsi que consulter, préparer et utiliser de la documentation, des systèmes et des communications en français et en anglais. La connaissance de l’anglais est donc nécessaire à l’exercice des fonctions liées au poste ainsi qu’au respect des exigences opérationnelles et des besoins de la clientèle dans un environnement d’affaires international.

AVANTAGES À TRAVAILLER AVEC NOUS:

- Startup bien financée avec de grandes ambitions; salaire compétitif et options d'achat d'actions (pre-IPO).

- Hopper couvre 100 % des primes du régime d'assurance collective.

- Couverture d'assurance vie et d'invalidité de courte et longue durée.

- Compte de dépenses de santé (HSA) couvrant les frais médicaux et dentaires admissibles.

- Accès illimité aux services de télémédecine de Dialogue pour les employés et leurs personnes à charge.

- Accès à un plan REER avec retenues salariales automatiques avant impôts.

- Congés parentaux très généreux, bien au-dessus des normes de l'industrie.

- Congés payés (PTO) illimités.

- Crédits de voyage Carrot Cash.

- Accès à des espaces de cotravail sur demande via FlexDesk ET allocation pour le télétravail.

- Culture entrepreneuriale valorisant l'audace et la prise de risque.

HTS, notre division B2B, représente aujourd'hui plus de 75 % de nos activités. Nos partenaires incluent des marques de renom telles que Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada et bien d'autres.

Hopper a été nommée l'entreprise la plus innovante dans le domaine du voyage par Fast Company. Avec plus de 750 millions $ US de capitaux levés, nous sommes prêts à poursuivre notre croissance en tant que chef de file du commerce électronique de voyage.

Venez prendre votre envol avec nous !

Conformément à la réglementation locale, vous avez le droit de connaître les principaux facteurs utilisés dans le cadre de cette évaluation, de demander la rectification de vos données ou de demander qu'une personne révise toute décision automatisée. Voice carries its own product problems, from latency and turn-taking to escalation timing when a human is on the line, and this role owns both surfaces with equal depth.

As Principal Product Manager, you will own the customer-facing agent end to end: the conversations, the interface, and the experience our partners put in front of millions of travelers. What would your day-to-day look like

- Own the roadmap for the customer-facing conversational agent across chat and voice, from intent coverage and conversation design to the interfaces partners embed in their apps and websites

- Set the product bar for voice specifically, covering latency, turn-taking, barge-in handling, localization, realtime voice and ASR/TTS quality, since a caller's tolerance for a bad interaction is lower than a chat user's

- Engage enterprise partners through discovery, requirement shaping, and launch decisions, translating partner asks into product choices that keep one product serving many partners

- Partner with Partner Solutions on implementation and onboarding

- Drive design daily, working hands-on in Figma to produce flows and wireframes, and partner with design on high-fidelity and production assets

- Build working prototypes using AI coding tools where they beat a written spec, to test conversation flows and interface ideas

- Define and defend quality bars with the evaluation team, covering resolution rate, containment, escalation correctness, and conversation quality across both chat and voice

- Specify agent behavior in detail, including resolution, tone, escalation policy, guardrails, and edge cases, and iterate from production conversation data

- Stay close to GTM, Partner Solutions, and Success teams, feeding what the field learns back into the roadmap



An ideal candidate has

- 8+ years of product management experience, including principal or lead-level ownership of a customer-facing product, with direct experience shipping voice-based conversational products such as IVR, voice bots, or contact center voice automation

- Hands-on ownership of a production voice product, not only chat or text-based conversational AI, with working knowledge of ASR/TTS tradeoffs, latency budgets, and turn-taking or barge-in design. This is a required skillset

- Design fluency, comfortable manipulating design files and producing flows and basic mocks solo in Figma, having operated as a de facto design lead on a lean team

- The ability to write enough code to get a prototype working without waiting on an engineer, treating AI tools as a normal part of how they build

- Hands-on front-end experience, having built or shipped web front ends and able to engage engineers credibly

- Deep partner-facing experience with enterprise clients, ideally in regulated industries, shaping requirements and launch decisions at the product level

- A data-driven approach grounded in customer service and automation metrics, including resolution, containment, CSAT, and escalation quality

- Working familiarity with LLM-based products, including prompt and behavior design, AI quality practices, and their failure modes

israel.title: Directeur ou directrice principal(e) de produit, IA conversationnelle// Principal Product Manager- Conversational AI
israel.description:
À propos du poste

HTS Assist est l'assistant d'intelligence artificielle agentique de Hopper pour le voyage, qui résout de vrais enjeux clients comme les changements de vol, les annulations, les remboursements et les réservations, par clavardage et par la voix, pour certaines des plus grandes marques et entreprises de voyage au monde. La voix pose ses propres défis produit, de la latence et de l'alternance de la parole jusqu'au moment de l'escalade vers un humain, et ce poste couvre les deux volets avec la même rigueur.

À titre de directeur ou directrice principal(e) de produit, vous serez responsable de l'agent orienté client de bout en bout : les conversations, l'interface et l'expérience que nos partenaires offrent à des millions de voyageurs. Il s'agit d'un poste délibérément axé sur le design, où vous serez la personne qui tranche les décisions de design au quotidien, en façonnant directement les parcours et les interfaces en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de design de nos partenaires et notre designer interne.

À quoi ressemblerait votre quotidien

- Être responsable de la feuille de route de l'agent conversationnel orienté client, tant par clavardage que par la voix, de la couverture des intentions et de la conception des conversations jusqu'aux interfaces que nos partenaires intègrent dans leurs applications et leurs sites web

- Établir la norme produit pour la voix en particulier, en couvrant la latence, l'alternance de la parole, la gestion des interruptions, la localisation, la voix en temps réel et la qualité de la reconnaissance et de la synthèse vocale, puisque la tolérance d'une personne au téléphone envers une mauvaise expérience est plus faible que celle d'une personne qui clavarde

- Mobiliser les partenaires d'entreprise à travers la découverte, la définition des exigences et les décisions de lancement, en traduisant leurs besoins en choix de produit qui permettent à un seul produit de servir plusieurs partenaires

- Collaborer avec l'équipe Solutions partenaires sur la mise en œuvre et l'intégration

- Piloter le design au quotidien, en travaillant directement dans Figma pour produire des parcours et des maquettes, et collaborer avec l'équipe de design sur les livrables haute fidélité et de production

- Construire des prototypes fonctionnels à l'aide d'outils de codage par IA lorsque cela est plus efficace qu'une spécification écrite, afin de tester des parcours de conversation et des concepts d'interface

- Définir et défendre les seuils de qualité avec l'équipe d'évaluation, en couvrant le taux de résolution, le taux de confinement, la justesse des escalades et la qualité des conversations

- Spécifier en détail le comportement de l'agent, y compris la résolution, le ton, la politique d'escalade, les garde-fous et les cas limites, et itérer à partir des données de conversations réelles

- Rester proche des équipes GTM, Solutions partenaires et Succès client, afin de faire remonter les apprentissages du terrain vers la feuille de route

Le ou la candidat(e) idéal(e) possède

- 8 ans ou plus d'expérience en gestion de produit, incluant une responsabilité de niveau principal ou de direction sur un produit orienté client, avec une expérience directe du lancement de produits conversationnels vocaux tels que les systèmes IVR, les robots vocaux ou l'automatisation vocale de centres de contact

- Une responsabilité directe d'un produit vocal en production, pas seulement d'un produit conversationnel par clavardage ou par texte, avec une bonne connaissance des compromis liés à la reconnaissance et à la synthèse vocale, des seuils de latence et de la gestion de l'alternance de la parole ou des interruptions. Il s'agit d'une compétence exigée

- Une aisance en design, à l'aise de manipuler des fichiers de design et de produire seul(e) des parcours et des maquettes de base dans Figma, ayant déjà agi comme responsable de design de facto au sein d'une petite équipe

- La capacité d'écrire suffisamment de code pour faire fonctionner un prototype sans attendre un ingénieur ou une ingénieure, en intégrant les outils d'IA comme partie normale de sa façon de construire

- Une expérience concrète en développement front-end, ayant déjà bâti ou lancé des interfaces web et étant capable d'échanger de façon crédible avec des ingénieurs

- Une solide expérience auprès de clients d'entreprise, idéalement dans des industries réglementées, à façonner les exigences et les décisions de lancement au niveau du produit

- Une approche axée sur les données, ancrée dans les mesures de service à la clientèle et d'automatisation, incluant la résolution, le confinement, la satisfaction client et la qualité des escalades

- Une bonne connaissance pratique des produits basés sur les grands modèles de langage, incluant la conception des invites et des comportements, les pratiques de qualité en IA et leurs modes d'échec

Avantages sociaux

- Une entreprise en démarrage bien financée et éprouvée, avec de grandes ambitions, un salaire compétitif et les avantages d'un régime d'options avant l'entrée en bourse

- Hopper couvre 100 % des primes du régime d'assurance collective

- Hopper offre une couverture d'assurance vie, invalidité de courte durée et de longue durée

- Un compte de dépenses santé qui couvre les frais médicaux et dentaires admissibles

- Tous les employés et leurs personnes à charge ont accès aux services de télémédecine de Dialogue

- Tous les employés ont accès à un régime de REER avec retenues automatiques avant impôt

- N'hésitez pas à nous poser des questions sur notre congé parental très généreux

- Vacances illimitées

- Allocation de voyage Carrot Cash

- Accès à un espace de coworking à la demande via FlexDesk et une allocation pour le télétravail

- Une culture entrepreneuriale où repousser les limites fait partie du quotidien

- Communication ouverte avec la direction et les dirigeants de l'entreprise

- De petites équipes dynamiques ayant un impact considérable

À propos de Hopper
Chez Hopper, notre mission est de devenir la plateforme de voyage de référence à l'échelle mondiale, en propulsant l'application mobile et le site Web de Hopper ainsi que notre division B2B, HTS. Grâce à d'importantes quantités de données et à des algorithmes d'apprentissage automatique avancés, Hopper combine une offre d'agence de voyages de calibre mondial avec des produits fintech propriétaires pour offrir transparence, flexibilité et économies aux voyageurs du monde entier.

La plateforme Hopper dessert des centaines de millions de voyageurs et continue de gagner des parts de marché partout dans le monde, avec plus de 120 millions de téléchargements. Par l'entremise de HTS, notre division B2B qui représente plus de 75 % de l'entreprise, nous propulsons les canaux directs de partenaires comme Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada et bien d'autres.

Hopper a été nommée entreprise la plus innovante en voyage par Fast Company, se classe au troisième rang des plus grandes agences de voyages en ligne en Amérique du Nord, et a amassé plus de 750 millions de dollars américains en capital privé auprès d'investisseurs institutionnels de premier plan.

Embarquez avec nous!

Ce poste utilise des systèmes de prise de décision automatisée pour évaluer l'aptitude des candidats. Conformément à la réglementation locale, vous avez le droit de comprendre les principaux facteurs utilisés dans cette évaluation, de demander une correction de vos données ou de demander une révision humaine de toute décision automatisée. Pour exercer ces droits, veuillez communiquer avec recruiting@hopper.com privacy@hopper.com

israel.title: Finance & Strategy Manager
israel.description:
About the Role

As a Finance & Strategy Manager at Hopper, you will be a finance partner to business leaders across the company, helping them understand performance, evaluate opportunities and make better decisions. You will build the models behind our forecasts, partnerships and strategic plans, lead business reviews, and turn analysis into clear recommendations for senior leadership and the CFO.

This role is a great fit for someone who has built rigorous models under pressure in investment banking or private equity and now wants to apply those skills in-house, closer to the decisions. We are a lean team that moves fast, and we use SQL and AI tools like Claude to automate the manual work so we can spend our time on analysis and strategy.

What would your day-to-day look like

- Build and maintain integrated financial models, scenario and sensitivity analyses, and business cases for new products, partnerships and investments

- Evaluate the economics of new commercial agreements (pricing, revenue share, unit economics, ROI) and help shape deal terms with business leaders

- Support fundraising, M&A and capital allocation decisions, including the models and analysis behind them

- Own the monthly and quarterly forecast for the areas you support, and contribute to the annual budget and long-range plan by building the driver-based models and inputs that connect operational metrics to P&L outcomes

- Lead monthly and quarterly reviews of actuals vs. plan and forecast, explain variances, and flag risks and opportunities to business leaders

- Partner with leadership on high-impact questions such as market sizing, investment prioritization and cost optimization

- Prepare clear, executive-, board- and investor-ready materials that tell the story behind the numbers

- Use SQL, BigQuery and AI tools to automate recurring reporting and analysis so the team spends less time handling data and more time on insight

An ideal candidate has

- 4+ years of experience in investment banking, corporate development, private equity, strategic finance or FP&A. Investment banking or private equity experience (Analyst or Associate) is preferred

- Advanced financial modeling skills: three-statement models, DCF, scenario and sensitivity analysis. Expert in Excel / Google Sheets

- Solid understanding of accounting and how the three financial statements connect

- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain financial concepts to non-finance partners and present confidently to senior leaders

- Working knowledge of SQL, or a demonstrated ability to pick up technical tools quickly

- Hands-on use of AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, etc.) to work faster and automate repetitive work

- Strong ownership, comfort with ambiguity and a builder mindset. Hopper moves fast

- A degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Math, Engineering or another quantitative discipline

Nice to have

- Experience in tech, fintech, travel, marketplaces or B2B partnerships

- Experience with Python and/or BI tools (Looker, Tableau, etc.)

- CFA, CPA or MBA

Perks and benefits of working with us

- Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and the upsides of pre-IPO equity packages

- Unlimited PTO

- Carrot Cash travel stipend

- Access to co-working space on demand through FlexDesk AND Work-from-home stipend

- Please ask us about our very generous parental leave, much above industry standards!

- Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business

- Open communication with management and company leadership

- Small, dynamic teams = massive impact

- 100% employer paid Medical, Dental and Vision coverage for employees

- Access to Disability & Life insurance

- Health Reimbursement Account (HRA)

- DCA/ FSA and access to 401k plan

About Hopper

At Hopper, we're building the leading travel technology platform in the world, and we're doing it by solving real problems for real travelers globally. Our Hopper consumer booking platforms and HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), our B2B business, work together to give travelers something the industry has never reliably offered: transparency, flexibility, and real savings on every trip. We combine massive amounts of data and AI with proprietary fintech products to make that happen, not just another booking engine, but a fundamentally better way to plan and experience travel for our customers and our partners. We're proof that better-for-the-customer and better-for-the-business can be one in the same

And we're continuing to grow fast! The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times, with 70% of our users being Gen Z and Millennials, next-generation travelers. Today, our biggest opportunity is powering travel fintech, commerce, and loyalty for some of the biggest brands in the industry. Our first HTS partnership with Capital One helped launch a dedicated travel portal for a major financial brand's cardholders, and we've since expanded across some of the biggest names in travel and banking, including Air Canada, Uber, Royal Bank of Canada (RBC), and Nubank, powering everything from a single fintech integration to a full end-to-end travel loyalty portal.

That's our trajectory: we started as a small, disruptive app within the travel space, and now we're the engine under the hood powering how Travel Tech works.

What that looks like in practice:

- Billions of dollars in travel and travel fintech move through Hopper and HTS every year

- Our fintech products, including Cancel for Any Reason and Disruption Assistance for Any Reason, post exceptionally strong customer satisfaction because the terms are clear and resolutions are instant, no questions asked

- Nearly 30% of app customers add a fintech product to their booking, and those customers are 1.6x more likely to book with us again

- HTS now drives more than 90% of the business, proof of how fast B2B has scaled

- Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies) can plug the company’s fintech, commerce and AI solutions into their own channels, whether that's a single integration or a full end-to-end travel portal

Come take off with us!

israel.title: Gestionnaire, Finance et stratégie// Finance & Strategy Manager
israel.description:
À propos du poste

À titre de gestionnaire, Finance et stratégie chez Hopper, vous serez un partenaire financier pour les leaders d'affaires de toute l'entreprise, en les aidant à comprendre la performance, à évaluer les occasions et à prendre de meilleures décisions. Vous construirez les modèles derrière nos prévisions, nos partenariats et nos plans stratégiques, dirigerez les revues d'affaires et transformerez l'analyse en recommandations claires pour la haute direction et le chef de la direction financière.

Ce poste convient parfaitement à une personne qui a bâti des modèles rigoureux sous pression en banque d'investissement ou en capital-investissement et qui souhaite maintenant mettre ces compétences à profit à l'interne, plus près des décisions. Nous sommes une équipe agile qui avance rapidement, et nous utilisons SQL et des outils d'IA comme Claude pour automatiser le travail manuel afin de consacrer notre temps à l'analyse et à la stratégie.

À quoi ressemblerait votre quotidien

- Construire et maintenir des modèles financiers intégrés, des analyses de scénarios et de sensibilité, ainsi que des analyses de rentabilisation pour de nouveaux produits, partenariats et investissements

- Évaluer les paramètres économiques des nouvelles ententes commerciales (tarification, partage des revenus, économie unitaire, RCI) et aider à façonner les modalités des ententes avec les leaders d'affaires

- Soutenir les décisions de financement, de fusions et acquisitions et de répartition du capital, y compris les modèles et les analyses qui les sous-tendent

- Être responsable des prévisions mensuelles et trimestrielles pour les secteurs que vous soutenez, et contribuer au budget annuel et au plan à long terme en construisant les modèles fondés sur les inducteurs qui relient les indicateurs opérationnels aux résultats financiers

- Diriger les revues mensuelles et trimestrielles des résultats réels par rapport au plan et aux prévisions, expliquer les écarts et signaler les risques et les occasions aux leaders d'affaires

- Collaborer avec la direction sur des questions à fort impact comme la taille des marchés, la priorisation des investissements et l'optimisation des coûts

- Préparer des documents clairs, adaptés à la haute direction, au conseil d'administration et aux investisseurs, qui racontent l'histoire derrière les chiffres

- Utiliser SQL, BigQuery et des outils d'IA pour automatiser les rapports et analyses récurrents afin que l'équipe consacre moins de temps à manipuler des données et plus de temps à en tirer des constats

Le ou la candidat(e) idéal(e) possède

- 4 ans ou plus d'expérience en banque d'investissement, en développement corporatif, en capital-investissement, en finance stratégique ou en planification et analyse financières (FP&A). Une expérience en banque d'investissement ou en capital-investissement (analyste ou associé(e)) est privilégiée

- Des compétences avancées en modélisation financière : modèles à trois états financiers, flux de trésorerie actualisés (DCF), analyses de scénarios et de sensibilité. Expertise dans Excel / Google Sheets

- Une solide compréhension de la comptabilité et des liens entre les trois états financiers

- D'excellentes aptitudes en communication, avec la capacité d'expliquer des concepts financiers à des partenaires non financiers et de présenter avec assurance à la haute direction

- Une connaissance pratique de SQL, ou une capacité démontrée à maîtriser rapidement des outils techniques

- Une utilisation concrète d'outils d'IA (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, etc.) pour travailler plus rapidement et automatiser les tâches répétitives

- Un grand sens des responsabilités, une aisance avec l'ambiguïté et un état d'esprit de bâtisseur. Hopper avance rapidement

- Un diplôme en finance, en économie, en administration, en mathématiques, en génie ou dans une autre discipline quantitative

Atouts

- Une expérience en technologie, en fintech, en voyage, en places de marché ou en partenariats B2B

- Une expérience avec Python et/ou des outils de BI (Looker, Tableau, etc.)

- Titre de CFA, CPA ou MBA

Avantages sociaux

- Une entreprise en démarrage bien financée et éprouvée, avec de grandes ambitions, un salaire compétitif et les avantages d'un régime d'options avant l'entrée en bourse

- Hopper couvre 100 % des primes du régime d'assurance collective

- Hopper offre une couverture d'assurance vie, invalidité de courte durée et de longue durée

- Un compte de dépenses santé qui couvre les frais médicaux et dentaires admissibles

- Tous les employés et leurs personnes à charge ont accès aux services de télémédecine de Dialogue

- Tous les employés ont accès à un régime de REER avec retenues automatiques avant impôt

- N'hésitez pas à nous poser des questions sur notre congé parental très généreux

- Vacances illimitées

- Allocation de voyage Carrot Cash

- Accès à un espace de coworking à la demande via FlexDesk et une allocation pour le télétravail

- Une culture entrepreneuriale où repousser les limites fait partie du quotidien

- Communication ouverte avec la direction et les dirigeants de l'entreprise

- De petites équipes dynamiques ayant un impact considérable

À propos de Hopper

Chez Hopper, nous bâtissons la plateforme technologique de voyage de référence à l'échelle mondiale, et nous le faisons en résolvant de vrais problèmes pour de vrais voyageurs, partout sur la planète. Nos plateformes de réservation grand public Hopper et notre division B2B, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), travaillent en synergie pour offrir aux voyageurs transparence, flexibilité et de véritables économies à chaque séjour. Pour y parvenir, nous combinons d'immenses volumes de données et l'intelligence artificielle à des produits fintech exclusifs. Nous ne sommes pas simplement un moteur de réservation de plus : nous offrons une façon fondamentalement meilleure de planifier et de vivre le voyage pour nos clients et nos partenaires. Nous sommes la preuve que ce qui est avantageux pour le client l'est tout autant pour l'entreprise.

Et notre croissance s'accélère! L’application Hopper a été téléchargée plus de 120 millions de fois, et 70 % de nos utilisateurs appartiennent à la génération Z et aux millénariaux — les voyageurs de demain. Aujourd'hui, notre plus grand levier consiste à propulser les solutions de fintech de voyage, de commerce et de fidélisation pour les plus grandes marques de l’industrie. Notre premier partenariat HTS avec Capital One a permis de lancer un portail de voyage dédié aux titulaires de cartes de cette grande marque financière. Depuis, nous nous sommes associés aux plus grands noms du voyage et du secteur bancaire, notamment Air Canada, Uber, la Banque Royale du Canada (RBC) et Nubank, en alimentant aussi bien une simple intégration fintech ciblée qu'un portail complet de fidélisation voyage clé en main.

Voilà notre trajectoire : nous avons fait nos débuts comme une petite application novatrice dans l'univers du voyage, et nous sommes désormais le moteur sous le capot qui propulse la technologie du voyage mondial.

Ce que cela représente concrètement :

- Des milliards de dollars en voyages et en solutions fintech transitent chaque année par Hopper et HTS.

- Nos produits fintech, dont l'annulation sans motif (Cancel for Any Reason) et l'assistance en cas de perturbation (Disruption Assistance for Any Reason), affichent des taux de satisfaction client exceptionnels grâce à des conditions limpides et des résolutions instantanées, sans poser de questions.

- Près de 30 % des clients de l'application ajoutent un produit fintech à leur réservation, et ces clients sont 1,6 fois plus susceptibles de réserver à nouveau avec nous.

- HTS génère désormais plus de 90 % des activités de l'entreprise, démontrant la rapidité avec laquelle notre volet B2B s'est développé à grande échelle.

- Grâce à HTS, n'importe quel fournisseur de voyages (transporteurs aériens, hôtels, banques, agences de voyages) peut intégrer les solutions fintech, commerciales et d'IA de Hopper directement dans ses propres canaux, qu'il s'agisse d'une intégration spécifique ou d'un portail de voyage complet de bout en bout.

Venez décoller avec nous!

Ce poste utilise des systèmes de prise de décision automatisée pour évaluer l'aptitude des candidats. Conformément à la réglementation locale, vous avez le droit de comprendre les principaux facteurs utilisés dans cette évaluation, de demander une correction de vos données ou de demander une révision humaine de toute décision automatisée. Pour exercer ces droits, veuillez communiquer avec privacy@hopper.com

israel.description:
We’re looking for a senior-level backend engineer to join our growing Engineering team in TLV.

This role will require you to bring features to the finish line while collaborating closely with other developers, as well as with the Product, QA, Data, and Machine Learning  teams—all with the goal of delivering a seamless, joyful experience for our customers.

We believe three things matter for every role at Lemonade: drive to push through challenges, efficiency that keeps standards high while moving fast, and adaptability that lets you pivot with data and AI insights. These aren't buzzwords, they're how we actually work.

Our AI-first approach isn't just a tagline either. We're building the future of insurance with AI at the center, and we need people who are genuinely excited to learn and grow alongside these tools.

- Help build our products using microservices written in Typescript (using NestJS).

- Leverage our in-house autonomous tools to manage all development flow, from setting up our development environment to creating git branches and deploying services to production

- Collaborate closely with the Product team, in a self-sufficient squad to achieve the squad’s OKRs

- Coach and mentor other developers and help them elevate their skills

- 6+ years working as a backend engineer

- BSc in Computer Science or Mathematics (or equivalent experience)

- Passionate about technology

- Broad knowledge of modern backend frameworks, tools, and architecture

- Experience working on high scale, production-grade projects

- Past contributions to open source projects are a plus

- Ready to work in an office environment most days of the week

- Hands-on experience with intelligence platforms like ISO ClaimSearch, Accurint, TLOxp, or LexisNexis

- Genuine curiosity about AI — both as an investigative asset and as a fraud threat vector you'll need to stay ahead of

israel.description:

You will contribute your actuarial expertise as part of an interdisciplinary team that includes data scientists, insurance Product and Underwriting professionals. Working in collaboration, you’ll help develop and implement new pricing capabilities that blend actuarial approaches with predictive modeling, machine learning, and artificial intelligence.

IN THIS ROLE YOU’LL

- Help shape our UK pricing strategy, balancing profitable growth, competitive prices and great customer outcomes.

- Turn trading data into action, digging into conversion, retention, risk mix and profitability to spot opportunities and explain what’s changing.

- Build a deep understanding of competitor pricing and our position on price comparison websites, using those insights to improve how we price.

- Own pricing changes from idea to launch, testing their impact and tracking what happens once they’re live.

- Partner with Data Science, Product and Underwriting to bring together predictive models, customer behaviour and commercial insight.

- Bring your UK insurance expertise to our global team, sharing knowledge and challenging assumptions to help us make better decisions.

- Help build a faster, smarter pricing engine through automation, experimentation and thoughtful use of AI.

- Further your actuarial education through industry research and stay on top of changing regulatory requirements

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

- 3–5 years of UK personal lines pricing experience, including hands-on commercial or street pricing.

- A strong understanding of how the UK insurance market works, with practical experience of price comparison websites, competitor pricing and customer behaviour.

- A track record of turning analysis into pricing changes that deliver measurable results.

- Strong SQL and Python or R skills, with confidence exploring data independently and checking that your conclusions hold up.

- Commercial judgement and curiosity: you ask good questions, challenge assumptions and connect the numbers to what’s happening in the market.

- Clear communication skills and enthusiasm for sharing your UK market knowledge with colleagues across the business.

- Working knowledge of UK pricing/insurance regulations

- Enthusiasm for learning and working with AI, and exploring how it can improve the way we price and work.

- UK home pricing experience is a strong plus, as are actuarial qualifications and experience with demand modelling or optimisation.

- Ability to work from our London office.

- Commitment in obtaining FIA (Fellow of the Institute of Actuaries) or FFA (Fellow of the Faculty of Actuaries)

Overview

About Certara

Certara accelerates the potential of bringing medicines to market and to patients using biosimulation software, technology, and services to transform traditional drug discovery and development. Our clients include more than 2,400 biopharmaceutical companies, academic institutions, and regulatory agencies across 70 countries.
Our goal is to enable the life sciences industry’s use of data, modeling, and analytics to make better decisions across the various phases of discovery and drug development. Our software and scientists incorporate modern advances in scientific understanding, drug development experience, data analysis, and AI resulting in significant opportunities to decrease the cost and increase the probability of success for new drug approval and commercialization.
About the Team
The Certara PBPK consultancy team is a global organization focused on using the Simcyp® physiologically-based pharmacokinetic (PBPK) and physiologically-based biopharmaceutics modeling platform to influence decision making on drug development programs from discovery to regulatory filing. We are the largest PBPK/PBBM consulting team in the industry, and our consultants work with hundreds of clients to inform human PK prediction, drug-drug interaction assessment, special population predictions and biopharmaceutics applications.
We are seeking highly motivated and talented PBPK modelling scientists and experts with a DMPK, PBPK and/or a biopharmaceutics modelling background who share our passion for using PBPK/PBBM models to understand and impact drug discovery and development questions.
Successful candidates will join an internationally recognized, multidisciplinary company, providing opportunities for further development of knowledge and skills. We offer a unique and exciting mix of academic and commercial environments which encourage regular attendance at scientific meetings as part of our continuous education programs.
Please note: The post does not include routine laboratory or clinical work.

Responsibilities

The role involves contributing to and leading (depending on experience) consultancy projects with clients in the Pharmaceutical Industry to develop PBPK models. Specific responsibilities include:

- Plan, develop and apply PBPK/PBBM models to address a wide range of modelling questions first-in-human dose, DDI liability, food effect, special populations and biopharmaceutics prediction in line with appropriate regulatory guidance

- Lead and support all aspects of PBPK/PBBM projects Conduct data reviews, write modeling analysis plans and PBPK/PBBM modeling reports

- Contribute to regulatory interactions and reviews for client projects

- Act as subject matter expert for business development activities to bring in new PBPK/PBBM business (depending on experience)

- Keep abreast of the latest scientific developments in PBPK/PBBM to enable effective communication with colleagues, clients and the wider scientific community

- Engage with potential and existing clients on a regular basis

- Conduct quality control and scientific review of other PBPK scientists’ work

- Contribute to PBPK/PBBM consulting and other Certara scientific and business initiatives

- Maintain a high profile in the scientific community — publish work, give talks at scientific meetings and engage in scientific debate with clients

Qualifications

- A PhD degree in a relevant field or equivalent experience in IVIVE/drug metabolism/pharmacokinetics

- 7 years+ of experience in the field of PBPK/PBBM modelling

- In-depth knowledge and practical experience of the application of PBPK modelling in the drug discovery and development process and awareness of its acceptance across various regulatory bodies

- In-depth knowledge and understanding of IVIVE/drug metabolism/pharmacokinetics

- Demonstrable experience with the leading PBPK/PBBM modeling platforms, ideally including Simcyp®

- Excellent oral and written communication skills to effectively engage with peers and clients within industry, academia and regulatory agencies

Desired

- Previous consulting experience

- Data analytics and programming skills using R.

- Application of AI skills to PBPK/PBBM and consulting workflows

Build the commercial operating system that makes growth dependable
What this role is
We are looking for a commercially minded operator who can make the systems behind Growth reliable and turn paid activity into qualified demand. You will own the foundations that let Sales and Marketing move quickly with confidence: HubSpot, lifecycle and routing logic, campaign measurement, data quality, and the operational backbone of email and paid campaigns.
You will also run paid acquisition and demand-capture activity across our priority use cases. This is not a role for someone who optimises for clicks or busy dashboards. You will connect audience, offer, creative, landing page, routing and sales follow-up, then improve the full loop based on what creates genuine commercial momentum.
Sales owns the commercial conversation. Product owns the in-product experience and instrumentation.
You own the connective infrastructure and campaign engine that help the right opportunities reach the right people, with clear evidence of what is working.
Top 3 Responsibilities
1) Growth Operations & Commercial Infrastructure (Core)
Own the systems and guardrails that make the commercial machine dependable.

- Own HubSpot governance: lifecycle stages, key properties, naming conventions, workflows and change discipline.

- Build and maintain lead capture, enrichment, scoring, routing and service-level workflows across sales-led and marketing-led motions.

- Own our email and CRM infrastructure: segmentation, nurture implementation, campaign operations, deliverability fundamentals and data quality.

- Maintain trustworthy campaign and funnel reporting, including UTM standards, source logic and dashboards that support real decisions.

- Identify and remove leakage, duplication, manual workarounds and other friction in the lead-to sales journey.

2) Paid Demand Generation & Conversion
Run focused paid campaigns that earn relevant attention and improve the quality of opportunities entering the commercial motion.

- Plan, launch and optimise priority paid campaigns across channels such as LinkedIn and Google, within agreed strategy and budget guardrails.

- Own the performance loop: ICP audience, offer, creative angle, landing page alignment, conversion tracking, sales outcome and learning.

- Build clear test plans and turn results into practical recommendations, not vanity-metric reporting.

- Work with GTM Enablement, Content and Design to translate proven market messaging into high-performing campaign assets.

- Manage channel pacing and recommend budget shifts based on qualified demand and pipeline evidence.

3) Growth Systems, Automation & Shared Leverage
Turn useful ways of working into durable systems the whole Growth team can rely on.

- Evaluate and integrate relevant growth tools across the stack, with a bias toward simplicity, adoption and measurable leverage.

- Turn validated AI-enabled workflows and prototypes into documented, maintainable systems rather than individual workarounds.

- Create lightweight playbooks, reporting rhythms and change logs so the operating system is understood and used across the team.

- Act as a practical sparring partner to Sales, Marketing and Product when commercial data or tooling is getting in the way of progress.

Must Haves

- 4–7+ years of experience spanning B2B marketing operations and performance or demand-generation marketing.

- Strong hands-on HubSpot capability, including CRM data structure, workflows, lists, forms, campaign operations, reporting and lifecycle logic.

- Proven ability to plan and optimise paid campaigns on LinkedIn and/or Google around commercial quality, not only lead volume.

- Sound understanding of tracking, attribution trade-offs, UTMs, conversion paths and how Sales follow-up affects campaign performance.

- A systems mindset: you document, improve and make work reusable instead of solving the same problem repeatedly.

- High agency and good judgment: you can investigate ambiguity, propose a practical direction and ship a sound V1 without waiting for detailed instructions.

Nice to Haves

- Experience in an enterprise B2B or hybrid sales-led growth environment with long buying cycles and small qualified audiences.

- Experience with GA4, Google Tag Manager, enrichment/outbound tools, APIs or no-code automation platforms.

- Comfort working with AI-assisted workflows, lightweight scripting or data analysis.

- Interest in games, gaming technology, digital platforms or data products.

Characteristics

- Commercially rigorous: you care about qualified opportunity creation and revenue relevance, not activity for its own sake.

- A builder with operational discipline: you enjoy getting the plumbing right because it lets everyone else move faster.

- Fast and pragmatic: you protect the essentials while shipping enough to learn.

- Clear collaborator: you can translate technical choices into plain language and work well across Sales, Marketing and Product.

What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)

- A clear, adopted view of the commercial data model, lead flow, routing rules and the highest-priority operational gaps.

- A reliable baseline for campaign tracking and funnel reporting that leaders and operators trust.

- Priority paid campaigns running with clear ICP, offer, conversion and sales-follow-up logic.

- The most important email, routing and data-hygiene gaps resolved or on a credible implementation plan.

- A practical backlog of automation and AI-enabled improvements, prioritised by commercial leverage rather than novelty.

How you’ll work with the team
Sales: You ensure high-intent leads are routed cleanly, campaign signals are visible and learnings from conversations improve targeting and follow-up.
GTM Enablement: You translate priority messaging and use cases into campaign setup, performance tests and feedback loops.
Content and Design: You give clear performance briefs and help make winning assets reusable across channels.
Product: You align external lifecycle and conversion signals with product truth, without taking ownership of in-product mechanics.
Why take this role
You will make a direct difference to how Gameopedia grows: less manual friction, clearer commercial evidence, faster execution and better-quality opportunities. It is a broad, high-leverage role for someone who enjoys improving the machine as much as running it.
What you can expect from us

- A collaborative, international team working across Norway, India and the US.

- The scope and trust to build systems, improve them and see the commercial impact of your work.

- Flexible work-life balance, strong benefits and a culture that values clarity, care and continuous improvement.

About the role
Comms8 is looking for a hands-on Bookkeeper & Finance Admin to take ownership of our day-to-day bookkeeping and finance administration across our group.
This is a practical, detail-focused role for someone who is comfortable keeping financial records accurate and up to date, reconciling accounts, processing invoices and expenses, and preparing regular finance reports.
You will support four entities across two jurisdictions and work closely with our team and accountants in the UK and Hong Kong.
Importantly, our UK and Hong Kong accountants handle all statutory filings and audit requirements. You will provide accurate records and information to support them, but you will not be responsible for owning statutory compliance or audit.
The role will initially focus entirely on finance. Once the month-end process is running accurately and consistently, the role will gradually expand to include general administrative support.
What you'll be doing
Finance & Bookkeeping

- Manage day-to-day bookkeeping across four group entities

- Complete regular bank reconciliations and investigate discrepancies

- Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable

- Prepare and issue client invoices and follow up on outstanding payments

- Process and record business expenses

- Prepare payroll data for UK employees and offshore contractors

- Record and reconcile intercompany transactions between business entities

- Produce a standard monthly finance pack

- Prepare a weekly cash and aged-debtors report using an established template

- Maintain accurate and well-organised financial records

- Respond to queries and provide supporting information to our UK and Hong Kong accountants

- Support month-end processes and help ensure the books are complete, accurate and ready for accountant review

You will not be expected to handle statutory filings or audits as these will be managed by our UK and Hong Kong accountants, giving you the opportunity to focus on maintaining accurate books and running the day-to-day finance processes well.
Admin Support
Once you have established a reliable month-end routine, the role will expand to include:

- Contractor onboarding and offboarding paperwork

- Vendor, subscription and business-tool administration

- Document filing and record-keeping across the four entities

- General administrative support for the operations team

What we're looking for

- 2–5 years of experience in bookkeeping, finance administration or a similar hands-on finance role

- Solid experience with day-to-day bookkeeping and bank reconciliations

- Experience handling accounts payable, accounts receivable, invoicing and expenses

- Good understanding of month-end bookkeeping processes

- Strong numerical accuracy and attention to detail

- Comfortable working independently in a remote environment

- Organised and consistent in maintaining records and following established processes

- Confident communicating with colleagues and accountants

- Good written and spoken English

- Comfortable working across multiple entities and currencies

- Able to work the required hours with regular overlap with our UK and Hong Kong teams

Experience preparing payroll data, handling intercompany transactions or working with international/remote businesses would be an advantage.
Working arrangement
This is a full-time contractor engagement, not an employment position.
The role is fully remote and open to candidates based across Southeast Asia.
Because you will work closely with colleagues and accountants across the UK and Hong Kong, availability during the required working hours and sufficient overlap with both teams is a mandatory requirement for this role.
Compensation
USD 500–800 per month, depending on relevant experience and demonstrated bookkeeping capability.
What success looks like
In your first few months, the priority will be straightforward: accurate books, clean reconciliations and a dependable month-end process.
Once the finance routine is running smoothly, you will begin supporting selected administrative tasks across the business.
If you are a practical, organised bookkeeper who enjoys keeping financial records accurate and processes running consistently, we'd be pleased to hear from you.

remote.title: Regional Associate, Growth & Competition (Portuguese-Speaking, Brazil / Spanish
remote.description:
About the Role

We are seeking a Portuguese-speaking Regional Associate to join a new outreach team supporting property hosts across Brazil and Spanish-speaking South America. In this role, you will use data to help hosts understand how their listings and pricing compare across booking platforms. You will also share education, tips, and insights that help them make informed decisions. This is a phone-heavy, relationship-driven role, a blend of business development and junior account management. It is well suited to someone early in their career who enjoys outbound outreach and building rapport quickly.

Key Responsibilities

- Analyze listing optimization opportunities and performance trends across a portfolio of high-potential host accounts, and act on data-driven opportunities that help hosts attract more bookings

- Make a high volume of outbound calls, roughly 10-20 per day, and reach hosts through video meetings and email, following up consistently across channels

- Present data clearly using charts and approved tools, and explain the platform's value to hosts

- Help hosts understand how their pricing compares across booking platforms, and address common questions and objections

- Maintain a baseline understanding of the technical integrations with various software partners

- Document conversations, classifications, and follow-ups in Salesforce, Gong, and team trackers

- Track progress toward quarterly goals and adjust your approach weekly

- Share learnings, objections, and best practices with the team

- Follow host communication guidelines at all times: educate and inform, provide objective, data-driven insights, and empower hosts to make their own pricing and business decisions

Qualifications

Required

- Fluency in Portuguese

- Comfort on the phone and on video, with the ability to build rapport quickly with people you have never met

- Comfort with outbound outreach and a high daily call volume

- Organized and self-directed, able to manage a large portfolio and a daily call plan

- Curiosity and comfort with data: you can read a dashboard, spot a pattern, and explain it simply

- Persistence and resilience: you can follow up many times, respectfully, without taking silence personally, and adapt quickly to different conversations

- Good judgment and integrity when working within compliance guidelines

Preferred

- Fluency in Spanish

- 1-2 years of experience in inside sales, business development, account management, or host or partner success and onboarding, ideally at a marketplace or tech platform

- Customer service, sales, or hospitality experience (internships count)

- Bachelor's degree completed or expected within the next 6 months (any field)

- Familiarity with CRM tools (Salesforce), call-intelligence tools (Gong), or outreach tools (Mixmax)

- Experience with spreadsheets and dashboards (Google Sheets, Tableau)

- Interest in travel, short-term rentals, or online marketplaces

What to Expect

- A structured ramp-up with guided training and competitive intelligence sessions

- Tool walkthroughs with teammates for Salesforce, Gong, Mixmax, and team dashboards and trackers

- Shadowing on host calls during your first weeks

- Weekly performance data and regular coaching to support your growth

Key Details

- Start date: Mid-November 2026

- Duration: 6 months

- Location: Remote (within the U.S.), Eastern or Central time zone preferred

- Work schedule: Full-time, 40 hours/week (8 hours/day, 5 days/week)

- Pay rate range: $20-$23/hour + benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401(K))

- Work Authorization: Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship.

- Engagement: W-2 Contract

Location: Remote

Compensation: $17–$27 per hour

ABOUT THE COMPANY
Soko Glam is the leading destination for K-beauty, founded on the belief that skincare is a journey, not a quick fix. Through our curated selection of top Korean beauty products, educational content, and authentic community engagement, we empower people to believe there are only good (skin) days ahead. At Soko Glam, we’re more than a beauty company—we’re a passionate team on a mission to educate, inspire, and connect.

The Graphic Design Contractor will work closely with the Marketing team to develop engaging, on-brand visual assets across a variety of channels.

The ideal candidate has 2–3 years of professional graphic design experience and is comfortable taking projects from concept through final execution. This is a hands-on role for a detail-oriented, visually driven designer who can work independently, manage multiple priorities, and bring a strong understanding of design principles and visual storytelling to a fast-paced environment.

The designer will primarily support digital and e-commerce creative, including email, website, paid advertising, social media, and campaign assets.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Collaborate with the creative team to develop engaging visual content across marketing channels including designing for daily newsletters, website visuals, paid ads, social media, and other assets that resonate with our audience and align with our brand's aesthetics.

- Edit, retouch, resize, and prepare PDP (product detail page) images to maintain a consistent visual standard across the site.

- Update and refresh creative assets across the homepage, navigation bars, landing pages, and other on-site placements to support current campaigns.

- Research visual trends, references, and creative inspiration to support campaign and concept development.

- Work with Creative team to organize and maintain creative assets to help improve efficiency and workflows

- Manage assigned design projects and deliverables independently, incorporating feedback and meeting agreed-upon deadlines

QUALIFICATIONS

- Strong technical skills in Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator; proficiency in Figma preferred.

- Basic video editing skills and familiarity with Premiere Pro and/or CapCut.

- Strong understanding of design principles, typography, composition, color, and visual hierarchy.

- Strong attention to detail and a keen eye for visual consistency and quality.

- Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across teams.

- Thrives in a highly entrepreneurial and fast-paced environment with an all-hands-on-deck and positive attitude

- Excellent presentation, written and oral communication skills

- A highly motivated, energetic self-starter who works collaboratively across cross-functional teams

Your tasks: Build challenging technical problems from your own domain and define what makes an answer correct
micro1 is engaging principal-level engineers, scientists, and faculty to design the technical problems that measure what AI systems can actually do. Your domain expertise is what matters here — no prior AI experience required.
We’re building this across four areas: aerospace, semiconductors, manufacturing and industrial engineering, and materials science. If your work sits in one of those — or across two of them — this is for you.

- Design difficult technical problems from your own area, with realistic constraints and supporting data.

- Provide the correct solution and walk through the reasoning that gets there.

- Define objective criteria for correctness, so another expert reviewing the work would reach the same verdict.

- Review problems built by other contributors for technical accuracy and soundness of method.

- Flag problems that turn out to be ambiguous or ungradable rather than submitting them.

What we’re looking for

- Master’s or PhD in engineering, physics, materials, or a closely related field.

- Principal, staff, or fellow-level experience at a major engineering organization, a national lab, or a faculty appointment at a leading university.

- Deep technical depth in at least one area, with hands-on ownership of the work.

- Able to explain why an answer is correct clearly enough that another expert could verify it.

- Publications, patents, or a record of technical leadership is a strong plus.

remote.title: Product Marketing Lead
remote.description:
About Us
Community Phone is building the best phone for communities in America. We are your hair salon’s business phone, how your auto-body shop texts you or gets appointments, your local government agency’s operations line, and your mom’s phone that she sometimes answers on her computer. We have more than 20,000 customers today, and are building the Square of phones.
Our team is ~80 people strong, across 15 countries. We are growing quickly, backed by Y Combinator Accelerator and Y Combinator’s Continuity Fund. We are customer-obsessed to the core. When we had a major network outage, everyone from recruiters to engineers to marketers to customer support agents got on the phone with our customers. Our team exemplifies our purpose. Join us on our mission to make it as easy as possible for communities to communicate.
Your Mission
We’re seeing new and interesting product use cases emerge regularly—and we’re looking for someone to help us understand, weigh, and communicate them clearly. As our first dedicated product marketing hire, you’ll define and own the function from the ground up. Reporting directly to the CEO, you’ll be a key partner to Growth, Product, Sales, and Customer Success.
You’ll own the end-to-end positioning, packaging, and go-to-market success of our core phone product and integrated communications suite. You’ll ensure every feature we ship reaches the right audience, with the right message, through the right channel—and that the story lands.
What You’ll Actually Do
Positioning & Messaging

- Develop and maintain differentiated positioning for each core use case

- Deliver two updated personas and a refreshed messaging framework within your first 30 days

Launch & Enablement

- Run GTM for every new feature or pricing change: define launch tiers, write launch briefs, own the comms calendar

- Lead one Tier-1 launch per month (features used by >20% of users or tied to upsell motion)

Revenue & Sales Alignment

- Own product marketing inputs to sales playbooks, user lifecycle, sales training, and CS enablement—reviewed biweekly with Sales and CS
Voice of the Customer

- Talk to users in our ICPs and grow to understand them deeply

- Partner with CS and Research to generate one new customer case study per month

- Conduct win/loss interviews monthly to inform roadmap prioritization and competitive content

Cross-Functional Leadership

- Run a weekly GTM sync with Growth, CS, and Product

- Provide insights for roadmap planning (next two quarters), especially as they relate to competitive shifts or field learnings that influence prioritization

What We’re Looking For

- 4–7 years in product marketing, ideally in SMB or consumer SaaS with a self-serve checkout and light-touch sales motion

- Experience shipping GTM for features tied to revenue impact—not just awareness

- Comfortable owning positioning for both hardware and software products serving low-tech audiences

- Excellent communicator and structured thinker—bonus if you can share a portfolio or sample launch plan

- Strong collaborator with an operator mindset: you focus on outcomes, prioritize speed, and work through blockers

- Humble, self-aware, and persistent

How We’ll Measure Success

- Increased logo growth and reduced CPA on target ICPs through maturing channels

- Accelerated feature adoption post-conversion for key ICPs

- Strong alignment between product value and sales/growth messaging

- Consistent messaging across key surfaces (site, demo, content)

- Improved conversion from site traffic to qualified leads among target ICPs

Total compensation with equity: $145k- $175k per year. 401(k) and health insurance included.
Community Phone is a customer-obsessed, performance culture. We are here to deliver the most extraordinary experience for as many customers as we can in America. That comes with enormous pride as well as regular challenges. You will feel like you are pushing yourself, and you will be an author of our future. Therefore, we have a bias for ownership. Here are ways our current team exemplifies our company culture:
Curiosity: Our team members double click obsessively, until they understand something enough to make a good decision. They don’t take things for granted. They want to really understand the truth.
Bias Toward Action: Our team members lean toward making change on their own, and then reporting the wins and losses back to the team. We don’t wait for long “alignment” meetings to take action, unless the change would be hard to reverse. Run through two-way doors.
Caring Mentality: Our team members deliver for our customers and our internal team. That does not mean things are comfortable always. It means that we strive to deliver a Disney-like experience for our customers. It means that we understand our team members are on an Olympic team, and Olympic teams need support.
Founder Mindset: Our team members all know they are at the very beginning of the journey we will take to capture the market. They go out of their comfort zones, out of their role definitions, and out of the norm to achieve our mission. When they have an idea for how things could be better, they jump into overdrive to test it.
Transparency: Our team will share their wins and losses with the company overall, so we can all learn together.
Efficiency where it counts: Our team members understand we aren’t here to sell $1 for $0.80. We are here to deliver an efficient growth machine.
