Jos mielenkiintosi on herännyt, toivomme, että kohtaamme! Voit olla meihin näppärästi ja nopeasti yhteydessä ilman CV:tä ja tarkennellaan yhdessä lisää. Jätä yhteystietosi meille hakulinkin kautta (esim. LinkedIn-profiilin avulla), niin olemme sinuun yhteydessä.
Kaipaatko lisätietoja ja haluat jutella lisää? Olethan yhteydessä suoraan Jesseen, .
Rekrytointiprosessimme on nopea, avoin ja informatiivinen. Voit lukea prosessistamme lisää blogistamme. Aloitus on sovittavissa joustavasti tilanteesi mukaan ja työnteko onnistuu ympäri Suomea. Roolissa vaaditaan sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa.
Mitä maailmamme olisi ilman integraatioita? 🌎

- Sähkömittarit luettaisiin käsin.

- Tavaratilaukset hoidettaisiin yhä puhelimella.

- Laivat eivät pääsisi satamiin ilman ennakolta lähetettyjä tulli-ilmoituksia.

remote.title: Director, Marketing Analytics
remote.description:
This is a remote role, required to work in EST hours.

Who We Are
Marketbridge is a leading integrated growth consulting and marketing services firm that accelerates performance from strategy through execution. We combine management consultancy with marketing agency expertise, all backed by marketing science, creative problem-solving, and technological know-how. Our integrated approach brings together teams, technology, data, strategies, processes, and plans to fuel sustainable revenue growth and build deeper, more resonant customer relationships. With a team of 300 professionals across global locations including Boston, D.C.,London, and Canada, Marketbridge partners with over 150 clients worldwide, including Amazon Web Services, AMD, MetLife, Flex and CERN.

Who We're Looking For
Marketbridge is seeking a Director, Marketing Analytics to lead the strategy, design, and evolution of the data and analytics capabilities that power modern marketing programs.
This role sits at the intersection of marketing strategy, marketing technology, data operations, measurement, and business intelligence. The Director will help clients establish the connected data foundations required to activate audiences effectively, measure marketing performance accurately, and turn complex information into actionable business insight.
The ideal candidate is equally comfortable discussing marketing objectives with senior client stakeholders and working with technical teams to implement and configure tracking and tagging mechanisms, design the data architectures, build data integrations and workflows, and establish governance standards.
This leader will oversee a team responsible for transforming, integrating, automating, and analyzing marketing data across complex client ecosystems. They will partner closely with Marketing Technology, Marketing Operations, Demand Strategy, Media, and client teams to ensure data moves reliably from source systems through activation and measurement.
Success in this role requires a combination of data strategy, technical fluency, analytical thinking, client leadership, and people development, along with the ability to translate between technical requirements and business outcomes.
Key Responsibilities

- Lead marketing data strategy and architecture across complex client environments, defining how data should be captured, integrated, transformed, governed, activated, and measured across marketing ecosystems.

- Collaborate with Marketing Technology & Operations leadership to establish reusable methodologies, standards, and intellectual property for data architecture, integration, data quality, automation, measurement readiness, and analytics delivery.

- Own the design and governance of scalable marketing data solutions spanning CRM, marketing automation platforms, media and ABM platforms, web analytics, data warehouses, BI environments, and other marketing and sales systems.

- Translate business and marketing strategies into data requirements, helping clients determine the data, integration, segmentation, measurement, and reporting capabilities required to support their goals.

- Oversee data integration and transformation frameworks, including ETL processes, APIs, cloud connectors, workflow automation, SQL- and Python-based solutions, and other methods used to move and prepare data across platforms.

- Establish data quality and governance standards that improve the accuracy, consistency, accessibility, security, and reliability of marketing data and downstream reporting.

- Advance marketing measurement and analytics capabilities by partnering with Strategy, Media, and Marketing Technology & Operations teams to establish reliable data foundations, KPI frameworks, reporting structures, and analytical approaches.

- Connect data to business insight, helping client and internal teams understand how data infrastructure, measurement, and analytical outputs can improve marketing decisions and business outcomes.

- Serve as a senior trusted advisor to clients, including Marketing Operations, Analytics, Technology, and Marketing leaders, on data architecture, operational data strategy, measurement readiness, governance, and future-state capabilities.

- Lead complex discovery and solution-design engagements, facilitating stakeholder conversations, documenting requirements, identifying gaps, and developing future-state recommendations and implementation roadmaps.

- Evaluate emerging data, analytics, automation, and AI capabilities, identifying opportunities to increase efficiency, improve decision-making, and expand Marketbridge's client offerings.

- Lead and develop Marketing Data & Analytics talent, providing coaching, technical guidance, performance management, career development, and opportunities for team members to expand their skills.

- Guide team resourcing and delivery quality across multiple client engagements, ensuring work is appropriately staffed and delivered against established technical and analytical standards.

- Support new business and organic growth, leading data and analytics discovery, solution design, technical scoping, estimation, proposal development, and client presentations.

Qualifications

- 8+ years of experience in marketing data, marketing analytics, data engineering, marketing operations, marketing technology, business intelligence, or a closely related discipline, ideally within an agency, consulting, or complex client-service environment.

- Demonstrated experience leading marketing data strategy and solution architecture across interconnected marketing and sales technology environments.

- Strong understanding of the role data plays across the marketing lifecycle, including audience development, segmentation, personalization, campaign activation, measurement, attribution, reporting, and optimization.

- Experience designing or overseeing ETL/ELT processes, data transformations, automated workflows, APIs, system integrations, and data quality frameworks.

- Strong working knowledge of SQL and familiarity with Python and modern data transformation or automation approaches; the Director does not need to be the primary hands-on developer but must be technically fluent enough to guide solutions and challenge architectural decisions.

- Deep expertise in web analytics and tag management strategy and implementation, including GA4, GTM, and Adobe Analytics, with experience defining measurement frameworks, tagging and data layer architectures, event taxonomies, implementation standards, QA processes, and governance across enterprise digital properties.

- Experience working across platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Marketo, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, 6sense, Demandbase, cloud data warehouses, BI platforms, and data integration/automation tools.

- Strong understanding of data architecture, data modeling, governance, identity, integration patterns, and marketing data quality.

- Experience with marketing measurement and analytics, including the ability to connect campaign and customer data to KPIs, reporting, performance analysis, and business outcomes.

- Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences.

- Strong client-facing communication and executive presentation skills, with experience advising senior marketing, operations, analytics, and technology stakeholders.

- Proven ability to lead ambiguous and complex engagements from discovery and requirements gathering through solution design, implementation, and optimization.

- Experience managing and developing multidisciplinary data and analytics talent, including coaching individual contributors and emerging people leaders.

- Strong cross-functional leadership skills and demonstrated ability to collaborate with strategy, technology, activation, analytics, media, creative, and account teams.

- Experience identifying, scoping, and supporting new business and organic growth opportunities.

- A strong sense of curiosity about emerging technologies, including how AI, automation, modern data platforms, and advanced analytics are changing marketing operations and decision-making.

Our Culture
Marketbridge supports Fortune 50 companies and top global brands in redefining how they go to market. At Marketbridge, you’ll join a vibrant community of collaborative minds dedicated to reinventing growth. We celebrate curiosity, reward bold thinking, and empower you to take the lead in shaping innovative strategies. From day one, you’ll gain hands-on experience, learn from supportive mentors, and engage in ongoing professional development through targeted training, skill-building workshops, and leadership guidance. Our inclusive environment values each individual’s voice, fostering genuine connections and a sense of belonging. Here, you won’t just watch the industry evolve—you’ll help drive it, turning fresh ideas into measurable outcomes and building a career defined by meaningful impact and continuous growth.

Benefits & Perks
At Marketbridge, we support our team with benefits that prioritize well-being, flexibility, and growth. Here’s what you can look forward to:

- 🏖️ Time Off & Flexibility – Flexible PTO, summer Fridays, and paid parental leave (up to 16 weeks for birthing parents). Plus, we’re closed from Christmas to New Year’s so you can fully unplug.

- 💙 Health & Wellness – Comprehensive medical benefits and free premium access to the Calm app for relaxation and mindfulness.

- 💰 Financial Security – 401(k) with a 3% company contribution* (US Only), life insurance, long-term disability, and AD&D coverage for extra peace of mind.

- 📚 Learning & Growth – A professional development fund ($500) and continuous learning programs to invest in your career.

- 💻 Tech & Perks – Company-provided laptop & accessories, monthly Wi-Fi & cell stipend, and exclusive discounts through Perkopolis.

Note: This position requires candidates to be eligible to work in the United States or Canada without visa sponsorship. Marketbridge is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
We aim to offer competitive and fair compensation based on experience, location, and market benchmarks. The salary range for this role is $115,000 – $130,000.

The agent owns the full loan file lifecycle: reading documents, checking them against investor and agency guidelines, and routing each loan through to a decision, acting rather than waiting on a human, and earning more autonomy as trust builds loan by loan. Customer discovery validates a real, recurring cost problem in this segment: lenders spend thousands of dollars to originate a single loan today, a cost that's climbed roughly 35% over the past three years, with up to 80% of that time spent on manual document review.
The US mortgage market processes roughly 6.5 million loans a year across close to 5,000 lending institutions, an estimated $3.25B in addressable software spend at Closeline's pricing. remote.title: Sales Manager (m/w/d) für SIMON [Bangkok/Remote] – Neukundengewinnung B2B SaaS
remote.description:
(This job is only available in german)
Worum es geht
SIMON ist die Außendienst-Plattform für alle, die beim Kunden vor Ort arbeiten. Das reicht von der Pharmareferentin in der Apotheke über den Merchandiser im Lebensmittelmarkt bis zum Techniker im Heizungskeller. SIMON setzt auf die vorhandenen ERP- und CRM-Systeme auf und ist technisch in vier bis sechs Wochen startklar. Seit über zehn Jahren arbeiten anspruchsvolle Außendienstteams im Pharmabereich damit.
Jetzt bringen wir SIMON zu weiteren mittelständischen Herstellern, vor allem im Handel und FMCG sowie im technischen Kundendienst. Dafür suchen wir dich: jemanden, der die richtigen Leute findet, anspricht und vom ersten Kontakt bis zum produktiven Einsatz begleitet.
Wie wir verkaufen
Wir verkaufen SIMON so, wie man einen neuen Kollegen einstellt. Zuerst kommt das Kennenlernen: Der Interessent probiert einen Prototyp für seine Branche selbst aus. Darauf folgt das Vorstellungsgespräch, eine Demo mit einem Klickdummy in seinen eigenen Begriffen. Danach kommt die Probearbeit, ein Pilot mit fünf bis zehn Nutzern und vorab vereinbarten Erfolgskriterien. Erst dann folgt die Festanstellung, also Vertrag und Rollout. Nach drei Monaten gibt es ein Mitarbeitergespräch mit echten Zahlen.
Wir versprechen dabei nichts, was nicht stimmt. In jeder Demo sagen wir klar, was Standard ist, was konfiguriert und was entwickelt werden muss.
Deine Aufgaben

- Du identifizierst passende mittelständische Hersteller mit eigenem Außendienst und findest dort die richtigen Ansprechpartner, vor allem über LinkedIn und den Sales Navigator.

- Du sprichst Vertriebs- und Serviceleitungen persönlich an, über LinkedIn und am Telefon, und gewinnst sie für ein erstes Gespräch.

- Du baust dein LinkedIn-Profil zu einer erkennbaren fachlichen Stimme für Außendienstthemen aus.

- Du qualifizierst eingehende Anfragen von der Website und aus unseren Branchenprototypen.

- Du führst Demos und stimmst dafür kundenspezifische Prototypen mit unserem Produktteam ab.

- Du begleitest Interessenten durch ihre Entscheidung und bindest dabei Fachbereich, IT, Geschäftsführung, Datenschutz und Betriebsrat ein.

- Du verhandelst Pilotprojekte und Verträge.

- Du bleibst nach dem Vertrag Ansprechpartner für deine Kunden, gemeinsam mit unserem Beratungsteam, und entwickelst die Zusammenarbeit weiter.

Was du mitbringst

- Du hast mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb, idealerweise mit Software oder erklärungsbedürftigen Lösungen für den Mittelstand.

- Du hast nachweislich selbst Kunden gewonnen. LinkedIn-Direktansprache und Telefonakquise sind für dich Handwerk.

- Du schreibst Nachrichten, die nach Mensch klingen, und führst am Telefon ein Gespräch statt eines Skripts.

- Du hast Erfahrung mit Entscheidungen über mehrere Monate und mehrere Beteiligte, zum Beispiel mit IT-Abteilungen und Betriebsräten.

- Du sprichst Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau. Englisch ist ein Plus.

- Ein großer Vorteil wäre eigene Erfahrung im Außendienst, im Handel oder im technischen Service.

Was du bekommst

- Gehalt mit Erfolgsbeteiligung: Gute Leistung zahlt sich bei uns aus, auch jenseits der Führungsebene. Wir vergüten nicht nur Abschlüsse, sondern auch qualifizierte Demo-Termine und Erweiterungen bei Bestandskunden.

- Werkzeuge, die verkaufen helfen: Prototypen, die Interessenten selbst ausprobieren, ein Produktteam, das kundenspezifische Klickdummys in wenigen Tagen baut, LinkedIn Sales Navigator und Zeit für den Aufbau deines Profils.

- Karriere und Weiterbildung: DMG Academy, Mentoring und Zugriff auf Lernplattformen zu KI, Kundenportalen und mehr.

- Agiles Arbeiten: Feedback, Mitgestaltung und Verantwortung statt Micromanagement. Du hast kurze Wege zu Geschäftsführung, Produkt und Beratung und echten Einfluss darauf, wie wir in neue Branchen gehen.

- Arbeitsmodelle nach Maß: Vollzeit, Teilzeit oder remote, mit nur zwei Stunden Kernzeit.

- Weltweit arbeiten: Du willst von Thailand, Bali oder einem Coworking-Space in Hamburg aus arbeiten? Go for it.

- Zusatzleistungen: Krankenversicherung, private Rente, Top-Equipment und Zuschüsse.

On behalf of UKRI we are looking for anIdentity & Collaboration Architect(Inside IR35) for an initial 4 month contract. Remote working with occasional office travel.

The Identity & Collaboration Architect will lead the architecture and design of a large-scale Microsoft 365 consolidation programme involving the migration of multiple Microsoft 365 tenancies, mail domains and identity platforms into a single strategic environment.

The role is accountable for developing the future-state architecture for identity, authentication, directory services, email namespace, collaboration services and associated governance models. The architect will work across technical, operational and business stakeholders to establish a coherent, sustainable target operating model that balances organisational requirements with Microsoft's strategic cloud architecture.

A key aspect of the role is the development of target-state identity and namespace strategies, including the transition from multiple independentlymanaged directories and Microsoft 365 tenancies to a consolidated identity platform centred on Microsoft Entra ID.

As an Identity & Collaboration Architect your main responsibilities will be to:

- Develop target-state identity architecture for a multi-organisational Microsoft 365 environment.

- Define authoritative sources for identity information and attribute ownership.

- Establish identity lifecycle architecture covering joiners, movers and leavers.

- Define future-state email namespace strategy.

- Develop mail domain architecture covering multiple existing SMTP domains.

- Analyse impacts of domain consolidation, retention and rationalisation.

- Support definition of future-state architecture for Microsoft 365 services and ancillary solutions

- Support tenant consolidation strategy and migration planning.

- Design core platform services including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint Online and OneDrive.

- Develop architectural principles and standards.

- Establish decision frameworks for identity and namespace management.

- Lead discovery activities across multiple organisations.

- Analyse current-state identity, directory and messaging environments.

- Engage senior stakeholders across IT, security, HR and business functions.

- Facilitate workshops to define identity, namespace and governance requirements.

Essential:

- Demonstrable experience in designing and delivering Identity Architecture within complex enterprise environments.

- Strong understanding of directory services, domain architecture and identity lifecycle management.

- Hands-on experience with Microsoft Entra ID, including authentication, conditional access, identity governance and privileged identity management.

- Proven experience designing and implementing Microsoft 365 architectures.

- Experience developing target-state architectures, migration strategies and transition roadmaps across multiple organisations or business units.

- Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to facilitate workshops and present architectural recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences.

- Experience defining governance frameworks, operating models and architectural standards.

Desirable:

- Experience with Microsoft Azure and/or AWS cloud platforms.

- Experience within the Public Sector or similarly regulated environments.

The Head of Human Resources will be responsible for building a scalable, high-performance and bank-ready people function that supports sustainable business growth while ensuring compliance with employment legislation, regulatory expectations and internal governance standards.

The company is executing a strategic transformation from a leading credit-only microfinance institution into a fully-fledged, deposit-taking bank regulated by the central bank.
This transformation will require significant organisational, cultural and workforce readiness. The Head of Human Resources will therefore play a critical role in ensuring that the company's people strategy, organisational structure, leadership capability, talent pipeline, policies, performance systems and HR governance evolve in line with the banking transition roadmap.
The role will lead the development of a future-ready workforce capable of operating within a more complex, highly regulated financial-services environment while maintaining the company's entrepreneurial culture and customer-focused orientation.
The priority is to build the right organisation, with the right people, capabilities, leadership and controls, at the right time to support profitable growth and regulatory readiness.

- Develop and execute the annual Human Resources strategy aligned with the company's corporate strategy and banking transition roadmap.

- Act as a strategic advisor and trusted business partner to the CEO and Executive Leadership Team on people, organisational and workforce matters.

- Translate business strategy into workforce requirements, organisational capability priorities and people initiatives.

- Establish mechanisms for measuring learning effectiveness and return on investment.

- Build internal capability and reduce organisational dependency on external recruitment for critical positions through targeted development and succession planning.

- Partner with senior leaders to strengthen management capability, coaching and people leadership.

- Lead culture transformation initiatives required to support the company's growth and transition into a regulated banking environment.

- Strengthen employee experience across the employee lifecycle.

- Develop employee wellbeing and financial-wellness initiatives that support attraction, engagement and retention.

H. Compensation, Benefits and Reward

- Develop and maintain a competitive and sustainable compensation and benefits framework aligned with market practices and the company's financial capacity.

- Lead periodic salary benchmarking and remuneration reviews.

- Develop reward mechanisms that support performance, retention and achievement of strategic business objectives.

I. Employee Relations, Employment Law and HR Governance

- Provide strategic advice on employee relations, disciplinary matters, grievances, investigations and workplace disputes.

- Ensure HR policies, employment contracts and practices comply with applicable local employment legislation and regulatory requirements.

- Develop, review and maintain HR policies, procedures and governance frameworks.

- Ensure appropriate documentation and controls across the employee lifecycle.

- Manage employee relations risks and provide timely advice to management on labour-law matters.

- Promote fair, consistent and transparent application of HR policies and employment practices.

- Maintain appropriate HR records and reporting to support governance, audit and regulatory requirements.

J. Regulatory and Banking Transition Readiness

- Partner with the CEO, Executive Leadership Team, Compliance, Risk and other functions to ensure people-related requirements for the banking transition are addressed.

- Develop a workforce and capability roadmap aligned with the company's licensing and regulatory-readiness programme.

- Ensure critical banking capabilities, leadership positions and specialist functions are identified and appropriately staffed.

4. QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE

- Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Commerce, Industrial Relations, Psychology or a related field.

Founded by Dhar Mann, named the “Moral Philosopher of YouTube” by The New York Times, a Time Top 100 Creator, and ranked #2 on Forbes’ 2025 Top Creators list—our founding principle is simple but ambitious: We’re not just telling stories. We’re changing lives.
BIG PICTURE:
We’re looking for an Assistant Editor who keeps our post-production pipeline organized and moving. You’ll collate and prep project files for our VFX and color teams, and manage the digital assets behind every episode we produce.
This is a hands-on support role. You’ll make sure editors, VFX artists, and colorists get clean, complete, correctly structured files on time, and that every piece of footage, project file, and finished master is ingested, organized, backed up, and archived.
Why this role matters
We deliver several hours of original content every week. Missing media, broken links, or poorly prepped turnovers cost our VFX and color teams hours they don’t have.
A well-run library, with clear naming, accurate metadata, and reliable archives, means faster turnarounds, easy re-versioning, and no lost work. You’ll be the person who makes handoffs between editorial, VFX, and color seamless.
HOW YOU’LL SPEND YOUR TIME:
Assistant editorial: file collation and handoffs

- Collating all project files, media, graphics, music, and SFX for each episode into a complete, correctly structured package

- Relinking offline media, consolidating projects, and making sure nothing is missing before a handoff

- Organizing project bins, sequences, and timelines so editors can pick up work without delays

- Syncing audio and video, and building stringouts or selects when requested

- Tracking each episode’s status and flagging missing assets or technical issues early

VFX prep

- Preparing VFX turnovers: exporting plates with handles, reference clips, and EDL/XML files to spec

- Naming and numbering VFX shots consistently and logging them in the VFX tracker

- Packaging shot notes, reference frames, and editor instructions with each turnover

- Bringing returned VFX shots back into the timeline and checking them for sync, frame accuracy, and version

Color prep

- Preparing locked cuts for color: simplifying timelines, flattening tracks, and removing unsupported effects

- Exporting XML/AAF/EDL files and reference videos for the colorist

- Confirming all source media is linked and accessible for the grade

- Conforming and patching graded media back into the edit, then QC’ing against the reference

Digital asset management

- Ingesting and verifying camera footage, audio, graphics, and music using checksum-verified offloads

- Maintaining folder structures, file-naming conventions, and version control across raw footage, projects, and deliverables

- Logging and tagging assets with accurate, searchable metadata (series, episode, talent, shoot date, usage rights)

- Uploading all working files and backups to the server in the agreed path, so any editor can pick up a project

- Creating proxies, transcodes, and alternate versions (textless, clean, localized) as needed

- Exporting and QC’ing final masters to spec (resolution, codec, aspect ratio, captions, loudness)

- Archiving completed projects to long-term cloud and offline storage, and retrieving archived media on request

- Monitoring storage capacity and keeping drives and servers clean per retention guidelines

- Keeping asset trackers, delivery logs, and archive records up to date

WHAT YOU HAVE:

- 3–5+ years of experience as an assistant editor, media manager, or in post-production operations

- Strong proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, including Project Manager, consolidating and relinking media, and proxy workflows

- Hands-on experience preparing VFX turnovers and color handoffs (EDL, XML, AAF, plates with handles)

- Working knowledge of codecs, formats, frame rates, resolutions, and export settings, and the ability to spot technical issues during QC

- Exceptional organization and attention to detail, with the discipline to keep naming, folder structures, and metadata consistent under tight deadlines

- An understanding of backup and archival best practices (3-2-1 rule, checksum verification with tools like Hedge or ShotPut Pro, cloud and LTO storage)

- Proficiency with Google Sheets, Excel, or Airtable for tracking assets, turnovers, and deliveries

- Clear, proactive communication, especially when flagging missing files or delays

Nice to have

- Familiarity with DaVinci Resolve and After Effects

- Experience with DAM/MAM and review platforms (Frame.io, Iconik, Air, CatDV, or similar) and shared storage (Google Drive, Dropbox, LucidLink)

- Basic understanding of music licensing, clearances, and usage rights

- Experience in a high-volume content studio or episodic workflow

WHO OVERSEES YOU:
The Assistant Editor reports to the Jr. Post Production Manager.
WHO YOU OVERSEE:
No direct reports at this time.
WHERE IT ALL GOES DOWN:
You’ll work remotely from home or a personal office and log hours in Dhar Mann Studios’ time-tracking software.
WHEN THE MAGIC HAPPENS:
The typical schedule is 40 hours per week. Specific hours and shift overlap with the US team will be discussed during interviews

In this role, you’ll lead the design and delivery of agentic systems that orchestrate tools, data, and policies to solve real business workflows—safely, reliably, and at scale. What you'll do
Architecture & System Design (Agentic)

- Design multi-agent architectures with robust state management, memory, and routing.

- Choose and implement leading frameworks such as LangGraph/LangChain Agents, Microsoft AutoGen, CrewAI, LlamaIndex Agents, Semantic Kernel, or Haystack Agents—and justify trade-offs.

Tooling & Orchestration

- Integrate enterprise tools and data sources via function/tool calling, webhooks, and event-driven flows (Queues/Service Bus/Functions).

- Implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) patterns with vector stores (Azure AI Search, pgvector, MongoDB Atlas, Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus) and structured knowledge (SQL/Graph).

- Add deterministic fallbacks, circuit breakers, and caching to keep latency and cost predictable.

Reliability, Observability & MLOps

- Define SLIs/SLOs for agent runs; implement tracing, metrics, and logging (e.g., Langfuse + OpenTelemetry) and build dashboards for run-level analytics.

- Create evaluation harnesses (automatic + human-in-the-loop) using tools such as Ragas, DeepEval, promptfoo to measure groundedness, task success, safety, and cost.

- Productionize with CI/CD, environment promotion, feature flags, and canary strategies; optimize cost-per-task and time-to-success.

Safety, Security & Governance

- Enforce content and safety policies (redaction, classification, guardrails) with policy-as-code; implement role/tenant isolation and data minimization.

- Collaborate with security teams to align to ISO 27001/SOC 2/NIST/HIPAA/GDPR contexts; deliver audit-ready evidence for agentic workflows.

- Build privacy-first patterns (no data exfiltration by default, least-privilege tool access, secure prompt/trace storage).

Product & Client Impact

- Work directly with enterprise client teams to translate business processes into agentic designs; present trade-offs and proofs-of-value that lead to production.

- Partner with solution leads to create domain-specific agents (e.g., RFP assist, incident RCA drafting, knowledge ops) and reusable templates.

Qualifications
Must-have

- 5–8+ years in software/platform engineering with recent production LLM applications (not just prototypes).

- Hands-on expertise with agentic frameworks (one or more of: LangGraph/LangChain Agents, AutoGen, CrewAI, LlamaIndex Agents, Semantic Kernel, Haystack Agents) and tool/function-calling patterns.

- Strong RAG engineering across vector DBs, chunking/embedding strategies, metadata/search ranking, and grounding techniques.

- Proven track record building observable, cost-aware, and secure LLM systems (tracing, evals, guardrails, secrets/IAM, PII handling).

- Solid software engineering fundamentals: Python/TypeScript, async patterns, APIs, testing, CI/CD, containerization.

- Clear communicator who can interface with clients and write crisp technical docs.

HawkAIdeploys always-on, multi-channel "AI workers" that autonomously manage high-volume freight communications across calls, texts, and emails, integrating directly with core freight systems including TMS, load boards, and broker/carrier databases. The platform handles track-and-trace calls, appointment scheduling, carrier rate negotiation, proof-of-delivery capture, and shipment status updates end-to-end — autonomously resolving 90%+ of routine communications and escalating only exceptions to human staff. This is a remote-first (UK-based) role, with access to our London office and/or other WeWork coworking spaces across the country. Some in-person attendance is expected for board and leadership meetings, plus international travel as required.

We are looking for a commercially intuitive General Counsel to lead the legal function of our established and rapidly scaling AI business as we launch our flagship innovation, Workspace, to market. This is a senior leadership role covering UK legal matters, with oversight across major international jurisdictions. You will support a growing global customer base in sectors including media and entertainment, retail, healthcare and the public sector.

You will be a trusted member of the executive leadership team, supported directly by the c suite and balancing legal risk management with pragmatic, business-focused advice.
You will build on the foundations of our existing legal function, with real freedom to shape how the department works moving forwards. The legal team’s structure, ways of working and tools are yours to design as you grow a high-performing in-house team. You will oversee external counsel relationships and own Stelia's legal, compliance, governance and regulatory frameworks as we expand globally.

Uniquely, you will build the legal function's technology on Stelia's own platform. You will act as an internal design partner to our product and engineering teams, and make legal a showcase for what our technology can do.
what you'll do

1. Corporate & Governance

- Advise the Board and CEO on corporate structure, governance and shareholder matters.

- Lead legal due diligence for upcoming funding rounds.

- Oversee company secretarial duties, board meetings and statutory filings in the UK and internationally.

- Draft, review and negotiate shareholder agreements and investment documentation.

2. Product Launch & Go-to-Market

- Ensure the legal and regulatory foundations for the continuous development of Stelia's technologies are in place, and scale them as adoption grows.

- Own Stelia's customer-facing terms, including master services and SaaS agreements, acceptable use policies, SLAs and data processing agreements.

- Maintain Stelia's positions on AI-specific contract issues, including ownership of outputs, IP indemnities for generated content, use of customer data for model training and performance disclaimers.

- Advise on sector-specific requirements in target markets with external support, such as medical device and clinical safety rules in healthcare, and procurement, security accreditation and transparency obligations in the public sector.

3. Commercial Contracts

- Introduce tools and processes that streamline contracting, balancing efficiency with Stelia's risk appetite and growth trajectory.

- Establish playbooks for scalable contract management across a global client base.

- Lead the negotiation and drafting of complex technology, SaaS, licensing, distribution and strategic partnership agreements.

4. Data Protection, AI Regulation & Compliance

- Act as the company's lead on data privacy, leading compliance with the UK GDPR, EU GDPR, CCPA and other international frameworks.

- Classify Stelia's products under the EU AI Act and other emerging AI regimes, and run the resulting transparency, documentation and governance obligations.

- Monitor and advise on developing AI legislation and ethical frameworks globally, and lead the strategy for managing conflicting requirements between jurisdictions.

- Oversee export controls and sanctions compliance as Stelia sells internationally.

- Partner with product and engineering teams to embed legal and regulatory compliance in product development.

- Develop internal compliance policies and training programmes.

5. Legal Technology & Operations

- Build the legal function's technology stack on Stelia's own platform and in-house models.

- Act as an internal design partner to product and engineering, translating legal workflows into clear product requirements and feeding back on early tools.

- Position the legal function as a reference use case for Stelia's technology, supporting customer conversations where useful.

- Set governance for using AI tools on confidential and privileged material, covering legal privilege, access controls and data retention.

6. Employment & People

- Line-manage Stelia's VP of People (or equivalent).

- Oversee employment law compliance in the UK and coordinate with international counsel and employers of record for global hiring.

- Own the legal framework for remote-first working, including staff working from abroad (tax, permanent establishment and immigration risk), remote working policies and health and safety for home workers.

- Keep employment contracts compliant and maintain consultancy agreements.

- Manage the administration of employee and advisor incentive schemes, including liaising with accountants on valuations.

- Advise on employee disputes, restructurings and cross-border HR matters.

7. Intellectual Property

- Lead IP strategy to protect proprietary AI models, code, datasets and related technology.

- Manage Stelia's trademark and patent portfolios, working with the COO and CAIO to identify new registration needs through the product development lifecycle.

- Advise on open-source software use and licensing risks.

8. Disputes & Risk Management

- Proactively identify, assess and mitigate legal and regulatory risks.

- Manage litigation, arbitration and IP disputes globally, working with external counsel where needed.

- Advise on client and vendor disputes, settlement negotiations and contract enforcement.

- Provide legal input into crisis management, incident response and data breach notification processes.

9. Leadership & Strategy

- Build and manage a high-performing in-house legal team as we scale.

- Act as a key strategic advisor to the CEO and executive team on growth, customer sectors and international expansion.

- Build strong relationships with regulators, industry bodies and external stakeholders.

- Represent Stelia publicly on the regulatory pressures facing the AI industry.

Your First 12 Months

- Continue to develop the legal and regulatory foundations for Workspace, and scale them as customer adoption grows.

- Build out the company's global legal framework, policies and compliance programme.

- Stand up the legal function's technology stack on Stelia's own platform, and implement scalable processes for contract negotiation and management.

- Provide executive-level legal input on fundraising, partnerships and international expansion.

- Oversee international subsidiary incorporation as customer or employee growth requires.

- Position Stelia as a leader in ethical and legally compliant AI deployment.

who we're looking for

Experience & Qualifications

- Qualified lawyer in England & Wales with at least 7 years' PQE.

- Experience in a high-growth technology company (AI or deep tech preferred).

- Background in commercial contracts, IP and data protection preferred but other specialisms considered.

- Experience taking a technology product to market, including customer terms and regulatory readiness (preferred).

- Familiarity with international regulatory frameworks governing technology, data and AI, and insight into the ethical considerations surrounding AI.

- Experience managing legal issues across multiple jurisdictions (preferred).

- Previous exposure to fundraising and M&A (preferred).

Skills & Competencies

- Ability to balance risk with business objectives, and to prioritise the work that enables growth.

- Excellent negotiation and stakeholder management skills.

- Strong leadership, with experience building and managing legal teams.

- Ability to translate complex legal issues into clear, actionable advice for non-lawyers.

- Comfortable working directly with engineers, testing early-stage tools and articulating legal workflows as product requirements.

- High ethical standards, with a proactive approach to governance and compliance.

Personal Attributes

- Strategic thinker with a growth mindset.

- Collaborative, resilient and adaptable, and comfortable with fast-shifting priorities in a dynamic market.

- Comfortable creating structure where it does not yet exist.

- Effective in a remote-first team, communicating clearly in writing and across time zones.

remote.title: Manager, Marketing Data & Analytics
remote.description:
How will you make a difference to PMI? The Manager, Marketing Data and Analytics owns the business data architecture and metric definitions behind Marketing's numbers, and leads the team that measures Marketing. The role defines how marketing, customer, product, and revenue data should be modeled, decides what each metric means, and ensures those definitions are implemented consistently across Snowflake, BI, and natural-language analytics. The role combines hands-on technical depth with team leadership. The individual is expected to be advanced in SQL, to design analytical data models, and to profile, reconcile, and diagnose data directly, so they can specify what engineering builds and verify that the result represents the business correctly. They are equally expected to lead three to four analysts, set the standards those analysts work to, and develop the team's technical capability. Data Engineering and the Snowflake team own ingestion, infrastructure, orchestration, transformation pipelines, and semantic view implementation. This role represents Marketing in the design of the data layer, writes the specifications those teams build against, and is accountable for ensuring the resulting data products correctly represent the business.
What you’ll bring to the role:
Business Data Architecture, Metric Definitions, and Context
Own Marketing's canonical metric definitions and the business logic the governed semantic layer implements, and arbitrate those definitions when marketing, finance, and reporting platforms disagree. Specify the semantic models for the most complex and cross-domain marketing use cases, and validate what the Snowflake team builds against that specification. Own the business data architecture for Marketing, defining the facts, dimensions, grain, relationships, hierarchies, and conformed dimensions that connect marketing, customer, product, transaction, and engagement data. Design analytical models that answer cross-domain questions spanning acquisition, engagement, conversion, certification, membership, renewal, and revenue. Write advanced SQL to profile data, validate sources, reconcile metrics, build reusable datasets, and investigate complex customer and business questions. Determine what unstructured content, such as business documentation, definitions, and prior analyses, must be retrievable alongside structured metrics for natural-language and agent-based analysis, and maintain source-to-metric mappings and lineage. Own the business questions, expected results, and synonym glossary behind the Verified Query Repository supporting Cortex Analyst and natural-language analytics. Own the context layer that makes Marketing's data interpretable to analysts and AI agents, including entity descriptions, metric documentation, approved analytical uses, and known limitations of each source. Diagnose discrepancies across Snowflake, BI, Adobe Analytics, marketing platforms, finance reporting, and operational systems. Identify gaps in source data, identity resolution, event structures, and dimensional consistency before they become downstream reporting issues. Define ownership boundaries between source systems, engineered data products, semantic models, and reporting layers.
Team Leadership and Capability
Lead, coach, and develop a team of three to four analysts spanning paid media, customer and lifecycle analytics, and digital analytics. Set the Marketing Analytics roadmap, allocate the team against it, and manage intake and prioritization from across Marketing. Establish and enforce analytical standards including SQL quality, peer review, testing, documentation, and reuse. Review the team's models, queries, and analyses before they reach stakeholders, and hold the quality bar for what gets published. Grow the team's depth in dimensional modeling, data modeling practice, and analytical rigor through direct coaching and review. Manage performance, hiring, and development planning for the team.
Marketing Measurement and Performance Analytics
Define and govern core marketing KPIs including revenue, conversion, CAC and CPA, ROAS, retention, funnel progression, pacing to plan, and channel efficiency. Own the integrity and narrative of recurring executive performance reporting, including monthly business reviews and QBR analytics, with the team producing the underlying analysis. Determine how platform-reported, attribution-based, financial, and incrementality-based measures reconcile, and establish where each is appropriately used. Lead attribution, cohort, and incrementality work so it produces decision-grade guidance on marketing investment, building the harder analyses directly. Own predictive modeling for Marketing, including membership churn and renewal propensity, certification lapse and recertification likelihood, and product and cross-sell propensity, alongside segmentation, lifecycle, and cohort analysis across CRM, web, campaign, commerce, certification, and membership data. Define the features, target definitions, validation approach, and performance thresholds for predictive models, determine when a score is reliable enough to act on, and establish how scores are refreshed, monitored for drift, and activated in campaign, lifecycle, and retention programs. Set analytical standards for A/B testing, holdouts, geo experiments, and conversion-lift studies within the marketing analytics practice, including hypotheses, test populations, success metrics, and readouts. Partner with Product and Marketing to define measurable funnels, customer states, lifecycle stages, and behavioral signals for considered-purchase journeys, and hold a clear distinction between attribution, correlation, prediction, and causal measurement when results are communicated.
Analytics Delivery and Enablement
Govern Marketing's analytical products in enterprise BI and visualization platforms, ensuring definitions are sourced from the semantic layer rather than rebuilt in the tool. Use Adobe Analytics to investigate digital behavior, traffic, customer journeys, and conversion performance, and work with data from Adobe Experience Platform, CRM, commerce, and paid media systems. Apply working knowledge of digital event instrumentation, tagging, identity, and schemas to identify measurement and architecture issues at the source, and establish where AI-assisted tooling is applied to SQL development, analysis, documentation, and testing. Expand governed self-service and AI-assisted analytics for Marketing across Snowflake, BI, and natural-language surfaces, and represent Marketing data and context requirements in the Marketing AI reference architecture. Define what Marketing data and context AI agents and natural-language tools are permitted to reach, at what grain, and under what access and accuracy controls, and own the evaluation approach that tests answer accuracy before release and monitors it as data and definitions change.
Cross-Functional Partnership
Serve as Marketing's primary analytical counterpart to Data Engineering, Data Architecture, and Data Governance. Translate business questions into analytical requirements and data-product specifications that engineering can build against. Partner with Data Engineering on transformation logic, data contracts, source integration, model design, and data-quality requirements. Partner with Performance Marketing, Brand, Digital, Product, Lifecycle, and Regional Marketing on measurement needs and analytical priorities. Present analytical findings, performance trends, and recommendations to senior leadership.
Scope of Role Leads a team of three to four analysts covering marketing, customer, and performance analytics, while personally designing analytical data models and validating them. Accountable for Marketing's business data architecture, metric definitions, context layer, predictive models, and executive performance reporting across certification, membership, e-learning, events, and other product lines. Hands-on ownership concentrates in data model design, metric reconciliation, predictive model validation, evaluation of analytical accuracy, and diagnosis of cross-system discrepancies. Semantic view implementation sits with the Snowflake team, built to this role's specification. Routine reporting, campaign analysis, and dashboard production sit with the team, under this role's review and standards. Data Engineering, Technology, and the Snowflake team own ingestion, infrastructure, orchestration, platform access, transformation pipelines, and semantic view implementation. Enterprise data governance policy, cataloging, and cross-domain stewardship sit outside this role; the incumbent partners with Data Governance and applies those standards within Marketing.
Role Qualifications:
10+ years across marketing analytics, customer analytics, analytics engineering, or related disciplines, including prior leadership of an analytics team. Demonstrated experience leading and developing an analytics team while remaining hands-on technically. Working knowledge of ETL and ELT concepts, transformation pipelines, data dependencies, and data-quality controls, with the ability to read, review, and challenge logic developed by engineering teams. Experience working within layered, dimensional, or medallion data architectures. Experience integrating and analyzing data across CRM, marketing, digital, commerce, and transactional systems. Development and governance of analytical products in an enterprise BI platform, preferred. Customer data platform architecture including identity resolution, event schema design, and audience activation. Marketing measurement including attribution, experimentation, incrementality, conversion, CAC and CPA, and ROAS, and experience directing or building predictive and propensity models such as churn or retention. Advanced SQL including complex joins, CTEs, window functions, transformations, data profiling, reconciliation, and validation, applied to large-scale datasets. Working hands-on experience with Snowflake or another modern cloud data platform, sufficient to profile, query, validate, and reconcile at scale. Demonstrated experience designing business and analytical data models, and specifying them for engineering teams to build against. Dimensional modeling including facts, dimensions, grain, cardinality, slowly changing dimensions, hierarchies, and conformed dimensions. Metric governance, lineage, and reconciliation across multiple enterprise systems. Strong analytical storytelling and executive communication. Familiarity with semantic layer and context technologies such as Snowflake Semantic Views, Cortex Analyst, Cortex Search, dbt Semantic Layer, or Looker, preferred. Digital analytics using an enterprise web analytics platform, preferred. dbt or comparable SQL transformation framework, preferred. Python or R for advanced analysis, automation, or modeling, preferred. Git and version-controlled analytics development, preferred. Data testing and observability frameworks, preferred. Marketing mix modeling, geo experimentation, conversion lift, causal-inference methods, and machine learning applied to churn, propensity, or lifetime value, preferred. Up to 10% if required.

remote.title: Analog Design Engineer (Graduate)
remote.description:
THE COMPANY
Established in early 2024, at Analogue Insight we are bridging the Analogue and Digital Worlds for Tomorrow through our Chiplet Solutions. Our core expertise lies in developing cutting-edge Chiplet technology that serves as the building block for advanced communication systems. Our Chiplets are designed to offer high performance, scalability, and integration flexibility, enabling our clients to achieve breakthroughs in computation speed, data processing, and connectivity. For more information about us, check out our website (Analogue Insight) and LinkedIn Page (Analogue Insight™: Overview | LinkedIn).

THE ROLE
We are seeking a talented and motivated Graduate Analog Design Engineer to join our team and contribute to the design of high-performance serial links and data converters for our chiplet solutions. Working alongside experienced analog designers, you will help design, simulate and verify ADC, DAC, RX, TX and PLL building blocks on advanced FinFET technology nodes, and see your work go into customer silicon. This role is well suited to recent graduates with a strong foundation in analog circuit design who want to learn fast through deep, hands-on work in a small, high-impact team.
Hiring Manager:Christian Borelli, Founder and CSO.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Analog & Mixed-Signal Block Design: Design and optimise sub-blocks of ADC, DAC, RX, TX and PLL circuits (e.g. amplifiers, comparators, bias circuits, references, clock buffers) under the guidance of senior designers.

- Simulation and Validation: Run transistor-level simulations (DC, AC, transient, noise, Monte Carlo and PVT corners) and mixed-signal verification using Cadence, AMS and SystemVerilog to confirm robust performance across operating conditions.

- Performance Optimisation: Learn and apply design techniques to improve key parameters such as gain, bandwidth, linearity, noise, jitter, power consumption and speed.

- Layout Collaboration: Work closely with layout engineers to communicate matching, symmetry and parasitic-sensitive nets, and run post-layout extracted simulations to close the design.

- Modelling & Scripting: Build behavioural models (e.g. Verilog-A) and scripts (e.g. Python, SKILL or OCEAN) to speed up simulation, analysis and design-check flows.

- Silicon Characterization Support: Help prepare test plans and support lab characterisation and debug of silicon as projects progress.

- Design Documentation: Document your designs, simulation results and design-review material clearly, supporting efficient knowledge sharing within the team.

- Technology Awareness: Keep learning about advances in high-speed SerDes, data converters and chiplet interfaces such as UCIe.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR
Must-have Technical skills:

- M.S. or Ph.D. in Electrical/Electronic Engineering or a related field, with a focus on analog/mixed-signal circuit design (recent graduates and those graduating within the next 6 months are welcome)

- 0–2 years of industry experience, including internships, placements or research projects

- Strong grasp of analog fundamentals: CMOS device physics, small-signal analysis, feedback and stability, noise, and mismatch

- Hands-on circuit design and simulation experience with Cadence Virtuoso/Spectre or similar tools, through coursework, thesis or internship projects

- Understanding of at least one of: data converters (ADC/DAC), PLLs/clocking, or high-speed TX/RX circuits

- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen eye for detail

Nice-to-have:

- Thesis, research or internship work on FinFET or other advanced-node technologies

- A completed tape-out and/or lab measurement experience

- Familiarity with Verilog/SystemVerilog, Verilog-A or AMS modelling

- Scripting experience (Python, MATLAB, SKILL or shell) and comfort in a Linux environment

- Publications or conference contributions in circuits (e.g. ISSCC, VLSI, CICC, ESSCIRC)

Soft & Professional Skills:

- Clear, structured communication in professional English—able to explain complex results concisely

- Collaborative and feedback-oriented mindset, open to learning from design reviews

- Strong ownership, reliability, and follow-through

- Curious, self-motivated attitude, eager to learn and explore new tools or methods

- High level of integrity and professionalism in representing the company and handling sensitive information.

OUR CULTURE
We’re a fully remote team of around 45 people distributed across the UK, Armenia, Italy, the US, Estonia, India, and beyond. We believe great talent is everywhere!

-
Our values are our north star:We Grow Together, We Win Together. Excellence Builds Relationships. Trust Is Our Currency. Results Matter, but People Create Them.

-
Connected, even remotely:We invest intentionally in staying connected through regular all-hands, 1:1s, technical reviews, and informal coffee chats, so collaboration feels natural and human despite the distance.

-
High ownership, real impact:Everyone contributes directly to customer-facing IP. Your work doesn’t disappear into layers of management – it ships.

-
How we work:We move fast but thoughtfully, communicate openly, and balance autonomy with support. Technical decisions are debated openly and grounded in data, trade-offs, and first-principles thinking.

WHY JOIN US

-
Remote-first flexibility – work from anywhere, with flexible hours

-
Equipment & setup – we’ll provide the tools you need to succeed

-
High-impact projects – design real analog IP used in customer silicon

-
Supportive team culture – a dedicated manager and a team of colleagues ready to help

-
Competitive, transparent compensation– adjusted for your location and engagement model

-
Learning & growth – AI–DLP sessions, technical deep dives, and peer-led knowledge sharing that build both technical depth and system-level perspective

RECRUITMENT PROCESS

-
Founder Call (30 min) – mutual introduction and interest alignment

-
Technical Interview(90 min) – fundamentals, reasoning, and problem-solving

-
Optional: Second Technical Interview (60 min) – another deep-dive into specific topics, which might include a presentation that we'll let you know about in advance

-
HR & Culture Call (45 min)–values, collaboration style, and ways of working

-
Offer & Next Steps– we send the offer and kick off the onboarding process.

Disclaimer: This is our standard process for most roles. For more senior, specialized, or higher-authority positions, we reserve the right to amend or tailor these steps as we see fit.

If you don’t meet every requirement but feel excited about the role, apply anyway. We value curiosity, integrity, and potential as much as experience.Originally posted on Himalayas

You will assess financing opportunities, evaluate institutional counterparties and structure transactions that balance commercial objectives with robust risk management. - Lead the credit assessment of borrowers (funds, miners, trading firms, corporates) from initial due diligence through transaction evaluation and approval recommendations.

- Counterparty due diligence experience, being able to effectively assess business models, ownership structures, operational capabilities and relevant risk factors.

- Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

- Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

remote.title: Scrum Master
remote.description:
Job Title: Scrum Master
Term: 12 months
Location: Nairobi, Kenya
Reports to: Technical Program Manager
Level: Intermediate/ Senior (4-8 years of relevant experience).
Key Responsibilities

- Facilitate and coordinate Scrum ceremonies (Daily Scrum, Sprint Planning, Sprint Review, Retrospective) with clear agendas, time-boxing, and documented outcomes (decisions, risks, actions, owners, due dates).

- Own and maintain the team's delivery metrics dashboard (sprint velocity, burndown/burnup, defect rates, cycle time, cumulative flow), surfacing trends and escalating concerns to the TPM.

- Actively identify, track, and remove constraints blocking squad members from delivering sprint goals; escalate cross-organizational blockers to the TPM within agreed SLAs.

- Coach squad members and relevant stakeholders on agile principles, Scrum practices, and delivery best practices, progressively building internal agile capability.

- Facilitate cross-squad coordination where multiple technical work streams (Backend, Frontend, API, Data) have interdependent sprint commitments.

- Support knowledge transfer by ensuring that process documentation, decision logs, and sprint artefacts are maintained in the agreed shared workspace.

- Report on delivery health metrics at fortnightly steering cadence, partnering with the TPM for programme-level reporting.

Measurable Outcomes & Deliverables
First 30 Days

- Attend all Scrum ceremonies and produce baseline assessment of ceremony health, compliance, and documentation gaps.

- Own the delivery metrics dashboard and report on velocity, burndown, defect rates, and cycle time and report any present gaps.

- Produce a cross-squad dependency register across Backend, Frontend, API, and Data workstreams.

- Confirm fortnightly steering cadence with the TPM and key stakeholders.

Days 31–60

- Sprint velocity stabilizing; at least two consecutive sprints with 80% sprint goal achievement.

- DoD compliance rate tracked and reported; 90% of completed stories meet DoD criteria.

- Backlog health confirmed: two sprints of stories refined and sprint-ready at all times.

- At least one agile coaching session delivered to client counterparts or junior squad members.

- Delivery metrics dashboard live and shared with TPM and stakeholders.

Days 61–90

- Retrospective improvement actions tracked; demonstrable improvement in at least two delivery metrics since sprint 1.

- Agile maturity assessment (informal) of squad completed; coaching plan for remaining engagement period produced.

- All sprint ceremonies running to time and rated as useful by squad members (informal pulse check).

- Knowledge transfer - one squad member or stakeholder who has visibly adopted improved Scrum practices through coaching

Ongoing KPIs

- Enable the squad to consistently achieve agreed sprint goals through effective planning and execution.

- Ensure stories meet the agreed Definition of Done before acceptance.

- Proactively identify, escalate, and facilitate resolution of delivery blockers and dependencies.

- Maintain a healthy, prioritized backlog that supports upcoming sprint planning and delivery.

- Drive continuous improvement by facilitating effective sprint ceremonies and retrospectives and ensuring agreed improvement actions are followed through.

Stakeholders & Ways of Working
Agile Ceremonies Owned: Sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives, backlog refinement.
Reporting Cadence:

- Fortnightly delivery health summary to TPM.

- Sprint metrics dashboard updated at end of each sprint.

- Ad-hoc impediment escalation to TPM as required.

Cross-Functional Touchpoints:

- All squad roles (API Engineer, Backend, Frontend, Data Scientist, UI/UX Designer).

- Product Owners and stakeholders attending sprint reviews.

- TPM for programme-level dependency and risk alignment.

Required Skills & Experience

- 4–8 years of experience in Scrum Master or agile delivery roles, with at least 2 years in technology delivery environments.

- Certified Scrum Master (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), or equivalent certification required.

- Proven ability to facilitate agile ceremonies for cross-functional technical teams, including engineers, data scientists, and designers.

- Experience tracking and improving delivery metrics (velocity, cycle time, burndown, DoD compliance).

- Strong coaching and facilitation skills; ability to work with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- Demonstrated ability to identify and remove impediments at both team and organizational level.

- Experience working in embedded client-side or consulting delivery contexts preferred.

- Familiarity with backlog management tools (Jira, Azure DevOps, or equivalent).

- Understanding software development lifecycle (SDLC), including testing, integration, and release processes.

Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills

- SAFe Agilist or equivalent scaled agile certification.

- Experience in fintech, payments, or mobile money delivery environments.

- Familiarity with Kanban or hybrid Scrum/Kanban delivery models.

- Prior experience embedding within a client organisation in a consulting or secondment capacity.

- Experience facilitating agile transformations or team capability-building programmes.

- Exposure to API integration, backend, or data science delivery workstreams.

Tools & Technologies

- Backlog and sprint management: Jira / Azure DevOps / equivalent

- Documentation and knowledge base: Confluence / SharePoint

- Communication: Microsoft Teams

- Metrics and reporting: Jira dashboards / Excel / Azure DevOps dashboards

- Retrospective facilitation: Miro or equivalent

- Collaboration: Miro / Mural / equivalent virtual whiteboard

remote.title: Co-Founder & CEO - AI Native Recruiting Firm
remote.description:
The Opportunity
FutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to lead Foundry, an AI-Native Recruiting Agency currently in build at FutureSight. This is a co-founder partnership with meaningful founder equity, not a salaried executive role.
Recruiting has run on the same model for decades: firms charge a fixed percentage of a hire's first-year salary for work that is largely manual, sourcing, screening, and outreach done one candidate at a time. That pricing made sense when the work required a person doing it by hand. It doesn't anymore.
Market Context
Foundry is an AI-native recruiting firm built around a simple idea: use AI agents to handle sourcing, screening, and candidate evaluation, and keep a small human team focused on what still requires a person: building trust with clients and candidates, exercising judgment on close calls, and closing the placement. That shift in who does the work lets us offer clients a fee that's a fraction of what traditional firms charge, without cutting corners on quality.
This is where we believe recruiting is headed. AI-native service firms are starting to emerge and prove the model works, and we're building toward that shift deliberately.
About FutureSight

FutureSight is a leading venture builder that co-creates world-class software companies with values-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale.
You’ll co-create with a proven studio team, led by John Carbrey (4x entrepreneur, $100M ARR), Krista LaRiviere (3x exited, E&Y Top Women Entrepreneur), Alan Smith (Strategyzer co-founder, $120M in products built), Prathna Ramesh (former MD of Maple Leaf Angels, $275M in follow-on capital), and Johnny Tong (0-to-1 builder, acquired by SAP and Stripe) bring a rare combination of operator exits, institutional investing, and AI product depth.
The Partnership

- Founder equity with meaningful ownership from inception

- Pre-seed capital committed by FutureSight for early hires and MVP development, with potential for follow-on funding

- Venture building resources, including embedded design, engineering, growth, and fundraising support from day one

- Investor and advisor network across vertical AI and early-stage capital markets

- A true co-creation model in which you operate as CEO with FutureSight's cross-functional team as your partner

What you'll own
As Co-Founder & CEO, you will set the venture's direction and lead its execution.

- Strategy — Refine the ICP, pricing model, and product positioning

- Customer Development — Lead pilot placements with design-partner companies, convert them to paid retained relationships, and build the go-to-market motion

- Product — Partner with the FutureSight product and engineering team to ship V1 and iterate on user feedback

- Capital — Lead the seed raise, supported by FutureSight's network and traction

- Team — Recruit and lead the founding team, and establish the cultural foundation of the company

Co-Founder Profile

- Previous founding experience at a venture-backed company

- Demonstrated success in B2B AI or B2B SaaS go-to-market, including consultative, relationship-driven sales and customer engagement

- Fundraising fluency, with the ability to develop investor narratives and close capital

- Proven ability to attract, develop, and retain top talent

- Clear-eyed understanding of the risks and demands of co-founding a venture-backed company

- Deep domain expertise in recruiting, staffing, or talent acquisition, as a builder operator or agency leader

How to Apply
Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.
FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.

remote.description:
Job Title: Senior Health Data Operations Analyst - Compass
Job Location: New York City, NY
Job Location Type: Remote
Job Contract Type: Full-time
Job Seniority Level:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.
The Role
As a Senior Health Data Analyst, you will focus on analyzing health data within the Veeva Compass product suite. Veeva Compass delivers record-level prescription and medical claims data to power longitudinal, de-identified patient analytics for commercial use cases—including patient journey, market landscape, and provider engagement.
You will be responsible for driving data quality, consistency, and standardization within the Terminology Reference Library (TRL) by managing reference data for key attributes found across prescription and medical claims—including drug information, ICD-10 diagnosis codes, procedure and lab codes, as well as payer and plan data. In this role, you will query prescription and medical claims datasets to support the evaluation and integration of new inbound data sources into core schemas. Additionally, you will define and track key quality metrics via interactive dashboards, contributing to technical documentation and validation reports to ensure our reference data remains accurate, scalable, and seamlessly integrated across all Veeva products.
What You’ll Do

- Drive TRL Governance: Maintain and expand the Terminology Reference Library (TRL), managing core reference datasets across prescription and medical claims (including drug information, ICD-10 codes, procedure/lab codes, and payer/plan data).

- Evaluate & Integrate New Data: Conduct deep-dive data querying, field mapping, and structural analysis on potential new data sources to evaluate fit and integrate them into existing core schemas.

- Execute Quality & Cleansing Workflows: Perform exploratory data analysis to identify discrepancies, handle missing values, execute deduplication, and ensure data completeness, accuracy, and timeliness.

- Continuous Product Improvement: Investigate data anomalies within the Veeva Compass product suite, testing both planned and unplanned data changes to assess downstream customer impact.

- Build Metrics & Documentation: Develop interactive dashboards to track key data quality metrics, contributing to technical documentation, validation reports, and team process improvements.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Data Scientists, Product Managers, and Developers to articulate data quality nuances, uncover root causes, and build robust data pipelines.

Requirements

- 4+ years of experience analyzing record-level prescription and medical claims datasets.

- 4+ years of experience in health data quality analysis, data profiling, and data governance principles.

- Advanced SQL proficiency, with extensive experience querying, manipulating, and aggregating large-scale relational databases.

- Deep working knowledge of healthcare code sets and industry standards, including NDC, ICD-10, CPT/HCPCS, LOINC, and payer/plan reference data.

- Proven track record in data storytelling: Experience analyzing, visualizing, and demonstrating data quality findings to stakeholders using Excel, BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Sigma), or interactive dashboards.

- Strong problem-solving mindset: Eagerness to dive deep into complex, unstructured healthcare data issues, identify root causes, and propose innovative solutions.

- Bachelor’s degree in a STEM, quantitative, or healthcare informatics field, or equivalent practical experience

Nice to Have

- Experience in Python

- Experience with the BI tool Sigma

- Experience in life science industry

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

- Follow the application process and submit your resume.

- Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.

- Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.

- If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:

- A conversation with the hiring manager

- A practical case exercise

- A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.

- Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

- The judgment and presence to lead substantive conversations with Quality, Manufacturing, Qualified Person or release, IT, and executive stakeholders

- Working knowledge of SAP or another ERP platform and several of manufacturing execution, laboratory, quality, document, and integration systems

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to turn complex processes into clear recommendations and reusable field material

- Ability to travel within Europe and occasionally globally for customer meetings, internal workshops, and industry events

Nice to Have

- Experience with SAP Batch Release Hub, TrackWise, Veeva Vault Quality, or comparable manufacturing and quality platforms

- Relationships with European systems integrators, consultancies, advisory firms, or organizations such as ISPE; or experience with external or contract manufacturing networks where release evidence crosses company and system boundaries

Overview:
Centessa Pharmaceuticals, a wholly owned subsidiary of Eli Lilly and Company,is a clinical-stage company developing orexin receptor 2 (OX2R) agonists as a new class of medicines for the treatment of narcolepsy and potentially other sleep-wake disorders. Centessa’s lead investigational candidate – cleminorexton (formerly ORX750) – is being developed for narcolepsy type 1, narcolepsy type 2, and idiopathic hypersomnia. Centessa's OX2R agonist portfolio includes additional clinical and preclinical-stage assets with potential utility across a broader range of neurological, neurodegenerative, and neuropsychiatric conditions. Headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, Centessa was recognized as aGreat Place to Work® in 2026.
Position Summary:
We are seeking an experienced, collaborative, and scientifically rigorous contributor (at the Associate Director level) to provide scientific leadership for molecular pharmacology activities supporting neuroscience discovery and development programs. The successful candidate will bring a strong foundation in pharmacology and apply broad scientific expertise to address questions related to compound pharmacology, receptor and target biology, signaling mechanisms, and translation across relevant experimental systems.
The ideal candidate will combine deep scientific expertise with curiosity, strategic thinking, and the ability to identify and implement experimental approaches that address evolving program needs. The individual will work collaboratively across multidisciplinary teams and with internal and external scientific partners to develop pharmacology strategies, guide experimental work, interpret complex data, and advance therapeutic programs.
