remote.title: Data Product Analyst (Data Science)
remote.description:
Overview
Adastra is seeking a Data Product Analyst (Data Science) to serve as a critical bridge between business stakeholders, data science and analytics teams, and data management groups. This role combines strong data analysis and data science capabilities with core business analysis skills to ensure that data is effectively leveraged to inform strategic decision making, improve processes, and influence solution design.
You will frame business problems as analytical and modeling questions, apply statistical and machine learning methods to answer them, and translate the results into clear, actionable recommendations. In addition to championing data stewardship, the Data Product Analyst plays a key role in eliciting requirements, documenting business processes, and facilitating alignment across technical and business teams.
Primary Location: Across Canada
Work Model: Fully Remote
Employment Type: Contractor
Vacancy Status: New
RESPONSIBILITIES

- Act as the Data Subject Matter Expert to stakeholders with an understanding of data across the end-to-end data supply chain

- Translate business problems into well-scoped analytical and data science use cases, working with stakeholders and technical leads to define requirements, success metrics, and approach

- Collect, clean, and analyze data from multiple structured and unstructured sources to uncover trends, patterns, and actionable insights

- Apply statistical analysis and experimentation (e.g., A/B testing) and develop predictive and descriptive models (e.g., segmentation, classification, forecasting, anomaly detection) in partnership with data science and engineering teams, evaluating performance with attention to bias, data leakage, and overfitting

- Translate analytical and modeling findings into clear, business-friendly insights

- Elicit, document, and manage business, functional, and non-functional requirements through techniques such as interviews, workshops, process analysis, and user story creation

- Support prioritization by assessing business value, impacts, complexity, and risk, and ensure traceability of requirements from intake through development, testing, and deployment

- Collaborate with data engineers, architects, data scientists, and MLOps teams to ensure solutions reflect business context and use cases, and to move analytical work from prototype toward production

- Define testing acceptance criteria, support user validation, and provide structured feedback for continuous improvement

- Monitor and enhance data quality through profiling, validation, remediation, and alignment with organizational priorities

QUALIFICATIONS, SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

- Bachelor’s degree in information systems, business analysis, statistics, computer science, data science, or related fields

- 2-5 years of experience in data analysis, data science, business analysis, product analytics, or similar roles

- Skilled at requirements elicitation, process mapping, and translating business needs into technical specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, and high-quality documentation

- Strong understanding of data stewardship principles, including data quality, lineage, metadata management, and responsible data use, and the ability to adapt these skills across a wide range of use cases

- Comfortable connecting data across multiple systems and enriching datasets to enable new insights for business stakeholders

- Excellent communication, with the ability to tailor messages for both technical teams (engineering, data science) and business stakeholders, including explaining model approaches and trade-offs

- Champions a consumer-first mindset, grounding product, data, and insights decisions in a deep understanding of consumer behaviors and needs

- Collaborative mindset with the ability to influence without authority, navigate ambiguity, and drive alignment across cross-functional teams

- Naturally curious and a strong critical thinker, with a passion for exploring new data sources and solving problems with incomplete, messy, or evolving datasets

- Strong analytical toolkit leveraging SQL, Python (e.g., pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn), and BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) to explore, transform, model, and validate complex datasets

- Solid grounding in statistics, model evaluation, and validation practices, with working knowledge of machine learning methods (e.g., regression, tree-based models, time-series forecasting) and exposure to generative AI and LLM-based tooling

- Working knowledge of data modeling, ETL/ELT pipelines, and cloud data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, AWS) to support reliable data products, along with Git-based version control

- Proven ability to work effectively in cross-functional environments and support the delivery of data products, including analytical and ML-driven products, that serve multiple stakeholders

NICE TO HAVE

- Master’s degree in a quantitative field

- Experience building and evaluating machine learning models

- Familiarity with experimentation design, responsible AI, and model explainability

ABOUT ADASTRA
Adastra is a global leader in AI and data-driven transformation, helping organizations lead with artificial intelligence—responsibly, strategically, and at scale. With over 25 years of experience, Adastra empowers enterprise clients to unlock business value through data innovation, operational excellence, and smart customer engagement.
Trusted by some of the world’s most prominent brands, Adastra delivers end-to-end solutions grounded in thoughtful strategy, robust governance, and deep technical expertise. From defining vision to ensuring execution, Adastra guides organizations through every stage of their AI, data and cloud journey—building future-ready capabilities and delivering measurable, lasting impact.
Adastra serves clients across key industries including financial services, automotive, manufacturing, technology, media and telecom (TMT), healthcare, retail, and professional services. The company employs more than 2,000 professionals across North America, Europe, and Asia.
WHAT WE OFFER

- Opportunity for advancement and career progression

- Competitive compensation

- Successful referral program

- The opportunity to work with one of Canada’s 50 Best Managed Companies

- Satisfaction of working for a reputable company

- A flexible, dynamic, and diverse workplace

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER
In our commitment to promote fair and equitable treatment of all employees and applicants, Adastra Corporation provides equal employment opportunities for all individuals regardless of age, sex, disability, race, ethnic origin, citizenship, creed, sexual orientation, marital status, or any other ground as described in the Ontario Human Rights Code. In addition, accommodation will be provided during the hiring process. Adastra Corporation’s implementation and support of employment initiatives, encourage diversified labour force participation and equal access to opportunities based on merit and performance.
AI Usage - Our hiring process includes the use of AI-enabled tools to screen applications (e.g., keyword matching, qualification ranking). A human recruiter reviews all AI-generated shortlists to make informed hiring decisions.
There has been an increased instance of fraudulent job offers coming from people posing as Adastra HR employees. Please note that Adastra will never request fees as part of our recruiting process and any emails sent to you that are not from ‘@adastragrp.com’ or ‘@talent.icims.com’ are fraudulent. All employment offers are sent via DocuSign and if you receive an employment offer from a suspicious email and not via DocuSign, it is fraudulent.
Contact to inquire about jobs at Adastra, to report a suspicious request for money or personal information from external websites or suspicious employment offers.

remote.title: Technical Product Manager - AI Investing
remote.description:
About BJAK
The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
The Role
BJAK is building a AI Investing Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.
These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.
The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.
We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.
What You'll Own

- Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

- Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

- Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

- Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

- Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

- Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

- Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

- 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

- Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

- Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

- Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

- Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

- Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

- Engineering or highly technical product background.

- Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

- Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

- Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

- Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

- Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

- AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

- Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

- Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location
This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.
Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.
Language
English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
Interview Process
Our process is designed to move fast:

- Online assessment or practical task

- Technical interview

- CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

remote.title: Initiative Support Associate, Consulting
remote.description:
Hiring at NFF includes a multi-step selection process. We do not make job offers through third-party job search tools such as LinkedIn. NFF will never ask for payment of any kind during the process. We encourage all job seekers to remain vigilant throughout their job search and verify the source of any recruitment-related communication, as individuals may attempt to impersonate organizations.
Applications closed on August 24, 2026. If you submitted an application after August 24, we will consider your application if we need additional candidates.
Position Reports to: Senior Director, Consulting
Department: Consulting
Location: US-based remote, with a strong preference for candidates within commutable distance to one of NFF’s Offices (Boston, New York, Philadelphia, Oakland, and Los Angeles)
Salary Range: $66,000 - $70,200
About Nonprofit Finance Fund
Nonprofit Finance Fund® (NFF®) is a nonprofit lender, consultant, and advocate.Since 1980, we’ve helped organizations access the money and resources they need to realize their communities’ aspirations. Alongside others, we’re working to build community wealth and well-being and put affordable housing, essential services, quality jobs, and excellent education within reach of more people. To learn more, visit nff.org. Learn more about our work to achieve our vision through our Theory of Change and Values.
About the Role
NFF’s Consulting team works with nonprofit organizations, funders, coalitions, networks and other mission-driven partners to support capacity building and financial sustainability. The team partners with nonprofit leaders navigating growth, change, and systemic challenges by providing strategic advice, financial analysis, and capacity-building support. Through customized consulting engagements nationwide, NFF helps organizations strengthen their capacity, sustainability, and impact.
NFF seeks an Initiative Support Associate to strengthen project execution operational effectiveness and client service delivery within the Consulting Department. The Associate will partner closely with consulting staff to coordinate projects and initiatives, maintain accurate project information, track progress against key milestones, and support the operational processes that underpin high quality consulting engagements. While this role is grounded in project coordination and department operations, the Associate will work across teams to facilitate communication, organize information, support compliance and invoicing requirements, and ensure critical project data and documentation remain current and accessible. The Associate will also assist with the review and analysis of client materials, including financial statements and impact data, helping project teams effectively manage information and advance client engagements.
NFF has offices in Boston, New York, Philadelphia, Oakland, and Los Angeles. This is a US-based remote role, with a strong preference for candidates within commutable distance to one of NFF’s offices. NFF has core business hours where we expect all staff to be available from 9:00 am to 5:00 pm local time, and occasional travel (20%) is required.
What You Will Do
Essential responsibilities for this role include, but are not limited to:
Project Coordination & Execution Support (40%)

- Coordinate project logistics and maintain project plans, action item trackers, timelines, deliverables, and other tools that support effective project execution

- Support client-facing administrative processes, including report timelines, invoicing and billing, tracking re-grant disbursements, and coordinating documentation with internal and external partners

- Prepare meeting materials, agendas, notes, and follow-up communications

- Monitor assigned tasks and proactively communicate progress, risks, and support needs

- Contribute to high quality client deliverables, including PowerPoint presentations, engagement letters, research reports, and workshop/training curriculum

- Identify opportunities for improvements; recommend policy or process changes as appropriate

Research, Analysis & Deliverable Development (25%)

- Update and maintain Salesforce data, ensuring financial, impact, and project records are accurate, organized, and current

- Conduct research and gather information from a variety of sources to support consulting engagements

- Compile, organize, and analyze quantitative and qualitative data

- Support the development of presentations, reports, summaries, and other client-facing deliverables

- Synthesize information into clear findings, observations, and recommendations

- Review work products for accuracy, consistency, and completeness prior to delivery

Knowledge Management & Continuous Learning (15%)

- Identify recurring themes, trends, and insights across projects, clients, and engagements

- Contribute to development and maintenance of tools, templates, resources, and knowledge repositories

- Support efforts to capture lessons learned and effective practices from consulting engagements

- Share observations and emerging insights that may strengthen future project design and delivery

Client & Team Support (10%)

- Collaborate effectively with colleagues across projects to support successful engagement outcomes

- Participate in client and internal meetings, contributing notes, follow-up actions, and logistical support

- Lead event logistics and support the delivery of client-facing workshops, training sessions, and convenings, including scheduling, participant coordination, materials preparation, and virtual or in-person execution

- Build positive working relationships with clients, partners, and colleagues

- Seek feedback, clarification, and guidance to ensure alignment with project goals and expectations.

- Contribute to a collaborative, inclusive, and solutions-oriented team environment

Meetings and Other Duties as Assigned (10%)

- Participate in department, team, and organizational meetings

- Engage in professional development and learning opportunities

- Support special projects, initiatives, and organizational priorities as assigned

- Contribute to NFF as a learning organization that seeks to advance the sector

- Perform other duties consistent with the scope and level of the position

Who You Are and Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution or equivalent combinations of relevant education, training, and experience

- One (1) year of professional work experience

- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and maintain strong attention to detail

- Strong written and verbal communication skills

- Demonstrated analytical, research, and problem-solving skills

- Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook

- Ability to work effectively both independently and collaboratively within a team environment

The Strongest Candidates Will

- Be committed to NFF’s values, mission, and approach to community impact

- Bring experience in nonprofit, public sector, consulting, financial services, or related environments

- Understand or be eager to learn about CDFIs and community-centered finance

- Build strong, trust-based relationships and collaborate effectively across teams, geographies, and perspectives in a highly matrixed organization

- Be able to work with large amounts of data to independently create reports and presentations

- Work independently, communicate proactively, and take ownership of outcomes

- Demonstrate curiosity and a commitment to continuous learning and professional growth

- Thrive in a dynamic, mission-driven environment where priorities evolve and ambiguity is common

Benefits and Compensation
NFF offers a generous benefits package that currently includes up to twenty (20) paid holidays/business closure days, three (3) floating holidays, flexible time off, group medical insurance with a funded health reimbursement account, dental and vision plans, life insurance and disability plans, a retirement plan with both a non-elective employer contribution (4%) and additional match contribution (up to 2%), a “work from home” fund, and flexible spending accounts to cover health, dependent care, and commuter costs.
This is a full-time role with a compensation range of $66,000 - $70,200. A compensation offer is based on a candidate’s background and years of relevant experience, with consideration for internal equity. Because of our strong commitment to equity and growth, we do not negotiate compensation offers.

- Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

Content designers and contracted writers produce the material; you decide whether it is good enough, explain why when it is not, and raise the team's capability over time. You will work closely with the PSSP Lead and the content team across Quest, Quest Ascend and Quest Launchpad.KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Own the final editorial review and approval of all learner-facing content across Quest, Quest Ascend and Quest Launchpad before it is published.

- Set and maintain the content standards covering learning outcomes, voice, reading level, format-specific word limits, factual accuracy and cultural relevance; document them as a style guide the team works to.

- Verify that content intended for AI scoring is structured so that automated evaluation returns accurate, specific and useful feedback to learners.

- Coach the Content Designer, Content Owner and contracted writers through structured feedback that improves the writer, not only the piece in front of you.

- Validate the accuracy of post-school, university-application and careers guidance against current requirements in Kenya and the other markets we serve.

- Run a predictable review cadence with agreed turnaround times and clear approve-or-revise decisions, so that review never becomes the bottleneck in the content pipeline.

- Audit published content periodically against learner completion data and feedback, and commission revisions where the evidence shows it is not working.

- Advise the PSSP Lead on content strategy, sequencing and gaps across both products, and flag risks to quality early.

REQUIRED SKILLS

- Senior experience in curriculum leadership, instructional design or editorial direction for education products, with a track record of setting standards that others work to.

- Deep understanding of pedagogy, learning progression and assessment design, with the judgement to tell genuinely good content from content that merely looks finished.

- Demonstrated experience reviewing and approving the work of others at volume, with feedback that is specific, actionable and developmental.

- Excellent command of written English, editorial precision, and the discipline to hold a defined house style consistently across many contributors.

- Familiarity with digital and blended learning formats, and a practical sense of how content behaves differently on a mobile product than on a page.

- Ability to work independently and remotely, managing a review queue to agreed turnaround times without day-to-day supervision.

CORE SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES

Nice-to-haves

- Experience in post-school transition, university applications, careers guidance or entrepreneurship education.

- Experience reviewing AI-generated or AI-assisted learning content, with the judgement to see where automation helps and where it quietly degrades quality.

- Working knowledge of the Kenyan secondary and tertiary landscape, including CBE pathways, KCSE and university placement.

SUCCESS MEASURES

- All learner-facing content is reviewed and approved against a documented standard before publication.

- A content style guide exists, is kept current, and the team works to it without needing individual direction on every piece.

- Review turnaround keeps pace with production, so content ships on schedule and the pipeline does not stall at approval.

- Content quality is visible in learner completion and feedback, and revisions can be traced to that evidence.

ADDITIONAL SKILLS AND REQUIREMENTS

- Excellent communication, attention to detail and a collaborative approach to working with content designers, programme staff and product teams.

- Commitment to youth safeguarding, learner privacy, accessible learning and the responsible use of AI.

- Alignment with Nova Pioneer's mission to develop the next generation of African innovators and leaders.

PUR Description
PUR is a global, impact-focused B-Corp specializing in the development of environmental restoration projects, known as ‘nature-based solutions’ (NbS). Since 2008, we have been helping the world’s largest organizations meet their ESG targets, reduce their environmental footprint, and regenerate the ecosystems they depend on across complex supply chains. Having developed over 45 projects in more than 30 countries, PUR is recognized as both a pioneer and leader in a sector that is now at the forefront of global efforts to address the ongoing climate and biodiversity crisis.
At the heart of our mission is a commitment to fostering and operationalizing insetting strategies—interventions by companies within their own value chains designed to reduce GHG emissions while creating positive impacts for communities, landscapes, and ecosystems. By championing this insetting approach, we aim to create a holistic range of benefits that extend beyond ecological restoration, encompassing social and economic dimensions through enhanced agricultural yields and resilience to climate change-induced stresses, among others.
One of the distinctive features of our work is our ability to tailor projects to the specific needs of different regions and communities. By recognizing the unique characteristics of each ecosystem and the cultural context of the communities involved, we ensure our initiatives are contextually relevant and have a meaningful and sustainable impact. All our projects are developed in close collaboration with local actors, including cooperatives, NGOs, governments, and corporations. Today, we employ 200 staff across 16 countries with key offices in Paris (HQ) and Toronto.
Thamma Raksa Project | PUR

PUR is looking for an experienced Sustainable Forest Management Consultant to support the development of a comprehensive Sustainable Forest Management Plan (SFMP) for the Thamma Raksa Project in Isaan, Thailand.
The project focuses on agroforestry and small-scale forest plantations across several provinces in Northeast Thailand. The consultant will develop practical forest management, selective harvesting, post-harvesting and farmer training approaches that support long-term forest health, carbon storage and farmer needs.
About the Assignment
The main objective of this consultancy is to develop a practical and comprehensive Sustainable Forest Management Plan aligned with:

- Verified Carbon Standard (VCS) Version 5.0

- VM0047

- ABACUS Label

- Symbiosis Quality Criteria

The plan will cover different planting models, tree species and ecological and socio-economic contexts across Isaan, Thailand.
Key Responsibilities
The consultant will be responsible for:

- Developing the Sustainable Forest Management Plan for the Thamma Raksa project.

- Developing appropriate maintenance practices, including pruning, thinning, weeding and pest management.

- Developing guidelines for selective harvesting, including tree selection, harvesting volumes, timing and methods.

- Conducting tree growth, biomass and harvesting analysis to support harvesting schedules and carbon-stock projections.

- Developing recommendations for post-harvesting management, replanting and natural regeneration.

- Considering Thailand's forestry regulations, land tenure and socio-economic context.

- Developing a practical monitoring, reporting and verification (MRV) framework.

- Supporting farmer engagement and developing practical training materials.

- Translating technical recommendations into practical guidance for farmers and field implementation partners.

Key Deliverables
The consultancy will include:

- Sustainable Forest Management Plan – English, Word and PDF

- Farmer-friendly summaries – English and Thai

- Harvesting Schedule & Biomass Growth Impact Dataset – Excel

-
Farmer Training Modules covering:

- Site maintenance

- Selective harvesting

- Post-harvesting activities

For the detail, please refer to this Term of Reference (ToR)
Requirements
Required Qualifications & Experience
We are looking for a consultant with:

- Bachelor's degree or higher in Forestry, Agroforestry or a related field.

- Minimum 5 years of demonstrated experience developing forest management plans, particularly for small-scale and/or community-based forestry projects.

- Professional experience in Thailand or Southeast Asia in forestry, agroforestry or natural resource management.

- Experience working on carbon projects, particularly Verra/VCS, Gold Standard or similar standards.

- Familiarity with Thailand's forestry policies, land tenure systems and socio-economic context.

- Experience with stakeholder engagement and participatory planning.

- Strong experience in selective harvesting, harvesting volume estimation and tree growth analysis.

- Strong analytical and report-writing skills.

- Ability to work independently and meet tight deadlines.

remote.title: Support & QA Specialist, Tax
remote.description:
This role is fully remote, open to candidates based anywhere in the United States outside New York, with a preference for the Pacific or Mountain time zones. Based in New York? Apply to the New York posting of this role instead.
A Different Kind Of Job Description
At Filed, we believe in radical transparency. Everything is open: company finances, team salaries, stock options, anonymous team feedback. That extends to how we talk about this job. So instead of a list of perks, we'll start with what's genuinely hard about it, then tell you why it might be the best move you'll make.
What's hard about this job
Bugs don't arrive with instructions. A customer tells you "it didn't work." Your job is to work out exactly what they did, with which return, in which tax software, and make it happen again on your own screen. If you can't reproduce it, engineering can't fix it.
Your ticket is the fix's starting point. Engineers will build from what you write. Vague steps mean days of back and forth while a firm waits. You'll need to be precise every time.
The pace is fast. Our customers are tax firms in their busiest weeks. When something breaks, they need an answer today, and a workaround while the real fix is built.
It isn't fixed until you've checked. You'll retest every fix before telling a customer it's resolved, and you'll recheck after releases that nothing else broke.
Why it might be the best career move you'll make
You'll sit between customers and engineering. Few roles see both sides this clearly. You'll learn how real firms use tax software, and how software actually gets built.
Your work ships. A bug you reproduce on Monday becomes a fix every firm on Filed benefits from. A workaround you find saves a firm hours the same day.
You'll grow as fast as we do. Filed is adding millions of dollars of revenue every quarter, and the support and QA function is still small. People who start here move into QA, product and engineering-adjacent roles.
We've raised $17.2 million to date, led by Northzone, and we work with tax firms across the country, from regional practices to some of the biggest names in the profession.
What You'll Own

- Reproducing customer-reported issues step by step, inside Filed and the tax software firms already use

- Writing clear, complete Linear tickets with exact steps, expected versus actual results, screenshots and sample data, so engineers can act straight away

- Answering customer tickets quickly and clearly in our support inbox

- Troubleshooting technical issues and finding workarounds that keep firms moving

- Verifying fixes before they go back to the customer, and regression testing after releases

- Spotting patterns across tickets and flagging them before they spread

Your Hard Skillset

- Hands-on QA or software testing experience: you've reproduced bugs and written them up for an engineering team

- Customer support experience in a ticketing system such as Pylon, Zendesk, Intercom or Freshdesk

- A tax background, either at a tax or accounting firm, at a tax software company, or preparing returns yourself. You don't need to be a preparer, but you should know your way around a return.

- Familiarity with at least one major tax platform, such as CCH Axcess, UltraTax, Lacerte, ProConnect, Drake or GoSystem

- Bonus if you've used Linear or Jira, browser developer tools or screen recording to capture issues

Your Soft Skillset

- Methodical: you change one thing at a time until you find what breaks

- Clear writing: your tickets and replies leave no room for confusion

- Curious: you want to know why something broke, not just that it did

- Calm and patient with customers who are under deadline pressure

- You take ownership and follow a problem through to the fix

Who This Suits

- People who enjoy hunting down a problem more than answering the same question twice

- Support professionals who want to move into QA and product

- Tax professionals who want to move into tech without leaving their expertise behind

How We Pay
Nothing at Filed is behind closed doors. Everyone sees everyone else's salary, and compensation isn't a negotiation. Depending on your location, everyone at the same level receives the same three offers.
This role is assessed at Level 1. The salary and equity bandings are:

- Most Equity: $66,000 per year + $100,020 of equity

- Great Equity: $72,000 per year + $66,680 of equity

- Good Equity: $78,000 per year + $33,340 of equity

We run performance reviews every four months, so strong work is recognized quickly.
Benefits

- Platinum-level medical insurance, fully covered for you, with 100% coverage for your dependents as well

- Dental insurance

- Vision insurance

- 401(k) retirement plan

- Paid maternity and paternity leave

- A minimum of 30 days of paid holiday every year

- Your choice of the latest and greatest computers, plus a budget for your home office setup

- Company-wide offsites every four months

The process

- Quick intro call (30 minutes)

- Bug reproduction exercise: we give you a real-style customer report, you reproduce the issue and write the ticket (60 minutes)

- Final round with Rachel and the team (60 minutes)

About Filed

Filed is the AI tax preparer trusted by America's accounting firms. It works inside the software firms already use, and takes on the work surrounding the accountant so tax professionals can spend their time on judgment, advice and their clients. We're backed by Northzone, Neo, Analog and Raine.

remote.title: Co-Founder & CEO — AI-Native Residential Appraisals for Mortgage Lenders
remote.description:
The Opportunity
FutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to leadComparo, an AI-native residential appraisal venture. This is a co-founder partnership with meaningful founder equity, not a salaried executive role.
Comparois an AI-native residential appraisal firm built for independent mortgage banks and private lenders. Today, a lender waits 5 to 10 days for an appraisal that takes under an hour of real analytical work. Comparo collapses that to 24 hours. Homeowners or data collectors capture the property with a phone scan, AI selects comparables, runs adjustments and drafts the full report, and a licensed appraiser reviews and signs. Comparo sells the finished, UAD 3.6-compliant appraisal rather than software, so it owns the workflow end to end and captures the full per-report fee. The same engine extends to tax appeals, insurance, estate valuations and continuous portfolio revaluation for lenders and mortgage-backed asset holders.
Market Context
The US residential appraisal industry is an $8.8-11.4B market, with roughly 5 million appraisals completed each year at $400-700 per report. Mortgage appraisals ordered by independent mortgage banks and private lenders represent a $1.5-2.1B serviceable market. The timing is sharp: UAD 3.6 becomes mandatory on November 2, 2026, expanding each report from roughly 700 to 3,600 data fields, while an aging workforce of 75,000–80,000 licensed appraisers shrinks.
About FutureSight

FutureSight is a leading venture builder that co-creates world-class software companies with values-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale.
You’ll co-create with a proven venture building team, led by John Carbrey (4x entrepreneur, $100M ARR), Krista LaRiviere (3x exited, E&Y Top Women Entrepreneur), Alan Smith (Strategyzer co-founder, $120M in products built), Prathna Ramesh (former MD of Maple Leaf Angels, $275M in follow-on capital), and Johnny Tong (0-to-1 builder, acquired by SAP and Stripe) bring a rare combination of operator exits, institutional investing, and AI product depth.
The Partnership

- Founder equity with meaningful ownership from inception

- Pre-seed capital committed by FutureSight for early hires and MVP development, with potential for follow-on funding

- Venture building resources, including embedded design, engineering, growth, and fundraising support from day one

- Investor and advisor network across fintech, proptech and early-stage capital markets

- A true co-creation model in which you operate as CEO with FutureSight’s cross-functional team as your partner

What You’ll Own
As Co-Founder & CEO, you will set the venture's direction and lead execution.

- Strategy — Refine the ICP, pricing model, and product positioning

- Customer Development — Lead pilots with independent mortgage banks and private lenders, convert them to paid engagements, secure approved-panel status, and build the go-to-market motion

- Product — Partner with the FutureSight product and engineering team to ship V1 and iterate on user feedback

- Capital — Lead the seed raise, supported by FutureSight's network and traction

- Team — Recruit and lead the founding team, and establish the cultural foundation of the company

- Previous founding experience at a venture-backed company

- Demonstrated success in B2B SaaS go-to-market, including sales and customer engagement

- Fundraising fluency, with the ability to develop investor narratives and close capital

- Proven ability to attract, develop, and retain top talent

- Clear-eyed understanding of the risks and demands of co-founding a venture-backed company

- Direct exposure to mortgage lending, residential appraisal, AMC operations, or proptech

How to Apply
Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.
FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.

remote.description:
About KIRA
Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.
In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.
Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.
We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.
We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.
If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
The Role
KIRA is building a AI Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.
These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.
The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.
We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.
What You'll Own

- Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

- Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

- Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

- Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

- Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

- Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

- Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

- 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

- Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

- Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

- Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

- Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

- Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

- Engineering or highly technical product background.

- Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

- Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

- Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

- Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

- Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

- AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

- Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

- Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location
This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.
Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.
Language
English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
Interview Process
Our process is designed to move fast:

- Online assessment or practical task

- Technical interview

- CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

remote.title: Growth Marketing Manager, Events
remote.description:
PermitFlow is redefining how America builds. We’re an applied AI company serving the nation’s builders, tackling one of the largest information challenges in the economy: understanding what can be built, where, and how. Our AI agent workforce helps the fastest-growing construction companies navigate everything from permitting and licensing to inspections and project closeouts – accelerating housing, clean-energy, and infrastructure development across the country.
Despite being a $1.6T industry, construction still suffers from massive delays, wasted capital, and lost opportunity. PermitFlow has already delivered unprecedented speed, accuracy, and visibility to over $20B in development, helping contractors reduce compliance time, de-risk projects, and scale with confidence.
As the U.S. enters a new capex supercycle across data centers, factories, housing, and renewables, joining PermitFlow means building the AI infrastructure at the core of every construction project driving the next wave of reindustrialization.
We’ve raised over $90M, most recently completing our Series B, from top-tier investors including Accel, Kleiner Perkins, Initialized, Y Combinator, Felicis, and Altos Ventures, with backing from leaders at OpenAI, Google, Procore, ServiceTitan, Zillow, PlanGrid, and Uber.
Our HQ is in New York City with a hybrid schedule (3 in-office days per week). We prefer NYC-based candidates or those open to relocation.
About the Role
We've built the foundation for events at PermitFlow. Now we need someone to own the outcome and turn events into a pillar of our GTM motion.
This role runs the full events portfolio: industry conferences, owned events, customer-specific gatherings, and field marketing, plus ongoing experimentation with new formats, venues, and audiences. You'll execute hands-on, with internal and external support, and tie every event back to pipeline and revenue goals. We're an experimentation-heavy culture. You'll be given room to ideate, experiment, measure, and repeat what works.
This is a manager-level individual contributor role. You already know how to set goals, manage a budget, and partner across teams, and you'll bring that experience on day one.
What You'll Do

- Own the events portfolio: build the calendar across industry events, owned events, customer events, and field marketing, and decide where to place bets.

- Run logistics end to end: venues, budgets, vendors, contractors, staffing, and the on-the-ground run of show.

- Experiment deliberately and iterate quickly: test new formats, venues, and target audiences, and kill what doesn't work.

- Get the right targets in the room and at our booth. Great events don't stop at a project plan; they rely on driving high-value attendees.

- Connect events to revenue: define what success looks like for each event, track pipeline and revenue impact, and report results back to the business.

- Partner cross-functionally: work closely with demand gen, product marketing, sales, CS, and business operations to align events with GTM priorities.

- Manage event budgets and vendor relationships: negotiate contracts, manage contractor relationships, and keep spend accountable.

- Build the playbook: turn what's worked into repeatable processes so the program scales as the business grows.

- Represent events at the leadership level: bring recommendations and results directly to company leadership.

- Source speaking opportunities at relevant industry and public events for executive leadership, including content submissions as needed.

Who You Are

- 4-7+ years running B2B events in a fast-moving environment and know the difference between an event that just looks good and one that drives pipeline.

- You can run logistics yourself. You don't need a coordinator to book a venue or manage a floor plan, but you know when and what to delegate.

- You think like a marketer first and an event planner second: every event ties back to organizational goals.

- You've worked closely with partners in Sales, Customer Success, and Executives.

- You're comfortable with ambiguity. This program is evolving, and you'll be instrumental in building the playbooks and processes.

- Bonus: experience in construction, home services, or a related built-world industry.

- Bonus: experience at a startup or in AI, and genuine interest in how physical infrastructure gets built.

What We Offer

- Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a high-growth company

- 100% company-paid base medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees + healthcare FSA

- 401(k) savings plan

- Unlimited PTO and paid family leave

- Home office & equipment stipend

- Daily in-office lunch and dinner provided

- Commuter benefits (pre-tax transit and parking)

PermitFlow provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, or family status, as protected by applicable law.
We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities. All employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.
Compensation Range: $120K - $150K

remote.title: Sr. Search Strategist
remote.description:
The Sr. Paid Search Specialist role is focused on defining strategy and driving success for top brands across the National, Enterprise and Multi-Location team. In this role, you will act as an advisor and investigator, understanding the clients’ business goals, analyzing current campaigns, the results, the set up, and recommending modifications and appropriate capabilities and implementation skillsets needed to help achieve set benchmarks.  This role will own the strategic recommendation elements to help campaigns reach client goals. This role will also take an active role in our pre-sales process and in making initial client recommendations prior to onboarding. The role we play is significant and we strive to exceed our goals and client expectations, while learning, growing, and having fun as a team along the way. Are you in? Come talk to us, we would love to tell you more!
About the job:
The Senior Paid Search Strategist will focus efforts around four core functions:
Discovery Implementation Optimization Results Leveraging our in-house reporting dashboards, you will identify and select campaigns to review based on shortfalls you see from established client expectations. In other circumstances, cases will come directly to you from our Sales and Brand Management team, soliciting your advice on recommendations to correct campaign performance. Some brands will be existing, while new, large brands will be also folded in as they are closed by our sales team. Our brands today are primarily focused on SEM, and you will work to ensure that this tactic is delivering stellar results across each brand and account within the brand, while helping to partner with colleagues to make strategic recommendations on how to diversify this approach through other advertising platforms. Recommended changes will then be implemented.   Whether helping implement the changes directly or delegating tasks to associated client success managers attached to the brands, you will be accountable for ensuring implementation is completed correctly.  From there, continuous optimization will occur with consistent reviews that you will conduct leveraging reporting tools to help tell the story to clients. Results will then be shared with internal and external clients.  Using the same reporting platforms, we will share results and format it in such a way that it tells a story and provides clients valuable insights and recommendations. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports and will own the strategic elements of the client relationship while the current/existing managers will own people management of teams and execution disciplines.
Expectations:  You must have applied experience in SEM at an expert level, with an advanced knowledge of shopping ads and paid search ads outside of search engine platforms, such as Yelp and Amazon. You should also have a cross-section of skills spanning:
Advertising Strategy Project Management Technology Attention to detail Consumer Insights Analytics Implementation of Data -Driven Decisions
Responsibilities:
Day-to-Day:
Develop and execute effective SEM and paid search strategies that align with clients’ goals and objectives. Conduct in-depth keyword research to identify high-value keywords and phrases for both organic and paid search campaigns. Oversee paid search campaigns, including budget management, ad copywriting, bid optimization, and performance tracking. Monitor and analyze performance metrics using tools like Google Analytics, Google Ads, and internal software, and provide regular reports to external and internal stakeholders. Stay current with industry trends, algorithm updates, and best practices in search marketing to ensure compliance and effectiveness. Conduct competitive analysis to identify opportunities and threats in the search marketing landscape. Collaborate with client or internal web development and UX teams to optimize landing pages and user experiences for improved conversion rates. Manage the search marketing budget, allocating effectively to maximize ROI. Foster cross-functional collaboration with other departments, such as sales, post-sales, creative, data science, customer experience and others, to integrate search marketing efforts with broader business objectives. Identify areas for improvement, conduct A/B testing, and implement optimization strategies to enhance clients’ SEM performance.
Strategy:
Digital Strategy - Act as an advisor, analyzing current campaigns, the results, the set up, and recommending modifications needed to help achieve set benchmarks. Provide proactive commentary on the overall health of an account, drive strategy, and actively make recommendations as appropriate. Plan & coordinate meetings with clients, and internal teams to ensure all strategic recommendations are shared, along with the campaign story of performance changes. Dive deep into campaign goals and make recommendations to help achieve results Partner with Data Science to build complementing reporting aspects related to campaign performance insights where needed.
Product:
Evolving Digital Marketing Landscape - Stay abreast of new and evolving digital marketing concepts, specifically related to Search, and develop and facilitate training sessions for team members to understand the evolving digital marketing concepts. Help to advise, even construct, Search proposals for new brands/RFPs or through the identified gaps in existing campaigns
Key Qualifications:
Creative thinker with strong time management and organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail Ability to lead the discussions related to strategic recommendations or campaign performance in critical in-person meetings including quarterly business reviews, annual reviews, or save efforts. Willingness to collaborate cross functionally and navigate effectively through multiple functions in the organization Ability to manage heavy workloads with flexibility to rapidly shift priorities based on organizational needs 5+ years of experience in the digital space, in an agency environment, or in-house equivalent 5+ years of hands-on SEM optimization experience – building PPC campaigns from the ground up and managing them directly – with in-depth knowledge of Google Ad Platform Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to effectively communicate complex digital/search concepts Expert knowledge and understanding of SEM, with advanced knowledge search impacts on social, email marketing, display, and an understanding of new media consumer behaviors and trends. Knowledge of Google Data Studio and/or other reporting platforms, with ability to determine advertising “story” from metrics. Ability to distill information within Microsoft Excel
Performance Measurements Include (but are not limited to):
Ability to connect professionally with other teams to ensure smooth and on-time deliverables Ability to drive urgency with internal teams to meet & exceed external client commitments Ability to identify product diversification, revenue retention and expansion opportunities Ability to make recommendations and facilitate remediation efforts for distressed accounts or clients that lack strategic direction (the latter especially applicable to new brands)
The annualized base salary for this role will be $70 000,00 - $85,000.00.  Variable compensation is not reflected in these figures and based on the role, may be applicable. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, location, and union representation, if applicable.

- Actief identificeren van nieuwe marktkansen, potentiële klanten en strategische samenwerkingspartners.

-
Nauw afstemmen met Europese collega's over nieuwe leads en commerciële trajecten, zodat kansen gezamenlijk en op de juiste manier worden opgepakt.

- 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

- Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

- Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

- Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

- Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

- Engineering or highly technical product background.

- Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

- Up to one year of relevant professional, internship, or practical experience is preferred but not required.

- Demonstrated interest in pursuing a career in digital advertising, advertising technology, media operations, or campaign management.

- Intermediate or higher proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including formulas, sorting, filtering, formatting, structured data, and spreadsheet-based reporting, with the capacity to learn more advanced functionality quickly.

- Working knowledge of Microsoft Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, and Teams.

- Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

- Exceptional attention to detail, strong organizational and time-management skills, and the ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.

- Ability to work independently and collaboratively, accept feedback, apply corrections, and adapt to changing technologies and business requirements.

This is a high-volume role for someone who has already built strong recruiting instincts and is ready to take a program that's up and running and push it further, improving speed, quality, and consistency as we grow. You'll travel to New Mexico periodically to stay close to the market and the teams you're hiring for.

You'll report to the Talent Lead and work alongside a Recruiter focused on emerging markets, with this role dedicated specifically to owning full-cycle recruiting for BT and RBT roles in FronteraCare's established markets. This is a great fit for someone who thrives in high-volume, fast-moving recruiting environments, finds genuine reward in the grind of consistent high-volume hiring, and brings both process discipline and compassion to every candidate interaction.

What is ABA?
Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) is a therapy that uses evidence-based techniques to help children with autism build communication, social, and daily living skills. Care is typically delivered one-on-one by Behavior Technicians and Registered Behavior Technicians under the guidance of a licensed Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA), with progress tracked closely so each child's plan can be adjusted as they grow.

What you'll do

- Own full cycle recruiting for BT and RBT roles across FronteraCare's existing markets, from sourcing and screening through offer and onboarding handoff

- Take ownership of established sourcing channels and candidate pipelines, refining and scaling what's already working rather than building from scratch

- Maintain a high, consistent volume of active requisitions, balancing speed with quality in a fast-moving, high-turnover talent pool

- Travel to New Mexico periodically to build local candidate and community relationships and stay close to market conditions

- Build and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders, clinical leaders, BCBAs, and current RBTs to stay close to market needs, referral opportunities, and what makes candidates want to join and stay

- Partner with the Talent Lead, the emerging markets Recruiter, onboarding, and HR to keep processes efficient and aligned across the broader recruiting team

- Proactively source candidates using Indeed and other established sourcing platforms, with an eye toward continuous improvement of what's already in place

- Post job openings on job boards and social media channels

- Coordinate and schedule interviews, manage calendars, and lead candidate communications

- Maintain accurate candidate records in Greenhouse and track key recruiting metrics

- Support additional recruiting projects and initiatives as needed to help the team meet its hiring goals

What you'll bring

- Associate's or bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related field

- 3-5 years of recruiting experience in a high-volume setting, ideally in healthcare or behavioral health

- Demonstrated experience recruiting for junior or entry-level profiles, with a genuine appreciation for the pace and repetition that high-volume hiring requires

- Familiarity with sourcing tools such as Indeed, as well as applicant tracking systems (Greenhouse experience a plus)

- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

- Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving, high-growth environment

- Willingness and ability to travel to New Mexico periodically

- A compassionate, people-first mindset, with genuine care for candidates and the families we serve

Bonus points

- Experience recruiting for ABA roles or knowledge of Applied Behavior Analysis is highly valued

We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Job Description:
About Our Cybersecurity Team
Are you ready to make an impact at one of the world’s leading technology companies? HPE’s Cybersecurity team is where you can do just that. We’re looking for a dynamic and experienced Application Security Engineer to join our team. If you’re passionate about shaping the future of cybersecurity and ready for your next challenge, we’d love to hear from you.
About the role
We are hiring an Application Security Engineer to build how our enterprise secures software, from first commit to production. This is not a role for running scans and filing tickets. You will design the guardrails, automation, and AI-powered tooling that let engineering teams ship securely by default, and you will prove they work with data.
You will work as a peer to engineering, architecture, and DevOps leaders and own outcomes across secure SDLC, CI/CD and supply chain integrity, WAF/WAAP and API protection, and AI/LLM security. The right person sees a recurring problem and builds the capability that makes it go away.

What you’ll do:
Secure SDLC & DevSecOps

- Build security into the SDLC as paved roads, so the secure path is the easiest path for every engineering team.

- Define the secure coding standards and reference patterns that teams across the enterprise build against.

- Build the vulnerability prioritization capability that shows where real risk sits across code, pipelines, and deployed services, and drive remediation to measurable closure.

- Establish a threat modeling practice for applications, APIs, and delivery pipelines that scale beyond a single team.

CI/CD & software supply chain security

- Architect the security control layer for our CI/CD platforms (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab, Azure DevOps) so every pipeline inherits it by default.

- Design the automated testing pipeline that runs SAST, DAST, SCA, and container scanning on every build, tuned for signal over noise.

- Build the automation that keeps our attack surface visible: API discovery, dependency scanning, SBOM generation, and secrets detection.

AI/LLM security & AI-powered automation

- Build reusable AI agent skills and workflows inside CI/CD (e.g., agentic coding tools, MCP-based integrations) that review every pull request for insecure patterns, authN/authZ gaps, secrets exposure, and risky dependency changes, and deliver CWE/OWASP-mapped findings developers can act on.

- Build AI-driven security testing that generates targeted test cases (API abuse cases, fuzzing inputs, prompt-injection and jailbreak suites), triages SAST/SCA/DAST results to cut false positives and proposes remediation PRs for human review.

- Define the guardrails AI agents operate under our pipelines: least-privilege tokens, human-in-the-loop approval, output-accuracy evaluation, and audit logging.

- Build the AI-specific scanning capability that catches insecure LLM orchestration patterns before they ship.

- Establish a reusable threat modeling approach for RAG architectures and autonomous agents.

- Define the framework for secure AI adoption in enterprise applications, covering data security, access controls, model input/output handling, and misuse prevention.

- Familiarity with agentic AI frameworks such as LangGraph and similar orchestration frameworks

Partnership & enablement

- Demonstrated ability to drive initiatives end-to-end, taking ownership of tasks, deliverables, and outcomes.

- Shape product, platform, and DevOps roadmaps as trusted advisors, translating technical risk into business decisions.

- Choose, implement, and prove the tooling that closes the gaps we have today, with metrics that show the impact.

- Grow security capability inside engineering teams through mentoring secure coding and pipeline practices.

- Help scale the Security Champions program into a self-sustaining network.

What you need to bring:

- 6+ years in Application Security, Product Security, or Secure Software Development, with a track record of building capabilities, not only operating them.

- Has designed security controls for CI/CD pipelines and source repositories (GitHub, GitLab, Jenkins, or similar) at scale.

- Has built and tuned SAST, DAST, SCA, and container scanning, so developers trust and act on the results.

- Has built and tuned WAF and API protections and driven vulnerability remediation to closure.

- Applies SLSA and NIST SSDF to design build integrity, including secrets management and artifact signing.

- Has designed security controls in AWS, Azure, or GCP.

- Deep understanding of OWASP Top 10 (Web & API), CWE, and secure coding practices.

- Working knowledge of OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and MITRE ATLAS.

Preferred

- Has built LLM-powered developer or security tooling, including prompt/skill design, tool and MCP integration, and evaluation of output quality and false-positive rates.

- Has implemented signing and provenance with Sigstore/Cosign or similar tooling.

- Integrate SBOM generation and SCA into CI/CD workflows.

- Has deployed runtime protection (API security platforms, RASP, container EDR).

- Has built GitOps, IaC scanning (Terraform, CloudFormation), and policy-as-code guardrails.

- Has led or shaped response to software supply chain or dependency poisoning incidents.

- Relevant certifications: OSWE, CSSLP, GPCS, GWEB, GCSA.

- Writes production-quality code in at least one language (Python, Java, Go, or JavaScript/Node.js) to build automation and tooling.

Soft skills

- Influences developers, DevOps engineers, and leadership through clear communication and well-built tooling, not mandates.

- Automation-first: if a task happens twice, you build the capability that removes it.

- Measures success by outcomes, balancing security with delivery velocity.

The Role
KIRA is building a AI Investing Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.
These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.
The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.
We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.
What You'll Own

- Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

- Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

- Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

- Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

- Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

- Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

- Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

- 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

- Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

- Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

- Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

- Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

- Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

- Engineering or highly technical product background.

- Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

- Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

- Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

- Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

- Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

- AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

- Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

- Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location
This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.
Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.
Language
English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
Interview Process
Our process is designed to move fast:

- Online assessment or practical task

- Technical interview

- CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

remote.title: Technical Product Manager - AI Neobank App
remote.description:
About KIRA
Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.
In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.
Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.
We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.
We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.
If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
The Role
KIRA is building a AI Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.
These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.
The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.
We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.
What You'll Own

- Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

- Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

- Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

- Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

- Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

- Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

- Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

- 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

- Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

- Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

- Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

- Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

- Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

- Engineering or highly technical product background.

- Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

- Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

- Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

- Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

- Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

- AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

- Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

- Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location
This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.
Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.
Language
English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
Interview Process
Our process is designed to move fast:

- Online assessment or practical task

- Technical interview

- CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.
