remote.description:
As a Staff Network Engineer at vCluster Labs, you aren't just configuring switches; you are building the automation logic that configures them. AI Clouds run on InfiniBand and high-speed Ethernet fabrics that most teams still wire up by hand, one customer at a time. You will build the automation that turns that fabric into repeatable provisioning logic. You start in a small R&D group alongside our CTO and grow into owning this area as it becomes a core part of our platform.
As a Staff Network Engineer, your role will include:

- Fabric automation: You will design and build the systems that automatically provision and configure NVIDIA switches and InfiniBand fabrics, including integration with NVIDIA UFM. Manual, per-customer switch setup is the thing you are replacing.

- Network config management and sync: You will build the control loop that keeps switch, VLAN, and VXLAN state consistent with what our platform intends, detects drift, and reconciles it safely in production.

- NAT gateway and L4 load balancing: You will build the gateway and load balancing layer that tenant clusters depend on for connectivity, with failover designed in from day one rather than bolted on later.

- Scale and failure engineering: You will define how our network layer behaves at large scale: BGP route table limits, convergence, failover, and what happens when a link, switch, or gateway dies under real AI workloads.

- Customer Zero for AI networking: You will run your automation on real AI Cloud environments, bring back what breaks, and turn hard-won operational lessons into product behavior our customers never have to think about.

- Technical direction: You will help decide what we build versus integrate with partner solutions, write the design and requirements docs, and set the standards for how networking works across vCluster products.

This role could be a fit for you if you bring:

- You have built network automation, not just operated networks: You have shipped software that configures switches, routers, or load balancers programmatically, ideally as part of a product or internal platform other teams relied on.

- NVIDIA networking experience: Hands-on work with NVIDIA UFM, NVIDIA Spectrum or Quantum switches, Cumulus Linux, or NVUE, including programming against their APIs.

- Deep fabric fundamentals: Strong command of InfiniBand, VLAN, VXLAN and EVPN, and BGP, including how they behave and fail at production scale.

- Production scale scars: You have run networks at real production scale, seen them break, and helped fix the root cause with automation rather than runbooks.

- Software engineering ability: You write production code in Go or Python, use version control and code review as a matter of course, and think of network config as code.

Bonus points for:

- AI networking depth: Experience tuning fabrics for GPU training or inference workloads, such as RoCEv2, congestion control, rail-optimized topologies, or Spectrum-X.

- AI Cloud or hyperscaler background: You helped build network automation at a GPU cloud, hyperscaler, or large CDN.

- Load balancer and gateway internals: Experience building L4 load balancers or NAT gateways, including with eBPF/XDP or DPDK.

- Open source: Contributions to networking or Kubernetes projects such as SONiC, FRRouting, Cilium, or MetalLB.

About vCluster Labs
We're the #1 platform for AI infrastructure, trusted by the world's fastest-growing AI cloud builders. We're a venture-backed startup that's raised over $28M from top-tier investors including Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, and DoorDash), and we're in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to join our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe with a remote-first culture.
We give AI Cloud providers and AI factories a hyperscaler-like experience on their own GPU infrastructure. Our platform runs the full stack an operator needs, from bare metal provisioning and node lifecycle management up through managed Kubernetes, Slurm, Ray, and inference clusters, so they can turn raw GPUs into cluster products they can sell in days instead of spending 12+ months building it themselves. Today we power over 100,000 GPUs and 1 million CPUs across 50+ AI clouds and Fortune 500 companies, backed by a team of 40+ infrastructure engineers who build alongside our customers rather than just shipping them software.
We're the company behind vCluster, the open source technology for tenant isolation on Kubernetes, with 11,000+ GitHub stars and 40M+ tenant clusters created since 2021. Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI, a Kubernetes-native framework built for running AI, ML, and GPU-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA-validated reference architecture for DGX systems.

What We Offer

-
Part-time compensation:

About the Role
Clarity Pediatrics is seeking a licensed Group Therapist to join our remote, multidisciplinary behavioral health team. In this specialized role, you will exclusively facilitate virtual, evidence-based psychoeducational groups for parents and caregivers of children with behavioral health needs, primarily ADHD and anxiety.
Our parent groups equip caregivers with practical, evidence-based strategies they can use at home to support their child and strengthen family functioning. You’ll guide families through structured curricula, create an engaging and supportive group environment, and help parents translate what they learn into meaningful change between sessions.

Job Title: Senior Health Data Informaticist - Compass
Job Location: Boston, MA
Job Location Type: Remote

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.
The Role
As a Senior Healthcare Data Informaticist, you will design, manage, and maintain all reference data assets in the Terminology Reference Library (TRL), including clinical, and claims-related coding standards. In this senior role, you will ensure high-quality, standardized, and actionable data to support therapeutic area frameworks and a comprehensive, reference data library. You will collaborate closely with data engineering, analytics, and product teams to deliver scalable, interoperable, and trusted healthcare data solutions.
What You’ll Do

- Curate, standardize, and validate medical and pharmacy claims data to ensure accuracy and usability across Compass products

- Map drugs to indications and therapeutic areas using coding standards such as ICD-10, CPT/HCPCS, NDC, RxNorm, and ATC

- Design, maintain, and document hierarchical structures, taxonomies, and vocabularies, including therapeutic area frameworks, diagnosis/procedure groupings

- Develop business rules, validation routines, and clinical logic to support reliable analytics and product use

- Lead data integration and modeling efforts, applying healthcare data standards for consistent, interoperable data assets

- Troubleshoot complex data issues, ensuring data integrity, system reliability, and adherence to regulatory requirements (HIPAA)

- Produce clear documentation (ERDs, flowcharts, sequence diagrams) to communicate processes and data solutions effectively

- Translate complex clinical and payer data concepts into actionable insights for cross-functional teams and leadership

- Mentor and guide junior team members to strengthen overall team capabilities.

Requirements

- Bachelor’s degree in Health Informatics, Biomedical Informatics, Pharmacy, Life Sciences, Public Health, or related field

- 5+ years of hands-on experience with healthcare data systems, clinical vocabularies, coding systems, and payer data

- Deep expertise in drug classification and coding systems (NDC, RxNorm, ATC)

- Advanced knowledge of diagnostic and procedural code sets (ICD-10-CM, ICD-10-PCS, CPT, HCPCS)

- Experience with payer data, including commercial and government payers, and a history of acting as a subject matter expert

- Strong SQL skills and experience with data modeling, transformation, and aggregation on large healthcare datasets

- Proven ability to design, maintain, and govern complex hierarchical structures (taxonomies, ontologies, clinical groupers)

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to resolve technical challenges in healthcare data systems

- Excellent collaboration and communication skills, able to translate complex data concepts for technical and non-technical audiences

- Familiarity with U.S. healthcare system structures, data standards, and payer mix concepts

Nice to Have

- Experience with terminology or ontology management tools (e.g., Apelon, SNOMED CT browsers, OHDSI/OMOP)

- Familiarity with data governance platforms (e.g., Collibra, Informatica) and FAIR data principles

- Background in pharmacy, clinical informatics, or health economics/market access analytics

- Proficiency in scripting languages (Python, R, SAS) or other ETL/data manipulation tools

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

- Follow the application process and submit your resume.

- Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.

- Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.

- If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:

- A conversation with the hiring manager

- A practical case exercise

- A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.

- Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

- Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance

- Flexible PTO and company paid holidays

- Retirement programs

- The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.

- CPA license required; advanced degree in taxation (MST/LL.M.), law degree, or comparable technical credential strongly preferred.

- 12–15+ years of progressive tax experience, with the majority spent advising clients with balance sheets of $25M or greater; meaningful experience with $100M+ families required.

- Deep technical command of individual, fiduciary, partnership, corporate, estate, gift, and state and local taxation, including advanced planning strategies commonly used by ultra-high net worth families.

- Experience identifying cross-border tax and reporting issues and working effectively with international tax specialists; direct technical expertise in every international area is not required.

- Secure network access using Tailscale VPN.

- Develop Infrastructure as Code using Pulumi alongside the infrastructure team.

- Investigate security incidents and conduct routine vulnerability assessments.

Who you are
We’re looking for someone with strong IT Engineering skills who shares our most important values:

- You’re fanatical about polish. Every detail matters. You love to make sure your configurations are documented, policies are enforced, and nothing slips through the cracks.

- You care about correctness. You take pride in the fact that the systems and policies you put in place are airtight and auditable.

- You obsess over security. You’re always thinking about the attack surface and how to reduce it without making engineers miserable.

- You dive deep. It’s important for you to really know how things work. You read the spec, not just the summary.

- You live on the bleeding edge. You’ve got a long list of upcoming platform features you’re excited about and can’t wait for the next nightly to drop.

- You’re a great teacher. You know how to communicate security requirements to engineers in a way that makes sense and gets buy-in.

- Our work has impact — We build products that are deployed to U.S. submarines and integrate with the sonobuoys we manufacture.

- We’re growing responsibly — We have the resources to hire a lot more people, but we don’t want to build a massive team of people who don’t share our values.

- We’re remote — Work from wherever you want. We collaborate in real time on Slack or asynchronously via GitHub.

- We’re profitable — We aren’t burning through cash trying to make the business work. But we also have investors who believe in us and are committed to our success.

- We care about doing great work — You don’t need permission to sweat the details here.

- We don’t take ourselves too seriously — We’re building products that make the world safer. But we don’t let that get to our heads.

Keysteadis an insurance brokerage built for the small businesses traditional brokers can't afford to serve. AI agents run the full workflow, from intake and multi-carrier quoting to binding and certificates of insurance, with licensed agents stepping in where judgment matters. Keystead starts with the businesses that need proof of coverage again and again, such as contractors, event vendors, and product brands selling into retail. For these owners, a certificate that takes days to arrive can cost them the job. Keystead issues it in minutes, explains coverage in plain language, and re-shops the market at every renewal.

Roughly 35M small businesses in the US are underserved by a broker model built for larger accounts. Across the US and Canada, small business insurance represents a $6.2B commission pool. remote.title: Senior Development Manager
remote.description:
About the Role
RTC is seeking an experienced Senior Development Manager to help build and grow our philanthropy function. Working closely with the Vice President of Philanthropy, this person will play a key role in shaping fundraising strategy, strengthening development operations, and expanding philanthropic support for RTC's mission.
This is a strategic and hands-on role with a primary focus on revenue generation. The Senior Development Manager will independently manage and grow a portfolio of mid-level institutional and individual donors and prospects, with direct responsibility for cultivating relationships, securing commitments, and stewarding donors. They will also help build the systems, infrastructure, and compelling fundraising narratives needed to support RTC's long-term growth.
The ideal candidate is a resourceful, collaborative fundraiser who brings strong relationship management skills, operational discipline, and the ability to turn strategy into action. They are comfortable building something new while taking ownership of the work that drives results.
Key Responsibilities
Revenue Generation & Relationship Management (60%)

- Independently manage and grow a portfolio of foundation, corporate philanthropy, and select individual donors and prospects, building toward achieving an annual fundraising goal of $1 million within the first two years.

- Proactively build the pipeline by researching, identifying, qualifying, and cultivating new institutional and individual prospects, with a particular focus on converting new relationships into philanthropic support.

- Build and strengthen donor relationships through thoughtful cultivation, personalized engagement, and stewardship that inspire long-term partnerships.

- Develop proposals, grant applications, funding requests, and donor communications that connect RTC's mission and impact to funder priorities.

- Collaborate across teams to identify opportunities for donor engagement and connect RTC's programs, outcomes, and impact to strategic priorities.

Development Operations & Infrastructure (20%)

- Maintain strong portfolio and pipeline discipline in RTC's CRM ensuring accurate donor and prospect information, timely tracking of activity, and clear visibility into next steps.

- Develop and maintain fundraising pipelines, revenue forecasts, dashboards, and performance reports to inform strategy and decision-making.

- Strengthen development processes and workflows, including prospect management, gift tracking, acknowledgments, grant reporting, and stewardship, to support an efficient, coordinated, and growing philanthropy function.

Fundraising Strategy, Campaigns, & Communications (20%)

- Partner with the Vice President of Philanthropy to develop and implement fundraising strategies that support RTC's revenue goals and long-term sustainability.

- Help build and execute annual giving initiatives, targeted fundraising campaigns, and partner engagement strategies that expand and diversify RTC’s funding base.

- Identify opportunities to engage RTC's board, alumni, and broader network in cultivation, stewardship, and fundraising initiatives.

Qualifications

- 5+ years of progressive experience in nonprofit fundraising, with a proven track record of building donor relationships and achieving fundraising goals.

- Understanding of the philanthropic landscape in education, workforce development, technology, or other related mission areas.

- Experience independently managing donor or funder relationships, including cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship.

- Experience with institutional fundraising, including corporate and foundation giving, grant proposals, and funder reporting.

- Strong writing and storytelling skills, with the ability to develop persuasive proposals and donor communications.

- Comfortable with HubSpot or comparable CRM systems, fundraising reporting, and development operations. Experience building or improving development systems, processes, or fundraising programs is a plus.

- Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to balance strategic priorities and hands-on execution.

- A collaborative, entrepreneurial approach and comfort working in a growing organization where systems and processes are still evolving.

We recognize that strong candidates bring experience through a variety of professional and educational pathways. We encourage applicants who demonstrate the skills and capabilities needed for this position, even if their backgrounds do not align with every qualification listed.
In the first year, the Senior Development Manager will:

- Build and actively manage a portfolio of qualified institutional and individual prospects, resulting in new and renewed philanthropic commitments.

- Establish a consistent prospecting rhythm that meaningfully expands RTC's pipeline.

- Strengthen portfolio management, forecasting, CRM discipline, and stewardship systems so RTC has clear visibility into fundraising progress.

- Execute targeted fundraising campaigns and donor strategies that expand and diversify RTC's philanthropic base.

- Build strong working relationships with VP of Philanthropy, CEO, and cross-functional colleagues and help establish a coordinated, high-performing philanthropy function.

All Applicants must be authorized to work within the US without the need for current or future sponsorship.

what you bring

- Fundiertes End-to-End-Prozessverständnis im B2B-E-Commerce, von der Kundenanfrage bis zur Auslieferung und Rechnung.

- Sicheres Auftreten gegenüber Fach- und Managementebene, Erfahrung mit Workshops, Präsentationen und Aufwandsschätzungen.

- Selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie ein hohes Maß an Eigeninitiative.

- Kommunikationsstärke, Begeisterung für neue Technologien und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit im Team.

- Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.

Zusätzlich von Vorteil:

- Kenntnisse im SAP-CX-Portfolio, zum Beispiel Sales und Service Cloud (V2), Engagement Cloud (Emarsys) und Customer Data Platform, sowie im Zusammenspiel von Commerce mit Marketing-, Vertriebs- und Serviceprozessen (CRM).

- Erfahrung mit CI/CD und DevOps im Commerce-Cloud-Umfeld sowie SAP-Zertifizierungen im Commerce-Umfeld.

- Du übernimmst eine Schlüsselrolle an der Schnittstelle von Betrieb, Beratung und Weiterentwicklung von B2B-Webshops und prägst, wie wir SAP Commerce Cloud am Markt aufstellen.

remote.description:
With a passion for life
Join our diverse teams of passionate people and a career that allows you to develop both personally and professionally. At Getinge we exist to make life-saving technology accessible for more people. To make a true difference for our customers – and to save more lives, we need team players, forward thinkers, and game changers.
Are you looking for an inspiring career? You just found it.
Job Overview
The R&D Sterilization Validation Scientist is an essential technical role within the R&D Science team, responsible for designing, validating, and sustaining the sterilization program for Healthmark manufactured and distributed medical devices.
Reporting directly to the Senior Principal Scientist in the R&D Science department in Fraser, MI, this position focuses on integrating sterilization validation into the early stages of new product development and providing advanced scientific support for sustaining engineering, material changes, and product lifecycle management. The Scientist ensures that all designs meet global regulatory standards for sterile barrier integrity, material compatibility, and microbial performance before commercial launch and throughout the product’s lifecycle. This position is fully remote for US candidates, with a preference in Eastern Standard Time. The role will require approximately 30-35% travel to our site in Fraser, MI and external testing labs.
Job Responsibilities and Essential Duties:
1. New Product Development (NPD) Support

- Serve as the sterilization validation SME on R&D project teams, embedding "design for sterilization" principles into the early phases of healthcare consumable product development.

- Define sterilization requirements, evaluate new material technologies, and assess material compatibility with various sterilization modalities (e.g., EO, Steam, Gamma, VHP).

- Author, execute, and review R&D protocols, test methods, and validation reports specific to sterilization validation and material compatibility.

2. Sterilization Validation & Integrity Testing

- Design and manage validation programs in strict compliance with ANSI/AAMI/ISO 11135, 11137, 14937 and 17665 and ISO 11607 (Parts 1 & 2) and applicable sterilization standards (ISO 11135, ISO 11137, ISO 17665).

- Coordinate and execute microbial barrier testing, physical integrity testing (e.g., tensile, burst, dye penetration), and shelf-life studies (accelerated and real-time aging).

- Direct and manage medical device sterilization and biocompatibility testing with external laboratories (ensuring compliance with ISO 10993 standards for material safety and biological evaluation).

- Partner with external testing laboratories and contract sterilizers to schedule and oversee protocol execution.

3. Sustaining Engineering & Existing Product Support

- Provide technical support for existing product lines, evaluating the impact of manufacturing process improvements, site transfers, or material supplier changes on product sterilization claims and integrity.

- Lead product adoption and equivalency assessments to incorporate design modifications or line extensions into existing sterilization validation frameworks.

- Perform periodic re-validation, review annual sterilization data, and maintain up-to-date Design History Files (DHF) and Risk Management files.

- Lead complaint investigations for product sterilization compatibility and validation issues

4. Technical Writing & Regulatory Compliance

- Draft the sterilization sections for regulatory submissions (FDA 510(k), EU MDR Technical Documentation, global filings).

- Author clearly defensible scientific justifications and technical assessments to support product changes without requiring full re-validation where appropriate.

- Investigate R&D-related non-conformances, out-of-specification (OOS) lab results, or test failures, determining root causes and implementing corrective actions.

Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

- In-depth knowledge of US and Global standards for terminally sterilized medical devices.

- Practical experience with industrial sterilization methods, particularly Ethylene Oxide (EO), Vaporized Hydrogen Peroxide, and Moist Heat (Steam), plus working knowledge of Gamma/E-beam irradiation, and biocompatibility testing (ISO 10993).

- Strong technical understanding of biological indicator (BI) and chemical indicator (CI) requirements and performance standards (e.g., ISO 11138 and ISO 11140 series).

- Prior training and adherence to Good Documentation Practices and Good Laboratory Practices

- Familiarity with medical device design controls (FDA 21 CFR Part 820.30 and ISO 13485).

- Strong collaborative mindset with the ability to influence cross-functional project teams (Engineering, Operations, Quality, Regulatory).

- Excellent technical writing and documentation skills.

- Strong root-cause analysis and structured problem-solving skills.

Minimum Requirements:

- Bachelor’s degree in Microbiology, Biomedical Engineering, Materials Science, Biology, or a related scientific/engineering field (Master’s or Ph.D. is a plus).

- 3–5+ years of experience directly focused on medical device sterilization validation.

- Direct experience working with sterile barrier systems (pouches, wraps, or rigid container systems).

Environmental/Safety/Physical Work Conditions:

- Ensures environmental consciousness and safe practices are exhibited in decisions.

- Works in office, laboratory, and manufacturing environments; follows applicable safety procedures and personal protective equipment (PPE) requirements when in the laboratory or on the production floor.

- Use of computer and telephone equipment and other related office accessories/devices to complete assignments.

- May work extended hours during peak business cycles.

- The position requires travel of approximately 30-35%.

- Able to lift 20 lbs. and stand for longer periods of time.

In a world of noise, we find the signal — the pulse of potential. We weave the strands of talent, vision, and purpose into organizations that endure. Blending intelligence with intuition, we honor the human art of connection at the heart of every great company.

Remote (USA) | Base $135,000 to $150,000 plus commission | Target Year 1 OTE $300,000
ABOUT THE JOB
Build a new market in the industry you already know.
Our client is a fast-growing outsourcing company that builds dedicated remote teams for US businesses. Their people handle customer support, sales support, scheduling, admin, and back-office work inside the client’s own systems, as part of the client’s team. They became a known name in two niche industries by learning those businesses deeply, and the model worked well enough that they’re now taking it into new markets, starting with an acquisition that opens the door to real estate.
They’re hiring one or two Vice Presidents of Business Development to lead that expansion. Each VP owns a vertical: Real Estate, Home Services and Construction, Waste Management and Environmental Services, or Hospitality. You’ll build the go-to-market from the ground up: who to call, what to offer them, how to price and package it, and how to turn the first few clients into a reputation. You’ll report to the Senior Vice President of Sales and work alongside Marketing and Customer Experience. This is a hands-on, entrepreneurial seat for someone who wants to build a market, not inherit one.
THE MANDATE
Our client is clear about who will thrive in this role, and who won’t.
They’re not looking for someone who has spent their career selling staffing, outsourcing, or BPO services. They’re not looking for a strategist who needs a team to execute, or an account manager who’s most comfortable growing relationships someone else opened.
They’re seeking an industry insider: someone who has spent years in real estate, home services or construction, waste and environmental services, or hospitality, running part of the business or selling into it, who knows the owners and operators by name and understands where the work piles up: the phones, the scheduling, the paperwork, the follow-up that never gets done. You can sit across from a CEO and talk about their business, not about outsourcing. You don’t need to have sold a service like this before. They’ll teach you the offering. You bring the industry.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Own new business for your vertical, from first conversation to signed agreement, with a pipeline you build yourself

- Design the go-to-market for a new industry: the ideal client profile, the offer, the pricing conversation, and the partnerships that open doors

- Land strategic partnerships and national accounts, then deepen them

- Be the face of the company in your industry: conferences, trade associations, client visits, and the dinners where deals get started

- Work with Marketing and Customer Experience so what you sell is what gets delivered, and what you hear in the market shapes the offer

- Help set the strategic direction of the division as the new verticals take hold

IDEAL PROFILE

- 5+ years in B2B business development with deep relationships in one of the target industries: real estate, home services and construction, waste management and environmental services, or hospitality

- 5+ years in senior sales leadership with a track record of winning in that industry, or selling into it

- Comfortable building and managing relationships with owners and the C-suite

- Experience in high-growth environments, using data and technology to drive results

- An entrepreneur’s mindset: strategic enough to design the plan, hands-on enough to run it

- Collaborative, efficient, and motivated by results; you want to win the day

- Energized by networking and industry events

- Bachelor’s degree in business, management, communication, or a related field

- Strong written and spoken communication; tech-savvy and quick to adopt new tools

- Not required: any background in outsourcing, staffing, or BPO

LOCATION & WORK MODEL

- Remote, anywhere in the US

- Core hours Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Central

- Travel for industry events, conferences, and client meetings

COMPENSATION
Base salary: $135,000 to $150,000, plus commission
Target OTE: $300,000
Realistic first-year earnings: $200,000 to $250,000 while you build the book
Benefits details will be provided during the interview process.
ABOUT THIS SEARCH
This search is being conducted by Signal & Strand, a boutique recruiting and people operations firm headquartered in Long Beach, CA with national and international reach, on behalf of our client. The company’s name will be shared with candidates as the conversation moves forward. All inquiries are held in confidence.
The Right Hire Changes Everything®

Base Compensation Range

$135,000—$150,000 USD

Equal Opportunity & Non-Discrimination Statement
Signal and Strand is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We—and our clients—do not discriminate in employment or contracting on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, registered domestic partner status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, or local laws.

We comply fully with the provisions of the U.S. Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC) and the California Fair Employment and Housing Act (FEHA). All employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We are committed to providing a workplace that is inclusive, respectful, and free from discrimination, harassment, and retaliation.

remote.description:

Lawgent är en modern juristbyrå för företag som verkar där juridik, AI, data och europeisk reglering möts. Vi arbetar med bland annat AI och data, GDPR, digital reglering, finansiell reglering och kommersiell juridik, och gör komplex juridik tydlig och användbar. Nu växer vi i hela Sverige.
Du kan bo och arbeta var som helst i landet: vi arbetar digitalt och träffar klienter på plats när det behövs.

Du ansvarar för att få ut jurister till våra kunder. Du säljer in Lawgents jurister som konsulter till företag och offentlig sektor som behöver kompetens inom EU-förordningar, AI-reglering, GDPR och övriga områden vi arbetar med.
Det här är en säljroll där du arbetar uppsökande med hjälp av dina egna och våra verktyg.
Det här gör du

- Hittar kunder med behov av juridisk kompetens och säljer in konsultuppdrag

- Matchar rätt jurist med rätt uppdrag och tar affären till avslut

- Bevakar och svarar på förfrågningar hos konsultmäklare som Verama och Ework

- Bygger och håller kontakt med en pool av jurister och konsulter

- Följer upp pågående uppdrag så att kunden vill förlänga

Vi söker dig som

- Har erfarenhet av försäljning, gärna av konsulttjänster eller bemanning

- Tar egna initiativ och driver affärer framåt utan att vänta på uppdrag

- Har affärssinne och trivs med kundkontakt

- Talar och skriver svenska och engelska obehindrat

Det är meriterande om du

- Har erfarenhet från juridik, konsultmäklare eller rekrytering

- Har kunskap om GDPR, AI-förordningen eller annan EU-reglering

Varför Lawgent

- Obegränsad intjäning: din inkomst växer med de affärer du skapar, utan tak

- Du arbetar med AI- och EU-reglering, ett av de snabbast växande områdena inom juridiken

- Internationell räckvidd med klienter och partners i Europa, Mellanöstern, Nordamerika och Asien

- Samarbete med internationella experter, bland annat professor Douwe Korff

- Full frihet att arbeta var du vill i Sverige

- Stort eget ansvar och möjlighet att växa in i en ledande roll när byrån växer

Vi går igenom upplägget och hur du tjänar pengar hos oss redan under första samtalet.
Så söker du
I ansökan svarar du på några frågor och spelar in en kort video där du presenterar dig. Vi läser alla svar innan vi bokar intervjuer.
Skicka in din ansökan via vår karriärsida. Alla rekryteringar till Lawgent hanteras genom Nordic Investin Groups gemensamma karriärportal.

remote.title: Project Manager
remote.description:
Project Manager
The Opportunity: As the Project Manager, you will navigate the execution of projects like a skilled sailor at sea. You assist with charting the course by translating client briefs into clear, actionable project plans, steering through the complexities from inception to completion. With a keen eye on budgets and schedules, you ensure the ship stays on course, raising the flag if turbulent waters are upon us and looking for the solution to get us through.
Your teamwork as a crew member ensures smooth sailing by consistently managing internal team communications to deliver the highest quality work. You can adeptly adjust the sails, regularly soliciting and acting on client feedback to ensure every project reaches its destination effectively.
What kind of person would that be?
Organized and on top of it. Someone people often describe as “dependable” and “reliable”. Flexible, not like Yoga, but open to learning. An active listener (which is a thing). A human, who likes people and forges strong relationships. Assertive and confident when identifying and responding to issues that might put a project at risk. Easily earns trust. Likes to have fun, a real plus. You know when and how to reach out, and can adapt your style to effectively manage up, down, and across.
What you’ll be part of:
One of the fastest growing integrated marketing/PR agencies on this planet. Offices and opportunities across the globe. Fantastic clients and a robust pipeline. Talented people at every position. Kind people. Leadership that cares about your success and provides career mentorship. A commitment to workable processes and taking care to do things correctly the first time. An agency that cares about work culture and gives you a voice in it.
Why Join FINN Partners?

- Competitive salary, benefits package, and a commitment to work-life balance.

- A culture that values innovation, continuous learning, and collaboration.

- Career advancement opportunities in a fast-growing company.

- A wellness subsidy.

- A manager that provides consistent 1:1 check ins, reviews, and culture-building opportunities to connect with people across the organization.

Responsibilities:

- Strong attention to detail in all aspects of projects and communication.

- Delivers professional & friendly interactions with client & team.

- Act as a communication hub for project team, partners, vendors, and clients.

- Produces clear, concise, organized and actionable written documents and correspondence, both internal and external. Including but not limited to QA, updating status documentation and time reports.

- Adept at problem solving and/or knowing who to go to for help.

- Understand the client's business and project management systems

- Ability to use agency systems and follow established processes and workflow.

- Schedule and attend key touch-point meetings, both internal and external. Ensuring the team is prepared with a call agenda and additional required information.

Qualifications:

- Prior experience as a project manager in an agency setting or comparable is helpful.

- 1-3 years of experience in project management.

- Bachelor’s degree is a plus.

Anticipated Salary: $55,000 - $65,000
Compensation is based on experience, qualifications, location, and level at which the candidate is hired.
To Apply:
Please upload your resume and cover letter, as well as indicate your desired salary in
$US Dollars. While we appreciate the interest of all candidates, we will only respond to
those with whom we have a greater interest.
About FINN
Founded in 2011 on the core principles of innovation and collaborative partnership, FINN Partners has grown from about $24 million in fees to nearly $200 million in fees over ten years, becoming one of the fastest growing independent public relations agencies in the world. The full-service marketing and communications company’s record setting pace is a result of organic growth and integrating new companies and new people into the FINN world through a common philosophy. With more than 1,300 professionals across 35 offices, FINN provides clients with global access and capabilities in the Americas, Europe and Asia. FINN Partners clients are also supported through longstanding partner agencies and its membership in the PROI network of leading agencies around the world.
Headquartered in New York, FINN has offices in: Abu Dhabi, Atlanta, Bangalore, Bangkok, Beijing, Boston, Chicago, Delhi, Denver, Detroit, Dublin, Fort Lauderdale, Frankfurt, Hong Kong, Honolulu, Jerusalem, Kuala Lumpur, London, Los Angeles, Madison, Manila, Mumbai, Munich, Nashville, Orange County, Paris, Portland, San Diego, San Francisco, Seattle, Shanghai, Singapore, Washington D.C. and Yangon. About Anthology FINN Partners Anthology FINN Partners is Hawaii’s only integrated marketing and communications firm with a full-service market research firm in house. With a full-time staff of 80 professionals, Anthology has enjoyed the privilege of working with Hawaii’s top corporate, nonprofit and government clients. Headquartered in Honolulu, we have a proven track record of executing successful integrated communications campaigns, and a deep bench of best-in-practice professionals across all disciplines needed to market in today’s environment.

remote.title: Director of Professional Services
remote.description:
Somewhere in your career, you walked into something that was already going wrong. A rollout three weeks from a date it was not going to hit. A team that had stopped telling anyone the truth about status. A client who had already decided you were the problem.

You did not wait for a playbook, because there was not one. You figured out what was actually broken, told people the parts they did not want to hear, and rebuilt the plan so it would hold this time. And when it landed, it landed because of how you ran it.

That is the kind of Director of Professional Services we are looking for.

What We Do

Every school district in America runs on service. Parents need answers, teachers need support, IT teams need systems that work. Most districts cobble that together with disconnected tools, overwhelmed staff, and no real visibility into what is working.

Onflo built the platform that fixes that. Our unified service platform brings together customer service, help desk ticketing, call center operations, AI chat, and IT asset management, purpose-built for K-12 public education. When a district runs on Onflo, their staff spends less time firefighting and more time serving students.

Professional Services is the team that makes that real. A district signs with us because they were promised something. Implementation, ongoing client solutioning, and client care all sit in this function, and together they decide whether that promise holds.

The Role

You would lead the function end to end. Roughly ten people across two layers, with four direct reports: three Implementation Managers, and the Manager of Professional Services who leads the Client Solutions Managers and Client Care Engineers.

The first year is largely about making the function current. Processes exist, but some were built for a smaller book of work and need modernizing. Newer systems do not have documented processes yet. Capacity is managed by judgment rather than a model. You would update what is there and build what is not, while the current book of delivery work keeps moving and districts keep going live. For the right person that is the appeal, not the catch.

What you would own:

- Delivery quality across implementation and ongoing solutioning engagements

- Client care outcomes against service levels, delivered through the Manager of Professional Services

- Post-implementation adoption, so districts realize the value they bought

- Resource and capacity planning across the function

- The methodology, templates, and standards the team runs on

- Commercial performance of the function, including scoping, pricing, and margin, with the VP and Finance

- Senior escalation point above the Implementation Manager and Manager level

- Coaching and developing your direct reports

Who Thrives Here

We will be direct with you, because we think you will appreciate it.

Onflo is a small, entrepreneurial team in the middle of a rebrand and a change to how we deliver services. We do not have a perfect playbook. Priorities shift. Communication is not always tidy. Sales will sometimes scope something your team then has to deliver. Product will not always ship on the timeline you would hope. We know that, and we are actively working on it. What we do have is a product that genuinely helps schools, districts who trust us, and a team that cares about doing the work well.

The people who do their best work here build the thing that is missing rather than waiting for it. They are close to the work without taking it over, and they know the difference. They say the unpopular thing early, to Sales, to a district, to their own VP, and they say it without making it personal. They absorb pressure rather than passing it down, because escalations are a permanent feature of this function and the team takes its temperature from whoever is leading it. They take feedback and apply it, and they still hold a point of view.

If you have spent your career waiting for clear direction, a defined process, and stable priorities before you produce, this probably is not your role. If you have spent it figuring it out and delivering anyway, keep reading.

Two Ways In

We are running two candidate paths against the same bar, because the strongest delivery leaders come from two very different places. One is software: you have led implementation, professional services, or customer success inside a technology company. The other is the district side: you have led district-wide or multi-site operational, technical, or change initiatives from inside K-12, in IT, operations, or central-office leadership.

If you are coming from a district, your resume will not say "professional services" anywhere, and that is expected. We wrote our requirements around capabilities rather than job titles, and our screeners are instructed not to filter on vendor vocabulary. If you have run something district-wide from kickoff to the day it actually worked, apply.

What We Are Looking For

- 7 to 12 years of professional experience, including 5 to 8 years managing people directly

- Personal ownership of a large-scale, multi-department rollout from kickoff through steady state, vendor-side or district-side

- Experience building a process, playbook, or operational framework where none existed, and recovering something that was genuinely at risk of failing

- A repeatable approach to making a new system stick past go-live, with a metric you moved

- Ownership of operating metrics for a team you managed, including acting when one went the wrong way

- Enough working knowledge of K-12 systems, single sign-on, student information systems, and data provisioning, to hold a credible conversation and know when to bring in a technical resource. Configuration depth is not required

- Strong communication and stakeholder management, including with Sales and Finance

- K-12 or EdTech experience on the vendor side is a plus, not a requirement

- Able to travel 10% to 25% for internal meetings, conferences, industry events, and occasional on-site work with districts

- The right person reading this already knows if they are right for it. If that is you, apply.

Compensation and Logistics

$135,000 to $160,000 base depending on experience, plus a discretionary annual bonus. Fully remote within the United States, with core operating hours of 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. Eastern. A background check is required at offer, because districts set their own access requirements and we have to meet them.

Explore our website and LinkedIn to learn more about our work and impact.

Onflo is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a team that reflects the diverse communities our clients serve. All are encouraged to apply. Onflo uses E-Verify to confirm employment eligibility. Learn more at www.DHS.gov/E-Verify

remote.title: Co-Founder & CEO — Supply Chain Tech | AI Returns Recovery
remote.description:
The Opportunity
FutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to leadRiuso, an AI recommerce venture. This is a co-founder partnership with meaningful founder equity, not a salaried executive role.
Riusois the operating record for electronics returns and liquidation benches. Owner-operated resellers and refurbishers spend around eleven minutes identifying, grading and pricing each returned or liquidated unit by hand. When the bench backs up, units default to the liquidation pallet, the lowest-value exit.Riusoidentifies and grades each unit from photos in seconds and prices every disposition route, from resell and refurb to part-out, wholesale and pallet. It then routes the unit to the highest-recovery option. Every decision becomes memory the bench owns: repeat models price instantly, seller manifest accuracy builds over time, and outbound IMEI records turn mismatched returns into winnable claims. It runs on a phone and a label printer, with no integration.
Market Context
US consumers returned an estimated $849.9B of merchandise in 2025, and North American refurbished electronics is a roughly $17B market growing at double digits. Riuso addresses a $2.2B TAM across North American returns and recommerce benches. Its beachhead is 12,000 electronics-focused owner-operators, a $144M SAM. remote.title: Director, Media Planning
remote.description:
About Mass Culture

Mass Culture is a growth media agency. We help mission-driven scale-ups connect brand and performance so they grow faster, more profitably, and with purpose.

About the Role

Mass Culture treats paid media as a single, orchestrated growth system, not a set of channels running in isolation. The Director, Media Planning owns the architecture behind that system: the cross-channel plan that connects paid social, paid search, CTV, retail media, and emerging platforms to a client's real business goals, margins, and growth stage.

This is a strategy-first role focused on planning and optimizing media execution. You will build the media plans clients act on, defend the logic behind budget allocation across channels, and make sure up-funnel and down-funnel investment work together instead of competing for the same dollar. You will stay close enough to the campaigns themselves to know when a plan needs to change, and why, and you will be the one to change it.

You will say what you expect each dollar to do before you spend it, define in advance what would make you move it, and come back to every allocation decision to say whether it worked. That is a higher bar than most agencies hold themselves to, and it is why clients trust us with the whole mix instead of one channel.

You will plan inside a proprietary platform. Channel budgets and line items, monthly pacing, KPI targets, market splits, and a surplus ledger that records the rationale behind every dollar that moves. You will co-own the planning surfaces of that product alongside agency leadership. What a plan should capture, and what we should be able to model before committing a budget.

Responsibilities:

Media Strategy & Planning

- Build full-funnel, cross-channel media plans that tie budget allocation, channel mix, and pacing directly to each client's revenue, margin, and growth targets.

- Define the role each channel plays in the plan, whether that is reach, demand capture, retention, or proof, before arguing its number.

- Own the media mix model for assigned accounts: determine how up-funnel investment (CTV, paid social awareness, emerging platforms) and down-funnel investment (paid search, retargeting, retail media) should work together, and adjust as performance and market conditions shift.

- Translate client business objectives into measurable media plans, KPIs, and testing roadmaps.

- Lead media planning sessions with clients, presenting the strategic rationale behind channel and budget decisions, not just the numbers.

The Allocation Argument

- Set reallocation triggers up front: the conditions under which money moves, agreed in collaboration with the client.

- Defend the plan without inflating it. Say what we don't know. And call out risks and assumptions.

- Hold the up-funnel line. The hardest budget to defend is the one that doesn't convert this week. Build that case in advance, with evidence from the analytics team.

- Grade our own allocations. Revisit every significant allocation decision against what actually happened, and say plainly when we got it right and when we got it wrong.

Cross-Channel Orchestration

- Partner with channel leads across paid social, paid search, CTV, and retail media to ensure each channel's execution ladders up to one plan.

- Identify where channels are working against each other, where budget is misallocated, and where a mixed media stack would reduce risk and capture more attention.

- Use the agency's forecasting and planning models to show clients how channels interact, not just how each performs on its own.

In-Flight Budget Management

- Own budget pacing across assigned accounts. Know where every account stands against plan, and act before a month closes badly rather than explaining it afterward.

- Own reallocation end to end. When a channel underdelivers, you decide where the money goes, and the rationale gets written down at the moment of the decision.

- Maintain the surplus ledger for your accounts: what moved, from where, to where, and why.

Measurement Partnership

- Define the business questions worth testing and commission the work from the analytics team: incrementality tests, geo experiments, holdouts, and media mix experiments.

- Turn measurement findings into budget decisions. A test that changes no allocation was either the wrong test or the wrong response.

- Work to the agency's measurement standards rather than a parallel set. One definition of a metric, agency-wide.

Client Leadership

- Serve as a senior strategic voice in client conversations, leading planning sessions and budget reviews with clarity and a clear point of view.

- Partner with Account Strategists in QBRs, owning the media plan and the investment narrative while they own the relationship.

- Translate performance data into business recommendations focused on revenue, margin, and efficiency, not platform vanity metrics.

- Act as an escalation point for planning and strategy questions on assigned accounts.

Platform & Product Partnership

- Co-own the planning surfaces of the Mass Culture client portal with agency leadership: what a media plan captures, how reallocation is recorded, and what we should be able to model before committing a budget.

- Build in the platform directly. You will construct plans, pacing views, and budget structures yourself rather than handing a spreadsheet to someone else.

Team & Growth

- Plan our most complex accounts personally, and build and lead the planning team behind them as the book grows.

- Set the standard for what a Mass Culture media plan looks like, and coach strategists and channel leads to it.

- Contribute media planning expertise to new business pitches and client onboarding.

Tools, Automation & AI

- Use media mix modeling, forecasting, and reporting tools to build plans grounded in data, not instinct.

- Incorporate AI tools into planning and analysis workflows to sharpen forecasting and surface patterns faster. AI should make good planners better, not replace their judgment.

- Stay current on new platforms, ad formats, and measurement approaches, and bring what's relevant to clients before they ask.

What We're Looking For

Required

- 10+ years of media planning or cross-channel strategy experience, ideally within a performance-driven or growth marketing agency.

- Proven ability to build media plans that connect budget allocation across paid social, paid search, CTV, and other channels to business outcomes, not just channel-level KPIs.

- Experience planning and managing budgets from small test allocations through multi-million-dollar annual books.

- Strong command of media mix modeling, incrementality testing, and cross-channel attribution. Enough to commission the right test and interrogate the result, whether or not you run it yourself.

- Fluency in direct-response economics: CAC, LTV, contribution margin, and the difference between blended and incremental efficiency.

- Track record leading senior client conversations and defending strategic recommendations under scrutiny.

- A plan you got wrong, and what you changed because of it. We will ask.

- Practical experience incorporating AI tools into planning, forecasting, or analytical workflows.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to connect media strategy to revenue and margin.

- Agency environment experience required.

Nice to Have

- Experience with retail media platforms (Amazon, Walmart Connect, Instacart Ads) as part of a broader media mix.

- Experience building or specifying planning and forecasting tools rather than only using them.

- Experience managing or mentoring media planners.

Why Mass Culture

We are not a traditional agency. We work inside our clients' businesses, connect media strategy to real commercial outcomes, and treat growth as a system. Our sister company, Brains, is a world-class branding agency, and that relationship is real. We love brand as much as we love performance.

No hacking. No smoke and mirrors. Real growth.

remote.title: AI Architect
remote.description:
Principal Data Scientist, AI (Architect-Level Scope)
About KLDiscovery

KLDiscovery is a global eDiscovery and legal technology provider serving large law firms, corporate legal departments, and government agencies. We build and operate the products and services that legal teams rely on to manage, process, and review case data at scale. With operations across multiple countries and a client base that includes AmLaw 200 firms, we handle some of the largest and most complex matters in the industry.
About the Role
We're hiring our most senior AI practitioner — someone with genuine data science rigor who also wants to build. In this role, you'll set the scientific and architectural direction for gen AI and ML at KLDiscovery: designing the evaluation methodology that proves our AI holds up under legal scrutiny, choosing and validating the models and retrieval systems that power our products, and building the hardest parts of that system yourself.
This is one of the most interesting data science problem sets in enterprise software. You'll work with terabytes of real-world legal data — emails, contracts, chat transcripts, images, video, depositions, and regulatory filings — from some of the largest litigation and investigation matters in the world. The work is hard in ways that matter: documents are messy and adversarial, the stakes are real (privilege, defensibility, attorney work product), and getting the evaluation wrong has real consequences. AI that can surface key people, themes, and timelines in hours instead of weeks, or pre-classify millions of documents for relevance and privilege with results that survive scrutiny, directly changes the economics of how legal matters get resolved. We build solutions that turn data into evidence the legal system can trust.
This is a builder-first role, not a research-only or advisory one. You'll design experiments and evaluation frameworks that prove our AI is defensible in court, build the retrieval and agent systems that reason over case data, and personally ship the hardest, most novel parts of that system. You'll set strategic direction across Nebula, our eDiscovery platform, and CS & Operations, then prove out the science and the architecture by building it yourself. Not a role for anyone stepping back from the keyboard, and not a role for anyone who treats evaluation as an afterthought.
We offer competitive total compensation that includes base pay, bonus potential, equity, inclusive benefits, wellness programs, and perks. We use market and industry data to inform pay decisions while considering geography and labor markets, individual experience, and business needs. Individual compensation will vary, although a reasonable estimate of the current annualized base pay range for this position is $190,000 to $240,000.
Job location: Remote (candidate must be based in the United States)
Key Responsibilities
Own the science and the architecture, and build both personally. Design the experimentation and evaluation methodology that determines whether our AI's outputs are accurate, consistent, and defensible — then define the end-to-end gen AI architecture across Nebula and CS & Operations to deliver on it: LLMs, agent harnesses, RAG, vector search, embeddings, and model selection and triage. Build the hardest parts personally: prototype agent loops, design and run the evaluations that validate them, tune retrieval, and ship the shared infrastructure that powers AI Case Explorer (case overviews, timelines, key people and themes, PII surfacing, and Agent chat), AI Agent Review (pre-classifying relevance, privilege, and key issues, shipping MLP), and CS & Ops tech-enablement as part of our central work orchestration system.
Own evaluation rigor, AI/MLOps, and telemetry end-to-end. Design the statistical and experimental methodology behind our evaluation harnesses — the standard our outputs have to meet to hold up under legal scrutiny — and own the infrastructure that enforces it: model deployment and versioning, eval pipelines, drift and quality monitoring, cost and latency telemetry, and prompt and agent observability. Define and implement how we select, triage, and route across models (Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, open-source, fine-tuned), manage vector databases and retrieval, and evolve our evaluation methodology and agent harness as the frontier moves.
Lead the practice from the front. Set the technical and scientific bar by building, not by reviewing. Partner with Engineering, Product, and Data Science leadership to translate that rigor into shipped product. Raise the bar on both AI engineering and evaluation discipline, mentor senior ICs through hands-on technical leadership, build and maintain relationships with model and infrastructure vendors, and represent KLD's AI strategy directly with customers, partners, and at industry events.
What You Bring (Required)

- 7+ years in data science, applied AI/ML, or ML engineering, with recent hands-on experience as a senior or principal-level practitioner in the gen AI era

- Real training in statistics, experimentation, or applied research you know how to design an evaluation that actually tests what you think it tests, not just one that looks reasonable

- Proven track record architecting and personally building enterprise gen AI systems in production with measurable customer impact

- Experience with consumer-facing or B2B customer-facing AI products — systems that real external users or customers depend on, not only internal tooling

- Builder at heart: still writes code, runs experiments, ships, and tunes prompts and evals, and wants to keep doing so as a leader

- Deep expertise across the modern gen AI stack: LLMs, agents, RAG, vector databases, embeddings, search, and evaluation harnesses

- Hands-on experience designing system-of-systems AI pipelines spanning search, retrieval, agent harnesses, and model selection/triage

- Strong proficiency with the Microsoft AI stack: Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, and supporting Azure infrastructure

- Excellent technical leadership skills; demonstrated ability to influence architecture and methodology decisions across product, engineering, and data science

- Strong communication skills, including explaining evaluation results and architecture trade-offs to executive and customer audiences

- Career experience spanning both a larger, established technology company and a smaller company or startup — comfortable operating with both institutional rigor and startup pace

- Mentor team members and contribute to a culture of continuous improvement

Nice to Have (Preferred)

- Advanced degree (MS or PhD) in Statistics, Machine Learning, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field

- Peer-reviewed publications, technical writing, conference talks, or other evidence of contributing to the field, not just building within it

- Background building agentic systems with tool use, planning, and multi-step reasoning in production

- Prior experience setting up AI governance and evaluation harnesses in a regulated or high-stakes domain

- Open-source contributions or other evidence of being a recognized builder in the AI community

- A demonstrated track record of sticking with hard, ambiguous problems over long timeframes rather than pivoting away when the first approach doesn't work.

Location: Your university campus / flexible remote working in EMEA, Asia or ANZ.
Contract: Paid Student Ambassador opportunity
Time commitment: Approximately 26–37 hours across the programme
Payment: £350–£500 (or local currency equivalent), depending on programme length

Turn your university experience into career experience
Want to build your CV, develop your communication and marketing skills, and help other students get more from the digital learning tools available to them?

We’re looking for enthusiastic, creative and reliable students to join us as Cengage Student Ambassadors.

This is a flexible, paid opportunity designed to fit around your studies. You’ll become a student voice for Cengage at your university, helping fellow students get started with and make effective use of Cengage digital learning products.
Along the way, you’ll gain practical experience in areas including marketing, content creation, communication, peer support and student engagement – all while working with a global education company.

What will you do?
As a Cengage Student Ambassador, you’ll help students at your university get the most from the Cengage products available to them.

Your activities could include:

- Helping fellow students get started with and use Cengage digital learning products

- Supporting student onboarding sessions, in-class activities, demonstrations or peer Q&As

- Creating social media content about Cengage products, student activities and your experience as an Ambassador

- Writing student-focused content about your experience of digital learning

- Creating a short video or testimonial about your experience with Cengage

- Sharing authentic feedback and student perspectives with our team

- Supporting selected Cengage marketing or student engagement activities

- Attending training sessions and programme check-ins with the Cengage team

You won't be expected to know everything from day one. We'll provide training and guidance to help you understand our products, plan your activities and make the most of the programme.

Who are we looking for?
You don't need extensive work experience. We're much more interested in your enthusiasm, ideas and ability to connect with other students.

You'll be a great fit if you:

- Are currently enrolled as an undergraduate, postgraduate or PhD student

- Study at an institution using a relevant Cengage digital learning product

- Are a confident and friendly communicator

- Enjoy helping and engaging with other students

- Are organised, reliable and comfortable managing your own time

- Can work independently and meet agreed deadlines

- Are interested in creating content or using social media

- Are comfortable getting involved in student-facing activities

Experience with social media, video creation, presenting, student societies, peer support or campus activities would be useful, but isn't essential.

What you'll get
As a Cengage Student Ambassador, you'll gain practical experience that you can add to your CV and talk about in future interviews, including:

- Working with a global education and technology company

- Marketing and social media experience

- Content and video creation

- Presentation and communication skills

- Student engagement and peer support

- Experience managing your own activities and deadlines

- The opportunity to share the student voice directly with Cengage

Most importantly, you'll play a role in helping fellow students get more from the digital learning tools designed to support their studies.

How does the programme work?
The programme is designed to fit around your studies. Rather than working fixed weekly hours, you'll complete a series of agreed activities and can organise much of the work around your own schedule.

Depending on your location and programme length, the expected commitment will be approximately 26 hours over a six-month programme or 37 hours over a nine-month/full programme.

You'll also attend three online training sessions and a programme check-in, giving you support and guidance throughout your time as an Ambassador.

Payment
This is a paid opportunity.

Depending on programme length and location, Ambassadors will receive:
£350 (or local equivalent) for the shorter/pro-rated programme, or
£500 (or local equivalent) for the full programme.

Payments will be made in stages during the programme, subject to completion of the agreed activities.

About Cengage
Cengage is a global education technology company helping millions of learners develop the skills and knowledge they need to achieve their goals.
As a Cengage Student Ambassador, you'll help us make sure our digital learning products don't just reach universities – they genuinely reach, engage and support the students they're designed for.

Interested? We'd love to hear from you.
Apply to become a Cengage Student Ambassador and turn your student experience into experience that can help shape your future career.

remote.description:
About Us!
At Sourcing Unicorns, we recruit globally across the creative and experiential industry, always on the lookout for exceptional talent to bring bold ideas to life. For this opportunity, we’re proud to collaborate with the team at Fivestone Studios to find the unicorn, the one who will truly make a difference. About Fivestone Studios!
Fivestone Studios is a Nashville-based creative media agency that an international clientele trust as their creative secret weapon. Our MO is taking on giants and making heroes of our clients through an impressive arsenal of strategy, design, digital media production & interactive technology capabilities.
Our primary goal at Fivestone Studios is to make a space for creative warriors to grow, thrive and take on their own giants. We use our Five Stones as our lens for success and our foundation for a healthy culture: honor, bravery, vision, generosity and excellence. If you have a passion for teamwork, are willing to leave your ego at the door, and have a strong drive for creative excellence, we would love to talk.
Your Mission
We are seeking a Lead Unreal Engine Developer to take technical ownership of the architecture, development, integration, and final delivery of a complex Unreal Engine application for an immersive, interactive experience.
In this role, you will bridge creative development, technical art, third-party software development, and physical AV systems integration.
You will be responsible for maintaining the Technical Design Document, defining the application's technical architecture, coordinating development tasks, and ensuring that all software components integrate into a stable, optimized, and deployable application.
We are looking for a hands-on technical leader who can balance creative ambition with practical implementation, proactively identify technical risks, collaborate with cross-disciplinary teams, and make informed technical decisions throughout production.
PS.: Candidates must be able to work and collaborate during US business hours (US time zones), regardless of their location.
Roles and Responsibilities
1. Technical Architecture & Documentation

- Own, develop, and maintain the Technical Design Document (TDD).

- Define application architecture, software dependencies, integration requirements, and technical workflows.

- Establish development standards and best practices for C++, Blueprints, project organization, and source control.

- Identify technical risks, performance constraints, and potential integration challenges early in development.

- Document the final application architecture and deployment requirements for ongoing maintenance and support.

2. Unreal Engine Application Development & Delivery

- Lead the development, integration, optimization, and delivery of the final Unreal Engine application.

- Implement and maintain core application systems using C++ and Blueprints.

- Integrate independently developed features, assets, and visual systems into a unified application.

- Troubleshoot performance, rendering, compatibility, and application stability issues.

- Manage application packaging, deployment configurations, and final production builds.

- Support system testing, debugging, and final deployment.

3. Development Planning & JIRA Support

- Collaborate with the Producer and development team to translate technical requirements into actionable JIRA tasks.

- Define technical dependencies, implementation priorities, and acceptance criteria.

- Provide technical estimates and identify potential development blockers.

- Review completed work to ensure consistency with the overall application architecture.

- Communicate technical progress, risks, and integration requirements to project stakeholders.

4. AV Hardware Consultation & Integration

- Collaborate with AV integrators and hardware vendors to ensure the Unreal application operates correctly within the specified hardware environment.

- Consult on GPU/CPU requirements, rendering performance, display configurations, and system architecture.

- Support integration with external hardware, display systems, and control interfaces.

- Identify and resolve hardware/software compatibility and performance challenges.

- Participate in system testing, commissioning, and deployment as needed.

5. Web Overlay & UI Integration

- Coordinate with a third-party web development vendor responsible for creating web-based UI overlays.

- Define and support communication interfaces between Unreal Engine and web-based UI components.

- Integrate web overlays into the Unreal application, ensuring reliable communication, rendering, and interaction.

- Troubleshoot integration issues and collaborate with the vendor on performance and compatibility.

6. Technical Art & Real-Time Visual Integration

- Collaborate with Unreal Technical Artists to integrate real-time graphics, shaders, materials, effects, and visual systems.

- Establish performance budgets and technical guidelines for externally developed visual content.

- Evaluate and optimize visual assets to meet target frame rates and hardware requirements.

- Troubleshoot rendering, shader, material, and Blueprint integration issues.

- Ensure independently developed visual systems function cohesively within the final application.

Requirements
Your Journey Includes
Must Have Experience

- Unreal Engine: Advanced experience developing and delivering applications using Unreal Engine 5.

- C++ Programming: Strong proficiency in Unreal C++ development, debugging, and application architecture.

- Blueprints: Advanced knowledge of Blueprint systems and best practices for combining Blueprints with C++.

- Graphics & Performance Optimization: Experience profiling and optimizing GPU/CPU performance, shaders, materials, and real-time rendering.

- Application Architecture: Experience designing modular, maintainable software systems and integrating work from multiple developers.

- Technical Leadership: Ability to take ownership of technical decisions, coordinate dependencies, and guide development efforts across multiple disciplines.

- Source Control & Collaboration: Experience with Git, Perforce, or equivalent version control systems.

- Production Delivery: Experience building, troubleshooting, packaging, and deploying production-ready Unreal Engine applications.

Nice to Have Experience

- JavaScript / TypeScript: Familiarity with modern web development and communication between native applications and browser-based interfaces.

- React: Experience integrating React-based interfaces or web overlays with Unreal Engine.

- AI-Assisted Programming: Practical experience using AI coding assistants to improve development efficiency, debugging, and documentation.

- Shader & Material Development: Experience building custom shaders, materials, and advanced rendering effects in Unreal Engine.

- Immersive & Interactive Installations: Experience developing software for museums, exhibitions, themed entertainment, or location-based experiences.

- AV & Show Control Systems: Experience with external control systems, hardware communication protocols, and real-time event-driven applications.

- Deployment & Reliability: Experience with unattended installations, application monitoring, recovery workflows, and long-duration runtime stability.

Roles in experiential can be ultra-specialized; if it's not a fit for this one, we may still flag your profile for future opportunities.
