remote.title: Member of Accounting Staff
remote.description:
This role is fully remote, open to candidates based anywhere in the United States outside New York. Based in New York? Apply to the New York posting of this role instead.
A Different Kind Of Job Description
At Filed, we believe in radical transparency. Everything is open: company finances, team salaries, stock options, anonymous team feedback. That extends to how we talk about this job, so what you'll read here looks a little different from other job ads. It starts with why this is a terrible job. Then it explains why it might be the best career move you'll ever make.
Why this is a terrible job
This is an incredibly high-paced, high-tempo environment. We're making a generational bet to change all of our lives, and generational bets are not comfortable.
You will stop signing returns. There are no clients of your own here, no book to build, no partner track. If the thing you want is the next rung on a firm ladder, this job takes it away from you on day one.
You will be on calls most of the day. You carry 5 to 10 firms at a time through onboarding and you own whether they actually succeed, for 8 weeks each, with your name attached. When a firm is floundering in week six, that is yours to fix, and there is nowhere in this job to hide from it.
The calendar is not negotiable. Firms will not change their stack mid-season, so December and January are relentless and everything has to land before the February 1 freeze. Miss the window and you wait a year.
Tax law is objective, but what applies under it and how professionals interpret it is full of judgment. You can give two tax professionals the same task and get two different results where both are right. You will sit across from a partner who disagrees with what the system did, and you will have to explain it in their language, without hiding behind the software. At times it will feel like hitting your head against the wall.
Customers will sometimes get frustrated, because they expect deterministic results from probabilistic systems, and we're managing the expectations of some of the biggest firms in the world, including the Big Four. You will be the person in the room who has actually done their job, which means the hard calls land with you.
And the rhythm is real. It's tough. It's relentless.
Why it might be the best career choice you'll ever make
You already know how to win a room full of sceptical tax professionals, because you have been one. Here that is the whole job, and it compounds: every firm you bring through onboarding properly becomes a firm that stays, refers, and grows.
It's addictive to be part of a business when you know you're winning. Filed is adding millions of dollars of revenue every quarter, and in under two years we've become the market leader in a space with entrenched incumbents and a drastic need for new AI tools. When we come into head-to-heads with competitors, we win every time, because our product is superior.
The industry looks boring from the outside, but the problem is unsolved, and the space has been riddled with products below the mark for decades. When you push through the wall, there's a spark of joy: a customer says "wow, this is phenomenal." That keeps happening, and you will be the one in the room when it does.
The opportunity here is not only to make a great deal of money. It's to have real impact on our mission: making this profession extraordinary. Nobody became a tax professional for the admin. They got into this work to be creative with tax law, to have fun, and to change the fabric of society. Filed enables them to do exactly that.
We've raised $17.2 million to date, led by Northzone. Our focus now is to deliver the roadmap and continue to win.
What You'll Own
As a Member of Accounting Staff, you own the moment a firm goes from signed to genuinely working:

- The technical demo on customer calls, where you show firms what Filed does and why it answers the problem you have lived yourself

- Group onboarding, 5 to 10 firms at a time, from kickoff to the point where the firm is running real work through Filed without you

- The relationship through the 8 weeks that decide whether a firm succeeds or quietly churns

- The feedback loop back into product, so the friction you watch firms hit gets fixed rather than repeated

You'll see your decisions carry real weight for some of the most demanding professional users in the world within days, not quarters.
What You'll Be Responsible For

- Running the technical demo alongside sales on firms that need a tax professional in the room

- Onboarding firms in groups and staying their point person until they are genuinely winning, backed by customer support

- Teaching: webinars, training sessions, and the ongoing work of making firms good at Filed

- Translating between firms and engineering, so what you hear on calls turns into what gets built

- Knowing the product well enough to be trusted on it, including catching output that would not pass a reviewer

Your Hard Skillset

- You have prepared or reviewed real returns inside a real firm. Credentials are welcome but not required, what matters is that you've done the work

- Real strength in either individual returns (1040) or business returns (1065, 1120, 1120-S, 990, 1041), enough that a partner takes you seriously in the first five minutes. One or the other is enough. Strength in both is a plus

- You are comfortable in front of customers. Demos, training, difficult conversations, escalations

- A high degree of confidence in a few of the major tax platforms, such as CCH Axcess, UltraTax, Lacerte, ProConnect, Drake, or GoSystem. Nobody is expert in all of them, and we don't expect you to be

- You pick up software fast. A product surface, a new workflow, an integration conversation, none of it puts you off

- Bonus if you've been through a SurePrep, GruntWorx, or AutoFlow implementation, or rolled new software out across a firm

Your Soft Skillset

- Comfortable being uncomfortable and making calls with incomplete data

- Empathetic and curious: building for the user, not just for the technically correct answer

- Highly collaborative across product, engineering, and tax

- Detail-oriented but pragmatic: you know when precision matters and when to move

- You own your work and welcome the accountability that comes with it

A championship team
We think of ourselves as a sports team. Incredibly high performance, incredibly high standards, and real success to show for it. Being a championship team means working with people who are deeply proud of the work they do and have great fun doing it together.
We measure employee happiness constantly, and our eNPS is +60. We don't say that to brag. We say it because a team playing at this tempo only holds together if people genuinely love being on it. Every four months, the whole company comes together for an offsite.
What Filed Stands For
Not posters. Not corporate language. Real operating standards.
No problem is someone else's problem. If you see it, it's yours. Bugs, customer confusion, missed expectations, internal friction. We don't pass problems sideways and we don't hide behind roles. You fix the typo even if you didn't write it, jump into a customer issue even if it's not your department, escalate early, and close loops fully. Ownership means you drive resolution, not that you suffer silently or burn out doing everything alone.
Waiting is not a strategy. Momentum is our advantage. We don't wait for perfect information or stall because something is unclear. You ship a V1 instead of debating V5, test instead of theorize, run small experiments instead of requesting big approvals, and propose solutions instead of just naming blockers. Speed is powerful. Sloppiness is not, and recklessness has no place in a high-trust industry.
We run toward the fire. When something breaks, we move. Tax is high-stakes and trust is fragile. We acknowledge issues immediately, communicate clearly and often, prioritize customer-impacting problems fast, and stay on it until it's fully resolved. Firefighting is a strength, not panic, and never an excuse for preventable mistakes.
We win on customer experience. AI will commoditize. Features will copy. Pricing will compress. Experience won't. We respond faster than customers expect, communicate proactively, think like a partner rather than a ticketing system, and anticipate needs before they're raised. Overdelivering means raising the standard of care, not overpromising, hero culture, or burning the team out.
Who This Suits
This is a very fun environment, but it only suits people who meet the criteria we're looking for:

- People who want to win

- People who have a point to prove

- People who want to write their own job descriptions

How We Pay
Nothing at Filed is behind closed doors. Everyone here sees everyone else's salary, because we believe transparency creates trust, and trust is the foundation of excellent teamwork. Compensation isn't a negotiation. Depending on your location, everyone receives the same three offers, and all of our offers are above market benchmarking.
This role is assessed at Level 3. The salary and equity bandings are:

- Most Equity: $85,800 per year + $130,027 of equity

- Great Equity: $93,600 per year + $86,684 of equity

- Good Equity: $101,400 per year + $43,342 of equity

We run performance reviews every four months. Meet your goals and you can expect to double your equity by the end of your first year.
One more thing, in the spirit of transparency: some people who apply for this role will be assessed at a different level. If the team determines your level of responsibility sits differently, we'll adjust the offer accordingly.
Benefits

- Platinum-level medical insurance, fully covered for you, with 100% coverage for your dependents as well

- Dental insurance

- Vision insurance

- 401(k) retirement plan

- Paid maternity and paternity leave

- A minimum of 30 days of paid holiday every year

- Your choice of the latest and greatest computers, plus a budget for your home office setup

- Company-wide offsites every four months

The process

- Quick intro call (30 minutes)

- Product walkthrough and async exercise (60 minutes)

- Final round with our team (60 minutes)

In just 2.5 hours, you'll be wanting early access, just like the rest of our team, to get into the product and start building a generational company, even before your first day.
About Filed

Filed is the AI tax preparer trusted by America's accounting firms.
Taxes might seem boring, but they are the $5 trillion backbone of the US economy. Globally, nearly $15 trillion in taxes is collected every year. Behind every dollar of it sits a professional making judgment calls, and the industry that does this work is breaking under a talent shortage no one has solved. We're fixing it. Firms run Filed inside the systems they already use, and we're backed by Northzone, Neo, Analog, and Raine.
There has never been a more exciting time to work on a problem this complex. Join us while "I was there when it all started" is still true.

About VictoriaMetrics
We are the company behind the popular open-source, high-performance time-series database and monitoring solution: VictoriaMetrics. Fortune 500 companies rely on our products as their core monitoring infrastructure. Our technology is trusted by Adidas, Wix, Grammarly, CERN, and thousands of engineering teams worldwide.
We are self-funded, profitable, and growing — which means every enterprise deal matters, and every salesperson has genuine leverage. There is no bureaucracy between you and the market.
About the Opportunity
After six years of strong growth in Europe and North America — driven primarily by inbound and community-led demand — we are now building the enterprise sales function that will take VictoriaMetrics to the next level. This is not a role for someone looking to work an existing playbook. We are looking for a Senior Enterprise AE who can navigate complex, technical sales cycles, build executive relationships, and close deals that matter.
You will work closely with Sales leadership, Solutions Engineering, and Customer Success to move enterprise accounts from first conversation to signed contract — and then expand them. The role spans new logo acquisition and expansion within existing accounts, with a strong emphasis on the US market and growing coverage across Europe and APAC.
Our buyers are engineers, SREs, DevOps leads, and infrastructure architects. They are sophisticated, skeptical of vendor hype, and deeply value technical credibility. If you enjoy selling to people who can tell when you don't know what you're talking about — and can hold your own in those conversations — this role is for you.
Our Values
We hire for a specific combination of traits. Our formula:
Impact = Ownership × Quality × Creativity × Speed × Integrity
Ownership -You act like a founder of the revenue engine — not a passenger. You own your pipeline, your accounts, and your results.
Quality -You build durable customer relationships, not fragile wins. High standards in every proposal, conversation, and follow-up.
Creativity -You find non-obvious paths to revenue. You adapt the playbook, or invent a new one, when the situation demands it.
Speed -You test, learn, and iterate quickly. You move with urgency but not at the cost of accuracy or trust.
Integrity -You do the right thing even when it costs you. You build trust with customers and colleagues — and you keep it.
We are looking for someone who embodies these values — not as a performance in interviews, but as a genuine way of working. You will be evaluated on them throughout the hiring process and in performance reviews.
What You Will Do
Own the Enterprise Sales Cycle

- Run end-to-end sales cycles for new enterprise accounts — from outbound prospecting and inbound qualification through to commercial negotiation and close.

- Manage complex, multi-stakeholder deals across technical champions (SREs, DevOps engineers), economic buyers, and procurement — applying MEDDIC to drive rigorous qualification throughout.

- Develop and execute account plans for strategic targets, including stakeholder mapping, value proposition alignment, and competitive positioning.

- Accurately forecast your pipeline and maintain a healthy, documented book of business in HubSpot.

Drive Expansion Within Existing Accounts

- Identify and execute upsell and cross-sell opportunities within the existing customer base — from open-source adoption to VictoriaMetrics Enterprise and VictoriaLogs.

- Partner with Customer Success to monitor account health, identify expansion signals, and ensure renewals are protected and grown.

- Build multi-threaded relationships within strategic accounts so that no deal is dependent on a single contact.

Engage Technical Buyers with Credibility

- Understand VictoriaMetrics products deeply enough to hold substantive conversations with engineers about architecture, performance, and TCO.

- Articulate the value of the enterprise offering over the open-source product — not just through feature comparison, but through total cost of ownership, support, compliance, and scale arguments.

- Work with Solutions Engineering on technical evaluations, proof-of-concepts, and competitive bakeoffs.

- Stay current on the observability and monitoring landscape — Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, Elastic, and adjacent technologies — to position VictoriaMetrics with confidence.

Contribute to the Go-To-Market System

- Feed structured deal intelligence — objections, competitive dynamics, persona insights, pricing friction — back into Marketing, Product, and Sales leadership.

- Collaborate with the BDR team on targeted account strategies and ensure smooth handoffs in both directions.

- Contribute to playbook development, competitive battlecards, and sales enablement materials as the function matures.

- Represent VictoriaMetrics at industry events, conferences, and customer meetings.

About You
Experience & Qualifications

- 5+ years of B2B enterprise software sales, with a consistent track record of meeting or exceeding quota.

- 3+ years selling open-source, open-core, or developer-first software — you understand how community adoption translates into commercial pipeline.

- Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles with deal sizes of $100K+ ACV.

- Proven ability to sell into DevOps, infrastructure, observability, or adjacent technical domains.

- Proficiency with MEDDIC or a comparable enterprise qualification framework.

- Hands-on with HubSpot or a comparable CRM; comfortable maintaining rigorous pipeline hygiene.

- Fluent in English; additional European languages are a meaningful advantage.

What Sets You Apart

- Technically fluent: you can hold a substantive conversation with an SRE or infrastructure engineer without relying on a solutions engineer to translate.

- Commercially sharp: you understand contract structure, pricing models (on-prem, SaaS, consumption), and how to navigate procurement without losing margin.

- Strategically patient: you know when to push and when to wait. You build relationships that outlast individual deals.

- Genuinely curious about the product: you have explored VictoriaMetrics, understand why engineers choose it, and can speak credibly about what it does and does not do.

- Builder mindset: you are comfortable in an environment where not everything is defined. You contribute to the system, not just work within it.

Together We Will

- Build an enterprise sales motion that scales beyond inbound — and becomes a competitive advantage for VictoriaMetrics.

- Close deals with engineering-led organisations that are building the infrastructure of tomorrow.

- Develop a commercial approach to the open-source-to-enterprise journey that others in the industry will study.

- Give you the autonomy, support, and tooling to do your best work — with competitive compensation, performance bonuses, flexible hours, and a remote-first culture built on trust.

remote.title: Technical Co-founder (CTO) - AI Workforce for Solo Practitioners and Small Law F
remote.description:
The Opportunity
AI is changing the economics of legal practice. Work that once took hours can increasingly be done in minutes, creating both enormous leverage for lawyers and new pressure to win and serve more clients efficiently.
Yet solo practitioners and small law firms still face many of the same constraints: missed calls, slow follow-up, intake handled between client matters, inconsistent marketing, and administrative work competing with billable time. Building larger intake, administrative, and marketing teams is expensive and increasingly unnecessary.
BloomLex is building a different model: a managed AI workforce that helps small law firms grow without growing their team.
The customer thesis has been validated through live pilots, and multiple deployments are moving into production evaluation. The next phase is proving in-production reliability, delivery economics, repeatability, and scalability. The companies that successfully deploy trusted AI workers into professional-service verticals over the next 18 months have an opportunity to define entirely new categories. We intend to be one of them.
The Venture
BloomLex is building an AI workforce for solo practitioners and small law firms, helping them win and serve more clients without adding headcount.
We call the broader shift the Rise of the Solo: AI gives an individual lawyer or a small firm access to capabilities that historically required a much larger organization.
Unlike self-serve software, BloomLex is fully managed. We configure, deploy, monitor, and continuously improve the AI workforce for each firm. Our customers evaluate us on outcomes — calls answered, prospective clients captured, consultations booked, demand generated, follow-up completed, and time saved — not on how much software they configure themselves.
Our Bloomlex workforce starts with two teammates:
Ava — AI Front Desk. Ava answers calls 24/7, handles structured intake, screens and routes inquiries, books consultations, performs outbound callbacks and follow-up, and integrates those interactions into the firm's workflow.
Claire — AI Marketing Assistant. Claire helps firms generate and nurture demand through content, digital marketing, campaign management and optimization, lead nurturing, and ongoing marketing execution.
Together, Ava and Claire address both sides of growth: Claire helps create demand; Ava helps ensure that demand is captured and converted.
They are also the beginning, not the end, of the platform. Our roadmap expands the AI workforce across the operational side of the practice — including custom workflows and additional specialized AI roles — all delivered through the same managed model and coordinated around the lawyer.
The Partnership
The CEO co-founder is in place. The customer thesis is validated, design partners are engaged, live pilots are running, and the initial product architecture exists. What remains is to bring on the technical co-founder — a partner who will own product and engineering with the same conviction, urgency, and ownership as the CEO.
This is a co-founder role, not a CTO hire. In return for that level of commitment, you receive founder-level equity, founder-level authority with decision collaboration on product, technology, hiring, fundraising, and strategy, and a genuine partnership with the CEO on every material decision.
You will inherit working products and live deployments, but you will not inherit sacred architecture. Your job is to determine what should survive, what should be rebuilt, and what needs to exist for BloomLex to scale from pilots to thousands of firms.
Role & Responsibilities
As Co-Founder & CTO, you will be a hands-on builder first and the architect of the technical organization that follows.

- Product & Architecture — Own the technical architecture across Ava, Claire, and the broader BloomLex AI workforce. Make the build-versus-buy decisions that determine where BloomLex creates durable technical advantage.

- Voice AI & Reliability — Harden Ava's real-time voice, telephony, intake, scheduling, routing, and workflow systems for production reliability. Establish observability, evaluation, escalation, and audit-trail standards appropriate for a trust-sensitive environment.

- Agentic Workflows — Build reliable AI systems capable of executing multi-step operational and marketing workflows across voice, email, SMS, web, calendars, CRM and practice-management systems, with appropriate human oversight.

- Managed AI Delivery Layer — Build the internal infrastructure that allows BloomLex to configure, deploy, monitor, evaluate, and continuously improve AI workers across hundreds and eventually thousands of firms without scaling engineering or implementation headcount linearly.

- AI Quality & Economics — Own the trade-offs among model capability, latency, reliability, privacy, and inference cost. Build an architecture capable of delivering strong gross margins within the initial ~$499/month product model as usage scales.

- Data, Security & Trust — Establish the security, privacy, tenancy, permissions, data-retention, and audit architecture required to earn the trust of law firms and their clients.

- Customer & Market — Work directly with lawyers and design partners, translating real-world workflows and failure modes into product decisions. Represent BloomLex with customers, partners, and investors as the technical voice of the company.

- Roadmap — Help convert pilots into repeatable commercial deployments, expand the AI workforce beyond Ava and Claire, deepen integrations into law-firm workflows, and establish a path toward custom and self-hosted models where economics, performance, privacy, or legal requirements justify them.

- Team — Recruit and lead the founding engineering team and establish a culture of speed, accountability, technical rigour, and customer obsession.

Co-Founder Profile
We are looking for a technical founder, not simply an engineering manager.
You have:

- Shipped LLM-powered, agentic, voice, or automation systems into production environments where incorrect outputs and system failures carried meaningful consequences

- Full-stack confidence across applied LLMs, conversational and real-time voice AI, APIs and integrations, workflow orchestration, observability, data architecture, and secure multi-tenant SaaS

- Strong instincts around AI evaluation, reliability engineering, edge-case management, hallucination mitigation, human-in-the-loop design, and production monitoring

- Well-formed convictions about the trade-offs among AI quality, latency, reliability, privacy, and cost

- Experience building platforms that combine software with managed or service-heavy delivery, with the discipline to automate delivery rather than scale headcount linearly

- The ability and willingness to work directly with customers and turn messy real-world workflows into reliable products

- The mindset of a principal and owner — including the willingness to say “this won't scale,” “this isn't ready,” or “we need to rebuild this” when the integrity of the product requires it

- The desire to remain deeply hands-on while building the team around you

Strongly preferred:

- Prior founder or early-stage technical leadership experience

- Experience with production voice AI, telephony, agentic workflows, or AI evaluation infrastructure

- Background in legal tech, healthcare, financial services, or another trust-sensitive vertical

- Experience with security, privacy, and compliance requirements involving sensitive customer data

- Experience deploying or self-hosting open-source/custom models where privacy, latency, control, or economics require it

How to Apply
Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.
FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.

This role reports to the Director of Revenue Operations (RevOps).
We are open to on-site, hybrid, and remote working within two time zones of our offices (CET).
About Us
Our group brings together three European software brands that help organisations earn and use data with trust: Cookie Information for consent management; Piwik PRO for privacy-by-design analytics and data activation; and Sheltr for reliably finding personal data in internal data sources.
Headquartered in Copenhagen with an office in Wrocław, our team of 180 people have been building trusted data solutions since 2011. We work with companies and marketing teams across various industries that take control of their data model, including some of the most data-sensitive clients in healthcare, finance, energy & utilities, and the public sector. We are proud that our clients rely on us to meet GDPR and EU data residency requirements across EMEA and the US, as this regulatory depth is hard to build and replicate. We believe compliance and performance are not opposites. Consented data, auditable analytics and full visibility of personal data belong to one data journey; together they form a foundation that marketing, IT, legal and the C-level can rely on.
Our journey is to move from a regulation-driven house of brands to one unified company with a clear point of view. We are creating a new category around this complete data journey, and together we are building an enterprise-ready, data-driven revenue engine led by thought leadership. Want to join us on this journey? Keep reading to find out how you can help shape this with us.
The Role
In this role, you will play a key part in driving business growth across Cookie Information, Piwik PRO, and Sheltr by turning internal performance metrics, customer insights, and market trends into actionable strategic guidance for leadership.
Your key responsibilities will include:

- Identifying revenue opportunities, diagnose funnel/segment performance gaps, and quantify business impact.

- Synthesising internal data, win/loss research, and 1–3 year competitor/market trends to deliver strategic recommendations.

- Building and own commercial dashboards across sales, marketing, and revenue funnels.

- Partnering with data, marketing, and AI teams to maintain robust tracking, data models, and data warehouse extraction.

- Leveraging AI-enabled analytics paired with rigorous human validation to support executive planning cycles.

About You
You’re an experienced Business Intelligence Manager with an analytical and commercial mindset. You extract and connect data quickly.
You bring:

- Commercial and revenue intelligence.

- B2B SaaS funnel & metrics acumen: pipeline, conversion, CAC, CLV, churn.

- Dashboarding & data architecture experience, incl. data integration.

- Market & customer research, incl. competitor analysis.

- Turning data into opportunities and recommendations, not just reports.

- Stakeholder management: executives, vendors, agencies.

- Looker Studio / Data Studio, Tableau, HubSpot.

- Proven record of insight-led recommendations with commercial impact.

- AI & automation acumen.

- Fluency in English (C2).

Nice-to-haves:

- Privacy, consent or analytics market knowledge.

- Multi-brand / multi-market environment exposure.

- Experience commissioning research agencies.

- Knowledge of Python.

What we offer

- The opportunity for you to shape the future growth of the company.

- An interesting mix of internal data, market and customer research.

- AI-first analytics with a real freedom to build.

- Professional development budget, health insurance, and other benefits.

- A positive, informal workplace.

Application process
We’re looking to fill the position as soon as possible and will be inviting candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis, so don’t hesitate to send your application today.
This is what our recruitment process looks like:

- A brief screening call with our Talent Partner (online, approx. 30 mins)

- An in-depth interview with the hiring manager and a member of the team (online)

- A final interview with the hiring manager, including a live case (online)

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion
At Cookie Information & Piwik PRO we value diversity as a cornerstone of our success. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability. We recognise that certain groups are underrepresented in the tech industry, and we encourage everyone to apply and help us shape a more inclusive workspace.

remote.title: Tax Product Specialist
remote.description:
This role is fully remote, open to candidates based anywhere in the United States outside New York. Based in New York? Apply to the New York posting of this role instead.
A Different Kind Of Job Description
At Filed, we believe in radical transparency. Everything is open: company finances, team salaries, stock options, anonymous team feedback. That extends to how we talk about this job, so what you'll read here looks a little different from other job ads. It starts with why this is a terrible job. Then it explains why it might be the best career move you'll ever make.
Why this is a terrible job
This is an incredibly high-paced, high-tempo environment. We're making a generational bet to change all of our lives, and generational bets are not comfortable.
You will stop signing returns. There are no clients of your own here, no book to build, no partner track. If the thing you want is the next rung on a firm ladder, this job takes it away from you on day one.
You will be on calls most of the day. You carry 5 to 10 firms at a time through onboarding and you own whether they actually succeed, for 8 weeks each, with your name attached. When a firm is floundering in week six, that is yours to fix, and there is nowhere in this job to hide from it.
The calendar is not negotiable. Firms will not change their stack mid-season, so December and January are relentless and everything has to land before the February 1 freeze. Miss the window and you wait a year.
Tax law is objective, but what applies under it and how professionals interpret it is full of judgment. You can give two tax professionals the same task and get two different results where both are right. You will sit across from a partner who disagrees with what the system did, and you will have to explain it in their language, without hiding behind the software. At times it will feel like hitting your head against the wall.
Customers will sometimes get frustrated, because they expect deterministic results from probabilistic systems, and we're managing the expectations of some of the biggest firms in the world, including the Big Four. You will be the person in the room who has actually done their job, which means the hard calls land with you.
And the rhythm is real. It's tough. It's relentless.
Why it might be the best career choice you'll ever make
You already know how to win a room full of sceptical tax professionals, because you have been one. Here that is the whole job, and it compounds: every firm you bring through onboarding properly becomes a firm that stays, refers, and grows.
It's addictive to be part of a business when you know you're winning. Filed is adding millions of dollars of revenue every quarter, and in under two years we've become the market leader in a space with entrenched incumbents and a drastic need for new AI tools. When we come into head-to-heads with competitors, we win every time, because our product is superior.
The industry looks boring from the outside, but the problem is unsolved, and the space has been riddled with products below the mark for decades. When you push through the wall, there's a spark of joy: a customer says "wow, this is phenomenal." That keeps happening, and you will be the one in the room when it does.
The opportunity here is not only to make a great deal of money. It's to have real impact on our mission: making this profession extraordinary. Nobody became a tax professional for the admin. They got into this work to be creative with tax law, to have fun, and to change the fabric of society. Filed enables them to do exactly that.
We've raised $17.2 million to date, led by Northzone. Our focus now is to deliver the roadmap and continue to win.
What You'll Own
As a Tax Product Specialist, you own the moment a firm goes from signed to genuinely working:

- The technical demo on customer calls, where you show firms what Filed does and why it answers the problem you have lived yourself

- Group onboarding, 5 to 10 firms at a time, from kickoff to the point where the firm is running real work through Filed without you

- The relationship through the 8 weeks that decide whether a firm succeeds or quietly churns

- The feedback loop back into product, so the friction you watch firms hit gets fixed rather than repeated

You'll see your decisions carry real weight for some of the most demanding professional users in the world within days, not quarters.
What You'll Be Responsible For

- Running the technical demo alongside sales on firms that need a tax professional in the room

- Onboarding firms in groups and staying their point person until they are genuinely winning, backed by customer support

- Teaching: webinars, training sessions, and the ongoing work of making firms good at Filed

- Translating between firms and engineering, so what you hear on calls turns into what gets built

- Knowing the product well enough to be trusted on it, including catching output that would not pass a reviewer

Your Hard Skillset

- You have prepared or reviewed real returns inside a real firm. Credentials are welcome but not required, what matters is that you've done the work

- Real strength in either individual returns (1040) or business returns (1065, 1120, 1120-S, 990, 1041), enough that a partner takes you seriously in the first five minutes. One or the other is enough. Strength in both is a plus

- You are comfortable in front of customers. Demos, training, difficult conversations, escalations

- A high degree of confidence in a few of the major tax platforms, such as CCH Axcess, UltraTax, Lacerte, ProConnect, Drake, or GoSystem. Nobody is expert in all of them, and we don't expect you to be

- You pick up software fast. A product surface, a new workflow, an integration conversation, none of it puts you off

- Bonus if you've been through a SurePrep, GruntWorx, or AutoFlow implementation, or rolled new software out across a firm

Your Soft Skillset

- Comfortable being uncomfortable and making calls with incomplete data

- Empathetic and curious: building for the user, not just for the technically correct answer

- Highly collaborative across product, engineering, and tax

- Detail-oriented but pragmatic: you know when precision matters and when to move

- You own your work and welcome the accountability that comes with it

A championship team
We think of ourselves as a sports team. Incredibly high performance, incredibly high standards, and real success to show for it. Being a championship team means working with people who are deeply proud of the work they do and have great fun doing it together.
We measure employee happiness constantly, and our eNPS is +60. We don't say that to brag. We say it because a team playing at this tempo only holds together if people genuinely love being on it. Every four months, the whole company comes together for an offsite.
What Filed Stands For
Not posters. Not corporate language. Real operating standards.
No problem is someone else's problem. If you see it, it's yours. Bugs, customer confusion, missed expectations, internal friction. We don't pass problems sideways and we don't hide behind roles. You fix the typo even if you didn't write it, jump into a customer issue even if it's not your department, escalate early, and close loops fully. Ownership means you drive resolution, not that you suffer silently or burn out doing everything alone.
Waiting is not a strategy. Momentum is our advantage. We don't wait for perfect information or stall because something is unclear. You ship a V1 instead of debating V5, test instead of theorize, run small experiments instead of requesting big approvals, and propose solutions instead of just naming blockers. Speed is powerful. Sloppiness is not, and recklessness has no place in a high-trust industry.
We run toward the fire. When something breaks, we move. Tax is high-stakes and trust is fragile. We acknowledge issues immediately, communicate clearly and often, prioritize customer-impacting problems fast, and stay on it until it's fully resolved. Firefighting is a strength, not panic, and never an excuse for preventable mistakes.
We win on customer experience. AI will commoditize. Features will copy. Pricing will compress. Experience won't. We respond faster than customers expect, communicate proactively, think like a partner rather than a ticketing system, and anticipate needs before they're raised. Overdelivering means raising the standard of care, not overpromising, hero culture, or burning the team out.
Who This Suits
This is a very fun environment, but it only suits people who meet the criteria we're looking for:

- People who want to win

- People who have a point to prove

- People who want to write their own job descriptions

How We Pay
Nothing at Filed is behind closed doors. Everyone here sees everyone else's salary, because we believe transparency creates trust, and trust is the foundation of excellent teamwork. Compensation isn't a negotiation. Depending on your location, everyone receives the same three offers, and all of our offers are above market benchmarking.
This role is assessed at Level 3. The salary and equity bandings are:

- Most Equity: $85,800 per year + $130,027 of equity

- Great Equity: $93,600 per year + $86,684 of equity

- Good Equity: $101,400 per year + $43,342 of equity

We run performance reviews every four months. Meet your goals and you can expect to double your equity by the end of your first year.

Job Description Summary
At GE HealthCare, we are passionate about advancing healthcare technology that helps clinicians make faster, more confident decisions and improves outcomes for patients around the world. We are seeking a Senior Product Manager, Next Generation MRI Solutions to help define and guide the future of MRI technology, AI-enabled capabilities, and imaging workflows.

In this highly visible role, you will translate customer insights, clinical needs, emerging technologies, and market opportunities into innovative MRI solutions that create meaningful value for healthcare providers and patients. You will work alongside talented colleagues across Engineering, Clinical, Research, Regulatory, Quality, Marketing, Finance, and Commercial teams to shape product strategy, influence investment decisions, and bring transformative solutions to market.Job Description
Product Strategy and Product Definition

- Define the strategy and multi-generation roadmap for next-generation MRI solutions, AI-enabled capabilities, and workflow innovations.

- Lead end-to-end product definition efforts, including customer segments, intended use, user needs, clinical and operational workflows, product requirements, feature prioritization, and value propositions.

- Translate customer feedback, clinical insights, competitive intelligence, and market trends into clear, actionable product requirements.

- Develop product requirement documents, use cases, workflow specifications, release content, and acceptance criteria in partnership with cross-functional teams.

- Identify product capabilities and technology investments that create meaningful differentiation and customer value.

- Evaluate trade-offs by balancing customer needs, clinical impact, technical feasibility, regulatory requirements, business priorities, investment needs, and timing considerations.

Business Planning and Growth Strategy

- Develop and maintain business plans for new MRI solutions, including market opportunity assessments, customer segmentation, competitive positioning, adoption assumptions, pricing considerations, investment needs, risks, and financial impact.

- Build business cases and investment recommendations that connect product capabilities to customer value, market demand, and growth opportunities.

- Partner with Marketing, Commercial, Regional, and Finance teams to develop revenue forecasts, market share objectives, customer adoption goals, and launch assumptions.

- Identify opportunities to expand market reach, increase product adoption, strengthen competitive positioning, and support portfolio growth.

- Monitor market performance and recommend adjustments to product strategy, roadmap priorities, positioning, pricing, and commercialization plans as needed.

Customer and Market Insights

- Engage with customers, key opinion leaders, clinical researchers, technologists, radiologists, field teams, and regional stakeholders to understand evolving clinical and operational needs.

- Lead structured customer research activities and translate insights into prioritized user needs and product requirements.

- Conduct market, customer, and competitive assessments to identify opportunities for differentiation and growth.

- Validate product concepts, workflows, value propositions, and adoption assumptions with representative customers and stakeholders.

- Develop a deep understanding of clinical, operational, and economic value drivers across priority customer segments.

Roadmap and New Product Introduction (NPI) Execution

- Develop and maintain the product roadmap, balancing near-term customer needs with long-term platform evolution.

- Partner with Engineering, Research, Clinical, Applications, and Technology teams to define and mature capabilities required for future product releases.

- Ensure external collaborations and advanced technology development timelines align with product release plans and program milestones.

- Provide product leadership throughout the NPI lifecycle, from concept and feasibility through development, verification, validation, launch, and post-launch evaluation.

- Lead roadmap and product reviews, communicate priorities, and facilitate informed, data-driven decision-making across stakeholders.

- Partner with Regulatory and Clinical Affairs teams to define evidence plans, intended claims, and regulatory strategies that support product value.

Commercialization and Revenue Enablement

- Collaborate with global and regional marketing teams to develop product positioning, messaging, launch strategies, and customer engagement plans.

- Translate product capabilities into compelling clinical, operational, and economic value propositions that support customer adoption and commercial success.

- Support customer advisory boards, clinical collaborations, industry events, internal training programs, launch activities, and sales initiatives.

- Partner with Marketing Communications to develop launch collateral, sales enablement tools, competitive materials, and NPI communications.

- Work closely with Commercial and Regional teams to monitor launch readiness, customer adoption, revenue performance, and pipeline development.

- Track key business indicators, including revenue contribution, market share, adoption, customer conversion, and portfolio performance, and recommend improvements where appropriate.

Cross-Functional Leadership and Operational Excellence

- Foster alignment across Product Management, Engineering, Clinical, Applications, Research, Regulatory, Quality, Marketing, Finance, and Commercial teams.

- Build strong partnerships and influence stakeholders across a global matrix organization to align resources and decisions around customer and business priorities.

- Communicate product strategy, business rationale, risks, dependencies, and progress clearly to senior leaders and cross-functional teams.

- Establish effective operating mechanisms and metrics to monitor roadmap execution, market readiness, and business outcomes.

- Champion behaviors aligned with integrity, quality standards, regulatory requirements, environmental health and safety (EHS) expectations, and a culture of continuous improvement.

Required Qualifications

- Master's degree in Engineering, MRI Physics, Biomedical Engineering, Computer Science, Medical Imaging, or a related technical field.

- Minimum of 8 years of experience in Product Management, Product Definition, Systems Engineering, Research & Development (R&D), or Technology Development within medical imaging or medical devices.

- Experience defining and commercializing MRI, software, or AI-enabled healthcare products.

- Experience developing product requirements, product roadmaps, business cases, market assessments, and commercialization plans.

- Strong understanding of MRI technology, clinical imaging workflows, and healthcare market dynamics.

- Demonstrated ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives and build alignment across diverse stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

- PhD in MRI Physics, Biomedical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

- Deep expertise in MRI product management, product definition, roadmap development, NPI execution, and lifecycle management.

- Experience with artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning, image reconstruction, workflow optimization, and advanced imaging technologies.

- Experience developing business plans, financial models, pricing strategies, and revenue forecasts for medical imaging products.

- Strong understanding of MRI clinical applications, image quality, scanner workflow design, and advanced imaging techniques.

- Experience supporting regulatory submissions, clinical evidence generation, claims development, and commercialization of medical imaging products.

- Experience collaborating globally with customers, academic institutions, research partners, and external technology organizations.

- Strong strategic thinking, analytical, communication, influencing, and presentation skills.

- Customer-focused and collaborative approach, with the ability to drive initiatives from concept through execution.

Why Join Us?

- Help shape the future of MRI technology.

- Influence products that have a meaningful impact on patient care and clinical outcomes.

- Work with multidisciplinary teams across engineering, clinical, research, commercial, and business functions.

- Contribute to innovative technologies at the intersection of healthcare, imaging, software, and artificial intelligence.

- Grow your leadership, technical, and strategic capabilities through high-impact, global collaboration.

- Be part of an inclusive environment where diverse perspectives are valued, respected, and essential to innovation.

remote.title: Senior Principal, Sales Compensation Design & Strategy
remote.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations

- US
Applications will be accepted until October 13, 2026.
About the Role
The Global GTM Strategy, Planning and Operations team at Cloudflare supports our high-growth Sales organization through scalable, AI supported GTM planning and operations. We focus on thoughtful planning of sales capacity, segmentation, territory carving, quota setting, and compensation design while ensuring clear rules of engagement for our Sales Team. Our goal is to establish a cohesive, consistent process framework that can support high growth, enable the Company's strategy, and accelerate Cloudflare's leadership in the developer and AI-native business segments.
As the Senior Principal, Sales Compensation Design & Strategy, you will design and manage Cloudflare's Sales Compensation Plans across all customer facing teams including Sales, Technical Sales, Partner Sales, and Customer Success & Experience, to ensure they are motivating, aligned with Cloudflare's strategy, and industry leading. This is a high visibility role with significant executive engagement, including leading C-level discussions with our CRO, CFO, CPO, and COO, and serving as the design authority on the Executive Compensation Steering Committee.
You will architect new compensation metrics that reflect how Cloudflare monetizes a developer first, AI supportive business - including consumption, adoption, and platform attach - and ensure roles, territories, and quotas align with compensation plans to achieve our GTM objectives. You will establish a governance framework for efficient compensation planning and partner closely with the Compensation Administration and Operations Teams to ensure effective implementation and accurate payouts. A strong understanding of SaaS bookings, monetization approaches, and consumption and adoption models is essential.
The scope of executive influence, the architectural work required to support our developer/AI business model, and the AI-native transformation of the compensation design function make this seat fundamental to our GTM execution strategy.
Responsibilities
Executive Leadership & Design Authority

- Lead the Sales Compensation Design Process with the Executive Steering Committee, including CRO, CFO, and CPO level stakeholders.

- Drive C-level discussions on compensation philosophy, pay-for-performance outcomes, and strategic trade-offs; develop recommendation decks and own the narrative through approval.

- Architect new metrics that align seller incentives with Cloudflare's developer platform and AI product strategy (e.g., Workers consumption, AI Gateway adoption, platform attach, multi-product penetration).

- Create a 3-year roadmap for the Sales Compensation Design function.

AI-Native Compensation Design

- Build the AI Compensation Design Framework and Application - an internal capability that uses AI to accelerate plan modeling, scenario simulation, payout forecasting, and what-if analysis across thousands of sellers and territories.

- Leverage AI to design high-quality SPIFFs and incentive structures, including generating candidate designs, simulating seller behavior, and stress-testing against historical data before launch.

- Track ROI of comp plans, SPIFFs, and incentive programs using AI-driven analytics - moving from lagging reporting to predictive measurement of plan effectiveness, seller behavior change, and revenue lift.

- Develop AI-powered pay-for-performance reporting that surfaces insights for executives, managers, and sellers in real time, replacing static quarterly reviews with continuous intelligence.

Cross-Functional Execution

- Collaborate with GTM Strategy, Operations, Finance, HR, IT, and Product to ensure effective deployment of compensation plans and GTM strategy.

- Lead compensation enablement and change management for the global Sales team, including AI-assisted communications, FAQ generation, and plan-acceptance workflows.

- Design SPIFFs and incentive strategies that balance long-term strategic bets with short-term revenue goals.

- Partner with the Compensation Administration and Operations Teams to ensure design intent translates into accurate, auditable payouts.

Required Experience & Skills

- 15+ years of experience in Sales Compensation Design in a fast-paced tech company or as a management consultant.

- Demonstrated fluency with AI tools and AI-augmented workflows - whether through prior comp design work, analytics, or strategic projects. Comfort building or directing the build of AI-powered internal applications is strongly preferred.

- Strong analytical skills, including the ability to architect new metrics for emerging business models (consumption, AI monetization).

- Exceptional presentation and communication skills, with proven experience presenting to and influencing C-level executives.

- Proven experience driving Executive Steering Committee meetings and owning the decision narrative end-to-end.

- Experience leading cross-functional initiatives to completion across Finance, HR, IT, Product, and GTM.

- Detail-oriented with a strategic mindset.

- Bachelor's degree required.

Bonus Points
The ideal candidate combines a strong background in sales strategy and compensation design with genuine curiosity about applying AI to transform the function. Candidates will have exceptional stakeholder management skills, executive presence, and the confidence to manage evolving strategies in a high-growth company.
Compensation
Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

- For San Francisco based hires: Estimated annual salary of $230,000 - $317,000

- For California (excluding Bay Area), Washington, Washington DC, NY and NJ based hires: $220,000 - $303,000

- For Colorado based hires: Estimated annual salary of $200,000 - $275,000

Equity
This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan.
Benefits
Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.
Health & Welfare Benefits

- Medical/Rx Insurance

- Dental Insurance

- Vision Insurance

- Flexible Spending Accounts

- Commuter Spending Accounts

- Fertility & Family Forming Benefits

- On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program

- Global Travel Medical Insurance

Financial Benefits

- Short and Long Term Disability Insurance

- Life & Accident Insurance

- 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan

- Employee Stock Participation Plan

Time Off

- Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave

- Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

: We released to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actualrace, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.

Clinical Independent Rater -PolishSpeaking

Location: Remote/Virtual
Hours: Estimated 10–16 hours per month
Role: Clinical Specialist
About IQVIA
IQVIA is a global leader in advanced analytics, technology solutions, and clinical research services, dedicated to driving healthcare forward. We partner with the world’s leading pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical device companies to improve patient outcomes and accelerate innovation. Our team combines deep scientific expertise with cutting-edge technology to deliver high-quality data and insights that shape the future of clinical trials.
Position Overview
The Clinical Specialist plays a key role in ensuring the integrity and reliability of clinical trial data. This position involves reviewing scales administered by raters to confirm standardized assessment practices. Responsibilities include evaluating assessment quality, engaging in live discussions with raters to provide guidance on methodology and scoring techniques, and supporting rater performance through functional assessments (e.g., mock interviews). Additional tasks may include assisting with communication materials and documentation.

- Participate in all required orientation, training, and calibration activities.

- Review case data and prepare for rater discussions, ensuring all relevant documents and scale items are available.

- Conduct live interactions with raters to provide feedback and guidance on assessment methodology and scoring.

- Complete assigned tasks and rater interactions according to schedule.

- Submit all required documentation accurately and on time.

Required Qualifications

- Education: Master’s degree (MA/MS) in Psychology, Counseling, Psychiatric Nursing, or Social Work (or equivalent). MD, DO, or PhD preferred.

-
Experience:

- Minimum 3 years administering psychiatric assessments, rating scales, and/or structured clinical interviews (specificallyMINI and MADRS).

- Minimum 3 years of clinical experience with psychiatric populations.

- Minimum 3 years administering scales in clinical research trials (excluding graduate/doctoral research).

- Experience in CNS trials preferred.

-
Skills:

- Strong interpersonal and communication skills for professional interaction at all levels.

- Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, time management, and problem-solving ability.

- Proficiency with Windows and Microsoft Office applications.

Language Requirement
Current openings require fluency in English and native-level proficiency in Polish.

remote.description:
CEO, ZNOHUB
Від 300 учнів до 200 000+. Тепер будуємо наступну версію ZNOHUB
ZNOHUB – один із лідерів українського EdTech і велика digital-компанія у сфері підготовки до НМТ.
За п’ять років із продуктами ZNOHUB навчалися понад 200 000 учнів.Сьогодні це команда близько 100 людей, власна технологічна платформа та комплексний освітній продукт, який об’єднує живі заняття, записи, навчальні матеріали, тести, пробні НМТ, трекінг прогресу й підтримку учнів.
ZNOHUB уже має те, чого більшість стартапів лише намагаються досягти: сильний бренд, підтверджений попит, масштабний core-бізнес і команду, здатну запускати нові продукти.
Що буде у вашій зоні відповідальності
Повний P&L і стратегія компанії
Взяти відповідальність за комерційні, фінансові та операційні результати ZNOHUB.
Сформувати стратегію зростання, перевести її у річні та квартальні пріоритети, визначати, куди інвестувати ресурси, і забезпечувати виконання цілей за виручкою, прибутковістю та розвитком бізнесу.
Масштабування основного бізнесу
Посилювати core-продукт ZNOHUB через розвиток продуктового портфеля, pricing, маркетинг, продажі, conversion, retention і monetisation.
Забезпечити, щоб продукт, маркетинг, продажі та операції були готові до кожного нового сезонного циклу заздалегідь.
Data-driven growth
Побудувати єдину картину маркетингу, продажів і retention:

- звідки приходять клієнти;

- які канали дають найкращу economics;

- де втрачається конверсія;

- що впливає на утримання та повторні продажі;

- які продукти й сегменти мають найбільший потенціал.

Використовувати ці дані для рішень щодо бюджету, pricing, продукту та growth-пріоритетів.
Нові напрями зростання
Визначати й тестувати нові можливості за межами підготовки до НМТ, зокрема продукти для молодших школярів, підтримку вступу за кордон та інші освітні сервіси.
Швидко перевіряти попит і unit-економіку, масштабувати сильні напрями та зупиняти ті, що не підтверджують бізнес-потенціал.
Leadership team і система управління
Оцінити поточну структуру та команду лідерів, визначити чіткі зони відповідальності й decision rights.
Побудувати management cadence, у якому компанія працює через зрозумілі цілі, метрики, регулярне прогнозування та accountability, без постійного залучення засновника у щоденні рішення.
Якого результату очікуємо
Перші 30 днів

- Глибоке розуміння бізнес-моделі, продукту, команди, фінансів і customer journey.

- Письмова діагностика ключових можливостей і вузьких місць.

- Розуміння того, де компанія заробляє, що обмежує зростання і які напрями потребують найбільшої уваги.

- Без передчасних структурних змін.

До 60 днів

- Діагностика переведена у сфокусований план.

- Визначені основні growth-пріоритети.

- Компанія починає працювати через спільні цілі, метрики та зони відповідальності.

- Запущений регулярний управлінський ритм: планування, business reviews, forecasting і звітність.

До 90 днів

- CEO є очевидним виконавчим лідером для C-level і всієї компанії.

- Засновник більше не є дефолтною точкою для щоденних операційних рішень.

- Є вимірюваний план розвитку core-бізнесу та нових напрямів.

- Видно перші покращення у growth, управлінні або economics.

Протягом 6–12 місяців

- Core-бізнес зростає відповідно до погодженого плану.

- Marketing, sales і retention працюють через єдину систему метрик.

- Один або два нові напрями валідовані, масштабовані або зупинені за чіткими критеріями.

- ZNOHUB готовий до наступного сезонного циклу без постійного залучення засновника.

- CEO повністю володіє P&L і загальним результатом компанії.

Потрібний досвід

- Досвід керування компанією або великим бізнес-юнітом із реальною відповідальністю за P&L.

- Конкретний track record зростання виручки та прибутковості.

- Досвід роботи з marketing funnel, sales, conversion, retention, monetisation і unit-економікою.

- Досвід роботи в EdTech (великий плюс) або в digital B2C, subscriptions, marketplaces та інші consumer-продукти.

- Розуміння того, як ростуть digital consumer-продукти.

- Досвід керування senior-лідерами у кількох функціях: product, marketing, sales, operations, finance та people.

- Здатність поєднувати стратегічне мислення з hands-on виконанням.

- Досвід роботи у founder-led компанії або тісної взаємодії із засновником.

- Сильне фінансове й аналітичне мислення: budgeting, forecasting, CAC, retention, cash flow та інвестиційні рішення.

- Досвід роботи у швидкозмінному або сезонному бізнесі.

- Вільна українська та сильна англійська.

Що буде у вашій зоні відповідальності

- Повний P&L: виручка, прибутковість, бюджет та ключові інвестиційні рішення.

- Growth strategy для core-бізнесу ZNOHUB.

- Маркетингова й sales funnel: acquisition, conversion, CAC та ефективність каналів.

- Retention, monetisation і розвиток продуктового портфеля.

- Валідація нових освітніх напрямів і масштабування тих, які показують сильну economics.

- Leadership team, оргструктура та система управління.

Що ми пропонуємо?

- Високий рівень базової фінансової винагороди, суттєві бонуси за досягнення цілей та програму опціонів (через 12 місяців)

- повністю віддалений формат у межах GMT±3;

- гнучкий графік

- Реальний вплив на компанію

- Безлімітні days-off і sick leaves.

Якщо вам цікаво не просто очолити компанію, а взяти сильний бізнес у точці трансформації та побудувати наступну версію ZNOHUB, будемо раді познайомитися.

Since its inception, Bubba Gump Shrimp Co. has grown into a globally-recognized brand with 16 international locations throughout Asia, Europe and Mexico and 22 locations in the United States.

Rooted in the values of teamwork, integrity, and genuine hospitality, we strive to create an environment where every team member feels valued, empowered, and encouraged to bring their unique personality to the table. remote.description:
About the Role:
We're looking for a performance-driven Paid Ads Manager - Google to lead the planning, execution, and optimization of paid advertising campaigns across Google platforms for ecommerce brands. This role combines strategic media buying, campaign analysis, and conversion-focused optimization to drive scalable growth and maximize return on ad spend. The ideal candidate is analytical, proactive, and experienced in managing high-performing Google Ads campaigns across Search, Shopping, Performance Max, and retargeting. They should be comfortable working with performance metrics, testing new strategies, collaborating with creative and marketing teams, and continuously optimizing campaigns to improve lead generation and ecommerce performance.
Responsibilities:
Core Tasks:

- Design, implement, and manage paid advertising campaigns in Google

- Develop audience targeting strategies, ad creatives, and campaign structures aligned with marketing goals

- Monitor daily performance metrics including ROAS, CPA, CTR, CPC, and conversion rates

Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Software Engineer, Email Platform (L3)
About the job
This position is a critical engineering role within Twilio SendGrid, requiring a hands-on engineer capable of developing, deploying, and managing highly available, massive-scale distributed systems.
Our systems regularly process more than 12 billion emails during peak events like Black Friday, and our throughput requirements continue to scale rapidly. As an L3 engineer, you will act as a key driver of execution within our core services. You will be heavily involved in modernizing our backend systems, optimizing our extensive Go-based microservices, and contributing to the design and reliability of our dual-cloud infrastructure span across Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Microsoft Azure.
Responsibilities
In this role, you’ll:

-
WEAR THE CUSTOMER’S SHOES: Architect and ship reliable, high-velocity features that handle critical traffic with low end-to-end latency. Partner closely with product management and technical leadership to break down complex system requirements into manageable, iterative milestones.

-
BE AN OWNER (CODE QUALITY): Drive rigorous code reviews and push for maintainable patterns in our Go codebase, ensuring high testing standards (unit, integration, and component testing) are executed across the team.

-
BE AN OWNER (INFRASTRUCTURE & OBSERVABILITY): Manage and enhance cloud configurations across AWS and Azure environments utilizing Infrastructure as Code (Terraform). Ensure deep observability coverage by standardizing metrics, alerts, and distributed tracing across core data pipelines.

-
CHAMPION ENGINEERING HEALTH: Advocate for a clean architectural foundation. Proactively identify technical debt, system bottlenecks, and single points of failure (SPOF), balancing feature delivery with critical platform refactoring.

-
MENTOR AND LEAD: Foster a collaborative environment by mentoring junior engineers, leading technical sprint planning, and sharing expertise across distributed engineering nodes.

Qualifications
Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!
Required:

-
Experience: 4+ years of professional software engineering experience building and operating resilient backend services at scale.

-
Modern Development Workflow: Practical experience leveraging AI-assisted development tools (such as Claude Code) to accelerate code generation, automate testing, and streamline debugging workflows.

-
Language Proficiency: Strong, hands-on production experience writing clean, idiomatic, and highly concurrent Go (Golang), Java or Python.

-
Cloud Infrastructure: Solid experience deploying and managing production workloads in cloud environments—ideally with deep exposure to AWS core services (such as EC2, S3, Aurora, or DynamoDB) AND Microsoft Azure equivalents (such as Virtual Machines, Blob Storage, Azure SQL, or Cosmos DB).

-
Infrastructure as Code: Proficiency with Terraform for provision-level automation and maintaining environment parity.

-
Distributed Systems: Strong theoretical and practical understanding of distributed datastores, caching layers, and asynchronous event streaming (e.g., Kafka or similar queuing ecosystems).

-
Systems Mindset: Strong foundational background in computer science fundamentals, data structures, and building self-healing cloud architectures.

Desired:

- Prior experience managing high-throughput applications running inside containerized infrastructure (Docker, Kubernetes).

- Familiarity with database migration pathways (e.g., transitioning traditional on-prem/relational datastores to managed instances like AWS Aurora).

- Experience implementing OpenTelemetry or distributed tracing systems across decoupled microservice platforms.

- Direct experience handling constraints related to network topology, proxy layers, or mail transfer agent (MTA) protocols.

Location
This role will be remote,but is not eligible to be hired in CA, CT, NJ, NY, PA, WA.
Travel
We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.
What We Offer
Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

*Please note the salary range information provided applies only to candidates residing in California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State due to local requirements.
