remote.title: Product Director, Consumer Channels
remote.description:
Does this position interest you? You should apply –even if you don’t match every single requirement! We're known as an auto glass company. That's the focus of what we do. But beyond the glass, we're so much more. We'll help you build a fulfilling career and encourage you to have a life. Let us be the best place you'll ever work.

A Brief Overview
Safelite is the leader in auto glass service, continuously raising the bar for experiences that are easy, fast, and done. Digital is central to that ambition and to how we serve consumers, clients, and colleagues.
We are seeking a Digital Product Director, Consumer Channels to lead the strategy, roadmap, and performance of Safelite's consumer digital experiences. This includes the direct-pay and insurance journeys across discovery, quote, coverage, scheduling, payment, and service.
Reporting to the VP, Digital Product, you will lead the consumer digital product portfolio and the product managers responsible for it. You will connect customer behavior, growth strategy, business performance, and emerging technology to identify high-value opportunities and translate them into clear product direction and measurable outcomes.
This is a hands-on product leadership role. You will set direction across the portfolio while staying close to customer behavior, product performance, and the work itself. You will develop product talent, raise the quality of product practice, and ensure the team is investing in the opportunities that create the greatest customer and business value.

What you will do

-
Lead the consumer product portfolio

• Define the product strategy, roadmap, and investment priorities for Safelite’s consumer digital experiences.
• Identify and prioritize high-value opportunities by connecting customer needs, behavioral signals, business performance, and emerging capabilities.
• Translate those opportunities into clear product direction, priorities, and measurable outcomes.
• Make portfolio tradeoffs across customer value, business impact, evidence, effort, risk, and learning potential.
• Balance performance optimization, foundational capability, and longer-term innovation across the portfolio

-
Drive growth and journey performance

• Lead the digital journey from initial need through quote, coverage, scheduling, payment, and service.
• Identify where friction, uncertainty, or unnecessary effort is limiting conversion, self-service, or customer confidence.
• Connect product decisions directly to revenue, margin, conversion, satisfaction, and operational performance.
• Use behavioral data, research, experimentation, and customer signals to identify the highest-value opportunities for improvement.
• Partner with Pricing, Marketing, and business leaders on how pricing, offers, payment options, and other commercial levers appear within the experience.

-
Build an AI-enabled product practice

• Establish how the team uses AI across discovery, analysis, synthesis, prototyping, experimentation, and product decision making.
• Use AI-native tools to analyze customer behavior and interactions at scale, surface patterns, investigate performance, and identify emerging opportunities.
• Help teams move quickly from signal to hypothesis to evidence while maintaining strong product judgment.
• Build fluency across the team so AI becomes part of how product managers work, not a separate capability or occasional tool.
• Stay current on emerging AI capabilities and determine where they can materially improve the consumer journey or the way the team works.

-
Shape AI-enabled consumer experiences

• Identify where AI can create meaningful customer and business value across the consumer journey.
• Partner with agentic product leadership to determine how conversational, agentic, predictive, and adaptive capabilities should integrate into the broader consumer experience.
• Define opportunities where AI can improve self-service, decision support, personalization, and service outcomes.
• Ensure AI-enabled experiences are grounded in customer value, measurable outcomes, appropriate controls, and clear expectations.
• Connect emerging AI capabilities to the broader product roadmap rather than treating them as standalone features.

-
Lead and develop the product team

• Lead, coach, and develop product managers responsible for areas within the consumer portfolio.
• Set a high standard for product judgment, customer understanding, analytical fluency, experimentation, and execution.
• Develop product managers who can form an independent point of view from customer behavior, data, research, and business performance.
• Create ways of working that support continuous discovery and delivery while maintaining clarity around outcomes, priorities, and accountability.
• Stay close enough to the work to challenge assumptions, raise the quality of decisions, and help teams navigate difficult tradeoffs.

-
Lead through partnership

• Operate as a close partner to Design and Engineering in shaping product strategy, priorities, and outcomes.
• Partner across Marketing, Pricing, Analytics, Technology, Operations, Contact Center, and business leadership to connect the digital experience to the broader service.
• Align teams around opportunities, priorities, measures of success, and the decisions required to move forward.
• Bring structure and clarity to complex product decisions when customer, business, technology, and operational priorities compete.

- Performs other duties as assigned

- Complies with all policies and standards

Education Qualifications

- Bachelor's Degree or equivalent work experience Required

Experience Qualifications

- 7-9 years of product management or digital product experience, including significant ownership of consumer-facing digital products at scale. Required

- Experience leading and developing product managers, with a track record of raising product judgment and team performance. Required

- Experience owning digital products from strategy and discovery through launch, measurement, and continuous improvement. Required

Skills and Abilities
REQUIRED

- Demonstrated success improving high-intent consumer journeys such as commerce, booking, quoting, scheduling, or self-service.

- Strong analytical fluency and hands-on experience using digital analytics platforms such as Quantum Metric, Heap, Amplitude, FullStory, Mixpanel, or similar.

- Demonstrated fluency using AI across product strategy, discovery, research synthesis, analysis, prototyping, experimentation, and optimization.

- Experience using AI-native tools to investigate customer behavior, product performance, and emerging opportunities.

- Strong experience with experimentation, A/B testing, funnel optimization, and evidence-based product decision making.

- Ability to connect customer needs, behavioral signals, business strategy, and technology capabilities into clear product direction and investment priorities.

- Experience working in continuous discovery and delivery environments where learning actively shapes the roadmap.

- Strong written and verbal communication and the ability to create clarity in complex, ambiguous product environments.

TARGET EXPERIENCE

- We are looking for a product leader who has led consumer digital experiences where customer behavior and business performance are tightly connected.

- You have owned high-intent journeys such as commerce, booking, quoting, scheduling, or self-service and can show how product decisions changed conversion, revenue, satisfaction, or customer effort.

- You have worked in environments where pricing, offers, payment options, and other commercial decisions are part of the product experience, not separate from it.

- You also know what strong product practice looks like. You have worked with dedicated cross-functional teams, continuous discovery, instrumented products, experimentation, and outcome-based goals, and you have helped raise the maturity of the product organization around you.

- Relevant experience may come from marketplaces, on-demand services, travel and hospitality, omnichannel retail, home services, financial services, modern automotive experiences, or other businesses where digital demand connects to real-world service delivery.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience shipping AI-enabled, conversational, agentic, predictive, or personalized product capabilities.

- Experience leading products that span both customer-facing and employee-facing digital experiences.

- Experience with behavioral analytics, voice of customer, journey analysis, service design, and customer research methods.

- Familiarity with APIs, data products, design systems, experimentation platforms, and the technical foundations of modern digital products.

- Experience with products where digital conversion connects directly to operational capacity or service fulfillment.

CORE CAPABILITIES

- Product Strategy. Turns customer, business, and technology signals into clear product choices, investment priorities, and measurable outcomes.

- Consumer Journey Leadership. Understands the end-to-end journey and identifies where product can materially improve customer behavior, confidence, and outcomes.

- Growth and Business Acumen. Connects product decisions to conversion, revenue, margin, satisfaction, and operational performance.

- Opportunity Identification. Uses customer behavior, evidence, and business context to identify and prioritize high-value opportunities.

- People Leadership. Builds strong product managers and raises the quality of judgment, execution, and product practice across the team.

- AI-Enabled Product Leadership. Uses AI directly to improve how the team learns and to identify where intelligent capabilities can create customer and business value.

- Experimentation and Learning. Uses analytics, testing, research, and feedback loops to improve decisions and product performance continuously.

- Cross-Functional Leadership. Aligns Product, Design, Engineering, Marketing, Pricing, Operations, and other partners around shared outcomes.

- Execution Discipline. Turns strategy into sustained product progress while managing priorities, dependencies, risk, and performance.

- Idealerweise ein bestehendes und aktives Netzwerk innerhalb einer oder mehrerer unserer Zielkundengruppen

- Sicheres und professionelles Auftreten gegenüber Geschäftskunden

- Begeisterung für Sport, Performance, Regeneration und innovative Produkte

Wir suchen aktuell deutschlandweit.

- Langfristig ausgerichtete Zusammenarbeit

Schick uns neben deinen Kontaktdaten gerne eine kurze Übersicht:

About Zipline

Zipline is the world’s largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world’s largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products.

Our customers include the world’s largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we’ve built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations.

Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe.

We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people’s lives and by scaling the future of logistics. We are seeking people who sculpt from first principles, enjoy facing adversity, and can do the impossible at record breaking speeds.

You will help us build customer-facing products that are clear, trustworthy, and easy to use—even when customers are not readily available for day-to-day feedback.
This is a hands-on full-stack role for an engineer with exceptional customer obsession, strong product instincts, and a high bar for UX. You will continually push the team beyond a merely functional experience, deeply considering what matters most to end users, simplifying workflows, reducing unnecessary elements, and refining details until the product feels intuitive and genuinely enjoyable to use.
Your goal is not only to deliver excellent customer experience, but to raise the bar for how the entire team designs, tests, launches, and iterates on customer-facing products.

- Lead the design and delivery of customer-facing applications that support ordering, tracking, and delivery operations.

- Build fast feedback loops with customers through direct conversations, analytics, support signals, limited releases, and structured experiments.

- Establish feature-flag, beta, phased-rollout, or other gradual-release practices that let us validate changes with a subset of customers before broad release.

- Raise the quality bar for frontend UX, interaction patterns, accessibility, and product polish.

- Partner with operations, supply chain, finance, and customer-facing teams to identify and solve high-impact user problems.

- Improve reliability, testing, observability, and engineering practices across the applications you own.

- Mentor engineers and help set product-minded technical standards across the team.

What You'll Bring

- 10+ years of production software engineering experience, including staff-level technical scope.

- Deep full-stack experience, including modern frontend development with React or a comparable framework and strong backend capability in Go, Python, or a similar language.

- A strong record of building external customer-facing products where UX affects adoption, trust, and business outcomes.

- Demonstrated customer obsession: you seek feedback, speak directly with users, turn insight into product improvements, and advocate for customer needs.

- Strong independent design and UX judgment; you can make high-quality product decisions without relying on a dedicated designer.

- Experience with limited releases, feature flags, beta programs, experiments, or phased rollouts.

- A record of owning architecture across teams, mentoring engineers, and leading delivery in an ambiguous, fast-changing environment.

- Experience in both a rigorous, high-engineering-bar organization and a startup or scale-up environment where you built through ambiguity.

- Clear, effective English communication.

- Ability to work from the US East Coast or London, UK, and travel to Africa approximately three times per year.

Nice to have:

- E-commerce, marketplaces, or other high-expectation external customer experiences.

- Measurable improvements to conversion, activation, retention, customer satisfaction, or usability.

- Healthcare, fulfillment, logistics, warehouse-management, or supply-chain products.

What Else You Need To Know
For US-based candidates, the starting cash range for this role is $180,000 - $220,000. Please note that this is a target, starting cash range for a candidate who meets the minimum qualifications for this role. The final cash pay for this role will depend on a variety of factors, including a specific candidate's experience, qualifications, skills, working location, and projected impact. The total compensation package for this role may also include: equity compensation; overtime pay; discretionary annual or performance bonuses; sales incentives; benefits such as medical, dental and vision insurance; paid time off; and more.

remote.title: Data Governance Lead
remote.description:
dv01 is lifting the curtain on the largest financial market in the world: structured finance. The $16+ trillion market is the backbone of everyday activities that empower financial freedom, from consolidating credit card debt and refinancing student loans, to buying a home and starting a small business.
dv01’s data analytics platform brings unparalleled transparency into investment performance and risk for lenders and Wall Street investors in structured products. As a data-first company, we wrangle critical loan data and build modern analytical tools that enable strategic decision-making for responsible lending. In a nutshell, we're helping prevent a repeat of the 2008 global financial crisis by offering the data and tools required to make smarter, data-driven decisions resulting in a safer world for all of us.
More than 400 of the largest financial institutions use dv01 for our coverage of over 75 million loans spanning mortgages, personal loans, auto, buy-now-pay-later programs, small business, and student loans. dv01 continues to expand coverage of new markets, adding loans monthly, and developing new technologies for the structured products universe.
The Problem and Opportunity
Our governance practices exist today, but they grew up alongside the product and are largely home-grown: definitions live in people's heads, ownership is informal, and data quality gets managed reactively, one escalation at a time. The Data Governance Lead will replace that with something deliberate. The priorities are named ownership and stewardship across our data domains, a correct and maintained data dictionary, a data quality framework with real metrics behind it, and disciplined compliance with the terms under which we receive client and third-party data. Cataloging, lineage, classification, and access controls follow from there.
We are building AI-powered products on top of that data, and that is what makes this role urgent. An AI product is only as trustworthy as the definitions, ownership, and quality controls underneath it. A model cannot reason correctly about a field nobody has defined, from a source nobody owns, at a quality level nobody measures. Governance is the constraint on how confidently and how quickly we can scale our AI and data products, and this role exists to remove it.
This is a builder's role and a relentless one. The pipeline build sits with Data Engineering and dataset definition with our Data Product Manager; you will work with them, with our teams of Data Analysts, and with Data Operations, Product, Commercial, and Legal to define what good looks like, get it instrumented, and hold the organization to it. It starts as an individual contributor role, with a team to be built as the function earns it.
You will:

-
Scale What We Have Already Built for AI: Our data already powers AI products in production. The hard problem is doing that across every dataset, every client, and every new product without ever having to guess whether an answer is right. Our Data Product Manager defines what the data is; you make sure it is owned, classified, measured, and trusted at the scale AI demands. Nobody in this market has solved this yet, and we intend to be the ones who do.

-
Own the Data Quality Framework and Its Metrics: Define what quality means across our loan-level and deal-level data, set the thresholds, and partner with our Data Product Manager, Data Engineering, and Data Analysts to get monitoring instrumented. Then report on it relentlessly and drive a sustained, measurable drop in failures.

-
Establish Ownership and Stewardship: Put named owners and stewards on every data domain, document their decisions, and make sure those decisions stay current instead of going stale the week after they are made.

-
Own the Data Dictionary and Business Definitions: Make our definitions correct, complete, and consistent everywhere they appear, from the warehouse to the product to what clients see. Chase down the ambiguities nobody else has time to chase.

-
Own Data Rights in Practice: Know exactly what we are permitted to do with every dataset we receive from clients and third parties, and make those terms enforceable in the platform rather than buried in a contract nobody reads.

-
Run It Like a Program: Track commitments, escalate what is stuck, and close things out. You will not have a team at the start, so persistence, credibility, and clear direction do the work.

You are:

-
Accomplished as a data governance professional, bringing 7+ years of expertise in data governance, data quality, or data management.

-
Proven at building programs from the ground up. What exists here today is home-grown at best, so we need someone who has stood a program up from nothing, not someone who has only administered one that was already running.

-
Meticulous and exceptionally organized. You are the person who notices a definition is wrong, tracks down who owns it, and does not let it go until it is fixed.

-
Fluent in technical conversations without needing to be an engineer. Able to review SQL, interpret data models, and partner effectively with engineering teams to guide the right technical architecture.

-
Experienced in hands-on governance and data quality using purpose-built tooling rather than spreadsheets and home-grown trackers. We use BigQuery, dbt, and Unity Catalog today; experience with platforms like Collibra or Alation counts equally. What matters is that you have operated a real stack.

-
Strategic about the intersection of AI and data governance. You have a proven track record of designing governance frameworks (covering quality, lineage, metadata, and compliance) that ensure AI models scale on trustworthy data.

-
Knowledgeable across core governance domains (ownership, stewardship, quality, lineage, metadata, classification, access, master/reference data) and key regulatory frameworks (GDPR, CCPA, EU AI Act / ISO 42001).

Nice to haves:

- Experience managing data intended for external customer consumption

- Experience at a startup or startup-like environment

- Experience with structured finance and lending data

- Experience building scalable web applications using TypeScript, Soda and deal studio

In good faith, our salary range for this role is $190,000 - $220,000, but are not tied to it. The final offer amount will be at the company’s sole discretion and determined by multiple factors, including years and depth of experience, expertise, and other business considerations. Our community is fueled by diverse people who welcome differing points of view and the opportunity to learn from each other. Our team is passionate about building a product people love and a culture where everyone can innovate and thrive.
BENEFITS & PERKS:

-
Unlimited PTO. Unplug and rejuvenate, however you want—whether that’s vacationing on the beach or at home on a mental-health day.

-
$1,000 Learning & Development Fund. No matter where you are in your career, always invest in your future. We encourage you to attend conferences, take classes, and lead workshops. We also host hackathons, brunch & learns, and other employee-led learning opportunities.

-
Remote-First Environment. People thrive in a flexible and supportive environment that best invigorates them. You can work from your home, cafe, or hotel. You decide.

-
Health Care and Financial Planning. We offer a comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance package for you and your family. We also offer a 401(k) for you to contribute.

Stay active your way! Get $138/month to put toward your favorite gym or fitness membership — wherever you like to work out. Prefer to exercise at home? You can also use up to $1,650 per year through our Fitness Fund to purchase workout equipment, gear, or other wellness essentials.

New Family Bonding. Primary caregivers can take 16 weeks off 100% paid leave, while secondary caregivers can take 4 weeks. Returning to work after bringing home a new child isn’t easy, which is why we’re flexible and empathetic to the needs of new parents.

Our CSM provides outstanding service to grow existing accounts by partnering on strategic training initiatives, defining high-level marketing & communication strategies within customer organizations, and driving increased utilization and engagement to our customers over long-term relationships. remote.description:
Job Summary
Mirantis is looking for a Technical Product Manager to own observability for k0rdent AI, our control plane for GPU infrastructure and distributed AI workloads. In this role, you will define the observability strategy, roadmap, and feature priorities that determine how operators gain visibility into the health, performance, and resource utilization of GPU clusters running large-scale training and inference. You will shape how k0rdent AI handles everything from GPU-level metrics and distributed tracing across AI workloads, to multi-tenant log aggregation and intelligent alerting — powered by the OpenTelemetry ecosystem, and Prometheus-compatible metrics pipelines.
The ideal candidate brings strong technical fluency in observability tooling and the AI infrastructure stack. You will work directly with engineering to shape requirements, with marketing to define positioning, and with customers to help ensure their success.
Responsibilities

- Own the vision, roadmap, and priorities for k0rdent AI observability across the full stack: GPU compute, east-west fabric (InfiniBand, RoCE), high-performance storage, DPU/SmartNIC telemetry, workload schedulers, inference serving, and data services

- Translate requirements from NeoClouds, GPU clouds, telcos, sovereign clouds, and enterprise platform teams into clear product direction; partner with engineering to define requirements and evaluate trade-offs

- Manage the observability backlog using feedback from production deployments and design partners to refine priorities

- Track and shape our response to emerging observability standards and technologies, including OpenTelemetry (OTel), DCGM GPU metrics, InfiniBand/RoCE fabric counters, storage platform telemetry APIs, and AI workload profiling

- Define integration strategies for vendor telemetry sources across the ecosystem — NVIDIA compute and BlueField DPUs, storage platforms (VAST, Weka, DDN), workload managers (SLURM), inference stacks, and vector and relational databases — into a unified, operator-facing observability plane

- Partner with product marketing and field teams on positioning, technical briefs, and reference architectures; represent Mirantis with customers, analysts, and ecosystem partners

- 5+ years in product management or a senior technical role owning an observability product or operating large-scale monitoring infrastructure

- Working knowledge of Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing (Jaeger, Tempo), and log aggregation (Loki, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch)

- Fluency in Kubernetes observability, cloud-native monitoring, or metrics and alerting pipeline architecture

- Ability to work directly with engineering on technical trade-offs and with field teams in competitive GPU cloud and NeoCloud deals

Strongly Preferred:

- Exposure to GPU observability, including DCGM metrics, AI workload profiling and performance analysis

- Familiarity with east-west fabric telemetry - InfiniBand counters, RoCEv2 congestion metrics (ECN, PFC, DCQCN), or switch-level fabric health

- Experience with high-performance storage telemetry from platforms such as VAST Data, Weka, or DDN, including IOPS, latency, and throughput instrumentation at scale

- Familiarity with NVIDIA BlueField DPU telemetry, SR-IOV, or offload pipeline observability

- Exposure to workload-level visibility for SLURM job scheduling, inference serving stacks (vLLM, Triton, TensorRT-LLM), or data service telemetry from vector databases (Milvus, Qdrant) and relational databases in AI pipelines

Why you’ll love Mirantis

- Build the observability foundation for the AI cloud era, working directly with leading GPU cloud operators, NeoClouds, sovereign clouds, and AI-first enterprises

- Collaborate with a world-class, distributed team committed to openness and technical excellence

- Shape the product narrative and influence go-to-market success

In parallel, you will work closely with clients and their brokers/consultants as a trusted advisor, using data and insights to identify trends, improve engagement, and drive better outcomes.

You will develop and execute account plans, deliver business reviews, support client escalations, and drive customer satisfaction, retention, and growth. - Communicate clearly and concisely in both verbal and written formats, demonstrating strong time management, prioritization skills and empathy towards clients

- Manage client communication for engagement marketing initiatives, including open enrollment events, webinars, mailers, ad-hoc marketing requests and case studies.

- Serve as the product expert and specialty care advocate by guiding clients through features, use cases, and issue resolution while reinforcing best practices for adoption.

- Collaborate cross-functionally within a team environment, ensuring seamless coordination, clear communication, and alignment across departments.

- Ensure company and client objectives are met by owning execution of agreed‑upon action items, maintaining alignment across stakeholders, and following through on commitments.

- Partner with Client Executives to maximize retention and identify churn risks, as well as upsell and expansion opportunities.

- Maintain accurate data input and hygiene in the customer relationship management system for all assigned clients.

- Own service issue resolution end‑to‑end by investigating root causes, documenting findings, coordinating solutions across teams, and implementing improvements to prevent recurrence.

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

- 5+ years of experience of client relationship and/or account management experience within the employee benefits, healthcare, or consulting industry, including at least one startup

- Willingness to travel up to 20%-25%.

- Experience using Salesforce and SharePoint, Data Integration knowledge, and a background in Health Plan, TPA, Insurance, and/or benefits

Strong Candidates will have:

- Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to quickly establish rapport and build sustainable relationships.

- Exceptional project management skills, including clear goal identification, effective action‑step management, and ongoing tracking of accomplishments and opportunities

- Excellent time and task management while maintaining a solution‑oriented mindset to deliver accurate, intentional, and timely outcomes for clients.

- A demonstrated ability to execute against plans — not just create them — with strong follow‑through and accountability.

- Comfort being “in the weeds” while still maintaining a forward‑looking, proactive mindset.

- Independent and adaptable, thriving in a fast-paced environment.

- Strong problem-solving, judgment, and analytical skills.

- Ability to work under pressure and prioritize competing tasks and responsibilities.

- Ability to thrive in a matrixed organizational structure.

- Demonstrates a natural, proactive, and preemptive approach to anticipating client needs, both internally and externally.

-
INCLUSION is a core tenant of your personal beliefs. A diverse and inclusive environment is incredibly important to you. You understand and desire to be a part of a diverse team with different experiences and perspectives & you cherish the differences in each individual that you interact with.

Location: Remote (Anywhere)
Full - Time

We specialize in providing top-tier espresso machines and related parts to coffee enthusiasts worldwide. Our dedication to excellence extends beyond our products; we're committed to building a talented team that shares our passion for coffee and exceptional customer service.

-
Review Offer Competitiveness: Continuously evaluate our product offers against key competitors across all marketplaces to ensure we are competitively positioned on price, shipping, promotions, and value. -
Own Merchandising Decisions (Sales, Promotions, Discounts): Make data-driven decisions on sales, promotions, and discount strategies across channels. Balance revenue growth, inventory goals, and margin targets while aligning promotions with marketplace dynamics and business priorities.

-
Set Team Priorities and Create Execution Tickets: Translate merchandising strategy into clear, actionable priorities for the Parts Specialist, Listings Specialist, QA Specialist, and A+ Content Lead. -
Review Marketplace Performance and Identify Improvements: Monitor performance across all marketplaces (Shopify, Amazon, eBay, Walmart), including revenue, conversion, visibility, and operational metrics. Identify underperforming areas, diagnose root causes, and define improvement plans to drive continuous optimization.

-

Assess product fit, demand potential, competitive landscape, and operational feasibility to maximize return on new listings.

- Technical Requirements:

- Pricing Strategy & Competitive Analysis

- Catalog & Listing Management

- Performance Analytics & Reporting

- Workflow & Ticketing Systems

- Promotions & Discount Management

- Marketplace Policies, Compliance & QAMarketplace Policies,

- Compliance & QA

- Skills:

- Data-Driven Analysis & Problem Solving

- Cross-Functional Team Leadership

- Competitive & Market Awareness

- Process Design & Workflow Optimization

- Attention to Detail & Quality Control

- Clear Communication & Stakeholder Alignment

- Ownership & Accountability

- Continuous Improvement Mindset

remote.title: Solutions Engineer II
remote.description:
About Hologram
Hologram is building the future of IoT connectivity, delivering internet access to millions of connected devices worldwide. We process over 5 billion transactions per month across our global infrastructure, this isn't just another app, it's the invisible backbone powering everything from fleet tracking to smart city infrastructure. We tackle challenges of scale, reliability, and performance that few companies face.
What Makes a Hologrammer?
We look for people with insatiable curiosity and an uncompromising commitment to excellence. Hologrammers are the type who dig deeper when things break, ask 'why' before 'how,' and aren't satisfied until the solution is bulletproof.
You'll love working here if you:
Value tenacious ownership of outcomes: You don't just resolve tickets, you immerse yourself in the customer's use case, identify root causes, and follow through until their IoT devices are online and stable in production.
Crave genuine technical challenges: You want the problems that keep production IoT deployments online: diagnosing connectivity issues across networks, devices, and protocols, then building the tooling so nobody has to diagnose that one by hand again.
Relentlessly pursue growth: IoT technology evolves rapidly, and so do we. You take on new challenges, quickly master emerging protocols and configurations, and share what you learn to elevate customers and teammates.
Solutions Engineer II
About this role:
The Solutions Engineering team owns the customer relationship after the sale, from first deployment through every connectivity issue that follows. This role covers onboarding, troubleshooting across SIM, device, and network issues, hands-on L2 escalation work, and building the automation and internal tooling the team runs on. It's the first technical relationship a new customer has with Hologram, and the one that keeps their deployment live.
Responsibilities:

- Own customer onboarding end to end, from SIM provisioning and device configuration through to a deployment that is live and stable in production

- Diagnose and resolve SIM, device, and network-level connectivity issues across the full deployment lifecycle, including L2 escalations, partnering with engineering on anything systemic

- Lead the team's automation work: find the manual work worth removing, then build it away

- Improve and automate the technical onboarding process, from SIM order intake through provisioning and connectivity setup, as new customers come through it

- Automate account-health monitoring and alerting for Account Management team

- Maintain and expand internal tooling, including AI-driven support tooling, along with the internal and external documentation behind it

- Advocate for customers internally, surfacing product gaps and technical pain points to product and engineering

- Write the runbooks and hand the work off, so any Solutions Engineer can pick up a build ticket and finish it

- Extend automation across the rest of the post-sale path: SIM order intake, billing configuration and reconciliation, and renewal admin, partnering with Revenue Operations and the account team

Requirements:

- 5+ years in a customer-facing technical role (e.g., Solutions Engineer, Technical Support Engineer, or Technical Consultant), including ownership of customer onboarding through to production

- Solid understanding of cellular networks, IoT devices, various Radio Access Technologies (RATs), and communication protocols (e.g., TCP/IP, UDP, MQTT)

- Experience working with scripting languages (e.g., Python or Ruby), SQL, and REST APIs

- A track record of building automations or integrations against real operational workflows, not just using them

- Experience applying AI tooling to real support, onboarding, or operational workflows

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics to non-technical audiences

- Proven ability to quickly learn and adapt to new technologies and technical concepts

- Comfortable working independently across a wide range of technical problems, and defining your own approach on work that has no established process yet

- Familiarity with Salesforce or a comparable CRM, and how record hygiene affects downstream reporting (nice-to-have)

You Might Be a Great Fit If You…

- Enjoy solving complex, technical problems that directly impact customer success

- Have a curious, self-driven mindset and aren't afraid to dig into logs, APIs, or device configurations

- Thrive in customer conversations and can translate technical detail into clear, actionable guidance

- Are comfortable working across teams, from support and sales to product and engineering

- Enjoy taking a manual process and turning it into something clean, automated, and built to last

Target Salary Range: $135,000 - $150,000 + New Hire Equity grant (RSUs)
How we work at Hologram
Hologram is a fun, upbeat, and remote-first team united by our mission to build a more connected future. We trust you to do what’s best for our product, customers, and team members and empower you to make the right calls without heavy bureaucracy.
Benefits and Perks
Competitive compensation: All employees receive equity with transparent salary and equity formulas across the team
Health & time off: Flexible health coverage (up to 100% employee, 95% dependents), unlimited PTO with 2 weeks mandatory, monthly mental health days, and 14 weeks paid parental leave
Remote work support: $1,000 hiring bonus plus $250/month taxable Work-From-Home stipend
Financial security: Life and disability insurance fully covered, 401(k) plan, and Professional Development Fund after one year
We pride ourselves on celebrating everyone; Hologram is an equal opportunity employer actively working on creating a diverse and inclusive work environment where underrepresented groups can thrive.
What to expect in the interview process:

- Intro call (15 min)

- Take-Home Technical Assessment (45-60 min)

- Peer Technical Interview (50 min)

- Cross-Team Interview (30 min)

- Hiring Manager Interview (50 min)

- Leadership Interview (30 min)

Ready to apply?
If you share our values and our passion for connecting the world, we’d love to review your application! For any needed accommodations during the hiring process, please email .

remote.title: Revenue Accountant
remote.description:
About Gladly

For business leaders who want to get AI right, Gladly is the only customer experience AI that delivers the cost savings they need AND the customer devotion that drives lasting business value. With over a decade of singular CX focus and trusted by the world's most customer-centric brands including Crate & Barrel, Breeze Airways, and Ulta Beauty, Gladly was designed for devotion, not deflection: purpose-built to engage customers and turn every conversation into lasting relationship equity. The result is experiences that are radically personal and effortlessly scalable, emotionally intelligent and operationally efficient.

At the heart of our simply powerful platform, Gladly maintains one continuous conversation across all channels while striking the perfect balance of AI and human connection. With 450M+ conversations powered globally, $510M+ cumulative cost savings delivered for customers, and a 65% increase in CSAT, this is a team where your work has real impact at scale. Learn more at.

The Team
You will be joining an experienced leadership team backed by top-tier investors, including Greylock, NEA, and GGV. Reporting to the Director of Accounting, you will own the revenue and billing cycle end to end. This is an individual contributor role, you own the function rather than a team.
Our accounting team acts as the financial backbone of the organization, fostering a culture of ownership, continuous improvement, and collaboration with cross-functional partners in FP&A, Sales, Sales Operations, Customer Success, and Legal.
The Opportunity
We are seeking a hands-on Revenue Accountant to own the full revenue cycle at a high-growth AI+SaaS company, from the moment a contract is signed through invoicing, recognition, and cash collection.
This is a role for someone who wants their fingerprints on the process, not just the output. You will inherit a growing book of subscription and usage-based contracts and a billing system in Tabs that is live but not yet fully dialed in. There is real work ahead to tighten the configuration, close the gaps between Tabs and NetSuite, and help shape how revenue operations should run as we scale. If you are energized by cleaning up a schedule, automating a manual close step, and being the person everyone trusts on how a deal should be billed and recognized, you will do the best work of your career here.
You will also be one of the few people in Finance who talks directly to customers. How you handle a billing question shapes how a customer experiences Gladly, and we take that seriously.
What You’ll Do:

-
Customer invoicing & billing: Own the end-to-end billing cycle for subscription, usage-based, and outcome-based contracts. Issue timely, accurate invoices, tie every invoice to the signed order form, and manage billing schedules through upgrades, mid-term changes, renewals, credits, and true-ups.

-
Revenue reporting & recognition: Maintain revenue and deferred revenue schedules under ASC 606 across recurring and consumption-based models. Own the month-end close journal entries for revenue, AR, and related accounts, and prepare monthly reconciliations, roll-forward, and variance analysis, delivering clean , close-ready reporting on a predictable cadence.

-
Revenue treatment support: Support the review of new and modified contracts for proper revenue treatment, including standalone selling price allocation, contract modifications, and variable consideration. Document conclusions and partner cross-functionally with Sales on questions that come up, including for newer models like AI licensing and outcome-based pricing.

-
Commission capitalization & amortization: Own the commission accrual and payout cycle in partnership with FP&A, Sales, and People Ops. Capitalize and amortize commissions and other costs to obtain a contract under ASC 340-40, and maintain the supporting schedules.

-
Accounts receivable & collections: Serve as the primary contact for accounts receivable matters. Manage the accurate daily recording of cash receipts and application of payments, drive AR aging and collections to hit DSO, cash, and burn ratio targets, and run the collections cadence. Deliver weekly, monthly and ad hoc AR reporting and key metrics to management, escalate at-risk balances with Sales and Customer Success, and maintain the allowance for credit losses.

-
Customer & cross-functional support: Serve as the front line for billing and invoicing questions from customers and internal teams, resolving them with the same care our customers expect from the rest of Gladly. Partner with Sales, Deal Desk, and Legal during contract review so deals are structured cleanly, and support FP&A with revenue and billings inputs for forecasting.

-
Systems & process improvement: Help improve the quote-to-cash flow across NetSuite and Tabs, replacing manual work with repeatable, documented processes. Maintain internal controls and audit-ready support, and serve as a key revenue contact for external auditors.

What we’re looking for:

- Experience: 5+ years in revenue accounting, billing, or order-to-cash roles, including ownership of a monthly revenue close.

- Education: Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

- Industry expertise: Revenue accounting experience at a technology or SaaS company with recurring and usage-based revenue streams.

- Technical skills: Working knowledge of ASC 606 as applied to subscription and usage-based revenue models, including deferred revenue, contract modifications, and variable consideration. Familiarity with ASC 340-40 for commission capitalization and amortization is a plus.

- Systems: NetSuite proficiency is required, including familiarity with the Advanced Revenue Management module. Hands-on experience with a dedicated billing platform is required, ideally Tabs, or a comparable system such as Zuora, Ordway, Maxio, or Stripe Billing. Advanced Excel and Google Sheets skills, including pivot tables, lookups, and high-volume reconciliation.

- Professional background: A CPA license is preferred but not required.

- Personal characteristics: You have real drive and curiosity, you're comfortable owning a function independently, and you're eager to learn and figure things out even when you don't have the answer yet.

- Exceptional problem-solving and communication skills, with a collaborative mindset.

- The ability to navigate ambiguity, manage competing deadlines, and hold a close timeline without sacrificing accuracy.

- A willingness to learn and contribute to a fast-paced team fueled by underdog grit and a shared passion for excellence.

Salary for this role: $110,000 - $125,000 USD
The cash compensation above includes base salary, and is not reflective of potential commission for employees in eligible roles, or annual bonus targets under Gladly's bonus plan for eligible roles. In addition to cash compensation, all Gladly's employees are eligible to participate in Gladly's equity incentive plan to receive stock options per the terms of the agreement. Individual compensation packages are based on a few different factors unique to each candidate, including their career level, skills, experience, specific geographic location qualifications and other job-related reasons.

Why Join Gladly?

Gladly is redefining customer experience AI; we're designed for devotion, not deflection. We put people at the center of everything we build, from our platform to our culture. When you join us, you'll enjoy:

- Competitive salaries, stock options, and comprehensive benefits

- Generous paid time off, parental leave, and home office stipends

- A fully remote work environment with opportunities for in-person team gatherings

- A strong commitment to professional growth and an inclusive workplace where diverse perspectives thrive

- A company where AI is not a buzzword. We build AI products and we expect our team to use AI tools daily

We're a team that believes in transparency, collaboration, and the idea that the best work happens when talented people genuinely enjoy working together. Top talent, good vibes, no politics. If this role excites you but you don't meet every qualification, we still encourage you to apply. The perspectives and experiences you bring matter more than checking every box.

Leadership & Security Architecture

- Help define security architecture for the cloud and AI platforms: set direction, write specs, and steward secure-by-default patterns across teams

- Review infrastructure and application designs for authorization, network, data-protection, secrets, and tenant-isolation risks

- Partner with Cloud Solutions, application engineering, AI engineering, Identity, CyberOps, and GRC/Privacy to prioritize work and drive adoption

Cloud & Identity Security

- Own and evolve security architecture for a multi-account AWS organization — account boundaries, service control policies, IAM Identity Center, delegated security services, KMS, VPC controls, and WAF

- Build and maintain reusable security controls in Terraform or OpenTofu, with safe rollout, testing, monitoring, and recovery patterns

- Strengthen centralized logging and evidence — CloudTrail, Config, GuardDuty, Security Hub, Macie, and CloudWatch — and keep guardrails current as the environment grows

Secure Software Delivery

- Integrate practical security checks into developer workflows — secrets detection, dependency and container scanning, SBOMs, Infrastructure as Code analysis, code scanning, and risk-based release gates

- Support vulnerability management for internally developed software, from detection and prioritization through remediation evidence and exception handling. Partner with the Vulnerability Manager to establish prioritization and reduce false positives

- Improve controls with engineers rather than around them, avoiding noisy or easily bypassed gates

Application & AI Security

- Lead threat modeling and security design reviews for web applications, APIs, data ingestion, authentication and authorization flows, and agentic systems

- Define secure patterns for Amazon Bedrock and other model platforms, including model access, guardrail lifecycle, invocation logging, usage attribution, and sensitive-data controls

- Harden agent tools, MCP servers, gateways, sandboxes, and code-execution environments against prompt injection, confused-deputy attacks, excessive agency, secret disclosure, data exfiltration, and cross-tenant access

Detection, Response & Assurance

- Translate cloud and application telemetry into actionable detections, runbooks, ownership, and escalation paths in partnership with CyberOps

- Lead technical response and root-cause remediation for cloud, identity, software supply chain, and AI security incidents

- Establish severity and ownership standards for cloud findings, software vulnerabilities, and AI security issues, with clear remediation expectations

- Produce the control evidence GRC and Privacy need, without turning engineering work into manual reporting

remote.description:
Our world is transforming, and PTC is leading the way. Our software brings the physical and digital worlds together, enabling companies to improve operations, create better products, and empower people in all aspects of their business.
Our people make all the difference in our success. Today, we are a global team of nearly 7,000 and our main objective is to create opportunities for our team members to explore, learn, and grow – all while seeing their ideas come to life and celebrating the differences that make us who we are and the work we do possible.
Position Summary
The Director, Global Partner Sales, Accenture Alliance is responsible for leading and growing PTC's strategic global partnership with Accenture. This role owns the overall alliance strategy, executive relationship management, governance framework, joint business planning, and market activation required to accelerate revenue growth, pipeline creation, and enterprise customer success worldwide.
As the senior alliance leader for Accenture, this individual will build and maintain executive relationships across both organizations, establish operating and governance cadences, develop joint solution strategies, and align global and regional teams around shared business objectives. Success will be measured through alliance growth, executive engagement, joint solution adoption, partner-sourced and partner-influenced business, and the overall health and effectiveness of the global partnership. The role reflects PTC's focus on executive alignment, solution ownership, measurable business outcomes, and partner-driven growth.
Primary Objective
Lead and grow PTC's global Accenture alliance through executive alignment, strategic planning, governance, joint solution development, and measurable business outcomes that accelerate revenue and pipeline growth worldwide.
Key Responsibilities:
Global Alliance Strategy

- Define and execute the global strategy for the Accenture partnership in alignment with PTC growth objectives.

- Develop and maintain multi-year business plans that drive revenue growth, pipeline expansion, and market leadership.

- Identify new growth opportunities, strategic investments, and emerging market initiatives within the alliance.

- Establish alliance objectives, success metrics, and annual operating priorities.

Executive Relationship Management

- Build and maintain trusted relationships with Accenture and PTC executive leadership.

- Establish regular executive engagement and sponsorship programs across both organizations.

- Facilitate strategic alignment between leadership teams on priorities, investments, and growth initiatives.

- Serve as the primary executive escalation point for alliance opportunities and business issues.

Alliance Governance & Business Planning

- Lead the global governance framework for the partnership.

- Conduct executive business reviews, steering committees, and strategic planning sessions.

- Drive accountability against joint business plans and performance objectives.

- Coordinate investments, resources, and priorities across both organizations.

Joint Solution Strategy

- Define and prioritize joint solutions that address strategic customer initiatives and industry transformation priorities.

- Align sales, marketing, services, and industry teams around solution-led growth motions.

- Drive adoption and expansion of joint offerings across target markets and industries.

- Champion innovation and differentiation through the alliance.

Global Go-To-Market Leadership

- Coordinate regional alliance leaders and field teams to ensure execution consistency worldwide.

- Sponsor strategic opportunities and key customer pursuits.

- Drive global co-sell, co-marketing, and business development programs.

- Ensure alignment between global strategy and regional execution plans.

Alliance Performance Management

- Own global alliance performance against revenue, pipeline, and strategic growth objectives.

- Establish and monitor KPIs that measure business impact and partnership effectiveness.

- Identify risks, barriers, and growth opportunities within the alliance.

- Provide regular performance updates and strategic recommendations to executive leadership.

Qualifications
Required

- 10+ years of experience in strategic alliances, partner sales, business development, or enterprise software sales.

- Significant experience managing executive-level relationships within large global organizations.

- Proven success building and scaling strategic partnerships that deliver measurable business outcomes.

- Experience leading complex global initiatives across matrixed organizations.

- Strong strategic planning, business development, and negotiation skills.

- Executive presence with the ability to influence senior leaders both internally and externally.

Preferred

- Direct experience working with Accenture.

- Experience managing Global System Integrator (GSI) partnerships.

- Understanding of enterprise software, digital transformation, AI, engineering, manufacturing, PLM, ALM, or industrial technology markets.

- Experience leading alliance governance models, executive steering committees, and global business planning processes.

Success Metrics

- Global alliance revenue growth

- Partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline growth

- Executive engagement and relationship strength

- Joint business plan execution

- Joint solution adoption and market impact

- Strategic account penetration

- Co-sell and co-marketing performance

- Overall alliance health and governance effectiveness

Onze klant is een sterke, groeiende speler in de Belgische vastgoedmarkt. remote.title: Director, Product Architecture
remote.description:
SailPoint is defining how identity security works for humans, machines, and AI agents. As Director of Product Architecture, you will be the senior technical authority for authorization-related products across our product portfolio. You will own the architectural vision and drive its adoption across product teams. This is a hands-on IC role with company-wide influence, reporting directly to Chief Product Officer.

What you’ll do

- Define and evolve SailPoint’s authorization architecture, covering policy models, enforcement points, and delegation across the platform, for both human and agentic identities.

- Set the technical direction for how authorization capabilities are built once and reused across product teams, so customers get one coherent experience.

- Work with Engineering and Product Management to turn architecture into roadmap, and to resolve cross-team design conflicts.

- Track and shape emerging standards and protocols (OAuth 2.x, token exchange, MCP, Shared Signals/CAEP, policy languages such as Cedar and OPA) and decide where SailPoint leads and where it adopts.

- Support analyst, customer, and field conversations with credible technical depth, including CISO and CIO audiences.

- Produce clear architecture artifacts, reference designs, and technical narratives that product, engineering, and GTM teams can act on.

What you bring

- 12+ years in software architecture or product architecture, with significant depth in authorization, access control, or identity and access management.

- Strong command of authorization models (RBAC, ABAC, ReBAC, policy-as-code), modern identity protocols, and distributed systems design.

- Experience shipping enterprise security or identity products at scale.

- A track record of driving alignment across multiple teams without direct authority.

- Exposure to AI agent security, non-human identity, or API and gateway enforcement is a strong plus.

- Excellent written and verbal communication, and the ability to explain complex architecture to executives, customers, and engineers alike.

Success looks like

- A single, well-understood authorization architecture adopted across the product teams.

- Faster, more consistent delivery of authorization capabilities, with less duplicated effort.

-
SailPoint recognized by customers and analysts as a leader in authorization for the agentic era.

Benefits and Compensation listed vary based on the location of your employment and the nature of your employment with SailPoint.

As a part of the total compensation package, this role may be eligible for the SailPoint Corporate Bonus Plan or a role-specific commission, along with potential eligibility for equity participation. SailPoint maintains broad salary ranges for its roles to account for variations in knowledge, skills, experience, market conditions and locations, as well as reflect SailPoint’s differing products, industries, and lines of business. Candidates are typically placed into the range based on the preceding factors as well as internal peer equity. We estimate the base salary, for US-based employees, will be in this range from (min-max, USD):
$166,800 - $281,194.00Base salaries for employees based in other locations are competitive for the employee’s home location.
Benefits Overview
1. Health and wellness coverage: Medical, dental, and vision insurance
2. Disability coverage: Short-term and long-term disability
3. Life protection: Life insurance and Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D)
4. Additional life coverage options: Supplemental life insurance for employees, spouses, and children
5. Flexible spending accounts for health care, and dependent care; limited purpose flexible spending account
6. Financial security: 401(k) Savings and Investment Plan with company matching
7. Time off benefits: Flexible vacation policy
8. Holidays: 8 paid holidays annually
9. Sick leave
10. Parental support: Paid parental leave
11. Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and Care Counselors
12. Voluntary benefits: Legal Assistance, Critical Illness, Accident, Hospital Indemnity and Pet Insurance options

remote.title: Regulatory / Compliance Manager
remote.description:
Regulatory / Compliance Manager
Location: London (Hybrid) or Remote (UK-Based)
Department: Risk & Compliance
Employment Type: Full Time
Salary: £50,000 + Equity
About Zenrox
Zenrox Healthcare UK is an AI-powered medical equipment marketplace, trusted by healthcare facilities across the country. Our automated compliance engine verifies MHRA and UKCA certifications in real time, ensuring all products and transactions meet NHS and CQC standards. We eliminate compliance risks for healthcare providers through robust, technology-driven regulatory safeguards.
The Opportunity
We are seeking a highly skilled Regulatory / Compliance Manager to own and shape the entire compliance function at Zenrox. In this foundational role, you will build the systems, processes, and documentation that ensure our marketplace operates in full adherence with MHRA, UKCA, NHS, and CQC requirements.
You will manage all aspects of regulatory strategy as we scale, ensuring Zenrox remains audit-ready, compliant, and trusted by healthcare organisations nationwide.
Key Responsibilities

- Establish and maintain Zenroxs MHRA medical device distributor registration and ensure ongoing compliance.

- Design and manage supplier compliance verification workflows, including checks on MHRA registration, UKCA/CE marking, insurance, and required certifications.

- Build automated compliance monitoring and documentation systems integrated with the ZenroxIQ platform.

- Maintain audit-ready documentation for all suppliers, products, and transactions.

- Continuously monitor regulatory changes (MHRA, NHS, UKCA transition timelines) and update internal processes accordingly.

- Serve as the primary point of contact for MHRA inquiries, regulatory audits, inspections, and compliance reviews.

- Develop compliance training materials and deliver sessions for internal teams and suppliers.

- Implement audit trail generation capabilities to support NHS compliance audits and CQC inspections.

- Establish and manage GDPR-compliant data protection policies and internal processes.

- Collaborate with legal counsel on supplier agreements, terms of service, and regulatory risk mitigation.

- Support sales teams with compliance documentation, tender support, and customer assurance materials.

What You Bring

- Minimum of 4 years experience in regulatory affairs, compliance, or quality assurance.

- Expert knowledge of MHRA regulations and UK medical device compliance (MDR 2002).

- Strong understanding of UKCA/CE marking requirements and transition timelines.

- Experience with medical device classification, risk assessment, and regulatory submissions.

- Exceptional attention to detail with a structured approach to documentation and audit preparation.

- Ability to translate complex regulation into manageable operational processes.

- Strong risk management orientation with the ability to identify and resolve compliance gaps.

- Excellent written communication and documentation skills.

Ideal Background (Preferred)

- Regulatory experience within medical device manufacturing, distribution, or importing.

- Experience preparing for CQC inspections or NHS compliance audits.

- Hands-on exposure to ISO 13485 quality management systems.

- Experience in e-commerce, marketplace, or multi-vendor compliance environments.

- Familiarity with AI or Software-as-a-Medical-Device (SaMD) regulatory frameworks.

- Experience building compliance functions within startups or scale-ups.

Why Join Zenrox

- Foundational regulatory role with meaningful equity.

- Opportunity to design and own compliance strategy for a fast-growing, AI-driven healthcare platform.

- Leverage automated tools that remove manual compliance workload.

- Direct impact on patient safety, healthcare quality, and institutional risk reduction.

- Long-term opportunity to build and lead the compliance team.

How to Apply
Send your CV and a brief overview of your regulatory/compliance experience to:
Email subject line:
Regulatory/Compliance Manager Application [Your Name]

remote.title: Sr. Director, Partnerships
remote.description:
POSITION SUMMARYThe Senior Director, Partnerships is a senior, quota-carrying revenue leader responsible for sourcing, developing, and closing sponsorship and strategic partnership opportunities across BMI's portfolio of live events, industry programs, digital platforms, and creator-driven initiatives. As the leading performing rights organization championing songwriters, composers, and music publishers, BMI offers unique access to the artists and moments that shape culture — and this role is central to monetizing that access through brand partnerships. This role is accountable for building a consistent pipeline of mid- to high-value partnerships and delivering against defined revenue targets. Each Senior Director focuses on designated industry verticals (e.g., financial services and technology, automotive/consumer, beverage/spirits/Latin markets), developing deep expertise and relationships within those categories. The role plays a critical part in scaling BMI's sponsorship business through proactive business development, disciplined pipeline management, and effective deal execution.
FUNCTIONS OF THE JOB
Essential Functions (representative, not all-inclusive):
Develops and maintains a robust pipeline of sponsorship opportunities within assigned verticals, with clear focus on revenue generation. Sources new business through outbound outreach, industry networking, and strategic account development. Builds and manages relationships with senior brand marketers, agencies, and corporate partners. Prepares and presents customized proposals and sales materials aligned with partner objectives and BMI's assets — including live events, artist access, content platforms, and digital/social reach. Negotiates sponsorship agreements in coordination with Legal/Business Affairs and senior leadership. Achieves individual revenue targets and contributes to overall team performance. Collaborates with Marketing & Activation and Operations teams to ensure successful execution of partnerships. Maintains accurate pipeline, activity tracking, and forecasting using CRM tools. Participates in regular pipeline reviews and provides clear reporting on deal status and revenue outlook. Travel required (50%).
POSITION QUALIFICATIONS
Education: Bachelor's degree required.
Experience:
7–10+ years in sponsorship sales, partnerships, or media/entertainment business development, with a demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets. Ideal candidates have experience at an advertising agency, music agency, or Fortune 500 company in a partnership sales capacity.
Skills and Abilities:
Strong sales and business development skills with a proven ability to close partnership deals. Excellent presentation, negotiation, and communication skills. Ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and prioritize across multiple opportunities. Strong relationship-building skills across brands, agencies, and partners. Results-oriented, self-directed, and highly motivated. Professional presence and ability to represent BMI in external, high-profile settings.
COMPENSATION:
The anticipated base salary range for this position is $135,000–$180,000 USD annually, plus eligibility for an annual commission target based on individual revenue performance. Actual base salary offered will depend on factors such as experience, qualifications, skills, and geographic location. This role may also be eligible for additional incentives, benefits, and other forms of compensation as part of BMI's total rewards package.

How Our Core Service Works:

Customers sign up on our web portal to schedule services on their respective campuses. Packing supply kits are shipped out to students as requested. remote.title: Co-Founder & CEO - AI LegalTech | AI-Native Litigation Defence Operations
remote.description:
The Opportunity
FutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to lead LucentAI, an AI-native litigation operations venture in build at FutureSight. This offers meaningful founder equity, not a salary.
LucentAI serves as an autopilot for medical-records and discovery operations in small-to-mid insurance-defence firms. Embedding in case-management systems, it retrieves and reviews records, flags key facts with confidence links, checks billing reasonableness, and chronologically triages discovery. This human-gated system excludes legal drafting, externalizing review capacity so firms can scale case volume without adding headcount.
Market validation through FutureSight’s discovery interviews confirmed strong demand:

- Operations is the wedge; autopilot is the vision. All buyers wanted managed operations. LucentAI provides end-to-end automation, earning trust incrementally by handling routine work silently while keeping legal drafting human.

- The pain is in the dollars, not the dashboards. One lead costs the middle phase at ~$1M/year in time and errors; a partner noted only ~$200K of a $1M medical bill was reasonable. With zero AI currently used, the ROI-driven payback case is immediate.

- Capacity is the ceiling, and the record is the moat. Manual partner review caps case capacity and revenue. Defence records and billing patterns form a proprietary dataset that plaintiff-focused incumbents lack.

Market Context
We target underserved small-to-mid US insurance-defence firms.
The Phase-1 beachhead SAM is $150M–$600M across 1,500–3,000 firms; the full roadmap reaches a ≥$100M obtainable market (SOM ≈ $110M–$360M).
With 71% of legal AI funding flowing to plaintiff-focused companies, the defence market remains underserved, creating a need for technology purpose-built for litigation defence and risk management.
About FutureSight

FutureSight is a leading venture builder that co-creates world-class software companies with values-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale.
You’ll co-create with a proven studio team, led by John Carbrey (4x entrepreneur, $100M ARR), Krista LaRiviere (3x exited, E&Y Top Women Entrepreneur), Alan Smith (Strategyzer co-founder, $120M in products built), Prathna Ramesh (former MD of Maple Leaf Angels, $275M in follow-on capital), and Johnny Tong (0-to-1 builder, acquired by SAP and Stripe) bring a rare combination of operator exits, institutional investing, and AI product depth.
The Partnership

- Founder equity with meaningful ownership from inception

- Pre-seed capital committed by FutureSight for early hires and MVP development, with potential for follow-on funding

- Venture building resources, including embedded design, engineering, growth, and fundraising support from day one

- Investor and advisor network across vertical AI and early-stage capital markets

- A true co-creation model in which you operate as CEO with FutureSight's cross-functional team as your partner

What you'll own
As Co-Founder & CEO, you will set the venture's direction and lead its execution.

- Strategy — Refine the ICP, size-tiered pricing model, and product positioning

- Customer Development — Lead pilots with managing partners and claims/litigation-operations leads at small-to-mid insurance-defence firms, starting from the confirmed design partner, convert them to paid engagements, and build the go-to-market motion

- Product — Partner with the FutureSight product and engineering team to ship V1 (records retrieval, key-fact flagging, billing-reasonableness analysis, and discovery triage) and iterate on user feedback; sequence carrier reserving and prediction as a later phase

- Capital — Lead the seed raise, supported by FutureSight's network and traction

- Team — Recruit and lead the founding team, and establish the cultural foundation of the company

Co-Founder Profile

- Previous founding experience at a venture-backed company

- Demonstrated success in B2B AI or B2B SaaS go-to-market, including consultative, relationship-driven sales and customer engagement

- Fundraising fluency, with the ability to develop investor narratives and close capital

- Proven ability to attract, develop, and retain top talent

- Clear-eyed understanding of the risks and demands of co-founding a venture-backed company

- Deep domain expertise in insurance defence or claims operations, including pre-litigation records and discovery, legal billing review, and litigation case management.

How to Apply
Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.
FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.

About Savi Security

Savi Security is a cybersecurity startup, focused on protecting families from scams and fraud. We currently operate a free scam checker, , and a premium mobile app that automatically blocks scam texts and calls, and does live call screening and protection. Our company is early-stage and founded in October 2025 with a team size of ~10 people.

We are looking for a Product Designer to take ownership of the end-to-end user journey—leading design from the moment a user first discovers Savi through to their conversion into an active, engaged Savi Premium subscriber.

Collaborate Across Leadership & Marketing: Present design narratives and strategy to executive leadership and marketing stakeholders. Know when to advocate strongly for user experience, when to incorporate feedback, and how to balance creative vision with business goals.

Pioneer AI-Driven Workflows: Continuously explore, evaluate, and integrate emerging AI tools and workflows into how you design and how design handoff works with engineering.

-
Elevate the Craft & Mentor: Act as a thought partner and mentor to peer designers on the team—fostering a culture of feedback, rapid prototyping, and relentless pursuit of design quality.

Obsessed with Product Design: You are a true student of the craft. You spend time analyzing tear downs on Mobbin, studying design systems, keeping up with product launches, and dissecting what makes top-tier consumer apps succeed.

AI-Forward & Adaptable: You recognize that design and engineering are rapidly evolving with AI. You are proactive about testing new AI tools (for design, prototyping, asset generation, or code bridging), tweaking your process, and leading the team in adopting modern methods.

Balanced Communicator: You possess strong executive presence and communication skills. You can present complex designs clearly, push back constructively with data or UX rationale, and pivot gracefully when strategic direction shifts.

Systematic Thinker: You treat design systems as living products. You know how to structure tokens, components, and documentation so engineering can build faster and with total fidelity.

Natural Mentor: You love sharing knowledge, pairing on design problems, and lifting the skill floor of the designers around you—all without needing a people manager title to do so.

-
Marketing & Graphic Design: Ability to jump into marketing collateral, landing pages, or ad creative to ensure seamless brand consistency from ad click to in-app conversion.
