Overview of Position

Speedcast delivers highly customizable, mission-critical communication solutions for remote sites worldwide. Our Data Engineering team operates a modern lakehouse platform — streaming telemetry from satellite and SD-WAN networks through Kafka into Iceberg, TimescaleDB, and a cloud query layer — that powers analytics across the business.

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will own the machine learning lifecycle on this platform end-to-end: from framing problems with stakeholders, through model development and evaluation, to deployment, monitoring, and retraining in production. Typical problem spaces include network usage and capacity forecasting, anomaly detection on high-volume time-series telemetry, and predictive insights for service quality and cost.
This is a senior role on a small, agile team. You will set the technical bar for how models are built, evaluated, and operated at Speedcast, and you will mentor AI Engineers on machine learning fundamentals and production discipline. The successful candidate works independently, proactively drives improvements, and communicates clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences.

What you will do

- Design, build, evaluate, and deploy machine learning models — including time-series forecasting, anomaly detection, and classification — on network telemetry and business data.

- Build and maintain feature and training-data pipelines on top of the data lakehouse (streaming and batch sources).

- Own MLOps practices end-to-end: experiment tracking, model versioning and registry, CI/CD for models, automated retraining, and monitoring for drift and degradation.

- Define and promote standards for model development, evaluation, documentation, and governance across the team.

- Translate business problems into well-framed ML problems, and communicate model behaviour, limitations, and business impact to stakeholders.

- Collaborate closely with data engineers to productionize models as reliable, observable services on AWS.

- Mentor AI Engineers and data scientists on ML best practices, code quality, and evaluation rigour.

- Participate in Agile ceremonies, backlog grooming, sprint planning, and prioritisation activities.

- Evaluate and support the adoption of new ML technologies, tools, and architectural approaches.

What we need from you

- 5+ years of experience in machine learning, data science, or ML engineering, including delivering and operating models in production.

- Strong programming skills in Python and deep familiarity with the ML ecosystem (e.g., scikit-learn, XGBoost, PyTorch or TensorFlow, pandas).

- Strong SQL skills and experience working with large analytical datasets.

- Hands-on experience with time-series modelling: forecasting and/or anomaly detection at scale.

- Solid grounding in statistics, experiment design, and model evaluation methodology.

- Hands-on experience with AWS services (e.g., SageMaker, Lambda, Step Functions, S3, ECR) and deploying ML workloads in the cloud.

- Experience containerising applications using Docker.

- Experience with MLOps tooling and practices (experiment tracking, model registries, monitoring).

- Experience using Git for source control and working within Agile/Scrum environments.

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including explaining model behaviour to non-technical audiences.

Even better if you have

- Experience applying ML to streaming data (Kafka/Confluent, Flink) or near-real-time inference.

- Experience with lakehouse architectures (Apache Iceberg, Parquet, medallion/dbt patterns) and query engines such as Dremio.

- Experience with time-series databases such as TimescaleDB.

- Exposure to LLMs and generative AI systems, including evaluation of generative outputs.

- Experience in telecommunications, satellite, networking, or IoT telemetry domains.

- Experience with Infrastructure as Code (e.g., CloudFormation, Terraform) and CI/CD pipelines.

- Advanced AWS expertise, including relevant AWS or ML certifications.

- Experience mentoring engineers or leading technical workstreams.

remote.description:
Role Title: Finance Research Expert
Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote
Opportunity Snapshot
Pay: $30 - $60 per hour
Time per task: around 4 to 8 hours
Location: Remote, worldwide
You’ll need: Hands-on experience reading US SEC filings and familiarity with US GAAP
Your tasks: Write finance research questions with a verified, sourced answer, and check each one against what AI models answer
Scope of Work
You will work on questions about real US public companies. Each question points to information that sits in long filings or IR materials, or that requires comparing several of them to find the right answer.

- Write questions that require finding a specific figure in a 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, proxy statement, earnings release or investor presentation.

- Write questions where two documents show different numbers and the answer depends on knowing which one is correct (for example, original vs. restated figures, or adjusted vs. reported).

- Pay attention to period and document version: the right fiscal year, the right filing, the latest amended version.

- Test each question against current AI models and keep only the ones they answer incorrectly.

- Rewrite questions when the wording allows more than one valid answer.

What we’re looking for
Hands-on work with US filings in one of these backgrounds:

-
Equity research or investment analysis (sell-side or buy-side) covering US companies.

-
Investment banking or corporate development (M&A, equity capital markets), with experience in deal filings, prospectuses, ownership history and subsidiary structures.

-
Credit or restructuring analysis, with experience in credit agreements, bond terms and bankruptcy filings.

-
SEC reporting or audit (Big 4 audit, corporate reporting), with experience in restatements, footnotes and how figures change across filings.

-
Corporate law or due diligence (securities law, KYC, investigations), with experience tracing entities, executives and related parties across records.

You should also be comfortable reading long filings, including footnotes and tables, and have clear written English.
How the selection process works

-
Apply with your resume and a short profile.

-
Complete the finance interview. It is a short conversation about your experience with US filings and financial reporting. You don’t need to prepare or write anything. Finishing it is what moves your application forward.

-
Review. We check your experience against what the project needs.

-
Onboarding and first task. If selected, you get the guidelines and start with an initial task, which is reviewed before you continue.

- 5+ years of healthcare IT or Epic-related experience, including program or project leadership in complex delivery environments

- Excellent written and verbal communication, facilitation, organization, and follow-through

- Ability to create structure in evolving environments and translate broad needs into clear actions, owners, and timelines

Help shape the future of customer service within Retail Solutions Service.
As a Business Systems Analyst or Business Systems Consultant supporting our Service AI efforts, you'll work at the intersection of business and technology to help design, test, deliver, and continuously improve AI-enabled experiences. You'll partner with business stakeholders, Product Owners, engineers, and cross-functional teams to translate customer and business needs into solutions that deliver meaningful outcomes.
Our Service AI team operates with a test-and-learn mindset, leveraging customer feedback, experimentation, analytics, and continuous improvement to enhance customer and associate experiences. We're looking for someone who is curious, adaptable, collaborative, and comfortable navigating ambiguity while helping turn emerging technologies into practical business solutions.
WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU:

- Estimated Salary (Levels have variable responsibilities and qualifications):

- Business Systems Analyst I: $25.50-32.00 hourly, plus annual bonus opportunity.

- Business Systems Analyst II: $59,000 - $76,000, plus annual bonus opportunity.

- Business Systems Analyst III: $68,000 - $87,500, plus annual bonus opportunity.

- Business Systems Consultant I: $75,500 - $97,000, plus annual bonus opportunity.

- Business Systems Consultant II: $86,000 - $114,000, plus annual bonus opportunity.

- Business Systems Consultant III: $99,000-133,500, plus annual bonus opportunity.

- 401(k) plan with a 2% company contribution and 6% company match.

- Work-life balance with vacation, personal time and paid holidays. See our benefits and perks page for details.

- Applicants for this position must not now, nor at any point in the future, require sponsorship for employment.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:
• Partner with business and technology teams to translate customer and business needs into requirements, user stories, process flows, test scenarios, and actionable solutions.
• Collaborate with Product Owners, engineers, architects, operations teams, and other stakeholders to design, deliver, and continuously enhance AI-enabled service experiences.
• Lead and support testing, validation, quality assurance, automated testing, and performance measurement efforts to ensure successful solution delivery.
• Analyze customer journeys, business processes, operational insights, and feedback to identify opportunities to improve experiences, increase efficiency, and drive business value.
• Apply a test-and-learn mindset by leveraging customer feedback, experimentation, analytics, testing results, and production insights to refine and optimize solutions.
• Partner across business, technology, service, and risk management teams to ensure solutions align with customer needs, operational readiness, business objectives, and regulatory requirements.
WHAT YOU’LL BRING:
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills with the ability to navigate ambiguity and develop practical solutions to complex business challenges.
• Ability to balance customer, business, technology, and risk considerations while effectively communicating with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Experience gathering requirements, documenting business processes, creating test scenarios, and supporting the successful delivery of business and technology initiatives.
• Strong quality mindset with experience supporting testing, validation, continuous improvement, and measuring solution effectiveness.
• Curiosity, adaptability, and a willingness to learn and apply emerging technologies, including AI, generative AI, conversational AI, and automation.
• Strong communication, facilitation, stakeholder management, and business acumen skills, with insurance industry knowledge or experience in financial services considered a strong advantage.
• You promote a collaborative culture, value different ideas and opinions, and listen courageously, remaining curious in all that you do.
• Able to work remotely with access to a high-speed internet connection and located in the United States.
PREFERRED:
• Familiarity with AI, generative AI, conversational AI, automation, digital transformation, or other emerging technology initiatives.
• Strong ability to gather requirements, analyze business processes, and translate customer and business needs into actionable solutions.
• Background in software testing, test automation, AI-enabled tools, and iterative test-and-learn approaches that drive quality, efficiency, scalability, and business outcomes.
We value unique experience, skills, and passion for innovation. If your experience aligns with the listed requirements, please apply!

remote.title: Lead Product Designer (m/f/d)
remote.description:
About Hilo by Aktiia
High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health.
We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US.
We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. Applicants must already hold a valid visa or work permit for their country of residence, as Hilo is not able to provide visa sponsorship.
Role overview
UX is our number one priority, and we need a design leader who consistently turns design into business outcomes. As Lead Product Designer, you set the quality bar for our app, own our design system and drive our biggest product bets from first idea to shipped result. You are hands-on: you prototype, you craft, you ship.
You will report directly to our Head of Design and work with product and engineering every day. You will be the design partner who keeps the whole product consistent and high quality, together with our Lead UX Writer and a Senior Product Designer.
You will have real ownership on a health product people use every day, in a business-critical, high-visibility role where UX is our top priority. You join a team with high talent density, people who raise your game, and a shared focus on speed, clarity and craft.
Location: Fully remote, open to candidates across the UK and Europe.
Core responsibilities
Direction & Outcomes

- Set the design direction and quality bar across the app, from new features to health insights and early vision work.

- Define the success measures for your work and own the business results.

Design System & Prototyping

- Own our design system, built to work with AI tools, and keep it consistent through tokens and clear decisions.

- Show instead of tell, with high-fidelity prototypes and motion built with AI tools and our design system.

Leadership & Collaboration

- Raise the bar for the team. Support, coach and unblock other designers, and give clear feedback.

- Challenge product and engineering with evidence, persuade stakeholders and make clear, documented decisions.

- Work daily with product managers and design engineers.

Requirements
Background & Experience
Essential

- Proven design leadership, with a track record of consistently delivering strong business outcomes.

- 2 to 3 shipped case studies that demonstrate high impact: the problem, your hypothesis, your decisions, the measured result.

- Outstanding visual design craft: hierarchy, typography, motion and attention to detail.

- High-fidelity prototypes and videos of your work, ideally built with AI tools such as Claude or Lovable.

- Daily, practical use of AI tools and experience with AI-ready design systems.

- Fluent Figma, including components, variables and tokens.

- Strong product thinking: you work with data, hypotheses and measurements.

- Ideally health, consumer, behavior change or regulated products.

- A public portfolio website (required with your application).

Nice to Have

- Mobile apps, connected devices, simple prototypes in code.
How you work

- AI first — You are already playing with AI tools and you are excited about what they make possible.

- Builder — You ship, and you can spin up something from nothing.

- Bias for action — You are autonomous and self-sufficient. You don't wait for a brief and you don't need chasing.

- Disciplined — Tokens, not screenshots. Decision logs, not memories.

- Curious — You want to know why, not just what. You can explain who made each decision and how.

- Clear under pressure — Medical regulation and different market rules are design problems, not excuses.

This isn't for you if

- You need all requirements, research and data before you start.

- You measure screens shipped, not outcomes moved.

- You'd rather list risks than own one.

How we hire

- Recruiter screen (30 min)

- Portfolio interview with the Head of Design (60 min): visual craft, prototyping, AI fluency

- Product thinking and interaction design deep dive

- Cross-functional conversation with design engineers and product

- Final conversation with senior leadership (finalists)

What success looks like

- You take something off our plate and it gets done.

- If it won't happen, you tell us first.

- You bring the problem, the root cause and options.

- You flag risk to dates early, while we can still change it.

- The product feels consistent, fast and high quality, and design outcomes show up in the numbers.

Benefits
What Makes You A Great Fit
At Hilo by Aktiia, our values guide everything we do:
Move the Needle — You focus on what drives real impact. You understand that a great product experience is fundamental to good decision-making and growth, and you take accountability for the quality and outcomes of your work, from first idea through to shipped result.
Move Fast, Learn, Refine — You work with urgency and purpose, balancing speed with craft. You continuously improve the way Design operates, experiment with better tools and processes, including AI, and solve root causes rather than accepting repetitive manual work.
Team First — You collaborate effectively with colleagues, engineers, product managers and stakeholders across countries and functions. You build trust by being reliable, clear and constructive, while maintaining high standards for quality and consistency.
Why Join Us?

- Hilo by Aktiia is becoming one of the most important med-tech companies, and you can be part of this exciting story.

- Work on a mission that matters: transforming cardiovascular health at global scale.

- Be part of a high-impact, fast-growing, and venture-backed scale-up company.

- Collaborate with a diverse, passionate, and talented team.

- Competitive compensation and equity program, and other benefits (depending on location).

Ready to Move the Needle?
If you are passionate about making a meaningful impact in people's lives and excel in an environment where individuals take ownership and are committed to delivering results, we are happy to receive your application.

remote.title: Marketing & Brand Specialist
remote.description:
Who Are We?

JayWay Travel is approaching its 20th anniversary and has grown into an international travel company with a team of 100+ people across more than 20 countries.

We create personalized travel experiences across Europe, Latin America, and other destinations, helping travelers turn their ideas into memorable journeys.

Our team brings together travel enthusiasts, marketers, sales professionals, planners, and problem-solvers — all working toward creating great experiences for our guests.

Are You a Marketing Professional Who Likes to Get Things Done?

We’re looking for an experienced marketing professional who understands brands, enjoys working with people, and is comfortable taking an idea and figuring out how to make it happen.

This is a broad, cross-functional role covering areas such as brand, guest experience, partnerships, and marketing operations. You’ll work closely with the Head of Department and with teams across JayWay to keep projects moving, spot opportunities, and make sure the way we present and deliver JayWay feels consistent.

No two days will necessarily look the same — and that’s part of the appeal.

And don’t worry if you don’t tick every box or have experience in every area listed. We’re interested in how you think, how you approach challenges, and how you turn ideas into action.

What Will You Do?

- Help manage the JayWay brand across our marketing and guest-facing communications, keeping our voice, messaging, and visual identity consistent.

- Look at the guest experience across different touchpoints, using feedback, reviews, and other insights to identify what’s working and where we can improve.

- Research and help develop new partnerships and commercial opportunities that could add value for our guests and our business.

- Coordinate projects involving internal teams, agencies, freelancers, designers, creators, and other external partners.

- Keep marketing projects organized, including timelines, budgets, vendors, tools, and documentation.

- Maintain and improve brand guidelines, templates, processes, and other resources used by the wider team.

- Keep an eye on industry trends, guest expectations, competitors, and new opportunities, and bring useful ideas to the Head of Department.

- Help make sure projects are delivered on time, to a high standard, and in a way that feels right for JayWay.

What Makes You a Great Fit?

You’ve already spent a few years working in marketing or a related field and are comfortable taking ownership rather than waiting to be told what to do.

We’d expect you to have:

-
3+ years of experience in brand management, integrated marketing, communications, guest/customer experience, partnerships, business development, marketing operations, or a related area.

- Strong communication skills and the confidence to work with people across different teams and levels of the organization.

- Good commercial instincts and an understanding of what makes something valuable for both the customer and the business.

- Excellent organization and attention to detail — especially when several projects are happening at once.

- The ability to work with both creative ideas and practical details, from a campaign concept to a budget, deadline, vendor, or approval.

- An analytical mindset and the ability to turn feedback, data, and research into useful recommendations.

- A proactive approach. If you see something that could be better, you’re the kind of person who will raise it and help find a solution.

Experience in travel, hospitality, tourism, luxury, lifestyle, destination marketing, or another high-touch service business is a plus, but it’s not essential.

Tools & Platforms

You should be comfortable learning and working with a range of tools. Experience with Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, Milanote, WordPress, ClickUp, Muck Rack, or similar marketing and project-management platforms is a plus.

Why You’ll Love Working With Us

-
Competitive pay & performance bonuses that recognize your impact.

-
Remote-first flexibility, with the opportunity to collaborate across 20+ countries.

-
Annual all-company gatherings in breathtaking European locations.

- Full support with work-from-home setup and equipment.

-
Wellness programs and travel insurance.

- Covered travel expenses for business-related trips.

Our Hiring Process

We believe in human-led recruitment — no AI filters. Here’s what you can expect:

-
Short one-way video questionnaire to learn more about your background.

-
Initial video interview with our HR team.

-
Job-related task to see how you approach the work.

- Interview with our executive marketing team.

We’ll review your application personally and aim to keep the process straightforward and respectful of your time.

Ready to Join Us?

If you have solid marketing experience, enjoy working across different areas, and like being the person who spots an opportunity and figures out what to do with it, we’d love to hear from you.

You don’t need to have done everything listed above.

What matters is that you’re curious, capable, organized, commercially aware, and comfortable taking ownership.

Think this sounds like you? Apply now.

Please submit your CV in English to get started.

We’re looking forward to hearing from you.

👉 Explore JayWay’s story

JayWay Travel Inc. is committed to ensuring equal opportunities, with recruitment and selection decisions based solely on qualifications and merit, without regard to protected characteristics.

About The Role
Mochi Medical, originally founded as an obesity management practice, is expanding its virtual care model to deliver high-touch behavior change support alongside our clinical and nutrition care. We're hiring Health Coaches to work as part of our multidisciplinary care team - alongside physicians, NPs, and Registered Dietitians - to support patients on GLP-1 medications and related programs.

Health Coaches at Mochi handle general wellness and behavior change coaching, helping patients build sustainable habits around nutrition, physical activity, sleep, stress, and emotional health. Your role is to be an effective accountability partner - helping patients consistently follow through on the plan their care team has built with them.

This role is ideal for someone passionate about metabolic health, behavior change, and leveraging digital healthcare to make a measurable difference in patients' lives.
What You’ll Do

- Conduct 30-minute one-on-one virtual coaching sessions (initial and follow-up) via video to help patients build sustainable lifestyle habits that complement their treatments.

- Use motivational interviewing and evidence-based behavior change techniques to help patients set SMART goals, build consistency, and navigate setbacks.

- Carry a caseload of patients and serve as their accountability partner in making long-lasting lifestyle changes.

- Support patients on issues like managing cravings, portion awareness, building exercise habits, stress eating, navigating social situations (vacations, holidays, dining out), and emotional dimensions of weight management.

- Provide general education on healthy eating principles, meal planning basics, and lifestyle strategies - without crossing into Medical Nutrition Therapy or individualized therapeutic nutrition.

- Document sessions in our EMR using SOAP format and communicate relevant updates to the care team.

- Adapt to a fast-paced startup environment and contribute to team-wide improvements.

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

• One of the following active certifications:

- NBC-HWC (National Board Certified Health & Wellness Coach)

- ACE-CHC (ACE Certified Health Coach)

- CHES (Certified Health Education Specialist)

• At least 1 year of experience in health coaching, telehealth, clinical wellness, or a closely related role.
• Skilled in motivational interviewing and patient education.

• Educating patients regarding Mochi-approved supplements as part of their wellness plan and directing any medical or dosing questions to their prescribing provider.
• Proficient in online scheduling tools, EMR systems, and video-visit coordination.
• Strong understanding of scope of practice for health coaches, including the boundary between coaching and Medical Nutrition Therapy.
• Comfortable working in a fully remote, dynamic startup environment.
• Reliable high-speed internet and a private, professional video setting.

Preferred Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in a health-related field (nutrition, public health, exercise science, psychology, health education, or related).

- 1+ years of experience coaching patients on GLP-1 medications, obesity, diabetes, or other metabolic conditions.

- Familiarity with the patient experience of GLP-1 medications (side effects, titration, appetite changes, common questions) and other treatments.

- Training in additional behavior change frameworks (stages of change, CBT-informed coaching, ACT).

- Bilingual (Spanish a strong plus).

Why Mochi Medical?
At Mochi Medical, we are redefining internal medicine and specialty care through technology-driven, patient-first solutions. By joining our team, you will:

- Enjoy full malpractice coverage.

- Have complete control over your schedule with 24/7 flexible hours.

- Utilize advanced tools like our custom-built EMR and obesity-specific protocols.

- Benefit from a support team handling lab testing, prior authorizations, and customer service.

- Access ongoing professional development through our optional academic lecture series.

OUR STORY
TechInsights is the information Platform for the semiconductor industry.
Regarded as the most trusted source of actionable, in-depth intelligence related to semiconductor innovation and surrounding markets, TechInsights’ content informs decision makers and professionals whose success depends on accurate knowledge of the semiconductor industry—past, present, or future.
Over 650 companies and 150,000 users access the TechInsights Platform, the world’s largest vertically integrated collection of unmatched reverse engineering, teardown, and market analysis in the semiconductor industry. This collection includes detailed circuit analysis, imagery, semiconductor process flows, device teardowns, illustrations, costing and pricing information, forecasts, market analysis, and expert commentary. TechInsights’ customers include the most successful technology companies who rely on TechInsights’ analysis to make informed business, design, and product decisions faster and with greater confidence. For more information, visit .

WHY WORK WITH US

- Company-sponsored training and development opportunities

- Comprehensive benefits package (health, dental, vision, wellness, pension contributions, annual fitness reimbursement)

- Flexible vacation policy

- Trusted device reimbursement program

- Community involvement opportunities through charitable alliances:

- Wellness resources and support

THE OPPORTUNITY
The Senior AI Market Intelligence Analyst is a strategic contributor within TechInsights' AI semiconductor practice, focusing on the fast-moving AI compute and semiconductor landscape. Utilizing their experience and network in the AI compute and semiconductor landscape, the incumbent independently drives high-impact research and analysis, leveraging TechInsights' proprietary intelligence — including teardown analysis, technical costing, and demand intelligence — to deliver original, market-defining insights across Datacenter AI trends, Edge AI (PC, Tablet, Mobile, Wearable, Consumer Electronics), and Physical AI (Robotics).
Operating with a high degree of autonomy, this individual owns end-to-end research coverage across assigned domains: defining analytical frameworks, setting research agendas, and delivering data-driven authoritative insight that directly informs client decision-making at the executive level. The analyst plays a formative role in shaping the team's intellectual direction, establishing methodological best practices, and elevating the overall quality and credibility of the practice's output. They collaborate closely with practice leadership to identify emerging coverage areas, develop new research offerings, and influence TechInsights' long-term AI intelligence strategy.
This individual is a highly visible, credible voice for TechInsights in the broader market: presenting at conferences and trade shows, leading panels, engaging proactively with media and industry stakeholders, and driving the practice's brand authority across the TechInsights Platform. They independently cultivate and deepen client relationships, serving as a primary point of contact.

This role is based in any of the European countries.

- Remote position

- Willing to travel for events, conferences, and relationship-building

WHAT YOU’LL DOAI Research and Production

- Lead coverage of AI Model/Compute Trends, Edge AI, and Physical AI delivering authoritative intelligence with full accountability for quality and impact, defining research priorities with practice leadership

- Lead the team's core deliverables, including data collection, conducting expert interviews, and synthesizing quantitative and qualitative intelligence into high-conviction, market-defining narratives

- Deliver timely, incisive event-driven analysis on market-moving AI and compute announcements, establishing TechInsights as an authoritative voice

- Author flagship research that leverages TechInsights' exclusive firsthand intelligence, proprietary data, and analyst community — setting the standard for depth, originality, and analytical rigor for the practice

- Serve as a senior editorial and quality authority across compute and AI coverage areas, establishing and upholding standards for analytical quality, consistency, and intellectual integrity

- Independently research, write, and publish high-impact analysis across compute and AI coverage domains, building recognized and cited work

Audience Development

- Build and steward a high-value network of industry contacts, journalists, and conference organizers — proactively generating organic thought-leadership opportunities and positioning TechInsights' AI research for the market

- Drive TechInsights' AI coverage visibility through a commanding, consistent presence across social media and owned media channels — setting the tone, cadence, and editorial standard for practice’s external voice

- Craft compelling, authoritative narratives that distill complex technical analysis into sharp, accessible insights for clients, media, analysts, and the broader investment and technology community

- Represent TechInsights at premier industry events — operate as a recognized and sought-after authority across the semiconductor ecosystem, representing TechInsights as a leading intelligence brand, and establishing a differentiated presence in the AI compute community

Customer Engagement

- Own client relationships on your work, independently prioritizing and responding to client requests, leading recurring customer meetings, and delivering forecast updates and expert commentary that drive measurable client satisfaction and retention

- Partner with sales leadership, leading high-stakes presentations, articulating the value of TechInsights' AI research, and directly supporting new business development and renewals

- Represent TechInsights as a senior ambassador - convening conversations, surfacing actionable market intelligence on competitive positioning and client priorities, and translating field intelligence into strategic recommendations for the practice

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

- Brings deep, applied expertise in semiconductors and technology ecosystems built through years of hands-on research, industry engagement, and a genuine passion for the field that drives continuous self-directed learning well beyond formal training

- Tackles complex, ambiguous problems independently. Pursues knowledge with relentless intellectual curiosity and strategic intent, asks the questions others won't, builds the trust and rapport needed to unlock insights that aren't publicly available, and consistently surfaces intelligence that yields competitive advantage

- Maintains a high-value, established professional network spanning the AI compute and semiconductor ecosystem, media, press, and analyst communities — actively cultivating relationships that translate into exclusive access, early signals, and visible thought-leadership opportunities

- Synthesizes complex information from multiple primary and secondary sources into clear, high-conviction conclusions — exercising independent analytical judgment and advising practice leadership on strategic implications.

- Communicates with authority and precision — a compelling writer and confident presenter who crafts narratives that resonate with technical and non-technical audiences alike, and who is recognized internally and externally as a credible, engaging voice on technology intelligence.

- Operates fluently and effectively across multicultural and multilingual environments; brings an informed, nuanced perspective on geopolitics and AI sovereignty, and integrates these dynamics into research and client conversations as a core analytical lens

- English speaker, ideally mastering one or two extra European languages – French and German. Notions of Asian languages to ease communication with teams and networks in the eastern regions are a welcome asset.

This role is focused on directly supporting Academic Medical Centers (AMCs) and clinical research health systems with day-to-day budgeting, coverage analysis, and billing compliance activities.

Why Join Vitalief?

-
Make an Impact: Support leading AMCs and health systems in improving clinical trial financial performance and compliance.

-
Innovation-Driven: Help modernize clinical trial budgeting and billing processes using technology and best practices.

-
People-First Culture: Thrive in an environment that fosters growth, innovation, and collaboration.

-
Comprehensive Benefits: Enjoy 20 PTO days, 9 paid holidays, company-paid life insurance, short- and long-term disability, a 401(k)-retirement plan, and robust healthcare options.

-
Flexible & Remote-Friendly: Primarily remote with occasional travel (up to 10%).

-
Salary Range: $75,000 to $125,000 – Based on experience level.

Responsibilities

- Develop, build, and finalize clinical trial budgets for industry-sponsored studies (oncology and non-oncology) in collaboration with academic medical center (AMC) and health system stakeholders.

- Perform detailed Medicare Coverage Analyses (MCA) to accurately distinguish routine care from research-related costs in compliance with CMS guidelines.

- Configure and maintain study calendars, budgets, and billing grids within OnCore, ensuring alignment with protocol requirements and institutional billing practices.

- Support clinical trial start-up by ensuring accurate budget setup, billing designations, and downstream readiness for compliant invoicing and revenue capture.

- Lead or support budget negotiations with sponsors and CROs, advocating for fair market value and full cost recovery for AMCs and health systems.

- Partner closely with investigators, study coordinators, finance, and revenue cycle teams to validate assumptions and resolve budget or billing discrepancies.

- Conduct ongoing budget tracking, reconciliation, and variance analysis to ensure financial accuracy throughout the study lifecycle.

- Identify and mitigate billing compliance risks while ensuring adherence to CMS, FDA, NIH, and institutional policies.

- Standardize and improve budgeting and Medicare Coverage Analysis workflows, templates, and tools to increase efficiency and consistency across client engagements.

- Provide hands-on support across multiple client engagements, effectively managing competing priorities while delivering high-quality results.

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree required; Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred.

- 3 to 5+ years of hands-on experience in clinical trial budgeting within an academic medical center or health system.

- Strong expertise in Medicare Coverage Analysis (MCA) and clinical trial billing compliance.

- Experience using a Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS) to build study calendars, budgets, and billing grids; OnCore experience is strongly preferred.

- Proven experience negotiating clinical trial budgets with sponsors and CROs.

- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills with proficiency in Microsoft Excel.

- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across clinical, financial, operational, and administrative teams.

- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple studies and deadlines in a fast-paced, client-facing environment.

- Experience with clinical trial financial lifecycle management, including invoicing, reconciliation, and financial reporting, is preferred.

- Knowledge of research billing workflows within academic medical centers and integrated health systems is preferred.

- Previous consulting or professional services experience is a plus.

- Willingness to travel domestically up to 10%.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS: Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working at a computer. Standing, walking, visual perception, talking and hearing. Lifting up to 20lbs. Limited travel to various physical locations domestically.

remote.title: Pharmacogenomics
remote.description:
Position Summary
Prometheus Federal Services (PFS) is a trusted partner of federal health agencies. We are exploring adding a highly experienced Lead Pharmacogenomics to support a high-profile federal precision medicine and pharmacogenomics (PGx) initiative. This role will provide strategic leadership, clinical implementation expertise, and stakeholder engagement support to facilitate the adoption of pharmacogenomic programs, clinical pathways, and decision-support tools across multiple healthcare sites.

The ideal candidate will bring extensive healthcare project management experience, a strong understanding of clinical operations, and the ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary stakeholders including physicians, pharmacists, laboratory professionals, and healthcare administrators. This individual will help design scalable implementation strategies, optimize clinical workflows, and support the integration of evidence-based pharmacogenomic practices into patient care. This position offers the opportunity to contribute to nationally significant healthcare transformation efforts while advising federal stakeholders on best practices for clinical implementation, workflow design, and sustainable program adoption.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

- Lead and manage pharmacogenomics (PGx) initiatives across multiple sites and/or virtual environments, ensuring successful implementation and adoption.

- Oversee the design, development, and implementation of clinical pathways, workflows, and toolkits that incorporate pharmacogenomic best practices.

- Manage and coordinate multidisciplinary teams, including clinicians, pharmacists, laboratory personnel, and other stakeholders.

- Support the review and interpretation of pharmacogenomic information, including drug-gene interactions and associated clinical implications.

- Collaborate with subject matter experts (SMEs) to facilitate clinical discussions, gather feedback, and drive consensus on PGx-related initiatives.

- Contribute to the development and optimization of clinical decision support tools and processes.

- Evaluate and apply evidence-based pharmacogenomic guidelines and resources, including CPIC, PharmGKB, DPWG, and FDA labeling.

- Engage internal and external stakeholders to support project goals, implementation activities, and long-term sustainability.

- Provide strategic recommendations and scalable solutions to advance pharmacogenomics programs and clinical integration efforts.

- Monitor project milestones, risks, dependencies, and outcomes to ensure timely and successful delivery of objectives.

Minimum Qualifications

- Master's degree in Public Health Administration, Health Management, Nursing, Health Administration, or a related healthcare field.

- Demonstrated project management experience within a healthcare environment.

- Experience implementing new clinical pathways, processes, or workflows involving multidisciplinary stakeholders.

- Experience managing and leading cross-functional or multi-member teams.

- Knowledge of pharmacogenomics principles, including drug-gene interactions and their application to clinical care.

- Familiarity with evidence-based pharmacogenomic guidelines and resources, including CPIC, PharmGKB, DPWG, and FDA labeling.

- Experience with clinical workflow design, process improvement, or toolkit development.

- Experience supporting the development or implementation of clinical decision support tools.

- Strong stakeholder engagement, facilitation, and communication skills.

- Ability to provide strategic guidance and develop scalable, sustainable healthcare solutions.

- Ability to work in the U.S. indefinitely without sponsorship

- Ability to obtain a public trust

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. .

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio's next Staff Software Engineer on our Data & Analytics Platform
Who we are & why we’re hiring
Twilio powers real-time business communications and data solutions that help companies and developers worldwide build better applications and customer experiences.
Although we're headquartered in San Francisco, we have presence throughout South America, Europe, Asia and Australia. We're on a journey to becoming a global company that actively opposes racism and all forms of oppression and bias. At Twilio, we support diversity, equity & inclusion wherever we do business.
About the job
We are seeking an experienced Staff Engineer to join our Data Substrate team. In this role, you will be responsible for architecting scalable and reliable data solutions, collaborating closely with cross-functional partners driving technical innovation, and mentoring a team of talented engineers. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in data systems, strong leadership skills, and a proven track record of delivering complex data projects at scale.
Responsibilities
In this role, you’ll:

- Serve as a subject matter expert in distributed systems, data technologies, with strong software engineering skills

- Architect and implement scalable and efficient data systems, storage solutions, and processing frameworks using state-of-the-art technologies.

- Drive technical innovation and research to stay at the forefront of emerging data technologies and best practices.

- Mentor and coach a team of talented engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning.

- Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable and efficient technical solutions.

- Ensure data quality, integrity, and security throughout the data lifecycle, adhering to industry best practices and compliance standards.

Qualifications
Not all applicants will have skills that match a job description exactly. Twilio values diverse experiences in other industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. While having “desired” qualifications make for a strong candidate, we encourage applicants with alternative experiences to also apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!
Required:

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

- 8+ years of experience in software development, or a related field.

With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. We are looking for a skilled individual to join our rapidly growing team at Bluelight Consulting. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high-quality applications that stand out in the market. What we are looking for

- Experience with AWS services including but not limited to S3, Athena, EC2, EMR, and Glue.

- Ability to solve any ongoing issues with operating the cluster.

- Experience with the integration of data from multiple data sources.

- Experience with or knowledge of Agile Software Development methodologies.

- Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.

- Excellent oral and written communication skills with a keen sense of customer service.

As a Software Engineer at Kapitus, you will be working with other developers to design well-crafted software. We are looking for engineers with a focus on code quality, developed in an agile environment utilizing modern architecture and design practices. Your contributions will empower Kapitus to continue helping small business owners find lending options so they can make payroll during tough times, scale to meet market demands, and make large purchases to scale their operations. You will join a team of engineers tasked with developing the modern interfaces to replace existing legacy systems.
What you will do:
· Design, develop, test, and maintain new software for internal customers from the ground up while providing a strong foundation for future development
· Help define the architecture, technical patterns, and engineering practices for a new platform while integrating with or extracting capabilities from legacy applications
· Develop backend services primarily in Python, with particular emphasis on Flask
· Build and integrate solutions using AWS services, including Lambda, Cognito, SNS, SQS, and DynamoDB
· Maintain and improve deployment pipelines and CI/CD processes
· Build and maintain infrastructure using tools such as OpenTofu and Terraform
· Collaborate with Stakeholders to understand the product roadmap, communicate progress, identify risks, and support delivery within an Agile/Scrum environment
· Partner with the Tech Lead and Engineering Manager to make sound technical decisions and establish scalable development practices
· Participate in code reviews and contribute to team-wide engineering standards as the team grows
· Mentor junior developers on Python and engineering practices
What we’re looking for:
· Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
· Minimum 5+ years of engineering experience
· Deep understanding of Python (5 years+) experience in Flask is preferred.
· Experience working in AWS particularly Lambda, Cognito, SNS, SQS, and DynamoDB

· Experience building clean, readable, and well documented code using modern best practices.

· Experience working in an Agile environment utilizing Scrum

· Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

· A growth mindset and interest in progressing from a senior engineering role toward technical leadership
· A strong sense of mentorship and a willingness to support the development of other team members
· Experience in the financial services or lending industry is a strong plus
· Certification in AWS is preferred

Kapitus Total Rewards Package Includes:

-

Additional perks through UHC include: Sweat Equity, free subscription to the Calm App, UHC rewards, Real Appeal, and Quit For Life.

-

-
100% Company Paid Insurances: Kapitus fully covers the cost of basic short-term and long-term disability insurance, as well as vision insurance, ensuring our employees have comprehensive protection without any personal expense.

-
Voluntary Insurance: Supplemental life insurance as well as enhanced short- and long-term disability coverage are available through Mutual of Omaha, providing additional security for our employees. Additionally, Colonial Accident and Hospitalization insurances are also available, offering further protection against unforeseen events.

-
Paid Maternity and Parental Leave: Beyond state-mandated leave policies, Kapitus provides company-paid maternity and parental leave, supporting our employees during important family milestones.

-
Commuter Benefits: We offer pre-tax benefits on parking and commuter expenses to cover travel to and from work.

-
LifeBalance Program: Enhance your lifestyle with our LifeBalance membership, which offers discounts on outdoor activities, the arts, health, and fitness. Additional benefits include:

Retirement Benefits: Our 401K plan is managed through Fidelity. To support your long-term financial goals, the company provides a 25% match on your contributions, up to 6% of your annual salary.

Founded in 2017, refurbed is Europe’s fastest-growing marketplace for refurbished products, active in 23 European countries and having surpassed €2Bn in GMV — all while being profitable. With beautiful headquarters in Vienna, we operate as a remote-first company and have been recognised as a Top DACH Employer by Kununu for four consecutive years.

Our mission is to make sustainable consumption the easy choice by enabling customers to buy products up to 40% cheaper while significantly reducing CO₂ emissions.

If you thrive in an environment that values momentum, ownership, and impact, you’ll feel at home here. We’re a fast-paced, high-performance team that works hard and challenges itself everyday. To enable this high-performance every team member enjoys full autonomy over their location (we’re remote-first).

The Legal Counsel (f/m/x) will play a crucial role as an enabler to tackle new business opportunities, in ensuring legal compliance and mitigating legal and regulatory risks associated with the dynamic e-commerce landscape and our marketplace platform operations across Europe’s refurbished industries. This position requires a legal professional with a broad and varied portfolio — from contracts and data protection to regulatory compliance and dispute resolution — and work closely with teams across the company to keep us moving fast while staying on the right side of the law, enabling us to navigate complex legal challenges while supporting the company's growth objectives.
WHO YOU ARE:

- 3+ years of work experience in an in-house legal department of a company or in a law firm

- Strong understanding of data privacy law, and experience in e-commerce, platform and technology regulations. Knowledge of Austrian corporate law is a plus.

- A solid generalist background with broad experience across commercial law, compliance, and regulatory topics is a must.

- Strongly motivated to tackle legal projects in other domains relevant to refurbed’s business where necessary

- Excellent communication skills in English and German, both verbal and written. Additional language skills (e.g., in Italian) are a plus.

- Strategic thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to anticipate legal risks and develop proactive solutions to mitigate them.

- Proven project and stakeholder-management skills to master larger projects.

- Flexibility and adaptability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly evolving environment.

- Degree in Austrian / German Law. (Experience in Austrian law is required).

Location & eligibility: This role is open to candidates based in Europe (including UK) only with a valid right to work.
WHAT YOU’LL DO:

- Advise internal teams on legal risks and help them find practical, workable solutions

- Support the business on new market entries, product launches, and strategic initiatives

- Own and improve our legal processes, templates, and documentation

- Ensure that our company is compliant with current and future e-commerce, technology and platform regulations

- Develop and implement legal strategies aligned with the company's growth objectives. Provide legal guidance and support for strategic initiatives and business projects.

- Oversee the drafting, review, and negotiation of contracts with suppliers, vendors, partners, and other stakeholders. Ensure that contracts protect the company's interests and comply with relevant laws and regulations.

- Oversee compliance with data protection laws and ensure the security of customer data and company information.

WHY YOU WILL ENJOY WORKING WITH US:

Our Culture and Values:

- Decisions should be made based on facts and not by hierarchy levels? We sure think so!

- We embrace giving and receiving feedback, testing and welcoming new ideas, as well as sharing our knowledge across the company.

- You fail sometimes? Well, so do we! We’re all just human, let’s learn from our mistakes to improve in the future!

- No matter who you love, where you’re from, who you pray to, whether you pee sitting down or standing up – we are a bunch of talented people who enjoy spending our time making a difference!

Personal & Professional Development:

- You'll have access to a dedicated learning budget within your department to support your growth, whether it's courses, conferences, or other learning opportunities that matter to you.

- We partner with Likeminded, offering you private sessions with experts for your personal growth and mental health.

- We frequently host internal workshops, allowing our teams to further develop their skills in different areas and enhancing collaboration across departments.

Flexibility:

- We care about a healthy work/life balance. We not only function and support a fully remote setting but also offer the possibility to work from our beautiful office in the vibrant heart of Vienna – we love dogs, so feel free to bring your furry little buddy too 😊

- We trust you to do the best job, so we don't care so much when you do it – you are able to self-organize.

- You will also be invited to take part in our office weeks, happening three times a year, where you will have the chance to work side by side with your colleagues and enjoy the team-building events and on-site workshops

…and much more! See for further insights!

remote.description:
About First Momentum Ventures

We're engineers at heart and investors by choice. That's why, what started in 2019 as a campus spin-off, we've grown into one of Europe's leading pre-seed funds, backing 50+ deeply technical startups reshaping industries from new industrials to novel computing.
With our €35M+ second fund in full swing and Fund III on the horizon, we're hiring a Visiting Associate to join our investment team and contribute to deal flow, technical evaluation, and portfolio projects.
Our aim is to be the #1 destination for deeply technical founders in Europe. We believe great teams create the future, and we're here to back them early and support them deeply. We aren't just capital providers; we invest in incredible individuals and view EQ as our greatest competitive advantage over traditional funds. The same applies to our own team: we win as a team (not individuals), believe in high agency & independence, and have every team member participate directly in the fund's economic upside.
The Role
As a Visiting Associate, you'll be a full member of our investment team with real ownership from day one and direct exposure to how the venture capital world truly operates.
This role is designed for people with 1–3 years of professional experience who want to break into the venture ecosystem and accelerate their career. It's the perfect launchpad for ambitious talent aiming to become a Chief of Staff at a leading European startup, land a full-time VC role, or start their own company down the road.
Whether you're coming from consulting, a fast-growing startup, or hold a master's degree with several internships in the startup ecosystem, we're looking for Europe's most driven young professionals to join us in building the leading pre-seed tech-focused venture fund in Europe.
Tasks

-
Find the most promising tech founders in Europe: Take the lead in sourcing high-potential pre-seed startups, running first calls independently, and developing your own conviction about which founders and ideas are truly exciting.

-
Gain full exposure to the investment process: Work side-by-side with our investment team through the entire deal flow, from first contact and due diligence to investment committee and closing. You'll play a key role in evaluating opportunities and shaping investment decisions.

-
Lead deep-dive research: Explore emerging technologies and market trends every week. Conduct sharp, data-driven analysis and present insights that influence our investment theses and strategic direction.

-
Drive impact in portfolio projects: Support our portfolio founders hands-on, from building their go-to-market motion to automating workflows with AI and optimizing operations.

Requirements

- You have 1-3 years of work experience in the startup ecosystem, consulting, or a technical role.

- You bring strong analytical capabilities and can move from technical papers to business models to founder conversations with ease.

- You work with extreme ownership and high agency, spotting opportunities, designing a plan, and executing without waiting for permission.

- You're genuinely curious about deeply technical domains. Whether you have an engineering background or just love learning how breakthrough technologies work, you're energized by technical depth.

- You communicate clearly and convincingly in both German and English, whether you're pitching a deal to partners or giving feedback to founders.

Benefits

-
Real ownership, not busy work: You'll make independent calls on deals, lead founder conversations, support DD processes end-to-end, and help drive critical projects for our portfolio companies.

-
Technical depth you won't find elsewhere: Most of our team are engineers and scientists, which lets you develop a genuine understanding of breakthrough technologies, not just assessment skills.

-
Exceptional colleagues who challenge you: Work alongside a team that values rigorous debate, mutual support, and winning together. You'll become part of the First Momentum family, even beyond your time with us.

-
Full venture stack visibility: See everything from AI-powered sourcing to automated portfolio support. Gain the whole picture of how a leading European Deep Tech fund operates.

-
Full flexibility with a remote-first culture balanced by regular in-person gatherings across Europe.

-
Competitive pay: The compensation package will be adjusted to your professional experience and will be well above an internship salary.

-
The perfect launchpad for your next move: Whether you're heading toward a full-time VC role, a Chief of Staff position in our portfolio, or eventually starting your own venture, this position sets you up for what's next.

We're looking for candidates available for 6-12 months, starting January 2027.

remote.title: Telesales Executive - Tamil
remote.description:
About Lokal :
In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren’t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they’d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online. This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.
Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission:
to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they’ve always deserved.
We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:

- Edutainment & Skill Learning – practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)

- Matrimonial Matchmaking – hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony)

- Agri Consulting – farmer-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)

- Local Jobs – blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs)

- Social & Community – Place to find & post social updates (Lokal app)

- Emotional Well-being & Peer Support – safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze)

- Astrology & Guidance – instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal)

- Advisory Services – early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more

Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we’ve built, they don’t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.
This is the story new teammates walk into:
a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre — access changes lives.
We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.
We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital.
Role Overview :
We are looking for a driven Telesales Executive (Tamil-speaking) to support Lokal App’s growth by engaging potential users through outbound calls and converting leads into customers. This role involves understanding user needs, pitching relevant solutions, managing the sales funnel end-to-end, and consistently achieving monthly sales targets.
You’ll work closely with the marketing team to capitalize on campaigns, maintain accurate CRM records, and provide on-ground customer insights that influence future strategies. This is an ownership-heavy role suited for someone who enjoys targets, conversations, and real impact.
Responsibilities

- Conduct outbound calls to prospective clients and effectively promote Lokal App's services.

- Engage with users to identify their needs and create tailored solutions that fit their requirements.

- Maintain accurate records of calls, interactions, and leads in the CRM system.

- Follow up on leads and manage the sales process from initial contact through to closing.

- Collaborate with the marketing team to leverage campaigns and enhance sales efforts.

- Provide feedback on customer interactions and market trends to help shape future strategies.

- Achieve monthly sales targets and contribute to the overall growth of Lokal App.

Requirements

- Fluency in Tamil and a good command of English.

- Previous experience in tele sales or sales roles is preferred.

- Excellent verbal communication and persuasive skills.

- Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Familiarity with CRM software, Excel and sales tracking tools is a plus.

- Motivated and goal-oriented individual with a passion for sales.

- Experience required: 1 Year (Minimum).

Why Join Us?
We’re scaling fast with strong fundamentals, on a mission to empower millions through AI and access. At Lokal, you’ll take ownership from day one, build for real impact, and help redefine the roadmap of how Bharat connects to opportunities, knowledge, and experts.

remote.description:
Ready to embark on the quest of joining Hack The Box?
Welcome! Super excited you dropped by 🥳
At the end of this journey, you'll become a proud member of Hack The Box, with the ultimate mission to raise cyber resilience, so that every organization can stay ahead of tomorrow’s threats.🚀🔒💻
✨The core mission of the Senior IT Platform engineer:
As an Internal Platform Engineer, you will own and evolve the internal tooling and enterprise platforms that keep a 300+ person, globally distributed company running securely and productively. This is not a helpdesk role — you'll be the engineering backbone behind identity & access management, corporate email and collaboration, device management, SaaS orchestration and our centralised AI/LLM gateway. You'll ensure that every team at HTB has the right tools, properly integrated, secured and automated.
Engineer, integrate and operate HTB's internal platform stack — from identity (Okta) and email (Google Workspace) through endpoint management (Jamf/Intune) and security tooling (SIEM, EDR) to our centralised LLM gateway — so that the company scales securely without friction.
🏢 Location & Work Mode:

- Europe/Greece

- Choose between fully remote work across Europe or relocating to our Athens Tech Hub with relocation support.
Fully Remote / Hybrid (2 days in the office, 3 days remote, plus one month of work from anywhere) - If only in Greece: When hiring in Greece, we’re open to candidates from all locations. Those based within 55 km of our Athens office will follow a hybrid work model. For candidates located beyond that radius, a fully remote arrangement is available.
✈️ Relocation

- We offer a 10% relocation bonus on the annual salary to support your move.

- In addition, you would benefit from a 50% tax reduction on your income as part of the relocation.

- We'll support you with accommodation during the first few weeks

⚔️ Tools & weapons you’ll be using:
Identity & Access: Okta (SSO, SCIM, Lifecycle Management, Okta Workflows), Google Workspace (Gmail, Drive, Admin Console)
Endpoint & Device Management: Jamf Pro (macOS/iOS), Microsoft Intune (Windows), Kolide / osquery
Security & Compliance: CrowdStrike Falcon (EDR), Elastic SIEM / Splunk, Vanta or Drata (compliance automation), HashiCorp Vault (secrets management)
AI / LLM Gateway: LiteLLM or Portkey (centralised LLM routing, cost controls, audit logging), API key management
Collaboration & Productivity: Slack, Atlassian (Jira, Confluence), Notion, GitHub (org-level administration)
Automation & Integration: Okta Workflows, Tines / Workato (SOAR / workflow automation), Terraform, Python scripting
Observability: Datadog or Grafana Cloud (SaaS monitoring), PagerDuty (on-call & incident management)
🚀 The adventures that await you after becoming Senior IT Platform Engineer at Hack The Box:

- Administer and engineer Okta as the central identity provider: SSO integrations, SCIM provisioning/de-provisioning, MFA policies, Okta Workflows for lifecycle automation (onboarding, offboarding, role changes)

- Own Google Workspace administration: domain management, email routing and security policies (DKIM/DMARC/SPF), shared drives governance, DLP rules and Google Vault for eDiscovery/retention

- Deploy and operate a centralised LLM gateway (e.g. LiteLLM, Portkey) to give teams governed access to AI models with usage tracking, cost controls, rate limiting and audit logging

- Manage endpoint fleets via Jamf Pro (macOS/iOS) and Intune (Windows): OS patching, app deployment, compliance baselines, disk encryption enforcement

- Integrate and maintain EDR (CrowdStrike Falcon or equivalent) and SIEM (Elastic/Splunk) for corporate endpoint and SaaS log visibility

- Operate and improve compliance automation tooling (Vanta/Drata) to maintain continuous SOC 2, ISO 27001 and similar audit readiness

- Manage secrets and credential distribution using HashiCorp Vault (or similar), ensuring zero-trust access patterns for service accounts and CI/CD pipelines

- Administer SaaS platforms at the org level: Slack (Enterprise Grid), Atlassian suite, Notion, GitHub (org/team/repo policies, SAML, audit logs)

- Build workflow automations (Tines, Workato or Okta Workflows) for repetitive IT and security operations: access requests, alert triage, onboarding checklists

- Maintain documentation, runbooks and internal knowledge-base articles so that common procedures are self-service where possible

- Participate in on-call rotation for identity, email and critical SaaS platform incidents

🏆 Skills, knowledge, and experience points required to unlock the role of Senior IT Platform Engineer at Hack The Box:

- 3–7 years of professional experience in IT engineering, internal platform engineering or infrastructure with a strong focus on enterprise SaaS and identity systems

- Deep hands-on experience with Okta (or a comparable enterprise IdP: Azure AD/Entra ID, OneLogin) including SSO, SCIM provisioning and MFA policy management

- Strong Google Workspace administration skills (domain management, email security, DLP, Vault, Admin SDK)

- Experience managing macOS and/or Windows fleets at scale using MDM tools (Jamf, Intune, Kandji or similar)

- Familiarity with at least one SIEM platform (Elastic, Splunk, Datadog Security) and one EDR solution (CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Carbon Black)

- Comfortable writing automation scripts (Python, Bash) and working with APIs to integrate SaaS tools

- Solid understanding of network and application security fundamentals: OAuth 2.0 / OIDC, SAML, SCIM, DKIM/DMARC/SPF, TLS, zero-trust principles

- Ability to translate security and compliance requirements (SOC 2, ISO 27001) into practical engineering controls

- Strong written communication for documentation, runbooks and cross-team collaboration in a remote-first environment

- Being cyber security-minded is a strong plus — at HTB, this isn't an afterthought, it's the business

Bonus Points:

- Experience deploying and operating a centralised LLM/AI gateway (LiteLLM, Portkey, Kong AI Gateway or equivalent) with cost and access controls

- Hands-on experience with HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager or similar secrets management platforms

- Familiarity with compliance automation platforms (Vanta, Drata, Secureframe)

- Experience with SOAR / workflow automation tools (Tines, Workato, Torq)

- Understanding of Golang for building internal tooling

- Okta Certified Professional or Administrator, Google Workspace Administrator certification, or equivalent

- Experience scaling internal platforms through a period of rapid company growth (100 → 500+ employees)

🕹️ What your Hack The Box adventure will have in store:

- 🎯You'll have the exhilarating opportunity to contribute to a product that is highly appreciated by users and the cybersecurity community at large.

- 🎯 You'll experience a highly supportive and caring environment, fostering growth, flexibility, and autonomy.

- 🎯 You'll embark on an exciting journey of continuous learning and problem-solving, levelling up as our organisation grows.

- 🎯 Most importantly, you'll have a blast at HTB 🥳 because fun is an essential ingredient in our recipe for success! Just wait until you see our global meet-ups!

💰 The gems you’ll be enjoying as Senior IT Platform Engineer:

- 25 annual leave days

- Paid parental leave

- Home Office Allowance

- Dedicated budget for training and professional development, participation in conferences

- State-of-the-art equipment

- Full access to the Hack The Box lab offerings; so you can learn how to hack 😉

- Flexibility in working hours

Our benefits package is designed to provide strong support to our team, but it may vary depending on location and type of employment (e.g., UK, US, Greece, Australia, or engagement through an Employer of Record or contract).
🗺️ The Quest of Becoming Hack The Box’s Senior IT Platform Engineer:

- Level 1: To complete level one’s objective, submit your application.

- Level 2: Meet the Talent Acquisition team. Level’s objective: highlight your past achievements, ambitions, and values.

- Level 3: Meet the hiring team. Level’s objective: have a technical conversation that aligns with day-to-day job-related tasks and responsibilities.

- Level 4: Level's objective: connect with the hiring team and share with them your achievements.

- Level 5: Congratulations! Not many reach this level 💪. Level’s objective: have a constructive, final conversation with senior leadership to explore the role and your future at HTB.

- Level 6: You've officially received an offer from HTB! To complete the last level and the Quest, all you need to do is accept the offer.

- Quest complete. Congratulations, you’re officially one of us 🥳🎉🎇Your next quest: complete the onboarding.

Hack Your Career, Today. Join us in this epic adventure of cybersecurity at Hack The Box! 🚀🔒💻
At Hack The Box, we are on a quest to find the most exceptional and enthusiastic talent to join our team. remote.title: Remote Physician Pro Fee Coding Specialist-Cardiology
remote.description:
Job Summary

The Remote Physician Pro Fee Coder-Cardiology is responsible for reviewing, analyzing, and assigning accurate CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10 codes for professional fee services documented in the medical record. This role ensures proper sequencing, modifier use, and place-of-service coding in compliance with governmental regulations, third-party payer policies, and corporate standards. The Physician Coder plays a key role in revenue cycle accuracy by identifying documentation gaps, ensuring coding integrity, and working collaboratively with internal teams to support physician coding compliance and reimbursement.

Essential Functions

- Assigns accurate CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10 codes for professional services, procedures, diagnoses, and treatments based on provider documentation.

- Ensures compliance with governmental regulations, third-party payer policies, and corporate coding protocols, following National Correct Coding Initiative (NCCI) edits, Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs), and National Coverage Determinations (NCDs).

- Performs coding audits and quality reviews, verifying accuracy of documentation and identifying areas for provider education.

- Works coding-related claim edits, holds, and scrubs in the electronic billing system (e.g., Athena Collector), ensuring timely claim resolution and reimbursement.

- Collaborates with physicians, revenue cycle teams, and coding education staff, requesting clarification when necessary to ensure optimal documentation and compliance.

- Performs edit checks on coded data before transmittal, identifying and correcting errors as needed.

- Maintains strict confidentiality of patient records, provider information, and financial data, adhering to HIPAA and corporate compliance policies.

- Escalates documentation or coding issues to the coding education team for provider training and improved documentation practices.

- Assists in coding-related special projects, ensuring accurate reporting and analysis of coding data for operational improvement.

- Performs other duties as assigned.

- Maintains regular and reliable attendance.

- Complies with all policies and standards.

Qualifications

- H.S. Diploma or GED required

- Associate Degree in Health Information Management, Healthcare Administration, or a related field preferred

- 2-4 years of experience in physician coding, professional fee coding, or medical billing required

- Experience with multiple specialties, surgical coding, or high-volume professional fee coding preferred

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

- Strong knowledge of ICD-10, CPT, and HCPCS coding systems for physician/professional fee services.

- Understanding of modifier usage, place-of-service coding, and payer billing guidelines.

- Experience with electronic health records (EHR), coding software, and claim processing systems.

- Ability to identify documentation deficiencies and escalate for provider education.

- Familiarity with NCCI edits, LCD/NCD guidelines, and medical necessity requirements.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, ensuring accurate coding and optimal reimbursement.

- Effective communication and collaboration skills, working with providers, revenue cycle teams, and compliance staff.

Licenses and Certifications

- CCS-Certified Coding Specialist (CCS-P) required or

- Certified Coder-AHIMA or AAPC or equivalent coding certification required or

- RHIT - Registered Health Information Technician required or

- RHIA - Registered Health Information Administrator required

HandsOn Connect is our volunteer management platform, built natively on Salesforce. Nonprofits, companies, and universities use it to recruit, schedule, track, and report on their volunteers through a branded portal that runs on their own Salesforce data.
Our Team & Culture
We think good software should make community work easier, not add to the pile. We are a remote team that ships carefully, shares credit, and gives people real room to grow.
We welcome different backgrounds and perspectives. If you meet most of what is listed below but not all of it, apply anyway. We would rather hear from you.
