You are the person our customers count on when something in Salesforce is not behaving, and the person who sets them up so that happens less often.
The job blends hands-on Salesforce work, customer support, and onboarding. You will work directly with clients, and you will also shape how support and onboarding actually run here: the process, the training, the documentation.
We are looking for someone who likes untangling a messy technical problem, likes the person on the other end of the ticket, and cannot leave a broken process alone.
It is a good fit if you like to lead by doing, if you enjoy teaching and coaching, and if you are happiest when you can fix the thing and then fix the reason it broke.

- Customer Support Leadership. Be the escalation point for the hard ones. Work tickets alongside the team, give clear answers quickly, and set the bar for what good support looks like here.

- Onboarding Program and Team Lead. Own onboarding from the first call to go-live. Walk new clients through setup and configuration on a timeline that fits them, then turn what works into a repeatable process.

- Client Training & Resource Development. Run customer trainings and build the materials that scale them: guides, short videos, knowledge base articles. Help customers get past the basics and actually use the platform well.

- Retention & Expansion Support. Work with Customer Success to spot accounts that are drifting, and step in early. Use usage data and support trends to find where customers could be getting more out of the product.

- Team Leadership & Process Improvement. Mentor the support team and help build a function that runs well without heroics. Improve workflows, documentation, and how tickets move between people.

- Custom object and field creation

- Salesforce Flow design and implementation

- SOQL query writing

- User permission management

- Email templates, alerts, and list views

- Reports and dashboards

- Data import/export and Translation Workbench

- Troubleshooting configuration and data issues

- 3+ years of hands-on Salesforce administration experience

- Manejo de bases de datos relacionales (SQL) e idealmente alguna NoSQL. Queries optimizadas, transacciones, índices.

- Manejo de errores robusto: respuestas consistentes, logging estructurado, trazabilidad.

- Pruebas unitarias e integración: no solo saber que existen también saber escribirlas y mantenerlas.

Esperamos identificar en ti:

- Facilidad para hablar de tus APIs con propiedad de producto: conoces el input, el output, los casos de error, quién lo consume y por qué se diseñó así.

- Claridad para explicar paso a paso cómo construiste o modificarías un servicio real: desde la definición del endpoint hasta su despliegue en producción.

- Agilidad cuando se te presenta un escenario técnico: daR una solución concreta sin evadir o desviar el caso.

- Capacidad para reconoces trade-offs: saber cuándo usar una Lambda vs un contenedor, una BD relacional vs una NoSQL, y poder justificarlo.

- Transparencia para compartir cuándo has tenido incidentes en producción y poder describir cómo los identificaste, atendiste y previenes.

Buenas prácticas — 'CÓDIGO LIMPIO'
Este punto es crítico. El código es evaluado automáticamente en cada promoción entre ambientes, por lo que es importante contar con buenas prácticas bien consolidadas desde el inicio.
Patrones de diseño — deberás conocer y saber aplicar al menos uno

- Clean Architecture (también llamada Arquitectura Limpia): separación de capas, dependencias apuntando hacia adentro, dominio independiente de infraestructura.

- Arquitectura en Capas (Layered / N-tier): presentación, negocio, datos — claramente separados.

- Arquitectura de Cebolla (Onion Architecture): núcleo de dominio rodeado por capas concéntricas de adaptadores.

Clean code — lo que esperamos ver en tu forma de trabajar
Se espera que puedas explicar cómo estructuras tu código, cómo separas responsabilidades y cómo manejas errores en servicios reales, con ejemplos claros de lo que has construido.

- Separación clara de responsabilidades: cada clase, función o módulo cumple un propósito específico.

- Uso de nombres descriptivos que hagan el código fácil de entender sin necesidad de explicaciones adicionales.

- Lógica de negocio ubicada en las capas correctas (servicios o dominio), no en controladores.

- Código limpio y mantenible, evitando redundancias o elementos innecesarios.

- Manejo explícito de errores, con control y trazabilidad adecuados.

Seguridad en código — requerida, no opcional

- Validación de inputs en backend (no confiar en el frontend para validar).

- Protección de endpoints: autenticación + autorización correctamente implementada.

- No hardcodear credenciales, API keys ni secrets en el código — uso de variables de entorno o servicios como AWS Secrets Manager.

- Conocimiento básico de OWASP Top 10: SQL injection, XSS, broken auth, etc.

- Logging sin exponer datos sensibles (PII, tokens, passwords).

Segundo Frente: — CLOUD AWS —
AWS es un componente clave del rol.
Se espera experiencia real en producción y entendimiento de cómo el backend vive dentro de un entorno cloud, pero el enfoque principal sigue siendo backend.

Se espera capacidad de explicar cómo ha desplegado servicios, cómo se conectan entre sí y cómo su código impacta el entorno.
Importante que el candidato:

- Haya trabajado con AWS en producción (no solo teoría)

- Entienda cómo se despliegan servicios y se promueve código entre ambientes

- Comprenda cómo su código impacta seguridad, despliegue y operación

Servicios con los que se espera experiencia práctica

- Lambda: creación, configuración de triggers, conexión con otros servicios, manejo de timeouts y errores.

- API Gateway: creación de APIs, integración con Lambda, manejo de stages y autorizadores.

- S3: gestión de objetos, permisos, políticas de acceso, lifecycle rules.

- DynamoDB o RDS: operaciones CRUD, índices, conexión desde servicios backend.

- IAM: roles, políticas, principio de menor privilegio — sabe por qué importa y cómo aplicarlo.

Infraestructura como Código (IaC) — conocimiento funcional obligatorio:

- Entiende qué es y para qué sirve: no se crean recursos manualmente en consola.

- Puede leer y entender una plantilla de CloudFormation o un módulo de CDK/Terraform aunque no sea su especialidad.

- Sabe cómo se declara una Lambda, un API Gateway o un rol IAM en código.

- Entiende el ciclo: escribir IaC → plan/preview → deploy controlado.

Seguridad en nube — nivel esperado

- Entiende buenas prácticas básicas de seguridad al trabajar en AWS

- Sabe que el acceso entre servicios debe manejarse mediante roles (no credenciales hardcodeadas)

- Tiene noción de cómo se protegen APIs expuestas

- Conoce prácticas básicas para manejo seguro de secretos

- No se requiere especialización en seguridad cloud, pero sí criterio suficiente para desarrollar sin comprometer el entorno.

Tercer frente: — REACT / NEXT.JS —

El candidato no desarrollará frontend. Pero sí construirá el backend que lo alimenta. Debe entender suficiente para garantizar que sus servicios funcionen correctamente en integración.

-Cómo el frontend consume una API- Entiendes qué estructura de respuesta espera, qué headers necesitas, cómo manejar errores HTTP
-fetch / axios o equivalente: Sabe cómo se hace una llamada desde frontend — puede diseñar su API pensando en quien la llama.
-Manejo de estado básico: Entiendes qué datos guarda el frontend y cuándo necesita refrescarlos desde el backend.
-Qué es un hook (nivel conceptual): Sabes que el frontend maneja efectos asíncronos
-Validación de formularios: Entiendes qué valida el frontend vs qué debe validar el backend (y por qué el backend siempre debe validar).
-Protección de endpoints consumidos por frontend: Sabes implementar autenticación/autorización pensando en un cliente React.

Benefits
🚀 Integración a marcas globales y startups disruptivas.
🏡 Trabajo remoto/Home office.
📍 En caso de requerir modalidad híbrida o presencial, serás informado desde la primera sesión.
⏳ Horario ajustado a la célula de trabajo/proyecto asignado.
📅 Trabajo de lunes a viernes.
🎉 Día off en tu cumpleaños.
🏥 Seguro de gastos médicos mayores (aplica para México).
🛡️ Seguro de vida (aplica para México).
🌎 Equipos de trabajo multiculturales.
🎓 Acceso a cursos y certificaciones.
📢 Meetups con invitados especiales del área de IT.
📡 Eventos virtuales de integración y grupos de interés.
📢 Clases de inglés.
🏆 Oportunidades dentro de nuestras diferentes líneas de negocio.

remote.title: Gestionnaire de Compte
remote.description:
Libérez votre potentiel chez Steritech – Où les carrières se construisent de l'intérieur
Chez Steritech, nous cultivons une culture d'apprentissage continu et de développement professionnel. Nous sommes fiers de dire que la majorité de notre équipe de direction a commencé son parcours avec nous en tant que spécialiste. Cela témoigne de notre forte conviction en la promotion interne et de la reconnaissance du potentiel de chacun de nos membres. Lorsque vous rejoignez Steritech, vous ne prenez pas simplement un emploi – vous entrez sur un chemin de carrière qui offre des opportunités de croissance et d'avancement à tous les niveaux. Nous vous fournissons les outils, les ressources et le mentorat pour vous aider à réussir, car votre succès est notre succès. Faites partie d'une équipe qui s'engage à votre développement et vous aider à monter dans votre carrière !
Sommaire du poste
Le gestionnaire de comptes (GC) est un poste au sein de l'équipe de l'expérience client, relevant du directeur des comptes stratégiques de son segment de marché. Le GC est le principal point de collaboration pour apporter de la valeur aux clients assignés. Le portefeuille de clients présente une complexité faible à moyenne. Le GC est la personne responsable de développer des relations solides, de fournir un soutien quotidien et d'apporter des perspectives techniques afin d'exécuter une stratégie de compte maximisant le rendement pour le client et pour Steritech.
Une partie essentielle de ce poste consiste à orchestrer la mise en œuvre des services, à assurer la qualité et la calibration des spécialistes évaluant les sites, à respecter les ententes sur les niveaux de service, ainsi qu’à communiquer et acheminer les problèmes aux instances supérieures lorsque nécessaire.
De plus, le gestionnaire de comptes doit posséder une compréhension approfondie du secteur des normes de marque (Brand Standards), des protocoles et procédures de Steritech, ainsi que des exigences spécifiques des marques clientes afin d'assurer un service de haut niveau et de faciliter une excellente communication entre Steritech et tous les paliers de l'organisation cliente.
Requirements
Responsabilités et tâches principales

-
Gestion de la relation client : Établir des relations productives, professionnelles et consultatives avec le personnel clé (niveaux franchise et siège social).

-
Coordination interne : Coordonner l'implication de l'équipe verticale (spécialistes, soutien, technique, opérations) pour atteindre les objectifs de performance.

-
Lien stratégique : Mettre en relation les parties prenantes du client avec l'équipe Steritech (revues d'affaires, rencontres de haute direction, sessions d'innovation).

-
Expertise de marché : Maintenir une connaissance approfondie du segment de marché, partager les tendances et les meilleures pratiques.

-
Suivi de la performance : Évaluer proactivement la qualité, la calibration, la répartition des tournées et gérer les ententes de service.

-
Objectifs financiers : Atteindre les cibles de croissance, de rentabilité et de recouvrement (A/R). Travailler avec le département de la comptabilité pour les factures en souffrance.

-
Contrats : Gérer les renouvellements de contrats et les négociations d'augmentation de prix.

-
Planification : Exécuter les plans stratégiques incluant les cibles financières et les étapes critiques.

-
Analyse des besoins : Valider proactivement les besoins des clients pour ajouter de la valeur à leurs programmes.

-
Rapports : Soumettre les rapports hebdomadaires, mensuels et annuels requis.

Profil du candidat
Expérience et qualifications requises

- Bilinguisme (français et anglais) : Un atout majeur pour ce poste.

- Minimum de trois ans d'expérience en vente stratégique (B2B) ou en gestion de comptes.

- Expérience dans l'industrie de la restauration, de l'alimentation, des dépanneurs ou de la restauration rapide (QSR).

Leadership et aptitudes personnelles

- Autonomie et capacité à performer sous pression avec tact et habileté.

- Capacité démontrée à mener à bien des projets et des initiatives complexes.

- Excellentes compétences en communication, tant à l'oral qu'à l'écrit.

- Capacité de négociation efficace et sens des affaires aiguisé.

- Grand souci du détail et solides compétences en prise de décision.

- Maîtrise des applications Google (Docs, Sheets, Calendar, Drive, etc.).

- Disponibilité pour voyager (auto et avion) pour rencontrer les clients et assister aux conférences.

- Réussite des vérifications d'antécédents (conduite, casier judiciaire, dépistage de drogues).

Éducation et formation

- Baccalauréat en administration, en gestion ou domaine connexe OU trois ans d'expérience progressive en gestion dans une industrie de services OU réussite du parcours interne de gestion de comptes.
Benefits

- Prime annuelle

- Téléphone cellulaire et ordinateur portable fournis par l’entreprise

- Congés fériés, vacances et congés de maladie payés par l’entreprise

- Excellents avantages sociaux, incluant les assurances médicale, dentaire, visuelle et vie

- Programme d’aide aux employés offrant notamment des services de counseling gratuits et d’autres avantages

- Régime d’épargne-retraite avec une contribution de l’employeur très compétitive de 3,5 %

- Rabais employés

- Excellents programmes de remboursement des frais de scolarité et de bourses d’études

remote.title: Vice President Data Center Design
remote.description:
At Montera, we’re building the future of digital infrastructure. Founder-led with $1.5B backed by Stonepeak, Montera is driven by a future-focused vision: to develop and operate hyperscale data centers essential for tomorrow's technology. Our mission is to deliver strategically located, hyperscale data centers designed for speed, reliability, and scalability. Backed by decades of experience in design, construction, and operations, we don’t just build—we execute with purpose.
Our Values

- Client First Alignment: We align every solution to our clients’ goals.

- Speed with Certainty: Velocity matters. We deliver with urgency and precision.

- Operational Excellence: Decades of experience drive our high standards.

- Safety & Integrity: Safety is non-negotiable. We lead with integrity and transparency.

- Ownership Mentality: We think like owners, because we are.
The Opportunity
Montera is seeking a Vice President Data Center Design leads the delivery of Montera’s facility designs across the portfolio. Reporting to the CTO, the VP owns design execution end to end — from reference architecture through IFC and construction support — and is the senior leader of Montera’s Principal Engineering & Architecture Leadership family and its external design and construction partners.
This is a people-leadership and delivery-accountability role, distinct from the CTO’s external technical and customer-facing mandate. The CTO owns customer requirements capture and is the technical external face of Montera; the VP converts those requirements into buildable, coordinated, on-schedule designs and drives them through the design and construction partner ecosystem (CSA, MEP, design-assist trades, GC/CM, and specialty consultants) to a predictable, commissioned outcome.
The VP manages the five Principal ICs — Architect & Master Planning, Electrical, Mechanical, Controls, and Network — aligning their reference architectures into a single coherent facility design, resolving cross-discipline conflicts, and holding the integrated design schedule and budget. The role is accountable for design quality, constructability, multi-discipline coordination, and the design inputs to cost, schedule, and availability targets across active projects (currently Eagle and Goldeneye) and the broader pipeline.
Requirements
What You'll Do
Design Delivery & Program Execution

- Own end-to-end design delivery across the portfolio — concept, SD, DD, IFP/IFC, and construction-phase support — against committed schedule milestones (e.g., schematic design and IFC dates) and yield-on-cost targets.

- Hold the integrated, multi-discipline design schedule and budget; drive the critical path across architectural, electrical, mechanical, controls, and network scopes.

- Govern design change control, trade studies, and value-engineering decisions, protecting design intent, reliability targets (five-nines availability), and operability.

- Own the design basis of design (BOD) and its consistent application across projects, and the design deliverables that feed permitting, procurement, and construction.
Leadership of the Principal Engineering & Architecture Family

- Directly lead and develop the five Principal ICs (Architect/Master Planning, Electrical, Mechanical, Controls, Network); set objectives, review performance, and build the discipline centers of excellence.

- Integrate discipline reference architectures into one coherent, coordinated facility design; arbitrate cross-discipline trade-offs (e.g., power vs. cooling vs. space, controls data model vs. network segmentation).

- Ensure the Controls–Network interlock on customer data exposure is delivered jointly and coherently, consistent with the single-tenant model and the requirements the CTO captures.

- Enforce portfolio-wide design standards, playbooks, and prototypical modules that enable rapid, repeatable deployment.
Design Contracts & Partner Governance

- Define, review, negotiate, and manage design contracts with design partners (CSA and MEP engineers of record, design-assist trades, and specialty consultants) — owning scopes of work, deliverable schedules, standard of care, fee structures, and design responsibility matrices.

- Establish consistent contracting standards and templates for design engagements across the portfolio; align scope boundaries and interface agreements so multi-discipline coverage is complete with no gaps or overlaps.

- Manage contract performance through delivery: track deliverables against milestones, administer change and additional-services requests, review and approve design invoicing against progress, and resolve scope and performance issues.

- Partner with Legal, Finance, and Procurement on design-contract terms, risk allocation, and commercial approvals, engaging qualified counsel on high-stakes terms.
Design & Construction Partner Leadership

- Serve as Montera’s senior owner-side leader to external design and construction partners: CSA and MEP engineers of record, design-assist trade partners (e.g., mechanical and electrical), GC/CM, and specialty consultants.

- Own the design-assist and delivery-model strategy (e.g., design-bid-build vs. design-assist) and the associated partner scopes, deliverables, and interface agreements.

- Lead design reviews, coordination summits, and constructability reviews; drive partner accountability to quality, schedule, and cost.

- Support AHJ permitting and entitlement outcomes through the Architect/Master Planning Principal and partner teams.
Design Oversight Through Construction

- Own owner-side design oversight through construction with GCs and subcontractors — protecting design intent from IFC through commissioning and turnover.

- Govern the construction-phase design workflow: RFIs, submittals and shop-drawing review, and coordination/BIM clash resolution across trades, driving timely engineer-of-record responses.

- Review and disposition field changes, design-related change orders, and value-engineering proposals from GCs and subs; safeguard reliability (five-nines availability), operability, and standards conformance.

- Lead design representation at OAC meetings and site design reviews; track design-related construction risk and drive resolution with the GC, subs, and design partners.

- Ensure as-built and design close-out documentation from GCs and subs is complete and fed back into Montera reference designs and standards.
Constructability, Commissioning & Handover

- Ensure designs are constructable, coordinated (clash-free), and aligned to procurement lead times and site logistics.

- Own the design-side inputs to commissioning and integrated systems testing (IST); ensure acceptance criteria and turnover readiness are designed in, not retrofitted.

- Drive lessons-learned from construction and operations back into reference designs and standards for continuous fleet improvement.
Cross-Functional & Executive Alignment

- Translate the CTO-captured customer requirements into a governed design program and report design status, risks, and decisions to the CTO and leadership.

- Partner with Development, Delivery, Operations, GRC, and Finance on schedule, cost, constructability, and interconnection-driven design constraints (e.g., FRT / utility obligations).

remote.description:
ChampionAI is QAD | Redzone agentic platform, purpose-built for manufacturing and utilized by the various business units within QAD | Redzone. practical and the platform work focused on real problems.
Key Responsibilities
Platform Development

- Build and ship features across the Champion platform repositories

- Improve developer experience: tooling, scaffolding, internal documentation, and onboarding paths for Applied AI engineers.

Applied AI Enablement

Agent Development

- Design and build Champion agents for BU use-cases when the platform team is directly engaged

- Write and iterate on system prompts, tool bindings, and context injection for production agents

- Register agents in Champion Server and configure LaunchDarkly-gated prompt rollout across environments

Engineering Practices
We follow trunk-based development with PR-gated merges to main. Engineers are expected to:

- Write tests before implementing. TDD is the expectation, not a nice-to-have.

- Keep PRs small and focused; use feature flags to ship partial work incrementally

- Follow conventional commit format (feat:, fix:, etc.)

- Be mindful of API and schema backward-compatibility; prefer additive changes over breaking ones

- Review your own diff before requesting review

Core Requirements

- Python: Proficient in async Python, Pydantic, type hints, and FastAPI. Experience with the Strands agent SDK or a comparable agentic framework. Testing is non-optional: candidates should be comfortable with pytest, pytest- asyncio, and DeepEval for agent-specific evaluation. We test agent behavior, not just unit logic.

- Prompt Engineering: Able to write and iterate on production system prompts: XML-structured, scope-enforced, with tool descriptions that guide LLM delegation reliably.

- Model Context Protocol (MCP): Solid understanding of MCP and hands-on experience building or consuming MCP servers. Familiarity with Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol is a strong plus.

- Agent Patterns: Familiar with multi-agent architectures and orchestration patterns beyond basic ReAct: supervisor/subagent delegation, parallel tool use, handoffs, and context management across agent boundaries.

- Agent Evals: Able to design and run evaluation suites for agent behavior: correctness checks, scope enforcement tests, regression coverage, and systematic prompt iteration based on eval results.

- Docker: Comfortable authoring Dockerfiles, multi-stage builds, and local dev environments via docker-compose / make.

- PostgreSQL: Comfortable with templated INSERT/SELECT, foreign key relationships, and reading an ER diagram.

- Git / Semantic Versioning: Follows conventional commit format (feat:, fix:) and a PR-based trunk workflow.

Nice to Have

- Kubernetes: Working knowledge of Deployments, Services, ConfigMaps, and ServiceAccounts. Able to read and adapt K8s manifests and use kubectl for basic troubleshooting.

- AWS: Working knowledge of ECR, EKS, IAM, and Bedrock (inference layer).

- OAuth2 / OIDC: Conceptual understanding of Authorization Code Flow with PKCE, token exchange, and agent auth delegation.

- Terraform: Beginner-level familiarity; able to make targeted changes to existing modules and interpret a plan diff.

- LaunchDarkly: Experience managing feature flags or AI config overrides for environment-gated rollout.

- Document Intelligence / OCR: AWS Textract or comparable pipeline experience for use cases involving structured document extraction.

AI-Native Development

- We run an AI-native SDLC. AI-assisted tools (Claude Code, Cursor) are part of the standard engineering workflow at every stage: planning, implementation, review, and documentation. This is not optional or supplemental; it is how we work. Candidates should be comfortable with AI-assisted development and willing to invest in getting good at it.

- Use Claude Code and Cursor actively across planning, implementation, and code review

- Know when AI output is wrong and push back on it.

- Help drive adoption across the team by sharing what works

What This Role Is Not
This is not an ML research or data science role. The platform team owns cluster networking, observability pipelines, auth configuration, and LLM routing, so deep expertise in those areas is not required. The job is building reliable
software on top of that infrastructure and helping others do the same.

remote.description:
About Collectly

Collectly is a fast-growing healthcare technology company transforming revenue cycle management (RCM) through AI-driven automation. Millions of patients navigate inefficient billing systems every day, while providers face delayed payments, rising administrative burden, and operational complexity.

Collectly applies artificial intelligence to automate workflows, accelerate cash flow, and modernize the patient financial experience; enabling healthcare organizations to operate more efficiently and focus on delivering care.

There could not be a hotter space to play in. Healthcare is a $4.9T industry and is adopting AI technology at 2.2x the rate of the rest of the economy. RCM is at the heart of this transformation as it has a clear and demonstrable ROI to our customers.

About the role

We’re hiring a Senior Product Data Analyst to own how customers and our own teams see product performance. You will work both on our pre-service products (visit cost estimates, eligibility and benefits, patient support voice agent) and post-service (patient billing, revenue cycle metrics). You’ll
own the dashboards for these products, provide visibility into our product performance, and use the data to find product gaps.

You’ll build customer-facing metrics yourself, mostly with AI tools like Claude Code. This is a product role more than an infrastructure one: we want your time going into how each product behaves and what customers run into, not into maintaining pipelines.

We are a hybrid company, partly based in Santa Monica, USA and partly remote, spread out around the United States & Europe.

Key responsibilities

In this role you will

- Own the dashboards that product and customer teams work from, across most of our products.

- Turn complaints and open questions into defined metrics, and track them over time.

- Catch product issues in the data before they become escalations.

- Work with the founder, product managers, engineers, and customer success to decide what to measure, and explain why a number moved.

Required qualifications

Must-haves

- At least 4 years in data or product analytics.

- Strong SQL and Python.

- A product mindset: you start from what the customer experiences, not from what’s in the tables.

- Fluency with AI-assisted development — we build dashboards and analyses with agentic coding tools (Claude Code and similar) as part of the day-to-day.

- Healthy skepticism about numbers: you validate before you trust.

- Exceptional written and oral communication skills.

Nice-to-haves

- Startup experience.

- Experience building dashboards people actually use (Metabase, Looker, or similar).

- Healthcare experience: eligibility and benefits, patient billing, revenue cycle.

- Comfort reading application code to see where a number comes from.

Collectly is a tech-enabled patient billing platform that works as an add-on for your EHR/PM. Collectly accelerates and increases patient cash flow, streamlines post-service billing operations, and provides the best patient experience that works for all demographics.

About Bazaarvoice

At Bazaarvoice, we create smart shopping experiences. Through our expansive global network, product-passionate community & enterprise technology, we connect thousands of brands and retailers with billions of consumers. Our solutions enable brands to connect with consumers and collect valuable user-generated content, at an unprecedented scale. This content achieves global reach by leveraging our extensive and ever-expanding retail, social & search syndication network. And we make it easy for brands & retailers to gain valuable business insights from real-time consumer feedback with intuitive tools and dashboards. The result is smarter shopping: loyal customers, increased sales, and improved products.
The problem we are trying to solve : Brands and retailers struggle to make real connections with consumers. It's a challenge to deliver trustworthy and inspiring content in the moments that matter most during the discovery and purchase cycle. The result? Time and money spent on content that doesn't attract new consumers, convert them, or earn their long-term loyalty.
Our brand promise : closing the gap between brands and consumers.
Founded in 2005, Bazaarvoice is headquartered in Austin, Texas with offices in North America, Europe, Asia and Australia.
It’s official: Bazaarvoice is a Great Place to Work in the US , Australia, India, Lithuania, France, Germany and the UK!

Bazaarvoice is seeking an experienced, strategic, and execution-oriented Director of Product Operations to lead and scale our core Product Operations discipline.In this critical leadership role, you will act as the force multiplier for our global Product & Engineering organization. You will build, streamline, and govern the operating model that enables our product teams to build the right things, launch them efficiently, and measure their business impact. A key dimension of this role will be driving innovation in operational workflows by leveraging AI to eliminate friction, automate routine effort, and elevate quality and consistency across all product processes.As Director, you will manage, mentor, and grow a team of four (4) dedicated Product Program Managers as well as oversee the Product Knowledge team, aligning their focus across strategic product pillars, portfolio roadmap visibility, technical communications, centralized knowledge management, and cross-functional enablement.
What You’ll Be Doing

- Establish closed-loop feedback systems to aggregate Voice of Customer (VoC) and Voice of Field data into Product Management prioritization.

- Standardize and elevate the end-to-end product delivery lifecycle (PDLC), from opportunity discovery through execution and launch.

- Define and track key product health metrics, feature adoption rates, and operational efficiency metrics across the portfolio.

- Lead, coach, and empower a team of 4 individual Program Managers and the Product Knowledge team, fostering a high-performance, collaborative, and results-driven culture.

- Establish clear team KPIs, resource allocation models, and career development pathways for your direct reports.

- Serve as an escalation point for complex operational roadblocks across product lines

What You'll Bring:

- 10+ years of total experience in Product Operations, Technical Program Management, or Product Management in a fast-paced B2B SaaS or enterprise software environment.

- 4+ years of direct people management experience, with a proven track record of leading, developing, and scaling high-performing program managers and technical communications or documentation functions.

- Deep Product Ops Expertise: Demonstrated success building or maturing a Product Operations function from early/mid-stage to enterprise scale.

- AI-First Operational Mindset: Proven track record of evaluating and integrating AI technologies into operational workflows to reduce manual effort, automate repeatable tasks, and ensure organizational consistency.

- Knowledge & Comms Management: Experience managing internal and external product knowledge bases, technical writing, and release communication frameworks..

- Hands-on experience and proficiency with key product platforms, analytics, and AI tools, including Notion, Pendo, Claude Cowork, Jira, Confluence, and Gong.

- Exceptional ability to synthesize complex quantitative data and qualitative feedback into actionable operational strategies.

- Cross-Functional Influence: Outstanding communication, collaboration, and negotiation skills to align diverse stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Sales, and CS without direct authority.

- Comfortable navigating ambiguity, driving clarity, and scaling processes within a dynamic, matrixed environment.

Why join Bazaarvoice?
Customer is key
We see our own success through our customers’ outcomes.
We approach every situation with a customer first mindset.
Transparency & Integrity Builds Trust
We believe in the power of authentic feedback because it’s in our DNA.

Innovation over Imitation

Stronger Together
We bring our whole selves to the mission and find value in diverse perspectives.

As a stronger company we build a stronger community.

remote.title: Senior Software Engineer - Mission Systems Integration
remote.description:
About the Organization
Now is a great time to join Redhorse Corporation. We are a solution-driven company delivering data insights and technology solutions to customers with missions critical to U.S. national interests. We’re looking for thoughtful, skilled professionals who thrive as trusted partners building technology-agnostic solutions and want to apply their talents supporting customers with difficult and important mission sets.

About the Role

Redhorse transforms the way government uses data and technology. To support this mission, we are seeking a Senior Software Engineer – Mission Systems Integrations to drive the development, integration, and modernization of mission-critical tactical systems for defense and national security stakeholders.

In this role, you will be the technical integration backbone bridging tactical-edge operations with enterprise-scale data platforms. You will design, build, and deploy high-performance software solutions leveraging the TAK (Tactical Assault Kit / Team Awareness Kit) ecosystem and Cursor on Target (CoT) architectures, directly enhancing real-time situational awareness and decision advantage for operators in high-stakes environments.

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, and integrate custom plugins, services, and middleware within the TAK ecosystem (ATAK, WinTAK, TAK Server, and MILTAK).

- Architect and implement Cursor on Target (CoT) data schemas, translations, and event-routing pipelines between tactical devices and enterprise cloud systems.

- Configure, scale, deploy, and maintain TAK Server instances across diverse on-premise, edge, and cloud operating environments.

- Build reliable, low-latency APIs and data ingestion pipelines to ingest multi-source sensor and intelligence feeds into tactical situational awareness interfaces.

- Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams, product managers, and government stakeholders to translate operational mission requirements into scalable technical solutions.

- Implement automated CI/CD pipelines, containerized deployments, and rigorous testing frameworks for edge-deployed mission software.

- Troubleshoot complex tactical network, protocol, and integration issues across heterogeneous environments.

Required Experience/Clearance

- Active DoD Secret clearance with eligibility to obtain and maintain a TS/SCI clearance.

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent practical experience).

- 7+ years of professional software engineering and systems integration experience.

- 3+ years of hands-on technical experience within the TAK protocol ecosystem, including Cursor on Target (CoT) messaging, TAK Server configuration/management, and ATAK/WinTAK/MILTAK integration.

- Strong proficiency in at least two core programming languages: Java/Kotlin (Android/TAK Server plugins), C#/.NET (WinTAK), C++, or Python.

- Proven experience with network protocols, real-time messaging systems (WebSockets, TCP/UDP, ZeroMQ, MQTT), and data serialization formats (XML, JSON, Protocol Buffers).

- Experience working with version control systems (e.g., Git/GitLab) and containerization technologies (e.g., Docker).

- Ability and willingness to travel up to 25% to customer sites, test events, and field integration exercises as needed.

Desired Experience

We encourage all candidates who meet the basic requirements to apply, even if you do not have any of the following experience:

- Experience developing custom ATAK Android plugins using the ATAK Plugin SDK.

- Familiarity with tactical data links (e.g., Link 16, VMF, SADL) and defense geospatial formats (e.g., KML/KMZ, GeoTIFF, NITF).

- Hands-on experience deploying TAK Server or mission applications in cloud environments (AWS GovCloud, Microsoft Azure Government).

- Experience with container orchestration (Kubernetes) and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Ansible).

- Knowledge of DoD cybersecurity policies, STIG compliance, and Risk Management Framework (RMF) standards.

Actual compensation will be determined based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, education, certifications, skills, security clearance level, geographic location, market conditions, and internal equity. In addition to base salary, eligible employees may participate in Redhorse's comprehensive benefits programs and may be eligible for performance-based or other incentive compensation, where applicable.

remote.title: Analytics Engineer, Data Platform
remote.description:
Ready to lead, disrupt and reinvent the sleep industry?
We are Emma – The Sleep Company. Founded in 2015, we have grown into the world’s largest direct-to-consumer (D2C) sleep brand, with a presence in over 20 markets and more than 35 Emma stores across Europe.

Our mission is simple: to develop sleep comfort products that empower our customers to awaken their best every day. Today, our products are trusted by millions and recommended by leading consumer associations worldwide.

It’s our people who bring this mission to life. At Emma, you’ll join a driven, international team that values ownership, collaboration, and continuous knowledge sharing. With colleagues from over 70 nationalities, we combine diverse perspectives with a shared ambition to learn, grow, and create lasting impact, together.

Ready to awaken your best with us?

You'll join a cross-functional Data Platform Team serving Emma's broader Data and Tech organisation, with internal users spanning analysts, analytics engineers, data scientists and data engineers. The team's mission is to make that work faster, safer, and more reliable - through observability, access control, engineering standards, code reviews, internal tooling, and AI adoption across the full pipeline from ingestion to BI tool consumption.

While the primary focus is analytics engineering tooling and process, you'll operate across the full stack, working closely with the Staff Analytics and Data Engineers to scope, build, and ship, while raising the bar for how the team builds. The role rewards breadth and initiative over deep specialisation in one layer, requiring frequent context-switching and comfort with unfamiliar problems.

What you will do:

Reliability, Standards & Governance

- Own and improve monitoring, alerting, and observability across the data platform, so failures are caught early and pipeline/model health is visible to teams.

- Contribute to architecture discussions: propose improvements, document trade-offs (ADRs, RFCs), and help decide what to build, refactor, or retire.

- Set, document, and enforce engineering standards and best practices across our lakehouse, orchestration layer, data warehouse, and reporting systems, including code review culture.

Enablement & Internal Tooling

- Write clear guides, standards, and documentation that help colleagues across the Data domain work more efficiently and consistently, driving alignment through knowledge-sharing forums.

- Build and maintain internal tooling that removes friction for the teams you serve (e.g. AI-augmented workflows, extending observability and quality frameworks).

- Support AI adoption within our data infrastructure, in collaboration with the broader tech division.

Hands-On Pipeline & model development

- Enhance and build on our Redshift data warehouse using dbt and Paradime.

- Orchestrate execution and dependencies between up/downstream pipelines (MWAA, Paradime), provisioning infrastructure via IaC (Pulumi, Terraform) so changes stay reproducible and version-controlled.

- Contribute to our ingestion pipelines across three core patterns - simple ELT, containerised Python, and event-based - landing data reliably into our medallion lakehouse (S3, Glue, Iceberg).

Who we're looking for:

- 3+ years in a data platform, data engineering, analytics engineering, DataOps, or closely related role in a production environment.

- Breadth over depth in a single tool - comfortable switching between topics, picking up unfamiliar problems, with a wide base of technical knowledge across the data stack.

- Strong SQL and Python skills, with a real understanding of how databases work (query execution, performance tuning, storage, access and permission models) and enough dbt experience to review others' work and set standards.

- Working knowledge of the AWS data stack (Redshift, S3, IAM, Athena, Glue) or equivalent, plus experience with lakehouse architectures (Apache Iceberg, Delta, etc), pipeline orchestration (Apache Airflow or equivalent), and modern ingestion/ELT tooling (Airbyte, Fivetran, or equivalent).

- Exposure to Infrastructure as Code (Pulumi, Terraform, or equivalent), and confidence navigating internal tooling and existing codebases.

- Strong communication and writing. You can move between a stakeholder conversation about a problem and a technical discussion about how to solve it.

- Comfortable writing documentation, guides, and architecture decisions.

- Initiative and autonomy to drive work forward independently after onboarding, raising blockers early.

- Fluent English, written and spoken; based in Europe with workable timezone overlap.

What we offer:

-
Maturing Scale-Up: We’re part of the 13–20% of start-ups that transition to scale-up. This is a rare stage where we refine systems without losing agility. It’s where start-up energy meets scalable impact - and where people can build the next version of Emma.

-
Empowerment to Impact: Every Emmie owns part of our success with accountability. It’s about seeing it, owning it, doing it – something that is valued and measured in development.

-
Growth & Learning Journey: We live by the 70/20/10 model – with 70% on the job, 20% from others, 10% structured training. We invest in your growth with trainings and coaching to get you to the top of your game.

-
Emma-zing Community: We hire selectively which means working with smart, collaborative people who care deeply. It’s a community built by Emmies for Emmies.

-
Next Level Global: With 60+ nationalities across 4 offices, global collaboration is part of our values. You’ll work across cultures, perspectives, and time zones.

-
Flexibility: Our Technology team's remote work policy allows for great flexibility.(Please note that the role requires being based in Portugal or Germany)

Become an Emmie

We are on a mission to become No.1 in the world of sleep, and we’re looking for driven, ambitious people to help us shape what’s next. If you’re curious, hands-on, and ready to challenge the status quo, you’ll find the space here to make things happen and create real impact.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building an inclusive workplace. We celebrate diversity and consider all qualified applicants regardless of race, ethnic origin, religion or belief, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or age.

Our aim is to get back to you within a few days. Due to the high volume of applications, there may be slight delays, but we’ll get back to you as soon as possible.

remote.title: Talent Acquisition Manager
remote.description:
About Us:

Zensurance is redefining commercial insurance for Canadian businesses.
As a leading InsurTech, we make getting the right coverage simple, fast, and accessible through a digital-first experience. Our platform combines advanced technology with deep industry expertise to deliver tailored insurance solutions that help businesses thrive.

Zensurance has been recognized for its rapid growth and industry impact:

✅ Deloitte’s Technology Fast 50 (2023, 2024, 2025)

✅ Deloitte’s Technology Fast 500 (2024, 2025)

✅ Top Insurance Employers (2022)

At Zensurance, we value ownership, collaboration, and innovation. Our team thrives on solving complex challenges, challenging the status quo, and making a real impact in an industry ready for change.
If you're looking to build something meaningful in a fast-growing, customer-focused company, we’d love to hear from you!

We’re hiring a Talent Acquisition Manager to lead our recruiting function and develop it into a consistent, measurable, and scalable function. This is a people leadership role. You’ll manage a team of three recruiters and, rather than carrying your own requisition load, you’ll own the systems, standards, and data that let the whole team hire consistently well.

You'll report to the Senior Manager, People Operations, and own the day-to-day execution of Zensurance’s Talent Acquisition strategy.

What you will do:

Lead and develop the recruiting team

- Manage, coach, and develop three recruiters, setting clear expectations and a growth path for each.

- Build a team culture centered on consistency, candidate experience, and accountability for outcomes.

- Own team capacity planning and workload distribution as hiring needs shift across the business.

Set the hiring standard

- Design and implement standardized intake, screening, and interview processes across all roles and levels.

- Define what a "strong hire" looks like for key roles, in partnership with hiring managers and People leadership, and build structured scorecards and interview kits around those definitions.

- Build screening that assesses how candidates work in a distributed environment, including written communication, self-direction and how they collaborate without being in the room.

- Train and coach hiring managers on structured interviewing, unbiased evaluation, and how to be effective partners in the hiring process.

Strengthen the top of the funnel

- Own how we build pipeline, including sourcing, referrals, talent pools and the channels we invest in, so we're not dependent on inbound applications for hard-to-fill roles.

- Set sourcing expectations and coach the team on proactive outreach, with pipeline volume and conversion tracked by role and by channel.

- Build pipeline ahead of demand for the roles we hire repeatedly, using the workforce plan rather than waiting for the req to open.

- Work with Marketing and People on employer brand so the roles we post reach the right candidates in the first place.

Build recruiting data leadership can act on

- Establish a reliable data foundation in our ATS so reporting can be trusted for decision making.

- Define and stand up core recruiting metrics (e.g., time-to-fill, quality of hire, pipeline conversion, interviewer consistency) and build dashboards leadership can rely on.

- Establish ongoing data hygiene practices so metrics stay accurate as the team scales.

Partner across the business

- Work with senior leaders across the business on hiring forecasts, role prioritization and realistic timelines, so recruiting capacity matches the plan and surprises get named early.

- Partner with People Operations and HR Analytics to connect recruiting execution to workforce planning and onboarding.

- Own talent acquisition operationally, translating the talent strategy you shape with HR leadership into how the team works week to week.

- Work with the onboarding team on the handoff from offer to first day, so hiring quality carries through to new-hire success.

Own the fundamentals of a modern TA function

- Maintain compliance with applicable employment and human rights legislation across all stages of the hiring process.

- Champion inclusive, bias-aware hiring practices across the team and hiring managers.

- Manage our ATS and recruiting tech stack, and evaluate new tools as needed.

- Assess and utilize automation, AI and tool integration where necessary to streamline internal processes and hiring process, without compromising human oversight.

- Contribute to employer branding and candidate experience, ensuring every candidate has a consistent, professional experience regardless of outcome.

- Manage recruiting vendor relationships (agencies, job boards, assessment tools) and associated budget.

What success looks like in your first year:

- Every role runs through a consistent intake, interview and scorecard process, and hiring managers use it because it works.

- Recruiting metrics are accurate enough that senior leaders plan from them without asking whether the numbers are right.

- Hiring managers across the business have been trained on structured interviewing, and interviewer consistency has measurably improved.

- Pipeline for our repeat-hire roles is built ahead of demand, with sourced candidates making up a meaningful share of hires rather than a rounding error.

What you bring:

- 5+ years of talent acquisition leadership experience including developing a recruiting team.

- A proven track record of building or rebuilding a TA function, rather than inheriting a mature one, including standing up interview frameworks, hiring standards, and recruiting metrics from scratch.

- Demonstrated success building top-of-funnel pipeline through sourcing, referrals and talent pooling, and coaching a team to do the same.

- Strong command of recruiting data and ATS administration, with the ability to turn messy or unreliable data into clean, trustworthy reporting.

- Experience training and influencing hiring managers, including those outside of People/HR, on structured and inclusive interviewing practices.

- Comfort operating as an execution and data owner within a broader talent strategy set by others, rather than setting that strategy independently.

- Excellent stakeholder management skills and the judgment to prioritize a build-phase roadmap under real hiring pressure.

- Experience in a scaling mid-size organization (roughly 200-1000 employees) is an asset.

Benefits & Perks at Zensurance:
At Zensurance, we know that when our people thrive, so does our business. That’s why we offer a flexible, people-first work environment designed to support your well-being, growth, and success.
💻 Work Your Way
• Remote-first setup for added flexibility
• Home office allowance to create a comfortable workspace
• Top-tier tech: "Office in a box" with all necessary tech equipment
• Half days before public holidays: Enjoy half days before long weekends
❤️ Your Health, Your Way
• Flexible health and dental plans for families, including mental health support
• Health & personal spending accounts to invest in wellness your way
• Parental leave top-up, because family comes first
🚀 Investing in Your Growth
• Education assistance reimbursement for courses, conferences, books, and memberships
• Opportunities to learn from industry experts and grow your career
🤝 Staying Connected
• Weekly Friday huddles to share updates and connect across teams
• Virtual & in-person team-building events to strengthen our culture
We’re building something special. Come be a part of it!
Who We Are:
Business is hard work, but insurance doesn’t have to be!
We empower business owners with simple, tech-driven insurance solutions through our online platform.
Our success is fueled by our team-oriented culture and four core values:

DELIVER – We set ambitious goals and achieve them.

INCLUDE – We foster an open and safe space for all.

INTEGRITY – We do what’s right.

INVENT – We create straightforward, innovative solutions.
AI Tools and Your Interview:
We know AI is a valuable tool, and you're welcome to use it to prepare for your interview. However, please don't use AI assistants during the live interview itself. We want to have an authentic conversation with you, and using AI during the interview could affect our evaluation of your suitability for the role.
Just so you know, we use an AI scribe to help us take notes and review interviews, ensuring a fair and clear process.
Diversity & Inclusion:

Zensurance celebrates diversity and is committed to creating an inclusive environment. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and provide accommodations throughout the hiring process. If you need support, let us know, we’re here to help.
Thank You!
We review every application with care to find the best fit for our team.
While we may take a little time to get back to you due to the high volume of applications we receive, know that a real human (not a bot!) is reviewing yours. We appreciate your patience and can't wait to learn more about you!

remote.title: Senior Director, Health Economics & Actuarial Analytics
remote.description:
About Foodsmart:
Foodsmart is the leading Foodcare platform in the U.S., built to deliver nutrition-driven healthcare at scale. Powered by a national network of Registered Dietitians, Foodsmart combines personalized clinical nutrition care, behavior change tools, and food benefits to improve member health outcomes while lowering healthcare costs.
Our platform is designed to foster healthier food choices, drive lasting behavior change, and deliver sustainable health outcomes. Through our highly personalized, digital platform, we guide more than 3 million members—including those in employer-sponsored health plans, regional and national Medicaid managed care organizations, Medicare Advantage plans, and commercial insurers—on a tailored journey to eating well while saving time and money.
Foodsmart seamlessly integrates dietary assessments and nutrition counseling with online food ordering and cost-effective meal planning for the entire family, optimizing ingredients both at home and on the go. We partner with national and regional retailers across the U.S., many of whom accept SNAP/EBT, making healthier food more accessible. Additionally, we assist members with SNAP enrollment and management, providing tangible access to nutritious food. In 2024, Foodsmart secured a $200 million investment from TPG’s Rise Fund, which supports entrepreneurs dedicated to achieving the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals. This investment helps us expand our reach, particularly to low-income workers who are disproportionately affected by diet-related diseases.
At Foodsmart, our mission is to make nutritious food accessible and affordable for everyone, regardless of economic status. We are committed to a set of core values that shape our culture and work environment:
👥 Customer First - You start with the member and work backwards.
🚀 Make It Happen - You act with urgency, use data, and hold high standards.
🤝 One Team - You collaborate with respect and commit as a group.
Whether you're a dietitian, a commercial leader, or a technologist, working at Foodsmart means being part of a team that is passionate, supportive, and driven by a shared purpose. Join us in transforming the way people access and enjoy healthy food.
About the Role:
Foodsmart’s value proposition rests on a claim: we improve outcomes for the members who need it most, and we save payers real money doing it. We’re looking for a Senior Director of Health Economics & Actuarial Analytics who can make that claim airtight, rigorous enough to hold up when a payer’s own actuarial team pressure tests it.
This role owns the full chain from clinical improvement to economic value. It starts with measuring what actually changed for a client’s members: weight loss, A1c improvement, blood pressure control, HEDIS performance. It ends with quantifying what that improvement is worth and defending that number in front of the people writing the check.
You’ll also help shape our value-based care strategy, including which populations we should be targeting and what performance we can credibly commit to.
Health economists and actuaries approach these problems differently, and either can be excellent here. What matters is the standard you hold yourself to. Our numbers get validated by payers’ own actuarial teams, which means the work has to be built the way they would build it, with their assumptions about trend, credibility, and risk adjustment.
This is our most senior data science leadership role, reporting directly to the VP of Analytics & Data Science. You’ll lead a small team while staying deeply hands-on with the methodology yourself, and you’ll be expected to use AI as a genuine force multiplier, to move faster, go deeper, and extend your reach well beyond what the headcount alone would suggest. You’ll also be a partner on our peer-reviewed research work, which we pursue with academic collaborators and our founder and Chief Science Officer.
The strongest candidates will have done this inside a telehealth or digital health company, or will have built their foundation on the payer or consulting side and then moved into digital health. What matters most is that you have proven value to payers before, repeatedly, and know what it takes for those numbers to be believed.
You will:

- Own how we measure clinical outcomes across client member populations: weight loss, A1c, blood pressure, food insecurity, HEDIS measures, and the quality metrics our clients hold us to.

- Own Foodsmart’s ROI methodology: translating those clinical outcomes into economic value, and identifying which member populations we help the most.

- Represent that methodology directly to payers and external actuarial and consulting firms, defending our approach under real technical scrutiny rather than just presenting a final number.

- Own the analytical substance of the value story we tell individual clients, grounded in their own members’ outcomes rather than generic benchmarks.

- Help shape our value-based care strategy, including which member populations to target and what performance we can credibly stand behind.

- Build our outcomes and ROI methodology as a scalable system, one that extends to new populations and new client conversations without being rebuilt from scratch each time.

- Partner on peer-reviewed research with academic collaborators

- Work with our clinical team to translate findings and best practices into how care is actually delivered.

- Lead and develop a small team while staying hands-on, and lean on AI and other tooling to extend how much ground you and your team can cover.

You are:

- Rigorous in the way a payer’s actuarial team is rigorous. You reason about cost, utilization, risk, and credibility with real discipline, and you know where a methodology is most likely to be attacked.

- Fluent in both clinical quality measurement and economic value, and comfortable moving between the two. You can look at a change in A1c across a population and know how to turn it into a number a payer will accept.

- Comfortable being the technical counterpart to a payer’s own actuaries and consultants: unintimidated by scrutiny, and able to defend methodology choices in real time.

- Seasoned. You have proven value to payers repeatedly, and you are not learning ROI methodology on the job.

- A systems builder who thinks in terms of scale: a repeatable methodology, not a one-off analysis redone for every new client or payer.

- Able to translate technical findings into how care actually gets delivered, working alongside clinical and care delivery teams.

- Someone who treats AI as a genuine lever on your own impact. You actively look for ways to use it to work faster and go deeper, and you have a point of view on where it helps and where rigor still demands a human.

- Comfortable leading a small team while staying personally hands-on with the hardest analytical work yourself.

You have:

- A background in health economics, actuarial science, or a closely related quantitative field, with a track record of applying it to healthcare cost and value questions. An advanced degree or actuarial credentials (ASA, FSA, MAAA) are a plus but not required if you have equivalent hands-on depth.

- Experience proving ROI and value inside a telehealth or digital health company, or a foundation on the payer or consulting side followed by time in digital health.

- Hands-on experience measuring clinical outcomes and quality across populations, including familiarity with HEDIS and common chronic condition measures.

- Deep, hands-on experience with healthcare claims data, both medical and pharmacy (Rx), including the practical realities of using it for cost and utilization analysis.

- Deep expertise in causal inference as applied to healthcare cost and outcomes: matched cohort design, risk adjustment, and quasi-experimental methods.

- Direct experience presenting and defending ROI methodology with payers, actuaries, or similarly technical external audiences.

- Experience with value-based care arrangements and a point of view on what a provider or vendor can credibly commit to.

- Peer-reviewed publication experience is a plus.

- Experience partnering with clinical or care delivery teams to translate findings into practice.

- Comfort working directly with data (SQL, R, or Python) to conduct your own analysis.

- Familiarity with AI-native tooling (Claude Code, or equivalent) as a way to accelerate analysis.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to write for external, technical, and non-technical audiences alike.

About our benefits and perks:

✅ Remote-First Company

✅ Unlimited PTO

✅ Flexible & remote location

✅ Healthcare Coverage (Medical, Dental, Vision)
✅ 401k & bonus

✅ Registered Dietitian Sessions

remote.description:
Datavant is the data collaboration platform trusted for healthcare. Guided by our mission to make the world’s health data secure, accessible and actionable, we provide critical data solutions for organizations across the healthcare ecosystem - including providers, health plans, researchers, and life sciences companies. From fulfilling a single patient’s request for their medical records to powering the AI revolution in healthcare, Datavanters are building the future of how data is connected and used to improve health.

By joining Datavant today, you’re stepping onto a driven and highly collaborative team that is passionate about creating transformative change in healthcare.

Staff Software Engineer
The Role
As a Staff Software Engineer, you will shape the technical direction and architecture of your business unit/vertical. You’ll drive innovation across verticals, solve large-scale system challenges, and mentor senior engineers to maximize impact. You operate with autonomy and influence outcomes at the vertical and/or organizational level.
What You’ll Do

- Define and lead multi-team technical strategies for scalability and interoperability.

- Design frameworks and reusable systems used across multiple engineering pods. Define engineering patterns adopted across Datavant.

- Drive cross-functional initiatives in data architecture, security, and reliability.

- Advise leadership on technical direction and major tradeoffs. Represent engineering in executive technical decisions and planning.

- Mentor senior engineers and influence cultural and architectural evolution.

Tech Stack You’ll Work With
As a Staff Software Engineer, you will work across the full breadth of Datavant’s platform and are expected to operate comfortably within our multi-cloud, large-scale distributed systems environment. Your work will span:

-
Backend: Python, Go, Java; microservices; REST and GraphQL

-
Frontend: TypeScript, React, Next.js (as needed for full-stack or cross-domain work)

-
Infrastructure & Cloud: AWS, multi-cloud architectures, Kubernetes, Docker, and infrastructure-as-code tooling

-
Data Platforms: Snowflake, Spark, SQL, S3; advanced data engineering workflows and high-scale data pipelines

-
ETL & Orchestration: Airflow or AWS Glue

-
Streaming: Kafka or Kinesis for real-time ingestion and system integrations

-
Observability: Enterprise-level telemetry systems including DataDog, Grafana, and CloudWatch

-
Security & Compliance: OAuth2/SAML, encryption, tokenization, and zero-trust security frameworks

Staff Engineers at this level are expected to apply deep architectural expertise across these technologies, define scalable patterns, guide cross-team adoption, and ensure Datavant’s platform meets the highest standards of reliability, security, and performance.
What You Bring

- 10+ years of software engineering experience with demonstrated system design mastery.

- Deep experience with large-scale distributed systems, multi-cloud architectures, data pipelines, and security.

- Strong organizational influence and ability to align teams across verticals.

- Ability to translate strategic objectives into scalable engineering execution.

- Commitment to mentorship, technical excellence, and continuous improvement.

Leadership Qualities & Mindset

- Operate as a trusted technical advisor and thought leader. Create clarity in ambiguous, cross-functional problem spaces.

- Balance vision with pragmatic implementation and organizational awareness.

- Champion scalability, security, and compliance as shared responsibilities.

- Elevate engineering standards and inspire architectural excellence.

- Act with integrity, empathy, and long-term impact orientation.

Core Value Expectations

- Earn trust through architectural stewardship and enterprise-grade reliability.

- Obsess over customers by driving scalable, secure, high-impact solutions.

- Prioritize growth over comfort by embracing the hardest challenges and modeling excellence.

- Win as a team by aligning pods, shaping cross-functional strategy, and building talent.

- Rise to the challenge by delivering transformative initiatives that move Datavant forward.

Why This Role Matters
This role defines the future of Datavant’s technology architecture and engineering standards. Your leadership empowers teams, resolves systemic challenges, and builds the technical foundation that powers secure, scalable healthcare data exchange across the ecosystem. As a Staff Engineer, you influence strategy, drive innovation, and ensure Datavant continues to lead in secure data interoperability.

remote.description:
Are you ready to join a growing team that puts a premium on productivity and has an award-winning culture centered around transforming talented employees into effective business leaders? Then BHG Financial is the place for you.
In 2001, we started with an idea, an opportunity, and $25,000. Back then, our focus was strictly
on serving those in the medical industry. With healthcare in our heritage, we soon expanded
to serve high-earning professionals in many
other industries, providing all with leading-edge financial solutions, including our extensive network of community banks.
Today, BHG Financial has firmly established
its legacy as a leader in the financial services space. Founded on the philosophy of a better way to borrow, we are dedicated to helping accomplished professionals, small businesses, and institutions build upon their success through innovative financial solutions, a hassle-free process, and personalized concierge service.
Our relentless commitment to the success of our customers is part of what has made BHG Financial thrive. We take a 360-degree view of our customers to tailor the best solutions for their financial aspirations. Today's professionals have multiple sources of income, not just their paycheck. Therefore, it is essential to factor those in when making responsible lending decisions. Our continued focus on data, analytics, and proprietary modeling has enabled faster funding for our customers.
From business to personal loans to relationships with community banks, the country’s top professionals and business owners rely on us for our exceptional financial solutions and concierge service to continue their success and legacy.
Who You Are
You are a motivated professional who is passionate about providing innovative solutions to current and potential customers. You excel at communication and presentation and have experience working closely with customers to asses needs. You are self-driven, ambitious and thrive in a fast-paced environment where you can market and promote company products and services to current and potential customers.
What You'll Do

- Associate Account Executives will utilize independent discretion and judgment to analyze and assess information related to customer assets, income, and debts, and decide which financial and loan products best meet the customer’s needs and financial circumstances, and advise customers accordingly regarding the advantages and disadvantages of different financial products

- Market and promote company products and services to current and potential clients

- Our best sales professionals show strong prospecting skills, including the ability to engage in high-level cold-calling to qualify and close new accounts

- Display excellent communication and presentation skills with a top-notch customer service approach

- Document activity using our CRM

- Follow up on new leads and referrals resulting from phone and field activity

- Establish and maintain current client and potential client relationships

What You'll Need

- Bachelor’s degree highly preferred

- 1-5 years of experience in a professional setting, preferably with evidence of prior success in sales

- Cold calling experience is highly preferred, in addition to other sales activity

- Proven demonstration of intellect, drive, executive presence, and sales acumen

- Competitive nature. You’re driven to be the best. You challenge yourself by setting goals, crushing them, and helping your teammates do the same.

-
Travel requirement: Within the first 6 months of employment, all employees will travel to attend the BHG All Oars Experience. Following this event, ongoing travel is minimal—approximately 5% annually—for team on-sites, meetings, and cross-functional collaboration.

Life at BHG Financial

At BHG Financial, we work hard and aren’t afraid to take risks. Since the beginning, our core values of PMA (positive mental attitude), team player, and loyalty have been the driving force behind every interaction we have between each other and our customers. From the top down, our leaders are actively involved not only in strategic oversight and running the business, but also in the well-being and growth of all employees. We consider people our #1 asset, and help employees realize their full potential, set and exceed their goals, and explore new opportunities for personal and professional development.
Why You Should Join BHG Financial

We strive to offer amenities, opportunities, events, and programming that support the interests of our teams, while furthering the culture that makes us Great Place to Work® certified. Some of the benefits you can expect when you join BHG Financial include:
•Medical/Rx/Dental/Vision coverage for employees and their eligible family members

•Company 401(k) plan with employer contributions after one year
•Company-sponsored training and certification opportunities

If you’re ready for a career where you can exercise your passions, be surrounded by co-workers who are relentlessly committed to service, and have a team-player mindset, apply today!

BHG Financial is committed to equal treatment and opportunity in all aspects of recruitment, selection, and employment without regard to gender, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, disability, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other category protected under the law.
