remote.title: Revenue Operations Analyst
remote.description:
Jeeves is a groundbreaking financial operating system built for global businesses that provides corporate cards, cross-border payments, and spend management software within one unified platform. The company operates across 20+ countries including Brazil, Canada, Colombia, Mexico, the United Kingdom, across Europe, and the United States, and serves over 5,000 clients ranging from venture-backed startups to SMBs around the world. With a mission to empower businesses with more efficient and cost-effective financial solutions worldwide, Jeeves combines cutting-edge financial technology with exceptional team expertise to transform the business financial landscape. Jeeves has been recognized as one of The Information's 50 Most Promising Startups in 2023, as well as a Y Combinator Top Company 2021-2023 and won “Fintech of the Year" at the European Fintech Awards.
Since graduating from Y Combinator in 2020, Jeeves has successfully raised over $380 million and is backed by top world-class investors including Andreessen Horowitz, Y Combinator, CRV, Tencent, Stanford University, Clocktower Ventures, and founders of more than 15 unicorns including David Velez (Nubank), Carlos Garcia (Kavak) and Sebastián Mejía (Rappi).
This role is focused on Jeeves’s growth programs and emerging revenue channels — including our partnerships channel and new market expansion initiatives — where we need rigorous, scalable analytics to match the pace of growth.
You’ll be responsible for the analytical layer that connects our sales activity to revenue outcomes: building the dashboards our leadership relies on, maintaining shared responsibility for the integrity of our performance data, and proactively surfacing the insights that shape how we operate. You’ll work closely with the Head of Revenue Operations and contribute meaningfully to planning and review cycles alongside GTM leadership.
The pace here is real. Priorities shift, timelines compress, and the ground moves under your feet — not occasionally, but constantly. We need someone who is energized by that, not worn down. You won’t wait for someone to tell you what to look at. You’ll already know.
Key Responsibilities

GTM Analytics & Growth Program Insights

- Build and maintain Tableau dashboards tracking performance across our partnerships channel and new growth initiatives — serving audiences from country leads to executive leadership.

- Analyze conversion rates, pipeline health, ramp trends, and revenue attainment across programs and segments, surfacing patterns before they become decisions that have already been made.

- Come with a point of view. When a program is underperforming or a trend shifts, bring an interpretation and a recommendation (not just a chart).

- Support quarterly and annual GTM business reviews with structured analysis: cohort breakdowns, market-level benchmarks, and forward-looking indicators.

Revenue Planning & Target Analysis

- Contribute to GTM capacity planning and quota-setting cycles — modeling scenarios, building attainment reports, and stress-testing assumptions before plans are finalized.

- Maintain performance-against-target reporting for growth programs and emerging channels: track attainment, flag outliers early, and ensure data is always reconciled.

- Support variable compensation analysis for relevant programs — running calculations, auditing for accuracy, and partnering with Finance to ensure payouts are correct and timely.

- Build and maintain data structures that support reliable rolling forecasts for new and high-growth segments.

AI-Driven Operations & Scale

- Use AI tools, including Claude and other frontier models, as active parts of your workflow: automating repetitive reporting tasks, accelerating data synthesis, and building scalable analytical programs that would otherwise require a much larger team.

- Identify RevOps processes that can be operationalized or significantly improved through AI, and take ownership of building those solutions, not just flagging the opportunity.

- Apply AI-assisted analysis to extract insights at scale from large, multi-source datasets: pipeline signals, rep activity, customer behavior, and market trends.

- Help establish Jeeves’s AI-first approach to RevOps as a model for how the broader GTM team operates.

Data Quality & Systems Integration

- Share responsibility for data quality across our revenue stack (HubSpot CRM, Tableau, and financial systems), conducting audits for accuracy, completeness, and consistency.

- Connect disparate data sources (CRM, marketing automation, financial tools, and proprietary revenue data) so that reporting on growth programs is unified and trustworthy.

- Document data models, metric definitions, and reporting logic so the team works from a shared understanding of what we’re measuring and why.

Stakeholder Partnership

- Develop enough context on our GTM motion to contribute meaningfully in planning and pipeline review cycles alongside sales leadership, bringing data that drives decisions, not just awareness.

- Serve as a reliable analytical resource to the Head of Revenue Operations and GTM leadership: scope requests clearly, pull the data, and return clear answers quickly.

- Identify process gaps and proactively propose improvements to how we collect, manage, and act on GTM data (especially across new and growing channels).

What We’re Looking For

Technical & Analytical Skills

- Tableau mastery: able to write complex calculated fields, build multi-source dashboards, and design views for diverse audiences from reps to the C-suite.

- Advanced Excel and Google Sheets: complex formulas, pivot tables, and financial modeling — you reach for the right tool for the job, not just the most impressive one.

- Strong SQL skills: you can get to an answer independently without waiting for a data engineer to pull it for you.

- Data integration experience: comfortable connecting CRM, marketing automation, and financial data into unified reporting environments.

- Business metrics fluency: deep understanding of conversion rates, customer lifetime value (LTV), pipeline coverage, ramp curves, revenue attainment, and customer health.

- Data modeling: able to design clean structures that support accurate forecasting, compensation analysis, and multi-region rollups.

AI Fluency (Required, Not Optional)

- You actively use AI tools, Claude Copilot/Code, or equivalent, as part of your day-to-day workflow, not as a novelty.

- You’ve used AI to automate reporting pipelines, accelerate analysis, or build operational programs that scale beyond what a single analyst could do manually.

- You’re curious about where AI can go next in RevOps and you bring ideas, not just execution.

Soft Skills & Ways of Working

- Hungry and driven: you want to build something generational, and you bring the energy and output to match. You hold yourself to a higher standard than anyone else will hold you to.

- Thrives in high-velocity environments: you’re not just comfortable with ambiguity and shifting priorities — you’re energized by them. You find a way through, not a reason to wait.

- High agency: you don’t wait for a ticket. You’re already thinking about what the data might be missing or what question leadership will ask next week.

- Sharp communicator: your outputs — whether a Slack message, a Tableau dashboard, or a business review slide — are concise, structured, and ready for a senior audience.

- Strong time management: you’re comfortable managing multiple live workstreams, setting expectations on timelines, and delivering reliably under pressure.

- Low ego and collaborative: Jeeves is building something ambitious across complex markets. You’re here to make the whole team better, not just your function.

Qualifications

- 2–4 years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Business Analytics, or a related GTM-adjacent role.

- Hands-on Tableau experience is required. You should be able to demonstrate dashboards you’ve built from scratch.

- Advanced proficiency in Excel and/or Google Sheets.

- Experience working with CRM data (HubSpot preferred) and connecting it to downstream reporting.

- Exposure to incentive compensation modeling, quota attainment reporting, or variable pay analysis is strongly preferred.

- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Data Science, or a related field.

- Fluency in English is required; proficiency in Spanish and/or Portuguese is preferred.

Nice to Have

- Experience in B2B fintech, payments, corporate banking, or expense management.

- Familiarity with multi-currency, multi-region revenue reporting.

- Experience building or improving compensation and quota-tracking systems end-to-end.

- Background in channel partnerships, broker networks, or indirect sales models.

What We Offer

- Competitive salary and performance-based bonus.

- The chance to work on analytically complex problems across 3+ continents and multiple currencies — at a company moving fast enough that your work actually changes things.

- A lean team that uses AI first, moves with urgency, and trusts you to own your domain from day one.

- Direct exposure to senior RevOps and GTM leadership.

- A culture that values output, curiosity, and honest feedback over hierarchy — and that genuinely believes it’s building something that matters.

remote.title: AI Architect
remote.description:
Job Title: AI Architect
Location: Remote (anywhere from India)
Timings :11 am to 8pm

Job Summary
This is a foundational hire. AI is being built and shipped across every product line in the portfolio, often in isolation. Duplication of models, tools, and infrastructure is driving up cost and slowing us down. The AI Architect will lead the definition of our target-state AI architecture, stand up the central AI services platform that every product will consume, and drive the delivery roadmap that consolidates and scales AI across the portfolio.
The role is technical and strategic. You will make the architecture decisions, then own their execution. You will build a small central team over time, but in the first six months you will operate primarily as a hands-on architect and delivery lead. AI is Phase 1 of a broader central services strategy at PairSoft; the pattern you set here will extend to other shared capabilities.

Responsibilities / Essential Functions
Architecture

- Define and publish the target-state AI architecture across the product lines, including central services versus application-layer boundaries.

- Own the technology decisions: foundation model providers, orchestration frameworks, vector stores, evaluation and observability platforms, guardrails, and agent frameworks.

- Establish architecture decision criteria and the decision-record process. Ensure every significant call is defensible, documented, and revisitable.

- Design for tenant isolation, PII handling, and regional data residency from day one, working with the CISO on the security envelope.

Delivery

- Lead the build of the central AI platform: model gateway, prompt registry, RAG-as-a-service, guardrails and content safety, evals and telemetry, cost attribution, and audit logging.

- Own the phased roadmap: discovery and decisions, platform build, migration of existing product AI features to the platform, and optimization.

- Partner with product engineering leaders across all product lines to migrate existing AI features onto the central platform without disrupting customer commitments.

- Set the operational bar: observability, SLOs, incident response, and on-call model for AI services.

Governance & Economics

- Stand up per-request cost tagging and the AI unit economics dashboard. Track cost per feature, per customer, and per model. Enforce budgets and rate limits per tenant.

- Chair a cross-product AI Council to govern shared standards, new use case intake, and vendor decisions.

- Own vendor relationships for AI infrastructure and tooling. Lead build-versus-buy analysis and commercial negotiation with product and finance partners.

- Prepare and represent the AI architecture and roadmap in leadership reviews and private-equity sponsor conversations, including technical due diligence.

Team

- Recruit and lead the AI Platform team as the function grows.

- Establish the operating model between the central platform team and embedded AI engineers across product lines.

- Mentor engineers across the portfolio on AI patterns, evaluation practices, and safe deployment.

Requirements

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent.

- 10+ years of engineering experience, with at least 5 years in senior architecture roles at enterprise B2B SaaS companies.

- 3+ years of hands-on production experience with LLM-based systems: RAG, agents, evaluation, prompt engineering, and inference optimization.

- 3+ years people management experience, including recruitment, motivation and development of 3+ teams in global setting.

- Demonstrated track record building an AI or ML platform consumed by multiple product teams. You have designed and shipped shared infrastructure, not just individual features.

- Strong delivery leadership. You have shipped platforms on time, on budget, and with the operational discipline required to run them in production.

- Deep cloud-native architecture experience on Azure and AWS. Comfort with Kubernetes, IaC, and modern data platforms.

- Fluency across the modern LLM ecosystem: OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, Bedrock, open-source models, LangChain or LlamaIndex, vector databases, and observability tools like LangSmith or Langfuse.

- Clear grasp of AI security and compliance: prompt injection, tenant isolation, PII handling, SOC 2, GDPR, and the vendor risk questions PE-owned SaaS companies face.

- Ability to communicate architecture decisions and tradeoffs to executive audiences, including private equity sponsors and technical due diligence teams.

- Fluency in English

Preferred Qualifications

- Domain experience in procure-to-pay, ERP integration, accounts payable, procurement, or adjacent finance and operations software.

- Prior experience at an international PE-backed B2B SaaS company, ideally one that went through or is preparing for a liquidity event.

- Experience integrating and consolidating AI capabilities across products acquired through mergers and acquisitions.

- Direct experience with agent frameworks in production (LangGraph, AutoGen, or custom orchestration), fine-tuning, and multi-model routing.

- Experience leading a central platform team through a technology consolidation program.

- Prior participation in technical due diligence, either as owner or advisor.

Work and Physical Requirements
This position may work from home and/or office environment. Working in an office environment may require prolonged sitting, work in an air-conditioned environment, ability to work with others at various noise levels and ability to lift up to 30 pounds or 15 kg.

Other Duties
This job description is not intended to be a complete list of responsibilities. Other duties may be assigned by management that may reasonably fit in the scope of job.

remote.title: Director, Business Development - Life Sciences
remote.description:
Arcadia is dedicated to happier, healthier days for all. We believe that there is a better healthcare world – one powered by data. Our platform transforms complex, diverse data into a unified foundation for health, helping organizations deliver better care, boost revenue, and lower costs.

We're a team of fiercely driven individuals committed to making healthcare more sustainable—and we're looking for passionate people to help us get there.

For more information, visit arcadia.io.

Why this role is important to Arcadia

Arcadia is building a direct-to–Life Sciences commercial function as a strategic growth pillar of the company. The Director, Business Development - Life Sciences is an individual contributor seller responsible for building and closing enterprise relationships with pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies within an assigned account territory.

This is a true end-to-end selling role. You will prospect and develop new opportunities, lead discovery conversations with scientific and commercial stakeholders, scope and price solutions, negotiate contracts, and partner closely with internal teams to ensure successful delivery and long-term client satisfaction.

This role is designed for a life sciences seller with fluency in real-world data, analytics, and evidence-based solutions—someone who understands how pharma organizations buy across the development lifecycle and who wants to build a durable book of business inside Arcadia's growing direct Life Sciences sales organization.

What Success Looks Like

In 3 months

- Build a deep understanding of Arcadia's Life Sciences data, solutions, operating model, and delivery capabilities

- Establish credibility and working rhythm with Product, Data, Ops, Delivery, Legal, and Finance

- Build a qualified pipeline within your assigned account territory, leveraging existing relationships and Arcadia's differentiated data assets

- Complete onboarding on Arcadia's Life Sciences value narrative, competitive positioning, and pricing framework

In 6 months

- Advance a meaningful, qualified pipeline aligned to pharma planning and budgeting cycles

- Close at least one deal or be in late-stage contracting on priority opportunities

- Demonstrate strong deal scoping discipline with smooth handoffs into delivery

- Maintain accurate CRM hygiene and deliver a reliable forecast to your manager

In 12 months

- Consistently attain quota with a 3-5x quota, well-qualified pipeline across your territory

- Close multiple deals with clear expansion potential, including at least one multi-year or enterprise agreement

- Build strong relationships with scientific, commercial, and procurement stakeholders where Arcadia is viewed as a trusted partner

- Provide market feedback that influences packaging, pricing, or roadmap prioritization

What You'll Be Doing

PROSPECT AND BUILD A QUALIFIED LIFE SCIENCES PIPELINE

- Proactively build pipeline in a green-field or assigned Life Sciences territory using conference presence, publication monitoring, thought leadership networks, hunting via warm and cold outreach, leveraging of BDR Team, and CRO or consultancy partnerships

- Identify and prioritize high-probability targets using a defined ideal customer profile: company size, therapeutic area focus, pipeline stage, and recent approvals

- Map multi-threaded stakeholder ecosystems across R&D, HEOR, medical, market access, and commercial teams at target accounts

- Maintain rigorous pipeline hygiene using a defined qualification methodology (e.g., MEDDIC, MEDDPICC, or BANT) to advance or deprioritize opportunities

LEAD SOLUTION SELLING ACROSS THE PHARMA DEVELOPMENT LIFECYCLE

- Lead discovery conversations across early research, clinical development, HEOR/RWE, market access, and commercial analytics

- Translate complex client needs into well-scoped solutions that balance data, analytics, services, and delivery realities

- Guide clients toward use cases where Arcadia can deliver outsized value, not lowest-friction data transactions

- Align solutions to client budgeting and planning cycles, including annual and multi-year funding processes

CONDUCT CONSULTATIVE, VALUE-BASED SELLING

- Lead structured discovery that surfaces business problems and internal success metrics before any product discussion

- Build ROI and business cases using the customer's own metrics and language, validated by the scientific or commercial champion

- Adapt selling approach and content to the buyer persona and Use Case - modulating message and proof points accordingly

NEGOTIATE AND CLOSE COMMERCIAL AGREEMENTS

- Structure enterprise data agreements—licensing, DUAs, MSAs, usage-based pricing—that protect margin while delivering clear buyer value

- Exercise strong commercial judgment on deal structure, pricing, and scope, with a clear negotiating position and walk-away point on every deal

- Respond to procurement pressure by re-anchoring to validated scientific and commercial value rather than discounting immediately

- Own the full lifecycle:

- Opportunity qualification

- Solution design and scoping

- Proposal and SOW development

- Pricing and commercial structuring

- Contract negotiation and close

- Partner closely with legal, finance, and leadership to finalize terms efficiently

COLLABORATE ACROSS TEAMS AND MAINTAIN FORECAST DISCIPLINE

- Partner effectively with data science, medical, product, legal, and delivery teams to configure and present solutions that meet complex customer requirements

- Orchestrate internal resources without over-committing them, and manage a clean handoff to delivery and customer success to protect revenue

- Maintain accurate, up-to-date CRM records and deliver reliable forecasts, distinguishing clearly between commit, best case, and pipeline

- Contribute market and competitive feedback that informs product roadmap, packaging, and pricing decisions

What You'll Bring

- 5+ years of experience selling into pharmaceutical and/or biotechnology companies, ideally in a quota-carrying, individual contributor role

- Demonstrated success selling data-, analytics-, or evidence-driven solutions (RWD, RWE/HEOR, clinical analytics, or adjacent offerings)

- Deep working knowledge of Life Sciences functional area—HEOR, Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, or Payer/Market Access—including how that function makes decisions and purchases data and analytics solutions

- Proven ability to engage scientific buyers (PhDs, MDs, biostatisticians, epidemiologists) with credibility on methodology, study design, and data fit-for-purpose

- Experience structuring and negotiating enterprise data licensing agreements, including DUAs, MSAs, and usage-based pricing models

- A disciplined approach to pipeline management and forecasting, using a defined qualification methodology

- Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and comfort operating in a build-mode commercial environment

Would Love For You To Have

- Existing senior relationships within pharma or biotech that can accelerate early pipeline development

- Familiarity with FDA RWE Framework, EMA guidance, or ISPOR methodology standards

- Experience selling into more than one Life Sciences functional area (e.g., both HEOR and Medical Affairs)

- Active presence in relevant industry conferences (ISPOR, ASCO, ASH, DIA, AMCP) and referral relationships with CROs or HEOR consultancies

- MEDDIC or MEDDPICC certification, or equivalent formal sales methodology training

What You'll Get

-
Arcadia brings a rare advantage to Life Sciences: a market-leading, scaled payer and provider platform as its foundation

- For more than a decade, Arcadia has been the trusted data and analytics partner to health systems, physician groups, and payers nationwide. That core business provides deep, longitudinal clinical and claims data, embedded clinical workflows, and durable relationships across the healthcare ecosystem

- Building on this foundation, Arcadia has assembled a large, de-identified real-world dataset combining claims and clinically rich EHR data sourced directly from provider systems. The result is a longitudinal, research-grade asset with depth and clinical context that is difficult to replicate through aggregation alone

- Life Sciences is a strategic pillar built on this foundation. Arcadia has made a deliberate, multi-year investment in:

- Purpose-built real-world data assets

- Clinically connected solutions that link insight back into provider workflows

- A growing research and collaboration ecosystem to expand data use rights

- Dedicated leadership, product, data, and operational resources

- The opportunity is to sell—and help shape—solutions that connect data, analytics, and real-world clinical activation across the pharma development lifecycle, backed by enterprise credibility and executive commitment

-
This role is a founding, hands-on commercial leadership role, accountable for building the direct Life Sciences revenue engine, and deeply involved in shaping deals, messaging, and market positioning

-
This role is not a channel-only or account maintenance role, a narrowly scoped quota-carrying role with a fixed playbook, and insulated from product, delivery, or execution realities

About Arcadia

Arcadia.io helps innovative providers and payers across the country transform healthcare to reduce cost while improving patient health. We do this by aggregating large amounts of disparate data, applying algorithms to identify opportunities to provide better patient care, and making those opportunities actionable by physicians at the point of care in near-real time. We are passionate about helping our customers drive meaningful outcomes. We are growing fast and have emerged as a market leader in the highly competitive population health management software market and have been recognized by industry analysts KLAS, IDC, Forrester, and Chilmark for our leadership. For a better sense of our brand and products, please explore our website.
Protect Yourself
If you have concerns about the authenticity of a job offer or recruitment-related communication claiming to be from Arcadia, we encourage you to verify by contacting us directly at (781) 202-3600 and select option 3. For more information, visit our website.
This position is responsible for following all Security policies and procedures in order to protect all PHI under Arcadia's custodianship as well as Arcadia Intellectual Properties. For any security-specific roles, the responsibilities would be further defined by the hiring manager.

remote.title: Account Executive, Mid-Market
remote.description:
About Osmind

Osmind is a public benefit corporation advancing psychiatry through technology, services, and real-world evidence to bring innovative mental health treatments to patients in need. Osmind's psychiatry-tailored software and services, used by leading psychiatry practices across the U.S., help improve patient outcomes while driving practice success. Osmind's network of over 1000 clinics comprises the country's largest network of interventional psychiatry practices. Simultaneously, Osmind's clinic network, point-of-care software, and real-world data support life sciences companies in developing and scaling access to cutting-edge treatments. Osmind is a 50-person, Series B-stage company and has raised funding from top investors such as DFJ Growth, Y Combinator, and General Catalyst.

The Opportunity

We're hiring a second mid-market Account Executive to close deals that give psychiatry practices offering innovative treatments the technology and services to treat more patients in need. These practices are growing, and the operational and financial side of running these programs is where they most often get stuck. You'll work with a physician owner, a practice administrator, and usually someone who runs the business side and will ask hard questions. These are substantial relationships, often six figures. You'll report to our Director of Sales.

Pipeline comes to you, from inbound demand and from two Founding BDRs who join at the same time to build our outbound motion. Your job is to run the deal from the first meeting through signature.

These practices rarely buy on features. They buy because their current setup isn't built for the new era of psychiatry, and that limits how many patients they can treat. Getting it right for a clinic has a direct effect on access to care.

What You'll Do

- Run mid-market deals from the first meeting through signature, aligning clinical, operational, and business stakeholders along the way.

- Diagnose which of our offerings fits a practice early in the conversation. Selling the wrong one is the most common way these deals are lost.

- Build the financial and ROI case. These practices buy on what they collect, so you'll need to be fluent enough in accounts receivable, denials, and net collection rate to hold your own with whoever runs their billing.

- Displace incumbents on how they're actually performing rather than on a feature comparison.

- Qualify with discipline, and verify what a practice tells you before investing a full cycle in it.

- Partner closely with the Founding BDRs: give fast, specific feedback on what you accept and why, and coach by example.

- Keep forecasting and pipeline hygiene in good order, and contribute to how we improve the way this segment is measured.

- Represent Osmind at industry conferences and events (quarterly travel).

- Use AI to increase selling effectiveness: leverage Gong, Claude, and other tools to cut manual admin so more of your week goes to selling.

What We're Looking For

- 3+ years closing deals end to end at six-figure contract values, with multi-stakeholder buying committees and 5+ years of closing experience overall

- Experience selling into independent medical practices — you understand how clinicians and clinic owners make purchasing decisions

- Genuine comfort with the numbers: you can talk through practice P&L yourself rather than handing it off

- Experience selling services, or services alongside software, rather than seats alone

- Disciplined qualification — you'd rather disqualify in week one than carry a weak deal for a quarter

- AI-first instincts, with a point of view on where it helps in a sales cycle

- Startup experience at Series A through C companies, demonstrating an ability to run autonomously and embrace ambiguity

Bonus points

- Experience with/understanding of interventional psychiatry treatments, including the REMS requirements attached to some of them

- Familiarity with prior authorization, verification of benefits, or payer contracting

- Experience selling EHR, RCM, or practice management software

THE JOB RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE

remote.title: Senior/Lead Lifecycle Marketing Manager (Full Remote - Greece)
remote.description:
Our Vision & Products

EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

More than 50 million people already use EverAI’s products, and we’re growing toward 100 million.

The audience is already here. The opportunity is what happens next.

We’re hiring a Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager to take CRM to an entirely new level. Your mission is clear: turn it into a major revenue channel by converting more users, increasing repeat purchases, and giving people compelling reasons to keep coming back.

You’ll own everything within CRM, from onboarding and first purchase to retention and reactivation, across email, push notifications, in-product messaging, and promotions.

You’ll report directly to Thomas Lacroix, our Co-founder and CMO, with the freedom to rethink journeys, test ambitious ideas, and build the CRM playbook that gets us there.

At our scale, even small improvements can influence millions of user journeys and create significant growth.

If you’re looking for more than a campaign-management role, this is your opportunity to drive measurable growth at exceptional scale.

Your Responsibilities

-
Own one of EverAI’s biggest growth opportunities: lead the strategy and execution across the full CRM lifecycle, from onboarding and conversion through repeat purchasing, retention, and reactivation

-
Find the growth hiding in our user base: use behavioral data to uncover where users lose interest, stop engaging, or miss an opportunity to purchase

-
Crack the first-purchase challenge: create onboarding, abandoned-payment, offer, and follow-up journeys that turn more registered users into paying customers

-
Keep users coming back: increase token purchases, repeat purchasing, retention, reactivation, and LTV through smarter segmentation, personalization, and timing

-
Test big ideas quickly: build experiments, measure what genuinely moved the numbers, scale the winners, and turn each result into the next opportunity

-
Make ambitious CRM ideas possible: work directly with Product, Data, Engineering, and Creative to improve the tooling, tracking, messages, offers, and reporting behind the channel

Your Qualifications

-
You’ve scaled CRM before: you can show significant improvements you personally drove in revenue, conversion, repeat purchases, retention, reactivation, or LTV, with real numbers

-
You understand consumer growth: you’ve worked in a high-volume B2C subscription business, where CRM had a direct effect on revenue

-
You think like a builder: you do not stop at recommendations; you can personally create segments, journeys, experiments, campaign logic, and performance analysis

-
You know how to find and prove what works: you can turn user behavior into ideas and use testing, control groups, attribution, and incrementality to validate the results

-
You move quickly and take ownership: you are comfortable building without a finished playbook, deciding what matters most, and creating momentum without waiting for perfect information

-
You communicate clearly and work across teams: you collaborate directly with technical, creative, and commercial stakeholders in English

-
You are comfortable with our product category: you can confidently work on products powered by uncensored AI models and content

Bonus points

-
You have worked in iGaming, free-to-play gaming, fintech, consumer subscriptions, or high-frequency e-commerce

-
You have experience with token, credit, virtual-currency, bonus, or repeat-deposit models

-
You have built or redesigned CRM in a fast-scaling company

-
You use AI to improve analysis, personalization, experimentation, or content development

Why EverAI?

Exponential Growth: From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work

‍‍‍ Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together

Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected
Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications
Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD
⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

If that’s you — reach out and apply!

remote.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Subject Matter Expert (SME), you'll be the deepest technical voice in the field for one product group, helping customers make technical decisions on GitLab's most important opportunities, roughly the top 10% by size or complexity.

Account Solutions Architects (Account SAs) will bring you into prioritized opportunities. The Account SA owns the opportunity; you own your product group's success within it. You'll work directly with Product and Engineering, bringing customer needs and field insights into roadmap discussions. You'll also help the wider Solutions Architecture team build expertise through reusable assets, enablement, and coaching.

You'll specialize in one product group, not all four. In Security & Compliance, you'll focus on GitLab Ultimate, application security, Dependency Firewall, software supply chain security, compliance, and artificial intelligence (AI) governance. In Platform, you'll focus on GitLab Dedicated, self-managed deployments, bring your own model, and cloud and hybrid architecture. In Core DevSecOps, you'll focus on GitLab Premium, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), source code management, Orbit, Artifact Central, and migrations. DevSecOps brings development, security, and operations together across software delivery. In AI & Competitive, you'll focus on GitLab Duo Agent Platform, agentic workflows, AI-native development, competitive displacement including GitHub, and migrations.

Your success will be measured by technical win rate and bookings on SME-engaged opportunities, product-category commit attainment and consumption growth in your region, and Proof of Value (PoV) conversion rate, evaluation cycle time, and time from technical win to production use. We'll also measure how often Account SAs reuse your assets, their confidence in handling your product group without escalation, and the quality and impact of your feedback to Product.

What you’ll do

- Act as the technical authority for your product group on prioritized opportunities, from discovery and architecture through trials and PoV evaluations.

- Lead technical deep dives, workshops, and executive briefings that connect product capabilities to business outcomes and explain how GitLab differs from competing solutions.

- Design and improve standardized PoV templates with clear, repeatable success criteria. Account SAs own the customer PoV; you'll contribute product-specific content and expertise while keeping the evaluation connected to the broader GitLab platform.

- Equip account teams for product launches with Product Management and Product Marketing. Build demos and talk tracks, and turn early customer wins into reference stories.

- Serve as the escalation point for Account SAs and Post-Sales Solutions Architects (Post-Sales SAs) on complex product questions, integrations, and objections.

- Hand off PoV success criteria and architecture decisions to the Post-Sales SA with the account team when an opportunity closes. Stay involved until the customer's first production workload uses the product, and support complex accounts when Post-Sales SAs bring you in to drive adoption and consumption.

- Bring structured field feedback, competitive insights, and customer requirements to Product Management and Engineering with the wider SME team. Help manage early-access and design-partner programs, and represent GitLab through customer events, conferences, industry working groups, and published content.

- Build reference architectures, demo environments, competitive battlecards, PoV playbooks, and enablement content so account teams can handle more opportunities without your direct involvement. Mentor Account SAs and contribute to GitLab's global SME community of practice.

What you’ll bring

- Substantial experience in technical pre-sales, solutions architecture, consulting, or software engineering, with deep, hands-on expertise in one domain: application security testing, supply chain security, and compliance; scalable cloud and hybrid platforms; large CI/CD environments and source code migrations; or production AI-assisted development, working prototypes, and competitive evaluations.

- Practical expertise in agentic and AI-assisted development workflows across planning, coding, testing, security, and delivery, applied in a customer-facing, pre-sales context.

- Experience winning technical decisions on large, complex enterprise opportunities through structured Proof of Concept (PoC) or PoV evaluations with defined success criteria and executive sign-off.

- Hands-on experience with Git, CI/CD, containers, Kubernetes, and at least one major cloud provider.

- The ability to lead a whiteboard session with engineers and present the business case to executives in the same meeting.

- Strong written communication, including the ability to turn complex topics into clear playbooks that others use.

- Comfort working asynchronously across time zones with Sales, Product, and Engineering.

- Optional: public speaking, published technical content, open source contributions, or relevant certifications in Kubernetes, cloud architecture, or security.

If you bring transferable experience in an adjacent domain, we encourage you to apply.

About the team

We're building our SME organization within GitLab's Solutions Architecture team, and we're distributed and all-remote.

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

- Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being

- Flexible Paid Time Off

- Team Member Resource Groups

- Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan

- Growth and Development Fund

- Parental Leave

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.

GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. remote.title: Staff Backend Engineer
remote.description:
We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

London / UK Remote | Staff Backend Engineer (L60) £130,000 - £170,000 + Equity + Benefits | Technology - Engineering

About our Engineering Teams:

We have around 650 engineers out of roughly 5,500 people in total - and we have big ambitions. There are many interesting challenges ahead, and we're happy for people to move between teams or to specialise, whatever you prefer. As an engineer here you'd be able to work directly with anyone across the company, and we run regular knowledge-sharing sessions so you’ll learn heaps about everything from how banks work to effective communication.

We contribute to open source software as much as possible. Our blog is a good place to learn even more about what we do!

What you’ll be working on:

We rely heavily on the following tools and technologies:

- Go to write our application code (there’s an excellent interactive Go tutorial here)

- Cassandra for most persistent data storage

- Kafka for our asynchronous message queue

- Envoy Proxy for RPC

- Kubernetes and Docker to schedule and run our services

- AWS for most of our infrastructure

- React for internal web dashboards

- We also have two physical datacenter sites with actual cables to connect to various third parties

Your day-to-day

This role is all about collaborating across disciplines to test hypotheses and make a difference to customers. As a product backend engineer you’ll work in a squad alongside product managers, marketers, user researchers, designers, mobile engineers, web engineers, data analysts, business analysts, writers and more!

Together you'll build and support a particular part of Monzo. Our squads belong to our wider collectives (a word we use to describe self-governing business units of ~100 people). Our collectives are doing innovative work, many of which have machine learning and AI at the forefront - from fighting financial crime to building smarter financial tools - and you may have the opportunity to join a collective that gives you direct exposure to this exciting space.

Our backend engineers have a variety of different backgrounds. As long as you enjoy learning new things, we’d love to talk to you. We do not ask for formal qualifications or degree requirements for any of our engineering roles.

How we work

Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles.

Work the way that works for you with Monzo!

You should apply if:

Our average process takes around 2-3 weeks but we will always work around your availability.

One of our engineers has written a detailed blog on their experience through this process, for extra details, hints and tips please see here.

£130,000 - £170,000 + Equity

✈️We can help you relocate to the UK

This role can be based in our London office or remotely across the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).

⏰We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.

Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences

➕And much more, see our full list of benefits here

remote.title: GRC Analyst (EMEA)
remote.description:
Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk.

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

Security Engineer, Governance, Risk & Compliance (EMEA)

The role:

GRC work is at its best when it makes security clearer, more consistent, and easier to operate. As a Security Engineer focused on Governance, Risk & Compliance, you’ll help maintain and improve Chainguard’s compliance and risk programs while building the experience and judgment to take on broader ownership over time.

You’ll work closely with experienced security and GRC partners to support SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 audit readiness, keep evidence and controls organized, help manage risk and remediation work, and improve the systems and processes behind our compliance program.

This is an earlier-career, hands-on role. You don’t need to have led an audit or built a GRC function before. We’re looking for someone with strong organizational habits, good judgment, curiosity, and a willingness to learn. You’ll have clear areas of responsibility, regular opportunities to work cross-functionally, and support from teammates as you grow your expertise.

Chainguard is building the secure foundation for software development and deployment. You’ll contribute to that mission by helping our security practices remain effective, measurable, and worthy of our customers’ trust.

What you’ll do:

-
Support audit readiness activities for SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and other security assurance initiatives.

-
Coordinate evidence collection with teams across Security, Engineering, Legal, HR, Product, and other functions.

-
Help maintain security policies, standards, procedures, control descriptions, and supporting documentation.

-
Assist with control testing, risk assessments, gap analysis, and remediation tracking.

-
Keep compliance and risk information accurate and up to date in GRC platforms such as Vanta.

-
Help translate auditor, customer, and internal security requests into clear next steps for the right stakeholders.

-
Track action items, follow up on dependencies, and communicate status, risks, and blockers clearly.

-
Identify opportunities to simplify and improve GRC workflows through better documentation, automation, and use of modern tooling.

-
Develop and maintain repeatable processes, checklists, runbooks, and evidence-collection practices.

-
Support customer security reviews, questionnaires, and third-party risk activities as needed.

-
Learn Chainguard’s systems and security practices well enough to ask useful questions, identify inconsistencies, and escalate potential risks with clear context.

-
Partner with senior members of the Security and Governance, Risk & Compliance teams on projects that improve Chainguard’s security posture.

What we’re looking for:

-
2+ years of experience in information security, GRC, compliance, audit, risk, IT, or a related field; equivalent practical experience is welcome.

-
Experience supporting audits, control activities, risk assessments, security questionnaires, or compliance programs.

-
Strong organizational and project coordination skills, with the ability to manage details across multiple workstreams.

-
Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain requests and findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

-
A structured, detail-oriented approach to documentation, evidence management, and follow-through.

-
Curiosity about how technology and security controls work, with the confidence to ask questions and investigate unfamiliar topics.

-
Comfort working with spreadsheets, documentation systems, ticketing tools, and GRC platforms.

-
An interest in improving repetitive processes through automation, better tooling, or clearer workflows.

-
A collaborative, team-first approach and the ability to work effectively with colleagues across regions and functions.

-
Comfort working in a fast-moving environment where priorities and processes continue to evolve.

Nice to have:

-
Experience with SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST, or another security or assurance framework.

-
Familiarity with GRC platforms such as Vanta, Drata, or similar tools.

-
Experience with control testing, risk registers, remediation plans, or policy management.

-
Exposure to cloud environments, SaaS applications, software development practices, or security operations.

-
Familiarity with third-party risk management or customer security reviews.

-
Experience improving workflows with automation, integrations, or lightweight scripting.

Why you’ll love it here:

We take security seriously without making it unnecessarily complicated. At Chainguard, you’ll:

-
Learn by doing: Work on real security and assurance programs with support from experienced teammates.

-
Challenge the status quo: Help simplify processes, improve tooling, and find better ways to get important work done.

-
Collaborate across borders: Partner with colleagues across EMEA and the broader Chainguard organization.

-
Grow your scope: Build the technical judgment and program-management skills needed to take on increasingly complex security initiatives.

-
Win together: We share context, assume good intentions, and value collective success over individual heroics.

-
Bring your whole self: We do serious work, but we also believe humor, curiosity, and enjoying the people you work with make the work better.

Base Salary Range

$89,000—$105,000 USD

About Us

We live and breathe our company values:

- We are customer obsessed — We focus on delivering solutions to our customers that create value and make their lives better.

- We have a bias for intentional action — We prioritize, plan, try things, and fail fast.

- We don't take ourselves too seriously (but we do serious work) — We are solving an important problem which takes focus, but we also like to enjoy the journey.

- We trust each other and assume good intentions — We're transparent with decisions to empower team members to make well informed decisions.

A few of the benefits we offer:

- Flexible & Remote-First Culture: Work remotely with team meetup opportunities, bi-annual destination summits, and a monthly stipend for coworking spaces, phone and internet costs.

- Our Approach to Equity: Receive stock options upon hire and promotion. Plus, you can participate in secondary offerings and have 10 years to exercise your options (yes, you read that correctly: 10 years!).

- 100% Covered Health Insurance: We cover 100% of your health, vision and dental insurance premiums for you and your dependents. Nothing comes out of your paycheck.

- ∞ Flexible Time Off: Take the time you need – to do our best work, we need to recharge and reset.

- 18 Weeks Paid Parental Leave: We offer 18 weeks for birthing parents and 12 weeks for non-birthing parents, with the option to use it all at once or throughout your child's first year.

If your experience is close but doesn't fulfill all requirements, please apply. We're building the best team in technology and are focused on hiring "Chainguardians" with unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.

We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

remote.title: Senior/Lead Lifecycle Marketing Manager (Full Remote - Netherlands)
remote.description:
Our Vision & Products

EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next

At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands)

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

More than 50 million people already use EverAI’s products, and we’re growing toward 100 million.

The audience is already here. The opportunity is what happens next.

We’re hiring a Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager to take CRM to an entirely new level. Your mission is clear: turn it into a major revenue channel by converting more users, increasing repeat purchases, and giving people compelling reasons to keep coming back.

You’ll own everything within CRM, from onboarding and first purchase to retention and reactivation, across email, push notifications, in-product messaging, and promotions.

You’ll report directly to Thomas Lacroix, our Co-founder and CMO, with the freedom to rethink journeys, test ambitious ideas, and build the CRM playbook that gets us there.

At our scale, even small improvements can influence millions of user journeys and create significant growth.

If you’re looking for more than a campaign-management role, this is your opportunity to drive measurable growth at exceptional scale.

Your Responsibilities

-
Own one of EverAI’s biggest growth opportunities: lead the strategy and execution across the full CRM lifecycle, from onboarding and conversion through repeat purchasing, retention, and reactivation

-
Find the growth hiding in our user base: use behavioral data to uncover where users lose interest, stop engaging, or miss an opportunity to purchase

-
Crack the first-purchase challenge: create onboarding, abandoned-payment, offer, and follow-up journeys that turn more registered users into paying customers

-
Keep users coming back: increase token purchases, repeat purchasing, retention, reactivation, and LTV through smarter segmentation, personalization, and timing

-
Test big ideas quickly: build experiments, measure what genuinely moved the numbers, scale the winners, and turn each result into the next opportunity

-
Make ambitious CRM ideas possible: work directly with Product, Data, Engineering, and Creative to improve the tooling, tracking, messages, offers, and reporting behind the channel

Your Qualifications

-
You’ve scaled CRM before: you can show significant improvements you personally drove in revenue, conversion, repeat purchases, retention, reactivation, or LTV, with real numbers

-
You understand consumer growth: you’ve worked in a high-volume B2C subscription business, where CRM had a direct effect on revenue

-
You think like a builder: you do not stop at recommendations; you can personally create segments, journeys, experiments, campaign logic, and performance analysis

-
You know how to find and prove what works: you can turn user behavior into ideas and use testing, control groups, attribution, and incrementality to validate the results

-
You move quickly and take ownership: you are comfortable building without a finished playbook, deciding what matters most, and creating momentum without waiting for perfect information

-
You communicate clearly and work across teams: you collaborate directly with technical, creative, and commercial stakeholders in English

-
You are comfortable with our product category: you can confidently work on products powered by uncensored AI models and content

Bonus points

-
You have worked in iGaming, free-to-play gaming, fintech, consumer subscriptions, or high-frequency e-commerce

-
You have experience with token, credit, virtual-currency, bonus, or repeat-deposit models

-
You have built or redesigned CRM in a fast-scaling company

-
You use AI to improve analysis, personalization, experimentation, or content development

Why EverAI?

Exponential Growth: From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
️ Paid Time Off: 4 weeks (20 working days) of PTO per year to recharge and reset
‍‍‍ Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together
❤️‍ Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of 100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members)
Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected
Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications
Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD
⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

If that’s you — reach out and apply!

remote.title: Marketing Team Lead
remote.description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

Marketers at Canonical are brand stewards and demand creators. They transform complex open-source technology into messages, stories, and strategies that shape the market understanding of our vision. Some focus on differentiated product and portfolio positioning; others specialize in account-based engagement, partner and alliance messaging, or product-led growth. Whatever their specialization, each marketer works as part of a cross-functional unit, contributing campaigns and insights that help the company learn and grow faster.

We have a bias for action, focus efforts on the most impactful activities, and take ownership of our results. We work across long buying cycles, balance storytelling with data, design experiments, track outcomes, and iterate rapidly to find what works.

Marketers at Canonical don’t just promote open source; they amplify it, ensuring our innovations reach the right people, at the right time, with clarity and purpose from developers to decision makers.

As an experienced marketer at Canonical, you’ll lead cross-disciplinary teams of product, partner, or sales professionals in your specific area, from establishing priorities and strategies with senior stakeholders to delivering on integrated campaigns. We are looking for both generalists who want to take ownership of a product portfolio or channel, and for specialists who can help the whole team excel in their domain of expertise.

Location: This is a globally remote role; you can be based in EMEA, APAC, or the Americas, depending on the team’s location.

The role entails

You will take ownership of one of our core marketing tracks and lead both strategy and execution. You’ll ensure campaigns land, launches succeed, and adoption grows, while contributing to the broader go-to-market engine.

You will:

- Lead GTM strategy and campaign execution in your functional area

- Align with product, sales, content, and partner teams to deliver integrated plans

- Shape messaging, positioning, and assets that resonate with customers

- Design and run experiments to test your hypothesis

- Drive major launches, marketing initiatives, and growth programs

- Run reviews and retrospectives to improve performance and impact

- Mentor colleagues, strengthen the function, and set high standards for delivery

What we are looking for in you

- Strong written and verbal communication in English

- Exceptional academic track record from high school and university

- Proven experience in B2B marketing, ideally in software, SaaS, or open source

- Strong track record shaping go-to-market strategy, messaging, and campaigns that move the pipeline

- Fast adaptation to change and new technology adoption in marketing

- A leader, growing and elevating others across the organization

- A solid eye for ROI and effective budget management

- Ability to influence and align stakeholders across the organization

- Excellent communication and storytelling skills for technical solutions

- Skilled at managing complex projects and leading cross-functional teams

- Comfortable using data to evaluate campaigns and refine strategy

- Proactive, outcome-driven, and confident, operating independently at a global scale

Nice-to-have skills

- Background in sales-led or ecosystem growth

- Familiarity with ABM (Account-Based Marketing) approaches

- Experience leading go-to-market efforts across a large product portfolio

- Experience managing budgets, agencies, or external vendors

- Understanding of open source communities and business models

- Experience mentoring or leading junior marketers

What we offer you

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilization. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.
In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, please ask your Talent Partner.

Fully remote working environment - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!

Personal learning and development budget of 2,000 USD per annum

Annual compensation review

Recognition rewards

Annual holiday leave

Parental Leave

‍Employee Assistance Programme

Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at ‘sprints’

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

remote.title: Staff Software Engineer, Security Factory: Static Analysis
remote.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Staff Backend Engineer on GitLab's Security Factory: Code Scanning team, you help developers find and fix security issues. Those issues live in the code they write, and you set the technical direction for the static analysis engine that finds them.

Your work spans two complementary parts of a complete security analysis. On the engine side, you shape how the static analysis toolkit models a program: parsing source into intermediate representations, resolving symbols, building call graphs, and tracking tainted data across files and languages. You define the architecture and specifications the team builds against, and you delegate component specifications within them to engineers and to the AI agents that implement them. On the evaluation side, you build and apply tooling that tests, measures, and validates what the engine finds against benchmark applications with known vulnerabilities.

What the engine can model and how we measure what it finds are parts of one picture. As a Staff engineer you hold that picture, shape the long-range technical goals of the team, and raise the bar for every engineer on it. We build the engine with AI agents that write and review code from written specifications, under human direction. We expect you to direct that work effectively and with good judgment, and to help the team do the same.

What you do

- Act as the directly responsible individual (DRI) for the team's highest-scope initiatives from design through delivery, shipping large features with minimal guidance and shaping the long-range goals of the team

- Bring systems built by one engineer to team ownership through documentation, tests, and shared review

- Set the technical direction for the AI-assisted tooling that implements, reviews, and validates engine changes and findings, design the checks that decide whether an agent-written change or generated result is fit to merge, and measure detection quality against benchmark applications with known vulnerabilities, raising the bar for what counts as a trustworthy result. That includes static application security testing (SAST) rules mapped to CWE and OWASP, and the test fixtures that prove they work.

- Own the architecture of the program model (parsing, symbol resolution, intermediate representations, call graphs, and taint and data-flow analysis) and of the pipeline that turns source code into findings, and define how both extend to new languages and frameworks

- Solve technical problems of the highest scope and complexity, actively seek out difficult impediments affecting the whole team, and advocate for improvements to quality, security, and performance with Product Management, UX, and partner teams such as Code Security and Composition Analysis

- Mentor all engineers on the team through code review and pairing, remove blockers to their autonomy, and shepherd the definition and improvement of our internal standards through review

- Participate in on-call rotations to assist troubleshooting product operations, security operations, and urgent engineering issues

- Define the overarching architecture and specification documents for the engine, delegate component specifications within them, and drive their implementation by AI agents and engineers working independently through phased plans, small reviewable units of change, and specifications kept in lockstep with the code

- Build and maintain the harness, agent instructions, and agentic skills that keep agent-written code trustworthy, including separate coding and reviewing agents, rules and tests the coding agents cannot change, independent review panels of agents from different model providers, and performance, API, and dependency gates, with risky changes escalated to human review

- Stay current with research in program analysis and security, run AI-assisted research and spikes, and turn the findings into prototypes, proposals, and upstream contributions, including responsible disclosure of findings in open source projects

What you bring

- Experience building your own LLM tooling, such as a harness, an agent pipeline, or evaluations, with the judgment to know when output is trustworthy and when it isn't

- Extensive professional experience writing, testing, and reviewing production code in Rust, Go, or a comparable systems language, with depth in at least one. The engine is Rust, the analyzer wrapper is Go, and the monolith integration is Ruby, and we value willingness to work across them.

- Experience with performance optimization and with containerized workflows and CI/CD (we use Docker heavily)

- A deep program analysis and static analysis background, such as parsing and ASTs, intermediate representations (SSA, control-flow and call graphs), taint and data-flow analysis, type inference, incremental and fixpoint computation, or writing detection rules, with the ability to read, evaluate, and apply the research literature

- Deep application security experience, such as vulnerability research, secure code review, or writing detection rules, and fluency with vulnerability classes (OWASP Top 10, CWE)

- Demonstrated capacity to communicate clearly and concisely about complex technical, architectural, and organizational problems, and to write architecture and design specifications that bring a team to a decision

- A track record of taking ownership of ambiguous, team-wide problems and shipping them from concept to production with minimal guidance, with specific, regular async updates on progress, blockers, risks, and next steps

- Experience defining a system's overarching architecture, delegating component specifications to engineers and AI agents, and getting them implemented reliably

- A track record of mentoring engineers, raising a team's technical bar, and influencing technical direction by achieving consensus with peers and leadership

Helpful experience

- Familiarity with popular web or mobile application frameworks and how they handle input, data, and configuration

- Experience designing guardrails for agent-written code, such as mutation testing, fuzzing, and CI gates the coding agent cannot modify

- A record of engaging with the research community, such as publications, tool papers, or upstream open source contributions in program analysis or security

About the team

The Security Factory: Code Scanning team develops GitLab's SAST capabilities for customer software repositories.

We work closely with the Code Security team on scanning rules & flows, with Composition Analysis on the broader software supply chain, and with other groups across the Sec Section. We rely heavily on asynchronous work across time zones.

Remote-Global

The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.

United States Salary Range

$152,800—$259,200 USD

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

- Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being

- Flexible Paid Time Off

- Team Member Resource Groups

- Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan

- Growth and Development Fund

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.
