remote.title: Senior/Lead Lifecycle Marketing Manager (Full Remote - UK)
remote.description:
Our Vision & Products

EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next

At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands)

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

More than 50 million people already use EverAI’s products, and we’re growing toward 100 million.

The audience is already here. The opportunity is what happens next.

We’re hiring a Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager to take CRM to an entirely new level. Your mission is clear: turn it into a major revenue channel by converting more users, increasing repeat purchases, and giving people compelling reasons to keep coming back.

You’ll own everything within CRM, from onboarding and first purchase to retention and reactivation, across email, push notifications, in-product messaging, and promotions.

You’ll report directly to Thomas Lacroix, our Co-founder and CMO, with the freedom to rethink journeys, test ambitious ideas, and build the CRM playbook that gets us there.

At our scale, even small improvements can influence millions of user journeys and create significant growth.

If you’re looking for more than a campaign-management role, this is your opportunity to drive measurable growth at exceptional scale.

Your Responsibilities

-
Own one of EverAI’s biggest growth opportunities: lead the strategy and execution across the full CRM lifecycle, from onboarding and conversion through repeat purchasing, retention, and reactivation

-
Find the growth hiding in our user base: use behavioral data to uncover where users lose interest, stop engaging, or miss an opportunity to purchase

-
Crack the first-purchase challenge: create onboarding, abandoned-payment, offer, and follow-up journeys that turn more registered users into paying customers

-
Keep users coming back: increase token purchases, repeat purchasing, retention, reactivation, and LTV through smarter segmentation, personalization, and timing

-
Test big ideas quickly: build experiments, measure what genuinely moved the numbers, scale the winners, and turn each result into the next opportunity

-
Make ambitious CRM ideas possible: work directly with Product, Data, Engineering, and Creative to improve the tooling, tracking, messages, offers, and reporting behind the channel

Your Qualifications

-
You’ve scaled CRM before: you can show significant improvements you personally drove in revenue, conversion, repeat purchases, retention, reactivation, or LTV, with real numbers

-
You understand consumer growth: you’ve worked in a high-volume B2C subscription business, where CRM had a direct effect on revenue

-
You think like a builder: you do not stop at recommendations; you can personally create segments, journeys, experiments, campaign logic, and performance analysis

-
You know how to find and prove what works: you can turn user behavior into ideas and use testing, control groups, attribution, and incrementality to validate the results

-
You move quickly and take ownership: you are comfortable building without a finished playbook, deciding what matters most, and creating momentum without waiting for perfect information

-
You communicate clearly and work across teams: you collaborate directly with technical, creative, and commercial stakeholders in English

-
You are comfortable with our product category: you can confidently work on products powered by uncensored AI models and content

Bonus points

-
You have worked in iGaming, free-to-play gaming, fintech, consumer subscriptions, or high-frequency e-commerce

-
You have experience with token, credit, virtual-currency, bonus, or repeat-deposit models

-
You have built or redesigned CRM in a fast-scaling company

-
You use AI to improve analysis, personalization, experimentation, or content development

Why EverAI?

Exponential Growth: From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
️ Paid Time Off: 4 weeks (20 working days) of PTO per year to recharge and reset
‍‍‍ Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together
❤️‍ Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of 100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members)
Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected
Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications
Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD
⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

If that’s you — reach out and apply!

Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

Canonical’s product management team are technologists who have a passion for delivering products and solutions that help shape market demands while elevating open source software everywhere. This is a general application track for the product management positions at Canonical. You will set a clear vision, prioritize work effectively, and ensure the team delivers high-quality products that meet business and user needs. Apply here if you excel at leadership, communication, and technical vision, and believe you can drive product strategy for the business needs of tomorrow. During the interview process we will identify specific software products which would be a good fit for your interests.

We believe that open source is transforming the way that enterprises solve their business needs. Although open source has been around for thirty years, it is only now fundamental to every corner of the software landscape. Going forward we believe open source will have an even bigger impact as it moves into specialised vertical markets. Our goal is to make open source easier, more reliable and more secure for deployment and development. We strive to be the provider of ‘most software to most companies’, starting with Ubuntu but expanding to cover every class of application on every class of compute. To deliver on that ambition, we select product managers for their intellect and strong drive to advance the open source community. Together, we aim to improve open source quality, outreach, and impact. Our product managers set the vision and the direction to ensure teams deliver the right products in the right markets at the right time. They push the boundaries of the technology landscape to identify and deliver products into new and existing market opportunities.

Our product managers are technology professionals with a software engineering background who strive to become business executives and entrepreneurs. We discuss strategy, plan product development, drive engagement, and promote the open source way. We oversee the entire product lifecycle from conception to delivery, blending technical expertise, strategic thinking, analytics, project management skills and effective communication to ensure products meet both user needs and business objectives.

We have open product manager roles across a wide range of product domains, including:

- Ubuntu Platform - Our Ubuntu experience on Desktop, Server, Windows (WSL), Multipass, Gaming, Enterprise, & Hardware Enablement

- Ubuntu Pro Services - Our key commercial offerings Ubuntu Pro, Compliance, Standards, Security Engineering, and Managed Services on cloud and on prem

- AI/ML & MLOps - Open source AI/ML solutions, AIOps automation, model lifecycle management, Kubeflow, MLFlow, KServe, and AI infrastructure on cloud and edge

- IoT - Ubuntu on embedded devices and/or edge servers, device management, and robotics

- Cloud - Ubuntu in public and private clouds, promoting automation frameworks, and including technologies such as Kubernetes, MAAS, and LXD

- Telco - Open source for Telco's including technologies and standards related to Core Network, RAN/vRAN, SoNIC, DENT, and SmartNICs

- Finance - Open source solutions for financial institutions including trading platforms, blockchain technologies, regulatory compliance, and AI-driven analytics

- Automotive - Open source solutions for autonomous driving, in-vehicle infotainment, connected vehicles, and compliance with automotive industry standards such as ISO 26262 and ISO 21434

- Application Management - Open source solutions in the enterprise including Observability, IAM, App Stores and technologies such Grafana, GitOps, and Juju Charms

remote.title: Lead Product Designer (100% Remote within Poland)
remote.description:
About us

Docplanner's mission is to help people live longer, healthier lives. Every month about 100 million people visit our sites and 25 million appointments are booked across 13 countries, and 300,000 doctors use our software (docplanner.com).

You'll join PMS Global, the group building the software clinics and doctors run on. We're building Noa, our AI assistant, into the daily work of doctors and front desks. The group is organised in verticals named after the people they serve: the doctor running a visit, the owner running the business, the practice signing up on its own.

The design team here is small and growing. As its Lead designer, you'll set the standard others work to and help the team grow.

The role

You'll own the design of an area of our practice management software (PMS), the tools clinics use every day to run visits, calendars and the business. You'll set design direction across the teams in that area and shape how it fits with the rest of the product. You'll help decide whether something is worth building, and why, before anyone decides how. This is an individual contributor role.

We want clinics to spend less time on manual work, from documenting a visit to getting it invoiced and paid, and owners to see what needs their attention without digging through reports.

What success looks like

-
After 3 months: you've been shipping since your first weeks, you can name the outcomes your area should move and the user behaviours behind them (where clinic staff lose time, work around the product or drop off), and you and product agree on the bigger problems worth solving. Clinics already feel it: your first fixes save front desks and doctors time on everyday tasks.

-
After 6 months: your first larger build is live with its impact measured, you're setting design direction across teams, and other designers are building on your patterns. For clinics this means less manual admin and fewer workarounds; for doctors, more time with patients and less time on the screen; for owners, a clearer view of how the practice is doing.

What you'll do

-
Discover continuously: talk to doctors, clinic owners and staff often, whatever project you're on.

-
Identify and solve bottlenecks: with product and engineering, find the friction points in the user journey and in how the team works, and fix them.

-
Drive clarity from complexity: balance user and business needs in areas like billing, records and reporting, and turn ambiguous problems into clear, strategic solutions.

-
Start with an LLM: use AI to clarify intent, draft short specs and surface risks and edge cases before opening a design tool.

-
Co-create with PMs and engineers from day one: define UX requirements early, stay through QA and release, and make engineering-aware decisions.

-
Shape high-leverage experiences: exceptional UI and UX for information-dense screens, from concept to polish, using the best tools to explore more directions faster and raise quality.

-
Prototype and build with AI: use Cursor and Claude Code to turn concepts into interactive prototypes and production-ready front-end code; move fluidly between code and Figma.

-
Validate and measure: run quick tests and track funnels, adoption and retention.

-
Lead without managing: set direction across teams, coach designers, and turn what works into patterns and practices others reuse.

What you bring

-
Multi-disciplinary craft: strong UI, UX and visual design skills, with a track record of functional yet delightful experiences in information-dense, data-heavy products, ideally B2B SaaS. You write clear interface copy and can tell the story behind a design.

-
Comfortable in code: you prototype in code with AI tools and know enough HTML and CSS to work with engineers on the front end. You don't need to be a front-end engineer.

-
Experimentation mindset: a deep understanding of product metrics, behaviour analytics and A/B testing, and experience with Amplitude, Mixpanel or similar tools. Your portfolio shows experiments and measurable outcomes.

-
Passion and drive: deep care for product design and UX craft, and for the business outcomes they move. Ambition, ownership and a rising bar.

-
Comfortable with ambiguity: you work at speed without dropping quality, and know when to go deep and when to execute.

-
Reasoning: first-principles thinking, sharp structure, resistance to bias, attention to the details that matter.

-
Team spirit: generous, backs the best idea, hands-on, reliable, honest and transparent.

-
Lead-level scope: you've shaped direction across several teams or products, and other designers have grown by working with you.

-
Proficient English.

Design and AI at Docplanner

AI is changing how products are designed and built. We want our designers to explore how AI can improve both the design process and the product, from faster prototyping to Noa, the assistant inside our clinic software. We're looking for designers who are curious about new technology and experiment with AI in their own work. If you've worked on AI features or use AI tools in your design process, show us examples in your portfolio.

Let’s talk money

-
A salary adequate to your experience and skills.

True flexibility and work-life balance

-
Remote or hybrid work model with or hub in Warsaw;

-
Flexible working hours (fully flexible, as in most cases you only have to be on a couple of meetings weekly);

-
20/26 days of paid time off (depending on your contract);

-
Additional paid day off on your birthday or work anniversary (you choose what you want to celebrate).

Health comes first

-
Private healthcare plan with Signal Iduna for you and subsidized for your family.

-
Multisport card co-financing for you to have access to sports facilities across Poland.

-
Access to iFeel, a technological platform for mental wellness offering online psychological support and counseling.

Keep growing with us

-
Free English and Spanish classes.

We promote and embrace equal opportunities in our hiring process, and also every day at work. When you apply for our roles you receive equal treatment regardless of age, disabilities, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or parental status, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation or any other dimension of human difference. If you require additional support in your recruitment process, we kindly encourage you to let us know. Behind those words you’re reading, there’s a person (hi!) who already helped a candidate by adapting the interviews, and now we’re lucky to have this person with us. So, even if you’ve never asked for it before, may this serve as a sign that, now, you can do so. We can only truly be equal if we adapt to each other.

remote.description:
HackerOne is a global leader in Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM) and the only solution provider that pairs the simultaneous trust of the Fortune 500 and the world's largest community of security researchers to secure the AI-native enterprise. The H1 Platform unites agentic AI solutions with security researchers ingenuity to continuously discover, validate, prioritize, and remediate exposures across code, cloud, and AI systems. Through solutions such as agentic and human offensive security testing, AI red teaming, code security, validation, and remediation, HackerOne delivers measurable, continuous reduction of cyber risk for enterprises. Industry leaders, including Anthropic, Crypto.com, General Motors, Goldman Sachs, Lufthansa, Uber, UK Ministry of Defence, and the U.S. Department of Defense, trust HackerOne to safeguard their digital ecosystems. HackerOne was recognized in Gartner’s Emerging Tech Impact Radar: AI Cybersecurity Ecosystem report for its leadership in AI Security Testing.

HackerOne Values

HackerOne is dedicated to fostering a strong and inclusive culture. HackerOne is Customer Obsessed and prioritizes customer outcomes in our decisions and actions. We Default to Disclosure by operating with transparency and integrity, ensuring trust and accountability. Employees, researchers, customers, and partners Win Together by fostering empowerment, inclusion, respect, and accountability.

Senior Counsel, Employment & Compliance

Remote Locations

U.S.: Seattle, San Francisco Bay Area, Austin, Washington DC, or Boston

UK: London

Position Summary

HackerOne seeks a trusted business partner and pragmatic builder with an ownership mentality to lead the Legal team’s employment, litigation, and compliance function. The Senior Counsel will co-own outcomes with business stakeholders across the company and balance legal and reputational risk with high-acceleration growth. This position reports directly to the Chief Legal Officer.

As Senior Counsel, you will be a hands-on and solutions-oriented member of the Legal team and will support the company in its mission to build a safer internet. You will be asked to own and operationalize corporate compliance programs, including governance, ethics and compliance, and workforce policies and processes, and serve as a data-driven, strategic partner in aligning legal guidance to business objectives.

At HackerOne, we embrace a Flexible Work approach that gives us the freedom to do our best work while also fostering the connections and community that make us stronger. Reflecting this philosophy, this is a remote role targeted for candidates within ~50 miles of Seattle, WA; San Francisco, CA; Austin, TX; Boston, MA, Washington, DC or London, UK. We believe this balance of proximity and flexibility gives Hackeronies the chance to occasionally come together – fostering collaboration, connection, and in-person moments that enrich our culture – while still preserving the benefits of remote work.

Primary Responsibilities

-
Serve as a trusted senior advisor to executives, People team members, and cross-functional stakeholders on complex U.S. and global labor and employment matters, including hiring and recruiting, compensation, benefits, leave, accommodations, and related topics.

-
Advise on and assist the People team with sensitive U.S. and global employee relations issues, including compliance, security, and EEO investigations, performance management, terminations/redundancies, and other related matters.

-
Coordinate with Commercial, Product, and Revenue team members to advise on platform and marketplace legal risk, while balancing business objectives.

-
Manage dispute resolution, legal process, and litigation, including legal holds, investigations, e-discovery, and subpoenas and law enforcement or regulatory investigations.

-
Provide counsel on regulatory and compliance issues related to HackerOne’s platform, customers, and workforce, including conflicts of interest, third-party due diligence, Terms of Service, audits, and other areas, as needed.

-
Act as an AI-forward legal partner by identifying opportunities to use AI to improve legal research, risk identification, workflow efficiency, knowledge management, and business resiliency while applying sound judgment regarding confidentiality, accuracy, bias, transparency, and human oversight.

Talent Principles

At HackerOne, how we work is just as important as what we accomplish. We expect every employee of Hackerone to demonstrate our Talent Principles in their day-to-day work.

-
AI Native – Thoughtfully leverage AI to improve legal research, streamline workflows, strengthen risk identification, and create scalable solutions while maintaining appropriate confidentiality, accuracy, and human oversight.

-
Change Agility – Navigate evolving regulations, shifting business priorities, and ambiguity with adaptability and sound judgment, helping stakeholders respond effectively to change.

-
Data-Driven Decision Making – Use relevant data, legal insights, and risk assessments to inform recommendations, prioritize actions, and support sound business decisions.

-
First Principles Problem Solving – Break down complex legal and compliance challenges to identify root causes, challenge assumptions, and develop practical, sustainable solutions.

Minimum Qualifications

-
J.D. from an ABA-accredited law school or global equivalent, with active bar admission in good standing in the applicable practice jurisdiction.

-
7+ years of legal experience in a law firm or in-house legal department, including substantive experience advising on global labor and employment matters, compliance, employee relations, and investigations.

-
Demonstrated experience managing complex legal matters, including litigation or dispute resolution, regulatory compliance, and cross-functional legal advisory work, with the ability to provide clear, practical guidance to business stakeholders.

-
Experience independently evaluating complex legal and business risks, using evidence and sound judgment to inform decisions, adapting to changing regulatory environments, and managing multiple competing priorities through resolution.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working in-house at a B2B SaaS, cybersecurity, or platform-based technology company.

-
Experience advising on or overseeing anti-bribery and corruption, privacy and data security, AML, KYC, OFAC, or security incident matters.

-
Experience using AI-powered legal technology or automation to improve legal research, compliance processes, risk management, or operational efficiency while maintaining appropriate professional and ethical safeguards.

remote.title: Account Manager, Life Sciences
remote.description:
About AlphaSense:

AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com. Come join us.

Location: US Remote

Reports to: Director, Account Management

About the Team:

Our Customer Success team is made up of Customer Success Managers and Account Managers who are passionate about helping our clients succeed. We partner with a diverse range of organizations, from Fortune 1000 companies to some of the largest financial institutions globally.

As a team, we are committed to providing value to our clients. We take a consultative approach to solve challenges through our product, ensuring our customers have the right data to make informed decisions. We focus on retaining customers, maximizing product usage, and collaborating with the sales team to uncover growth opportunities.

About the Role:

The Account Manager, Corporate is responsible for developing three-dimensional relationships with customers and key stakeholders in order to effectively retain and grow our customer base. In this role, you will serve as our Corporate clients' main point of contact for inbound queries, outbound engagement, relationship updates, and renewal discussions. You'll need to be versatile. You will manage a portfolio of clients within one of the industry-aligned books of business described below. In this role, you'll be expected to collaborate with account executives, identifying new business opportunities to help expand our footprint within each client account.

While key performance indicators include retention rate and the identification of growth opportunities, the responsibilities of Account Managers go much deeper. The team also extracts a wealth of knowledge from our clients, bringing that internally to product, marketing and sales teams in order to maximize the effectiveness of our business' strategy and communication.

Books of Business:

Our Corporates & Consulting Account Management team is organized into industry-aligned books of business. Depending on team needs at the time of hire, you may manage accounts in one of the following areas.

Corporations

- Life Sciences & Healthcare: Clients use AlphaSense to track therapeutic pipelines, benchmark deals, and analyze markets.

- Tech, Media & Telecom: Clients monitor product launches, competitor strategy, and market disruption.

- Energy: Clients follow policy changes, M&A activity, and supply chain risk.

- Industrials: Clients scan for M&A, capital expenditure trends, and global demand.

- Consumer Goods & Retail: Clients track pricing moves, retailer strategy, and consumer demand.

Consulting & Professional Services

- Consulting: Firms use AlphaSense to build proposals and client deliverables with less research time.

- Law Firms: Firms use legal research to prepare cases and shape strategy.

- Insurance: Carriers use AlphaSense to inform underwriting decisions and risk analysis.

A note on industry background: Prior experience in any of the industries above is not required to apply. We assess for account management skill and client relationship experience. Industry knowledge can be built on the job.

Who You Are:

- Commercially accountable: You have at least three years of experience in an account management role where you owned retention and growth for an existing book of business. You've carried renewal and expansion targets for client accounts you managed after the initial sale.

- Relationship-driven: You have a strong ability to develop instant rapport with new people and you've demonstrated success at managing and growing relationships within Fortune 1000 clients.

- A subject matter expert: You excel at what you do and know how to succeed within your role. This includes both internal and external relationship management as well as strong business acumen and commitment to effective processes and tactics.

- Energetic and Creative: You possess a natural intellectual curiosity with the ability to learn and adapt quickly.

- You understand our business: We are a rapidly growing SaaS company and are incredibly passionate about our product. We are looking for individuals who understand best practices for client engagement within a SaaS environment.

- Committed to delivering results: You set the example for grit, work ethic, initiative, enthusiasm and commitment amongst your peers.

- A strong communicator: You'll regularly be engaged with anyone from an Analyst to a C-level executive and that requires exceptional oral, written and presentation skills. You'll need to distill and explain complex issues in simple terms.

What You'll Do:

- Maximize retention rate across the book of business

- Increase and drive adoption of AlphaSense solutions into other business units of existing clients to uncover new opportunities, exceeding monthly, quarterly and annual revenue goals

- Identify revenue at risk in order to best position the company to prevent churn

- Forecast retention rates

- Collaborate with Account Executives to identify growth opportunities within the book of business

- Understand the ins and outs of the business, roles, responsibilities, projects, performance metrics, etc. within our client base in order to more effectively: 1) communicate with users, 2) communicate with decision makers, 3) identify white space, 4) partner with AE to craft most compelling messaging to prospective users

- Cultivate relationships with users and key stakeholders to ensure AlphaSense is viewed as a business partner rather than vendor

- Hold Business Reviews with key stakeholders

- Consistent proactive outreach with material and information that's relevant for our user base

- Serve as our boots on the ground and physical presence within each client (floor walks, lunch and learns, etc.)

- Serve as both the advocate for AlphaSense to the client, and the client advocate within AlphaSense

- Acquire value stories and product feedback from clients. Circulate internally to assist with product development, marketing, sales efforts

For base compensation, we set standard ranges for all roles based on function and level benchmarked against similar stage growth companies and internal comparables. In order to be compliant with local legislation, as well as to provide greater transparency to candidates, we share salary ranges on all job postings regardless of desired hiring location. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience/expertise and may vary from the amounts listed below.

You may also be offered a performance-based bonus, equity, and a generous benefits program.

Base Compensation Range

$100,000—$120,000 USD

AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.

In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.

Recruiting Scams and Fraud

We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note:

- AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.

- If you’re unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our Careers page.

If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.

remote.description:

LaunchDarkly is seeking a Sr. Director, Enablement to join our Revenue team. This position will report to the VP, Revenue Operations and Enablement. The Revenue Operations and Enablement team is responsible for sales strategy, technology, and enablement. The Sr. Director, Enablement will build a repeatable enablement framework to systematically support all segments of LaunchDarkly’s Revenue Organization. This role will ensure that all customer-facing personnel have the knowledge, content, skills, processes, and behaviors needed to optimize every interaction with buyers. The role will also oversee the planning and execution of Revenue Organization events, including SKOs.

The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker with leadership experience in a revenue-focused organization where enablement is integrated into every interaction. They bring deep experience developing enablement programs, supporting ongoing employee development, and implementing the processes and tools required to build a world-class enablement function.

Responsibilities:

- Own the multi-year revenue enablement strategy and roadmap, aligned to GTM priorities, with quarterly outcomes tied to ramp time, win rate, and quota attainment.

- Lead and grow a global team of enablement leaders and specialists, setting clear priorities, coaching for excellence, and operating as a player-coach where needed.

- Architect role-based onboarding and continuous readiness for all revenue roles (Sales, Sales Managers, SEs, CS, BDR/SDR, PAMs), covering product, process, messaging, and selling skills, including pitch certification, with ramp metrics tracked from day one.

- Equip teams to win with technical buyers by developing playbooks, talk tracks, objection handling, and competitive messaging for developer, platform engineering, DevOps, and engineering leadership personas, and by owning the sales playbook for Land & Expand motions, including New Logo and Expansion plays.

- Own the enablement track for the annual GTM kickoff and quarterly business reviews, with full oversight of content and readiness.

- Modernize the enablement tech stack (LMS, CMS, sales engagement, conversation intelligence) and embed AI into seller workflows to accelerate productivity, coaching, and deal execution, while maintaining a company-wide content map that serves as a single source of truth for the field.

- Partner with the CRO, VP Sales, VP CS, Product, Product Marketing, and Partner leaders to align messaging, qualification frameworks, and customer journey execution, and advise GTM leadership on readiness and change management for new initiatives.

- Define and drive the partner enablement strategy, aligned with internal enablement programs and GTM motions.

- Track record of scaling onboarding and enablement in a high-growth environment.

- Deep expertise in core enablement disciplines: value selling, sales process and methodologies, coaching, skill development, and presentation skills.

- History of designing and launching partner enablement programs.

- Prior work in a GTM strategy role, with a strong grasp of how enablement connects to revenue planning.

- Success planning and executing large-scale events, such as global sales kickoffs.

- Time spent carrying a quota in a selling role.

- Leadership of a sales-related function, such as Sales Development, Inside Sales, or Enterprise Sales.

remote.title: Senior Director of Nursing
remote.description:
About Abby Care: Powering the future of care at home for all of America.

Abby Care is building the leading AI-native platform for family-led care. America is facing a growing care crisis. Millions more people need care at home than ever. Over 50 million family caregivers support loved ones without the tools, training, or recognition they deserve.

We believe families are the largest untapped caregiving workforce in America, and that technology can help them deliver better care while driving stronger outcomes and greater transparency across the healthcare system.

Abby Care combines clinical oversight with an AI-powered platform to train, enable, and support family caregivers in delivering high-quality care at home. Our platform helps health plans and government partners better understand, verify, and improve care in the home. We expand access to care, reduce reliance on higher-cost settings, and help ensure public dollars are spent effectively.

We are proud to partner with leading health plans, providers, and community organizations and are backed by top VCs. We envision a future where family-led care is a core part of the healthcare system. Abby Care is building that future.

Join us in solving one of the most important challenges of our time.

The Opportunity:

Abby Care is scaling our capacity to support family caregivers and medically complex patients across the country, and our clinical leadership team is also expanding. We’re hiring for a Senior Director of Nursing/Administrator to provide strategic, multi-state clinical leadership and operational governance across a designated region. This high-impact senior leadership role reports to our Head of Clinical Operations, and directly manages, coaches, and holds accountable the local Directors of Nursing (DONs)/Administrators to ensure the highest standards of patient care, operational efficiency, and regulatory compliance.

A savvy leader, serving as the bridge between regional clinical performance and executive leadership comes naturally. Executive presence and strong communication skills are hallmarks of your leadership style, you have a proven ability to distill complex clinical data into actionable insights. Data-driven, you are comfortable utilizing business intelligence tools and clinical dashboards to measure performance and hold leaders accountable. Collaborative, you work easily across teams and balance a macro-level strategic mindset with a rigorous focus on execution; partnering cross-functionally with Senior General Managers, Compliance, HR, and Product teams to scale clinical capacity, exceed quality benchmarks, and ensure continuous survey readiness. If you are excited about the opportunity to build the future of care at home, we’d love to hear from you.

This is a Full-Time Remote opportunity based in Central or Eastern Time Zones with the ability to travel to various Abby Care markets.

What you’ll work on:

Regional Executive Governance & Accountability

-
Executive Report Outs: Own the aggregation, analysis, and presentation of regional clinical and quality performance metrics to the executive team.

-
Strategic Alignment: Translate corporate clinical strategies into standardized, actionable operational practices across multiple markets and states.

-
Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner closely with Regional Senior General Managers to align clinical quality with market growth targets, and collaborate with HR, Compliance, Finance, and Product/IT teams to optimize operations.

Clinical Capacity & Workforce Strategy

-
Macro Capacity Planning: Oversee regional clinical capacity models to ensure local agencies can support census growth, service line expansions, and geographic surges.

-
Leadership Development: Standardize onboarding, mentoring, and professional growth pathways for local DONs/Administrators to build a resilient, high-performing leadership pipeline.

-
Retention & Culture: Monitor regional nursing turnover and burnout trends; partner with HR to implement regional strategies that champion clinician well-being and engagement.

Quality Benchmarks & Outcome Mastery

-
Regional Quality Ownership: Drive regional performance against enterprise clinical quality strategy, QA/QAPI initiatives, and utilization benchmarks.

-
Clinical Escalations & Edge Cases: Serve as the regional authority for the review and escalation of complex clinical edge cases, high-risk patient events, or severe adverse incidents.

-
Root Cause & Corrective Strategy: Lead regional root-cause analyses for adverse events, ensuring systemic adjustments are implemented across all markets to avoid recurrence, in partnership with compliance, HR and legal as necessary.

Multi-State Regulatory Compliance & Survey Readiness

-
Continuous Survey Readiness: Standardize a proactive, "always-ready" culture for CMS Conditions of Participation (CoPs), ACHC/Joint Commission accreditation, and varying state-specific regulations.

-
Audit & Response Leadership: Oversee the preparation for, and response to, state surveys and federal audits. Review and sign off on all local Plans of Correction (POC) before execution.

-
Risk Mitigation: Work alongside the corporate Compliance team to proactively identify, track, and mitigate legal, financial, and clinical operational risks across the region.

Cross-Functional Workflow & Product Optimization

-
Tech & Product Collaboration: Partner directly with the Product/IT teams to drive technical updates that reduce clinician documentation burdens, and standardize clinical workflows across their markets.

-
Practice Standardization: Minimize unwarranted practice variations across state lines while ensuring strict adherence to individual state nursing practice acts.

What success looks like:

In 12 months, you will have successfully built a cohesive, high-performing regional nursing organization by standardizing operational workflows, achieving 100% survey readiness across all local agencies, and lowering clinician turnover. You will have established a data-driven governance cadence that directly correlates high clinical quality benchmarks with scalable census growth and seamless cross-functional execution.

What you’ll have:

-
Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN) required; Master of Science in Nursing (MSN), Master of Health Administration (MHA), or MBA strongly preferred.

-
Current, unrestricted Registered Nurse (RN) license. Multistate/Compact license eligibility required (and willingness to obtain licensure in additional states within the region as necessary).

-
Minimum of 5+ years of progressive home healthcare experience.

-
5+ years of clinical leadership experience in a home health or comparable multi-site setting (e.g., Regional DON, VP of Clinical Operations, or senior-level agency administrator).

-
Demonstrated experience managing multi-site teams, successfully leading agencies through state/federal regulatory surveys, and scaling clinical operations during rapid growth.

Benefits:

-

remote.title: Product Manager, Salesforce
remote.description:
About Kaseya

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success.

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in.

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.

Position Summary

Kaseya is seeking a strategic, detail-oriented Product Manager to join our Business Information Systems (BIS) team. This individual will drive the vision, roadmap, and execution of enterprise capabilities supporting our Product Business Systems (PBS), with a focus on product configuration, pricing, fulfillment, software provisioning, entitlements, usage, and overage management.

This role will support Kaseya’s current operating environment while helping shape the future-state architecture and processes needed to support continued growth and transformation. PBS capabilities span multiple platforms, including Salesforce, NetSuite, integrations, and Kaseya products such as Kaseya One. As Kaseya evolves its enterprise systems landscape, this individual will help guide the transition toward a scalable architecture anchored by Salesforce Revenue Cloud Advanced (RCA), Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Oracle ERP, and related applications.

The ideal candidate brings a strong understanding of the Lead-to-Cash lifecycle within an enterprise SaaS environment, including product and pricing configuration, bundle management, software license provisioning, entitlement management, and usage-based billing. This person must be comfortable navigating complex integrations, balancing competing priorities, and partnering across business and technical teams to simplify legacy processes, strengthen controls, and deliver scalable solutions.

Key Responsibilities

- Product Strategy and Roadmap: Define and manage the product roadmap for Product and Pricing, Fulfillment, and Provisioning capabilities, ensuring alignment with corporate strategy, revenue operations priorities, finance transformation goals, customer experience improvements, and future-state migration objectives.

- Product and Pricing Management: Lead capabilities related to product configuration, catalog management, SKU creation, product hierarchies, master data governance, pricing models, discount management, renewal pricing, promotions, and bundle configuration.

- Fulfillment and Provisioning: Drive requirements and solutions for automated, manual, and hybrid provisioning models, fulfillment routing, tenant and instance creation, customer-to-tenant mapping, license provisioning, and entitlement lifecycle management.

- Lead-to-Cash Lifecycle: Lead requirements definition and solution alignment across the Lead-to-Cash lifecycle, including product and pricing setup, order fulfillment, provisioning, usage capture, overage management, billing, revenue recognition, and reporting.

- Product Ownership and Agile Delivery: Own and manage the product backlog, develop clear user stories and acceptance criteria, and lead backlog refinement, sprint planning, discovery sessions, solution reviews, demonstrations, and other Agile ceremonies.

- Systems and Integration Management: Serve as a subject matter expert across current and future-state platforms, including Salesforce, Salesforce Revenue Cloud Advanced, NetSuite, Oracle ERP, MuleSoft, Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), Kaseya One, and related applications. Partner with technical teams to ensure reliable integrations and consistent data flows.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Finance, Billing Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Customer Operations, Product, Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, Security, and IT to gather requirements, prioritize initiatives, resolve issues, and deliver scalable business outcomes.

- Business Process Optimization: Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, reduce manual intervention, clarify ownership, improve operational handoffs, strengthen governance, and increase automation across PBS capabilities.

- Transformation and Migration Readiness: Balance support for legacy systems with future-state transformation priorities, ensuring legacy enhancements deliver measurable value, reduce operational risk, or improve migration readiness.

- Governance, Risk, and Compliance: Ensure solutions align with enterprise policies, internal controls, data privacy, and security requirements. Maintain clear documentation of requirements, business rules, integration dependencies, decisions, testing coverage, and operational readiness.

- Continuous Improvement: Monitor system performance, user adoption, data quality, defect trends, billing accuracy, provisioning effectiveness, and operational outcomes to identify opportunities for improvement and scalability.

- Delivery and Stakeholder Alignment: Partner with Engineering Leads, QA, Scrum Masters, Business Process Leads, and Release/PMO teams to manage dependencies, remove blockers, coordinate testing, and deliver capabilities aligned with business objectives and release milestones.

Required Qualifications

- 7+ years of experience in product management, product ownership, business systems analysis, CRM systems, revenue operations systems, or enterprise solution delivery.

- Proven experience with Lead-to-Cash, Quote-to-Cash, or subscription lifecycle processes within an enterprise SaaS environment.

- Strong working knowledge of Salesforce CPQ, Salesforce Revenue Cloud, Revenue Cloud Advanced, or comparable enterprise product configuration and pricing platforms.

- Experience with product catalog management, SKU management, pricing configuration, discounting, bundle management, or product master data governance.

- Hands-on experience with software license provisioning, entitlement management, or fulfillment workflows, including integrations using platforms such as MuleSoft or Boomi.

- Experience with usage-based pricing models, including usage capture, rating, overage management, and associated billing or revenue processes.

- Understanding of integrated system flows across sales, order management, billing, accounts receivable, collections, revenue recognition, and reporting.

- Demonstrated success managing cross-functional Agile delivery teams and driving complex enterprise initiatives from requirements through implementation.

- Strong understanding of business process mapping, technical integrations, data dependencies, user stories, acceptance criteria, and system controls.

- Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to influence decisions and drive alignment across business and technical teams.

- Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment while balancing business-as-usual support, competing priorities, and future-state transformation initiatives.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Salesforce Revenue Cloud Advanced (RCA), Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Oracle ERP, NetSuite, MuleSoft, or Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC).

- Experience supporting enterprise SaaS subscription models, managed service providers (MSPs), usage-based billing, and customer lifecycle processes.

- Familiarity with Kaseya One or comparable software provisioning, entitlement, and license management platforms.

- Experience with revenue operations, billing operations, finance transformation, or enterprise business systems within a complex, integrated technology environment.

- Experience supporting enterprise architecture modernization, legacy platform transitions, data governance initiatives, and large-scale systems migration.

- Knowledge of revenue recognition and billing metadata requirements associated with product, pricing, usage, and subscription management.

Additional information
Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

remote.title: Director, New Business Operations
remote.description:
Cloudinary is the Image and Video API platform trusted by millions of developers and over 10,000 companies worldwide. Our powerful tools fuel websites to be faster, richer in user engagement, and breakthrough creativity. With a growing suite of products that support everything from developer efficiency to brand storytelling, Cloudinary is becoming the visual layer of the web.

Cloudinary has a globally distributed team across North America, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific, united by a shared commitment to building smart, scalable technology and a culture rooted in humility, curiosity, and collaboration. At Cloudinary, we celebrate Life & Work. We believe in healthy growth, working with purpose, and creating meaningful value. If you’re looking for a place where your voice matters and your work truly makes an impact, this may be the opportunity for you.

Cloudinary is looking for a Director, New Business Operations to make our New Business organization more predictable, focused, and effective as we scale. You will own the operating system behind our New Business motions - the processes, data, cadence, and tools that help leaders and sellers turn pipeline into ARR.

Reporting to the VP, Revenue Operations & Enablement, you will be the operating partner to New Business leadership, Account Executives, and Sales Engineers. You will work cross-functionally with Marketing, Pricing, Finance, IT, Legal, Data, Enablement, and Channels & Alliances to improve how the business runs.

This role is ideal for a hands-on operator who combines sales-operations expertise, analytical judgment, cross-functional execution, and a high bar for clarity and adoption. You will build the systems and rhythms that make it easier to inspect performance, resolve blockers, and improve field execution without owning the sale itself.

Responsibilities:

• Own and evolve the operating model and cadence for all New Business motions, including standards, agendas, decision rights, and priorities.

• Lead forecast readiness and opportunity inspection, giving leaders an accurate, timely view of performance, risk, upside, stage progression, qualification, next steps, close dates, and opportunity health.

• Improve pipeline hygiene, opportunity completeness, and Salesforce data quality; combine Account Executive, Sales Engineer, and system signals to surface deal risk, blockers, and forecast changes early.

• Build and curate reporting that drives decisions, consolidating redundant dashboards into clear, useful views for New Business leaders and the field.

• Lead cross-functional initiatives involving CRM, CPQ, RFPs, pricing, and other GTM systems and processes from problem definition through delivery and adoption.

• Translate field needs into clear requirements, acceptance criteria, and success measures; coordinate owners, make tradeoffs visible, remove blockers, and escalate decisions with context.

• Partner with Marketing, Enablement, and Channels & Alliances to align handoffs and shared workflows, and convert field feedback into a prioritized improvement backlog.

• Create durable playbooks and inspection mechanisms; measure adoption, data quality, forecast accuracy, and process performance, and use the evidence to improve the operating model.

About You:

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience, plus 10+ years of progressive experience in Business Operations, Sales Strategy, or related roles in B2B SaaS or technology companies.

• Experience owning or materially shaping the operating model for New Business or enterprise sales motions.

• Strong experience with forecasting, pipeline management, opportunity inspection, and revenue-process discipline.

• Salesforce experience and familiarity with GTM systems such as CPQ and RFP tools, are highly desired.

• A proven ability to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives from requirements through delivery, adoption, and measurable outcomes.

• Strong analytical and data-storytelling skills, with the judgment to distinguish useful decision support from reporting noise.

• Exceptional stakeholder-management, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create alignment and accountability without direct authority.

• Comfort moving between executive-level framing and detailed execution, with a high bar for clarity, urgency, organization, and follow-through.

Nice to Have:

• Experience supporting global, technical, or developer-focused sales organizations.

• Experience simplifying and increasing efficiencies of GTM processes.

• Familiarity with Cloudinary's market, including APIs, cloud technologies, digital asset management, or media workflows.

#LI-BP1

Compensation

Additional Information

We have you in mind. As an employee, you will experience many benefits, including:

Awesome technology

Top-talent peers

100% sponsored medical, dental, and vision plans for employees & family

HSA company contribution

Matching 401k program

Robust vacation & wellness policy

Annual development stipend

Catered lunches or a food stipend

The Account Executive supports client services efforts in a critical way, connecting the activities of the agency to clients. The Account Executive is responsible for implementing projects to promote and support the success and profitability of client deliverables. In implementing projects, the Account Executive drives the daily tasks of by communicating with key internal service delivery personnel and leading client communications.

remote.title: Account Manager, Consulting & Professional Services
remote.description:
About AlphaSense:

AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com. Come join us.

Location: US Remote

Reports to: Director, Account Management

About the Team:

Our Customer Success team is made up of Customer Success Managers and Account Managers who are passionate about helping our clients succeed. We partner with a diverse range of organizations, from Fortune 1000 companies to some of the largest financial institutions globally.

As a team, we are committed to providing value to our clients. We take a consultative approach to solve challenges through our product, ensuring our customers have the right data to make informed decisions. We focus on retaining customers, maximizing product usage, and collaborating with the sales team to uncover growth opportunities.

About the Role:

The Account Manager, Corporate is responsible for developing three-dimensional relationships with customers and key stakeholders in order to effectively retain and grow our customer base. In this role, you will serve as our Corporate clients' main point of contact for inbound queries, outbound engagement, relationship updates, and renewal discussions. You'll need to be versatile. You will manage a portfolio of clients within one of the industry-aligned books of business described below. In this role, you'll be expected to collaborate with account executives, identifying new business opportunities to help expand our footprint within each client account.

While key performance indicators include retention rate and the identification of growth opportunities, the responsibilities of Account Managers go much deeper. The team also extracts a wealth of knowledge from our clients, bringing that internally to product, marketing and sales teams in order to maximize the effectiveness of our business' strategy and communication.

Books of Business:

Our Corporates & Consulting Account Management team is organized into industry-aligned books of business. Depending on team needs at the time of hire, you may manage accounts in one of the following areas.

Corporations

- Life Sciences & Healthcare: Clients use AlphaSense to track therapeutic pipelines, benchmark deals, and analyze markets.

- Tech, Media & Telecom: Clients monitor product launches, competitor strategy, and market disruption.

- Energy: Clients follow policy changes, M&A activity, and supply chain risk.

- Industrials: Clients scan for M&A, capital expenditure trends, and global demand.

- Consumer Goods & Retail: Clients track pricing moves, retailer strategy, and consumer demand.

Consulting & Professional Services

- Consulting: Firms use AlphaSense to build proposals and client deliverables with less research time.

- Law Firms: Firms use legal research to prepare cases and shape strategy.

- Insurance: Carriers use AlphaSense to inform underwriting decisions and risk analysis.

A note on industry background: Prior experience in any of the industries above is not required to apply. We assess for account management skill and client relationship experience. Industry knowledge can be built on the job.

Who You Are:

- Commercially accountable: You have at least three years of experience in an account management role where you owned retention and growth for an existing book of business. You've carried renewal and expansion targets for client accounts you managed after the initial sale.

- Relationship-driven: You have a strong ability to develop instant rapport with new people and you've demonstrated success at managing and growing relationships within Fortune 1000 clients.

- A subject matter expert: You excel at what you do and know how to succeed within your role. This includes both internal and external relationship management as well as strong business acumen and commitment to effective processes and tactics.

- Energetic and Creative: You possess a natural intellectual curiosity with the ability to learn and adapt quickly.

- You understand our business: We are a rapidly growing SaaS company and are incredibly passionate about our product. We are looking for individuals who understand best practices for client engagement within a SaaS environment.

- Committed to delivering results: You set the example for grit, work ethic, initiative, enthusiasm and commitment amongst your peers.

- A strong communicator: You'll regularly be engaged with anyone from an Analyst to a C-level executive and that requires exceptional oral, written and presentation skills. You'll need to distill and explain complex issues in simple terms.

What You'll Do:

- Maximize retention rate across the book of business

- Increase and drive adoption of AlphaSense solutions into other business units of existing clients to uncover new opportunities, exceeding monthly, quarterly and annual revenue goals

- Identify revenue at risk in order to best position the company to prevent churn

- Forecast retention rates

- Collaborate with Account Executives to identify growth opportunities within the book of business

- Understand the ins and outs of the business, roles, responsibilities, projects, performance metrics, etc. within our client base in order to more effectively: 1) communicate with users, 2) communicate with decision makers, 3) identify white space, 4) partner with AE to craft most compelling messaging to prospective users

- Cultivate relationships with users and key stakeholders to ensure AlphaSense is viewed as a business partner rather than vendor

- Hold Business Reviews with key stakeholders

- Consistent proactive outreach with material and information that's relevant for our user base

- Serve as our boots on the ground and physical presence within each client (floor walks, lunch and learns, etc.)

- Serve as both the advocate for AlphaSense to the client, and the client advocate within AlphaSense

- Acquire value stories and product feedback from clients. Circulate internally to assist with product development, marketing, sales efforts

For base compensation, we set standard ranges for all roles based on function and level benchmarked against similar stage growth companies and internal comparables. In order to be compliant with local legislation, as well as to provide greater transparency to candidates, we share salary ranges on all job postings regardless of desired hiring location. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience/expertise and may vary from the amounts listed below.

You may also be offered a performance-based bonus, equity, and a generous benefits program.

Base Compensation Range

$100,000—$120,000 USD

AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.

In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.

Recruiting Scams and Fraud

We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note:

- AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.

- All official communications will come from an @alpha-sense.com email address.

- If you’re unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our Careers page.

If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.

remote.title: Chief of Staff
remote.description:
About the Job:

LaunchDarkly is hiring a Chief of Staff to report to the CEO and partner with the Executive Leadership Team (ELT) as the company continues to scale. This is a senior, individual contributor role for a strategic operator and trusted advisor who thrives at the intersection of strategy, execution, communication, and data.

As Chief of Staff, you’ll help translate company strategy into action, shape executive-level planning and decision-making, and ensure leadership discussions are grounded in clear insights and high-quality materials. You’ll operate with significant autonomy, exercise wide latitude in how work gets done, and act as a thought partner to senior leaders across the organization.

This role is ideal for someone with deep experience navigating complex, cross-functional environments and a strong executive presence who is excited to have broad influence without people management responsibilities.

Responsibilities:

Strategic Leadership & Cross-Functional Execution

- Partner with the CEO to drive company-wide strategic initiatives from conception through execution. Help align the Executive Leadership Team and broader organization around priorities, tradeoffs, and outcomes. Proactively identify risks, dependencies, and gaps across critical initiatives and surface insights to leadership. Act as connective tissue across executives and teams to ensure strategy translates into coordinated action.

Operating Cadence & Company Planning

- Shape and support LaunchDarkly’s operating rhythm, including owning OKRs and leadership planning processes.

- Design and evolve planning frameworks that enable effective executive decision-making.

- Support annual and long-range planning cycles, synthesizing inputs and highlighting strategic implications.

Executive & Company Communications

- Lead the preparation and refinement of executive-level materials, including Board meeting materials and ELT presentations. Ensure executive content is clear, concise, decision-oriented, and aligned with company strategy.

Data, Insights & Analysis

- Partner on executive dashboards and reporting, ensuring metrics are accurate, consistent, and actionable.

- Analyze and understand data to inform strategic decisions and evaluate proposed initiatives.

- Translate analysis into clear recommendations for senior leadership audiences.

Executive Meetings & Offsites

- Design agendas and content for executive meetings and off-sites with a focus on alignment and outcomes.

- Capture key decisions, clarify next steps, and support follow-through across the organization.

Qualifications:

- Typically requires a minimum of 15 years of related experience, preferably in senior-level roles involving strategy, operations, consulting, finance, product operations, or executive advisory work.

- Demonstrated success partnering closely with executive leaders and influencing at the highest levels of an organization.

- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distill complexity into clear, compelling narratives.

- Strong analytical capabilities and comfort working with SaaS metrics and executive-level data.

- Ability to manage multiple, high-impact workstreams with sound judgment and prioritization.

- High degree of discretion, integrity, and emotional intelligence.

Pay:

Target pay ranges based on Geographic Zones* for Level 6:

- Zone 1: San Francisco/Bay Area or NYC Metropolitan Area, Boston, Seattle - $240,600 - $330,700**

- Zone 2: Irvine, LA, Monterey, Santa Barbara, Santa Rosa, Austin, Portland, Philadelphia, Chicago - $216,500 - $297,600**

- All Zones Inclusive of 10% Bonus Target

LaunchDarkly operates from a place of high trust and transparency; we are happy to state the pay range for our open roles to best align with your needs. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location.

*Within the United States, our geographic pay zones are defined by counties surrounding major metropolitan areas.
**Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), health, vision, and dental insurance, and mental health benefits in addition to salary.

About LaunchDarkly:

Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. Slow, inefficient development cycles, costly outages, and fragmented customer experiences are preventing developers from building their best software. The LaunchDarkly platform helps developers innovate on new features faster while protecting them with a safety valve to instantly rewind when things go wrong. Developers can target product experiences to any customer segment and maximize the business impact of every feature.
